translated_text: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.
original_text: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.

translated_text: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
original_text: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

translated_text:
And his master saw that the LORD
was with him, and that the LORD made all
that he did to prosper in his hand.
original_text:
And his master saw that the LORD
was with him, and that the LORD made all
that he did to prosper in his hand.

translated_text: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
original_text: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

translated_text:
And it came to pass from the time
that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.
original_text:
And it came to pass from the time
that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.

translated_text:
And he left all that he had in Joseph’s hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was
a goodly
person, and well favoured.
original_text:
And he left all that he had in Joseph’s hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was
a goodly
person, and well favoured.

translated_text: And it came to pass after these things, that his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.
original_text: And it came to pass after these things, that his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.

translated_text:
But he refused, and said unto his master’s wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what
is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;
original_text:
But he refused, and said unto his master’s wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what
is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;

translated_text:
There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou
art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?
original_text:
There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou
art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

translated_text:
And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her,
or to be with her.
original_text:
And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her,
or to be with her.

translated_text:
And it came to pass about this time, that
Joseph went into the house to do his business; and
there was none of the men of the house there within.
original_text:
And it came to pass about this time, that
Joseph went into the house to do his business; and
there was none of the men of the house there within.

translated_text: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.
original_text: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,
original_text: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,

translated_text: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:
original_text: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:

translated_text: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.
original_text: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.

translated_text: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.
original_text: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.

translated_text: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:
original_text: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:

translated_text: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.
original_text: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.
original_text: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.

translated_text:
And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king’s prisoners
were bound: and he was there in the prison.
original_text:
And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king’s prisoners
were bound: and he was there in the prison.

translated_text: But the LORD was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
original_text: But the LORD was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

translated_text:
And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners that
were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer
of it.
original_text:
And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners that
were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer
of it.

translated_text:
The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing
that was
 under his hand; because the LORD was with him, and
that which he did, the LORD made
it to prosper.
original_text:
The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing
that was
 under his hand; because the LORD was with him, and
that which he did, the LORD made
it to prosper.

translated_text:
And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name
was Hirah.
original_text:
And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name
was Hirah.

translated_text:
And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name
was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.
original_text:
And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name
was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.

translated_text: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.
original_text: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.

translated_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.
original_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.

translated_text: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.
original_text: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.

translated_text:
And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name
was
 Tamar.
original_text:
And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name
was
 Tamar.

translated_text: And Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD slew him.
original_text: And Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD slew him.

translated_text: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother’s wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.
original_text: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother’s wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.

translated_text:
And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother’s wife, that he spilled
it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.
original_text:
And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother’s wife, that he spilled
it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.

translated_text: And the thing which he did displeased the LORD: wherefore he slew him also.
original_text: And the thing which he did displeased the LORD: wherefore he slew him also.

translated_text:
Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father’s house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren
did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house.
original_text:

translated_text: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah’s wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
original_text: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah’s wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

translated_text: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.
original_text: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.

translated_text:
And she put her widow’s garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which
is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.
original_text:
And she put her widow’s garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which
is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.

translated_text:
When Judah saw her, he thought her
to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.
original_text:
When Judah saw her, he thought her
to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.

translated_text:
And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she
was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?
original_text:
And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she
was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?

translated_text:
And he said, I will send
thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give
me a pledge, till thou send
it?
original_text:
And he said, I will send
thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give
me a pledge, till thou send
it?

translated_text:
And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that
is in thine hand. And he gave
it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
original_text:
And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that
is in thine hand. And he gave
it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.

translated_text: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
original_text: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

translated_text:
And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive
his pledge from the woman’s hand: but he found her not.
original_text:
And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive
his pledge from the woman’s hand: but he found her not.

translated_text:
Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where
is the harlot, that
was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this
place.
original_text:
Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where
is the harlot, that
was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this
place.

translated_text:
And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said,
that there was no harlot in this
place.
original_text:
And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said,
that there was no harlot in this
place.

translated_text:
And Judah said, Let her take
it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.
original_text:
And Judah said, Let her take
it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.

translated_text:
And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she
is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.
original_text:
And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she
is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.

translated_text:
When she
was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these
are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose
are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.
original_text:
When she
was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these
are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose
are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.

translated_text:
And Judah acknowledged
them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.
original_text:
And Judah acknowledged
them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins
were in her womb.
original_text:
And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins
were in her womb.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when she travailed, that
the one put out
his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first,
original_text:
And it came to pass, when she travailed, that
the one put out
his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first,

translated_text:
And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth?
this breach
be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.
original_text:
And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth?
this breach
be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.

translated_text: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.
original_text: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.

translated_text: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.
original_text: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

translated_text:
Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that
were with him, Put away the strange gods that
are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:
original_text:
Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that
were with him, Put away the strange gods that
are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:

translated_text: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
original_text: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

translated_text:
And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which
were in their hand, and
all their earrings which
were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which
was by Shechem.
original_text:
And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which
were in their hand, and
all their earrings which
were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which
was by Shechem.

translated_text:
And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that
were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
original_text:
And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that
were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

translated_text:
So Jacob came to Luz, which
is in the land of Canaan, that
is, Bethel, he and all the people that
were with him.
original_text:
So Jacob came to Luz, which
is in the land of Canaan, that
is, Bethel, he and all the people that
were with him.

translated_text: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
original_text: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

translated_text: But Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bachuth.
original_text: But Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bachuth.

translated_text: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padan-aram, and blessed him.
original_text: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padan-aram, and blessed him.

translated_text:
And God said unto him, Thy name
is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.
original_text:
And God said unto him, Thy name
is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.

translated_text:
And God said unto him, I
am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
original_text:
And God said unto him, I
am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;

translated_text: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.
original_text: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.

translated_text: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.
original_text: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.

translated_text:
And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him,
even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.
original_text:
And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him,
even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.

translated_text: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.
original_text: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.

translated_text: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.
original_text: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.
original_text: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.

translated_text: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.
original_text: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.

translated_text:
And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which
is
 Bethlehem.
original_text:
And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which
is
 Bethlehem.

translated_text:
And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that
is the pillar of Rachel’s grave unto this day.
original_text:
And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that
is the pillar of Rachel’s grave unto this day.

translated_text: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.
original_text: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine: and Israel heard

 Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:

translated_text: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:
original_text: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:

original_text: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:

original_text:
And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these

translated_text:
And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which
is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
original_text:
And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which
is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

translated_text: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
original_text: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.

translated_text:
And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people,
being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
original_text:
And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people,
being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

translated_text: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
original_text: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

translated_text: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.
original_text: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.

translated_text: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.
original_text: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.

translated_text: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.
original_text: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.

translated_text: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.
original_text: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.

translated_text: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.
original_text: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.

translated_text:
And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard
it:
 and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter; which thing ought not to be done.
original_text:
And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard
it:
 and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter; which thing ought not to be done.

translated_text: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.
original_text: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.

translated_text:
And make ye marriages with us,
and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
original_text:
And make ye marriages with us,
and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.

translated_text: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.
original_text: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.

translated_text: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.
original_text: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.

translated_text: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
original_text: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.

translated_text: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:
original_text: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:

translated_text:
And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that
were a reproach unto us:
original_text:
And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that
were a reproach unto us:

translated_text: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
original_text: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

translated_text: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
original_text: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.

translated_text: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor’s son.
original_text: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor’s son.

translated_text: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.

translated_text:

original_text: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for an hundred pieces of money.

translated_text: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-elohe-Israel.

original_text: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

original_text: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.

translated_text: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.
original_text: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.

translated_text:

original_text: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.

translated_text: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:

translated_text:

original_text:
Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me,

translated_text: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
original_text: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

original_text: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;

original_text: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,

original_text: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.

translated_text:

They be thy servant Jacob’s; it

They be thy servant Jacob’s; it

original_text: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.

original_text: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

translated_text: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.

original_text: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.

original_text: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.

original_text: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

original_text:
And he said unto him, What

translated_text: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
original_text: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

Reuben, thou

original_text:

original_text:

original_text:
Cursed
be their anger, for

Judah, thou

were
 two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt,

were

translated_text: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
original_text: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.

translated_text: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
original_text: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

translated_text: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
original_text: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

translated_text: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.
original_text: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

translated_text:

original_text:

translated_text:

original_text:
And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I

translated_text: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.
original_text: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

For these two years

there are five years, in the which

 neither
be earing nor harvest.
original_text:
For these two years
hath the famine
been in the land: and yet
there are five years, in the which
there shall
 neither
be earing nor harvest.

translated_text: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
original_text: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

translated_text:
So now
it was not you
that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
original_text:
So now
it was not you

translated_text: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:
original_text: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:

translated_text: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children’s children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:
original_text: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children’s children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

translated_text:
And there will I nourish thee; for yet
there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.
original_text:
And there will I nourish thee; for yet
there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.

translated_text:
And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that
it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
original_text:
And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that
it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.

translated_text: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.
original_text: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.

translated_text: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
original_text: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

translated_text: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
original_text: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

translated_text: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, Joseph’s brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
original_text: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, Joseph’s brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

translated_text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
original_text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

translated_text: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.
original_text: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

translated_text: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
original_text: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

translated_text:
Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt
is yours.
original_text:
Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt
is yours.

translated_text: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
original_text: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

translated_text:
To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred
pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.
original_text:
To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred

translated_text:
And to his father he sent after this
manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.
original_text:
And to his father he sent after this
manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.

translated_text: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.
original_text: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.

translated_text: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,
original_text: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,

translated_text:
And told him, saying, Joseph
is yet alive, and he
is
 governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob’s heart fainted, for he believed them not.
original_text:
And told him, saying, Joseph
is yet alive, and he
is
 governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob’s heart fainted, for he believed them not.

translated_text: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:
original_text: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:

translated_text:
And Israel said,
It is enough; Joseph my son
is
 yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
original_text:
And Israel said,
It is enough; Joseph my son
is
 yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.

translated_text:
And it came to pass after these things, that
one told Joseph, Behold, thy father
is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
original_text:
And it came to pass after these things, that
one told Joseph, Behold, thy father

translated_text:

one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
original_text:
And
one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

translated_text: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
original_text: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

translated_text:

original_text:
And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee

translated_text:
And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt,

original_text:
And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt,

translated_text:

original_text:
And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine,
and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

translated_text:
And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet

original_text:

translated_text:
And Israel beheld Joseph’s sons, and said, Who

original_text:
And Israel beheld Joseph’s sons, and said, Who

translated_text:
And Joseph said unto his father, They
are my sons, whom God hath given me in this
place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.
original_text:
And Joseph said unto his father, They
are my sons, whom God hath given me in this
place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.

translated_text:
Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age,
so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
original_text:
Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age,
so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

translated_text: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.
original_text: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.

translated_text: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
original_text: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

translated_text:
And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought

original_text:
And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought

translated_text:
And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim’s head, who

And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim’s head, who
was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh

translated_text: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,
original_text: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,

translated_text: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
original_text: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

translated_text: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head unto Manasseh’s head.
original_text: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head unto Manasseh’s head.

translated_text:
And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this

original_text:

is

translated_text:

original_text:

translated_text: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
original_text: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

translated_text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
original_text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

translated_text: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.
original_text: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.

translated_text:

translated_text:
The land of Egypt

original_text:
The land of Egypt

original_text: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old
art thou?
original_text:
And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old
art thou?

original_text:

translated_text: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.
original_text: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.

original_text:

original_text:

there was no bread in all the land; for the famine

translated_text: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.
original_text: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.

translated_text: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.
original_text: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.

translated_text: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
original_text: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.

translated_text:
And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread
in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.
original_text:
And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread
in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

translated_text:
When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide
it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:
original_text:
When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide

translated_text:

original_text:

translated_text: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh’s.
original_text: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh’s.

translated_text:
And as for the people, he removed them to cities from
one
 end of the borders of Egypt even to the
other end thereof.
original_text:
And as for the people, he removed them to cities from
one
 end of the borders of Egypt even to the
other end thereof.

translated_text:

original_text:
Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion
assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.

translated_text:

here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.
original_text:
Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo,

translated_text: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.
original_text: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.

translated_text:
