original_text:
And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day,
that Pharaoh should have the fifth
part; except the land of the priests only,
which became not Pharaoh’s.

translated_text: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.
original_text: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

translated_text: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.
original_text: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.

translated_text: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:
original_text: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:

translated_text: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.
original_text: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.

translated_text: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed’s head.
original_text: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed’s head.

translated_text: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?
original_text: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?

translated_text: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.
original_text: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.

translated_text: And Joseph’s ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.
original_text: And Joseph’s ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.

translated_text: But Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.
original_text: But Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.

translated_text:
And the sons of Israel came to buy
corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
original_text:
And the sons of Israel came to buy
corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

translated_text:
And Joseph
was the governor over the land,
and he
it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph’s brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him
with their faces to the earth.
original_text:
And Joseph
was the governor over the land,
and he
it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph’s brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him
with their faces to the earth.

translated_text: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.
original_text: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

translated_text: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.
original_text: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.

translated_text:
And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye
are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
original_text:
And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye
are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

translated_text: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.
original_text: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.

translated_text:
We
are all one man’s sons; we
are true
men,
 thy servants are no spies.
original_text:
We
are all one man’s sons; we
are true
men,
 thy servants are no spies.

translated_text: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
original_text: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

translated_text:
And they said, Thy servants
are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest
is this day with our father, and one
is not.
original_text:
And they said, Thy servants
are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest
is this day with our father, and one
is not.

translated_text:
And Joseph said unto them, That
is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye
are spies:
original_text:
And Joseph said unto them, That
is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye
are spies:

translated_text: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.
original_text: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.

translated_text:
Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether
there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye
are spies.
original_text:
Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether
there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye
are spies.

translated_text: And he put them all together into ward three days.
original_text: And he put them all together into ward three days.

translated_text:
If ye
be true
men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:
original_text:
If ye
be true
men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:

translated_text: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.
original_text: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.

translated_text:
And they said one to another, We
are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.
original_text:
And they said one to another, We
are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

translated_text: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.
original_text: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.

translated_text:
And they knew not that Joseph understood
them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.
original_text:
And they knew not that Joseph understood
them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.

translated_text: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.
original_text: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.

translated_text: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man’s money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.
original_text: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man’s money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.

translated_text: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.
original_text: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.

translated_text:
And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it
was in his sack’s mouth.
original_text:
And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it
was in his sack’s mouth.

translated_text:
And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo,
it is even in my sack: and their heart failed
them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What
is this
that
 God hath done unto us?
original_text:
And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo,
it is even in my sack: and their heart failed
them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What
is this
that
 God hath done unto us?

translated_text: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,
original_text: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,

translated_text:
The man,
who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.
original_text:
The man,
who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.

translated_text:
And we said unto him, We
are true
men; we are no spies:
original_text:
And we said unto him, We
are true
men; we are no spies:

translated_text:
We
be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one
is
 not, and the youngest
is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.
original_text:
We
be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one
is
 not, and the youngest
is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

translated_text:
And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye
are true
men; leave one of your brethren
here with me, and take
food for the famine of your households, and be gone:
original_text:
And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye
are true
men; leave one of your brethren
here with me, and take
food for the famine of your households, and be gone:

translated_text:
And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye
are no spies, but
that ye
are true
men: so
 will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.
original_text:
And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye
are no spies, but
that ye
are true
men: so
 will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.

translated_text:
And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man’s bundle of money
was in his sack: and when
both
 they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.
original_text:
And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man’s bundle of money
was in his sack: and when
both
 they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.

translated_text:
And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved
of my children: Joseph
is not, and Simeon
is not, and ye will take Benjamin
away: all these things are against me.
original_text:
And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved
of my children: Joseph
is not, and Simeon
is not, and ye will take Benjamin
away: all these things are against me.

translated_text: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.
original_text: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.

translated_text: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
original_text: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

translated_text: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.
original_text: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.

translated_text: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.
original_text: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.

translated_text:
And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the
other kine upon the brink of the river.
original_text:
And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the
other kine upon the brink of the river.

translated_text: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.
original_text: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.

translated_text: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
original_text: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.

translated_text: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.
original_text: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.

translated_text:
And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold,
it was a dream.
original_text:
And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold,
it was a dream.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but
there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
original_text:
And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but
there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.

translated_text: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:
original_text: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:

translated_text:
Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard’s house, both
me and the chief baker:
original_text:
Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard’s house, both
me and the chief baker:

translated_text: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
original_text: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.

translated_text:
And
there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.
original_text:
And
there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.

translated_text: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.
original_text: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.

translated_text:
Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved
himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.
original_text:
Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved
himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.

translated_text:
And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and
there is
 none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee,
that
 thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.
original_text:
And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and
there is
 none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee,
that
 thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.

translated_text:
And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying,
It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
original_text:
And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying,
It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.

translated_text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:
original_text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:

translated_text: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:
original_text: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:

translated_text: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:
original_text: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:

translated_text: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
original_text: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:

translated_text:
And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they
were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
original_text:
And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they
were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

translated_text: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:
original_text: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:

translated_text:
And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin,
and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
original_text:
And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin,
and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:

translated_text:
And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told
this
 unto the magicians; but
there was none that could declare
it to me.
original_text:
And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told
this
 unto the magicians; but
there was none that could declare
it to me.

translated_text:
And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh
is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he
is about to do.
original_text:
And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh
is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he
is about to do.

translated_text:
The seven good kine
are seven years; and the seven good ears
are seven years: the dream
is one.
original_text:
The seven good kine
are seven years; and the seven good ears
are seven years: the dream
is one.

translated_text:
And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them
are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.
original_text:
And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them
are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.

translated_text:
This
is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God
is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.
original_text:
This
is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God
is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.

translated_text: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
original_text: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:

translated_text: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
original_text: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;

translated_text:
And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it
shall be very grievous.
original_text:
And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it
shall be very grievous.

translated_text:
And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice;
it is
 because the thing
is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
original_text:
And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice;
it is
 because the thing
is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

translated_text: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
original_text: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
Let Pharaoh do
this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
original_text:
Let Pharaoh do
this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.

translated_text: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
original_text: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.

translated_text: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
original_text: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.

translated_text: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
original_text: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

translated_text:
And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find
such a one
 as this
is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?
original_text:
And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find
such a one
 as this
is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?

translated_text:
And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this,
there is none so discreet and wise as thou
art:
original_text:
And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this,
there is none so discreet and wise as thou
art:

translated_text: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.
original_text: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.

translated_text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.
original_text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
original_text: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;

translated_text:
And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him
ruler over all the land of Egypt.
original_text:
And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him
ruler over all the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I
am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.
original_text:
And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I
am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over
all the land of Egypt.
original_text:
And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over
all the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
And Joseph
was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
original_text:
And Joseph
was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
original_text: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.

translated_text:
And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which
was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
original_text:
And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which
was round about every city, laid he up in the same.

translated_text:
And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for
it was without number.
original_text:
And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for
it was without number.

translated_text: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.
original_text: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.

translated_text:
And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God,
said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.
original_text:
And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God,
said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.

translated_text: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
original_text: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

translated_text: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.
original_text: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.

translated_text: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
original_text: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

translated_text: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.
original_text: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.

translated_text: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.
original_text: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men’s sacks
with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man’s money in his sack’s mouth.
original_text:
And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men’s sacks
with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man’s money in his sack’s mouth.

translated_text: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
original_text: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

translated_text: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.
original_text: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

translated_text:
And when they were gone out of the city,
and not
yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?
original_text:
And when they were gone out of the city,
and not
yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?

translated_text:
Is not this
it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.
original_text:
Is not this
it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.

translated_text: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.
original_text: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.

translated_text: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:
original_text: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:

translated_text: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord’s house silver or gold?
original_text: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord’s house silver or gold?

translated_text: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord’s bondmen.
original_text: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord’s bondmen.

translated_text:
And he said, Now also
let it
be according unto your words; he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.
original_text:
And he said, Now also
let it
be according unto your words; he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.

translated_text: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
original_text: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.

translated_text:
And he searched,
and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
original_text:
And he searched,
and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

translated_text: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.
original_text: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.

translated_text:
And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph’s house; for he
was
 yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
original_text:
And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph’s house; for he
was
 yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.

translated_text:
And Joseph said unto them, What deed
is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?
original_text:
And Joseph said unto them, What deed
is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?

translated_text:
And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we
are my lord’s servants, both we, and
he also with whom the cup is found.
original_text:
And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we
are my lord’s servants, both we, and
he also with whom the cup is found.

translated_text:
And he said, God forbid that I should do so:
but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.
original_text:
And he said, God forbid that I should do so:
but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.

translated_text:
Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord’s ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou
art even as Pharaoh.
original_text:
Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord’s ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou
art even as Pharaoh.

translated_text: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?
original_text: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?

translated_text: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.
original_text: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.

translated_text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.
original_text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.

translated_text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.
original_text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.

translated_text: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
original_text: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

translated_text:
And our father said, Go again,
and buy us a little food.
original_text:
And our father said, Go again,
and buy us a little food.

translated_text:
And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man’s face, except our youngest brother
be with us.
original_text:
And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man’s face, except our youngest brother
be with us.

translated_text:
And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two
sons:
original_text:
And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two
sons:

translated_text: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:
original_text: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:

translated_text: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
original_text: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

translated_text:
Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad
be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad’s life;
original_text:
Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad
be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad’s life;

translated_text:
It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad
is not
with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.
original_text:
It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad
is not
with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

translated_text: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.
original_text: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.

translated_text: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
original_text: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.

translated_text:
For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad
be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.
original_text:
For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad
be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.

translated_text:
And the famine
was sore in the land.
original_text:
And the famine
was sore in the land.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.
original_text: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.

translated_text:
And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother
be with you.
original_text:
And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother
be with you.

translated_text: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:
original_text: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:

translated_text:
But if thou wilt not send
him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother
be
 with you.
original_text:
But if thou wilt not send
him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother
be
 with you.

translated_text: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?
original_text: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?

translated_text:
And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying,
Is your father yet alive? have ye
another
 brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?
original_text:
And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying,
Is your father yet alive? have ye
another
 brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

translated_text:
And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou,
and
 also our little ones.
original_text:
And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou,
and
 also our little ones.

translated_text: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:
original_text: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:

translated_text: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.
original_text: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.

translated_text:
And their father Israel said unto them, If
it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:
original_text:
And their father Israel said unto them, If
it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:

translated_text:
And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry
it again in your hand; peradventure it
was an oversight:
original_text:
And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry
it again in your hand; peradventure it
was an oversight:

translated_text: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:
original_text: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:

translated_text:
And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved
of my children,
 I am bereaved.
original_text:
And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved
of my children,
 I am bereaved.

translated_text: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
original_text: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

translated_text:
And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring
these men home, and slay, and make ready; for
these men shall dine with me at noon.
original_text:
And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring
these men home, and slay, and make ready; for
these men shall dine with me at noon.

translated_text: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph’s house.
original_text: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph’s house.

translated_text: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph’s house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.
original_text: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph’s house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

translated_text: And they came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,
original_text: And they came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,

translated_text: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:
original_text: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold,
every man’s money
was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold,
every man’s money
was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.

translated_text: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.
original_text: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.

translated_text:
And he said, Peace
be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.
original_text:
And he said, Peace
be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.

translated_text:
And the man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave
them
 water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.
original_text:
And the man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave
them
 water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.

translated_text: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.
original_text: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.

translated_text:
And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which
was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.
original_text:
And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which
was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.

translated_text:
And he asked them of
their welfare, and said,
Is
 your father well, the old man of whom ye spake?
Is he yet alive?
original_text:
And he asked them of
their welfare, and said,
Is
 your father well, the old man of whom ye spake?
Is he yet alive?

translated_text:
And they answered, Thy servant our father
is in good health, he
is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.
original_text:
And they answered, Thy servant our father
is in good health, he
is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.

translated_text:
And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother’s son, and said,
Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.
original_text:
And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother’s son, and said,
Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.

translated_text:
And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought
where to weep; and he entered into
his chamber, and wept there.
original_text:
And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought
where to weep; and he entered into
his chamber, and wept there.

translated_text: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.
original_text: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.

translated_text:
And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that
is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
original_text:
And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that
is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

translated_text: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.
original_text: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.

translated_text:
And he took
and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin’s mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.
original_text:
And he took
and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin’s mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.

translated_text:
And it came to pass after these things,
that the butler of the king of Egypt and
his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.
original_text:
And it came to pass after these things,
that the butler of the king of Egypt and
his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.

translated_text:
And Pharaoh was wroth against two
of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.
original_text:
And Pharaoh was wroth against two
of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.

translated_text:
And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph
was bound.
original_text:
And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph
was bound.

translated_text: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.
original_text: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.

translated_text:
And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which
were bound in the prison.
original_text:
And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which
were bound in the prison.

translated_text:
And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they
were sad.
original_text:
And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they
were sad.

translated_text:
And he asked Pharaoh’s officers that
were with him in the ward of his lord’s house, saying, Wherefore look ye
so sadly to day?
original_text:
And he asked Pharaoh’s officers that
were with him in the ward of his lord’s house, saying, Wherefore look ye
so sadly to day?

translated_text:
And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and
there is
 no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them,
Do not interpretations
belong to God? tell me
them, I pray you.
original_text:
And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and
there is
 no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them,
Do not interpretations
belong to God? tell me
them, I pray you.

translated_text:
And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine
was before me;
original_text:
And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine
was before me;

translated_text:
And in the vine
were three branches: and it
was
 as though it budded,
and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:
original_text:
And in the vine
were three branches: and it
was
 as though it budded,
and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:

translated_text:
And Pharaoh’s cup
was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.
original_text:
And Pharaoh’s cup
was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.

translated_text:
And Joseph said unto him, This
is the interpretation of it: The three branches
are three days:
original_text:
And Joseph said unto him, This
is the interpretation of it: The three branches
are three days:

translated_text: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.
original_text: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.

translated_text: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:
original_text: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:

translated_text: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.
original_text: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.

translated_text:
When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also
was in my dream, and, behold,
I had three white baskets on my head:
original_text:
When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also
was in my dream, and, behold,
I had three white baskets on my head:

translated_text:
And in the uppermost basket
there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.
original_text:
And in the uppermost basket
there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.

translated_text:
And Joseph answered and said, This
is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets
are three days:
original_text:
And Joseph answered and said, This
is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets
are three days:

translated_text: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.
original_text: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.

translated_text:
And it came to pass the third day,
which was Pharaoh’s birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.
original_text:
And it came to pass the third day,
which was Pharaoh’s birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.

translated_text: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand:
original_text: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand:

translated_text: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.
original_text: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.

translated_text: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.
original_text: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.

translated_text:
And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I
am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.
original_text:
And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I
am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

translated_text: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.
original_text: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.

translated_text: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,
original_text: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,

translated_text:
As for me, behold, my covenant
is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.
original_text:
As for me, behold, my covenant
is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.

translated_text: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
original_text: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.

translated_text: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
original_text: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.

translated_text: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.
original_text: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.

translated_text: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.
original_text: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.

translated_text: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.
original_text: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.

translated_text:
This
is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.
original_text:
This
is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.

translated_text: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.
original_text: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.

translated_text:
And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which
is not of thy seed.
original_text:
And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which
is not of thy seed.

translated_text: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
original_text: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

translated_text: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.
original_text: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.

translated_text:
And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah
shall her name
be.
original_text:
And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah
shall her name
be.

translated_text:
And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be
a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.
original_text:
And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be
a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.

translated_text:
Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall
a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
original_text:
Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall
a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?

translated_text: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!
original_text: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!

translated_text:
