And Abram
was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
original_text:
And Abram
was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.

translated_text: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;
original_text: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;

translated_text: Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD.
original_text: Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD.

translated_text: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.
original_text: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.

translated_text: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
original_text: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.

translated_text: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram’s cattle and the herdmen of Lot’s cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.
original_text: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram’s cattle and the herdmen of Lot’s cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.

translated_text:
And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we
be brethren.
original_text:
And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we
be brethren.

translated_text:
Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if
thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if
thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
original_text:
Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if
thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if
thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.

translated_text:
And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it
was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah,
even as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.
original_text:
And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it
was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah,
even as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.

translated_text: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
original_text: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.

translated_text:
Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched
his tent toward Sodom.
original_text:
Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched
his tent toward Sodom.

translated_text:
But the men of Sodom
were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.
original_text:
But the men of Sodom
were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:
original_text: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:

translated_text: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
original_text: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.

translated_text:
And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth,
then shall thy seed also be numbered.
original_text:
And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth,
then shall thy seed also be numbered.

translated_text: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.
original_text: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.

translated_text:
Then Abram removed
his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which
is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.
original_text:
Then Abram removed
his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which
is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.

translated_text: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
original_text: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto a land that I will shew thee:

translated_text: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
original_text: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:

translated_text: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
original_text: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.

translated_text:
So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram
was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
original_text:
So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram
was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.

translated_text: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother’s son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
original_text: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother’s son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.

translated_text:
And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite
was then in the land.
original_text:
And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite
was then in the land.

translated_text: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.
original_text: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.

translated_text:
And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent,
having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.
original_text:
And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent,
having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.

translated_text: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.
original_text: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.

translated_text:
And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine
was grievous in the land.
original_text:
And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine
was grievous in the land.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou
art a fair woman to look upon:
original_text:
And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou
art a fair woman to look upon:

translated_text:
Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This
is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
original_text:
Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This
is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.

translated_text:
Say, I pray thee, thou
art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.
original_text:
Say, I pray thee, thou
art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she
was very fair.
original_text:
And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she
was very fair.

translated_text: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.
original_text: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

translated_text: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.
original_text: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.

translated_text: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram’s wife.
original_text: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram’s wife.

translated_text:
And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What
is this
that
 thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she
was
 thy wife?
original_text:
And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What
is this
that
 thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she
was
 thy wife?

translated_text:
Why saidst thou, She
is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take
her, and go thy way.
original_text:
Why saidst thou, She
is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take
her, and go thy way.

translated_text:
And Pharaoh commanded
his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
original_text:
And Pharaoh commanded
his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.

translated_text:
After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I
am thy shield,
and thy exceeding great reward.
original_text:
After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I
am thy shield,
and thy exceeding great reward.

translated_text: And Abram said, Lord GOD, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
original_text: And Abram said, Lord GOD, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?

translated_text: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
original_text: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.

translated_text:
And, behold, the word of the LORD
came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
original_text:
And, behold, the word of the LORD
came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.

translated_text: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
original_text: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.

translated_text: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
original_text: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.

translated_text:
And he said unto him, I
am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
original_text:
And he said unto him, I
am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.

translated_text: And he said, Lord GOD, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
original_text: And he said, Lord GOD, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?

translated_text: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.
original_text: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

translated_text: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.
original_text: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.

translated_text: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.
original_text: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.

translated_text: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.
original_text: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.

translated_text:
And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land
that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
original_text:
And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land
that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;

translated_text: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
original_text: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.

translated_text: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
original_text: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.

translated_text:
But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites
is not yet full.
original_text:
But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites
is not yet full.

translated_text: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.
original_text: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.

translated_text: In the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:
original_text: In the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:

translated_text: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,
original_text: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,

translated_text: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,
original_text: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,

translated_text: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
original_text: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.

translated_text: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;
original_text: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;

translated_text: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.
original_text: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.

translated_text: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.
original_text: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.

translated_text: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
original_text: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

translated_text:
And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that
were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
original_text:
And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that
were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

translated_text:
And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto El-paran, which
is
 by the wilderness.
original_text:
And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto El-paran, which
is
 by the wilderness.

translated_text:
And they returned, and came to En-mishpat, which
is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites that dwelt in Hazezon-tamar.
original_text:
And they returned, and came to En-mishpat, which
is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites that dwelt in Hazezon-tamar.

translated_text:
And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same
is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;
original_text:
And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same
is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;

translated_text: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.
original_text: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.

translated_text:
And the vale of Siddim
was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.
original_text:
And the vale of Siddim
was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.

translated_text: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
original_text: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.

translated_text: And they took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
original_text: And they took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

translated_text:
And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these
were confederate with Abram.
original_text:
And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these
were confederate with Abram.

translated_text:
And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained
servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued
them unto Dan.
original_text:
And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained
servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued
them unto Dan.

translated_text:
And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which
is on the left hand of Damascus.
original_text:
And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which
is on the left hand of Damascus.

translated_text: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
original_text: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.

translated_text:
And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that
were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which
is the king’s dale.
original_text:
And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that
were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which
is the king’s dale.

translated_text:
And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he
was the priest of the most high God.
original_text:
And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he
was the priest of the most high God.

translated_text:
And he blessed him, and said, Blessed
be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:
original_text:
And he blessed him, and said, Blessed
be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:

translated_text: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.
original_text: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.

translated_text: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.
original_text: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.

translated_text: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,
original_text: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,

translated_text:
That I will not
take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that
is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:
original_text:
That I will not
take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that
is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:

translated_text: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.
original_text: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.

translated_text: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.
original_text: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.

translated_text: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
original_text: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.

translated_text: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them throughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.
original_text: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them throughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.

translated_text:
And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top
may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
original_text:
And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top
may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.

translated_text: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
original_text: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.

translated_text:
And the LORD said, Behold, the people
is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.
original_text:
And the LORD said, Behold, the people
is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.

translated_text: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.
original_text: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.

translated_text: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.
original_text: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.

translated_text: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
original_text: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.

translated_text:
These
are the generations of Shem: Shem
was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
original_text:
These
are the generations of Shem: Shem
was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:

translated_text: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
original_text: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

translated_text: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:
original_text: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:

translated_text: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
original_text: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

translated_text: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
original_text: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:

translated_text: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
original_text: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

translated_text: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:
original_text: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:

translated_text: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
original_text: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.

translated_text: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
original_text: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:

translated_text: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
original_text: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.

translated_text: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:
original_text: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:

translated_text: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.

original_text:
And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me,
even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

translated_text: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;
original_text: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;

translated_text: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.
original_text: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.

translated_text: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.
original_text: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.

translated_text:
And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself,
purposing to kill thee.
original_text:
And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself,
purposing to kill thee.

translated_text: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;
original_text: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;

translated_text: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother’s fury turn away;
original_text: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother’s fury turn away;

translated_text:
Until thy brother’s anger turn away from thee, and he forget
that
 which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?
original_text:
Until thy brother’s anger turn away from thee, and he forget
that
 which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?

translated_text:
And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these
which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?
original_text:
And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these
which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?

translated_text: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.
original_text: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.

translated_text:
And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there
were
 three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone
was upon the well’s mouth.
original_text:
And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there
were
 three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone
was upon the well’s mouth.

translated_text: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well’s mouth in his place.
original_text: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well’s mouth in his place.

translated_text:
And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence
be ye? And they said, Of Haran
are we.
original_text:
And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence
be ye? And they said, Of Haran
are we.

translated_text:
And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know
him.
original_text:
And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know
him.

translated_text:
And he said unto them,
Is he well? And they said,
He is
 well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.
original_text:
And he said unto them,
Is he well? And they said,
He is
 well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

translated_text:
And he said, Lo,
it is yet high day, neither
is it
 time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go
and feed
them.
original_text:
And he said, Lo,
it is yet high day, neither
is it
 time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go
and feed
them.

translated_text:
And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and
till they roll the stone from the well’s mouth; then we water the sheep.
original_text:
And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and
till they roll the stone from the well’s mouth; then we water the sheep.

translated_text: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep: for she kept them.
original_text: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep: for she kept them.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.
original_text: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

translated_text: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
original_text: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

translated_text:
And Jacob told Rachel that he
was her father’s brother, and that he
was Rebekah’s son: and she ran and told her father.
original_text:
And Jacob told Rachel that he
was her father’s brother, and that he
was Rebekah’s son: and she ran and told her father.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister’s son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.
original_text: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister’s son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

translated_text:
And Laban said to him, Surely thou
art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.
original_text:
And Laban said to him, Surely thou
art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.

translated_text:
And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou
art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what
shall
 thy wages
be?
original_text:
And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou
art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what
shall
 thy wages
be?

translated_text:
And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder
was Leah, and the name of the younger
was Rachel.
original_text:
And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder
was Leah, and the name of the younger
was Rachel.

translated_text:
Leah
was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.
original_text:
Leah
was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.

translated_text: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.
original_text: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.

translated_text:
And Laban said,
It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.
original_text:
And Laban said,
It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.

translated_text:
And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him
but a few days, for the love he had to her.
original_text:
And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him
but a few days, for the love he had to her.

translated_text:
And Jacob said unto Laban, Give
me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.
original_text:
And Jacob said unto Laban, Give
me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.

translated_text: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
original_text: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

translated_text: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.
original_text: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.

translated_text:
And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid
for
 an handmaid.
original_text:
And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid
for
 an handmaid.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it
was
 Leah: and he said to Laban, What
is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?
original_text:
And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it
was
 Leah: and he said to Laban, What
is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?

translated_text: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.
original_text: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.

translated_text: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.
original_text: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.

translated_text: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.
original_text: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.

translated_text: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.
original_text: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.

translated_text: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
original_text: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

translated_text:
And when the LORD saw that Leah
was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel
was barren.
original_text:
And when the LORD saw that Leah
was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel
was barren.

translated_text: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.
original_text: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.

translated_text:
And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard that I
was hated, he hath therefore given me this
son
 also: and she called his name Simeon.
original_text:
And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard that I
was hated, he hath therefore given me this
son
 also: and she called his name Simeon.

translated_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.
original_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.

translated_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the LORD: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.
original_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the LORD: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.

translated_text:
And Abraham was old,
and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.
original_text:
And Abraham was old,
and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.

translated_text: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:
original_text: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:

translated_text: And I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:
original_text: And I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:

translated_text: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.
original_text: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.

translated_text: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
original_text: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?

translated_text: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
original_text: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.

translated_text: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.
original_text: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.

translated_text: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.
original_text: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.

translated_text: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.
original_text: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.

translated_text:
And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master
were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.
original_text:
And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master
were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.

translated_text:
And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening,
even the time that women go out to draw
water.
original_text:
And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening,
even the time that women go out to draw
water.

translated_text: And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.
original_text: And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.

translated_text:
Behold, I stand
here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:
original_text:
Behold, I stand
here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:

translated_text:
And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also:
let the same be she
that
 thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.
original_text:
And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also:
let the same be she
that
 thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.

translated_text: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
original_text: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.

translated_text:
And the damsel
was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
original_text:
And the damsel
was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

translated_text: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.
original_text: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.

translated_text: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
original_text: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.

translated_text:
And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw
water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
original_text:
And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw
water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.

translated_text:
And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw
water, and drew for all his camels.
original_text:
And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw
water, and drew for all his camels.

translated_text: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.
original_text: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten
shekels weight of gold;
original_text:
And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten
shekels weight of gold;

translated_text:
And said, Whose daughter
art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room
in thy father’s house for us to lodge in?
original_text:
And said, Whose daughter
art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room
in thy father’s house for us to lodge in?

translated_text:
And she said unto him, I
am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.
original_text:
And she said unto him, I
am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.

translated_text: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
original_text: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.

translated_text: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the LORD.
original_text: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the LORD.

translated_text:
And he said, Blessed
be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I
being
 in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master’s brethren.
original_text:
And he said, Blessed
be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I

 in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master’s brethren.

translated_text:
And the damsel ran, and told
them of her mother’s house these things.
original_text:
And the damsel ran, and told
them of her mother’s house these things.

translated_text:
And Rebekah had a brother, and his name
was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.
original_text:
And Rebekah had a brother, and his name
was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.
original_text: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.

translated_text: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
original_text: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.

translated_text:
And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men’s feet that

original_text:
And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men’s feet that

translated_text:
And there was set

original_text:

meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.

translated_text:
And he said, I
am Abraham’s servant.
original_text:
And he said, I
am Abraham’s servant.

translated_text: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.
original_text: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.

translated_text: And Sarah my master’s wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.
original_text: And Sarah my master’s wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.

translated_text: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:
original_text: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:

translated_text: But thou shalt go unto my father’s house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.
original_text: But thou shalt go unto my father’s house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.

translated_text: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.
original_text: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.

translated_text: And he said unto me, The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father’s house:

translated_text:

this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee
one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.
original_text:
Then shalt thou be clear from
this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee
one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.

translated_text: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go;
original_text: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go;

translated_text:
Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw
water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;
original_text:
Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw

let the same

original_text:
And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels:
let the same

translated_text:
And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew

original_text:
And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew

original_text:

shoulder,
 and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.

original_text:
And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter

translated_text: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the LORD, and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter unto his son.
original_text: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the LORD, and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter unto his son.

translated_text: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.
original_text: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.

translated_text: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the LORD: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.
original_text: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the LORD: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.

translated_text:
Behold, Rebekah
is before thee, take
her, and go, and let her be thy master’s son’s wife, as the LORD hath spoken.
original_text:
Behold, Rebekah
is before thee, take
her, and go, and let her be thy master’s son’s wife, as the LORD hath spoken.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, that, when Abraham’s servant heard their words, he worshipped the LORD,

translated_text: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.

translated_text:

translated_text:

translated_text: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?

translated_text:

translated_text: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.

translated_text: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.

translated_text: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.
original_text: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.

translated_text: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?

And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God

son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

translated_text: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.

translated_text: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
original_text: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.

translated_text: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you,

translated_text: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.

translated_text: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.

translated_text:
And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said

original_text:

translated_text: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,
original_text: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,

son:

original_text:

translated_text: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
original_text: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.

translated_text: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.
original_text: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.

translated_text: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;

translated_text: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
original_text: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.

translated_text: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
original_text: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

translated_text: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.
original_text: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.

translated_text: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.
original_text: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.

original_text: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.

so that all that hear will laugh with me.

original_text: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
