am I in the place of God?

translated_text: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
original_text: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.

translated_text: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father’s house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.
original_text: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father’s house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.

translated_text:
And Joseph saw Ephraim’s children of the third
generation:
 the children also of Machir the son Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph’s knees.
original_text:
And Joseph saw Ephraim’s children of the third
generation:
 the children also of Machir the son Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph’s knees.

translated_text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
original_text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

translated_text: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
original_text: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.

translated_text:
So Joseph died,
being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
original_text:
So Joseph died,
being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.

translated_text:
Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that
are not clean by two, the male and his female.
original_text:
Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that
are not clean by two, the male and his female.

translated_text: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.
original_text: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.

translated_text: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.
original_text: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.

translated_text: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.
original_text: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.

translated_text:
And Noah
was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
original_text:
And Noah
was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.

translated_text: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.
original_text: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.

translated_text:
Of clean beasts, and of beasts that
are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,
original_text:
Of clean beasts, and of beasts that
are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,

translated_text: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.
original_text: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.

translated_text: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
original_text: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.

translated_text: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
original_text: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.

translated_text: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
original_text: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

translated_text: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah’s wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;
original_text: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah’s wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;

translated_text: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.
original_text: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.

translated_text:
And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein
is the breath of life.
original_text:
And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein
is the breath of life.

translated_text: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.
original_text: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.

translated_text: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.
original_text: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.

translated_text: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
original_text: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.

translated_text:
And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that
were under the whole heaven, were covered.
original_text:
And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that
were under the whole heaven, were covered.

translated_text: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.
original_text: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.

translated_text: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:
original_text: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:

translated_text:
All in whose nostrils
was the breath of life, of all that
was in the dry
land, died.
original_text:
All in whose nostrils
was the breath of life, of all that
was in the dry
land, died.

translated_text:
And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained
alive, and they that
were with him in the ark.
original_text:
And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained
alive, and they that
were with him in the ark.

translated_text: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.
original_text: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.

translated_text:
And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that
was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;
original_text:
And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that
was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;

translated_text: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;
original_text: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;

translated_text: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.
original_text: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.

translated_text: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
original_text: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.

translated_text:
And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth
month, on the first
day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
original_text:
And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth
month, on the first
day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.

translated_text: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:
original_text: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:

translated_text: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
original_text: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.

translated_text: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
original_text: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;

translated_text:
But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters
were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.
original_text:
But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters
were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.

translated_text: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;
original_text: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;

translated_text:
And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth
was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
original_text:
And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth
was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

translated_text: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.
original_text: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first
month, the first
day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.
original_text:
And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first
month, the first
day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.

translated_text: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.
original_text: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.

translated_text: And God spake unto Noah, saying,
original_text: And God spake unto Noah, saying,

translated_text: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons’ wives with thee.
original_text: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons’ wives with thee.

translated_text:
Bring forth with thee every living thing that
is with thee, of all flesh,
both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
original_text:
Bring forth with thee every living thing that
is with thee, of all flesh,
both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.

translated_text: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him:
original_text: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him:

translated_text:
Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl,
and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.
original_text:
Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl,
and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.

translated_text: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
original_text: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

translated_text:
And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart
is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.
original_text:
And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart
is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.

translated_text: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
original_text: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.

translated_text: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.
original_text: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

translated_text:
And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth
upon
 the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
original_text:
And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth
upon
 the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.

translated_text: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.
original_text: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.

translated_text:
But flesh with the life thereof,
which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.
original_text:
But flesh with the life thereof,
which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.

translated_text: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man’s brother will I require the life of man.
original_text: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man’s brother will I require the life of man.

translated_text: Whoso sheddeth man’s blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.
original_text: Whoso sheddeth man’s blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.

translated_text: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.
original_text: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.

translated_text: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,
original_text: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,

translated_text: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
original_text: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;

translated_text:
And with every living creature that
is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.
original_text:
And with every living creature that
is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.

translated_text: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
original_text: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.

translated_text:
And God said, This
is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that
is with you, for perpetual generations:
original_text:
And God said, This
is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that
is with you, for perpetual generations:

translated_text: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
original_text: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:
original_text: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:

translated_text:
And I will remember my covenant, which
is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
original_text:
And I will remember my covenant, which
is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

translated_text:
And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that
is upon the earth.
original_text:
And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that
is upon the earth.

translated_text:
And God said unto Noah, This
is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that
is upon the earth.
original_text:
And God said unto Noah, This
is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that
is upon the earth.

translated_text: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
original_text: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.

translated_text:
These
are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
original_text:
These
are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.

translated_text:
And Noah began
to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
original_text:
And Noah began
to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:

translated_text: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
original_text: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.

translated_text: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
original_text: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.

translated_text:
And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid
it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces
were backward, and they saw not their father’s nakedness.
original_text:
And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid
it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces
were backward, and they saw not their father’s nakedness.

translated_text: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
original_text: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.

translated_text:
And he said, Cursed
be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
original_text:
And he said, Cursed
be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.

translated_text:
And he said, Blessed
be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
original_text:
And he said, Blessed
be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

translated_text: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
original_text: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

translated_text: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
original_text: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.

translated_text: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
original_text: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.

translated_text: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
original_text: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?

translated_text: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:
original_text: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:

translated_text:
But of the fruit of the tree which
is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
original_text:
But of the fruit of the tree which
is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.

translated_text: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
original_text: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:

translated_text: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
original_text: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.

translated_text:
And when the woman saw that the tree
was good for food, and that it
was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make
one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.
original_text:
And when the woman saw that the tree
was good for food, and that it
was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make
one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.

translated_text:
And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they
were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.
original_text:
And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they
were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

translated_text: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.
original_text: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.

translated_text:
And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where
art
 thou?
original_text:
And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where
art
 thou?

translated_text:
And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I
was naked; and I hid myself.
original_text:
And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I
was naked; and I hid myself.

translated_text:
And he said, Who told thee that thou
wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
original_text:
And he said, Who told thee that thou
wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?

translated_text:
And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest
to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
original_text:
And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest
to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.

translated_text:
And the LORD God said unto the woman, What
is this
that
 thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
original_text:
And the LORD God said unto the woman, What
is this
that
 thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.

translated_text:
And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou
art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
original_text:
And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou
art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:

translated_text: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
original_text: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.

translated_text:
Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire
shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
original_text:
Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire
shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.

translated_text: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;
original_text: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;

translated_text:
In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou
art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
original_text:
In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou
art, and unto dust shalt thou return.

translated_text: And Adam called his wife’s name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
original_text: And Adam called his wife’s name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.

translated_text: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
original_text: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.

translated_text: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:
original_text: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:

translated_text: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
original_text: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.

translated_text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubim, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
original_text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubim, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

translated_text: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.
original_text: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.

translated_text: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
original_text: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

translated_text: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD.

translated_text:

Am I my brother’s keeper?

translated_text: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground.

original_text:
And now

translated_text:

original_text:

translated_text: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.

translated_text: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

translated_text: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.

 only evil continually.

translated_text: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.

original_text: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.

translated_text: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
original_text: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

translated_text: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
original_text: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

translated_text: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.
original_text: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.

translated_text: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
original_text: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.

translated_text: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
original_text: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.

translated_text:
And this

 The length of the ark

 upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
