translated_text: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
original_text: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

translated_text: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.
original_text: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.

translated_text:
These
are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,
original_text:
These
are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,

translated_text:
And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and
there was not a man to till the ground.
original_text:
And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and
there was not a man to till the ground.

translated_text: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
original_text: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.

translated_text:
And the LORD God formed man
of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
original_text:
And the LORD God formed man
of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

translated_text: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
original_text: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.

translated_text: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
original_text: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

translated_text: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.
original_text: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.

translated_text:
The name of the first
is Pison: that
is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where
there is gold;
original_text:
The name of the first
is Pison: that
is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where
there is gold;

translated_text:
And the gold of that land
is good: there
is bdellium and the onyx stone.
original_text:
And the gold of that land
is good: there
is bdellium and the onyx stone.

translated_text:
And the name of the second river
is Gihon: the same
is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.
original_text:
And the name of the second river
is Gihon: the same
is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.

translated_text:
And the name of the third river
is Hiddekel: that
is
 it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river
is Euphrates.
original_text:
And the name of the third river
is Hiddekel: that
is
 it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river
is Euphrates.

translated_text: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
original_text: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

translated_text: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:
original_text: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:

translated_text: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.
original_text: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.

translated_text:
And the LORD God said,
It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
original_text:
And the LORD God said,
It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.

translated_text:
And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought
them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that
was the name thereof.
original_text:
And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought
them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that
was the name thereof.

translated_text: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.
original_text: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.

translated_text: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;
original_text: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;

translated_text: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
original_text: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.

translated_text:
And Adam said, This
is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.
original_text:
And Adam said, This
is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

translated_text: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.
original_text: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.

translated_text: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
original_text: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.

translated_text:
In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they
into the wilderness of Sinai.
original_text:
In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they
into the wilderness of Sinai.

translated_text:
For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come
to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.
original_text:
For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come
to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.

translated_text: And Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;
original_text: And Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;

translated_text:
Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and
how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.
original_text:
Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and
how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.

translated_text:
Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth
is mine:
original_text:
Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth
is mine:

translated_text:
And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These
are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.
original_text:
And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These
are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.

translated_text: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.
original_text: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.

translated_text: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the LORD.
original_text: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the LORD.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,

translated_text: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
original_text: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.

translated_text:
And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves,
that ye go
not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:
original_text:
And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves,
that ye go
not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:

translated_text:
There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether
it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.
original_text:
There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether
it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.

translated_text: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
original_text: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

translated_text:
And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at
your wives.
original_text:
And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at
your wives.

translated_text:
And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that
was in the camp trembled.
original_text:
And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that
was in the camp trembled.

translated_text: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
original_text: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.

translated_text: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
original_text: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.

translated_text: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.
original_text: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.

translated_text:
And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses
up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
original_text:
And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses
up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.

translated_text: And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.
original_text: And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.

translated_text: And Moses said unto the LORD, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
original_text: And Moses said unto the LORD, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD, lest he break forth upon them.
original_text: And the LORD said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD, lest he break forth upon them.

translated_text: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.
original_text: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.

translated_text:
When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people,
and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;
original_text:
When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people,
and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;

translated_text: Then Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her back,
original_text: Then Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her back,

translated_text:
And her two sons; of which the name of the one
was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:
original_text:
And her two sons; of which the name of the one
was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:

translated_text:
And the name of the other
was Eliezer; for the God of my father,
said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:
original_text:
And the name of the other
was Eliezer; for the God of my father,
said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:

translated_text: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:
original_text: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:

translated_text: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.
original_text: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.

translated_text:
And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of
their welfare; and they came into the tent.
original_text:
And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of
their welfare; and they came into the tent.

translated_text:
And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake,
and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and
how the LORD delivered them.
original_text:
And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake,
and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and
how the LORD delivered them.

translated_text: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.
original_text: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.

translated_text:
And Jethro said, Blessed
be the LORD, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
original_text:
And Jethro said, Blessed
be the LORD, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

translated_text:
Now I know that the LORD
is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly
he was above them.
original_text:
Now I know that the LORD
is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly
he was above them.

translated_text: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father in law before God.
original_text: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father in law before God.

translated_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.
original_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.

translated_text:
And when Moses’ father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What
is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?
original_text:
And when Moses’ father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What
is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?

translated_text: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:
original_text: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:

translated_text:
When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make
them know the statutes of God, and his laws.
original_text:
When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make
them know the statutes of God, and his laws.

translated_text:
And Moses’ father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest
is not good.
original_text:
And Moses’ father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest
is not good.

translated_text:
Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that
is
 with thee: for this thing
is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.
original_text:
Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that
is
 with thee: for this thing
is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.

translated_text: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:
original_text: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:

translated_text: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.
original_text: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.

translated_text:
Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place
such over them,
to be rulers of thousands,
and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:
original_text:
Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place
such over them,
to be rulers of thousands,
and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:

translated_text:
And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be,
that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear
the burden with thee.
original_text:
And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be,
that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear
the burden with thee.

translated_text:
If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee
so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.
original_text:
If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee
so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.

translated_text: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.
original_text: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.

translated_text: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
original_text: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

translated_text: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
original_text: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

translated_text: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
original_text: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.

translated_text: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
original_text: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.

translated_text: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
original_text: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.

translated_text: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we do.
original_text: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we do.

translated_text: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
original_text: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

translated_text: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the LORD.
original_text: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And Moses took half of the blood, and put
it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
original_text:
And Moses took half of the blood, and put
it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

translated_text: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD hath said will we do, and be obedient.
original_text: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD hath said will we do, and be obedient.

translated_text:
And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled
it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.
original_text:
And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled
it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.

translated_text: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
original_text: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:

translated_text:
And they saw the God of Israel: and
there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in
his clearness.
original_text:
And they saw the God of Israel: and
there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in
his clearness.

translated_text: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.
original_text: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.

translated_text: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
original_text: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.

translated_text:
And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur
are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.
original_text:
And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur
are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.

translated_text: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
original_text: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.

translated_text: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
original_text: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.

translated_text:
And the sight of the glory of the LORD
was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
original_text:
And the sight of the glory of the LORD
was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.

translated_text: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
original_text: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.

translated_text: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
original_text: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not follow a multitude to
do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest
judgment:
original_text:
Thou shalt not follow a multitude to
do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest
judgment:

translated_text: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.
original_text: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.

translated_text: If thou meet thine enemy’s ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
original_text: If thou meet thine enemy’s ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.

translated_text: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.
original_text: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.

translated_text: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
original_text: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.

translated_text: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
original_text: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.

translated_text: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
original_text: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.

translated_text: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
original_text: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:
original_text: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:

translated_text:
But the seventh
year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard,
and
 with thy oliveyard.
original_text:
But the seventh
year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard,
and
 with thy oliveyard.

translated_text: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
original_text: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.

translated_text:
And in all
things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
original_text:
And in all
things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.

translated_text: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
original_text: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.

translated_text: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
original_text: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)

translated_text:
And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering,
which is
 in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.
original_text:
And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering,
which is
 in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.

translated_text: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord GOD.
original_text: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.
original_text: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.

translated_text: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
original_text: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

translated_text: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
original_text: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.

translated_text:
Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name
is in him.
original_text:
Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name
is in him.

translated_text: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
original_text: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.

translated_text: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.
original_text: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.

translated_text: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
original_text: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.

translated_text: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
original_text: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.

translated_text: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
original_text: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.

translated_text: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
original_text: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.

translated_text: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
original_text: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.

translated_text: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.
original_text: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.

translated_text: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
original_text: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.

translated_text: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
original_text: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.

translated_text: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
original_text: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

translated_text: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.
original_text: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.

translated_text: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
original_text: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

translated_text:
If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die,
there shall no blood
be shed for him.
original_text:
If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die,
there shall no blood
be shed for him.

translated_text:
If the sun be risen upon him,
there shall be blood
shed
 for him;
for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
original_text:
If the sun be risen upon him,
there shall be blood
shed
 for him;
for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

translated_text: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
original_text: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.

translated_text: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
original_text: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.

translated_text:
If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed
therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
original_text:
If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed
therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

translated_text: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.
original_text: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.

translated_text:
If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges,
to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods.
original_text:
If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges,
to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods.

translated_text:
For all manner of trespass,
whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment,
or for any manner of lost thing, which
another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges;
and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.
original_text:
For all manner of trespass,
whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment,
or for any manner of lost thing, which
another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges;
and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.

translated_text:
If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing
it:
original_text:
If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing
it:

translated_text:
Then shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods; and the owner of it shall accept
thereof, and he shall not make
it good.
original_text:
Then shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods; and the owner of it shall accept
thereof, and he shall not make
it good.

translated_text: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
original_text: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.

translated_text:
If it be torn in pieces,
then let him bring it
for
 witness,
and he shall not make good that which was torn.
original_text:
If it be torn in pieces,
then let him bring it
for
 witness,
and he shall not make good that which was torn.

translated_text:
And if a man borrow
ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof
being not with it, he shall surely make
it good.
original_text:
And if a man borrow
ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof
being not with it, he shall surely make
it good.

translated_text:
But if the owner thereof
be with it, he shall not make
it good: if it
be an hired
thing, it came for his hire.
original_text:
But if the owner thereof
be with it, he shall not make
it good: if it
be an hired
thing, it came for his hire.

translated_text: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
original_text: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.

translated_text: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
original_text: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

translated_text: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
original_text: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.

translated_text: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.
original_text: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.

translated_text:
He that sacrificeth unto
any god, save unto the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
original_text:
He that sacrificeth unto
any god, save unto the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.

translated_text: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
original_text: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

translated_text: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
original_text: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

translated_text: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;
original_text: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;

translated_text: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
original_text: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

translated_text:
If thou lend money to
any of my people
that is
 poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.
original_text:
If thou lend money to
any of my people
that is
 poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.

translated_text: If thou at all take thy neighbour’s raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:
original_text: If thou at all take thy neighbour’s raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:

translated_text:
For that
is his covering only, it
is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I
am gracious.
original_text:
For that
is his covering only, it
is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I
am gracious.

translated_text: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.
original_text: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not delay
to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.
original_text:
Thou shalt not delay
to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.

translated_text:
Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen,
and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
original_text:
Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen,
and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.

translated_text:
And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat
any
 flesh
that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
original_text:
And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat
any
 flesh
that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.

translated_text:
Now these
are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.
original_text:
Now these
are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.

translated_text: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
original_text: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.

translated_text: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.
original_text: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.

translated_text: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
original_text: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.

translated_text: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
original_text: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:

translated_text: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.
original_text: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.

translated_text: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.
original_text: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.

translated_text: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.
original_text: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.

translated_text: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
original_text: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.

translated_text:
If he take him another
wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
original_text:
If he take him another
wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.

translated_text: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.
original_text: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.

translated_text: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.
original_text: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.

translated_text:
And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver
him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.
original_text:
And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver
him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.

translated_text: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.
original_text: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.

translated_text: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.
original_text: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.

translated_text: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
original_text: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

translated_text: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.
original_text: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.

translated_text:
And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with
his fist, and he die not, but keepeth
his bed:
original_text:
And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with
his fist, and he die not, but keepeth
his bed:

translated_text:
If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote
him be quit: only he shall pay
for the loss of his time, and shall cause
him to be thoroughly healed.
original_text:
If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote
him be quit: only he shall pay
for the loss of his time, and shall cause
him to be thoroughly healed.

translated_text: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.
original_text: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.

translated_text:
Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he
is his money.
original_text:
Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he
is his money.

translated_text:
If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart
from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman’s husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges
determine.
original_text:
If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart
from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman’s husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges
determine.

translated_text:
And if
any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,
original_text:
And if
any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,

translated_text: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
original_text: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

translated_text: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
original_text: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

translated_text: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
original_text: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

translated_text: And if he smite out his manservant’s tooth, or his maidservant’s tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.
original_text: And if he smite out his manservant’s tooth, or his maidservant’s tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.

translated_text:
If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox
shall be quit.
original_text:
If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox
shall be quit.

translated_text: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.
original_text: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.

translated_text: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
original_text: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.

translated_text: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
original_text: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.

translated_text: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
original_text: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

translated_text: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;
original_text: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;

translated_text:
The owner of the pit shall make
it good,
and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead
beast shall be his.
original_text:
The owner of the pit shall make
it good,
and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead
beast shall be his.

translated_text:
And if one man’s ox hurt another’s, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead
ox also they shall divide.
original_text:
And if one man’s ox hurt another’s, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead
ox also they shall divide.

translated_text: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
original_text: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.

translated_text:
And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office,
even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.
original_text:
And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office,
even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

translated_text: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.
original_text: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.

translated_text:
And thou shalt speak unto all
that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron’s garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
original_text:
And thou shalt speak unto all
that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron’s garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

translated_text:
And these
are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
original_text:
And these
are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

translated_text: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
original_text: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.

translated_text:
And they shall make the ephod
of gold,
of blue, and
of purple,
of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.
original_text:
And they shall make the ephod
of gold,
of blue, and
of purple,
of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.

translated_text:
It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and
so it shall be joined together.
original_text:
It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and
so it shall be joined together.

translated_text:
And the curious girdle of the ephod, which
is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof;

And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars
of shittim
wood, and overlay them with gold,
and their hooks
shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.
original_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.

translated_text:
And this
is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
original_text:
And this
is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,

translated_text:
And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats
hair,
original_text:
And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats
hair,

translated_text: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
original_text: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,

translated_text: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
original_text: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,

translated_text: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
original_text: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.

translated_text: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
original_text: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.

translated_text:
According to all that I shew thee,
after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make
it.
original_text:
According to all that I shew thee,
after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make
it.

translated_text:
And they shall make an ark
of shittim wood: two cubits and a half
shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
original_text:
And they shall make an ark
of shittim wood: two cubits and a half
shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

translated_text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
original_text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.

translated_text:
And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put
them
 in the four corners thereof; and two rings
shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
original_text:
And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put
them
 in the four corners thereof; and two rings
shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.

translated_text:
And thou shalt make staves
of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
original_text:
And thou shalt make staves
of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

translated_text: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
original_text: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.

translated_text: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
original_text: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.

translated_text: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
original_text: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.

translated_text:
And thou shalt make a mercy seat
of pure gold: two cubits and a half
shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
original_text:
And thou shalt make a mercy seat
of pure gold: two cubits and a half
shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

translated_text:
And thou shalt make two cherubims
of gold,
of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
original_text:
And thou shalt make two cherubims
of gold,
of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.

translated_text:
And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end:
even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
original_text:
And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end:
even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

translated_text:
And the cherubim shall stretch forth
their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces
shall look
 one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.
original_text:
And the cherubim shall stretch forth
their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces
shall look
 one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.

translated_text: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
original_text: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.

translated_text:
And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which
are upon the ark of the testimony, of all
things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
original_text:
And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which
are upon the ark of the testimony, of all
things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.

translated_text:
Thou shalt also make a table
of shittim wood: two cubits
shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
original_text:
Thou shalt also make a table
of shittim wood: two cubits
shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

translated_text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
original_text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.

translated_text: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
original_text: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.

translated_text:
And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that
are on the four feet thereof.
original_text:
And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that
are on the four feet thereof.

translated_text: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
original_text: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.

translated_text:
And thou shalt make the staves
of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
original_text:
And thou shalt make the staves
of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.

translated_text:
And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal:
of pure gold shalt thou make them.
original_text:
And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal:
of pure gold shalt thou make them.

translated_text: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.
original_text: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.

translated_text:
And thou shalt make a candlestick
of pure gold:
of
 beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.
original_text:
And thou shalt make a candlestick
of pure gold:
of
 beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.

translated_text: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
original_text: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:

translated_text:
Three bowls made like unto almonds,
with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch,
with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
original_text:
Three bowls made like unto almonds,
with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch,
with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.

translated_text:
And in the candlestick
shall be four bowls made like unto almonds,
with their knops and their flowers.
original_text:
And in the candlestick
shall be four bowls made like unto almonds,
with their knops and their flowers.

translated_text:
And
there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
original_text:
And
there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.

translated_text:
Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it
shall be one beaten work
of pure gold.
original_text:
Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it
shall be one beaten work
of pure gold.

translated_text: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.
original_text: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.

translated_text:
And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof,
shall be of
 pure gold.
original_text:
And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof,
shall be of
 pure gold.

translated_text: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
original_text: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.

translated_text:
And look that thou make
them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.
original_text:
And look that thou make
them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.

translated_text: And God spake all these words, saying,
original_text: And God spake all these words, saying,

translated_text:
I
am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
original_text:
I
am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

translated_text: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
original_text: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness
of any thing that
is in heaven above, or that
is
 in the earth beneath, or that
is in the water under the earth:
original_text:
Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness
of any thing that
is in heaven above, or that
is
 in the earth beneath, or that
is in the water under the earth:

translated_text: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.
original_text: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.

translated_text: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
original_text: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

translated_text: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
original_text: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

translated_text: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:
original_text: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:

translated_text:
But the seventh day
is the sabbath of the LORD thy God:
in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that
is within thy gates:
original_text:
But the seventh day
is the sabbath of the LORD thy God:
in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that
is within thy gates:

translated_text:
For
in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them
is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
original_text:
For
in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them
is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

translated_text: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
original_text: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

translated_text: Thou shalt not kill.
original_text: Thou shalt not kill.

translated_text: Thou shalt not commit adultery.
original_text: Thou shalt not commit adultery.

translated_text: Thou shalt not steal.
original_text: Thou shalt not steal.

translated_text: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
original_text: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that
is thy neighbour’s.
original_text:
Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that
is thy neighbour’s.

translated_text:
And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw
it, they removed, and stood afar off.
original_text:
And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw
it, they removed, and stood afar off.

translated_text: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.
original_text: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.

translated_text: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.
original_text: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.

translated_text:
And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God
was.
original_text:
And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God
was.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

translated_text: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.
original_text: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.

translated_text: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.
original_text: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.

translated_text: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.
original_text: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.

translated_text: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.
original_text: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel,
both of man and of beast: it
is mine.
original_text:
Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel,
both of man and of beast: it
is mine.

translated_text:
And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this
place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.
original_text:
And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this
place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.

translated_text: This day came ye out in the month Abib.
original_text: This day came ye out in the month Abib.

translated_text: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.
original_text: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.

translated_text:
Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day
shall be a feast to the LORD.
original_text:
Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day
shall be a feast to the LORD.

translated_text: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.
original_text: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.

translated_text:
And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying,
This is done
 because of that
which the LORD did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.
original_text:
And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying,
This is done
 because of that
which the LORD did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.
