translated_text: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that the LORD’S law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath the LORD brought thee out of Egypt.
original_text: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that the LORD’S law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath the LORD brought thee out of Egypt.

translated_text: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.
original_text: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.

translated_text: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,
original_text: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,

translated_text:
That thou shalt set apart unto the LORD all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males
shall be the LORD’S.
original_text:
That thou shalt set apart unto the LORD all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males
shall be the LORD’S.

translated_text: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem.
original_text: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem.

translated_text:
And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What
is this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:
original_text:
And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What
is this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:

translated_text: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the LORD slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.
original_text: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the LORD slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.

translated_text: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt.
original_text: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not
through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that
was near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:
original_text:
And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not
through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that
was near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:

translated_text:
But God led the people about,
through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.
original_text:
But God led the people about,
through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.
original_text: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.

translated_text: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
original_text: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

translated_text: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:
original_text: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:

translated_text:
He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night,
from before the people.
original_text:
He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night,
from before the people.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,

translated_text:
This month
shall be unto you the beginning of months: it
shall be the first month of the year to you.
original_text:
This month
shall be unto you the beginning of months: it
shall be the first month of the year to you.

translated_text:
Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth
day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of
their fathers, a lamb for an house:
original_text:
Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth
day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of
their fathers, a lamb for an house:

translated_text:
And if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take
it according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.
original_text:
And if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take
it according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.

translated_text:
Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take
it out from the sheep, or from the goats:
original_text:
Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take
it out from the sheep, or from the goats:

translated_text: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.
original_text: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.

translated_text:
And they shall take of the blood, and strike
it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.
original_text:
And they shall take of the blood, and strike
it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.

translated_text:
Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast
with
 fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.
original_text:
Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast
with
 fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.

translated_text: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.
original_text: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.

translated_text:
For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I
am the LORD.
original_text:
For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye
are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy
you, when I smite the land of Egypt.
original_text:
And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye
are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy
you, when I smite the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the LORD throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.
original_text: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the LORD throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.

translated_text: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.
original_text: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.

translated_text:
And in the first day
there shall be an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save
that which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.
original_text:
And in the first day
there shall be an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save
that which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.

translated_text:
And ye shall observe
the feast of unleavened bread; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever.
original_text:
And ye shall observe
the feast of unleavened bread; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever.

translated_text:
In the first
month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.
original_text:
In the first
month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.

translated_text: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.
original_text: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.

translated_text: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.
original_text: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.

translated_text: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said unto them, Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.
original_text: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said unto them, Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.

translated_text:
And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip
it in the blood that
is in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that
is in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.
original_text:
And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip
it in the blood that
is in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that
is in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.

translated_text:
For the LORD will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite
you.
original_text:
For the LORD will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite
you.

translated_text: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.
original_text: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the LORD will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.
original_text: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the LORD will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean ye by this service?
original_text: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean ye by this service?

translated_text:
That ye shall say, It
is the sacrifice of the LORD’S passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.
original_text:
That ye shall say, It
is the sacrifice of the LORD’S passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.

translated_text: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
original_text: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that
was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.
original_text:
And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that
was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.

translated_text:
And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for
there was not a house where
there was not one dead.
original_text:
And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for
there was not a house where
there was not one dead.

translated_text:
And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up,
and get you forth from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD, as ye have said.
original_text:
And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up,
and get you forth from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD, as ye have said.

translated_text: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.
original_text: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.

translated_text:
And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We
be all dead
men.
original_text:
And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We
be all dead
men.

translated_text: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.
original_text: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.

translated_text: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:
original_text: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:

translated_text:
And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them
such things as they required. And they spoiled the Egyptians.
original_text:
And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them
such things as they required. And they spoiled the Egyptians.

translated_text:
And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot
that were men, beside children.
original_text:
And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot
that were men, beside children.

translated_text:
And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds,
even very much cattle.
original_text:
And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds,
even very much cattle.

translated_text: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.
original_text: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.

translated_text:
Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt,
was four hundred and thirty years.
original_text:
Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt,
was four hundred and thirty years.

translated_text: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.
original_text: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
It
is a night to be much observed unto the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this
is that night of the LORD to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.
original_text:
It
is a night to be much observed unto the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this
is that night of the LORD to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses and Aaron, This
is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses and Aaron, This
is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:

translated_text: But every man’s servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.
original_text: But every man’s servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.

translated_text: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.
original_text: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.

translated_text: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.
original_text: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.

translated_text: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.
original_text: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

translated_text: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.
original_text: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.

translated_text: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.
original_text: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.

translated_text: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
original_text: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

translated_text:
And it came to pass the selfsame day,
that the LORD did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
original_text:
And it came to pass the selfsame day,
that the LORD did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague
more
 upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence: when he shall let
you go, he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague
more
 upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence: when he shall let
you go, he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.

translated_text: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow of his neighbour, and every woman of her neighbour, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.
original_text: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow of his neighbour, and every woman of her neighbour, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.

translated_text:
And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover the man Moses
was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants, and in the sight of the people.
original_text:
And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover the man Moses
was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants, and in the sight of the people.

translated_text: And Moses said, Thus saith the LORD, About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:
original_text: And Moses said, Thus saith the LORD, About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:

translated_text:
And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that
is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.
original_text:
And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that
is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.

translated_text: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.
original_text: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.

translated_text: But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that ye may know how that the LORD doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.
original_text: But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that ye may know how that the LORD doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.

translated_text: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me, and bow down themselves unto me, saying, Get thee out, and all the people that follow thee: and after that I will go out. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.
original_text: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me, and bow down themselves unto me, saying, Get thee out, and all the people that follow thee: and after that I will go out. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land.
original_text: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants, that I might shew these my signs before him:
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants, that I might shew these my signs before him:

translated_text:
And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son, and of thy son’s son, what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that ye may know how that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son, and of thy son’s son, what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that ye may know how that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.
original_text: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.

translated_text: Else, if thou refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast:
original_text: Else, if thou refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast:

translated_text: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:
original_text: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:

translated_text: And they shall fill thy houses, and the houses of all thy servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians; which neither thy fathers, nor thy fathers’ fathers have seen, since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day. And he turned himself, and went out from Pharaoh.
original_text: And they shall fill thy houses, and the houses of all thy servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians; which neither thy fathers, nor thy fathers’ fathers have seen, since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day. And he turned himself, and went out from Pharaoh.

translated_text: And Pharaoh’s servants said unto him, How long shall this man be a snare unto us? let the men go, that they may serve the LORD their God: knowest thou not yet that Egypt is destroyed?
original_text: And Pharaoh’s servants said unto him, How long shall this man be a snare unto us? let the men go, that they may serve the LORD their God: knowest thou not yet that Egypt is destroyed?

translated_text:
And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh: and he said unto them, Go, serve the LORD your God:
but who
are they that shall go?
original_text:
And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh: and he said unto them, Go, serve the LORD your God:
but who
are they that shall go?

translated_text:
And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds will we go; for we
must hold a feast unto the LORD.
original_text:
And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds will we go; for we
must hold a feast unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And he said unto them, Let the LORD be so with you, as I will let you go, and your little ones: look
to it; for evil
is before you.
original_text:
And he said unto them, Let the LORD be so with you, as I will let you go, and your little ones: look
to it; for evil
is before you.

translated_text:
Not so: go now ye
that are men, and serve the LORD; for that ye did desire. And they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.
original_text:
Not so: go now ye
that are men, and serve the LORD; for that ye did desire. And they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land,
even all that the hail hath left.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land,
even all that the hail hath left.

translated_text:
And the locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the coasts of Egypt: very grievous
were they; before them there were no such locusts as they, neither after them shall be such.
original_text:
And the locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the coasts of Egypt: very grievous
were they; before them there were no such locusts as they, neither after them shall be such.

translated_text: For they covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened; and they did eat every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left: and there remained not any green thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land of Egypt.
original_text: For they covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened; and they did eat every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left: and there remained not any green thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

translated_text: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and he said, I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you.
original_text: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and he said, I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you.

translated_text: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and intreat the LORD your God, that he may take away from me this death only.
original_text: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and intreat the LORD your God, that he may take away from me this death only.

translated_text: And he went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.
original_text: And he went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.

translated_text: And the LORD turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts, and cast them into the Red sea; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt.
original_text: And the LORD turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts, and cast them into the Red sea; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt.

translated_text: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go.
original_text: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness
which
 may be felt.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness
which
 may be felt.

translated_text: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:
original_text: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:

translated_text: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.
original_text: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

translated_text: And Pharaoh called unto Moses, and said, Go ye, serve the LORD; only let your flocks and your herds be stayed: let your little ones also go with you.
original_text: And Pharaoh called unto Moses, and said, Go ye, serve the LORD; only let your flocks and your herds be stayed: let your little ones also go with you.

translated_text: And Moses said, Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice unto the LORD our God.
original_text: And Moses said, Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice unto the LORD our God.

translated_text: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left behind; for thereof must we take to serve the LORD our God; and we know not with what we must serve the LORD, until we come thither.
original_text: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left behind; for thereof must we take to serve the LORD our God; and we know not with what we must serve the LORD, until we come thither.

translated_text: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not let them go.
original_text: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not let them go.

translated_text:
And Pharaoh said unto him, Get thee from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in
that day thou seest my face thou shalt die.
original_text:
And Pharaoh said unto him, Get thee from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in
that day thou seest my face thou shalt die.

translated_text: And Moses said, Thou hast spoken well, I will see thy face again no more.
original_text: And Moses said, Thou hast spoken well, I will see thy face again no more.

translated_text:
And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the LORD, and pitched in Rephidim: and
there was no water for the people to drink.
original_text:
And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the LORD, and pitched in Rephidim: and
there was no water for the people to drink.

translated_text: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the LORD?
original_text: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the LORD?

translated_text:
And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore
is this
that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
original_text:
And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore
is this
that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?

translated_text: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.
original_text: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.

translated_text: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
original_text: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

translated_text: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us, or not?
original_text: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us, or not?

translated_text: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
original_text: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

translated_text: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.
original_text: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.

translated_text: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
original_text: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
original_text: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

translated_text:
But Moses’ hands
were heavy; and they took a stone, and put
it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
original_text:
But Moses’ hands
were heavy; and they took a stone, and put
it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

translated_text: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
original_text: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Write this
for a memorial in a book, and rehearse
it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Write this
for a memorial in a book, and rehearse
it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.

translated_text: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovah-nissi:
original_text: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovah-nissi:

translated_text:
For he said, Because the LORD hath sworn
that the LORD
will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.
original_text:
For he said, Because the LORD hath sworn
that the LORD
will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.

translated_text:
And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which
is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
original_text:
And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which
is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:
original_text: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:

translated_text:
And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots,
and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.
original_text:
And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots,
and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.

translated_text: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
original_text: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare
that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare
that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.

translated_text: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:
original_text: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:

translated_text:
And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD; for that he heareth your murmurings against the LORD: and what
are we, that ye murmur against us?
original_text:
And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD; for that he heareth your murmurings against the LORD: and what
are we, that ye murmur against us?

translated_text:
And Moses said,
This shall be, when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the LORD heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what
are
 we? your murmurings
are not against us, but against the LORD.
original_text:
And Moses said,
This shall be, when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the LORD heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what
are
 we? your murmurings
are not against us, but against the LORD.

translated_text: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your murmurings.
original_text: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your murmurings.

translated_text: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud.
original_text: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I
am the LORD your God.
original_text:
I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I
am the LORD your God.

translated_text: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.
original_text: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.

translated_text:
And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness
there lay a small round thing,
as small as the hoar frost on the ground.
original_text:
And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness
there lay a small round thing,
as small as the hoar frost on the ground.

translated_text:
And when the children of Israel saw
it, they said one to another, It
is manna: for they wist not what it
was.
 And Moses said unto them, This
is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.
original_text:
And when the children of Israel saw
it, they said one to another, It
is manna: for they wist not what it
was.
 And Moses said unto them, This
is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.

translated_text:
This
is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, Gather of it every man
according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for
them which
are in his tents.
original_text:
This
is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, Gather of it every man
according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for
them which
are in his tents.

translated_text: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.
original_text: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.

translated_text:
And when they did mete
it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.
original_text:
And when they did mete
it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.

translated_text: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.
original_text: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.

translated_text: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.
original_text: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.

translated_text: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.
original_text: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.

translated_text:
And it came to pass,
that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one
man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
original_text:
And it came to pass,
that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one
man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

translated_text:
And he said unto them, This
is that which the LORD hath said, To morrow
is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the LORD: bake
that which ye will bake
to day, and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.
original_text:
And he said unto them, This
is that which the LORD hath said, To morrow
is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the LORD: bake
that which ye will bake
to day, and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.

translated_text: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.
original_text: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.

translated_text:
And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day
is a sabbath unto the LORD: to day ye shall not find it in the field.
original_text:
And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day
is a sabbath unto the LORD: to day ye shall not find it in the field.

translated_text:
Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day,
which is
 the sabbath, in it there shall be none.
original_text:
Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day,
which is
 the sabbath, in it there shall be none.

translated_text:
And it came to pass,
that there went out
some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.
original_text:
And it came to pass,
that there went out
some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?

translated_text: See, for that the LORD hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.
original_text: See, for that the LORD hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.

translated_text: So the people rested on the seventh day.
original_text: So the people rested on the seventh day.

translated_text:
And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it
was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it
was
 like wafers
made with honey.
original_text:
And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it
was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it
was
 like wafers
made with honey.

translated_text:
And Moses said, This
is the thing which the LORD commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.
original_text:
And Moses said, This
is the thing which the LORD commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations.
original_text: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations.

translated_text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
original_text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

translated_text: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.
original_text: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.

translated_text:
Now an omer
is the tenth
part of an ephah.
original_text:
Now an omer
is the tenth
part of an ephah.

translated_text: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
original_text: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

translated_text:
The LORD
is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he
is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
original_text:
The LORD
is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he
is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

translated_text:
The LORD
is a man of war: the LORD
is his name.
original_text:
The LORD
is a man of war: the LORD
is his name.

translated_text: Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.
original_text: Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.

translated_text: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.
original_text: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.

translated_text: Thy right hand, O LORD, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O LORD, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.
original_text: Thy right hand, O LORD, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O LORD, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.

translated_text:
And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath,
which consumed them as stubble.
original_text:
And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath,
which consumed them as stubble.

translated_text:
And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap,
and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
original_text:
And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap,
and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.

translated_text: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.
original_text: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.

translated_text: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.
original_text: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.

translated_text:
Who
is like unto thee, O LORD, among the gods? who
is
 like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful
in praises, doing wonders?
original_text:
Who
is like unto thee, O LORD, among the gods? who
is
 like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful
in praises, doing wonders?

translated_text: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.
original_text: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.

translated_text:
Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people
which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided
them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.
original_text:
Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people
which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided
them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.

translated_text:
The people shall hear,
and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.
original_text:
The people shall hear,
and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.

translated_text: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
original_text: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.

translated_text:
Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be
as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O LORD, till the people pass over,
which thou hast purchased.
original_text:
Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be
as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O LORD, till the people pass over,
which thou hast purchased.

translated_text:
Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance,
in the place, O LORD,
which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O Lord,
which thy hands have established.
original_text:
Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance,
in the place, O LORD,
which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O Lord,
which thy hands have established.

translated_text: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.
original_text: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.

translated_text:
For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry
land in the midst of the sea.
original_text:
For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry
land in the midst of the sea.

translated_text: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.
original_text: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.

translated_text: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
original_text: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

translated_text: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
original_text: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

translated_text:
And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they
were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
original_text:
And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they
were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.

translated_text: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?
original_text: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?

translated_text:
And he cried unto the LORD; and the LORD shewed him a tree,
which
 when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,
original_text:
And he cried unto the LORD; and the LORD shewed him a tree,
which
 when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,

translated_text:
And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I
am the LORD that healeth thee.
original_text:
And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I
am the LORD that healeth thee.

translated_text:
And they came to Elim, where
were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
original_text:
And they came to Elim, where
were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baal-zephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.
original_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baal-zephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.

translated_text:
For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They
are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.
original_text:
For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They
are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.

translated_text:
And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I
am the LORD. And they did so.
original_text:
And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I
am the LORD. And they did so.

translated_text: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?
original_text: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?

translated_text: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:
original_text: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:

translated_text: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.
original_text: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.

translated_text: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.
original_text: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.

translated_text:
But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses
and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pi-hahiroth, before Baal-zephon.
original_text:
But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses
and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pi-hahiroth, before Baal-zephon.

translated_text: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD.
original_text: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And they said unto Moses, Because
there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?
original_text:
And they said unto Moses, Because
there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?

translated_text:
Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For
it had been
 better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.
original_text:
Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For
it had been
 better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.

translated_text: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
original_text: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.

translated_text: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
original_text: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:

translated_text:
But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry
ground through the midst of the sea.
original_text:
But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry
ground through the midst of the sea.

translated_text: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
original_text: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

translated_text:
And the Egyptians shall know that I
am the LORD, when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
original_text:
And the Egyptians shall know that I
am the LORD, when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

translated_text: And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:
original_text: And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:

translated_text:
And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness
to them, but it gave light by night
to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.
original_text:
And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness
to them, but it gave light by night
to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.

translated_text:
And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go
back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry
land, and the waters were divided.
original_text:
And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go
back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry
land, and the waters were divided.

translated_text:
And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry
ground: and the waters
were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
original_text:
And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry
ground: and the waters
were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

translated_text:
And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea,
even all Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
original_text:
And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea,
even all Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

translated_text: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the LORD looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,
original_text: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the LORD looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,

translated_text: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the LORD fighteth for them against the Egyptians.
original_text: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the LORD fighteth for them against the Egyptians.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.

translated_text: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
original_text: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.

translated_text:
And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen,
and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.
original_text:
And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen,
and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.

translated_text:
But the children of Israel walked upon dry
land in the midst of the sea; and the waters
were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
original_text:
But the children of Israel walked upon dry
land in the midst of the sea; and the waters
were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

translated_text: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.
original_text: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.

translated_text: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the LORD, and believed the LORD, and his servant Moses.
original_text: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the LORD, and believed the LORD, and his servant Moses.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
original_text: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

translated_text: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.
original_text: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.

translated_text: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
original_text: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.

translated_text: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.
original_text: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.

translated_text: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
original_text: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

translated_text: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.
original_text: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.

translated_text: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.
original_text: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.

translated_text:
And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that
is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.
original_text:
And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that
is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.

translated_text: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.
original_text: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.

translated_text: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.
original_text: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.

translated_text: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.
original_text: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.

translated_text: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
original_text: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

translated_text: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:
original_text: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:

translated_text: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.
original_text: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.

translated_text: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.
original_text: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first
day of the month,
that the tabernacle was reared up.
original_text:
And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first
day of the month,
that the tabernacle was reared up.

translated_text: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.
original_text: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.

translated_text: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:
original_text: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:

translated_text: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.
original_text: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.

translated_text: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.
original_text: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.

translated_text: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
original_text: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

translated_text: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:
original_text: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:

translated_text: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text:
And he set up the hanging
at the door of the tabernacle.
original_text:
And he set up the hanging
at the door of the tabernacle.

translated_text:
And he put the altar of burnt offering
by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text:
And he put the altar of burnt offering
by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text:
And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash
withal.
original_text:
And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash
withal.

translated_text: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:
original_text: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:

translated_text: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
