original_text: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.

translated_text: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
original_text: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

translated_text: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
original_text: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

translated_text: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:
original_text: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:

translated_text: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.
original_text: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.

translated_text:
For the cloud of the LORD
was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
original_text:
For the cloud of the LORD
was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

translated_text:
And this
is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest’s office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,
original_text:
And this
is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest’s office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,

translated_text:
And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil:
of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.
original_text:
And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil:
of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.

translated_text: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
original_text: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.

translated_text: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.
original_text: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.

translated_text: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:
original_text: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:

translated_text: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
original_text: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.

translated_text:
Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour
it upon his head, and anoint him.
original_text:
Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour
it upon his head, and anoint him.

translated_text: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.
original_text: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.

translated_text: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest’s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.
original_text: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest’s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.

translated_text: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.
original_text: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.

translated_text:
And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD,
by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
original_text:
And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD,
by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

translated_text:
And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put
it
 upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.
original_text:
And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put
it
 upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.

translated_text:
And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul
that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn
them upon the altar.
original_text:
And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul
that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn
them upon the altar.

translated_text:
But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it
is a sin offering.
original_text:
But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it
is a sin offering.

translated_text: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
original_text: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.

translated_text:
And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle
it round about upon the altar.
original_text:
And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle
it round about upon the altar.

translated_text:
And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put
them unto his pieces, and unto his head.
original_text:
And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put
them unto his pieces, and unto his head.

translated_text:
And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it
is a burnt offering unto the LORD: it
is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
original_text:
And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it
is a burnt offering unto the LORD: it
is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

translated_text: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
original_text: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.

translated_text:
Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put
it
 upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
original_text:
Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put
it
 upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

translated_text:
And thou shalt take of the blood that
is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle
it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
original_text:
And thou shalt take of the blood that
is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle
it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

translated_text:
Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the
caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that
is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it
is a ram of consecration:
original_text:
Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the
caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that
is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it
is a ram of consecration:

translated_text:
And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that
is before the LORD:
original_text:
And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that
is before the LORD:

translated_text:
And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them
for a wave offering before the LORD.
original_text:
And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them
for a wave offering before the LORD.

translated_text:
And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn
them
 upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the LORD: it
is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
original_text:
And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn
them
 upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the LORD: it
is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s consecration, and wave it
for a wave offering before the LORD: and it shall be thy part.
original_text:
And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s consecration, and wave it
for a wave offering before the LORD: and it shall be thy part.

translated_text:
And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration,
even of
that which
is
 for Aaron, and of
that which is for his sons:
original_text:
And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration,
even of
that which
is
 for Aaron, and of
that which is for his sons:

translated_text:
And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’ by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it
is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings,
even their heave offering unto the LORD.
original_text:
And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’ by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it
is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings,
even their heave offering unto the LORD.

translated_text: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons’ after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.
original_text: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons’ after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.

translated_text:
And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy
place.
original_text:
And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy
place.

translated_text: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.
original_text: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.

translated_text:
And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that
is in the basket,
by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
original_text:
And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that
is in the basket,
by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

translated_text:
And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate
and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat
thereof, because they
are holy.
original_text:
And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate
and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat
thereof, because they
are holy.

translated_text:
And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it
is holy.
original_text:
And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it
is holy.

translated_text:
And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all
things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
original_text:
And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all
things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.

translated_text:
And thou shalt offer every day a bullock
for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.
original_text:
And thou shalt offer every day a bullock
for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.

translated_text: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
original_text: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.

translated_text:
Now this
is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
original_text:
Now this
is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.

translated_text: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:
original_text: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:

translated_text:
And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine
for
 a drink offering.
original_text:
And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine
for
 a drink offering.

translated_text: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
original_text: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

translated_text:
This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations
at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.
original_text:
This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations
at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.

translated_text:
And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and
the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.
original_text:
And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and
the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.

translated_text: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest’s office.
original_text: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest’s office.

translated_text: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
original_text: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

translated_text:
And they shall know that I
am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I
am the LORD their God.
original_text:
And they shall know that I
am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I
am the LORD their God.

translated_text:
And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These
are the words which the LORD hath commanded, that
ye should do them.
original_text:
And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These
are the words which the LORD hath commanded, that
ye should do them.

translated_text: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.
original_text: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.

translated_text: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.
original_text: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.

translated_text:
And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This
is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,
original_text:
And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This
is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,

translated_text:
Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD: whosoever
is
 of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD; gold, and silver, and brass,
original_text:
Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD: whosoever
is
 of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD; gold, and silver, and brass,

translated_text:
And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’
hair,
original_text:
And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’
hair,

translated_text: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
original_text: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,

translated_text: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
original_text: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,

translated_text: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
original_text: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.

translated_text: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;
original_text: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;

translated_text: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,
original_text: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,

translated_text:
The ark, and the staves thereof,
with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,
original_text:
The ark, and the staves thereof,
with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,

translated_text: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,
original_text: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,

translated_text: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,
original_text: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,

translated_text: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,
original_text: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,

translated_text: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
original_text: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

translated_text: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,
original_text: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,

translated_text: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,
original_text: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,

translated_text:
The cloths of service, to do service in the holy
place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.
original_text:
The cloths of service, to do service in the holy
place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

translated_text: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
original_text: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

translated_text:
And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing,
and they brought the LORD’S offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.
original_text:
And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing,
and they brought the LORD’S offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.

translated_text:
And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted,
and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered
offered an offering of gold unto the LORD.
original_text:
And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted,
and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered
offered an offering of gold unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’
hair, and red skins of rams, and badgers’ skins, brought
them.
original_text:
And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’
hair, and red skins of rams, and badgers’ skins, brought
them.

translated_text:
Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD’S offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought
it.
original_text:
Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD’S offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought
it.

translated_text:
And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun,
both of blue, and of purple,
and of scarlet, and of fine linen.
original_text:
And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun,
both of blue, and of purple,
and of scarlet, and of fine linen.

translated_text:
And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats’
hair.
original_text:
And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats’
hair.

translated_text: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;
original_text: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;

translated_text: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
original_text: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

translated_text: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.
original_text: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.

translated_text: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
original_text: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;

translated_text: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
original_text: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;

translated_text: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
original_text: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

translated_text:
And in the cutting of stones, to set
them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.
original_text:
And in the cutting of stones, to set
them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.

translated_text:
And he hath put in his heart that he may teach,
both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
original_text:
And he hath put in his heart that he may teach,
both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

translated_text:
Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver,
even
 of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.
original_text:
Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver,
even
 of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon
these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon
these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.

translated_text: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.
original_text: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.

translated_text: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.
original_text: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.

translated_text: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.
original_text: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.

translated_text: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.
original_text: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.

translated_text: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
original_text: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

translated_text:
Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear
the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, unto the third and to the fourth
generation.
original_text:
Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear
the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, unto the third and to the fourth
generation.

translated_text: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.
original_text: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.

translated_text:
And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray thee, go among us; for it
is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.
original_text:
And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray thee, go among us; for it
is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.

translated_text:
And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou
art shall see the work of the LORD: for it
is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.
original_text:
And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou
art shall see the work of the LORD: for it
is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.

translated_text: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
original_text: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

translated_text: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:
original_text: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:

translated_text: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:
original_text: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:

translated_text:
For thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD, whose name
is Jealous,
is a jealous God:
original_text:
For thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD, whose name
is Jealous,
is a jealous God:

translated_text: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.
original_text: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.

translated_text: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.
original_text: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.

translated_text: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.
original_text: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.

translated_text:
All that openeth the matrix
is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle,
whether ox or sheep,
that is male.
original_text:
All that openeth the matrix
is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle,
whether ox or sheep,
that is male.

translated_text:
But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem
him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.
original_text:
But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem
him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.

translated_text: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
original_text: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.

translated_text: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year’s end.
original_text: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year’s end.

translated_text: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.
original_text: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.

translated_text: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the LORD thy God thrice in the year.
original_text: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the LORD thy God thrice in the year.

translated_text: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.
original_text: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.

translated_text: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
original_text: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.

translated_text: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
original_text: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
original_text: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.

translated_text: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.
original_text: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.

translated_text: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.
original_text: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.

translated_text: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
original_text: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai.

translated_text:
And
till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.
original_text:
And
till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.

translated_text:
But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel
that which he was commanded.
original_text:
But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel
that which he was commanded.

translated_text: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
original_text: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Depart,
and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Depart,
and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:

translated_text: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
original_text: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

translated_text:
Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou
art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.
original_text:
Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou
art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.

translated_text: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.
original_text: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.

translated_text:
For the LORD had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye
are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.
original_text:
For the LORD had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye
are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.

translated_text: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.
original_text: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.

translated_text:
And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass,
that every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which
was without the camp.
original_text:
And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass,
that every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which
was without the camp.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle,
that
 all the people rose up, and stood every man
at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle,
that
 all the people rose up, and stood every man
at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood
at the door of the tabernacle, and
the LORD talked with Moses.
original_text:
And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood
at the door of the tabernacle, and
the LORD talked with Moses.

translated_text:
And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand
at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man
in his tent door.
original_text:
And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand
at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man
in his tent door.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.

translated_text: And Moses said unto the LORD, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.
original_text: And Moses said unto the LORD, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.

translated_text:
Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation
is thy people.
original_text:
Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation
is thy people.

translated_text:
And he said, My presence shall go
with thee, and I will give thee rest.
original_text:
And he said, My presence shall go
with thee, and I will give thee rest.

translated_text:
And he said unto him, If thy presence go not
with me, carry us not up hence.
original_text:
And he said unto him, If thy presence go not
with me, carry us not up hence.

translated_text:
For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight?
is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that
are
 upon the face of the earth.
original_text:
For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight?
is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that
are
 upon the face of the earth.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.

translated_text: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
original_text: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.

translated_text: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.
original_text: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.

translated_text: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.
original_text: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.

translated_text:
And the LORD said, Behold,
there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:
original_text:
And the LORD said, Behold,
there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:

translated_text: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:
original_text: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:

translated_text: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.
original_text: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.

translated_text:
And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for
as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
original_text:
And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for
as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

translated_text:
And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which
are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring
them unto me.
original_text:
And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which
are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring
them unto me.

translated_text:
And all the people brake off the golden earrings which
were
 in their ears, and brought
them unto Aaron.
original_text:
And all the people brake off the golden earrings which
were
 in their ears, and brought
them unto Aaron.

translated_text:
And he received
them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These
be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
original_text:
And he received
them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These
be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
And when Aaron saw
it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow
is a feast to the LORD.
original_text:
And when Aaron saw
it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow
is a feast to the LORD.

translated_text: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
original_text: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted
themselves:
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted
themselves:

translated_text:
They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These
be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
original_text:
They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These
be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it
is a stiffnecked people:
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it
is a stiffnecked people:

translated_text: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.
original_text: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.

translated_text: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?
original_text: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?

translated_text: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.
original_text: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.

translated_text:
Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit
it for ever.
original_text:
Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit
it for ever.

translated_text: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.
original_text: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.

translated_text:
And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony
were in his hand: the tables
were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other
were they written.
original_text:
And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony
were in his hand: the tables
were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other
were they written.

translated_text:
And the tables
were the work of God, and the writing
was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.
original_text:
And the tables
were the work of God, and the writing
was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.

translated_text:
And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses,
There is a noise of war in the camp.
original_text:
And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses,
There is a noise of war in the camp.

translated_text:
And he said,
It is not the voice of
them that shout for mastery, neither
is it the voice of
them that cry for being overcome:
but the noise of
them that sing do I hear.
original_text:
And he said,
It is not the voice of
them that shout for mastery, neither
is it the voice of

but the noise of

translated_text: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses’ anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.
original_text: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses’ anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.

translated_text:
And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt
it in the fire, and ground
it to powder, and strawed
it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink
of it.
original_text:
And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt
it in the fire, and ground
it to powder, and strawed
it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink
of it.

translated_text: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
original_text: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?

translated_text:
And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are
set on mischief.
original_text:
And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are
set on mischief.

translated_text:
For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for
as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
original_text:
For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for
as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

translated_text:
And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break
it off. So they gave
it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
original_text:
And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break
it off. So they gave
it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.

translated_text:
And when Moses saw that the people
were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto
their shame among their enemies:)
original_text:
And when Moses saw that the people
were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto
their shame among their enemies:)

translated_text:
Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who
is
 on the LORD’S side?
let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
original_text:
Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who
is
 on the LORD’S side?
let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.

translated_text:
And he said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side,
and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.
original_text:
And he said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side,
and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.

translated_text: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
original_text: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.

translated_text: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to day to the LORD, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
original_text: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to day to the LORD, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.

translated_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the LORD; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.
original_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the LORD; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.

translated_text: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
original_text: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.

translated_text: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin—; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.
original_text: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin—; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.

translated_text:
Therefore now go, lead the people unto
the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.
original_text:
Therefore now go, lead the people unto
the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.

translated_text: And the LORD plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
original_text: And the LORD plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.

translated_text:
And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy
place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text:
And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy
place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text:
And he made the ephod
of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
original_text:
And he made the ephod
of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

translated_text:
And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut
it into
 wires, to work
it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen,
with cunning work.
original_text:
And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut
it into
 wires, to work
it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen,
with cunning work.

translated_text:
They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple
it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.
original_text:
They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple
it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.

translated_text:
And the curious girdle of his ephod, that
was upon it,
was of the same, according to the work thereof;
of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text:
And the curious girdle of his ephod, that
was upon it,
was of the same, according to the work thereof;
of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.
original_text: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.

translated_text:
And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod,
that they should be
 stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text:
And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod,
that they should be
 stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text:
It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span
was
 the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof,
being
 doubled.
original_text:
It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span
was
 the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof,
being
 doubled.

translated_text:
And they set in it four rows of stones:
the first row
was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this
was the first row.
original_text:
And they set in it four rows of stones:
the first row
was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this
was the first row.

translated_text: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
original_text: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

translated_text: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
original_text: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

translated_text:
And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper:
they were
 inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.
original_text:
And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper:
they were
 inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.

translated_text:
And the stones
were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names,
like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
original_text:
And the stones
were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names,
like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.

translated_text:
And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends,
of
 wreathen work
of pure gold.
original_text:
And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends,
of
 wreathen work
of pure gold.

translated_text:
And they made two ouches
of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
original_text:
And they made two ouches
of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.

translated_text: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
original_text: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.

translated_text: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
original_text: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.

translated_text:
And they made two rings of gold, and put
them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which
was on the side of the ephod inward.
original_text:
And they made two rings of gold, and put
them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which
was on the side of the ephod inward.

translated_text:
And they made two
other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the
other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
original_text:
And they made two
other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the
other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

translated_text: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text:
And he made the robe of the ephod
of woven work, all
of blue.
original_text:
And he made the robe of the ephod
of woven work, all
of blue.

translated_text:
And
there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon,
with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
original_text:
And
there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon,
with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.

translated_text:
And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates
of blue, and purple, and scarlet,
and twined
linen.
original_text:
And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates
of blue, and purple, and scarlet,
and twined
linen.

translated_text:
And they made bells
of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
original_text:
And they made bells
of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;

translated_text:
A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister
in; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text:
A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister
in; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text:
And they made coats
of fine linen
of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
original_text:
And they made coats
of fine linen
of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,

translated_text:
And a mitre
of fine linen, and goodly bonnets
of
 fine linen, and linen breeches
of fine twined linen,
original_text:
And a mitre
of fine linen, and goodly bonnets
of
 fine linen, and linen breeches
of fine twined linen,

translated_text:
And a girdle
of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet,
of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text:
And a girdle
of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet,
of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text:
And they made the plate of the holy crown
of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing,
like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
original_text:
And they made the plate of the holy crown
of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing,
like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.

translated_text:
And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten
it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text:
And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten
it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
original_text: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.

translated_text: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
original_text: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,

translated_text: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,
original_text: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,

translated_text: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
original_text: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,

translated_text:
The table,
and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
original_text:
The table,
and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,

translated_text:
The pure candlestick,
with the lamps thereof,
even with
 the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
original_text:
The pure candlestick,
with the lamps thereof,
even with
 the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,

translated_text: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
original_text: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,

translated_text: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
original_text: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

translated_text: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
original_text: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,

translated_text:
The cloths of service to do service in the holy
place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister in the priest’s office.
original_text:
The cloths of service to do service in the holy
place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister in the priest’s office.

translated_text: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.
original_text: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.

translated_text: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they have done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
original_text: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they have done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.

translated_text:
And he made the altar of burnt offering
of shittim wood: five cubits
was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof;
it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.
original_text:
And he made the altar of burnt offering
of shittim wood: five cubits
was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof;
it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.

translated_text: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.
original_text: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.

translated_text:
And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons,

original_text:
And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons,
and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he

translated_text: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.
original_text: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.

translated_text:
And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass,
to be places for the staves.
original_text:
And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass,
to be places for the staves.

translated_text:
And he made the staves

original_text:
And he made the staves
of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.

translated_text: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.
original_text: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.

translated_text:
And he made the laver
of brass, and the foot of it
of
 brass, of the lookingglasses of
the women assembling, which assembled
at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
original_text:
And he made the laver
of brass, and the foot of it
of
 brass, of the lookingglasses of
the women assembling, which assembled
at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

translated_text:

original_text:
And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court

original_text:
Their pillars
were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets

the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars

original_text:
The hangings of the one side

 filleted with silver.

This is the sum of the tabernacle,
even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses,

translated_text: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text:

original_text:
And with him

place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
original_text:
All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy
place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation

translated_text: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,

of shittim wood: two cubits and a half

translated_text: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.

translated_text:

original_text:
And he cast for it four rings of gold,

translated_text:
And he made staves
of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
original_text:
And he made staves
of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

translated_text: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
original_text: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

translated_text:
And he made the mercy seat
of pure gold: two cubits and a half
was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
original_text:
And he made the mercy seat
of pure gold: two cubits and a half
was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

translated_text:
And he made two cherubims
of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;
original_text:
And he made two cherubims
of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;

translated_text:
One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the
other
 end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
original_text:
One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the
other
 end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

translated_text:
And the cherubims spread out
their wings on high,
and
 covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another;
even
to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.
