And the cherubims spread out
their wings on high,
and
 covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another;
even
to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.

translated_text:
And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits
was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:
original_text:
And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits
was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:

translated_text: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.
original_text: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.

translated_text: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.
original_text: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.

translated_text:
And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that
were in the four feet thereof.
original_text:
And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that
were in the four feet thereof.

translated_text: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.
original_text: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.

translated_text:
And he made the staves
of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
original_text:
And he made the staves
of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.

translated_text:
And he made the vessels which
were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal,
of
 pure gold.
original_text:
And he made the vessels which
were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal,
of
 pure gold.

translated_text:
And he made the candlestick
of pure gold:
of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:
original_text:
And he made the candlestick
of pure gold:
of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:

translated_text: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:
original_text: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:

translated_text: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.
original_text: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.

translated_text:
And in the candlestick
were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:
original_text:
And in the candlestick
were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:

translated_text: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.
original_text: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.

translated_text:
Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it
was
 one beaten work
of pure gold.
original_text:
Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it
was
 one beaten work
of pure gold.

translated_text:
And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes,
of pure gold.
original_text:
And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes,
of pure gold.

translated_text: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.
original_text: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.

translated_text:
And he made the incense altar
of shittim wood: the length of it
was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it
was
 foursquare; and two cubits

original_text:
And he made the incense altar
of shittim wood: the length of it
was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it
was
 foursquare; and two cubits

translated_text:
And he overlaid it with pure gold,
both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
original_text:
And he overlaid it with pure gold,
both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.

translated_text: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.
original_text: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.

translated_text:
And he made the staves
of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
original_text:
And he made the staves
of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

translated_text: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.
original_text: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.

translated_text: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.
original_text: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.

translated_text:
And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom,
even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:
original_text:
And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom,
even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:

translated_text:
And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it
withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.
original_text:
And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it
withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.

translated_text: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;
original_text: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;

translated_text: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.
original_text: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.

translated_text: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
original_text: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.

translated_text: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.
original_text: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.

translated_text:
And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains
of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet:
with cherubims of cunning work made he them.
original_text:
And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains
of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet:
with cherubims of cunning work made he them.

translated_text:
The length of one curtain
was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains
were all of one size.
original_text:
The length of one curtain
was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains
were all of one size.

translated_text:
And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and
the other
 five curtains he coupled one unto another.
original_text:
And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and
the other
 five curtains he coupled one unto another.

translated_text:
And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of
another
 curtain, in the coupling of the second.
original_text:
And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of
another
 curtain, in the coupling of the second.

translated_text:
Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which
was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one
curtain to another.
original_text:
Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which
was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one
curtain to another.

translated_text: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.
original_text: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.

translated_text:
And he made curtains
of goats’
hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
original_text:
And he made curtains
of goats’
hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.

translated_text:
The length of one curtain
was thirty cubits, and four cubits
was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains
were
 of one size.
original_text:
The length of one curtain
was thirty cubits, and four cubits
was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains
were
 of one size.

translated_text: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
original_text: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

translated_text: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
original_text: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

translated_text:
And he made fifty taches
of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
original_text:
And he made fifty taches
of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.

translated_text:
And he made a covering for the tent
of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering
of badgers’ skins above
that.
original_text:
And he made a covering for the tent
of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering
of badgers’ skins above
that.

translated_text:
And he made boards for the tabernacle
of shittim wood, standing up.
original_text:
And he made boards for the tabernacle
of shittim wood, standing up.

translated_text:
The length of a board
was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
original_text:
The length of a board
was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.

translated_text: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
original_text: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

translated_text: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:
original_text: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:

translated_text: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
original_text: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

translated_text:
And for the other side of the tabernacle,
which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,
original_text:
And for the other side of the tabernacle,
which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,

translated_text: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
original_text: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

translated_text: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
original_text: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

translated_text: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
original_text: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

translated_text: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.
original_text: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.

translated_text:
And there were eight boards; and their sockets
were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.
original_text:
And there were eight boards; and their sockets
were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.

translated_text: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
original_text: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

translated_text: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.
original_text: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.

translated_text: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.
original_text: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.

translated_text:
And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings
of
 gold
to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
original_text:
And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings
of
 gold
to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

translated_text:
And he made a vail
of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen:
with cherubims made he it of cunning work.
original_text:
And he made a vail
of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen:
with cherubims made he it of cunning work.

translated_text:
And he made thereunto four pillars
of shittim
wood,
 and overlaid them with gold: their hooks
were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.
original_text:
And he made thereunto four pillars
of shittim
wood,
 and overlaid them with gold: their hooks
were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.

translated_text:
And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door
of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;
original_text:
And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door
of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;

translated_text:
And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets
were of
 brass.
original_text:
And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets
were of
 brass.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
original_text: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:

translated_text: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
original_text: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,

translated_text: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
original_text: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

translated_text:
And in cutting of stones, to set
them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
original_text:
And in cutting of stones, to set
them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.

translated_text: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;
original_text: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;

translated_text:
The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that
is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,
original_text:
The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that
is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,

translated_text: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,
original_text: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,

translated_text: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,
original_text: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,

translated_text: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office,
original_text: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office,

translated_text:
And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy
place:
 according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.
original_text:
And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy
place:
 according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I
am the LORD that doth sanctify you.
original_text:
Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I
am the LORD that doth sanctify you.

translated_text:
Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it
is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth
any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
original_text:
Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it
is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth
any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

translated_text:
Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD: whosoever doeth
any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
original_text:
Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD: whosoever doeth
any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.

translated_text:
Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations,
for a perpetual covenant.
original_text:
Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations,
for a perpetual covenant.

translated_text:
It
is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for
in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.
original_text:
It
is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for
in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.

translated_text: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
original_text: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.

translated_text:
And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon:
of shittim wood shalt thou make it.
original_text:
And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon:
of shittim wood shalt thou make it.

translated_text:
A cubit
shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits
shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof
shall be of the same.
original_text:
A cubit
shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits
shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof
shall be of the same.

translated_text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.
original_text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.

translated_text:
And thou shalt make the staves
of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
original_text:
And thou shalt make the staves
of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

translated_text:
And thou shalt put it before the vail that
is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that
is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.
original_text:
And thou shalt put it before the vail that
is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that
is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.

translated_text: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.
original_text: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.

translated_text: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.
original_text: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.

translated_text: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.
original_text: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.

translated_text:
And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it
is most holy unto the LORD.
original_text:
And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it
is most holy unto the LORD.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when
thou numberest them.
original_text:
When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when
thou numberest them.

translated_text:
This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel
is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel
shall be the offering of the LORD.
original_text:
This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel
is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel
shall be the offering of the LORD.

translated_text: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the LORD.
original_text: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the LORD.

translated_text:
The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when
they give an offering unto the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
original_text:
The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when
they give an offering unto the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.

translated_text: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
original_text: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
Thou shalt also make a laver
of brass, and his foot
also of brass, to wash
withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.
original_text:
Thou shalt also make a laver
of brass, and his foot
also of brass, to wash
withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.

translated_text: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
original_text: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:

translated_text: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the LORD:
original_text: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the LORD:

translated_text:
So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them,
even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.
original_text:
So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them,
even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.

translated_text: Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred
shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much,
even two hundred and fifty
shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty
shekels,
original_text:
Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred
shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much,
even two hundred and fifty
shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty
shekels,

translated_text:
And of cassia five hundred
shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:
original_text:
And of cassia five hundred
shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:

translated_text: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.
original_text: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.

translated_text: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,
original_text: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,

translated_text: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,
original_text: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,

translated_text: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.
original_text: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.

translated_text: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.
original_text: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.

translated_text:
And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that
they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
original_text:
And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that
they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

translated_text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.
original_text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.

translated_text:
Upon man’s flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make
any other like it, after the composition of it: it
is
 holy,
and it shall be holy unto you.
original_text:
Upon man’s flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make
any other like it, after the composition of it: it
is
 holy,
and it shall be holy unto you.

translated_text:
Whosoever compoundeth
any like it, or whosoever putteth
any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.
original_text:
Whosoever compoundeth
any like it, or whosoever putteth
any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.

translated_text:
And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure
and holy:
original_text:
And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure
and holy:

translated_text:
And thou shalt beat
some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.
original_text:
And thou shalt beat
some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.

translated_text:
And
as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD.
original_text:
And
as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD.

translated_text: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.
original_text: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.

translated_text: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
original_text: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

translated_text:
For if thou refuse to let
them go, and wilt hold them still,
original_text:
For if thou refuse to let
them go, and wilt hold them still,

translated_text:
Behold, the hand of the LORD is upon thy cattle which
is in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep:
there shall be a very grievous murrain.
original_text:
Behold, the hand of the LORD is upon thy cattle which
is in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep:
there shall be a very grievous murrain.

translated_text:
And the LORD shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt: and there shall nothing die of all
that is the children’s of Israel.
original_text:
And the LORD shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt: and there shall nothing die of all
that is the children’s of Israel.

translated_text: And the LORD appointed a set time, saying, To morrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.
original_text: And the LORD appointed a set time, saying, To morrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.

translated_text: And the LORD did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.
original_text: And the LORD did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.

translated_text: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.
original_text: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.

translated_text:
And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth
with blains upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.
original_text:
And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth
with blains upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth
with
 blains upon man, and upon beast.
original_text:
And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth
with
 blains upon man, and upon beast.

translated_text: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.
original_text: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.

translated_text: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had spoken unto Moses.
original_text: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had spoken unto Moses.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

translated_text:
For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people; that thou mayest know that
there is
 none like me in all the earth.
original_text:
For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people; that thou mayest know that
there is
 none like me in all the earth.

translated_text: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.
original_text: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.

translated_text:
And in very deed for this
cause have I raised thee up, for to shew
in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.
original_text:
And in very deed for this
cause have I raised thee up, for to shew
in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.

translated_text: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?
original_text: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?

translated_text: Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now.
original_text: Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now.

translated_text: He that feared the word of the LORD among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:
original_text: He that feared the word of the LORD among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:

translated_text: And he that regarded not the word of the LORD left his servants and his cattle in the field.
original_text: And he that regarded not the word of the LORD left his servants and his cattle in the field.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the LORD sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt.
original_text: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the LORD sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt.

translated_text: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
original_text: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.

translated_text:
And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that
was
 in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.
original_text:
And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that
was
 in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.

translated_text:
Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel
were,
 was there no hail.
original_text:
Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel
were,
 was there no hail.

translated_text:
And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto them, I have sinned this time: the LORD
is righteous, and I and my people
are wicked.
original_text:
And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto them, I have sinned this time: the LORD
is righteous, and I and my people
are wicked.

translated_text:
Intreat the LORD (for
it is enough) that there be no
more mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and ye shall stay no longer.
original_text:
Intreat the LORD (for
it is enough) that there be no
more mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and ye shall stay no longer.

translated_text: But as for thee and thy servants, I know that ye will not yet fear the LORD God.
original_text: But as for thee and thy servants, I know that ye will not yet fear the LORD God.

translated_text:
And the flax and the barley was smitten: for the barley was in the ear, and the flax
was bolled.
original_text:
And the flax and the barley was smitten: for the barley was in the ear, and the flax
was bolled.

translated_text:
But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they
were
 not grown up.
original_text:
But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they
were
 not grown up.

translated_text: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands unto the LORD: and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.
original_text: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands unto the LORD: and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.

translated_text: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.
original_text: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.

translated_text: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the children of Israel go; as the LORD had spoken by Moses.
original_text: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the children of Israel go; as the LORD had spoken by Moses.

translated_text: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.
original_text: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.

translated_text:
And Pharaoh said, Who
is the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the LORD, neither will I let Israel go.
original_text:
And Pharaoh said, Who
is the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the LORD, neither will I let Israel go.

translated_text: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days’ journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the LORD our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.
original_text: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days’ journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the LORD our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.

translated_text: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.
original_text: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.

translated_text:
And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now
are many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.
original_text:
And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now
are many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.

translated_text: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,
original_text: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,

translated_text: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.
original_text: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.

translated_text:
And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish
ought thereof: for they
be
 idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go
and sacrifice to our God.
original_text:
And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish
ought thereof: for they
be
 idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go
and sacrifice to our God.

translated_text: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.
original_text: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.

translated_text: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.
original_text: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.

translated_text: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.
original_text: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.

translated_text: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.
original_text: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.

translated_text:
And the taskmasters hasted
them, saying, Fulfil your works,
your daily tasks, as when there was straw.
original_text:
And the taskmasters hasted
them, saying, Fulfil your works,
your daily tasks, as when there was straw.

translated_text:
And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten,
and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?
original_text:
And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten,
and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?

translated_text: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?
original_text: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?

translated_text:
There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants
are beaten; but the fault
is in thine own people.
original_text:
There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants
are beaten; but the fault
is in thine own people.

translated_text:
But he said, Ye
are idle,
ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go
and do sacrifice to the LORD.
original_text:
But he said, Ye
are idle,
ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go
and do sacrifice to the LORD.

translated_text:
Go therefore now,
and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.
original_text:
Go therefore now,
and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.

translated_text:
And the officers of the children of Israel did see
that they
were in evil
case, after it was said, Ye shall not minish
ought from your bricks of your daily task.
original_text:
And the officers of the children of Israel did see
that they
were in evil
case, after it was said, Ye shall not minish
ought from your bricks of your daily task.

translated_text: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:
original_text: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:

translated_text: And they said unto them, The LORD look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.
original_text: And they said unto them, The LORD look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.

translated_text:
And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou
so evil entreated this people? why
is it
that
 thou hast sent me?
original_text:
And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou
so evil entreated this people? why
is it
that
 thou hast sent me?

translated_text: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.
original_text: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.

translated_text: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.
original_text: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.

translated_text:
And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I
am the LORD:
original_text:
And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I
am the LORD:

translated_text:
And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by
the name of God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.
original_text:
And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by
the name of God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.

translated_text: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.
original_text: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.

translated_text: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.
original_text: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.

translated_text:
Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I
am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:
original_text:
Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I
am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:

translated_text:
And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I
am the LORD your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
original_text:
And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I
am the LORD your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

translated_text:
And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I
am the LORD.

translated_text: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
original_text: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
original_text: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.

translated_text:
And Moses spake before the LORD, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who
am
 of uncircumcised lips?
original_text:
And Moses spake before the LORD, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who
am
 of uncircumcised lips?

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
These
be the heads of their fathers’ houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these
be the families of Reuben.
original_text:
These
be the heads of their fathers’ houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these
be the families of Reuben.

translated_text:
And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these
are the families of Simeon.
original_text:
And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these
are the families of Simeon.

translated_text:
And these
are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi
were an hundred thirty and seven years.
original_text:
And these
are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi
were an hundred thirty and seven years.

translated_text: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.
original_text: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.

translated_text:
And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath
were an hundred thirty and three years.
original_text:
And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath
were an hundred thirty and three years.

translated_text:
And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these
are the families of Levi according to their generations.
original_text:
And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these
are the families of Levi according to their generations.

translated_text:
And Amram took him Jochebed his father’s sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram
were an hundred and thirty and seven years.
original_text:
And Amram took him Jochebed his father’s sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram
were an hundred and thirty and seven years.

translated_text: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
original_text: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

translated_text: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.
original_text: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.

translated_text: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
original_text: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

translated_text:
And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these
are the families of the Korhites.
original_text:
And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these
are the families of the Korhites.

translated_text:
And Eleazar Aaron’s son took him
one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these
are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.
original_text:
And Eleazar Aaron’s son took him
one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these
are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.

translated_text:
These
are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the LORD said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.
original_text:
These
are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the LORD said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.

translated_text:
These
are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these
are that Moses and Aaron.
original_text:
These
are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these
are that Moses and Aaron.

translated_text:
And it came to pass on the day
when the LORD spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,
original_text:
And it came to pass on the day
when the LORD spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,

translated_text:
That the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, I
am the LORD: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.
original_text:
That the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, I
am the LORD: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.

translated_text:
And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I
am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
original_text:
And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I
am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.

translated_text: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.
original_text: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.

translated_text: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
original_text: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies,
and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
original_text:
But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies,
and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

translated_text:
And the Egyptians shall know that I
am the LORD, when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.
original_text:
And the Egyptians shall know that I
am the LORD, when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.

translated_text: And Moses and Aaron did as the LORD commanded them, so did they.
original_text: And Moses and Aaron did as the LORD commanded them, so did they.

translated_text:
And Moses
was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.
original_text:
And Moses
was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

translated_text:
When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast
it before Pharaoh,
and it shall become a serpent.
original_text:
When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast
it before Pharaoh,
and it shall become a serpent.

translated_text: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the LORD had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
original_text: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the LORD had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

translated_text: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.
original_text: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.

translated_text: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.
original_text: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.

translated_text: And he hardened Pharaoh’s heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.
original_text: And he hardened Pharaoh’s heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh’s heart
is hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh’s heart
is hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.

translated_text: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river’s brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.
original_text: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river’s brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.

translated_text: And thou shalt say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.
original_text: And thou shalt say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, In this thou shalt know that I
am the LORD: behold, I will smite with the rod that
is in mine hand upon the waters which
are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, In this thou shalt know that I
am the LORD: behold, I will smite with the rod that
is in mine hand upon the waters which
are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

translated_text:
And the fish that
is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.
original_text:
And the fish that
is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.

translated_text:
And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and
that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in
vessels of wood, and in
vessels of stone.
original_text:
And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and
that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in
vessels of wood, and in
vessels of stone.

translated_text:
And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that
were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that
were
 in the river were turned to blood.
original_text:
And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that
were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that
were
 in the river were turned to blood.

translated_text:
And the fish that
was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.
original_text:
And the fish that
was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, neither did he hearken unto them; as the LORD had said.
original_text: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, neither did he hearken unto them; as the LORD had said.

translated_text: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.
original_text: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.

translated_text: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.
original_text: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.

translated_text: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the LORD had smitten the river.
original_text: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the LORD had smitten the river.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

translated_text:
And if thou refuse to let
them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:
original_text:
And if thou refuse to let
them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:

translated_text: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into thine house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thine ovens, and into thy kneadingtroughs:
original_text: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into thine house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thine ovens, and into thy kneadingtroughs:

translated_text: And the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.
original_text: And the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.
original_text: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.
original_text: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.

translated_text: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Intreat the LORD, that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto the LORD.
original_text: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Intreat the LORD, that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Glory over me: when shall I intreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people, to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses,
that they may remain in the river only?
original_text:
And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Glory over me: when shall I intreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people, to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses,
that they may remain in the river only?

translated_text:
And he said, To morrow. And he said,
Be it according to thy word: that thou mayest know that
there is none like unto the LORD our God.
original_text:
And he said, To morrow. And he said,
Be it according to thy word: that thou mayest know that
there is none like unto the LORD our God.

translated_text: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.
original_text: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.

translated_text: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto the LORD because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.
original_text: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto the LORD because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.

translated_text: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.
original_text: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.

translated_text: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.
original_text: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.

translated_text: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.
original_text: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
original_text: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.
original_text: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.

translated_text:
Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This
is the finger of God: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.
original_text:
Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This
is the finger of God: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

translated_text:
Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms
of flies upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms
of flies, and also the ground whereon they
are.
original_text:
Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms
of flies upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms
of flies, and also the ground whereon they
are.

translated_text:
And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms
of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I
am the LORD in the midst of the earth.
original_text:
And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms
of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I
am the LORD in the midst of the earth.

translated_text: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.
original_text: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.

translated_text:
And the LORD did so; and there came a grievous swarm
of flies
 into the house of Pharaoh, and
into his servants’ houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm
of flies.
original_text:
And the LORD did so; and there came a grievous swarm
of flies
 into the house of Pharaoh, and
into his servants’ houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm
of flies.

translated_text: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go ye, sacrifice to your God in the land.
original_text: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go ye, sacrifice to your God in the land.

translated_text: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?
original_text: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?

translated_text: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.
original_text: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.

translated_text: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness; only ye shall not go very far away: intreat for me.
original_text: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness; only ye shall not go very far away: intreat for me.

translated_text:
And Moses said, Behold, I go out from thee, and I will intreat the LORD that the swarms
of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, to morrow: but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the LORD.
original_text:
And Moses said, Behold, I go out from thee, and I will intreat the LORD that the swarms
of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, to morrow: but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the LORD.

translated_text: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.
original_text: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.

translated_text:
And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms
of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.
original_text:
And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms
of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.

translated_text: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.
original_text: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.

translated_text:
Now these
are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.
original_text:
Now these
are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.

translated_text: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
original_text: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

translated_text: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
original_text: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

translated_text: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
original_text: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

translated_text:
And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt
already.
original_text:
And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt
already.

translated_text: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.
original_text: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.

translated_text: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.
original_text: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.

translated_text: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.
original_text: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.

translated_text:
And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel
are more and mightier than we:
original_text:
And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel
are more and mightier than we:

translated_text:
Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and
so get them up out of the land.
original_text:
Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and
so get them up out of the land.
