translated_text: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.
original_text: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.

translated_text: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.
original_text: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.

translated_text: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:
original_text: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:

translated_text:
And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve,
was with rigour.
original_text:
And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve,
was with rigour.

translated_text:
And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one
was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:
original_text:
And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one
was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:

translated_text:
And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see
them upon the stools; if it
be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it
be a daughter, then she shall live.
original_text:
And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see
them upon the stools; if it
be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it
be a daughter, then she shall live.

translated_text: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.
original_text: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.

translated_text: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?
original_text: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?

translated_text:
And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women
are
 not as the Egyptian women; for they
are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.
original_text:
And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women
are
 not as the Egyptian women; for they
are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.

translated_text: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.
original_text: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.

translated_text: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.
original_text: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.

translated_text: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.
original_text: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.

translated_text:
And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took
to wife
 a daughter of Levi.
original_text:
And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took
to wife
 a daughter of Levi.

translated_text:
And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he
was a goodly
child, she hid him three months.
original_text:
And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he
was a goodly
child, she hid him three months.

translated_text:
And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid
it in the flags by the river’s brink.
original_text:
And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid
it in the flags by the river’s brink.

translated_text: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.
original_text: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.

translated_text:
And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash
herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river’s side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.
original_text:
And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash
herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river’s side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.

translated_text:
And when she had opened
it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This
is one
 of the Hebrews’ children.
original_text:
And when she had opened
it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This
is one
 of the Hebrews’ children.

translated_text: Then said his sister to Pharaoh’s daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?
original_text: Then said his sister to Pharaoh’s daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?

translated_text: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child’s mother.
original_text: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child’s mother.

translated_text:
And Pharaoh’s daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give
thee thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.
original_text:
And Pharaoh’s daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give
thee thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.

translated_text: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.
original_text: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.

translated_text: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.
original_text: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.

translated_text:
And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that
there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
original_text:
And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that
there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.

translated_text: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?
original_text: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?

translated_text: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.
original_text: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.

translated_text: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.
original_text: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.

translated_text:
Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew
water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
original_text:
Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew
water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.

translated_text: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
original_text: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.

translated_text:
And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How
is it that
 ye are come so soon to day?
original_text:
And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How
is it that
 ye are come so soon to day?

translated_text:
And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew
water enough for us, and watered the flock.
original_text:
And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew
water enough for us, and watered the flock.

translated_text:
And he said unto his daughters, And where
is he? why
is it
that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.
original_text:
And he said unto his daughters, And where
is he? why
is it
that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.

translated_text: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.
original_text: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.

translated_text:
And she bare
him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.
original_text:
And she bare
him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.

translated_text: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.
original_text: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.

translated_text: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
original_text: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

translated_text:
And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto
them.
original_text:
And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto
them.

translated_text:
Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God,
even to Horeb.
original_text:
Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God,
even to Horeb.

translated_text:
And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush
was not consumed.
original_text:
And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush
was not consumed.

translated_text: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
original_text: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.

translated_text:
And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here
am I.
original_text:
And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here
am I.

translated_text: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
original_text: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.

translated_text:
Moreover he said, I
am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.
original_text:
Moreover he said, I
am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.

translated_text:
And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which
are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;
original_text:
And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which
are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;

translated_text: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
original_text: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

translated_text: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.
original_text: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.

translated_text: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.
original_text: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.

translated_text:
And Moses said unto God, Who
am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?
original_text:
And Moses said unto God, Who
am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?

translated_text:
And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this
shall be
 a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.
original_text:
And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this
shall be
 a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.

translated_text:
And Moses said unto God, Behold,
when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?
original_text:
And Moses said unto God, Behold,
when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?

translated_text: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
original_text: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.

translated_text:
And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this
is my name for ever, and this
is my memorial unto all generations.
original_text:
And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this
is my name for ever, and this
is my memorial unto all generations.

translated_text:
Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and
seen that which is done to you in Egypt:
original_text:
Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and
seen that which is done to you in Egypt:

translated_text: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.
original_text: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.

translated_text: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.
original_text: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.

translated_text: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.
original_text: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.

translated_text: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.
original_text: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.

translated_text: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:
original_text: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:

translated_text:
But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put
them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.
original_text:
But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put
them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.

translated_text: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The LORD hath not appeared unto thee.
original_text: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The LORD hath not appeared unto thee.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto him, What
is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto him, What
is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.

translated_text: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
original_text: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:

translated_text: That they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.
original_text: That they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.

translated_text:
And the LORD said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand
was leprous as snow.
original_text:
And the LORD said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand
was leprous as snow.

translated_text:
And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his
other flesh.
original_text:
And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his
other flesh.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
original_text: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour
it upon the dry
land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry
land.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour
it upon the dry
land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry
land.

translated_text:
And Moses said unto the LORD, O my Lord, I
am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I
am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.
original_text:
And Moses said unto the LORD, O my Lord, I
am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I
am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto him, Who hath made man’s mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the LORD?
original_text: And the LORD said unto him, Who hath made man’s mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the LORD?

translated_text: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.
original_text: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.

translated_text:
And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand
of him whom
 thou wilt send.
original_text:
And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand
of him whom
 thou wilt send.

translated_text:
And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses, and he said,
Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.
original_text:
And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses, and he said,
Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.

translated_text: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.
original_text: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.

translated_text:
And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be,
even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.
original_text:
And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be,
even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.

translated_text: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.
original_text: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.

translated_text:
And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which
are
 in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.
original_text:
And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which
are
 in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.

translated_text: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.
original_text: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.

translated_text:
And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD, Israel
is
 my son,
even my firstborn:
original_text:
And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD, Israel
is
 my son,
even my firstborn:

translated_text:
And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son,
even thy firstborn.
original_text:
And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son,
even thy firstborn.

translated_text: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the LORD met him, and sought to kill him.
original_text: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the LORD met him, and sought to kill him.

translated_text:
Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast
it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband
art thou to me.
original_text:
Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast
it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband
art thou to me.

translated_text:
So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband
thou art,
 because of the circumcision.
original_text:
So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband
thou art,
 because of the circumcision.

translated_text: And the LORD said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.
original_text: And the LORD said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.

translated_text: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.
original_text: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.

translated_text: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:
original_text: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:

translated_text: And Aaron spake all the words which the LORD had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
original_text: And Aaron spake all the words which the LORD had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.

translated_text: And the people believed: and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.
original_text: And the people believed: and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD
concerning things
 which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:
original_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD
concerning things
 which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:

translated_text: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.
original_text: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.

translated_text: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock’s head, and kill the bullock before the LORD.
original_text: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock’s head, and kill the bullock before the LORD.

translated_text: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock’s blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:
original_text: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock’s blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:

translated_text: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the vail of the sanctuary.
original_text: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the vail of the sanctuary.

translated_text:
And the priest shall put
some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which
is in the tabernacle of the congregation: and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which
is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
original_text:
And the priest shall put
some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which
is in the tabernacle of the congregation: and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which
is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

translated_text:
And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that
is
 upon the inwards,
original_text:
And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that
is
 upon the inwards,

translated_text:
And the two kidneys, and the fat that
is upon them, which
is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,
original_text:
And the two kidneys, and the fat that
is upon them, which
is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,

translated_text: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.
original_text: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.

translated_text: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,
original_text: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,

translated_text: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.
original_text: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.

translated_text:
And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done
somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD
concerning things
 which should not be done, and are guilty;
original_text:
And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done
somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD
concerning things
 which should not be done, and are guilty;

translated_text: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.
original_text: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.

translated_text: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD: and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD.
original_text: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD: and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD.

translated_text: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock’s blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:
original_text: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock’s blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:

translated_text:
And the priest shall dip his finger
in some of the blood, and sprinkle
it seven times before the LORD,
even before the vail.
original_text:
And the priest shall dip his finger
in some of the blood, and sprinkle
it seven times before the LORD,
even before the vail.

translated_text:
And he shall put
some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which
is before the LORD, that
is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which
is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
original_text:
And he shall put
some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which
is before the LORD, that
is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which
is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

translated_text:
And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn
it upon the altar.
original_text:
And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn
it upon the altar.

translated_text: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
original_text: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.

translated_text:
And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it
is a sin offering for the congregation.
original_text:
And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it
is a sin offering for the congregation.

translated_text:
When a ruler hath sinned, and done
somewhat through ignorance
against any of the commandments of the LORD his God
concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;
original_text:
When a ruler hath sinned, and done
somewhat through ignorance
against any of the commandments of the LORD his God
concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;

translated_text: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:
original_text: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:

translated_text:
And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD: it
is
 a sin offering.
original_text:
And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD: it
is

original_text: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the LORD: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.

translated_text:
And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn
it upon the altar:
it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
original_text:
And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn
it upon the altar:
it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And that which is left of the meat offering
shall be Aaron’s and his sons’:
it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
original_text:
And that which is left of the meat offering
shall be Aaron’s and his sons’:
it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

translated_text: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.
original_text: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.

translated_text: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.
original_text: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.

translated_text: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.
original_text: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.

translated_text:
And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire,
even corn beaten out of full ears.
original_text:
And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire,
even corn beaten out of full ears.

translated_text:
And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it
is a meat offering.
original_text:
And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it
is a meat offering.

translated_text:
And the priest shall burn the memorial of it,
part of the beaten corn thereof, and
part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof:
it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
original_text:
And the priest shall burn the memorial of it,
part of the beaten corn thereof, and
part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof:
it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

translated_text: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
original_text: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

translated_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle,
even of the herd, and of the flock.
original_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle,
even of the herd, and of the flock.

translated_text:
If his offering
be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.
original_text:
If his offering
be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.

translated_text: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
original_text: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

translated_text:
And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that
is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
original_text:
And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that
is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

translated_text: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.
original_text: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.

translated_text: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:
original_text: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:

translated_text:
And the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that
is on the fire which
is
 upon the altar:
original_text:
And the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that
is on the fire which
is
 upon the altar:

translated_text:
But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar,
to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
original_text:
But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar,
to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And if his offering
be of the flocks,
namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.
original_text:
And if his offering
be of the flocks,
namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.

translated_text: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.
original_text: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.

translated_text:
And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that
is on the fire which
is upon the altar:
original_text:
And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that
is on the fire which
is upon the altar:

translated_text:
But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring
it all, and burn
it upon the altar: it
is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
original_text:
But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring
it all, and burn
it upon the altar: it
is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD
be
 of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.
original_text:
And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD
be
 of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.

translated_text:
And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn
it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:
original_text:
And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn
it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:

translated_text: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:
original_text: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:

translated_text:
And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof,
but shall not divide
it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that
is upon the fire: it
is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
original_text:
And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof,
but shall not divide
it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that
is upon the fire: it
is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
original_text: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;

translated_text: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
original_text: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

translated_text: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
original_text: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

translated_text:
And Moses said unto the congregation, This
is the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.
original_text:
And Moses said unto the congregation, This
is the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.

translated_text: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
original_text: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

translated_text:
And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound
it unto him therewith.
original_text:
And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound
it unto him therewith.

translated_text: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.
original_text: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.

translated_text:
And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre,
even
 upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text:
And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre,
even
 upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text:
And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that
was therein, and sanctified them.
original_text:
And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that
was therein, and sanctified them.

translated_text: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.
original_text: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.

translated_text: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
original_text: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

translated_text: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.
original_text: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.

translated_text:
And he slew
it; and Moses took the blood, and put
it
 upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.
original_text:
And he slew
it; and Moses took the blood, and put
it
 upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.

translated_text:
And he took all the fat that
was upon the inwards, and caul
above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned
it upon the altar.
original_text:
And he took all the fat that
was upon the inwards, and caul
above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned
it upon the altar.

translated_text: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
original_text: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

translated_text:
And he killed
it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
original_text:
And he killed
it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

translated_text: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
original_text: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

translated_text:
And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it
was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour,
and an offering made by fire unto the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text:
And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it
was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour,
and an offering made by fire unto the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
original_text: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

translated_text:
And he slew
it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put
it upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
original_text:
And he slew
it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put
it upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.

translated_text: And he brought Aaron’s sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
original_text: And he brought Aaron’s sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

translated_text:
And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that
was
 upon the inwards, and the caul
above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:
original_text:
And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that
was
 upon the inwards, and the caul
above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:

translated_text:
And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that
was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put
them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:
original_text:
And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that
was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put
them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:

translated_text:
And he put all upon Aaron’s hands, and upon his sons’ hands, and waved them
for a wave offering before the LORD.
original_text:
And he put all upon Aaron’s hands, and upon his sons’ hands, and waved them
for a wave offering before the LORD.

translated_text:
And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt
them
 on the altar upon the burnt offering: they
were consecrations for a sweet savour: it
is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
original_text:
And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt
them
 on the altar upon the burnt offering: they
were consecrations for a sweet savour: it
is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which
was
 upon the altar, and sprinkled
it upon Aaron,
and
 upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons’ garments with him; and sanctified Aaron,
and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
original_text:
And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which
was
 upon the altar, and sprinkled
it upon Aaron,
and
 upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons’ garments with him; and sanctified Aaron,
and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

translated_text:
And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that
is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
original_text:
And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that
is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.

translated_text: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
original_text: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.

translated_text:
And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation
in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.
original_text:
And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation
in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.

translated_text:
As he hath done this day,
so the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.
original_text:
As he hath done this day,
so the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.

translated_text:
Therefore shall ye abide
at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.
original_text:
Therefore shall ye abide
at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.

translated_text: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
original_text: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

translated_text:
Likewise this
is the law of the trespass offering: it
is most holy.
original_text:
Likewise this
is the law of the trespass offering: it
is most holy.

translated_text: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.
original_text: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.

translated_text: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
original_text: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,

translated_text:
And the two kidneys, and the fat that
is on them, which
is by the flanks, and the caul
that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:
original_text:
And the two kidneys, and the fat that
is on them, which
is by the flanks, and the caul
that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:

translated_text:
And the priest shall burn them upon the altar
for an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it
is a trespass offering.
original_text:
And the priest shall burn them upon the altar
for an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it
is a trespass offering.

translated_text:
Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it
is most holy.
original_text:
Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it
is most holy.

translated_text:
As the sin offering
is, so
is the trespass offering:
there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have
it.
original_text:
As the sin offering
is, so
is the trespass offering:
there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have
it.

translated_text:
And the priest that offereth any man’s burnt offering,
even
 the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.
original_text:
And the priest that offereth any man’s burnt offering,
even
 the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.

translated_text: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest’s that offereth it.
original_text: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest’s that offereth it.

translated_text:
And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one
as much as another.
original_text:
And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one
as much as another.

translated_text:
And this
is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the LORD.
original_text:
And this
is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the LORD.

translated_text: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.
original_text: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.

translated_text:
Besides the cakes, he shall offer
for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
original_text:
Besides the cakes, he shall offer
for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.

translated_text:
And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation
for
 an heave offering unto the LORD,
and it shall be the priest’s that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.
original_text:
And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation
for
 an heave offering unto the LORD,
and it shall be the priest’s that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.

translated_text: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
original_text: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.

translated_text:
But if the sacrifice of his offering
be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:
original_text:
But if the sacrifice of his offering
be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:

translated_text: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
original_text: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.

translated_text:
And if
any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
original_text:
And if
any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.

translated_text:
And the flesh that toucheth any unclean
thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.
original_text:
And the flesh that toucheth any unclean
thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.

translated_text:
But the soul that eateth
of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that
pertain unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
original_text:
But the soul that eateth
of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that
pertain unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

translated_text:
Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean
thing, as
 the uncleanness of man, or
any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean
thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which
pertain unto the LORD, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
original_text:
Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean
thing, as
 the uncleanness of man, or
any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean
thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which
pertain unto the LORD, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
original_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.

translated_text: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
original_text: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.

translated_text:
For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, even the soul that eateth
it
 shall be cut off from his people.
original_text:
For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, even the soul that eateth
it
 shall be cut off from his people.

translated_text:
Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood,
whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
original_text:
Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood,
whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.

translated_text:
Whatsoever soul
it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
original_text:
Whatsoever soul
it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the LORD shall bring his oblation unto the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
original_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the LORD shall bring his oblation unto the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

translated_text:
His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved
for a wave offering before the LORD.
original_text:
His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved
for a wave offering before the LORD.

translated_text: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
original_text: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

translated_text:
And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest
for
 an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
original_text:
And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest
for
 an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

translated_text:
He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for
his part.
original_text:
He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for
his part.

translated_text: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.
original_text: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.

translated_text:
Which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them,
by a statute for ever throughout their generations.
original_text:
Which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them,
by a statute for ever throughout their generations.

translated_text:
This
is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;
original_text:
This
is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;

translated_text: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
original_text: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.

translated_text:
And it came to pass on the eighth day,
that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
original_text:
And it came to pass on the eighth day,
that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

translated_text:
And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer
them before the LORD.
original_text:
And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer
them before the LORD.

translated_text:
And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb,
both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;
original_text:
And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb,
both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;

translated_text: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the LORD will appear unto you.
original_text: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the LORD will appear unto you.

translated_text:
And they brought
that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.
original_text:
And they brought
that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.

translated_text:
And Moses said, This
is the thing which the LORD commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the LORD shall appear unto you.
original_text:
And Moses said, This
is the thing which the LORD commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the LORD shall appear unto you.

translated_text: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the LORD commanded.
original_text: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the LORD commanded.

translated_text:
Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which
was for himself.
original_text:
Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which
was for himself.

translated_text:
And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put
it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:
original_text:
And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put
it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:

translated_text: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.
original_text: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.

translated_text: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.
original_text: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.

translated_text:
And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt
them upon the altar.
original_text:
And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt
them upon the altar.

translated_text:
And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt
them
 upon the burnt offering on the altar.
original_text:
And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt
them
 upon the burnt offering on the altar.

translated_text:
And he brought the people’s offering, and took the goat, which
was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
original_text:
And he brought the people’s offering, and took the goat, which
was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.

translated_text: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.
original_text: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.

translated_text:
And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt
it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
original_text:
And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt
it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.

translated_text:
He slew also the bullock and the ram
for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which
was for the people: and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,
original_text:
He slew also the bullock and the ram
for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which
was for the people: and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,

translated_text:
And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth
the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul
above
 the liver:
original_text:
And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth
the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul
above
 the liver:

translated_text: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
original_text: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:

translated_text:
And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved
for a wave offering before the LORD; as Moses commanded.
original_text:
And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved
for a wave offering before the LORD; as Moses commanded.

translated_text: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.
original_text: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.

translated_text: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the people.
original_text: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the people.

translated_text:
And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat:
which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
original_text:
And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat:
which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

translated_text: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.
original_text: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.

translated_text: And there went out fire from the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.
original_text: And there went out fire from the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.

translated_text:
Then Moses said unto Aaron, This
is it that the LORD spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.
original_text:
Then Moses said unto Aaron, This
is it that the LORD spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.

translated_text: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
original_text: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.

translated_text: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.
original_text: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.

translated_text: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled.
original_text: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled.

translated_text:
And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the LORD
is
 upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.
original_text:
And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the LORD
is
