 upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, saying,

translated_text:
Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die:
it shall be
 a statute for ever throughout your generations:
original_text:
Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die:
it shall be
 a statute for ever throughout your generations:

translated_text: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;
original_text: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;

translated_text: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.
original_text: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.

translated_text:
And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it
is most holy:
original_text:
And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it
is most holy:

translated_text:
And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it
is thy due, and thy sons’ due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire: for so I am commanded.
original_text:
And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it
is thy due, and thy sons’ due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire: for so I am commanded.

translated_text:
And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for
they be thy due, and thy sons’ due,
which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.
original_text:
And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for
they be thy due, and thy sons’ due,
which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.

translated_text:
The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave
it for a wave offering before the LORD; and it shall be thine, and thy sons’ with thee, by a statute for ever; as the LORD hath commanded.
original_text:
The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave
it for a wave offering before the LORD; and it shall be thine, and thy sons’ with thee, by a statute for ever; as the LORD hath commanded.

translated_text:
And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron
which were left
alive, saying,
original_text:
And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron
which were left
alive, saying,

translated_text:
Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it
is most holy, and
God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?
original_text:
Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it
is most holy, and
God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?

translated_text:
Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy
place:
 ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy
place, as I commanded.
original_text:
Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy
place:
 ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy
place, as I commanded.

translated_text:
And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things have befallen me: and
if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD?
original_text:
And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things have befallen me: and
if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD?

translated_text:
And when Moses heard
that, he was content.
original_text:
And when Moses heard
that, he was content.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,

translated_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These
are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that
are on the earth.
original_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These
are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that
are on the earth.

translated_text:
Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted,
and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.
original_text:
Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted,
and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.

translated_text:
Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof:
as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
original_text:
Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof:
as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

translated_text:
And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he
is unclean unto you.
original_text:
And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he
is unclean unto you.

translated_text:
And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he
is unclean unto you.
original_text:
And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he
is unclean unto you.

translated_text:
And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he
is unclean to you.
original_text:
And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he
is unclean to you.

translated_text:
Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they
are unclean to you.
original_text:
Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they
are unclean to you.

translated_text:
These shall ye eat of all that
are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.
original_text:
These shall ye eat of all that
are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.

translated_text:
And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which
is in the waters, they
shall be an abomination unto you:
original_text:
And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which
is in the waters, they
shall be an abomination unto you:

translated_text: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.
original_text: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.

translated_text:
Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that
shall be
 an abomination unto you.
original_text:
Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that
shall be
 an abomination unto you.

translated_text:
And these
are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they
are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
original_text:
And these
are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they
are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

translated_text: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;
original_text: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;

translated_text: Every raven after his kind;
original_text: Every raven after his kind;

translated_text: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
original_text: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

translated_text: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,
original_text: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,

translated_text: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,
original_text: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,

translated_text: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
original_text: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

translated_text:
All fowls that creep, going upon
all four,
shall be
 an abomination unto you.
original_text:
All fowls that creep, going upon
all four,
shall be
 an abomination unto you.

translated_text:
Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon
all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;
original_text:
Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon
all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;

translated_text: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.
original_text: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.

translated_text:
But all
other flying creeping things, which have four feet,
shall be an abomination unto you.
original_text:
But all
other flying creeping things, which have four feet,
shall be an abomination unto you.

translated_text: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.
original_text: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.

translated_text:
And whosoever beareth
ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
original_text:
And whosoever beareth
ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

translated_text:
The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and
is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud,
are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.
original_text:
The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and
is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud,
are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.

translated_text:
And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on
all four, those
are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.
original_text:
And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on
all four, those
are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

translated_text:
And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they
are unclean unto you.
original_text:
And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they
are unclean unto you.

translated_text:
These also
shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,
original_text:
These also
shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,

translated_text: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.
original_text: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.

translated_text:
These
are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.
original_text:
These
are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.

translated_text:
And upon whatsoever
any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether
it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel
it be, wherein
any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.
original_text:
And upon whatsoever
any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether
it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel
it be, wherein
any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.

translated_text:
And every earthen vessel, whereinto
any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.
original_text:
And every earthen vessel, whereinto
any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.

translated_text:
Of all meat which may be eaten,
that on which
such
 water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every
such vessel shall be unclean.
original_text:
Of all meat which may be eaten,
that on which
such
 water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every
such vessel shall be unclean.

translated_text:
And every
thing whereupon
any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean;
whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down:
for they
are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.
original_text:
And every
thing whereupon
any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean;
whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down:
for they
are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.

translated_text:
Nevertheless a fountain or pit,
wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.
original_text:
Nevertheless a fountain or pit,
wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.

translated_text:
And if
any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it
shall be clean.
original_text:
And if
any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it
shall be clean.

translated_text:
But if
any water be put upon the seed, and
any part
 of their carcase fall thereon, it
shall be unclean unto you.
original_text:
But if
any water be put upon the seed, and
any part
 of their carcase fall thereon, it
shall be unclean unto you.

translated_text: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.
original_text: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.

translated_text: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
original_text: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

translated_text:
And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth
shall be
 an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
original_text:
And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth
shall be
 an abomination; it shall not be eaten.

translated_text:
Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon
all
 four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they
are an abomination.
original_text:
Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon
all
 four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they
are an abomination.

translated_text: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
original_text: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.

translated_text:
For I
am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I
am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
original_text:
For I
am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I
am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

translated_text:
For I
am the LORD that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I
am holy.
original_text:
For I
am the LORD that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I
am holy.

translated_text:
This
is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:
original_text:
This
is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:

translated_text: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.
original_text: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons
shall be for the LORD by thy estimation.
original_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons
shall be for the LORD by thy estimation.

translated_text: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
original_text: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

translated_text:
And if it
be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
original_text:
And if it
be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.

translated_text:
And if
it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
original_text:
And if
it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

translated_text:
And if
it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation
shall be three shekels of silver.
original_text:
And if
it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation
shall be three shekels of silver.

translated_text:
And if
it be from sixty years old and above; if
it be
 a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
original_text:
And if
it be from sixty years old and above; if
it be
 a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

translated_text: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.
original_text: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.

translated_text:
And if
it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that
any man giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.
original_text:
And if
it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that
any man giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.

translated_text: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
original_text: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.

translated_text:
And if
it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:
original_text:
And if
it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:

translated_text:
And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it,
who art the priest, so shall it be.
original_text:
And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it,
who art the priest, so shall it be.

translated_text:
But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth
part
 thereof unto thy estimation.
original_text:
But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth
part
 thereof unto thy estimation.

translated_text:
And when a man shall sanctify his house
to be holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
original_text:
And when a man shall sanctify his house
to be holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.

translated_text:
And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth
part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
original_text:
And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth
part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.

translated_text:
And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD
some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed
shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
original_text:
And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD
some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed
shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

translated_text: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.
original_text: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.

translated_text: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.
original_text: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.

translated_text:
And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth
part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
original_text:
And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth
part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.

translated_text: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
original_text: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.

translated_text: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest’s.
original_text: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest’s.

translated_text:
Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation,
even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day,
as a holy thing unto the LORD.
original_text:
Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation,
even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day,
as a holy thing unto the LORD.

translated_text:
In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought,
even to him to whom the possession of the land
did belong.
original_text:
In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought,
even to him to whom the possession of the land
did belong.

translated_text: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
original_text: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.

translated_text:
Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD’S firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether
it be ox, or sheep: it
is
 the LORD’S.
original_text:
Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD’S firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether
it be ox, or sheep: it
is
 the LORD’S.

translated_text:
And if
it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth
part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.
original_text:
And if
it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth
part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.

translated_text:
Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath,
both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing
is most holy unto the LORD.
original_text:
Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath,
both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing
is most holy unto the LORD.

translated_text:
None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed;
but shall surely be put to death.
original_text:
None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed;
but shall surely be put to death.

translated_text:
And all the tithe of the land,
whether of the seed of the land,
or of the fruit of the tree,
is the LORD’S:
it is holy unto the LORD.
original_text:
And all the tithe of the land,
whether of the seed of the land,
or of the fruit of the tree,
is the LORD’S:
it is holy unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And if a man will at all redeem
ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth
part thereof.
original_text:
And if a man will at all redeem
ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth
part thereof.

translated_text:
And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock,
even
 of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.
original_text:
And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock,
even
 of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.

translated_text: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
original_text: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

translated_text:
These
are the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.
original_text:
These
are the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them,
Concerning
 the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim
to be holy convocations,
even these
are my feasts.
original_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them,
Concerning
 the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim
to be holy convocations,
even these
are my feasts.

translated_text:
Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day
is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work
therein: it
is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.
original_text:
Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day
is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work
therein: it
is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.

translated_text:
These
are the feasts of the LORD,
even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.
original_text:
These
are the feasts of the LORD,
even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.

translated_text:
In the fourteenth
day of the first month at even
is
 the LORD’S passover.
original_text:
In the fourteenth
day of the first month at even
is
 the LORD’S passover.

translated_text:
And on the fifteenth day of the same month
is the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.
original_text:
And on the fifteenth day of the same month
is the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.

translated_text: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
original_text: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

translated_text:
But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days: in the seventh day
is an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work
therein.
original_text:
But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days: in the seventh day
is an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work
therein.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:
original_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:

translated_text: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
original_text: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

translated_text: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
original_text: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And the meat offering thereof
shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD
for
 a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof
shall be of wine, the fourth
part of an hin.
original_text:
And the meat offering thereof
shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD
for
 a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof
shall be of wine, the fourth
part of an hin.

translated_text:
And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God:
it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
original_text:
And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God:
it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

translated_text: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:
original_text: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:

translated_text: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD.
original_text: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD.

translated_text:
Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven;
they are the firstfruits unto the LORD.
original_text:
Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven;
they are the firstfruits unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be
for
 a burnt offering unto the LORD, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings,
even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the LORD.
original_text:
And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be
for
 a burnt offering unto the LORD, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings,
even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the LORD.

translated_text: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
original_text: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

translated_text:
And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits
for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
original_text:
And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits
for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

translated_text:
And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day,
that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work
therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
original_text:
And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day,
that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work
therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

translated_text:
And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I
am the LORD your God.
original_text:
And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I
am the LORD your God.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first
day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.
original_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first
day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.

translated_text:
Ye shall do no servile work
therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
original_text:
Ye shall do no servile work
therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
Also on the tenth
day of this seventh month
there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
original_text:
Also on the tenth
day of this seventh month
there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it
is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.
original_text:
And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it
is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.

translated_text:
For whatsoever soul
it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.
original_text:
For whatsoever soul
it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.

translated_text:
And whatsoever soul
it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.
original_text:
And whatsoever soul
it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.

translated_text:
Ye shall do no manner of work:
it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
original_text:
Ye shall do no manner of work:
it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

translated_text:
It
shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth
day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.
original_text:
It
shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth
day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month
shall be the feast of tabernacles
for seven days unto the LORD.
original_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month
shall be the feast of tabernacles
for seven days unto the LORD.

translated_text:
On the first day
shall be an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work
therein.
original_text:
On the first day
shall be an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work
therein.

translated_text:
Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it
is a solemn assembly;
and ye shall do no servile work
therein.
original_text:
Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it
is a solemn assembly;
and ye shall do no servile work
therein.

translated_text:
These
are the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim
to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:
original_text:
These
are the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim
to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:

translated_text: Beside the sabbaths of the LORD, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the LORD.
original_text: Beside the sabbaths of the LORD, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the LORD.

translated_text:
Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days: on the first day
shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day
shall be
 a sabbath.
original_text:
Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days: on the first day
shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day
shall be
 a sabbath.

translated_text: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
original_text: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.

translated_text:
And ye shall keep it a feast unto the LORD seven days in the year.
It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
original_text:
And ye shall keep it a feast unto the LORD seven days in the year.
It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.

translated_text: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:
original_text: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:

translated_text:
That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I
am
 the LORD your God.
original_text:
That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I
am
 the LORD your God.

translated_text: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the LORD.
original_text: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the LORD.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.
original_text: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.

translated_text:
Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the LORD continually:
it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.
original_text:
Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the LORD continually:
it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.

translated_text: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the LORD continually.
original_text: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the LORD continually.

translated_text: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.
original_text: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.

translated_text: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the LORD.
original_text: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the LORD.

translated_text:
And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon
each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial,
even an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
original_text:
And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon
each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial,
even an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

translated_text:
Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually,
being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
original_text:
Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually,
being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.

translated_text:
And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it
is most holy unto him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.
original_text:
And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it
is most holy unto him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.

translated_text:
And the Israelitish woman’s son blasphemed the name
of the LORD,
 and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother’s name
was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
original_text:
And the Israelitish woman’s son blasphemed the name
of the LORD,
 and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother’s name
was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)

translated_text: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them.
original_text: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard
him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
original_text:
Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard
him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

translated_text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
original_text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.

translated_text:
And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD, he shall surely be put to death,
and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name
of the LORD, shall be put to death.
original_text:
And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD, he shall surely be put to death,
and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name
of the LORD, shall be put to death.

translated_text: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.
original_text: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.

translated_text: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
original_text: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.

translated_text: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;
original_text: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;

translated_text:
Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him
again.
original_text:
Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him
again.

translated_text: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.
original_text: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.

translated_text:
Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I
am the LORD your God.
original_text:
Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I
am the LORD your God.

translated_text: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

translated_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.
original_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.

translated_text: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
original_text: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;

translated_text: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
original_text: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

translated_text:
That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed:
for it is a year of rest unto the land.
original_text:
That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed:
for it is a year of rest unto the land.

translated_text: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,
original_text: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,

translated_text:
And for thy cattle, and for the beast that
are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.
original_text:
And for thy cattle, and for the beast that
are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.

translated_text: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.
original_text: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.

translated_text:
Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth
day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.
original_text:
Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth
day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.

translated_text:
And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout
all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
original_text:
And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout
all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

translated_text:
A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather
the grapes
 in it of thy vine undressed.
original_text:
A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather
the grapes
 in it of thy vine undressed.

translated_text:
For it
is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
original_text:
For it
is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.

translated_text: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.
original_text: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.

translated_text:
And if thou sell
ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour’s hand, ye shall not oppress one another:
original_text:
And if thou sell
ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour’s hand, ye shall not oppress one another:

translated_text:
According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour,
and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:
original_text:
According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour,
and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:

translated_text:
According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for
according to the number
of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.
original_text:
According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for
according to the number
of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.

translated_text:
Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I
am the LORD your God.
original_text:
Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I
am the LORD your God.

translated_text: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
original_text: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.

translated_text: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
original_text: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

translated_text: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
original_text: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:

translated_text: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
original_text: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.

translated_text:
And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat
yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat
of
 the old
store.
original_text:
And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat
yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat
of
 the old
store.

translated_text:
The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land
is mine; for ye
are strangers and sojourners with me.
original_text:
The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land
is mine; for ye
are strangers and sojourners with me.

translated_text: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
original_text: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.

translated_text:
If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away
some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
original_text:
If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away
some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.

translated_text: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
original_text: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;

translated_text: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.
original_text: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.

translated_text:
But if he be not able to restore
it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
original_text:
But if he be not able to restore
it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.

translated_text:
And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold;
within a full year may he redeem it.
original_text:
And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold;
within a full year may he redeem it.

translated_text:
And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that
is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.
original_text:
And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that
is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.

translated_text: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.
original_text: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.

translated_text:
Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites,
and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
original_text:
Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites,
and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.

translated_text:
And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in
the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites
are their possession among the children of Israel.
original_text:
And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in
the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites
are their possession among the children of Israel.

translated_text: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
original_text: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

translated_text:
And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him:
yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.
original_text:
And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him:
yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.

translated_text: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
original_text: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.

translated_text: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.
original_text: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.

translated_text:
I
am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan,
and to be your God.
original_text:
I
am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan,
and to be your God.

translated_text:
And if thy brother
that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
original_text:
And if thy brother
that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:

translated_text:
But as an hired servant,
and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee,
and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:
original_text:
But as an hired servant,
and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee,
and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:

translated_text:
And
then shall he depart from thee,
both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
original_text:
And
then shall he depart from thee,
both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.

translated_text:
For they
are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
original_text:
For they
are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.

translated_text: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.
original_text: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.

translated_text:
Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have,
shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.
original_text:
Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have,
shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.

translated_text:
Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that
are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
original_text:
Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that
are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.

translated_text:
And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit
them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.
original_text:
And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit
them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.

translated_text:
And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother
that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger
or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger’s family:
original_text:
And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother
that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger
or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger’s family:

translated_text: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:
original_text: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:

translated_text:
Either his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or
any
 that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
original_text:
Either his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or
any
 that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.

translated_text: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
original_text: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.

translated_text:
If
there be yet many years
behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
original_text:
If
there be yet many years
behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

translated_text:
And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him,
and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.
original_text:
And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him,
and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.

translated_text:
And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him:
and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.
original_text:
And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him:
and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.

translated_text:
And if he be not redeemed in these
years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile,
both he, and his children with him.
original_text:
And if he be not redeemed in these
years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile,
both he, and his children with him.

translated_text:
For unto me the children of Israel
are servants; they
are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I
am the LORD your God.
original_text:
For unto me the children of Israel
are servants; they
are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I
am the LORD your God.

translated_text:
Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up
any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I
am the LORD your God.
original_text:
Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up
any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I
am the LORD your God.

translated_text:
Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I
am
 the LORD.
original_text:
Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I
am
 the LORD.

translated_text: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
original_text: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

translated_text: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
original_text: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

translated_text: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
original_text: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

translated_text:
And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make
you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
original_text:
And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make
you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

translated_text: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
original_text: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

translated_text: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
original_text: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

translated_text: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.
original_text: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.

translated_text: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
original_text: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.

translated_text: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
original_text: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.

translated_text: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
original_text: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.

translated_text:
I
am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.
original_text:
I
am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.

translated_text: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
original_text: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;

translated_text:
And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments,
but that ye break my covenant:
original_text:
And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments,
but that ye break my covenant:

translated_text: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
original_text: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

translated_text: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
original_text: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.

translated_text: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
original_text: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

translated_text: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:
original_text: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:

translated_text: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.
original_text: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.

translated_text: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
original_text: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.

translated_text:
I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your
high ways shall be desolate.
original_text:
I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your
high ways shall be desolate.

translated_text: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;
original_text: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;

translated_text: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
original_text: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.

translated_text:
And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of
my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
original_text:
And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of
my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

translated_text:
And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver
you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.
original_text:
And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver
you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.

translated_text: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;
original_text: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;

translated_text: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
original_text: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.

translated_text: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.
original_text: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.

translated_text: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.
original_text: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.

translated_text: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.
original_text: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.

translated_text: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
original_text: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.

translated_text: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.
original_text: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.

translated_text:
Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies’ land;
even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.
original_text:
Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies’ land;
even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.

translated_text: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.
original_text: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.

translated_text:
And upon them that are left
alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
original_text:
And upon them that are left
alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.

translated_text: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
original_text: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.

translated_text: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
original_text: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.

translated_text: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.
original_text: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

translated_text: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;
original_text: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;

translated_text:
And
that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
original_text:
And
that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:

translated_text: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
original_text: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.

translated_text: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.
original_text: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.

translated_text:
