And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I
am the LORD their God.
original_text:
And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I
am the LORD their God.

translated_text:
But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I
am the LORD.
original_text:
But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
These
are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
original_text:
These
are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy
place within the vail before the mercy seat, which
is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy
place within the vail before the mercy seat, which
is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.

translated_text:
Thus shall Aaron come into the holy
place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
original_text:
Thus shall Aaron come into the holy
place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

translated_text:
He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these
are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and
so put them on.
original_text:
He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these
are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and
so put them on.

translated_text: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
original_text: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

translated_text:
And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which
is
 for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
original_text:
And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which
is
 for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.

translated_text:
And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD
at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
original_text:
And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD
at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

translated_text: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
original_text: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

translated_text:
And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD’S lot fell, and offer him
for a sin offering.
original_text:
And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD’S lot fell, and offer him
for a sin offering.

translated_text:
But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him,
and
 to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.
original_text:
But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him,
and
 to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.

translated_text:
And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which
is
 for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which
is for himself:
original_text:
And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which
is
 for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which
is for himself:

translated_text:
And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring
it within the vail:
original_text:
And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring
it within the vail:

translated_text:
And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that
is upon the testimony, that he die not:
original_text:
And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that
is upon the testimony, that he die not:

translated_text:
And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle
it
 with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
original_text:
And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle
it
 with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.

translated_text:
And he shall make an atonement for the holy
place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
original_text:
And he shall make an atonement for the holy
place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

translated_text:
And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy
place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.
original_text:
And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy
place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.

translated_text:
And he shall go out unto the altar that
is before the LORD, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put
it upon the horns of the altar round about.
original_text:
And he shall go out unto the altar that
is before the LORD, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put
it upon the horns of the altar round about.

translated_text: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
original_text: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

translated_text:
And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy
place,
 and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:
original_text:
And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy
place,
 and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:

translated_text:
And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send
him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:
original_text:
And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send
him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:

translated_text: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
original_text: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.

translated_text:
And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy
place, and shall leave them there:
original_text:
And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy
place, and shall leave them there:

translated_text: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.
original_text: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.

translated_text: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
original_text: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.

translated_text: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.
original_text: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.

translated_text:
And the bullock
for the sin offering, and the goat
for
 the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy
place, shall
one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
original_text:
And the bullock
for the sin offering, and the goat
for
 the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy
place, shall
one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.

translated_text: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
original_text: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

translated_text:
And
this shall be a statute for ever unto you:
that
 in the seventh month, on the tenth
day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all,
whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:
original_text:
And
this shall be a statute for ever unto you:
that
 in the seventh month, on the tenth
day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all,
whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:

translated_text:
For on that day shall
the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you,
that ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
original_text:
For on that day shall
the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you,
that ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.

translated_text:
It
shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.
original_text:
It
shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.

translated_text:
And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest’s office in his father’s stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes,
even the holy garments:
original_text:
And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest’s office in his father’s stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes,
even the holy garments:

translated_text: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.
original_text: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.

translated_text: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This
is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying,
original_text:
Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This
is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying,

translated_text:
What man soever
there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth
it out of the camp,
original_text:
What man soever
there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth
it out of the camp,

translated_text: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
original_text: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:

translated_text:
To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them
for peace offerings unto the LORD.
original_text:
To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them
for peace offerings unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the LORD
at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
original_text:
And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the LORD
at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the LORD.

translated_text: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
original_text: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.

translated_text:
And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man
there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering of sacrifice,
original_text:
And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man
there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering of sacrifice,

translated_text: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the LORD; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.
original_text: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the LORD; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.

translated_text:
And whatsoever man
there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
original_text:
And whatsoever man
there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

translated_text:
For the life of the flesh
is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it
is
 the blood
that maketh an atonement for the soul.
original_text:
For the life of the flesh
is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it
is
 the blood
that maketh an atonement for the soul.

translated_text: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.
original_text: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.

translated_text:
And whatsoever man
there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
original_text:
And whatsoever man
there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.

translated_text:
For
it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it
is
 for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh
is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
original_text:
For
it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it
is
 for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh
is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.

translated_text:
And every soul that eateth that which died
of itself, or that which was torn
with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe
himself
 in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.
original_text:
And every soul that eateth that which died
of itself, or that which was torn
with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe
himself
 in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.

translated_text:
But if he wash
them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.
original_text:
But if he wash
them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.
original_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.

translated_text: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.
original_text: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.

translated_text:
Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I
am the LORD your God.
original_text:
Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I
am the LORD your God.

translated_text:
Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I
am the LORD.
original_text:
Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover
their nakedness: I
am the LORD.
original_text:
None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover
their nakedness: I
am the LORD.

translated_text: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
original_text: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

translated_text: The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father’s nakedness.
original_text: The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father’s nakedness.

translated_text:
The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother,
whether she be born at home, or born abroad,
even
 their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
original_text:
The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother,
whether she be born at home, or born abroad,
even
 their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.

translated_text:
The nakedness of thy son’s daughter, or of thy daughter’s daughter,
even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs
is
 thine own nakedness.
original_text:
The nakedness of thy son’s daughter, or of thy daughter’s daughter,
even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs
is
 thine own nakedness.

translated_text:
The nakedness of thy father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of thy father, she
is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
original_text:
The nakedness of thy father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of thy father, she
is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s sister: she
is thy father’s near kinswoman.
original_text:
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s sister: she
is thy father’s near kinswoman.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister: for she
is thy mother’s near kinswoman.
original_text:
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister: for she
is thy mother’s near kinswoman.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she
is thine aunt.
original_text:
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she
is thine aunt.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she
is thy son’s wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
original_text:
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she
is thy son’s wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother’s wife: it
is thy brother’s nakedness.
original_text:
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother’s wife: it
is thy brother’s nakedness.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness;
for they
are her near kinswomen: it
is wickedness.
original_text:
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness;
for they
are her near kinswomen: it
is wickedness.

translated_text:
Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex
her,
 to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life
time.
original_text:
Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex
her,
 to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life
time.

translated_text: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
original_text: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.

translated_text: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour’s wife, to defile thyself with her.
original_text: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour’s wife, to defile thyself with her.

translated_text:
And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through
the fire
 to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I
am
 the LORD.
original_text:
And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through
the fire
 to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I
am
 the LORD.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it
is
 abomination.
original_text:
Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it
is
 abomination.

translated_text:
Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it
is confusion.
original_text:
Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it
is confusion.

translated_text: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
original_text: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:

translated_text: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
original_text: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.

translated_text:
(For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which
were before you, and the land is defiled;)
original_text:
(For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which
were before you, and the land is defiled;)

translated_text:
That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that
were before you.
original_text:
That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that
were before you.

translated_text:
For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit
them shall be cut off from among their people.
original_text:
For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit
them shall be cut off from among their people.

translated_text:
Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that
ye commit not
any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I
am the LORD your God.
original_text:
Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that
ye commit not
any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I
am the LORD your God.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God
am holy.
original_text:
Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God
am holy.

translated_text:
Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I
am the LORD your God.
original_text:
Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I
am the LORD your God.

translated_text:
Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I
am
 the LORD your God.
original_text:
Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I
am
 the LORD your God.

translated_text: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.
original_text: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.

translated_text: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
original_text: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.

translated_text:
And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it
is abominable; it shall not be accepted.
original_text:
And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it
is abominable; it shall not be accepted.

translated_text:
Therefore
every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
original_text:
Therefore
every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

translated_text: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
original_text: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.

translated_text:
And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather
every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I
am the LORD your God.
original_text:
And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather
every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I
am the LORD your God.

translated_text: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
original_text: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.

translated_text:
And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob
him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
original_text:
Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob
him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I
am the LORD.
original_text:
Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty:
but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
original_text:
Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty:
but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not go up and down
as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I
am the LORD.
original_text:
Thou shalt not go up and down
as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I
am the LORD.

translated_text: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.
original_text: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I
am the LORD.
original_text:
Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I
am the LORD.

translated_text: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.
original_text: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.

translated_text:
And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that
is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
original_text:
And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that
is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

translated_text:
And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
even a ram for a trespass offering.
original_text:
And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
even a ram for a trespass offering.

translated_text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.
original_text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.

translated_text: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
original_text: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.

translated_text:
But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD
withal.
original_text:
But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD
withal.

translated_text:
And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I
am the LORD your God.
original_text:
And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I
am the LORD your God.

translated_text:
Ye shall not eat
any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
original_text:
Ye shall not eat
any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.

translated_text: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
original_text: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.

translated_text:
Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I
am the LORD.
original_text:
Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I
am the LORD.

translated_text: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
original_text: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.

translated_text:
Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I
am
 the LORD.
original_text:
Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I
am
 the LORD.

translated_text:
Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I
am the LORD your God.
original_text:
Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I
am the LORD your God.

translated_text:
Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I
am the LORD.
original_text:
Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I
am the LORD.

translated_text: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.
original_text: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.

translated_text:
But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I
am the LORD your God.
original_text:
But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I
am the LORD your God.

translated_text: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
original_text: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.

translated_text:
Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I
am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
original_text:
Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I
am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I
am the LORD.
original_text:
Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I
am the LORD.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.
original_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.

translated_text: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
original_text: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

translated_text: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
original_text: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.

translated_text: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.
original_text: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.

translated_text: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:
original_text: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:

translated_text:
Who shall offer it before the LORD, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This
is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.
original_text:
Who shall offer it before the LORD, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This
is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.

translated_text: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
original_text: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.

original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,

And
if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it

It

 unclean.
original_text:

 unclean.

translated_text:

 a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:
original_text: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:

translated_text:
And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold,
if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;
original_text:
And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold,
if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;

translated_text:
Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive
and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
original_text:
Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive
and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

translated_text: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:
original_text: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:

original_text:

translated_text: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.
original_text: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.

translated_text: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.
original_text: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.

translated_text: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
original_text: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.

translated_text:
And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour
for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.
original_text:
And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour

translated_text:
And the priest that maketh
him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD,

him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD,
at
 the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

original_text:
And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them
for a wave offering before the LORD:

is the priest’s,
so is the trespass offering: it

original_text:
And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering
is the priest’s,
so is the trespass offering: it
is most holy:

And the priest shall take

some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put
it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

some of the log of oil, and pour

And the priest shall take
some of the log of oil, and pour

And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that
is

And of the rest of the oil that

original_text:

translated_text:
And the remnant of the oil that
is in the priest’s hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD.
original_text:
And the remnant of the oil that
is in the priest’s hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD.

translated_text: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:
original_text: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:

translated_text: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
original_text: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

translated_text: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.
original_text: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

translated_text: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the LORD.
original_text: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the LORD.

translated_text:

This
is the law
of him in whom
is the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get
that which pertaineth
 to his cleansing.

This

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

translated_text: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
original_text: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;

translated_text:
And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me
there is as it were a plague in the house:
original_text:
And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me
there is as it were a plague in the house:

translated_text:
Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go
into it to see the plague, that all that
is
 in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:
original_text:
Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go
into it to see the plague, that all that
is
 in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:

translated_text:
And he shall look on the plague, and, behold,
if the plague
be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight
are lower than the wall;
original_text:
And he shall look on the plague, and, behold,
if the plague
be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight
are lower than the wall;

translated_text: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:
original_text: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:

translated_text:
And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold,
if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;
original_text:
And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold,
if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;

translated_text:
Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague
is, and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:
original_text:
Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague
is, and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:

translated_text: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:
original_text: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:

translated_text:
And they shall take other stones, and put
them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.
original_text:
And they shall take other stones, and put
them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.

translated_text: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;
original_text: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;

translated_text:
Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold,
if the plague be spread in the house, it
is a fretting leprosy in the house: it is unclean.
original_text:
Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold,
if the plague be spread in the house, it
is a fretting leprosy in the house: it is unclean.

translated_text:
And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the morter of the house; and he shall carry
them
 forth out of the city into an unclean place.
original_text:
And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the morter of the house; and he shall carry
them
 forth out of the city into an unclean place.

translated_text: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
original_text: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.

translated_text: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.
original_text: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.

translated_text:
And if the priest shall come in, and look
upon it, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
original_text:
And if the priest shall come in, and look
upon it, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

translated_text: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
original_text: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

translated_text: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:
original_text: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:

translated_text: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:
original_text: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:

translated_text: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:
original_text: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:

translated_text: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.
original_text: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.

translated_text:
This
is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,
original_text:
This
is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,

translated_text: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,
original_text: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,

translated_text: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:
original_text: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:

translated_text:
To teach when
it is unclean, and when
it is clean: this
is the law of leprosy.
original_text:
To teach when
it is unclean, and when
it is clean: this
is the law of leprosy.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,

translated_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh,
because of his issue he
is
 unclean.
original_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh,
because of his issue he
is
 unclean.

translated_text:
And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it
is his uncleanness.
original_text:
And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it
is his uncleanness.

translated_text: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.
original_text: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.

translated_text:
And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe
himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
original_text:
And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe
himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

translated_text:
And he that sitteth on
any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe
himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
original_text:
And he that sitteth on
any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe
himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

translated_text:
And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe
himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
original_text:
And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe
himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

translated_text:
And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe
himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
original_text:
And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe
himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

translated_text: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.
original_text: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.

translated_text:
And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth
any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe
himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
original_text:
And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth
any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe
himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

translated_text:
And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe
himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
original_text:
And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe
himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

translated_text: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
original_text: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

translated_text: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
original_text: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

translated_text: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:
original_text: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:

translated_text:
And the priest shall offer them, the one
for a sin offering, and the other
for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.
original_text:
And the priest shall offer them, the one
for a sin offering, and the other
for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.

translated_text: And if any man’s seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
original_text: And if any man’s seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.

translated_text: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
original_text: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.

translated_text:
The woman also with whom man shall lie
with seed of copulation, they shall
both bathe
themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
original_text:
The woman also with whom man shall lie
with seed of copulation, they shall
both bathe
themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.

translated_text:
And if a woman have an issue,
and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
original_text:
And if a woman have an issue,
and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.

translated_text: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
original_text: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.

translated_text:

himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
original_text:
And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe
himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

translated_text:
And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe
himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
original_text:
And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe
himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

translated_text:
And if it
be on
her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
original_text:
And if it
be on
her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.

translated_text:
And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth
shall be
 unclean.
original_text:
And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth
shall be
 unclean.

translated_text: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.

translated_text: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.
original_text: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.

translated_text:

original_text:

translated_text: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
original_text: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

translated_text: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
original_text: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

translated_text:

original_text: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.

original_text:

original_text: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

translated_text: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.
original_text: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.

original_text: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.

translated_text:

original_text:
Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I

original_text:

original_text:

shall be
 upon him.

original_text:

original_text: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.

original_text:

original_text:

translated_text: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
original_text: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

translated_text: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister, nor of thy father’s sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
original_text: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister, nor of thy father’s sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.

translated_text: And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife, he hath uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
original_text: And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife, he hath uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

translated_text:

original_text:
And if a man shall take his brother’s wife, it

translated_text: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.
original_text: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.

translated_text: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
original_text: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

translated_text:

other
 people.
original_text:

other
 people.

translated_text: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
original_text: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.

translated_text:

original_text:

original_text:

original_text: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.

translated_text:

original_text:

original_text: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

original_text:

original_text:

original_text: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.

translated_text:

he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;

he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;

original_text: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

original_text: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

original_text:

original_text: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD do sanctify him.

original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

original_text:

original_text:

original_text: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the LORD do sanctify them.

original_text:

original_text:

original_text: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.

original_text:

original_text:

original_text: But if the priest’s daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father’s house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father’s meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.

original_text:
That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I
am
 the LORD.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

translated_text:
This
is the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein
is no blemish,
and upon which never came yoke:
original_text:
This
is the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein
is no blemish,
and upon which never came yoke:

translated_text:
And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and
one shall slay her before his face:
original_text:
And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and
one shall slay her before his face:

translated_text: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
original_text: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:

translated_text:
And
one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
original_text:
And
one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:

translated_text:
And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast
it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
original_text:
And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast
it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

translated_text: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.
original_text: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.

translated_text: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
original_text: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.

translated_text:
And a man
that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay
them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it
is a purification for sin.
original_text:
And a man
that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay
them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it
is a purification for sin.

translated_text: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.
original_text: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.

translated_text: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
original_text: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

translated_text: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
original_text: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

translated_text:
Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness
is yet upon him.
original_text:
Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness
is yet upon him.

translated_text:
This
is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that
is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
original_text:
This
is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that
is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

translated_text:
And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it,
is
 unclean.
original_text:
And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it,
is
 unclean.

translated_text: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
original_text: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

translated_text:
And for an unclean
person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
original_text:
And for an unclean
person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:

translated_text:
And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip
it in the water, and sprinkle
it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
original_text:
And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip
it in the water, and sprinkle
it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:

translated_text:
And the clean
person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
original_text:
And the clean
person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.

translated_text:
But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he
is unclean.
original_text:
But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he
is unclean.

translated_text: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.
original_text: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.

translated_text:
And whatsoever the unclean
person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth
it shall be unclean until even.
original_text:
And whatsoever the unclean
person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth
it shall be unclean until even.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father’s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father’s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

translated_text:
And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee
shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.
original_text:
And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee
shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.

translated_text: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.
original_text: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.

translated_text: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.
original_text: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.

translated_text: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.
original_text: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.

translated_text:
