And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men
were heads of the children of Israel.
original_text:
And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men
were heads of the children of Israel.

translated_text:
And these
were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
original_text:
And these
were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

translated_text: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
original_text: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

translated_text: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
original_text: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

translated_text: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
original_text: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

translated_text: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
original_text: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.

translated_text: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
original_text: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

translated_text: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
original_text: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

translated_text: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
original_text: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

translated_text: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
original_text: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

translated_text: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
original_text: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

translated_text: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
original_text: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

translated_text: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
original_text: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

translated_text:
These
are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
original_text:
These
are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.

translated_text:
And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this
way southward, and go up into the mountain:
original_text:
And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this
way southward, and go up into the mountain:

translated_text:
And what the land
is that they dwell in, whether it
be good or bad; and what cities
they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
original_text:
And what the land
is that they dwell in, whether it
be good or bad; and what cities
they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;

translated_text:
And what the land
is, whether it
be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time
was the time of the firstripe grapes.
original_text:
And what the land
is, whether it
be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time
was the time of the firstripe grapes.

translated_text: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
original_text: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

translated_text:
And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak,
were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
original_text:
And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak,
were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

translated_text:
And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and
they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
original_text:
And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and
they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

translated_text: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.
original_text: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

translated_text: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.
original_text: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.

translated_text: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.
original_text: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.

translated_text:
And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this
is the fruit of it.
original_text:
And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this
is the fruit of it.

translated_text:
Nevertheless the people
be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities
are walled,
and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
original_text:
Nevertheless the people
be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities
are walled,
and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

translated_text: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.
original_text: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.

translated_text: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
original_text: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

translated_text: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
original_text: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

translated_text:
And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it
are men of a great stature.
original_text:
And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it
are men of a great stature.

translated_text:
And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak,
which come
 of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
original_text:
And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak,
which come
 of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.

translated_text: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.
original_text: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.

translated_text:
And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard
it.
original_text:
And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard
it.

translated_text:
(Now the man Moses
was very meek, above all the men which
were upon the face of the earth.)
original_text:
(Now the man Moses
was very meek, above all the men which
were upon the face of the earth.)

translated_text: And the LORD spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.
original_text: And the LORD spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.

translated_text: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.
original_text: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.

translated_text:
And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you,
I the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision,
and
 will speak unto him in a dream.
original_text:
And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you,
I the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision,
and
 will speak unto him in a dream.

translated_text:
My servant Moses
is not so, who
is faithful in all mine house.
original_text:
My servant Moses
is not so, who
is faithful in all mine house.

translated_text: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?
original_text: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?

translated_text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.
original_text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.

translated_text:
And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam
became leprous,
white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold,
she was leprous.
original_text:
And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam
became leprous,
white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold,
she was leprous.

translated_text: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.
original_text: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.

translated_text: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother’s womb.
original_text: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother’s womb.

translated_text: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.
original_text: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in
again.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in
again.

translated_text:
And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in
again.
original_text:
And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in
again.

translated_text: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
original_text: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.

translated_text: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:
original_text: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:

translated_text: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
original_text: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.

translated_text:
And if they be married to any of the sons of the
other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
original_text:
And if they be married to any of the sons of the
other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.

translated_text: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
original_text: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.

translated_text: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.
original_text: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.

translated_text: This is the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
original_text: This is the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.

translated_text: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
original_text: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

translated_text: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
original_text: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.

translated_text:
Neither shall the inheritance remove from
one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
original_text:
Neither shall the inheritance remove from
one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.

translated_text: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
original_text: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:

translated_text: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father’s brothers’ sons:
original_text: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father’s brothers’ sons:

translated_text: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
original_text: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

translated_text:
These
are the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan
near Jericho.
original_text:
These
are the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan
near Jericho.

translated_text:
These
are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
original_text:
These
are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

translated_text:
And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these
are their journeys according to their goings out.
original_text:
And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these
are their journeys according to their goings out.

translated_text: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
original_text: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

translated_text:
For the Egyptians buried all
their firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.
original_text:
For the Egyptians buried all
their firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.

translated_text: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
original_text: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.

translated_text:
And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which
is
 in the edge of the wilderness.
original_text:
And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which
is
 in the edge of the wilderness.

translated_text:
And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pi-hahiroth, which
is before Baal-zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
original_text:
And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pi-hahiroth, which
is before Baal-zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.

translated_text: And they departed from before Pi-hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
original_text: And they departed from before Pi-hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.

translated_text:
And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim
were
 twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
original_text:
And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim
were
 twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.

translated_text: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
original_text: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.

translated_text: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
original_text: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

translated_text: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
original_text: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

translated_text: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
original_text: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

translated_text: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
original_text: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.

translated_text: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
original_text: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.

translated_text: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.
original_text: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.

translated_text: And they departed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
original_text: And they departed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.

translated_text: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
original_text: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.

translated_text: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon-parez.
original_text: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon-parez.

translated_text: And they departed from Rimmon-parez, and pitched in Libnah.
original_text: And they departed from Rimmon-parez, and pitched in Libnah.

translated_text: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
original_text: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.

translated_text: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
original_text: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.

translated_text: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
original_text: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.

translated_text: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
original_text: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.

translated_text: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
original_text: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.

translated_text: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
original_text: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.

translated_text: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
original_text: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.

translated_text: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
original_text: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.

translated_text: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
original_text: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.

translated_text: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
original_text: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.

translated_text: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene-jaakan.
original_text: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene-jaakan.

translated_text: And they removed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.
original_text: And they removed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.

translated_text: And they went from Hor-hagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
original_text: And they went from Hor-hagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.

translated_text: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
original_text: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.

translated_text: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion-gaber.
original_text: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion-gaber.

translated_text:
And they removed from Ezion-gaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which
is Kadesh.
original_text:
And they removed from Ezion-gaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which
is Kadesh.

translated_text: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
original_text: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

translated_text:
And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first
day of the fifth month.
original_text:
And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first
day of the fifth month.

translated_text:
And Aaron
was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
original_text:
And Aaron
was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.

translated_text: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
original_text: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

translated_text: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
original_text: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.

translated_text: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
original_text: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.

translated_text: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
original_text: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.

translated_text: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.
original_text: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.

translated_text: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibon-gad.
original_text: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibon-gad.

translated_text: And they removed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.
original_text: And they removed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.

translated_text: And they removed from Almon-diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
original_text: And they removed from Almon-diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

translated_text:
And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan
near Jericho.
original_text:
And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan
near Jericho.

translated_text:
And they pitched by Jordan, from Beth-jesimoth
even unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.
original_text:
And they pitched by Jordan, from Beth-jesimoth
even unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.

translated_text:
And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan
near Jericho, saying,
original_text:
And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan
near Jericho, saying,

translated_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
original_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

translated_text: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
original_text: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:

translated_text:
And ye shall dispossess
the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
original_text:
And ye shall dispossess
the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.

translated_text:
And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families:
and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man’s
inheritance
 shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
original_text:
And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families:
and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man’s
inheritance
 shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.

translated_text:
But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them
shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
original_text:
But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them
shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.

translated_text:
Moreover it shall come to pass,
that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
original_text:
Moreover it shall come to pass,
that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.

translated_text:
Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place
was a place for cattle;
original_text:
Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place
was a place for cattle;

translated_text: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
original_text: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,

translated_text: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
original_text: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

translated_text:
Even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel,
is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
original_text:
Even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel,
is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:

translated_text:
Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession,
and bring us not over Jordan.
original_text:
Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession,
and bring us not over Jordan.

translated_text: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
original_text: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?

translated_text: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?
original_text: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?

translated_text: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.
original_text: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

translated_text: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
original_text: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.

translated_text: And the LORD’S anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,
original_text: And the LORD’S anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,

translated_text: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
original_text: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:

translated_text: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.
original_text: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.

translated_text: And the LORD’S anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.
original_text: And the LORD’S anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.

translated_text: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers’ stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.
original_text: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers’ stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.

translated_text: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
original_text: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.

translated_text: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
original_text: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:

translated_text: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
original_text: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

translated_text: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
original_text: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

translated_text: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
original_text: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.

translated_text: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,
original_text: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,

translated_text: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
original_text: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,

translated_text: And the land be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.
original_text: And the land be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

translated_text: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.
original_text: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.

translated_text: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
original_text: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.

translated_text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
original_text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.

translated_text: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
original_text: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:

translated_text: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.
original_text: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.

translated_text: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:
original_text: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:

translated_text: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
original_text: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

translated_text: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
original_text: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

translated_text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
original_text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.

translated_text:
We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan
may be ours.
original_text:
We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan
may be ours.

translated_text:
And Moses gave unto them,
even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts,
even the cities of the country round about.
original_text:
And Moses gave unto them,
even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts,
even the cities of the country round about.

translated_text: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
original_text: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

translated_text: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
original_text: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,

translated_text: And Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
original_text: And Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.

translated_text: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
original_text: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,

translated_text: And Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
original_text: And Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.

translated_text:
And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which
was in it.
original_text:
And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which
was in it.

translated_text: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
original_text: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.

translated_text: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havoth-jair.
original_text: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havoth-jair.

translated_text: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
original_text: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

translated_text:
And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan
near
 Jericho, saying,
original_text:
And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan
near
 Jericho, saying,

translated_text:
Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give
also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.
original_text:
Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give
also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.

translated_text: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
original_text: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.

translated_text:
And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites,
shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
original_text:
And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites,
shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.

translated_text:
And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits and the city
shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
original_text:
And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits and the city
shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.

translated_text:
And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites
there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.
original_text:
And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites
there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.

translated_text:
So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites
shall be forty and eight cities: them
shall ye give with their suburbs.
original_text:
So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites
shall be forty and eight cities: them
shall ye give with their suburbs.

translated_text:
And the cities which ye shall give
shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from
them that have many ye shall give many; but from
them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.
original_text:
And the cities which ye shall give
shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from
them that have many ye shall give many; but from
them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
original_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

translated_text: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.
original_text: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.

translated_text: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
original_text: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.

translated_text: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.
original_text: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.

translated_text:
Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan,
which shall be cities of refuge.
original_text:
Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan,
which shall be cities of refuge.

translated_text:
These six cities shall be a refuge,
both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
original_text:
These six cities shall be a refuge,
both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.

translated_text:
And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he
is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
original_text:
And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he
is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

translated_text: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
original_text: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

translated_text:
Or
if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he
is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
original_text:
Or
if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he
is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

translated_text: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
original_text: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.

translated_text: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
original_text: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;

translated_text:
Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote
him shall surely be put to death;
for he
is
 a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
original_text:
Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote
him shall surely be put to death;
for he
is
 a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.

translated_text: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,
original_text: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,

translated_text:
Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing
him not, and cast
it upon him, that he die, and
was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
original_text:
Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing
him not, and cast
it upon him, that he die, and
was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:

translated_text: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
original_text: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:

translated_text: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
original_text: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.

translated_text: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
original_text: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;

translated_text: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
original_text: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:

translated_text: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
original_text: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

translated_text:
So these
things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
original_text:
So these
things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

translated_text:
Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person
to cause him to die.
original_text:
Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person
to cause him to die.

translated_text:
Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which
is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
original_text:
Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which
is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.

translated_text: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
original_text: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

translated_text:
So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye
are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
original_text:
So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye
are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.

translated_text: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.
original_text: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance,
even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
original_text:
Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance,
even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)

translated_text: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
original_text: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:

translated_text: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon:
original_text: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon:

translated_text: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
original_text: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.

translated_text:
And
as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
original_text:
And
as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.

translated_text: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
original_text: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:

translated_text:
From mount Hor ye shall point out
your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
original_text:
From mount Hor ye shall point out
your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:

translated_text: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.
original_text: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.

translated_text: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:
original_text: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:

translated_text: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
original_text: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:

translated_text: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
original_text: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.

translated_text:
And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This
is
 the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
original_text:
And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This
is
 the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:

translated_text:
For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received
their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
original_text:
For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received
their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:

translated_text:
The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan
near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
original_text:
The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan
near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
These
are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
original_text:
These
are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

translated_text: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
original_text: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.

translated_text:
And the names of the men
are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
original_text:
And the names of the men
are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

translated_text: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
original_text: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

translated_text: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
original_text: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

translated_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
original_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.

translated_text: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
original_text: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

translated_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
original_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

translated_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
original_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

translated_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
original_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

translated_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
original_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

translated_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
original_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.

translated_text:
These
are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
original_text:
These
are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
original_text: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.

translated_text: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.
original_text: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.

translated_text: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
original_text: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.

translated_text:
So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of
every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
original_text:
So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of
every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

translated_text:
And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of
every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
original_text:
And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of
every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.

translated_text: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
original_text: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.

translated_text:
And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain;
namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
original_text:
And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain;
