Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the LORD, after your weeks
be out, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:

translated_text: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;
original_text: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;

translated_text: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,
original_text: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,

translated_text: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;
original_text: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;

translated_text: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.
original_text: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.

translated_text:
Ye shall offer
them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.
original_text:
Ye shall offer
them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.

translated_text: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
original_text: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

translated_text:
And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation,
by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
original_text:
And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation,
by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

translated_text: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.
original_text: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.

translated_text:
Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us
therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.
original_text:
Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us
therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.

translated_text: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
original_text: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
original_text: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.

translated_text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
original_text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.

translated_text: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
original_text: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.

translated_text: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father’s brethren.
original_text: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father’s brethren.

translated_text: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.

translated_text: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
original_text: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.

translated_text:
For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that
is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
original_text:
For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that
is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

translated_text: And Moses spake unto the LORD, saying,
original_text: And Moses spake unto the LORD, saying,

translated_text: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
original_text: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,

translated_text: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
original_text: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom
is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom
is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;

translated_text: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
original_text: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.

translated_text: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
original_text: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.

translated_text:
And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask
counsel
 for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in,
both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
original_text:
And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask
counsel
 for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in,
both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.

translated_text: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
original_text: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:

translated_text: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
original_text: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

translated_text:
And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan
by Jericho.
original_text:
And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan
by Jericho.

translated_text: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
original_text: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

translated_text:
And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they
were
 many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
original_text:
And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they
were
 many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

translated_text:
And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all
that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor
was king of the Moabites at that time.
original_text:
And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all
that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor
was king of the Moabites at that time.

translated_text:
He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which
is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:
original_text:
He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which
is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:

translated_text:
Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they
are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail,
that
 we may smite them, and
that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest
is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.
original_text:
Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they
are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail,
that
 we may smite them, and
that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest
is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.

translated_text: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.
original_text: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.

translated_text: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
original_text: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.

translated_text:
And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men
are these with thee?
original_text:
And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men
are these with thee?

translated_text:
And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me,
saying,
original_text:
And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me,
saying,

translated_text:
Behold,
there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.
original_text:
Behold,
there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.

translated_text:
And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they
are blessed.
original_text:
And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they
are blessed.

translated_text: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.
original_text: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.

translated_text: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.
original_text: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.

translated_text: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.
original_text: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.

translated_text: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:
original_text: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:

translated_text: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
original_text: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.

translated_text: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.
original_text: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.

translated_text: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the LORD will say unto me more.
original_text: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the LORD will say unto me more.

translated_text:
And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up,
and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.
original_text:
And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up,
and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.

translated_text: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
original_text: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.

translated_text:
And God’s anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants
were with him.
original_text:
And God’s anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants
were with him.

translated_text: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
original_text: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.

translated_text:
But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall
being on this side, and a wall on that side.
original_text:
But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall
being on this side, and a wall on that side.

translated_text: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
original_text: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall: and he smote her again.

translated_text:
And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where
was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
original_text:
And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where
was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

translated_text: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam’s anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.
original_text: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam’s anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.

translated_text: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
original_text: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?

translated_text: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.
original_text: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.

translated_text:
And the ass said unto Balaam,
Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since
I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.
original_text:
And the ass said unto Balaam,
Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since
I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.

translated_text: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.
original_text: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.

translated_text:
And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because
thy way is perverse before me:
original_text:
And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because
thy way is perverse before me:

translated_text: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.
original_text: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.

translated_text: And Balaam said unto the angel of the LORD, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.
original_text: And Balaam said unto the angel of the LORD, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.

translated_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
original_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

translated_text:
And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which
is in the border of Arnon, which
is
 in the utmost coast.
original_text:
And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which
is in the border of Arnon, which
is
 in the utmost coast.

translated_text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?
original_text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?

translated_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.
original_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.

translated_text: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjath-huzoth.
original_text: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjath-huzoth.

translated_text:
And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that
were with him.
original_text:
And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that
were with him.

translated_text:
And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost
part of the people.
original_text:
And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost
part of the people.

translated_text:
And
when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took
some of them prisoners.
original_text:
And
when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took
some of them prisoners.

translated_text: And Israel vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
original_text: And Israel vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.

translated_text: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.
original_text: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.

translated_text: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
original_text: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.

translated_text:
And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for
there is
 no bread, neither
is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.
original_text:
And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for
there is
 no bread, neither
is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.

translated_text: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
original_text: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.

translated_text: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD, and against thee; pray unto the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
original_text: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD, and against thee; pray unto the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.

translated_text: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
original_text: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.

translated_text: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.
original_text: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.

translated_text:
And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ije-abarim, in the wilderness which
is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
original_text:
And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ije-abarim, in the wilderness which
is before Moab, toward the sunrising.

translated_text: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.
original_text: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.

translated_text:
From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which
is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon
is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
original_text:
From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which

translated_text: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the LORD, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,
original_text: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the LORD, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,

translated_text: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.
original_text: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.

translated_text:
And from thence
they went to Beer: that
is the well whereof the LORD spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
original_text:
And from thence
they went to Beer: that
is the well whereof the LORD spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.

translated_text: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:

The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by
the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness
they went to Mattanah:
original_text:
The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by
the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness

original_text: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:

And from Bamoth
in the valley, that

original_text:
And from Bamoth
in the valley, that
is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.

translated_text: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
original_text: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

translated_text:
Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink
of the waters of the well:
but we will go along by the king’s
high way, until we be past thy borders.
original_text:
Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink

but we will go along by the king’s
high way, until we be past thy borders.

translated_text: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
original_text: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

translated_text:
And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon
was strong.
original_text:
And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon
was strong.

translated_text: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.
original_text: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.

translated_text:
For Heshbon
was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.
original_text:
For Heshbon
was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.

translated_text: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:
original_text: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:

translated_text:
For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab,
and the lords of the high places of Arnon.
original_text:
For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab,
and the lords of the high places of Arnon.

translated_text: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
original_text: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.

translated_text:
We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which
reacheth unto Medeba.
original_text:
We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which
reacheth unto Medeba.

translated_text: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
original_text: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.

translated_text:
And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that
were there.
original_text:
And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that
were there.

translated_text: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.
original_text: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

translated_text: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.
original_text: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.

translated_text: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
original_text: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

translated_text:
And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding
in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.
original_text:
And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding
in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.

translated_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
original_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:

translated_text:
He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling
into a trance, but having his eyes open:
original_text:
He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling
into a trance, but having his eyes open:

translated_text:
How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob,
and thy tabernacles, O Israel!
original_text:
How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob,
and thy tabernacles, O Israel!

translated_text:
As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river’s side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted,
and as cedar trees beside the waters.
original_text:
As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river’s side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted,
and as cedar trees beside the waters.

translated_text:
He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed
shall be
 in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
original_text:
He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed
shall be
 in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.

translated_text:
God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce
them through with his arrows.
original_text:
God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce
them through with his arrows.

translated_text:
He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed
is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.
original_text:
He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed
is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.

translated_text:
And Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed
them these three times.
original_text:
And Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed
them these three times.

translated_text: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.
original_text: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.

translated_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,
original_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,

translated_text:
And now, behold, I go unto my people: come
therefore, and
 I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
original_text:
And now, behold, I go unto my people: come
therefore, and
 I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.

translated_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
original_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:

translated_text:
He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High,
which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling
into a trance, but having his eyes open:
original_text:
He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High,
which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling
into a trance, but having his eyes open:

translated_text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
original_text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

translated_text: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.
original_text: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.

translated_text: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.
original_text: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.

translated_text:
And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek
was the first of the nations; but his latter end
shall be
 that he perish for ever.
original_text:
And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek
was the first of the nations; but his latter end
shall be
 that he perish for ever.

translated_text: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.
original_text: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.

translated_text: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.
original_text: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.

translated_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!
original_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!

translated_text:
And ships
shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
original_text:
And ships
shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.

translated_text: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.
original_text: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.

translated_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
original_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.

translated_text:
And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on
every altar a bullock and a ram.
original_text:
And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on
every altar a bullock and a ram.

translated_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the LORD will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.
original_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the LORD will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.

translated_text:
And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon
every altar a bullock and a ram.
original_text:
And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon
every altar a bullock and a ram.

translated_text: And the LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
original_text: And the LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.

translated_text: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
original_text: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.

translated_text:
And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east,
saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.
original_text:
And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east,
saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.

translated_text:
How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy,
whom the LORD hath not defied?
original_text:
How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy,
whom the LORD hath not defied?

translated_text: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
original_text: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.

translated_text:
Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth
part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
original_text:
Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth
part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!

translated_text:
And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed
them altogether.
original_text:
And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed
them altogether.

translated_text: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth?
original_text: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth?

translated_text: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
original_text: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.

translated_text:
And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on
every altar.
original_text:
And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on
every altar.

translated_text:
And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet
the LORD yonder.
original_text:
And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet
the LORD yonder.

translated_text: And the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
original_text: And the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.

translated_text: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?
original_text: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?

translated_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
original_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:

translated_text:
God
is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do
it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
original_text:
God
is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do
it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?

translated_text:
Behold, I have received
commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
original_text:
Behold, I have received
commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.

translated_text:
He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God
is with him, and the shout of a king
is among them.
original_text:
He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God
is with him, and the shout of a king
is among them.

translated_text: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.
original_text: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.

translated_text:
Surely
there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither
is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
original_text:
Surely
there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither
is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!

translated_text:
Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat
of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
original_text:
Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat
of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.

translated_text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
original_text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.

translated_text: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?
original_text: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?

translated_text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
original_text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.

translated_text: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.
original_text: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.

translated_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
original_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.

translated_text:
And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on
every altar.
original_text:
And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on
every altar.

translated_text:
Then came the children of Israel,
even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
original_text:
Then came the children of Israel,
even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

translated_text: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
original_text: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

translated_text: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!
original_text: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!

translated_text: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
original_text: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?

translated_text:
And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it
is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither
is there any water to drink.
original_text:
And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it
is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither
is there any water to drink.

translated_text: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto them.
original_text: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto them.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.
original_text: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.

translated_text: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.
original_text: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.

translated_text: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?
original_text: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?

translated_text:
And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts
also.
original_text:
And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts
also.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.

translated_text:
This
is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.
original_text:
This
is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.

translated_text: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:
original_text: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:

translated_text: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:
original_text: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:

translated_text:
And when we cried unto the LORD, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we
are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:
original_text:
And when we cried unto the LORD, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we
are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:

translated_text:
Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink
of
 the water of the wells: we will go by the king’s
high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.
original_text:
Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink
of
 the water of the wells: we will go by the king’s
high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.

translated_text: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.
original_text: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.

translated_text:
And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without
doing any thing
else, go through on my feet.
original_text:
And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without
doing any thing
else, go through on my feet.

translated_text: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
original_text: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.

translated_text: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.
original_text: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.

translated_text:
And the children of Israel,
even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.
original_text:
And the children of Israel,
even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,

translated_text: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.
original_text: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.

translated_text: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:
original_text: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:

translated_text:
And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered
unto his people, and shall die there.
original_text:
And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered
unto his people, and shall die there.

translated_text: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
original_text: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

translated_text: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.
original_text: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.

translated_text:
And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days,
even all the house of Israel.
original_text:
And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days,
even all the house of Israel.

translated_text:
And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first
day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
original_text:
And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first
day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

translated_text: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
original_text: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.

translated_text: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
original_text: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.

translated_text:
And these
are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of
the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
original_text:
And these
are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of
the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.

with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:

to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:

translated_text: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;
original_text: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;

translated_text:
And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make
thy belly to swell, and
thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.

And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make
thy belly to swell, and
thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.

translated_text:
And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot
them out with the bitter water:

them out with the bitter water:

translated_text:
And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her,
and become bitter.
original_text:
And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her,
and become bitter.

translated_text: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:
original_text: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:

translated_text:

even
 the memorial thereof, and burn
it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.

even
 the memorial thereof, and burn
it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.

translated_text:

that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her,
and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.

translated_text: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
original_text: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.

translated_text: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
original_text: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.

translated_text: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
original_text: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate
themselves unto the LORD:

themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate
themselves unto the LORD:

translated_text:
He shall separate
himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
original_text:
He shall separate
himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.

translated_text: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.
original_text: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

translated_text:
All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth
himself
 unto the LORD, he shall be holy,
and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.

himself
 unto the LORD, he shall be holy,

translated_text:
All the days that he separateth
himself unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.
original_text:
All the days that he separateth
himself unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.

translated_text:

is upon his head.
original_text:

is upon his head.

is holy unto the LORD.
original_text:
All the days of his separation he
is holy unto the LORD.

translated_text: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
original_text: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.

translated_text: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
original_text: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

translated_text: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
original_text: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.

translated_text: And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.

translated_text:
And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that
was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.
original_text:
And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that
was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.
original_text: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.

translated_text: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text:
And this work of the candlestick
was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof,
was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
original_text:
And this work of the candlestick
was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof,
was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
original_text: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

translated_text:
And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and
so make themselves clean.
original_text:
And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and
so make themselves clean.

translated_text:
Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering,
even
 fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.
original_text:
Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering,
even
 fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.

translated_text: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:
original_text: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:

translated_text: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:
original_text: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:

translated_text:
And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD
for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD.
original_text:
And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD
for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD.

translated_text:
And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one
for a sin offering, and the other
for a burnt offering, unto the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.
original_text:
And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one
for a sin offering, and the other
for a burnt offering, unto the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.

translated_text:
And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them
for an offering unto the LORD.
original_text:
And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them
for an offering unto the LORD.

translated_text: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.
original_text: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.

translated_text:
And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them
for an offering.
original_text:
And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them
for an offering.

translated_text:
For they
are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb,
even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.
original_text:
For they
are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb,
even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.

translated_text:
For all the firstborn of the children of Israel
are mine,
both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.
original_text:
For all the firstborn of the children of Israel
are mine,
both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.

translated_text: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
original_text: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.

translated_text:
And I have given the Levites
as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.
original_text:
And I have given the Levites
as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.

translated_text: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.
original_text: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.

translated_text:
And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them
as an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.
original_text:
And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them
as an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.

translated_text: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.
original_text: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
This
is it that
belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:
original_text:
This
is it that
belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:

translated_text:
And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service
thereof, and shall serve no more:
original_text:
And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service
thereof, and shall serve no more:

translated_text: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.
original_text: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

translated_text: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.
original_text: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.

translated_text: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.
original_text: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.

translated_text: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.
original_text: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.

translated_text: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.
original_text: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.

translated_text: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
original_text: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:

translated_text:
And those men said unto him, We
are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?
original_text:
And those men said unto him, We
are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?

translated_text: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.
original_text: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

translated_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or
be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD.
original_text:
Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or
be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD.

translated_text:
The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it,
and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter
herbs.
original_text:
The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it,
and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter
herbs.

translated_text: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.
original_text: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.

translated_text:
But the man that
is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
original_text:
But the man that
is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

translated_text: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.
original_text: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.

translated_text:
And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle,
namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.
original_text:
And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle,
namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.

translated_text:
So it was alway: the cloud covered it
by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
original_text:
So it was alway: the cloud covered it
by day, and the appearance of fire by night.

translated_text: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.
original_text: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.
