original_text: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.

translated_text:
Also every sickness, and every plague, which
is not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
original_text:
Also every sickness, and every plague, which
is not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.

translated_text: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the LORD thy God.
original_text: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the LORD thy God.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.

translated_text:
And the LORD shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known,
even wood and stone.
original_text:
And the LORD shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known,
even wood and stone.

translated_text: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the LORD shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:
original_text: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the LORD shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:

translated_text: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:
original_text: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:

translated_text: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
original_text: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

translated_text:
And the LORD shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy
you.
original_text:
And the LORD shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy
you.

translated_text: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, Keep all the commandments which I command you this day.
original_text: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, Keep all the commandments which I command you this day.

translated_text: And it shall be on the day when ye shall pass over Jordan unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, that thou shalt set thee up great stones, and plaister them with plaister:
original_text: And it shall be on the day when ye shall pass over Jordan unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, that thou shalt set thee up great stones, and plaister them with plaister:

translated_text: And thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law, when thou art passed over, that thou mayest go in unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, a land that floweth with milk and honey; as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee.
original_text: And thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law, when thou art passed over, that thou mayest go in unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, a land that floweth with milk and honey; as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee.

translated_text:
Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan,
that ye shall set up these stones, which I command you this day, in mount Ebal, and thou shalt plaister them with plaister.
original_text:
Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan,
that ye shall set up these stones, which I command you this day, in mount Ebal, and thou shalt plaister them with plaister.

translated_text:
And there shalt thou build an altar unto the LORD thy God, an altar of stones: thou shalt not lift up
any iron
tool upon them.
original_text:
And there shalt thou build an altar unto the LORD thy God, an altar of stones: thou shalt not lift up
any iron
tool upon them.

translated_text: Thou shalt build the altar of the LORD thy God of whole stones: and thou shalt offer burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD thy God:
original_text: Thou shalt build the altar of the LORD thy God of whole stones: and thou shalt offer burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD thy God:

translated_text: And thou shalt offer peace offerings, and shalt eat there, and rejoice before the LORD thy God.
original_text: And thou shalt offer peace offerings, and shalt eat there, and rejoice before the LORD thy God.

translated_text: And thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly.
original_text: And thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly.

translated_text: And Moses and the priests the Levites spake unto all Israel, saying, Take heed, and hearken, O Israel; this day thou art become the people of the LORD thy God.
original_text: And Moses and the priests the Levites spake unto all Israel, saying, Take heed, and hearken, O Israel; this day thou art become the people of the LORD thy God.

translated_text: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the LORD thy God, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command thee this day.
original_text: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the LORD thy God, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command thee this day.

translated_text: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,
original_text: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,

translated_text: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:
original_text: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:

translated_text: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
original_text: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

translated_text: And the Levites shall speak, and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice,
original_text: And the Levites shall speak, and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice,

translated_text:
Cursed
be the man that maketh
any graven or molten image, an abomination unto the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and putteth
it in
a secret
place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.
original_text:
Cursed
be the man that maketh
any graven or molten image, an abomination unto the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and putteth
it in
a secret
place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.

translated_text:
Cursed
be he that setteth light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
original_text:
Cursed
be he that setteth light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

translated_text:
Cursed
be he that removeth his neighbour’s landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.
original_text:
Cursed
be he that removeth his neighbour’s landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.

translated_text:
Cursed
be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.
original_text:
Cursed
be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.

translated_text:
Cursed
be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.
original_text:
Cursed
be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.

translated_text:
Cursed
be he that lieth with his father’s wife; because he uncovereth his father’s skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.
original_text:
Cursed
be he that lieth with his father’s wife; because he uncovereth his father’s skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.

translated_text:
Cursed
be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.
original_text:
Cursed
be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.

translated_text:
Cursed
be he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
original_text:
Cursed
be he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

translated_text:
Cursed
be he that lieth with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.
original_text:
Cursed
be he that lieth with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.

translated_text:
Cursed
be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.
original_text:
Cursed
be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.

translated_text:
Cursed
be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.
original_text:
Cursed
be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.

translated_text:
Cursed
be he that confirmeth not
all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.
original_text:
Cursed
be he that confirmeth not
all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.

translated_text:
That thou shalt take of the first of all the fruit of the earth, which thou shalt bring of thy land that the LORD thy God giveth thee, and shalt put
it in a basket, and shalt go unto the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to place his name there.
original_text:
That thou shalt take of the first of all the fruit of the earth, which thou shalt bring of thy land that the LORD thy God giveth thee, and shalt put
it in a basket, and shalt go unto the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to place his name there.

translated_text: And thou shalt go unto the priest that shall be in those days, and say unto him, I profess this day unto the LORD thy God, that I am come unto the country which the LORD sware unto our fathers for to give us.
original_text: And thou shalt go unto the priest that shall be in those days, and say unto him, I profess this day unto the LORD thy God, that I am come unto the country which the LORD sware unto our fathers for to give us.

translated_text: And the priest shall take the basket out of thine hand, and set it down before the altar of the LORD thy God.
original_text: And the priest shall take the basket out of thine hand, and set it down before the altar of the LORD thy God.

translated_text:
And thou shalt speak and say before the LORD thy God, A Syrian ready to perish
was my father, and he went down into Egypt, and sojourned there with a few, and became there a nation, great, mighty, and populous:
original_text:
And thou shalt speak and say before the LORD thy God, A Syrian ready to perish
was my father, and he went down into Egypt, and sojourned there with a few, and became there a nation, great, mighty, and populous:

translated_text: And the Egyptians evil entreated us, and afflicted us, and laid upon us hard bondage:
original_text: And the Egyptians evil entreated us, and afflicted us, and laid upon us hard bondage:

translated_text: And when we cried unto the LORD God of our fathers, the LORD heard our voice, and looked on our affliction, and our labour, and our oppression:
original_text: And when we cried unto the LORD God of our fathers, the LORD heard our voice, and looked on our affliction, and our labour, and our oppression:

translated_text: And the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with great terribleness, and with signs, and with wonders:
original_text: And the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with great terribleness, and with signs, and with wonders:

translated_text:
And he hath brought us into this place, and hath given us this land,
even a land that floweth with milk and honey.
original_text:
And he hath brought us into this place, and hath given us this land,
even a land that floweth with milk and honey.

translated_text: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land, which thou, O LORD, hast given me. And thou shalt set it before the LORD thy God, and worship before the LORD thy God:
original_text: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land, which thou, O LORD, hast given me. And thou shalt set it before the LORD thy God, and worship before the LORD thy God:

translated_text:
And thou shalt rejoice in every good
thing which the LORD thy God hath given unto thee, and unto thine house, thou, and the Levite, and the stranger that
is among you.
original_text:
And thou shalt rejoice in every good
thing which the LORD thy God hath given unto thee, and unto thine house, thou, and the Levite, and the stranger that
is among you.

translated_text:
Then thou shalt say before the LORD thy God, I have brought away the hallowed things out of
mine house, and also have given them unto the Levite, and unto the stranger, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all thy commandments which thou hast commanded me: I have not transgressed thy commandments, neither have I forgotten
them:
original_text:
Then thou shalt say before the LORD thy God, I have brought away the hallowed things out of
mine house, and also have given them unto the Levite, and unto the stranger, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all thy commandments which thou hast commanded me: I have not transgressed thy commandments, neither have I forgotten
them:

translated_text:
I have not eaten thereof in my mourning, neither have I taken away
ought thereof for
any unclean
use, nor given
ought thereof for the dead:
but I have hearkened to the voice of the LORD my God,
and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me.
original_text:
I have not eaten thereof in my mourning, neither have I taken away
ought thereof for
any unclean
use, nor given
ought thereof for the dead:
but I have hearkened to the voice of the LORD my God,
and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me.

translated_text: Look down from thy holy habitation, from heaven, and bless thy people Israel, and the land which thou hast given us, as thou swarest unto our fathers, a land that floweth with milk and honey.
original_text: Look down from thy holy habitation, from heaven, and bless thy people Israel, and the land which thou hast given us, as thou swarest unto our fathers, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

translated_text: This day the LORD thy God hath commanded thee to do these statutes and judgments: thou shalt therefore keep and do them with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
original_text: This day the LORD thy God hath commanded thee to do these statutes and judgments: thou shalt therefore keep and do them with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.

translated_text: Thou hast avouched the LORD this day to be thy God, and to walk in his ways, and to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and to hearken unto his voice:
original_text: Thou hast avouched the LORD this day to be thy God, and to walk in his ways, and to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and to hearken unto his voice:

translated_text:
And the LORD hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people, as he hath promised thee, and that
thou shouldest keep all his commandments;
original_text:
And the LORD hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people, as he hath promised thee, and that
thou shouldest keep all his commandments;

translated_text: And to make thee high above all nations which he hath made, in praise, and in name, and in honour; and that thou mayest be an holy people unto the LORD thy God, as he hath spoken.
original_text: And to make thee high above all nations which he hath made, in praise, and in name, and in honour; and that thou mayest be an holy people unto the LORD thy God, as he hath spoken.

translated_text: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
original_text: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

translated_text: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
original_text: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:

translated_text: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
original_text: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.

translated_text:
He is the Rock, his work
is perfect: for all his ways
are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right
is he.
original_text:
He is the Rock, his work
is perfect: for all his ways
are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right
is he.

translated_text:
They have corrupted themselves, their spot
is not
the spot of his children:
they are a perverse and crooked generation.
original_text:
They have corrupted themselves, their spot
is not
the spot of his children:
they are a perverse and crooked generation.

translated_text:
Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise?
is
 not he thy father
that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?
original_text:
Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise?
is
 not he thy father
that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?

translated_text: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.
original_text: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.

translated_text: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.
original_text: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.

translated_text:
For the LORD’S portion
is his people; Jacob
is the lot of his inheritance.
original_text:
For the LORD’S portion
is his people; Jacob
is the lot of his inheritance.

translated_text: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.
original_text: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.

translated_text: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
original_text: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:

translated_text:
So the LORD alone did lead him, and
there was no strange god with him.
original_text:
So the LORD alone did lead him, and
there was no strange god with him.

translated_text: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
original_text: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;

translated_text: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.
original_text: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.

translated_text:
But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered
with fatness; then he forsook God
which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
original_text:
But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered
with fatness; then he forsook God
which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

translated_text:
They provoked him to jealousy with strange
gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.
original_text:
They provoked him to jealousy with strange
gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.

translated_text:
They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new
gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
original_text:
They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new
gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.

translated_text:
Of the Rock
that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
original_text:
Of the Rock
that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.

translated_text:
And when the LORD saw
it, he abhorred
them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
original_text:
And when the LORD saw
it, he abhorred
them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.

translated_text:
And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end
shall be: for they
are a very froward generation, children in whom
is no faith.
original_text:
And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end
shall be: for they
are a very froward generation, children in whom
is no faith.

translated_text:
They have moved me to jealousy with
that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with
those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
original_text:
They have moved me to jealousy with
that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with
those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

translated_text: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
original_text: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.

translated_text: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.
original_text: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.

translated_text: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.
original_text: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.

translated_text:
The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling
also with the man of gray hairs.
original_text:
The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling
also with the man of gray hairs.

translated_text: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
original_text: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:

translated_text:
Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely,
and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the LORD hath not done all this.
original_text:
Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely,
and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the LORD hath not done all this.

translated_text:
For they
are a nation void of counsel, neither
is there any understanding in them.
original_text:
For they
are a nation void of counsel, neither
is there any understanding in them.

translated_text:
O that they were wise,
that they understood this,
that
 they would consider their latter end!
original_text:
O that they were wise,
that they understood this,
that
 they would consider their latter end!

translated_text: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?
original_text: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?

translated_text:
For their rock
is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves
being judges.
original_text:
For their rock
is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves
being judges.

translated_text:
For their vine
is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes
are grapes of gall, their clusters
are bitter:
original_text:
For their vine
is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes
are grapes of gall, their clusters
are bitter:

translated_text:
Their wine
is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.
original_text:
Their wine
is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.

translated_text:
Is not this laid up in store with me,
and sealed up among my treasures?
original_text:
Is not this laid up in store with me,
and sealed up among my treasures?

translated_text:
To me
belongeth vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in
due time: for the day of their calamity
is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.
original_text:
To me
belongeth vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in
due time: for the day of their calamity
is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.

translated_text:
For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that
their power is gone, and
there is
 none shut up, or left.
original_text:
For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that
their power is gone, and
there is
 none shut up, or left.

translated_text:
And he shall say, Where
are their gods,
their rock in whom they trusted,
original_text:
And he shall say, Where
are their gods,
their rock in whom they trusted,

translated_text:
Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices,
and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you,
and be your protection.
original_text:
Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices,
and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you,
and be your protection.

translated_text:
See now that I,
even I,
am he, and
there is
 no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither
is there any that can deliver out of my hand.
original_text:
See now that I,
even I,
am he, and
there is
 no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither
is there any that can deliver out of my hand.

translated_text: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.
original_text: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.

translated_text: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.
original_text: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.

translated_text:
I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh;
and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.
original_text:
I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh;
and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.

translated_text:
Rejoice, O ye nations,
with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land,
and to his people.
original_text:
Rejoice, O ye nations,
with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land,
and to his people.

translated_text: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
original_text: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.

translated_text: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:
original_text: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:

translated_text: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
original_text: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

translated_text:
For it
is not a vain thing for you; because it
is
 your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong
your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
original_text:
For it
is not a vain thing for you; because it
is
 your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong
your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,

translated_text:
Get thee up into this mountain Abarim,
unto mount Nebo, which
is in the land of Moab, that
is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:
original_text:
Get thee up into this mountain Abarim,
unto mount Nebo, which
is in the land of Moab, that
is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:

translated_text: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:
original_text: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:

translated_text: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.
original_text: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.

translated_text:
Yet thou shalt see the land before
thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.
original_text:
Yet thou shalt see the land before
thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.

translated_text: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.
original_text: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.

translated_text:
And he said unto them, I
am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the LORD hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
original_text:
And he said unto them, I
am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the LORD hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

translated_text:
The LORD thy God, he will go over before thee,
and he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them:
and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the LORD hath said.
original_text:
The LORD thy God, he will go over before thee,
and he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them:
and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the LORD hath said.

translated_text: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.
original_text: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.

translated_text: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.
original_text: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.

translated_text:
Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he
it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
original_text:
Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he
it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

translated_text: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the LORD hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.
original_text: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the LORD hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.

translated_text:
And the LORD, he
it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
original_text:
And the LORD, he
it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

translated_text: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and unto all the elders of Israel.
original_text: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and unto all the elders of Israel.

translated_text:
And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of
every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,
original_text:
And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of
every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,

translated_text: When all Israel is come to appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
original_text: When all Israel is come to appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

translated_text:
Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that
is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:
original_text:
Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that
is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:

translated_text:
And
that their children, which have not known
any thing,
 may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
original_text:
And
that their children, which have not known
any thing,
 may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.

translated_text: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.
original_text: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go
to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go
to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.

translated_text:
Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God
is not among us?
original_text:
Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God
is not among us?

translated_text: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.
original_text: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.

translated_text: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
original_text: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

translated_text: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.
original_text: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.
original_text: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.

translated_text: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.
original_text: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.

translated_text: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.
original_text: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
original_text: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

translated_text: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,
original_text: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,

translated_text: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.
original_text: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.

translated_text: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the LORD; and how much more after my death?
original_text: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the LORD; and how much more after my death?

translated_text: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.
original_text: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.

translated_text:
For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt
yourselves,
 and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
original_text:
For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt
yourselves,
 and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.

translated_text: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.
original_text: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call
them to mind among all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath driven thee,
original_text:
And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call
them to mind among all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath driven thee,

translated_text: And shalt return unto the LORD thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;
original_text: And shalt return unto the LORD thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;

translated_text: That then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.
original_text: That then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.

translated_text:
If
any of thine be driven out unto the outmost
parts
 of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:
original_text:
If
any of thine be driven out unto the outmost
parts
 of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:

translated_text: And the LORD thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.
original_text: And the LORD thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.

translated_text: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
original_text: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.

translated_text: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.
original_text: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.

translated_text: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
original_text: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.

translated_text: And the LORD thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the LORD will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:
original_text: And the LORD thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the LORD will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:

translated_text:
If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law,
and if thou turn unto the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
original_text:
If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law,
and if thou turn unto the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.

translated_text:
For this commandment which I command thee this day, it
is
 not hidden from thee, neither
is it far off.
original_text:
For this commandment which I command thee this day, it
is
 not hidden from thee, neither
is it far off.

translated_text:
It
is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
original_text:
It
is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

translated_text:
Neither
is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
original_text:
Neither
is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

translated_text:
But the word
is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
original_text:
But the word
is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.

translated_text: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;
original_text: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;

translated_text: In that I command thee this day to love the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
original_text: In that I command thee this day to love the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.

translated_text: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
original_text: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;

translated_text:
I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish,
and that ye shall not prolong
your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.
original_text:
I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish,
and that ye shall not prolong
your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.

translated_text:
I call heaven and earth to record this day against you,
that
 I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
original_text:
I call heaven and earth to record this day against you,
that
 I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:

translated_text:
That thou mayest love the LORD thy God,
and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he
is
 thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
original_text:
That thou mayest love the LORD thy God,
and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he
is
 thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

translated_text:
And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that
is over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,
original_text:
And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that
is over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,

translated_text: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,
original_text: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,

translated_text: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.
original_text: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto him, This
is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see
it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto him, This
is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see
it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.

translated_text: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.
original_text: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.

translated_text: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Beth-peor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.
original_text: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Beth-peor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.

translated_text:
And Moses
was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
original_text:
And Moses
was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.

translated_text:
And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping
and mourning for Moses were ended.
original_text:
And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping
and mourning for Moses were ended.

translated_text: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,
original_text: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,

translated_text: In all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
original_text: In all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

translated_text: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.
original_text: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.

translated_text:
And this
is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
original_text:
And this
is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

translated_text:
And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand
went a fiery law for them.
original_text:
And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand
went a fiery law for them.

translated_text:
Moses commanded us a law,
even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
original_text:
Moses commanded us a law,
even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.

translated_text:
And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people
and
 the tribes of Israel were gathered together.
original_text:
And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people
and
 the tribes of Israel were gathered together.

translated_text:
Let Reuben live, and not die; and let
not his men be few.
original_text:
Let Reuben live, and not die; and let
not his men be few.

translated_text:
And this
is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help
to him from his enemies.
original_text:
And this
is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help
to him from his enemies.

translated_text:
And of Levi he said,
Let thy Thummim and thy Urim
be
 with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah,
and with
 whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;
original_text:
And of Levi he said,
Let thy Thummim and thy Urim
be
 with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah,
and with
 whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;

translated_text: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.
original_text: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.

translated_text: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.
original_text: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.

translated_text: Bless, LORD, his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.
original_text: Bless, LORD, his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.

translated_text:
And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him;
and the LORD shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
original_text:
And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him;
and the LORD shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.

translated_text:
And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD
be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,
original_text:
And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD
be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,

translated_text:
And for the precious fruits
brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,
original_text:
And for the precious fruits
brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,

translated_text: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,
original_text: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,

translated_text:
And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and
for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let
the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him
that was separated from his brethren.
original_text:
And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and
for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let
the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him
that was separated from his brethren.

translated_text:
His glory
is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns
are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they
are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they
are the thousands of Manasseh.
original_text:
His glory
is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns
are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they
are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they
are the thousands of Manasseh.

translated_text: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.
original_text: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.

translated_text:
They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck
of the abundance of the seas, and
of treasures hid in the sand.
original_text:
They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck
of the abundance of the seas, and
of treasures hid in the sand.

translated_text:
And of Gad he said, Blessed
be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.
original_text:
And of Gad he said, Blessed
be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.

translated_text:
And he provided the first part for himself, because there,
in
 a portion of the lawgiver,
was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the LORD, and his judgments with Israel.
original_text:
And he provided the first part for himself, because there,
in
 a portion of the lawgiver,
was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the LORD, and his judgments with Israel.

translated_text:
And of Dan he said, Dan
is a lion’s whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.
original_text:
And of Dan he said, Dan
is a lion’s whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.

translated_text: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the LORD: possess thou the west and the south.
original_text: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the LORD: possess thou the west and the south.

translated_text:
And of Asher he said,
Let Asher
be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.
original_text:
And of Asher he said,
Let Asher
be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.

translated_text:
Thy shoes
shall be iron and brass; and as thy days,
so shall thy strength
be.
original_text:
Thy shoes
shall be iron and brass; and as thy days,
so shall thy strength
be.

translated_text:
There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun,
who
 rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.
original_text:
There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun,
who
 rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.

translated_text:
The eternal God
is thy refuge, and underneath
are
 the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy
them.
original_text:
The eternal God
is thy refuge, and underneath
are
 the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy
them.

translated_text:
Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob
shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.
original_text:
Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob
shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.

translated_text:
Happy
art thou, O Israel: who
is like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of thy help, and who
is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.
original_text:
Happy
art thou, O Israel: who
is like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of thy help, and who
is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.

translated_text: At that time the LORD said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.
original_text: At that time the LORD said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.

translated_text: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.
original_text: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.

translated_text:
And I made an ark
of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.
original_text:
And I made an ark
of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.

translated_text: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the LORD gave them unto me.
original_text: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the LORD gave them unto me.

translated_text: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the LORD commanded me.
original_text: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the LORD commanded me.

translated_text: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his stead.
original_text: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his stead.

translated_text: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.
original_text: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.

translated_text: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.
original_text: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.

translated_text:
Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD
is his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God promised him.
original_text:
Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD
is his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God promised him.

translated_text:
And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also,
and
 the LORD would not destroy thee.
original_text:
And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also,
and
 the LORD would not destroy thee.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto me, Arise, take
thy journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto me, Arise, take
thy journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.

translated_text: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,
original_text: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,

translated_text: To keep the commandments of the LORD, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?
original_text: To keep the commandments of the LORD, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?

translated_text:
Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens
is the LORD’S thy God, the earth
also, with all that therein
is.
original_text:
Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens
is the LORD’S thy God, the earth
also, with all that therein
is.

translated_text:
Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them,
even you above all people, as
it is
 this day.
original_text:
Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them,
even you above all people, as
it is
 this day.

translated_text: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.
original_text: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.

translated_text:
For the LORD your God
is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:
original_text:
For the LORD your God
is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:

translated_text: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
original_text: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.

translated_text: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
original_text: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

translated_text: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.
original_text: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.

translated_text:
He
is thy praise, and he
is thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.
original_text:
He
is thy praise, and he
is thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.

translated_text: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.
original_text: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.

translated_text: When the LORD thy God hath cut off the nations, whose land the LORD thy God giveth thee, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their cities, and in their houses;
original_text: When the LORD thy God hath cut off the nations, whose land the LORD thy God giveth thee, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their cities, and in their houses;

translated_text: Thou shalt separate three cities for thee in the midst of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.
original_text: Thou shalt separate three cities for thee in the midst of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.

translated_text: Thou shalt prepare thee a way, and divide the coasts of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to inherit, into three parts, that every slayer may flee thither.
original_text: Thou shalt prepare thee a way, and divide the coasts of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to inherit, into three parts, that every slayer may flee thither.

translated_text:
And this
is the case of the slayer, which shall flee thither, that he may live: Whoso killeth his neighbour ignorantly, whom he hated not in time past;
original_text:
And this
is the case of the slayer, which shall flee thither, that he may live: Whoso killeth his neighbour ignorantly, whom he hated not in time past;

translated_text: As when a man goeth into the wood with his neighbour to hew wood, and his hand fetcheth a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree, and the head slippeth from the helve, and lighteth upon his neighbour, that he die; he shall flee unto one of those cities, and live:
original_text: As when a man goeth into the wood with his neighbour to hew wood, and his hand fetcheth a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree, and the head slippeth from the helve, and lighteth upon his neighbour, that he die; he shall flee unto one of those cities, and live:

translated_text:
Lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer, while his heart is hot, and overtake him, because the way is long, and slay him; whereas he
was not worthy of death, inasmuch as he hated him not in time past.
original_text:
Lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer, while his heart is hot, and overtake him, because the way is long, and slay him; whereas he
was not worthy of death, inasmuch as he hated him not in time past.

translated_text: Wherefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt separate three cities for thee.
original_text: Wherefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt separate three cities for thee.

translated_text: And if the LORD thy God enlarge thy coast, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, and give thee all the land which he promised to give unto thy fathers;
original_text: And if the LORD thy God enlarge thy coast, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, and give thee all the land which he promised to give unto thy fathers;

translated_text: If thou shalt keep all these commandments to do them, which I command thee this day, to love the LORD thy God, and to walk ever in his ways; then shalt thou add three cities more for thee, beside these three:
original_text: If thou shalt keep all these commandments to do them, which I command thee this day, to love the LORD thy God, and to walk ever in his ways; then shalt thou add three cities more for thee, beside these three:

translated_text:
That innocent blood be not shed in thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee
for an inheritance, and
so blood be upon thee.
original_text:
That innocent blood be not shed in thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee
for an inheritance, and
so blood be upon thee.

translated_text: But if any man hate his neighbour, and lie in wait for him, and rise up against him, and smite him mortally that he die, and fleeth into one of these cities:
original_text: But if any man hate his neighbour, and lie in wait for him, and rise up against him, and smite him mortally that he die, and fleeth into one of these cities:

translated_text: Then the elders of his city shall send and fetch him thence, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.
original_text: Then the elders of his city shall send and fetch him thence, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.

translated_text:
Thine eye shall not pity him, but thou shalt put away
the guilt of
 innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well with thee.
original_text:
Thine eye shall not pity him, but thou shalt put away
the guilt of
 innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well with thee.

translated_text: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour’s landmark, which they of old time have set in thine inheritance, which thou shalt inherit in the land that the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.
original_text: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour’s landmark, which they of old time have set in thine inheritance, which thou shalt inherit in the land that the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.

translated_text: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sinneth: at the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be established.
original_text: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sinneth: at the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be established.

translated_text:
If a false witness rise up against any man to testify against him
that which is wrong;
original_text:
If a false witness rise up against any man to testify against him
that which is wrong;

translated_text:
Then both the men, between whom the controversy
is, shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges, which shall be in those days;
original_text:
Then both the men, between whom the controversy
is, shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges, which shall be in those days;

translated_text:
And the judges shall make diligent inquisition: and, behold,
if
 the witness
be a false witness,
and hath testified falsely against his brother;
original_text:
And the judges shall make diligent inquisition: and, behold,
if
 the witness
be a false witness,
and hath testified falsely against his brother;

translated_text: Then shall ye do unto him, as he had thought to have done unto his brother: so shalt thou put the evil away from among you.
original_text: Then shall ye do unto him, as he had thought to have done unto his brother: so shalt thou put the evil away from among you.

translated_text: And those which remain shall hear, and fear, and shall henceforth commit no more any such evil among you.
original_text: And those which remain shall hear, and fear, and shall henceforth commit no more any such evil among you.

translated_text:
And thine eye shall not pity;
but life
shall go
 for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
original_text:
And thine eye shall not pity;
but life
shall go
 for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

translated_text:
Ye
are the children of the LORD your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.
original_text:
Ye
are the children of the LORD your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

translated_text:
for thou
art an holy people unto the LORD thy God, and the LORD hath chosen thee to be a peculiar people unto himself, above all the nations that
are upon the earth.
original_text:
for thou
art an holy people unto the LORD thy God, and the LORD hath chosen thee to be a peculiar people unto himself, above all the nations that
are upon the earth.

translated_text: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.
original_text: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.

translated_text:
These
are the beasts which ye shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,
original_text:
These
are the beasts which ye shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,

translated_text: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.
original_text: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.

translated_text:
And every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaveth the cleft into two claws,
and cheweth the cud among the beasts, that ye shall eat.
original_text:
And every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaveth the cleft into two claws,
and cheweth the cud among the beasts, that ye shall eat.
