translated_text: And the swine, because it divideth the hoof, yet cheweth not the cud, it is unclean unto you: ye shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.
original_text: And the swine, because it divideth the hoof, yet cheweth not the cud, it is unclean unto you: ye shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.

translated_text:
These ye shall eat of all that
are in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall ye eat:
original_text:
These ye shall eat of all that
are in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall ye eat:

translated_text:
And whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye may not eat; it
is
 unclean unto you.
original_text:
And whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye may not eat; it
is
 unclean unto you.

translated_text: Of all clean birds ye shall eat.
original_text: Of all clean birds ye shall eat.

translated_text:
But these
are they of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and ossifrage, and the ospray,
original_text:
But these
are they of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and ossifrage, and the ospray,

translated_text: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,
original_text: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,

translated_text: And every raven after his kind,
original_text: And every raven after his kind,

translated_text: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
original_text: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

translated_text: The little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,
original_text: The little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,

translated_text: And the pelican, and the gier eagle, and the cormorant,
original_text: And the pelican, and the gier eagle, and the cormorant,

translated_text: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
original_text: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

translated_text:
And every creeping thing that flieth
is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.
original_text:
And every creeping thing that flieth
is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.

translated_text: But of all clean fowls ye may eat.
original_text: But of all clean fowls ye may eat.

translated_text:
Ye shall not eat
of any thing that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that
is in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou
art an holy people unto the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
original_text:
Ye shall not eat
of any thing that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that
is in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou
art an holy people unto the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

translated_text: Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.
original_text: Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.

translated_text: And thou shalt eat before the LORD thy God, in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear the LORD thy God always.
original_text: And thou shalt eat before the LORD thy God, in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear the LORD thy God always.

translated_text:
And if the way be too long for thee, so that thou art not able to carry it;
or if the place be too far from thee, which the LORD thy God shall choose to set his name there, when the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:
original_text:
And if the way be too long for thee, so that thou art not able to carry it;
or if the place be too far from thee, which the LORD thy God shall choose to set his name there, when the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:

translated_text:
Then shalt thou turn
it into money, and bind up the money in thine hand, and shalt go unto the place which the LORD thy God shall choose:
original_text:
Then shalt thou turn
it into money, and bind up the money in thine hand, and shalt go unto the place which the LORD thy God shall choose:

translated_text: And thou shalt bestow that money for whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever thy soul desireth: and thou shalt eat there before the LORD thy God, and thou shalt rejoice, thou, and thine household,
original_text: And thou shalt bestow that money for whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever thy soul desireth: and thou shalt eat there before the LORD thy God, and thou shalt rejoice, thou, and thine household,

translated_text:
And the Levite that
is within thy gates; thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no part nor inheritance with thee.
original_text:
And the Levite that
is within thy gates; thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no part nor inheritance with thee.

translated_text:
At the end of three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thine increase the same year, and shalt lay
it up within thy gates:
original_text:
At the end of three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thine increase the same year, and shalt lay
it up within thy gates:

translated_text:
And the Levite, (because he hath no part nor inheritance with thee,) and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, which
are within thy gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hand which thou doest.
original_text:
And the Levite, (because he hath no part nor inheritance with thee,) and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, which
are within thy gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hand which thou doest.

translated_text: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder,
original_text: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder,

translated_text: And the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them;
original_text: And the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them;

translated_text: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for the LORD your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
original_text: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for the LORD your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

translated_text: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.
original_text: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.

translated_text:
And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken to turn
you away from the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the LORD thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee.
original_text:
And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken to turn
you away from the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the LORD thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee.

translated_text:
If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which
is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;
original_text:
If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which
is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;

translated_text:
Namely, of the gods of the people which
are round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the
one end of the earth even unto the
other end of the earth;
original_text:
Namely, of the gods of the people which
are round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the
one end of the earth even unto the
other end of the earth;

translated_text: Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him:
original_text: Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him:

translated_text: But thou shalt surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.
original_text: But thou shalt surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.

translated_text: And thou shalt stone him with stones, that he die; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
original_text: And thou shalt stone him with stones, that he die; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

translated_text: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.
original_text: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.

translated_text:
If thou shalt hear
say in one of thy cities, which the LORD thy God hath given thee to dwell there, saying,
original_text:
If thou shalt hear
say in one of thy cities, which the LORD thy God hath given thee to dwell there, saying,

translated_text: Certain men, the children of Belial, are gone out from among you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known;
original_text: Certain men, the children of Belial, are gone out from among you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known;

translated_text:
Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that
is therein, and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.
original_text:
Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that
is therein, and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.

translated_text: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof, and shalt burn with fire the city, and all the spoil thereof every whit, for the LORD thy God: and it shall be an heap for ever; it shall not be built again.
original_text: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof, and shalt burn with fire the city, and all the spoil thereof every whit, for the LORD thy God: and it shall be an heap for ever; it shall not be built again.

translated_text: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand: that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and shew thee mercy, and have compassion upon thee, and multiply thee, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers;
original_text: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand: that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and shew thee mercy, and have compassion upon thee, and multiply thee, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers;

translated_text:
When thou shalt hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, to do
that which is
 right in the eyes of the LORD thy God.
original_text:
When thou shalt hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, to do
that which is
 right in the eyes of the LORD thy God.

translated_text:
These
are the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the LORD God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.
original_text:
These
are the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the LORD God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.

translated_text: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:
original_text: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:

translated_text: And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.
original_text: And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.

translated_text: Ye shall not do so unto the LORD your God.
original_text: Ye shall not do so unto the LORD your God.

translated_text:
But unto the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there,
even unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come:
original_text:
But unto the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there,
even unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come:

translated_text: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:
original_text: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:

translated_text: And there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.
original_text: And there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.

translated_text:
Ye shall not do after all
the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever
is right in his own eyes.
original_text:
Ye shall not do after all
the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever
is right in his own eyes.

translated_text: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the LORD your God giveth you.
original_text: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the LORD your God giveth you.

translated_text: Then there shall be a place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the LORD:
original_text: Then there shall be a place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the LORD:

translated_text:
And ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that
is within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.
original_text:
And ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that
is within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.

translated_text: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest:
original_text: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest:

translated_text: But in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.
original_text: But in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.

translated_text: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.
original_text: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.

translated_text: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.
original_text: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.

translated_text: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:
original_text: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

translated_text:
But thou must eat them before the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that
is within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto.
original_text:
But thou must eat them before the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that
is within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto.

translated_text: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.
original_text: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.

translated_text: When the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
original_text: When the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.

translated_text: If the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the LORD hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
original_text: If the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the LORD hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.

translated_text:
Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat
of them alike.
original_text:
Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat
of them alike.

translated_text:
Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood
is
 the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.
original_text:
Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood
is
 the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.

translated_text: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.
original_text: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do
that which is right in the sight of the LORD.
original_text:
Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do
that which is right in the sight of the LORD.

translated_text: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which the LORD shall choose:
original_text: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which the LORD shall choose:

translated_text: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.
original_text: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.

translated_text:
Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest
that which is good and right in the sight of the LORD thy God.
original_text:
Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest
that which is good and right in the sight of the LORD thy God.

translated_text: When the LORD thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest to possess them, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their land;
original_text: When the LORD thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest to possess them, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their land;

translated_text: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before thee; and that thou enquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.
original_text: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before thee; and that thou enquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.

translated_text: Thou shalt not do so unto the LORD thy God: for every abomination to the LORD, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.
original_text: Thou shalt not do so unto the LORD thy God: for every abomination to the LORD, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.

translated_text: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.
original_text: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.

translated_text: Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.
original_text: Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.

translated_text:
And know ye this day: for
I speak not with your children which have not known, and which have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his stretched out arm,
original_text:
And know ye this day: for
I speak not with your children which have not known, and which have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his stretched out arm,

translated_text: And his miracles, and his acts, which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;
original_text: And his miracles, and his acts, which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;

translated_text:
And what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and
how the LORD hath destroyed them unto this day;
original_text:
And what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and
how the LORD hath destroyed them unto this day;

translated_text: And what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came into this place;
original_text: And what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came into this place;

translated_text:
And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that
was in their possession, in the midst of all Israel:
original_text:
And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that
was in their possession, in the midst of all Israel:

translated_text: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the LORD which he did.
original_text: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the LORD which he did.

translated_text: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither ye go to possess it;
original_text: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither ye go to possess it;

translated_text:
And that ye may prolong
your days in the land, which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land that floweth with milk and honey.
original_text:
And that ye may prolong
your days in the land, which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

translated_text:
For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it,
is not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst
it with thy foot, as a garden of herbs:
original_text:
For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it,
is not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst
it with thy foot, as a garden of herbs:

translated_text:
But the land, whither ye go to possess it,
is a land of hills
and valleys, and drinketh water of the rain of heaven:
original_text:
But the land, whither ye go to possess it,
is a land of hills
and valleys, and drinketh water of the rain of heaven:

translated_text:
A land which the LORD thy God careth for: the eyes of the LORD thy God
are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.
original_text:
A land which the LORD thy God careth for: the eyes of the LORD thy God
are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,
original_text: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

translated_text:
That I will give
you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.
original_text:
That I will give
you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.

translated_text: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle, that thou mayest eat and be full.
original_text: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle, that thou mayest eat and be full.

translated_text: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;
original_text: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;

translated_text:
And
then the LORD’S wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and
lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD giveth you.
original_text:
And
then the LORD’S wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and
lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD giveth you.

translated_text: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.
original_text: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.

translated_text: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
original_text: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

translated_text: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house, and upon thy gates:
original_text: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house, and upon thy gates:

translated_text: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.
original_text: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.

translated_text: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him;
original_text: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him;

translated_text: Then will the LORD drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.
original_text: Then will the LORD drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.

translated_text: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.
original_text: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.

translated_text:
There shall no man be able to stand before you:
for the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.
original_text:
There shall no man be able to stand before you:
for the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.

translated_text: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;
original_text: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;

translated_text: A blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day:
original_text: A blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day:

translated_text: And a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.
original_text: And a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.
original_text: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.

translated_text: Are they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goeth down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?
original_text: Are they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goeth down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?

translated_text: For ye shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.
original_text: For ye shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.

translated_text: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day.
original_text: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day.

translated_text:
The priests the Levites,
and all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel: they shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and his inheritance.
original_text:
The priests the Levites,
and all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel: they shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and his inheritance.

translated_text:
Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren: the LORD
is their inheritance, as he hath said unto them.
original_text:
Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren: the LORD
is their inheritance, as he hath said unto them.

translated_text:
And this shall be the priest’s due from the people, from them that offer a sacrifice, whether
it be ox or sheep; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder, and the two cheeks, and the maw.
original_text:
And this shall be the priest’s due from the people, from them that offer a sacrifice, whether
it be ox or sheep; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder, and the two cheeks, and the maw.

translated_text:
The firstfruit
also of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.
original_text:
The firstfruit
also of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.

translated_text: For the LORD thy God hath chosen him out of all thy tribes, to stand to minister in the name of the LORD, him and his sons for ever.
original_text: For the LORD thy God hath chosen him out of all thy tribes, to stand to minister in the name of the LORD, him and his sons for ever.

translated_text: And if a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel, where he sojourned, and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the LORD shall choose;
original_text: And if a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel, where he sojourned, and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the LORD shall choose;

translated_text:
Then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brethren the Levites
do, which stand there before the LORD.
original_text:
Then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brethren the Levites
do, which stand there before the LORD.

translated_text: They shall have like portions to eat, beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony.
original_text: They shall have like portions to eat, beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony.

translated_text: When thou art come into the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.
original_text: When thou art come into the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.

translated_text:
There shall not be found among you
any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination,
or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch,
original_text:
There shall not be found among you
any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination,
or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch,

translated_text: Or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer.
original_text: Or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer.

translated_text:
For all that do these things
are an abomination unto the LORD: and because of these abominations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee.
original_text:
For all that do these things
are an abomination unto the LORD: and because of these abominations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee.

translated_text: Thou shalt be perfect with the LORD thy God.
original_text: Thou shalt be perfect with the LORD thy God.

translated_text:
For these nations, which thou shalt possess, hearkened unto observers of times, and unto diviners: but as for thee, the LORD thy God hath not suffered thee so
to do.
original_text:
For these nations, which thou shalt possess, hearkened unto observers of times, and unto diviners: but as for thee, the LORD thy God hath not suffered thee so
to do.

translated_text: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
original_text: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;

translated_text: According to all that thou desiredst of the LORD thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I die not.
original_text: According to all that thou desiredst of the LORD thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I die not.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto me, They have well
spoken that which they have spoken.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto me, They have well
spoken that which they have spoken.

translated_text: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren, like unto thee, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him.
original_text: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren, like unto thee, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require
it
 of him.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require
it
 of him.

translated_text: But the prophet, which shall presume to speak a word in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or that shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die.
original_text: But the prophet, which shall presume to speak a word in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or that shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die.

translated_text: And if thou say in thine heart, How shall we know the word which the LORD hath not spoken?
original_text: And if thou say in thine heart, How shall we know the word which the LORD hath not spoken?

translated_text:
When a prophet speaketh in the name of the LORD, if the thing follow not, nor come to pass, that
is the thing which the LORD hath not spoken,
but the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously: thou shalt not be afraid of him.
original_text:
When a prophet speaketh in the name of the LORD, if the thing follow not, nor come to pass, that
is the thing which the LORD hath not spoken,
but the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously: thou shalt not be afraid of him.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not sacrifice unto the LORD thy God
any bullock, or sheep, wherein is blemish,
or any evilfavouredness: for that
is an abomination unto the LORD thy God.
original_text:
Thou shalt not sacrifice unto the LORD thy God
any bullock, or sheep, wherein is blemish,
or any evilfavouredness: for that
is an abomination unto the LORD thy God.

translated_text: If there be found among you, within any of thy gates which the LORD thy God giveth thee, man or woman, that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the LORD thy God, in transgressing his covenant,
original_text: If there be found among you, within any of thy gates which the LORD thy God giveth thee, man or woman, that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the LORD thy God, in transgressing his covenant,

translated_text: And hath gone and served other gods, and worshipped them, either the sun, or moon, or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded;
original_text: And hath gone and served other gods, and worshipped them, either the sun, or moon, or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded;

translated_text:
And it be told thee, and thou hast heard
of it, and enquired diligently, and, behold,
it be true,
and the thing certain,
that such abomination is wrought in Israel:
original_text:
And it be told thee, and thou hast heard
of it, and enquired diligently, and, behold,
it be true,
and the thing certain,
that such abomination is wrought in Israel:

translated_text:
Then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman, which have committed that wicked thing, unto thy gates,
even that man or that woman, and shalt stone them with stones, till they die.
original_text:
Then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman, which have committed that wicked thing, unto thy gates,
even that man or that woman, and shalt stone them with stones, till they die.

translated_text:
At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death;
but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.
original_text:
At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death;
but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

translated_text: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So thou shalt put the evil away from among you.
original_text: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So thou shalt put the evil away from among you.

translated_text: And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites, and unto the judge that shall be in those days, and enquire; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment:
original_text: And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites, and unto the judge that shall be in those days, and enquire; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment:

translated_text: And thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD shall choose shall shew thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee:
original_text: And thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD shall choose shall shew thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee:

translated_text:
According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee, and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee, thou shalt do: thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee,
to
 the right hand, nor
to the left.
original_text:
According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee, and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee, thou shalt do: thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee,
to
 the right hand, nor
to the left.

translated_text: And the man that will do presumptuously, and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the LORD thy God, or unto the judge, even that man shall die: and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel.
original_text: And the man that will do presumptuously, and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the LORD thy God, or unto the judge, even that man shall die: and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel.

translated_text: And all the people shall hear, and fear, and do no more presumptuously.
original_text: And all the people shall hear, and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

translated_text:
When thou art come unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, and shalt possess it, and shalt dwell therein, and shalt say, I will set a king over me, like as all the nations that
are about me;
original_text:
When thou art come unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, and shalt possess it, and shalt dwell therein, and shalt say, I will set a king over me, like as all the nations that
are about me;

translated_text:
Thou shalt in any wise set
him king over thee, whom the LORD thy God shall choose:
one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee: thou mayest not set a stranger over thee, which
is
 not thy brother.
original_text:
Thou shalt in any wise set
him king over thee, whom the LORD thy God shall choose:
one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee: thou mayest not set a stranger over thee, which
is
 not thy brother.

translated_text: But he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he should multiply horses: forasmuch as the LORD hath said unto you, Ye shall henceforth return no more that way.
original_text: But he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he should multiply horses: forasmuch as the LORD hath said unto you, Ye shall henceforth return no more that way.

translated_text: Neither shall he multiply wives to himself, that his heart turn not away: neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.
original_text: Neither shall he multiply wives to himself, that his heart turn not away: neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

translated_text:
And it shall be, when he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of
that which is
 before the priests the Levites:
original_text:
And it shall be, when he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of
that which is
 before the priests the Levites:

translated_text: And it shall be with him, and he shall read therein all the days of his life: that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them:
original_text: And it shall be with him, and he shall read therein all the days of his life: that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them:

translated_text:
That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren, and that he turn not aside from the commandment,
to the right hand, or
to
 the left: to the end that he may prolong
his days in his kingdom, he, and his children, in the midst of Israel.
original_text:
That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren, and that he turn not aside from the commandment,
to the right hand, or
to
 the left: to the end that he may prolong
his days in his kingdom, he, and his children, in the midst of Israel.

translated_text: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the passover unto the LORD thy God: for in the month of Abib the LORD thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night.
original_text: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the passover unto the LORD thy God: for in the month of Abib the LORD thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night.

translated_text: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the LORD thy God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to place his name there.
original_text: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the LORD thy God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to place his name there.

translated_text:
Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith,
even the bread of affliction; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste: that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life.
original_text:
Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith,
even the bread of affliction; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste: that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life.

translated_text:
And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days; neither shall there
any thing of the flesh, which thou sacrificedst the first day at even, remain all night until the morning.
original_text:
And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days; neither shall there
any thing of the flesh, which thou sacrificedst the first day at even, remain all night until the morning.

translated_text: Thou mayest not sacrifice the passover within any of thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee:
original_text: Thou mayest not sacrifice the passover within any of thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee:

translated_text: But at the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to place his name in, there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even, at the going down of the sun, at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt.
original_text: But at the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to place his name in, there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even, at the going down of the sun, at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt.

translated_text:
And thou shalt roast and eat
it in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose: and thou shalt turn in the morning, and go unto thy tents.
original_text:
And thou shalt roast and eat
it in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose: and thou shalt turn in the morning, and go unto thy tents.

translated_text:
Six days thou shalt eat unleavened bread: and on the seventh day
shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work
therein.
original_text:
Six days thou shalt eat unleavened bread: and on the seventh day
shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work
therein.

translated_text:
Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee: begin to number the seven weeks from
such time as thou beginnest
to put the sickle to the corn.
original_text:
Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee: begin to number the seven weeks from
such time as thou beginnest
to put the sickle to the corn.

translated_text:
And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto the LORD thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hand, which thou shalt give
unto the LORD thy God, according as the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:
original_text:
And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto the LORD thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hand, which thou shalt give
unto the LORD thy God, according as the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:

translated_text:
And thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that
is within thy gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that
are among you, in the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to place his name there.
original_text:
And thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that
is within thy gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that
are among you, in the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to place his name there.

translated_text: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.
original_text: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.

translated_text: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in thy corn and thy wine:
original_text: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in thy corn and thy wine:

translated_text:
And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that
are within thy gates.
original_text:
And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that
are within thy gates.

translated_text: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD shall choose: because the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the works of thine hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.
original_text: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD shall choose: because the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the works of thine hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.

translated_text: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose; in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles: and they shall not appear before the LORD empty:
original_text: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose; in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles: and they shall not appear before the LORD empty:

translated_text:
Every man
shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.
original_text:
Every man
shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.

translated_text: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, throughout thy tribes: and they shall judge the people with just judgment.
original_text: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, throughout thy tribes: and they shall judge the people with just judgment.

translated_text: Thou shalt not wrest judgment; thou shalt not respect persons, neither take a gift: for a gift doth blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.
original_text: Thou shalt not wrest judgment; thou shalt not respect persons, neither take a gift: for a gift doth blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.

translated_text: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
original_text: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

translated_text: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the LORD thy God, which thou shalt make thee.
original_text: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the LORD thy God, which thou shalt make thee.

translated_text:
Neither shalt thou set thee up
any image; which the LORD thy God hateth.
original_text:
Neither shalt thou set thee up
any image; which the LORD thy God hateth.

translated_text:
At the end of
every seven years thou shalt make a release.
original_text:
At the end of
every seven years thou shalt make a release.

translated_text:
And this
is the manner of the release: Every creditor that lendeth
ought unto his neighbour shall release
it; he shall not exact
it of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called the LORD’S release.
original_text:
And this
is the manner of the release: Every creditor that lendeth
ought unto his neighbour shall release
it; he shall not exact
it of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called the LORD’S release.

translated_text:
Of a foreigner thou mayest exact
it again: but
that
 which is thine with thy brother thine hand shall release;
original_text:
Of a foreigner thou mayest exact
it again: but
that
 which is thine with thy brother thine hand shall release;

translated_text:
Save when there shall be no poor among you; for the LORD shall greatly bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee
for an inheritance to possess it:
original_text:
Save when there shall be no poor among you; for the LORD shall greatly bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee
for an inheritance to possess it:

translated_text: Only if thou carefully hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all these commandments which I command thee this day.
original_text: Only if thou carefully hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all these commandments which I command thee this day.

translated_text: For the LORD thy God blesseth thee, as he promised thee: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over thee.
original_text: For the LORD thy God blesseth thee, as he promised thee: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over thee.

translated_text: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not harden thine heart, nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother:
original_text: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not harden thine heart, nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother:

translated_text:
But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need,
in that which he wanteth.
original_text:
But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need,
in that which he wanteth.

translated_text: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother, and thou givest him nought; and he cry unto the LORD against thee, and it be sin unto thee.
original_text: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother, and thou givest him nought; and he cry unto the LORD against thee, and it be sin unto thee.

translated_text: Thou shalt surely give him, and thine heart shall not be grieved when thou givest unto him: because that for this thing the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thy works, and in all that thou puttest thine hand unto.
original_text: Thou shalt surely give him, and thine heart shall not be grieved when thou givest unto him: because that for this thing the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thy works, and in all that thou puttest thine hand unto.

translated_text: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.
original_text: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.

translated_text: And if thy brother, an Hebrew man, or an Hebrew woman, be sold unto thee, and serve thee six years; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee.
original_text: And if thy brother, an Hebrew man, or an Hebrew woman, be sold unto thee, and serve thee six years; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee.

translated_text: And when thou sendest him out free from thee, thou shalt not let him go away empty:
original_text: And when thou sendest him out free from thee, thou shalt not let him go away empty:

translated_text:
Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy floor, and out of thy winepress:
of that wherewith the LORD thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him.
original_text:
Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy floor, and out of thy winepress:
of that wherewith the LORD thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him.

translated_text: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt, and the LORD thy God redeemed thee: therefore I command thee this thing to day.
original_text: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt, and the LORD thy God redeemed thee: therefore I command thee this thing to day.

translated_text: And it shall be, if he say unto thee, I will not go away from thee; because he loveth thee and thine house, because he is well with thee;
original_text: And it shall be, if he say unto thee, I will not go away from thee; because he loveth thee and thine house, because he is well with thee;

translated_text:
Then thou shalt take an aul, and thrust
it through his ear unto the door, and he shall be thy servant for ever. And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise.
original_text:
Then thou shalt take an aul, and thrust
it through his ear unto the door, and he shall be thy servant for ever. And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise.

translated_text:
It shall not seem hard unto thee, when thou sendest him away free from thee; for he hath been worth a double hired servant
to thee, in serving thee six years: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all that thou doest.
original_text:
It shall not seem hard unto thee, when thou sendest him away free from thee; for he hath been worth a double hired servant
to thee, in serving thee six years: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all that thou doest.

translated_text: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock, nor shear the firstling of thy sheep.
original_text: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock, nor shear the firstling of thy sheep.

translated_text:
Thou shalt eat
it before the LORD thy God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, thou and thy household.
original_text:
Thou shalt eat
it before the LORD thy God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, thou and thy household.

translated_text:
And if there be
any blemish therein,
as if it be
 lame, or blind,
or have any ill blemish, thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the LORD thy God.
original_text:
And if there be
any blemish therein,
as if it be
 lame, or blind,
or have any ill blemish, thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the LORD thy God.

translated_text:
Thou shalt eat it within thy gates: the unclean and the clean
person shall eat it alike, as the roebuck, and as the hart.
original_text:
Thou shalt eat it within thy gates: the unclean and the clean
person shall eat it alike, as the roebuck, and as the hart.

translated_text: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof; thou shalt pour it upon the ground as water.
original_text: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof; thou shalt pour it upon the ground as water.

translated_text:
Hear, O Israel: Thou
art to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,
original_text:
Hear, O Israel: Thou
art to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,

translated_text:
A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and
of whom thou hast heard
say, Who can stand before the children of Anak!
original_text:
A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and
of whom thou hast heard
say, Who can stand before the children of Anak!

translated_text: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the LORD thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the LORD hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD doth drive them out from before thee.
original_text: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the LORD thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the LORD hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD doth drive them out from before thee.

translated_text: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
original_text: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

translated_text:
Understand therefore, that the LORD thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou
art a stiffnecked people.
original_text:
Understand therefore, that the LORD thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou
art a stiffnecked people.

translated_text:
Remember,
and forget not, how thou provokedst the LORD thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the LORD.
original_text:
Remember,
and forget not, how thou provokedst the LORD thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the LORD.

translated_text: Also in Horeb ye provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.
original_text: Also in Horeb ye provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.

translated_text:
When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone,
even the tables of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:
original_text:
When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone,
even the tables of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:

translated_text:
And the LORD delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them
was written according to all the words, which the LORD spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.
original_text:
And the LORD delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them
was written according to all the words, which the LORD spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.

translated_text:
And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights,
that the LORD gave me the two tables of stone,
even the tables of the covenant.
original_text:
And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights,
that the LORD gave me the two tables of stone,
even the tables of the covenant.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted
themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted
themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.

translated_text:
Furthermore the LORD spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it
is a stiffnecked people:
original_text:
Furthermore the LORD spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it
is a stiffnecked people:

translated_text: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.
original_text: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.

translated_text:
So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant
were in my two hands.
original_text:
So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant
were in my two hands.

translated_text:
And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the LORD your God,
and had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.
original_text:
And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the LORD your God,
and had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.

translated_text: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.
original_text: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.

translated_text: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
original_text: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.

translated_text: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you. But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.
original_text: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you. But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.

translated_text: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.
original_text: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.

translated_text:
And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it,
and ground
it very small,
even
 until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.
original_text:
And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it,
and ground
it very small,
even
 until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.

translated_text: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah, ye provoked the LORD to wrath.
original_text: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah, ye provoked the LORD to wrath.

translated_text: Likewise when the LORD sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.
original_text: Likewise when the LORD sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.

translated_text: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.
original_text: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.

translated_text:
Thus I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights, as I fell down
at the first; because the LORD had said he would destroy you.
original_text:
Thus I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights, as I fell down
at the first; because the LORD had said he would destroy you.

translated_text: I prayed therefore unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
original_text: I prayed therefore unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

translated_text: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:
original_text: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:

translated_text: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.
original_text: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.

translated_text:
Yet they
are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm.
original_text:
Yet they
are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm.

translated_text: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.
original_text: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.

translated_text:
And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee,
and to prove thee, to know what
was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.
original_text:
And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee,
and to prove thee, to know what
was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.

translated_text:
And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every
word
 that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
original_text:
And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every
word
 that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.

translated_text: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
original_text: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.

translated_text:
Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son,
so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.
original_text:
Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son,
so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.

translated_text: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
original_text: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

translated_text: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;
original_text: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;

translated_text: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;
original_text: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;

translated_text:
A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any
thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.
original_text:
A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any
thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.

translated_text: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
original_text: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.

translated_text: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:
