original_text: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:

translated_text:
And
when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;
original_text:
And
when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;

translated_text: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;
original_text: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;

translated_text:
Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness,
wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where
there was
 no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;
original_text:
Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness,
wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where
there was
 no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;

translated_text: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;
original_text: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;

translated_text:
And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of
mine
 hand hath gotten me this wealth.
original_text:
And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of
mine
 hand hath gotten me this wealth.

translated_text:
But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for
it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as
it is this day.
original_text:
But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for
it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as
it is this day.

translated_text: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.
original_text: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.

translated_text: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God.
original_text: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God.

translated_text: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;
original_text: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;

translated_text:
And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them,
and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:
original_text:
And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them,
and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:

translated_text: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
original_text: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.

translated_text: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.
original_text: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.

translated_text: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.
original_text: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.

translated_text:
For thou
art an holy people unto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that
are upon the face of the earth.
original_text:
For thou
art an holy people unto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that
are upon the face of the earth.

translated_text:
The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye
were the fewest of all people:
original_text:
The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye
were the fewest of all people:

translated_text: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
original_text: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

translated_text:
Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he
is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
original_text:
Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he
is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;

translated_text: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.
original_text: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.

translated_text: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.
original_text: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.

translated_text: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:
original_text: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:

translated_text: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
original_text: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

translated_text: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
original_text: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.

translated_text:
And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all
them that hate thee.
original_text:
And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all
them that hate thee.

translated_text:
And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that
will be a snare unto thee.
original_text:
And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that
will be a snare unto thee.

translated_text:
If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations
are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
original_text:
If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations
are more than I; how can I dispossess them?

translated_text:
Thou shalt not be afraid of them:
but shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;
original_text:
Thou shalt not be afraid of them:
but shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;

translated_text: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.
original_text: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.

translated_text: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.
original_text: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God
is
 among you, a mighty God and terrible.
original_text:
Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God
is
 among you, a mighty God and terrible.

translated_text: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.
original_text: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.

translated_text: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.
original_text: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.

translated_text: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.
original_text: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.

translated_text:
The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold
that is on them, nor take
it
 unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it
is an abomination to the LORD thy God.
original_text:
The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold
that is on them, nor take
it
 unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it
is an abomination to the LORD thy God.

translated_text:
Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it:
but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it
is a cursed thing.
original_text:
Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it:
but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it
is a cursed thing.

translated_text:
Now these
are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do
them in the land whither ye go to possess it:
original_text:
Now these
are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do
them in the land whither ye go to possess it:

translated_text: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.
original_text: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.

translated_text:
Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do
it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.
original_text:
Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do
it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.

translated_text:
Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God
is one LORD:
original_text:
Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God
is one LORD:

translated_text: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
original_text: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

translated_text: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:
original_text: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:

translated_text: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
original_text: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

translated_text: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.
original_text: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.

translated_text: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.
original_text: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.

translated_text: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,
original_text: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,

translated_text:
And houses full of all good
things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;
original_text:
And houses full of all good
things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;

translated_text: Then beware lest thou forget the LORD, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
original_text: Then beware lest thou forget the LORD, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

translated_text: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.
original_text: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.

translated_text:
Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which
are round about you;
original_text:
Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which
are round about you;

translated_text:
(For the LORD thy God
is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.
original_text:
(For the LORD thy God
is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.

translated_text:
Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted
him in Massah.
original_text:
Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted
him in Massah.

translated_text: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.
original_text: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.

translated_text:
And thou shalt do
that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers,
original_text:
And thou shalt do
that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers,

translated_text: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.
original_text: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.

translated_text:
And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What
mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?
original_text:
And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What
mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?

translated_text: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:
original_text: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:

translated_text: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:
original_text: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:

translated_text: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.
original_text: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.

translated_text:
And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as
it is
 at this day.
original_text:
And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as
it is
 at this day.

translated_text: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded us.
original_text: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded us.

translated_text: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.
original_text: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.

translated_text: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
original_text: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

translated_text:
The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us,
even us, who
are all of us here alive this day.
original_text:
The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us,
even us, who
are all of us here alive this day.

translated_text: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,
original_text: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,

translated_text: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,
original_text: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,

translated_text:
I
am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
original_text:
I
am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

translated_text: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.
original_text: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not make thee
any graven image,
or any likeness
of any thing that
is in heaven above, or that
is in the earth beneath, or that
is in the waters beneath the earth:
original_text:
Thou shalt not make thee
any graven image,
or any likeness
of any thing that
is in heaven above, or that
is in the earth beneath, or that
is in the waters beneath the earth:

translated_text:
Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God
am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth
generation of them that hate me,
original_text:
Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God
am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth
generation of them that hate me,

translated_text: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
original_text: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold
him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
original_text:
Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold
him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

translated_text: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.
original_text: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.

translated_text: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:
original_text: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:

translated_text:
But the seventh day
is the sabbath of the LORD thy God:
in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that
is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.
original_text:
But the seventh day
is the sabbath of the LORD thy God:
in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that
is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.

translated_text:
And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and
that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.
original_text:
And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and
that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.

translated_text: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
original_text: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

translated_text: Thou shalt not kill.
original_text: Thou shalt not kill.

translated_text: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.
original_text: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.

translated_text: Neither shalt thou steal.
original_text: Neither shalt thou steal.

translated_text: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.
original_text: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.

translated_text:
Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour’s wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour’s house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any
thing that
is thy neighbour’s.
original_text:
Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour’s wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour’s house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any
thing that
is thy neighbour’s.

translated_text: These words the LORD spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.
original_text: These words the LORD spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me,
even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
original_text:
And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me,
even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

translated_text: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.
original_text: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.

translated_text: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.
original_text: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.

translated_text:
For who
is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we
have,
 and lived?
original_text:
For who
is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we
have,
 and lived?

translated_text:
Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear
it, and do
it.
original_text:
Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear
it, and do
it.

translated_text: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.
original_text: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.

translated_text: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
original_text: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!

translated_text: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.
original_text: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.

translated_text:
But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do
them in the land which I give them to possess it.
original_text:
But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do
them in the land which I give them to possess it.

translated_text: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
original_text: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

translated_text:
Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and
that it may be well with you, and
that ye may prolong
your days in the land which ye shall possess.
original_text:
Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and
that it may be well with you, and
that ye may prolong
your days in the land which ye shall possess.

translated_text:
Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do
them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.
original_text:
Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do
them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.

translated_text:
Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish
ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
original_text:
Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish
ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.

translated_text: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal-peor: for all the men that followed Baal-peor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.
original_text: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal-peor: for all the men that followed Baal-peor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.

translated_text:
But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God
are alive every one of you this day.
original_text:
But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God
are alive every one of you this day.

translated_text: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.
original_text: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.

translated_text:
Keep therefore and do
them; for this
is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation
is a wise and understanding people.
original_text:
Keep therefore and do
them; for this
is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation
is a wise and understanding people.

translated_text:
For what nation
is there so great, who
hath God
so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God
is in all
things that we call upon him
for?
original_text:
For what nation
is there so great, who
hath God
so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God
is in all
things that we call upon him
for?

translated_text:
And what nation
is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments
so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
original_text:
And what nation
is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments
so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?

translated_text: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons’ sons;
original_text: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons’ sons;

translated_text:
Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and
that they may teach their children.
original_text:
Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and
that they may teach their children.

translated_text: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
original_text: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.

translated_text:
And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only
ye heard a voice.
original_text:
And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only
ye heard a voice.

translated_text:
And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform,
even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
original_text:
And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform,
even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.

translated_text: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
original_text: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.

translated_text:
Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day
that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
original_text:
Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day
that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:

translated_text:
Lest ye corrupt
yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
original_text:
Lest ye corrupt
yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

translated_text:
The likeness of any beast that
is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,
original_text:
The likeness of any beast that
is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,

translated_text:
The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that
is in the waters beneath the earth:
original_text:
The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that
is in the waters beneath the earth:

translated_text:
And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars,
even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.
original_text:
And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars,
even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.

translated_text:
But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace,
even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as
ye are this day.
original_text:
But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace,
even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as
ye are this day.

translated_text:
Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee
for an inheritance:
original_text:
Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee
for an inheritance:

translated_text: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.
original_text: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.

translated_text:
Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image,
or the likeness of any
thing, which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.
original_text:
Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image,
or the likeness of any
thing, which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.

translated_text:
For the LORD thy God
is a consuming fire,
even
 a jealous God.
original_text:
For the LORD thy God
is a consuming fire,
even
 a jealous God.

translated_text:
When thou shalt beget children, and children’s children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt
yourselves, and make a graven image,
or the likeness of any
thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:
original_text:
When thou shalt beget children, and children’s children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt
yourselves, and make a graven image,
or the likeness of any
thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:

translated_text:
I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong
your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
original_text:
I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong
your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.

translated_text: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.
original_text: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.

translated_text: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
original_text: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

translated_text:
But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find
him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
original_text:
But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find
him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

translated_text:
When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee,
even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;
original_text:
When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee,
even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;

translated_text:
(For the LORD thy God
is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
original_text:
(For the LORD thy God
is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.

translated_text:
For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and
ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been
any such thing
 as this great thing
is, or hath been heard like it?
original_text:
For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and
ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been
any such thing
 as this great thing
is, or hath been heard like it?

translated_text:
Did
ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
original_text:
Did
ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?

translated_text:
Or hath God assayed to go
and take him a nation from the midst of another
nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
original_text:
Or hath God assayed to go
and take him a nation from the midst of another
nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

translated_text: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.
original_text: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.

translated_text: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;
original_text: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;

translated_text:
To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou
art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land
for an inheritance, as
it is this day.
original_text:
To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou
art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land
for an inheritance, as
it is this day.

translated_text:
Know therefore this day, and consider
it in thine heart, that the LORD he
is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath:
there is none else.
original_text:
Know therefore this day, and consider
it in thine heart, that the LORD he
is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath:
there is none else.

translated_text:
Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong
thy days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.
original_text:
Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong
thy days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.

translated_text: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
original_text: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

translated_text: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
original_text: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:

translated_text: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
original_text: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.

translated_text: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:
original_text: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:

translated_text:
These
are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,
original_text:
These
are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,

translated_text: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:
original_text: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:

translated_text:
And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which
were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
original_text:
And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which
were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

translated_text:
From Aroer, which
is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which
is Hermon,
original_text:
From Aroer, which
is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which
is Hermon,

translated_text: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.
original_text: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.

translated_text: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
original_text: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
original_text: And the LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

translated_text: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.
original_text: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.

translated_text: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
original_text: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

translated_text:
All these cities
were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.
original_text:
All these cities
were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.

translated_text: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.
original_text: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.

translated_text: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.
original_text: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.

translated_text:
And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that
was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;
original_text:
And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that
was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;

translated_text: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)
original_text: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)

translated_text: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
original_text: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

translated_text:
For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead
was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.
original_text:
For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead
was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.

translated_text:
And this land,
which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which
is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
original_text:
And this land,
which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which
is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.

translated_text:
And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan,
being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.
original_text:
And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan,
being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.

translated_text: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashan-havoth-jair, unto this day.
original_text: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashan-havoth-jair, unto this day.

translated_text: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
original_text: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.

translated_text:
And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok,
which is the border of the children of Ammon;
original_text:
And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok,
which is the border of the children of Ammon;

translated_text:
The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast
thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain,
even the salt sea, under Ashdoth-pisgah eastward.
original_text:
The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast
thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain,
even the salt sea, under Ashdoth-pisgah eastward.

translated_text:
And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all
that are meet for the war.
original_text:
And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all
that are meet for the war.

translated_text:
But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for
 I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
original_text:
But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for
 I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;

translated_text:
Until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and
until they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and
then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.
original_text:
Until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and
until they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and
then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.

translated_text: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the LORD do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.
original_text: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the LORD do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.

translated_text: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.
original_text: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.

translated_text: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,
original_text: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,

translated_text:
O Lord GOD, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God
is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?
original_text:
O Lord GOD, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God
is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?

translated_text:
I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that
is
 beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.
original_text:
I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that
is
 beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.

translated_text: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.
original_text: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.

translated_text:
Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold
it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
original_text:
Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold
it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

translated_text: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.
original_text: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.

translated_text: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.
original_text: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.

translated_text: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.
original_text: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto me, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto me, saying,

translated_text: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.
original_text: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.

translated_text:
And command thou the people, saying, Ye
are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:
original_text:
And command thou the people, saying, Ye
are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:

translated_text:
Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a footbreadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau
for
 a possession.
original_text:
Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a footbreadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau
for
 a possession.

translated_text: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.
original_text: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.

translated_text:
For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God
hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.
original_text:
For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God
hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.

translated_text: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Ezion-gaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
original_text: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Ezion-gaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land
for
 a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot
for a possession.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land
for
 a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot
for a possession.

translated_text: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;
original_text: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;

translated_text: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.
original_text: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.

translated_text: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.
original_text: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.

translated_text:
Now rise up,
said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
original_text:
Now rise up,
said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.

translated_text:
And the space in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered,
was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the LORD sware unto them.
original_text:
And the space in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered,
was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the LORD sware unto them.

translated_text: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.
original_text: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.

translated_text: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
original_text: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

translated_text: That the LORD spake unto me, saying,
original_text: That the LORD spake unto me, saying,

translated_text: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:
original_text: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:

translated_text:
And
when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon
any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot
for a possession.
original_text:
And
when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon
any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot
for a possession.

translated_text: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;
original_text: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;

translated_text: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:
original_text: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:

translated_text: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:
original_text: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:

translated_text:
And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim,
even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)
original_text:
And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim,
even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)

translated_text:
Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess
it, and contend with him in battle.
original_text:
Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess
it, and contend with him in battle.

translated_text:
This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations
that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.
original_text:
This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations
that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.

translated_text: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
original_text: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

translated_text: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
original_text: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.

translated_text: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;
original_text: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;

translated_text: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.
original_text: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.

translated_text:
But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as
appeareth this day.
original_text:
But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as
appeareth this day.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.
original_text: And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.

translated_text: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
original_text: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

translated_text: And the LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
original_text: And the LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.

translated_text: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:
original_text: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:

translated_text: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.
original_text: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.

translated_text:
From Aroer, which
is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and
from the city that
is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto us:
original_text:
From Aroer, which
is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and
from the city that
is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto us:

translated_text:
Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok,
nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the LORD our God forbad us.
original_text:
Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok,
nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the LORD our God forbad us.

translated_text:
These
be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red
sea,
 between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
original_text:
These
be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red
sea,
 between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

translated_text:
(There are eleven days’
journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh-barnea.)
original_text:
(There are eleven days’
journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh-barnea.)

translated_text: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:
original_text: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:

translated_text: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,
original_text: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,

translated_text: The LORD our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:
original_text: The LORD our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:

translated_text:
Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all
the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.
original_text:
Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all
the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.

translated_text: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.
original_text: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.

translated_text: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
original_text: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:

translated_text:
The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye
are
 this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
original_text:
The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye
are
 this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.

translated_text:
(The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye
are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)
original_text:
(The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye
are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)

translated_text: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
original_text: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?

translated_text: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
original_text: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.

translated_text:
And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good
for us to do.
original_text:
And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good
for us to do.

translated_text: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
original_text: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.

translated_text:
And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear
the causes
 between your brethren, and judge righteously between
every
 man and his brother, and the stranger
that is with him.
original_text:
And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear
the causes
 between your brethren, and judge righteously between
every
 man and his brother, and the stranger
that is with him.

translated_text:
Ye shall not respect persons in judgment;
but
ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment
is
God’s: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring
it
unto me, and I will hear it.
original_text:
Ye shall not respect persons in judgment;
but
ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment
is
God’s: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring
it
unto me, and I will hear it.

translated_text: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
original_text: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.

translated_text: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.
original_text: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.

translated_text: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give unto us.
original_text: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give unto us.

translated_text:
Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up
and possess
it, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.
original_text:
Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up
and possess
it, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.

translated_text: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.
original_text: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.

translated_text: and the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:
original_text: and the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:

translated_text: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
original_text: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.

translated_text:
And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought
it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said,
It is
 a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.
original_text:
And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought
it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said,
It is
 a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.

translated_text: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:
original_text: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:

translated_text: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
original_text: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.

translated_text:
Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people
is greater and taller than we; the cities
are
 great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.
original_text:
Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people
is greater and taller than we; the cities
are
 great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.

translated_text: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
original_text: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.

translated_text: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
original_text: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;

translated_text: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
original_text: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.

translated_text: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God,
original_text: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God,

translated_text:
Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents
in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.
original_text:
Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents
in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.

translated_text: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,
original_text: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,

translated_text: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,
original_text: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,

translated_text: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.
original_text: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.

translated_text: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.
original_text: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.

translated_text: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
