original_text: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

translated_text: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
original_text: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.

translated_text:
But
as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
original_text:
But
as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

translated_text: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.
original_text: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I
am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I
am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.

translated_text: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and went presumptuously up into the hill.
original_text: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and went presumptuously up into the hill.

translated_text:
And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir,
even unto Hormah.
original_text:
And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir,
even unto Hormah.

translated_text: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.
original_text: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.

translated_text:
So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode
there.
original_text:
So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode
there.

translated_text: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.
original_text: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

translated_text:
And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time,
even
 Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.
original_text:
And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time,
even
 Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.

translated_text: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.
original_text: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.

translated_text: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
original_text: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

translated_text: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
original_text: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

translated_text: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.
original_text: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.

translated_text: And when they cried unto the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.
original_text: And when they cried unto the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.

translated_text: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.
original_text: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.

translated_text: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:
original_text: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:

translated_text: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.
original_text: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.

translated_text: And ye went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.
original_text: And ye went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.

translated_text: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.
original_text: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.

translated_text: Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the LORD.
original_text: Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the LORD.

translated_text:
And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that
were
 on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
original_text:
And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that
were
 on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

translated_text: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;
original_text: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;

translated_text:
For the LORD our God, he
it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:
original_text:
For the LORD our God, he
it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:

translated_text:
And the LORD drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land:
therefore will we also serve the LORD; for he
is our God.
original_text:
And the LORD drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land:
therefore will we also serve the LORD; for he
is our God.

translated_text:
And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the LORD: for he
is an holy God; he
is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.
original_text:
And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the LORD: for he
is an holy God; he
is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.

translated_text: If ye forsake the LORD, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.
original_text: If ye forsake the LORD, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.

translated_text: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the LORD.
original_text: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the LORD.

translated_text:
And Joshua said unto the people, Ye
are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the LORD, to serve him. And they said,
We are witnesses.
original_text:
And Joshua said unto the people, Ye
are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the LORD, to serve him. And they said,
We are witnesses.

translated_text:
Now therefore put away,
said he, the strange gods which
are among you, and incline your heart unto the LORD God of Israel.
original_text:
Now therefore put away,
said he, the strange gods which
are among you, and incline your heart unto the LORD God of Israel.

translated_text: And the people said unto Joshua, The LORD our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.
original_text: And the people said unto Joshua, The LORD our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.

translated_text: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
original_text: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

translated_text:
And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that
was by the sanctuary of the LORD.
original_text:
And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that
was by the sanctuary of the LORD.

translated_text: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.
original_text: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.

translated_text: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.
original_text: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.

translated_text:
And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died,
being an hundred and ten years old.
original_text:
And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died,
being an hundred and ten years old.

translated_text:
And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah, which
is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.
original_text:
And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah, which
is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

translated_text: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD, that he had done for Israel.
original_text: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD, that he had done for Israel.

translated_text: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
original_text: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

translated_text:
And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill
that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.
original_text:
And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill
that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.

translated_text:
And it came to pass a long time after that the LORD had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old
and
 stricken in age.
original_text:
And it came to pass a long time after that the LORD had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old
and
 stricken in age.

translated_text:
And Joshua called for all Israel,
and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old
and stricken in age:
original_text:
And Joshua called for all Israel,
and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old
and stricken in age:

translated_text:
And ye have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for the LORD your God
is he that hath fought for you.
original_text:
And ye have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for the LORD your God
is he that hath fought for you.

translated_text: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.
original_text: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.

translated_text: And the LORD your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the LORD your God hath promised unto you.
original_text: And the LORD your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the LORD your God hath promised unto you.

translated_text:
Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom
to
 the right hand or
to the left;
original_text:
Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom
to
 the right hand or
to the left;

translated_text:
That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the names of their gods, nor cause to swear
by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:
original_text:
That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the names of their gods, nor cause to swear
by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:

translated_text: But cleave unto the LORD your God, as ye have done unto this day.
original_text: But cleave unto the LORD your God, as ye have done unto this day.

translated_text:
For the LORD hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but
as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day.
original_text:
For the LORD hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but
as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day.

translated_text:
One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the LORD your God, he
it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.
original_text:
One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the LORD your God, he
it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.

translated_text: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the LORD your God.
original_text: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the LORD your God.

translated_text:
Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations,
even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:
original_text:
Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations,
even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:

translated_text:
Know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out
any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.
original_text:
Know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out
any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

translated_text:
And, behold, this day I
am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you,
and not one thing hath failed thereof.
original_text:
And, behold, this day I
am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you,
and not one thing hath failed thereof.

translated_text:
Therefore it shall come to pass,
that as all good things are come upon you, which the LORD your God promised you; so shall the LORD bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.
original_text:
Therefore it shall come to pass,
that as all good things are come upon you, which the LORD your God promised you; so shall the LORD bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

translated_text: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.
original_text: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.

translated_text: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
original_text: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

translated_text: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:
original_text: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:

translated_text: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the LORD your God.
original_text: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the LORD your God.

translated_text:
And now the LORD your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents,
and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side Jordan.
original_text:
And now the LORD your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents,
and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side Jordan.

translated_text: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the LORD charged you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.
original_text: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the LORD charged you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.

translated_text: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.
original_text: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.

translated_text:
Now to the
one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given
possession in Bashan: but unto the
other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,
original_text:
Now to the
one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given
possession in Bashan: but unto the
other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,

translated_text: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.
original_text: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.

translated_text:
And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which
is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
original_text:
And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which
is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

translated_text:
And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that
are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.
original_text:
And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that
are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.

translated_text: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.
original_text: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.

translated_text:
And when the children of Israel heard
of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.
original_text:
And when the children of Israel heard
of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.

translated_text: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,
original_text: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,

translated_text:
And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one
was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.
original_text:
And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one
was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.

translated_text: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,
original_text: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,

translated_text:
Thus saith the whole congregation of the LORD, What trespass
is
 this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the LORD, in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the LORD?
original_text:
Thus saith the whole congregation of the LORD, What trespass
is
 this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the LORD, in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the LORD?

translated_text: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the LORD,
original_text: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the LORD,

translated_text:
But that ye must turn away this day from following the LORD? and it will be,
seeing ye rebel to day against the LORD, that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.
original_text:
But that ye must turn away this day from following the LORD? and it will be,
seeing ye rebel to day against the LORD, that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.

translated_text:
Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession
be unclean,
then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the LORD, wherein the LORD’S tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the LORD, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the LORD our God.
original_text:
Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession
be unclean,
then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the LORD, wherein the LORD’S tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the LORD, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the LORD our God.

translated_text: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.
original_text: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.

translated_text: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,
original_text: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,

translated_text:
The LORD God of gods, the LORD God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if
it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the LORD, (save us not this day,)
original_text:
The LORD God of gods, the LORD God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if
it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the LORD, (save us not this day,)

translated_text: That we have built us an altar to turn from following the LORD, or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let the LORD himself require it;
original_text: That we have built us an altar to turn from following the LORD, or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let the LORD himself require it;

translated_text:
And if we have not
rather done it for fear of
this
 thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with the LORD God of Israel?
original_text:
And if we have not
rather done it for fear of
this
 thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with the LORD God of Israel?

translated_text: For the LORD hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the LORD: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the LORD.
original_text: For the LORD hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the LORD: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the LORD.

translated_text: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:
original_text: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:

translated_text:
But
that it
may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the LORD.
original_text:
But
that it
may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the LORD.

translated_text:
Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say
again, Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it
is a witness between us and you.
original_text:
Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say
again, Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it
is a witness between us and you.

translated_text:
God forbid that we should rebel against the LORD, and turn this day from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of the LORD our God that
is
 before his tabernacle.
original_text:
God forbid that we should rebel against the LORD, and turn this day from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of the LORD our God that
is
 before his tabernacle.

translated_text:
And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which
were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.
original_text:
And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which
were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.

translated_text:
And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the LORD
is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD.
original_text:
And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the LORD
is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD.

translated_text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.
original_text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

translated_text: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.
original_text: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.

translated_text:
And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar
Ed: for it
shall be a witness between us that the LORD
is God.
original_text:
And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar
Ed: for it
shall be a witness between us that the LORD
is God.

translated_text: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;
original_text: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;

translated_text: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.
original_text: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.

translated_text: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the LORD, these cities and their suburbs.
original_text: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the LORD, these cities and their suburbs.

translated_text:
And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest,
which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.
original_text:

translated_text: And the LORD gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.
original_text: And the LORD gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.

translated_text: And the LORD gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.
original_text: And the LORD gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.

translated_text: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.
original_text: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.

translated_text: The LORD also spake unto Joshua, saying,
original_text: The LORD also spake unto Joshua, saying,

translated_text: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:
original_text: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:

translated_text:
That the slayer that killeth
any person unawares
and
 unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
original_text:
That the slayer that killeth
any person unawares
and
 unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

translated_text: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.
original_text: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.

translated_text: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.
original_text: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.

translated_text:
And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment,

 person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.

inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and
this was
the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.

translated_text: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:
original_text: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:

translated_text:
And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan,
were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
original_text:
And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan,
were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.

translated_text:
These
are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
original_text:
These
are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.

translated_text:
But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not
any inheritance: the LORD God of Israel
was their inheritance, as he said unto them.
original_text:
But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not
any inheritance: the LORD God of Israel
was their inheritance, as he said unto them.

translated_text:
Now these
are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:
original_text:
Now these
are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:

translated_text:
Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon,
and ruled from Aroer, which
is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok,
which is the border of the children of Ammon;
original_text:
Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon,
and ruled from Aroer, which
is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok,
which is the border of the children of Ammon;

translated_text:
And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain,
even the salt sea on the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdoth-pisgah:
original_text:
And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain,
even the salt sea on the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdoth-pisgah:

translated_text:
And the coast of Og king of Bashan,
which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
original_text:
And the coast of Og king of Bashan,
which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

translated_text: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
original_text: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

translated_text:
Them did Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the LORD gave it
for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.
original_text:
Them did Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the LORD gave it
for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.

translated_text: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
original_text: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:

translated_text:
The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which
is beside Bethel, one;
original_text:
The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which
is beside Bethel, one;

translated_text: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
original_text: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

translated_text: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
original_text: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

translated_text: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
original_text: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

translated_text: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
original_text: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

translated_text: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
original_text: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

translated_text: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
original_text: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

translated_text: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
original_text: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;

translated_text: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
original_text: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

translated_text: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
original_text: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;

translated_text: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
original_text: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

translated_text: The king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
original_text: The king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

translated_text: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
original_text: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

translated_text: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;
original_text: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;

translated_text: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;
original_text: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;

translated_text: The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.
original_text: The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard
those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
original_text:
And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard
those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,

translated_text:
And to the kings that
were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,
original_text:
And to the kings that
were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,

translated_text:
And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and
to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and
to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.
original_text:
And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and
to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and
to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.

translated_text:
And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that
is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.
original_text:
And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that
is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.

translated_text: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.
original_text: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.

translated_text: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.
original_text: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.

translated_text: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephoth-maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
original_text: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephoth-maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.

translated_text: And Joshua did unto them as the LORD bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
original_text: And Joshua did unto them as the LORD bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.

translated_text: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
original_text: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.

translated_text:
And they smote all the souls that
were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying
them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.
original_text:
And they smote all the souls that
were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying
them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.

translated_text:
And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword,
and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.
original_text:
And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword,
and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.

translated_text: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.
original_text: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.

translated_text: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;
original_text: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;

translated_text: Even from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.
original_text: Even from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.

translated_text: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
original_text: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

translated_text:
There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all
other they took in battle.
original_text:
There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all
other they took in battle.

translated_text:
For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly,
and
 that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text:
For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly,
and
 that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.
original_text: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.

translated_text: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.
original_text: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.

translated_text: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.
original_text: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.

translated_text: Now it came to pass, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;
original_text: Now it came to pass, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;

translated_text:
That they feared greatly, because Gibeon
was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it
was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof
were mighty.
original_text:
That they feared greatly, because Gibeon
was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it
was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof
were mighty.

translated_text: Wherefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,
original_text: Wherefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,

translated_text: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.
original_text: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.

translated_text: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.
original_text: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.

translated_text: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.
original_text: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.

translated_text: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.
original_text: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.

translated_text:
Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly,
and went up from Gilgal all night.
original_text:
Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly,
and went up from Gilgal all night.

translated_text: And the LORD discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Beth-horon, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.
original_text: And the LORD discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Beth-horon, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel,
and
 were in the going down to Beth-horon, that the LORD cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died:
they were
 more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.
original_text:
And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel,
and
 were in the going down to Beth-horon, that the LORD cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died:
they were
 more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.

translated_text: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.
original_text: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.

translated_text:
And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies.
Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.
original_text:
And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies.
Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.

translated_text: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the LORD fought for Israel.
original_text: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the LORD fought for Israel.

translated_text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
original_text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

translated_text: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.
original_text: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.

translated_text: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.
original_text: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.

translated_text: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:
original_text: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:

translated_text:
And stay ye not,
but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for the LORD your God hath delivered them into your hand.
original_text:
And stay ye not,
but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for the LORD your God hath delivered them into your hand.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest
which remained of them entered into fenced cities.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest
which remained of them entered into fenced cities.

translated_text: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.
original_text: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.

translated_text: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.
original_text: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.

translated_text:
And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish,
and the king of Eglon.
original_text:
And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish,
and the king of Eglon.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.
original_text: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.

translated_text: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the LORD do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.
original_text: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the LORD do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.

translated_text: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.
original_text: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.

translated_text:
And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun,
that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave’s mouth,
which remain until this very day.
original_text:
And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun,
that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave’s mouth,
which remain until this very day.

translated_text:
And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls
that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.
original_text:
And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls
that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.

translated_text: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:
original_text: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:

translated_text:
And the LORD delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that
were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.
original_text:
And the LORD delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that
were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.

translated_text: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:
original_text: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:

translated_text:
And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that
were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
original_text:
And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that
were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

translated_text: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.
original_text: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.

translated_text: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:
original_text: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:

translated_text:
And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that
were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
original_text:
And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that
were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

translated_text: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:
original_text: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:

translated_text:
And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that
were
 therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that
were therein.
original_text:
And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that
were
 therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that
were therein.

translated_text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:
original_text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:

translated_text:
And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that
were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.
original_text:
And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that
were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.

translated_text: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD God of Israel commanded.

original_text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.

translated_text: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh-barnea.
original_text: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh-barnea.

translated_text:
Forty years old
was I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as
it was in mine heart.
original_text:
Forty years old
was I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as
it was in mine heart.

translated_text: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the LORD my God.
original_text: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the LORD my God.

translated_text: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children’s for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God.
original_text: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children’s for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God.

translated_text:
And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses, while
the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I
am this day fourscore and five years old.
original_text:
And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses, while
the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I
am this day fourscore and five years old.

translated_text:
As yet I
am as strong this day as
I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength
was then, even so
is
 my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.
original_text:
As yet I
am as strong this day as
I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength
was then, even so
is
 my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.

translated_text:
Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims
were there, and
that the cities
were great
and fenced: if so be the LORD
will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.
original_text:
Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims
were there, and
that the cities
were great
and fenced: if so be the LORD
will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.

translated_text: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.
original_text: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.

translated_text: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.
original_text: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.

translated_text: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.
original_text: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.

translated_text: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,
original_text: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,

translated_text: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;
original_text: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;

translated_text:
And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry
and mouldy.
original_text:
And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry
and mouldy.

translated_text: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.
original_text: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.

translated_text: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?
original_text: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?

translated_text:
And they said unto Joshua, We
are thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who
are ye? and from whence come ye?
original_text:
And they said unto Joshua, We
are thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who
are ye? and from whence come ye?

translated_text: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the LORD thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,
original_text: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the LORD thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,

translated_text:
And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that
were
 beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which
was at Ashtaroth.
original_text:
And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that
were
 beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which
was at Ashtaroth.

translated_text:
Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We
are your servants: therefore now make ye a league with us.
original_text:
Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We
are your servants: therefore now make ye a league with us.

translated_text:
This our bread we took hot
for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:
original_text:
This our bread we took hot
for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:

translated_text:
And these bottles of wine, which we filled,
were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.
original_text:
And these bottles of wine, which we filled,
were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.

translated_text:
And the men took of their victuals, and asked not
counsel
 at the mouth of the LORD.
original_text:
And the men took of their victuals, and asked not
counsel
 at the mouth of the LORD.

translated_text: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.
original_text: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.

translated_text:
And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they
were their neighbours, and
that they dwelt among them.
original_text:
And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they
were their neighbours, and
that they dwelt among them.

translated_text:
And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities
were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.
original_text:
And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities
were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.

translated_text: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.
original_text: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.

translated_text: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.
original_text: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.

translated_text: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.
original_text: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.

translated_text: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.
