original_text: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.

translated_text:
And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We
are very far from you; when ye dwell among us?
original_text:
And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We
are very far from you; when ye dwell among us?

translated_text:
Now therefore ye
are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.
original_text:
Now therefore ye
are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.

translated_text: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that the LORD thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
original_text: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that the LORD thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

translated_text:
And now, behold, we
are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.
original_text:
And now, behold, we
are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.

translated_text: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew them not.
original_text: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew them not.

translated_text: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the LORD, even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.
original_text: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the LORD, even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.

translated_text: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in.
original_text: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof,
and the mighty men of valour.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof,
and the mighty men of valour.

translated_text:
And ye shall compass the city, all
ye men of war,
and
 go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.
original_text:
And ye shall compass the city, all
ye men of war,
and
 go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.

translated_text: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams horns: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.
original_text: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams horns: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long
blast
 with the ram’s horn,
and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long
blast
 with the ram’s horn,
and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.

translated_text: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the LORD.
original_text: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the LORD.

translated_text: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the LORD.
original_text: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the LORD.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns passed on before the LORD, and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.
original_text: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns passed on before the LORD, and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.

translated_text:
And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark,
the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.
original_text:
And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark,
the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

translated_text:
And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, Ye shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall
any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall ye shout.
original_text:
And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, Ye shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall
any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall ye shout.

translated_text:
So the ark of the LORD compassed the city, going about
it
 once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.
original_text:
So the ark of the LORD compassed the city, going about
it
 once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.

translated_text: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the LORD.
original_text: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the LORD.

translated_text:
And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the LORD went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of the LORD,
the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.
original_text:
And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the LORD went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of the LORD,
the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

translated_text: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.
original_text: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.

translated_text: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.
original_text: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.

translated_text: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the LORD hath given you the city.
original_text: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the LORD hath given you the city.

translated_text:
And the city shall be accursed,
even it, and all that
are therein, to the LORD: only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that
are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.
original_text:
And the city shall be accursed,
even it, and all that
are therein, to the LORD: only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that
are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

translated_text:
And ye, in any wise keep
yourselves from the accursed thing, lest ye make
yourselves accursed, when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.
original_text:
And ye, in any wise keep
yourselves from the accursed thing, lest ye make
yourselves accursed, when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.

translated_text:
But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron,
are
 consecrated unto the LORD: they shall come into the treasury of the LORD.
original_text:
But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron,
are
 consecrated unto the LORD: they shall come into the treasury of the LORD.

translated_text:
So the people shouted when
the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.
original_text:
So the people shouted when
the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.

translated_text:
And they utterly destroyed all that
was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.
original_text:
And they utterly destroyed all that
was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.

translated_text: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country, Go into the harlot’s house, and bring out thence the woman, and all that she hath, as ye sware unto her.
original_text: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country, Go into the harlot’s house, and bring out thence the woman, and all that she hath, as ye sware unto her.

translated_text: And the young men that were spies went in, and brought Rahab, and her father, and her mother, and her brethren, and all that she had; and they brought out all her kindred, and left them without the camp of Israel.
original_text: And the young men that were spies went in, and brought Rahab, and her father, and her mother, and her brethren, and all that she had; and they brought out all her kindred, and left them without the camp of Israel.

translated_text:
And they burnt the city with fire, and all that
was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the LORD.
original_text:
And they burnt the city with fire, and all that
was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father’s household, and all that she had; and she dwelleth in Israel
even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
original_text:
And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father’s household, and all that she had; and she dwelleth in Israel
even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

translated_text:
And Joshua adjured
them at that time, saying, Cursed
be the man before the LORD, that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest
son shall he set up the gates of it.
original_text:
And Joshua adjured
them at that time, saying, Cursed
be the man before the LORD, that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest
son shall he set up the gates of it.

translated_text:
So the LORD was with Joshua; and his fame was
noised throughout all the country.
original_text:
So the LORD was with Joshua; and his fame was
noised throughout all the country.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which
were on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, which
were by the sea, heard that the LORD had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children of Israel, until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Israel.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which
were on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, which
were by the sea, heard that the LORD had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children of Israel, until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Israel.

translated_text: At that time the LORD said unto Joshua, Make thee sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.
original_text: At that time the LORD said unto Joshua, Make thee sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.

translated_text: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.
original_text: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

translated_text:
And this
is the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the people that came out of Egypt,
that were males,
even all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came out of Egypt.
original_text:
And this
is the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the people that came out of Egypt,
that were males,
even all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came out of Egypt.

translated_text:
Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the people
that were born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt,
them they had not circumcised.
original_text:
Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the people
that were born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt,
them they had not circumcised.

translated_text:
For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people
that were men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD: unto whom the LORD sware that he would not shew them the land, which the LORD sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land that floweth with milk and honey.
original_text:
For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people
that were men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD: unto whom the LORD sware that he would not shew them the land, which the LORD sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

translated_text:
And their children,
whom he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.
original_text:
And their children,
whom he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.
original_text: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.

translated_text: And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, and kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.
original_text: And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, and kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.

translated_text:
And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched
corn in the selfsame day.
original_text:
And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched
corn in the selfsame day.

translated_text: And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old corn of the land; neither had the children of Israel manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.
original_text: And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old corn of the land; neither had the children of Israel manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him,
Art thou for us, or for our adversaries?
original_text:
And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him,
Art thou for us, or for our adversaries?

translated_text:
And he said, Nay; but
as captain of the host of the LORD am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What saith my lord unto his servant?
original_text:
And he said, Nay; but
as captain of the host of the LORD am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What saith my lord unto his servant?

translated_text:
And the captain of the LORD’S host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest
is holy. And Joshua did so.
original_text:
And the captain of the LORD’S host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest
is holy. And Joshua did so.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:
original_text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:

translated_text: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king: only the spoil thereof, and the cattle thereof, shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves: lay thee an ambush for the city behind it.
original_text: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king: only the spoil thereof, and the cattle thereof, shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves: lay thee an ambush for the city behind it.

translated_text: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.
original_text: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.

translated_text:
And he commanded them, saying, Behold, ye shall lie in wait against the city,
even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:
original_text:
And he commanded them, saying, Behold, ye shall lie in wait against the city,
even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:

translated_text:
And I, and all the people that
are with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,
original_text:
And I, and all the people that
are with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,

translated_text: (For they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.
original_text: (For they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.

translated_text: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.
original_text: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.

translated_text:
And it shall be, when ye have taken the city,
that ye shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of the LORD shall ye do. See, I have commanded you.
original_text:
And it shall be, when ye have taken the city,
that ye shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of the LORD shall ye do. See, I have commanded you.

translated_text: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.
original_text: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.

translated_text: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.
original_text: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.

translated_text:
And all the people,
even the people of war that
were
 with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now
there was a valley between them and Ai.
original_text:
And all the people,
even the people of war that
were
 with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now
there was a valley between them and Ai.

translated_text: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.
original_text: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.

translated_text:
And when they had set the people,
even all the host that
was on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.
original_text:
And when they had set the people,
even all the host that
was on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw
it, that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that
there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw
it, that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that
there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.

translated_text: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
original_text: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

translated_text:
And all the people that
were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.
original_text:
And all the people that
were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

translated_text: And there was not a man left in Ai or Bethel, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.
original_text: And there was not a man left in Ai or Bethel, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that
is
 in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thine hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that
he had in his hand toward the city.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that
is
 in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thine hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that
he had in his hand toward the city.

translated_text: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.
original_text: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.

translated_text: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.
original_text: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.

translated_text: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.
original_text: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.

translated_text: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.
original_text: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

translated_text: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.
original_text: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.
original_text: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.

translated_text:
And
so it was,
that all that fell that day, both of men and women,
were twelve thousand,
even all the men of Ai.
original_text:
And
so it was,
that all that fell that day, both of men and women,
were twelve thousand,
even all the men of Ai.

translated_text: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.
original_text: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.

translated_text: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of the LORD which he commanded Joshua.
original_text: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of the LORD which he commanded Joshua.

translated_text:
And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever,
even a desolation unto this day.
original_text:
And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever,
even a desolation unto this day.

translated_text:
And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones,
that remaineth unto this day.
original_text:
And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones,
that remaineth unto this day.

translated_text: Then Joshua built an altar unto the LORD God of Israel in mount Ebal,
original_text: Then Joshua built an altar unto the LORD God of Israel in mount Ebal,

translated_text:
As Moses the servant of the LORD commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man hath lift up
any iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the LORD, and sacrificed peace offerings.
original_text:
As Moses the servant of the LORD commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man hath lift up
any iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the LORD, and sacrificed peace offerings.

translated_text: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.
original_text: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.

translated_text: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.
original_text: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.

translated_text: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.
original_text: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

translated_text: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.
original_text: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.

translated_text: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed thing: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against the children of Israel.
original_text: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed thing: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against the children of Israel.

translated_text:
And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which
is beside Beth-aven, on the east side of Bethel, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country. And the men went up and viewed Ai.
original_text:
And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which
is beside Beth-aven, on the east side of Bethel, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country. And the men went up and viewed Ai.

translated_text:
And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai;
and
 make not all the people to labour thither; for they
are but
 few.
original_text:
And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai;
and
 make not all the people to labour thither; for they
are but
 few.

translated_text: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.
original_text: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.

translated_text:
And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them
from before the gate
even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.
original_text:
And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them
from before the gate
even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.

translated_text: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the LORD until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust upon their heads.
original_text: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the LORD until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust upon their heads.

translated_text: And Joshua said, Alas, O Lord GOD, wherefore hast thou at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? would to God we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!
original_text: And Joshua said, Alas, O Lord GOD, wherefore hast thou at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? would to God we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!

translated_text: O Lord, what shall I say, when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies!
original_text: O Lord, what shall I say, when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies!

translated_text:
For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear
of it, and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth: and what wilt thou do unto thy great name?
original_text:
For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear
of it, and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth: and what wilt thou do unto thy great name?

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face?
original_text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face?

translated_text:
Israel hath sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put
it even among their own stuff.
original_text:
Israel hath sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put
it even among their own stuff.

translated_text:
Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies,
but turned
their backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except ye destroy the accursed from among you.
original_text:
Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies,
but turned
their backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except ye destroy the accursed from among you.

translated_text:
Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus saith the LORD God of Israel,
There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee, O Israel: thou canst not stand before thine enemies, until ye take away the accursed thing from among you.
original_text:
Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus saith the LORD God of Israel,
There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee, O Israel: thou canst not stand before thine enemies, until ye take away the accursed thing from among you.

translated_text:
In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be,
that the tribe which the LORD taketh shall come according to the families
thereof; and the family which the LORD shall take shall come by households; and the household which the LORD shall take shall come man by man.
original_text:
In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be,
that the tribe which the LORD taketh shall come according to the families
thereof; and the family which the LORD shall take shall come by households; and the household which the LORD shall take shall come man by man.

translated_text:
And it shall be,
that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he hath: because he hath transgressed the covenant of the LORD, and because he hath wrought folly in Israel.
original_text:
And it shall be,
that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he hath: because he hath transgressed the covenant of the LORD, and because he hath wrought folly in Israel.

translated_text: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken:
original_text: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken:

translated_text: And he brought the family of Judah; and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:
original_text: And he brought the family of Judah; and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:

translated_text: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.
original_text: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.

translated_text:
And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the LORD God of Israel, and make confession unto him; and tell me now what thou hast done; hide
it not from me.
original_text:
And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the LORD God of Israel, and make confession unto him; and tell me now what thou hast done; hide
it not from me.

translated_text: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against the LORD God of Israel, and thus and thus have I done:
original_text: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against the LORD God of Israel, and thus and thus have I done:

translated_text:
When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they
are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.
original_text:
When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they
are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.

translated_text:
So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold,
it was hid in his tent, and the silver under it.
original_text:
So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold,
it was hid in his tent, and the silver under it.

translated_text: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the LORD.
original_text: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the LORD.

translated_text: And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.
original_text: And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.

translated_text: And Joshua said, Why hast thou troubled us? the LORD shall trouble thee this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.
original_text: And Joshua said, Why hast thou troubled us? the LORD shall trouble thee this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.

translated_text: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day. So the LORD turned from the fierceness of his anger. Wherefore the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, unto this day.
original_text: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day. So the LORD turned from the fierceness of his anger. Wherefore the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, unto this day.

translated_text: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there.
original_text: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there.

translated_text: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.
original_text: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.

translated_text: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.
original_text: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.

translated_text:
And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they
were:
original_text:
And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they
were:

translated_text:
And it came to pass
about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.
original_text:
And it came to pass
about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.

translated_text: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.
original_text: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.

translated_text: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.
original_text: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.

translated_text: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;
original_text: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;

translated_text: And she said unto the men, I know that the LORD hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.
original_text: And she said unto the men, I know that the LORD hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.

translated_text:
For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that
were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.
original_text:
For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that
were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.

translated_text:
And as soon as we had heard
these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the LORD your God, he
is God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.
original_text:
And as soon as we had heard
these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the LORD your God, he
is God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.

translated_text: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the LORD, since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father’s house, and give me a true token:
original_text: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the LORD, since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father’s house, and give me a true token:

translated_text:
And
that ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.
original_text:
And
that ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.

translated_text: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the LORD hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.
original_text: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the LORD hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.

translated_text:
Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house
was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.
original_text:
Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house
was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.

translated_text: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.
original_text: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.

translated_text:
And the men said unto her, We
will be blameless of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.
original_text:
And the men said unto her, We
will be blameless of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.

translated_text:
Behold,
when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father’s household, home unto thee.
original_text:
Behold,
when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father’s household, home unto thee.

translated_text:
And it shall be,
that whosoever shall go out of the doors of thy house into the street, his blood
shall be upon his head, and we
will be guiltless: and whosoever shall be with thee in the house, his blood
shall be on our head, if
any hand be upon him.
original_text:
And it shall be,
that whosoever shall go out of the doors of thy house into the street, his blood
shall be upon his head, and we
will be guiltless: and whosoever shall be with thee in the house, his blood
shall be on our head, if
any hand be upon him.

translated_text: And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.
original_text: And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.

translated_text:
And she said, According unto your words, so
be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.
original_text:
And she said, According unto your words, so
be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.

translated_text:
And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought
them
 throughout all the way, but found
them not.
original_text:
And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought
them
 throughout all the way, but found
them not.

translated_text:
So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all
things
 that befell them:
original_text:
So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all
things
 that befell them:

translated_text: And they said unto Joshua, Truly the LORD hath delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.
original_text: And they said unto Joshua, Truly the LORD hath delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.

translated_text: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD it came to pass, that the LORD spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,
original_text: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD it came to pass, that the LORD spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,

translated_text:
Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them,
even
 to the children of Israel.
original_text:
Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them,
even
 to the children of Israel.

translated_text: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.
original_text: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.

translated_text: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.
original_text: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.

translated_text:
There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses,
so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
original_text:
There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses,
so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

translated_text: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.
original_text: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.

translated_text:
Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it
to the right hand or
to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.
original_text:
Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it
to the right hand or
to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.

translated_text: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
original_text: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

translated_text:
Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God
is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
original_text:
Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God
is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

translated_text: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,
original_text: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

translated_text: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the LORD your God giveth you to possess it.
original_text: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the LORD your God giveth you to possess it.

translated_text: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,
original_text: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,

translated_text: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, The LORD your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.
original_text: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, The LORD your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.

translated_text: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;
original_text: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;

translated_text:
Until the LORD have given your brethren rest, as
he hath given
 you, and they also have possessed the land which the LORD your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD’S servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.
original_text:
Until the LORD have given your brethren rest, as
he hath given
 you, and they also have possessed the land which the LORD your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD’S servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.

translated_text: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.
original_text: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.

translated_text: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the LORD thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.
original_text: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the LORD thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.

translated_text:
Whosoever
he be that doth rebel against thy commandment, and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.
original_text:
Whosoever
he be that doth rebel against thy commandment, and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,
original_text: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,

translated_text: Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,
original_text: Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,

translated_text: And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.
original_text: And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.

translated_text: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:
original_text: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:

translated_text: And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of the LORD your God into the midst of Jordan, and take ye up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel:
original_text: And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of the LORD your God into the midst of Jordan, and take ye up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel:

translated_text:
That this may be a sign among you,
that when your children ask
their fathers in time to come, saying, What
mean ye by these stones?
original_text:
That this may be a sign among you,
that when your children ask
their fathers in time to come, saying, What
mean ye by these stones?

translated_text: Then ye shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD; when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.
original_text: Then ye shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD; when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.

translated_text: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as the LORD spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.
original_text: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as the LORD spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.

translated_text: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.
original_text: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.

translated_text: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until every thing was finished that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.
original_text: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until every thing was finished that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the LORD passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.
original_text: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the LORD passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.

translated_text: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spake unto them:
original_text: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spake unto them:

translated_text: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the LORD unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.
original_text: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the LORD unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.

translated_text: On that day the LORD magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.
original_text: On that day the LORD magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,

translated_text: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.
original_text: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.

translated_text: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come ye up out of Jordan.
original_text: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come ye up out of Jordan.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD were come up out of the midst of Jordan,
and the soles of the priests’ feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as
they did before.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD were come up out of the midst of Jordan,
and the soles of the priests’ feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as
they did before.

translated_text:
And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth
day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.
original_text:
And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth
day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.

translated_text: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.
original_text: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.

translated_text:
And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What
mean these stones?
original_text:
And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What
mean these stones?

translated_text: Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.
original_text: Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

translated_text: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until ye were passed over, as the LORD your God did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:
original_text: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until ye were passed over, as the LORD your God did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:

translated_text:
That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the LORD, that it
is mighty: that ye might fear the LORD your God for ever.
original_text:
That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the LORD, that it
is mighty: that ye might fear the LORD your God for ever.

translated_text: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.
original_text: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.

translated_text: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;
original_text: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;

translated_text: And they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.
original_text: And they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.

translated_text:
Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this
way heretofore.
original_text:
Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this
way heretofore.

translated_text: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.
original_text: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.

translated_text: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.
original_text: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee.
original_text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee.

translated_text: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, ye shall stand still in Jordan.
original_text: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, ye shall stand still in Jordan.

translated_text: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, Come hither, and hear the words of the LORD your God.
original_text: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, Come hither, and hear the words of the LORD your God.

translated_text:
And Joshua said, Hereby ye shall know that the living God
is
 among you, and
that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.
original_text:
And Joshua said, Hereby ye shall know that the living God
is
 among you, and
that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.

translated_text: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan.
original_text: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan.

translated_text: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.
original_text: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the LORD, the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan,
that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off
from the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the LORD, the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan,
that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off
from the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;
original_text: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;

translated_text: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water, (for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest,)
original_text: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water, (for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest,)

translated_text:
That the waters which came down from above stood
and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that
is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain,
even the salt sea, failed,
and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.
original_text:
That the waters which came down from above stood
and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that
is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain,
even the salt sea, failed,
and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.

translated_text: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.
original_text: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.

translated_text: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.
original_text: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.

translated_text:
And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you?
Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abi-ezer?
original_text:
And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you?
Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abi-ezer?

translated_text: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.
original_text: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.

translated_text:
And Gideon came to Jordan,
and passed over, he, and the three hundred men that
were with him, faint, yet pursuing
them.
original_text:
And Gideon came to Jordan,
and passed over, he, and the three hundred men that
were with him, faint, yet pursuing
them.

translated_text:
And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they
be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.
original_text:
And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they
be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.

translated_text:
And the princes of Succoth said,
Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?
original_text:
And the princes of Succoth said,
Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?

translated_text: And Gideon said, Therefore when the LORD hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.
original_text: And Gideon said, Therefore when the LORD hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.

translated_text:
And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered
him.
original_text:
And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered
him.

translated_text: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.
original_text: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.

translated_text:
Now Zebah and Zalmunna
were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand
men, all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.
original_text:
Now Zebah and Zalmunna
were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand
men, all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.

translated_text: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.
original_text: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.

translated_text: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.
original_text: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.

translated_text:
And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun
was up,
original_text:
And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun
was up,

translated_text:
And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof,
even threescore and seventeen men.
original_text:
And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof,
even threescore and seventeen men.

translated_text:
And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying,
Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men
that are weary?
original_text:
And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying,
Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men
that are weary?

translated_text: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
original_text: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.

translated_text: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.
original_text: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.

translated_text:
Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men
were they
 whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou
art, so
were they; each one resembled the children of a king.
original_text:
Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men
were they
 whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou
art, so
were they; each one resembled the children of a king.

translated_text:
And he said, They
were my brethren,
even the sons of my mother:
as the LORD liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.
original_text:
And he said, They
were my brethren,
even the sons of my mother:
as the LORD liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.

translated_text:
And he said unto Jether his firstborn, Up,
and slay them. But the youth drew not his sword: for he feared, because he
was yet a youth.
original_text:
And he said unto Jether his firstborn, Up,
and slay them. But the youth drew not his sword: for he feared, because he
was yet a youth.

translated_text:
Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man
is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that
were on their camels’ necks.
original_text:
Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man
is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that
were on their camels’ necks.

translated_text: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.
