original_text: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim:

translated_text:
And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that
were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the LORD to anger.
original_text:
And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that
were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the LORD to anger.

translated_text: And they forsook the LORD, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.
original_text: And they forsook the LORD, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.

translated_text: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.
original_text: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.

translated_text: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the LORD was against them for evil, as the LORD had said, and as the LORD had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.
original_text: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the LORD was against them for evil, as the LORD had said, and as the LORD had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.

translated_text: Nevertheless the LORD raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.
original_text: Nevertheless the LORD raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.

translated_text:
And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the LORD;
but they did not so.
original_text:
And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the LORD;
but they did not so.

translated_text: And when the LORD raised them up judges, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the LORD because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.
original_text: And when the LORD raised them up judges, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the LORD because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when the judge was dead,
that they returned, and corrupted
themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when the judge was dead,
that they returned, and corrupted
themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.

translated_text: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;
original_text: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;

translated_text: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:
original_text: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:

translated_text:
That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the LORD to walk therein, as their fathers did keep
it, or not.
original_text:
That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the LORD to walk therein, as their fathers did keep
it, or not.

translated_text: Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.
original_text: Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.

translated_text: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?
original_text: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?

translated_text: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.
original_text: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.

translated_text: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.
original_text: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.

translated_text: And Judah went up; and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.
original_text: And Judah went up; and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.

translated_text: And they found Adoni-bezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
original_text: And they found Adoni-bezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

translated_text: But Adoni-bezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
original_text: But Adoni-bezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.

translated_text:
And Adoni-bezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered
their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.
original_text:
And Adoni-bezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered
their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.

translated_text: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
original_text: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

translated_text: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.
original_text: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.

translated_text:
And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before
was Kirjath-arba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.
original_text:
And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before
was Kirjath-arba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.

translated_text:
And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before
was Kirjath-sepher:
original_text:
And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before
was Kirjath-sepher:

translated_text: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
original_text: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

translated_text: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
original_text: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when she came
to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off
her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?
original_text:
And it came to pass, when she came
to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off
her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?

translated_text: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.
original_text: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.

translated_text:
And the children of the Kenite, Moses’ father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which
lieth in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.
original_text:
And the children of the Kenite, Moses’ father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which
lieth in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.

translated_text: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.
original_text: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.

translated_text: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.
original_text: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.

translated_text:
And the LORD was with Judah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out
the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
original_text:
And the LORD was with Judah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out
the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

translated_text: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.
original_text: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.

translated_text: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.
original_text: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.

translated_text:
And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the LORD
was with them.
original_text:
And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the LORD
was with them.

translated_text:
And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before
was Luz.)
original_text:
And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before
was Luz.)

translated_text: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.
original_text: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.

translated_text: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.
original_text: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.

translated_text:
And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which
is the name thereof unto this day.
original_text:
And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which
is the name thereof unto this day.

translated_text:
Neither did Manasseh drive out
the inhabitants of Beth-shean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
original_text:
Neither did Manasseh drive out
the inhabitants of Beth-shean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.
original_text: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.

translated_text: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.
original_text: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.

translated_text: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.
original_text: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.

translated_text: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:
original_text: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:

translated_text: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.
original_text: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.

translated_text: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth-anath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and of Beth-anath became tributaries unto them.
original_text: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth-anath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and of Beth-anath became tributaries unto them.

translated_text: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:
original_text: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:

translated_text: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.
original_text: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.

translated_text:
And the coast of the Amorites
was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
original_text:
And the coast of the Amorites
was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

translated_text: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.
original_text: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.

translated_text: And the people came to the house of God, and abode there till even before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept sore;
original_text: And the people came to the house of God, and abode there till even before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept sore;

translated_text: And said, O LORD God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel?
original_text: And said, O LORD God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel?

translated_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
original_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

translated_text:
And the children of Israel said, Who
is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the LORD? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the LORD to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.
original_text:
And the children of Israel said, Who
is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the LORD? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the LORD to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.

translated_text: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.
original_text: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.

translated_text: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?
original_text: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?

translated_text:
And they said, What one
is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpeh to the LORD? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.
original_text:
And they said, What one
is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpeh to the LORD? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.

translated_text:
For the people were numbered, and, behold,
there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead there.
original_text:
For the people were numbered, and, behold,
there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead there.

translated_text: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the children.
original_text: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the children.

translated_text:
And this
is the thing that ye shall do, Ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.
original_text:
And this
is the thing that ye shall do, Ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.

translated_text: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
original_text: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

translated_text:
And the whole congregation sent
some to speak to the children of Benjamin that
were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably unto them.
original_text:
And the whole congregation sent
some to speak to the children of Benjamin that
were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably unto them.

translated_text: And Benjamin came again at that time; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh-gilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.
original_text: And Benjamin came again at that time; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh-gilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.

translated_text: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
original_text: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.

translated_text: Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?
original_text: Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?

translated_text:
And they said,
There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel.
original_text:
And they said,
There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel.

translated_text:
Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters: for the children of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed
be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin.
original_text:
Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters: for the children of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed
be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin.

translated_text:
Then they said, Behold,
there is a feast of the LORD in Shiloh yearly
in a place which
is on the north side of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.
original_text:
Then they said, Behold,
there is a feast of the LORD in Shiloh yearly
in a place which
is on the north side of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.

translated_text: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;
original_text: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;

translated_text: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
original_text: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

translated_text:
And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain, that we will say unto them, Be favourable unto them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for ye did not give unto them at this time,
that ye should be guilty.
original_text:
And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain, that we will say unto them, Be favourable unto them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for ye did not give unto them at this time,
that ye should be guilty.

translated_text:
And the children of Benjamin did so, and took
them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.
original_text:
And the children of Benjamin did so, and took
them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.

translated_text: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.
original_text: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.

translated_text:
In those days
there was no king in Israel: every man did
that which was right in his own eyes.
original_text:
In those days
there was no king in Israel: every man did
that which was right in his own eyes.

translated_text: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, with the land of Gilead, unto the LORD in Mizpeh.
original_text: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, with the land of Gilead, unto the LORD in Mizpeh.

translated_text:
And the chief of all the people,
even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.
original_text:
And the chief of all the people,
even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.

translated_text:
(Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpeh.) Then said the children of Israel, Tell
us, how was this wickedness?
original_text:
(Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpeh.) Then said the children of Israel, Tell
us, how was this wickedness?

translated_text:
And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah that
belongeth to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.
original_text:
And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah that
belongeth to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.

translated_text:
And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round about upon me by night,
and thought to have slain me: and my concubine have they forced, that she is dead.
original_text:
And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round about upon me by night,
and thought to have slain me: and my concubine have they forced, that she is dead.

translated_text: And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel: for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.
original_text: And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel: for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.

translated_text:
Behold, ye
are all children of Israel; give here your advice and counsel.
original_text:
Behold, ye
are all children of Israel; give here your advice and counsel.

translated_text:
And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any
of us
 go to his tent, neither will we any
of us turn into his house.
original_text:
And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any
of us
 go to his tent, neither will we any
of us turn into his house.

translated_text: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch victual for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel.
original_text: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch victual for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel.

translated_text: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.
original_text: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.

translated_text:
And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, What wickedness
is this that is done among you?
original_text:
And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, What wickedness
is this that is done among you?

translated_text:
Now therefore deliver
us the men, the children of Belial, which
are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from Israel. But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel:
original_text:
Now therefore deliver
us the men, the children of Belial, which
are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from Israel. But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel:

translated_text: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.
original_text: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.

translated_text: And the children of Benjamin were numbered at that time out of the cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, beside the inhabitants of Gibeah, which were numbered seven hundred chosen men.
original_text: And the children of Benjamin were numbered at that time out of the cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, beside the inhabitants of Gibeah, which were numbered seven hundred chosen men.

translated_text:
Among all this people
there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair
breadth, and not miss.
original_text:
Among all this people
there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair
breadth, and not miss.

translated_text:
And the men of Israel, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these
were men of war.
original_text:
And the men of Israel, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these
were men of war.

translated_text:
And the children of Israel arose, and went up to the house of God, and asked counsel of God, and said, Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin? And the LORD said, Judah
shall go up
 first.
original_text:
And the children of Israel arose, and went up to the house of God, and asked counsel of God, and said, Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin? And the LORD said, Judah
shall go up
 first.

translated_text: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.
original_text: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.

translated_text: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.
original_text: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.

translated_text: And the children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah, and destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites that day twenty and two thousand men.
original_text: And the children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah, and destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites that day twenty and two thousand men.

translated_text: And the people the men of Israel encouraged themselves, and set their battle again in array in the place where they put themselves in array the first day.
original_text: And the people the men of Israel encouraged themselves, and set their battle again in array in the place where they put themselves in array the first day.

translated_text: (And the children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until even, and asked counsel of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the LORD said, Go up against him.)
original_text: (And the children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until even, and asked counsel of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the LORD said, Go up against him.)

translated_text: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.
original_text: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.

translated_text: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.
original_text: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.

translated_text: Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and came unto the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the LORD, and fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.
original_text: Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and came unto the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the LORD, and fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

translated_text:
And the children of Israel enquired of the LORD, (for the ark of the covenant of God
was there in those days,
original_text:
And the children of Israel enquired of the LORD, (for the ark of the covenant of God
was there in those days,

translated_text: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And the LORD said, Go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand.
original_text: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And the LORD said, Go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand.

translated_text: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.
original_text: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.

translated_text: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.
original_text: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

translated_text:
And the children of Benjamin went out against the people,
and
 were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people,
and kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goeth up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Israel.
original_text:
And the children of Benjamin went out against the people,
and
 were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people,
and kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goeth up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Israel.

translated_text:
And the children of Benjamin said, They
are smitten down before us, as at the first. But the children of Israel said, Let us flee, and draw them from the city unto the highways.
original_text:
And the children of Benjamin said, They
are smitten down before us, as at the first. But the children of Israel said, Let us flee, and draw them from the city unto the highways.

translated_text:
And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baal-tamar: and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places,
even out of the meadows of Gibeah.
original_text:
And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baal-tamar: and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places,
even out of the meadows of Gibeah.

translated_text:
And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil
was near them.
original_text:
And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil
was near them.

translated_text: And the LORD smote Benjamin before Israel: and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men: all these drew the sword.
original_text: And the LORD smote Benjamin before Israel: and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men: all these drew the sword.

translated_text: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten: for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites, because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah.
original_text: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten: for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites, because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah.

translated_text:
And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew
themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.
original_text:
And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew
themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.

translated_text: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait, that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city.
original_text: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait, that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city.

translated_text:
And when the men of Israel retired in the battle, Benjamin began to smite
and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons: for they said, Surely they are smitten down before us, as
in the first battle.
original_text:
And when the men of Israel retired in the battle, Benjamin began to smite
and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons: for they said, Surely they are smitten down before us, as
in the first battle.

translated_text: But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the flame of the city ascended up to heaven.
original_text: But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the flame of the city ascended up to heaven.

translated_text: And when the men of Israel turned again, the men of Benjamin were amazed: for they saw that evil was come upon them.
original_text: And when the men of Israel turned again, the men of Benjamin were amazed: for they saw that evil was come upon them.

translated_text:
Therefore they turned
their backs before the men of Israel unto the way of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them; and them which
came out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.
original_text:
Therefore they turned
their backs before the men of Israel unto the way of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them; and them which
came out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.

translated_text:
Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about,
and
 chased them,
and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.
original_text:
Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about,
and
 chased them,
and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.

translated_text:
And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these
were
 men of valour.
original_text:
And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these
were
 men of valour.

translated_text: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon: and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom, and slew two thousand men of them.
original_text: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon: and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom, and slew two thousand men of them.

translated_text:
So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these
were men of valour.
original_text:
So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these
were men of valour.

translated_text: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon, and abode in the rock Rimmon four months.
original_text: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon, and abode in the rock Rimmon four months.

translated_text:
And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword, as well the men of
every
 city, as the beast, and all that came to hand: also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.
original_text:
And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword, as well the men of
every
 city, as the beast, and all that came to hand: also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.

translated_text: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.
original_text: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.

translated_text: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.
original_text: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.

translated_text:
Then his father and his mother said unto him,
Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.
original_text:
Then his father and his mother said unto him,
Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.

translated_text:
But his father and his mother knew not that it
was of the LORD, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.
original_text:
But his father and his mother knew not that it
was of the LORD, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.

translated_text: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto the children of Israel,
Did not
I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
original_text:
And the LORD said unto the children of Israel,
Did not
I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

translated_text: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.
original_text: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.

translated_text: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.
original_text: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.

translated_text: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.
original_text: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.

translated_text: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.
original_text: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.

translated_text: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
original_text: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

translated_text: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.
original_text: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.

translated_text:
And the people
and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man
is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
original_text:
And the people
and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man
is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

translated_text:
Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he
was
 the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.
original_text:
Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he
was
 the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.

translated_text:
And Gilead’s wife bare him sons; and his wife’s sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father’s house; for thou
art the son of a strange woman.
original_text:
And Gilead’s wife bare him sons; and his wife’s sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father’s house; for thou
art the son of a strange woman.

translated_text: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.
original_text: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.

translated_text: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
original_text: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.

translated_text: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:
original_text: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:

translated_text: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.
original_text: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.

translated_text: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father’s house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?
original_text: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father’s house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?

translated_text: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
original_text: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

translated_text: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, shall I be your head?
original_text: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, shall I be your head?

translated_text: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The LORD be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.
original_text: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The LORD be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.

translated_text: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.
original_text: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.

translated_text: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?
original_text: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?

translated_text:
And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those
lands again peaceably.
original_text:
And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those
lands again peaceably.

translated_text: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:
original_text: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:

translated_text: And said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:
original_text: And said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:

translated_text: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;
original_text: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;

translated_text:
Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken
thereto. And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not
consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.
original_text:
Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken
thereto. And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not
consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.

translated_text:
Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon
was the border of Moab.
original_text:
Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon
was the border of Moab.

translated_text: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.
original_text: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.

translated_text: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
original_text: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

translated_text: And the LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
original_text: And the LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.

translated_text: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.
original_text: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.

translated_text: So now the LORD God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?
original_text: So now the LORD God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?

translated_text: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.
original_text: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.

translated_text:
And now
art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,
original_text:
And now
art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,

translated_text:
While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that
be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover
them within that time?
original_text:
While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that
be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover
them within that time?

translated_text: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the LORD the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.
original_text: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the LORD the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.

translated_text: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.
original_text: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

translated_text:
Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over
unto the children of Ammon.
original_text:
Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over
unto the children of Ammon.

translated_text: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,
original_text: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,

translated_text: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD’S, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.
original_text: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD’S, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.

translated_text: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hands.
original_text: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hands.

translated_text:
And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith,
even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
original_text:
And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith,
even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

translated_text:
And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she
was his
 only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.
original_text:
And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she
was his
 only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD, and I cannot go back.
original_text: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD, and I cannot go back.

translated_text: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.
original_text: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.

translated_text:
And he said, Go. And he sent her away
for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.
original_text:
And he said, Go. And he sent her away
for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.

translated_text:
And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her
according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,
original_text:
And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her
according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,

translated_text: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.
original_text: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.

translated_text:
In those days
there was no king in Israel: and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in; for unto that day
all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel.
original_text:
In those days
there was no king in Israel: and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in; for unto that day
all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel.

translated_text: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts, men of valour, from Zorah, and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land, and to search it; and they said unto them, Go, search the land: who when they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged there.
original_text: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts, men of valour, from Zorah, and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land, and to search it; and they said unto them, Go, search the land: who when they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged there.

translated_text:
When they
were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite: and they turned in thither, and said unto him, Who brought thee hither? and what makest thou in this
place? and what hast thou here?
original_text:
When they
were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite: and they turned in thither, and said unto him, Who brought thee hither? and what makest thou in this
place? and what hast thou here?

translated_text: And he said unto them, Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me, and hath hired me, and I am his priest.
original_text: And he said unto them, Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me, and hath hired me, and I am his priest.

translated_text: And they said unto him, Ask counsel, we pray thee, of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.
original_text: And they said unto him, Ask counsel, we pray thee, of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.

translated_text: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.
original_text: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.

translated_text:
Then the five men departed, and came to Laish, and saw the people that
were therein, how they dwelt careless, after the manner of the Zidonians, quiet and secure; and
there was no magistrate in the land, that might put
them to shame in
any thing; and they
were far from the Zidonians, and had no business with
any
 man.
original_text:
Then the five men departed, and came to Laish, and saw the people that
were therein, how they dwelt careless, after the manner of the Zidonians, quiet and secure; and
there was no magistrate in the land, that might put
them to shame in
any thing; and they
were far from the Zidonians, and had no business with
any
 man.

translated_text:
And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol: and their brethren said unto them, What
say ye?
original_text:
And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol: and their brethren said unto them, What
say ye?

translated_text:
And they said, Arise, that we may go up against them: for we have seen the land, and, behold, it
is very good: and
are ye still? be not slothful to go,
and to enter to possess the land.
original_text:
And they said, Arise, that we may go up against them: for we have seen the land, and, behold, it
is very good: and
are ye still? be not slothful to go,
and to enter to possess the land.

translated_text:
When ye go, ye shall come unto a people secure, and to a large land: for God hath given it into your hands; a place where
there is no want of any thing that
is in the earth.
original_text:
When ye go, ye shall come unto a people secure, and to a large land: for God hath given it into your hands; a place where
there is no want of any thing that
is in the earth.

translated_text: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.
original_text: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.

translated_text:
And they went up, and pitched in Kirjath-jearim, in Judah: wherefore they called that place Mahaneh-dan unto this day: behold,
it is
 behind Kirjath-jearim.
original_text:
And they went up, and pitched in Kirjath-jearim, in Judah: wherefore they called that place Mahaneh-dan unto this day: behold,
it is
 behind Kirjath-jearim.

translated_text: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.
original_text: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.

translated_text: Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of Laish, and said unto their brethren, Do ye know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a graven image, and a molten image? now therefore consider what ye have to do.
original_text: Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of Laish, and said unto their brethren, Do ye know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a graven image, and a molten image? now therefore consider what ye have to do.

translated_text:
And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young man the Levite,
even unto the house of Micah, and saluted him.
original_text:
And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young man the Levite,
even unto the house of Micah, and saluted him.

translated_text:
And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, which
were of the children of Dan, stood by the entering of the gate.
original_text:
And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, which
were of the children of Dan, stood by the entering of the gate.

translated_text:
And the five men that went to spy out the land went up,
and
 came in thither,
and took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men
that were appointed with weapons of war.
original_text:
And the five men that went to spy out the land went up,
and
 came in thither,
and took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men
that were appointed with weapons of war.

translated_text: And these went into Micah’s house, and fetched the carved image, the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image. Then said the priest unto them, What do ye?
original_text: And these went into Micah’s house, and fetched the carved image, the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image. Then said the priest unto them, What do ye?

translated_text:
And they said unto him, Hold thy peace, lay thine hand upon thy mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest:
is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel?
original_text:
And they said unto him, Hold thy peace, lay thine hand upon thy mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest:
is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel?

translated_text: And the priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.
original_text: And the priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.

translated_text: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them.
original_text: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them.

translated_text:
And when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that
were in the houses near to Micah’s house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.
original_text:
And when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that
were in the houses near to Micah’s house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.

translated_text: And they cried unto the children of Dan. And they turned their faces, and said unto Micah, What aileth thee, that thou comest with such a company?
original_text: And they cried unto the children of Dan. And they turned their faces, and said unto Micah, What aileth thee, that thou comest with such a company?

translated_text:
And he said, Ye have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and ye are gone away: and what have I more? and what
is this
that ye say unto me, What aileth thee?
original_text:
And he said, Ye have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and ye are gone away: and what have I more? and what
is this
that ye say unto me, What aileth thee?

translated_text: And the children of Dan said unto him, Let not thy voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows run upon thee, and thou lose thy life, with the lives of thy household.
original_text: And the children of Dan said unto him, Let not thy voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows run upon thee, and thou lose thy life, with the lives of thy household.

translated_text:
And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that they
were too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house.
original_text:
And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that they
were too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house.

translated_text:
And they took
the things which Micah had made, and the priest which he had, and came unto Laish, unto a people
that were at quiet and secure: and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire.
original_text:
And they took
the things which Micah had made, and the priest which he had, and came unto Laish, unto a people
that were at quiet and secure: and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire.

translated_text:
And
there was no deliverer, because it
was far from Zidon, and they had no business with
any man; and it was in the valley that
lieth by Beth-rehob. And they built a city, and dwelt therein.
original_text:
And
there was no deliverer, because it
was far from Zidon, and they had no business with
any man; and it was in the valley that
lieth by Beth-rehob. And they built a city, and dwelt therein.

translated_text:
And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born unto Israel: howbeit the name of the city
was
 Laish at the first.
original_text:
And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born unto Israel: howbeit the name of the city
was
 Laish at the first.

translated_text: And the children of Dan set up the graven image: and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.
original_text: And the children of Dan set up the graven image: and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.

translated_text: And they set them up Micah’s graven image, which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.
original_text: And they set them up Micah’s graven image, which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in those days, when
there was no king in Israel, that there was a certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount Ephraim, who took to him a concubine out of Bethlehemjudah.
original_text:
And it came to pass in those days, when
there was no king in Israel, that there was a certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount Ephraim, who took to him a concubine out of Bethlehemjudah.

translated_text: And his concubine played the whore against him, and went away from him unto her father’s house to Bethlehemjudah, and was there four whole months.
original_text: And his concubine played the whore against him, and went away from him unto her father’s house to Bethlehemjudah, and was there four whole months.

translated_text:
And her husband arose, and went after her, to speak friendly unto her,
and to bring her again, having his servant with him, and a couple of asses: and she brought him into her father’s house: and when the father of the damsel saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.
original_text:
And her husband arose, and went after her, to speak friendly unto her,
and to bring her again, having his servant with him, and a couple of asses: and she brought him into her father’s house: and when the father of the damsel saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

translated_text: And his father in law, the damsel’s father, retained him; and he abode with him three days: so they did eat and drink, and lodged there.
original_text: And his father in law, the damsel’s father, retained him; and he abode with him three days: so they did eat and drink, and lodged there.

translated_text: And it came to pass on the fourth day, when they arose early in the morning, that he rose up to depart: and the damsel’s father said unto his son in law, Comfort thine heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward go your way.
