Then said Boaz, What day thou buyest the field of the hand of Naomi, thou must buy
it also of Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.

translated_text:
And the kinsman said, I cannot redeem
it for myself, lest I mar mine own inheritance: redeem thou my right to thyself; for I cannot redeem it.
original_text:
And the kinsman said, I cannot redeem
it for myself, lest I mar mine own inheritance: redeem thou my right to thyself; for I cannot redeem it.

translated_text:
Now this
was the manner in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning changing, for to confirm all things; a man plucked off his shoe, and gave
it to his neighbour: and this
was
 a testimony in Israel.
original_text:
Now this
was the manner in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning changing, for to confirm all things; a man plucked off his shoe, and gave
it to his neighbour: and this
was
 a testimony in Israel.

translated_text:
Therefore the kinsman said unto Boaz, Buy
it for thee. So he drew off his shoe.
original_text:
Therefore the kinsman said unto Boaz, Buy
it for thee. So he drew off his shoe.

translated_text:
And Boaz said unto the elders, and
unto all the people, Ye
are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that
was
 Elimelech’s, and all that
was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, of the hand of Naomi.
original_text:
And Boaz said unto the elders, and
unto all the people, Ye
are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that
was
 Elimelech’s, and all that
was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, of the hand of Naomi.

translated_text:
Moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place: ye
are witnesses this day.
original_text:
Moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place: ye
are witnesses this day.

translated_text:
And all the people that
were in the gate, and the elders, said,
We are witnesses. The LORD make the woman that is come into thine house like Rachel and like Leah, which two did build the house of Israel: and do thou worthily in Ephratah, and be famous in Bethlehem:
original_text:
And all the people that
were in the gate, and the elders, said,
We are witnesses. The LORD make the woman that is come into thine house like Rachel and like Leah, which two did build the house of Israel: and do thou worthily in Ephratah, and be famous in Bethlehem:

translated_text: And let thy house be like the house of Pharez, whom Tamar bare unto Judah, of the seed which the LORD shall give thee of this young woman.
original_text: And let thy house be like the house of Pharez, whom Tamar bare unto Judah, of the seed which the LORD shall give thee of this young woman.

translated_text: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife: and when he went in unto her, the LORD gave her conception, and she bare a son.
original_text: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife: and when he went in unto her, the LORD gave her conception, and she bare a son.

translated_text:
And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed
be the LORD, which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Israel.
original_text:
And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed
be the LORD, which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Israel.

translated_text:
And he shall be unto thee a restorer of
thy life, and a nourisher of thine old age: for thy daughter in law, which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons, hath born him.
original_text:
And he shall be unto thee a restorer of
thy life, and a nourisher of thine old age: for thy daughter in law, which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons, hath born him.

translated_text: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.
original_text: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.

translated_text:
And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he
is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
original_text:
And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he
is the father of Jesse, the father of David.

translated_text:
Now these
are the generations of Pharez: Pharez begat Hezron,
original_text:
Now these
are the generations of Pharez: Pharez begat Hezron,

translated_text: And Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab,
original_text: And Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab,

translated_text: And Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,
original_text: And Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,

translated_text: And Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed,
original_text: And Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed,

translated_text: And Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.
original_text: And Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.

translated_text: Then Naomi her mother in law said unto her, My daughter, shall I not seek rest for thee, that it may be well with thee?
original_text: Then Naomi her mother in law said unto her, My daughter, shall I not seek rest for thee, that it may be well with thee?

translated_text:
And now
is not Boaz of our kindred, with whose maidens thou wast? Behold, he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor.
original_text:
And now
is not Boaz of our kindred, with whose maidens thou wast? Behold, he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor.

translated_text:
Wash thyself therefore, and anoint thee, and put thy raiment upon thee, and get thee down to the floor:
but make not thyself known unto the man, until he shall have done eating and drinking.
original_text:
Wash thyself therefore, and anoint thee, and put thy raiment upon thee, and get thee down to the floor:
but make not thyself known unto the man, until he shall have done eating and drinking.

translated_text: And it shall be, when he lieth down, that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie, and thou shalt go in, and uncover his feet, and lay thee down; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do.
original_text: And it shall be, when he lieth down, that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie, and thou shalt go in, and uncover his feet, and lay thee down; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do.

translated_text: And she said unto her, All that thou sayest unto me I will do.
original_text: And she said unto her, All that thou sayest unto me I will do.

translated_text: And she went down unto the floor, and did according to all that her mother in law bade her.
original_text: And she went down unto the floor, and did according to all that her mother in law bade her.

translated_text: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn: and she came softly, and uncovered his feet, and laid her down.
original_text: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn: and she came softly, and uncovered his feet, and laid her down.

translated_text: And it came to pass at midnight, that the man was afraid, and turned himself: and, behold, a woman lay at his feet.
original_text: And it came to pass at midnight, that the man was afraid, and turned himself: and, behold, a woman lay at his feet.

translated_text:
And he said, Who
art thou? And she answered, I
am
 Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid; for thou
art a near kinsman.
original_text:
And he said, Who
art thou? And she answered, I
am
 Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid; for thou
art a near kinsman.

translated_text:
And he said, Blessed
be thou of the LORD, my daughter:
for thou hast shewed more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, inasmuch as thou followedst not young men, whether poor or rich.
original_text:
And he said, Blessed
be thou of the LORD, my daughter:
for thou hast shewed more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, inasmuch as thou followedst not young men, whether poor or rich.

translated_text:
And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou
art
 a virtuous woman.
original_text:
And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou
art
 a virtuous woman.

translated_text:
And now it is true that I
am thy near kinsman: howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I.
original_text:
And now it is true that I
am thy near kinsman: howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I.

translated_text:
Tarry this night, and it shall be in the morning,
that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman, well; let him do the kinsman’s part: but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee, then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee,
as the LORD liveth: lie down until the morning.
original_text:
Tarry this night, and it shall be in the morning,
that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman, well; let him do the kinsman’s part: but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee, then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee,
as the LORD liveth: lie down until the morning.

translated_text: And she lay at his feet until the morning: and she rose up before one could know another. And he said, Let it not be known that a woman came into the floor.
original_text: And she lay at his feet until the morning: and she rose up before one could know another. And he said, Let it not be known that a woman came into the floor.

translated_text:
Also he said, Bring the vail that
thou hast upon thee, and hold it. And when she held it, he measured six
measures of barley, and laid
it on her: and she went into the city.
original_text:
Also he said, Bring the vail that
thou hast upon thee, and hold it. And when she held it, he measured six
measures of barley, and laid
it on her: and she went into the city.

translated_text:
And when she came to her mother in law, she said, Who
art
 thou, my daughter? And she told her all that the man had done to her.
original_text:
And when she came to her mother in law, she said, Who
art
 thou, my daughter? And she told her all that the man had done to her.

translated_text:
And she said, These six
measures of barley gave he me; for he said to me, Go not empty unto thy mother in law.
original_text:
And she said, These six
measures of barley gave he me; for he said to me, Go not empty unto thy mother in law.

translated_text: Then said she, Sit still, my daughter, until thou know how the matter will fall: for the man will not be in rest, until he have finished the thing this day.
original_text: Then said she, Sit still, my daughter, until thou know how the matter will fall: for the man will not be in rest, until he have finished the thing this day.

translated_text:
And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech; and his name
was Boaz.
original_text:
And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech; and his name
was Boaz.

translated_text:
And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi, Let me now go to the field, and glean ears of corn after
him in whose sight I shall find grace. And she said unto her, Go, my daughter.
original_text:
And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi, Let me now go to the field, and glean ears of corn after
him in whose sight I shall find grace. And she said unto her, Go, my daughter.

translated_text:
And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field
belonging unto Boaz, who
was of the kindred of Elimelech.
original_text:
And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field
belonging unto Boaz, who
was of the kindred of Elimelech.

translated_text:
And behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said unto the reapers, The LORD
be with you. And they answered him, The LORD bless thee.
original_text:
And behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said unto the reapers, The LORD
be with you. And they answered him, The LORD bless thee.

translated_text:
Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers, Whose damsel
is this?
original_text:
Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers, Whose damsel
is this?

translated_text:
And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said, It
is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab:
original_text:
And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said, It
is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab:

translated_text: And she said, I pray you, let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves: so she came, and hath continued even from the morning until now, that she tarried a little in the house.
original_text: And she said, I pray you, let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves: so she came, and hath continued even from the morning until now, that she tarried a little in the house.

translated_text: Then said Boaz unto Ruth, Hearest thou not, my daughter? Go not to glean in another field, neither go from hence, but abide here fast by my maidens:
original_text: Then said Boaz unto Ruth, Hearest thou not, my daughter? Go not to glean in another field, neither go from hence, but abide here fast by my maidens:

translated_text:
Let thine eyes
be on the field that they do reap, and go thou after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee? and when thou art athirst, go unto the vessels, and drink of
that
 which the young men have drawn.
original_text:
Let thine eyes
be on the field that they do reap, and go thou after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee? and when thou art athirst, go unto the vessels, and drink of
that
 which the young men have drawn.

translated_text:
Then she fell on her face, and bowed herself to the ground, and said unto him, Why have I found grace in thine eyes, that thou shouldest take knowledge of me, seeing I
am a stranger?
original_text:
Then she fell on her face, and bowed herself to the ground, and said unto him, Why have I found grace in thine eyes, that thou shouldest take knowledge of me, seeing I
am a stranger?

translated_text:
And Boaz answered and said unto her, It hath fully been shewed me, all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband: and
how thou hast left thy father and thy mother, and the land of thy nativity, and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore.
original_text:
And Boaz answered and said unto her, It hath fully been shewed me, all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband: and
how thou hast left thy father and thy mother, and the land of thy nativity, and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore.

translated_text: The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel, under whose wings thou art come to trust.
original_text: The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel, under whose wings thou art come to trust.

translated_text: Then she said, Let me find favour in thy sight, my lord; for that thou hast comforted me, and for that thou hast spoken friendly unto thine handmaid, though I be not like unto one of thine handmaidens.
original_text: Then she said, Let me find favour in thy sight, my lord; for that thou hast comforted me, and for that thou hast spoken friendly unto thine handmaid, though I be not like unto one of thine handmaidens.

translated_text:
And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come thou hither, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached her parched
corn, and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.
original_text:
And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come thou hither, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached her parched
corn, and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.

translated_text: And when she was risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, Let her glean even among the sheaves, and reproach her not:
original_text: And when she was risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, Let her glean even among the sheaves, and reproach her not:

translated_text:
And let fall also
some of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave
them, that she may glean
them, and rebuke her not.
original_text:
And let fall also
some of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave
them, that she may glean
them, and rebuke her not.

translated_text: So she gleaned in the field until even, and beat out that she had gleaned: and it was about an ephah of barley.
original_text: So she gleaned in the field until even, and beat out that she had gleaned: and it was about an ephah of barley.

translated_text:
And she took
it up, and went into the city: and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned: and she brought forth, and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed.
original_text:
And she took
it up, and went into the city: and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned: and she brought forth, and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed.

translated_text:
And her mother in law said unto her, Where hast thou gleaned to day? and where wroughtest thou? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee. And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought, and said, The man’s name with whom I wrought to day
is Boaz.
original_text:
And her mother in law said unto her, Where hast thou gleaned to day? and where wroughtest thou? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee. And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought, and said, The man’s name with whom I wrought to day
is Boaz.

translated_text:
And Naomi said unto her daughter in law, Blessed
be he of the LORD, who hath not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead. And Naomi said unto her, The man
is near of kin unto us, one of our next kinsmen.
original_text:
And Naomi said unto her daughter in law, Blessed
be he of the LORD, who hath not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead. And Naomi said unto her, The man
is near of kin unto us, one of our next kinsmen.

translated_text: And Ruth the Moabitess said, He said unto me also, Thou shalt keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.
original_text: And Ruth the Moabitess said, He said unto me also, Thou shalt keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.

translated_text:
And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter in law,
It is good, my daughter, that thou go out with his maidens, that they meet thee not in any other field.
original_text:
And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter in law,
It is good, my daughter, that thou go out with his maidens, that they meet thee not in any other field.

translated_text: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and dwelt with her mother in law.
original_text: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and dwelt with her mother in law.

translated_text: Now it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Bethlehemjudah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.
original_text: Now it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Bethlehemjudah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.

translated_text:
And the name of the man
was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehemjudah. And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.
original_text:
And the name of the man
was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehemjudah. And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.

translated_text: And Elimelech Naomi’s husband died; and she was left, and her two sons.
original_text: And Elimelech Naomi’s husband died; and she was left, and her two sons.

translated_text:
And they took them wives of the women of Moab; the name of the one
was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth: and they dwelled there about ten years.
original_text:
And they took them wives of the women of Moab; the name of the one
was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth: and they dwelled there about ten years.

translated_text: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband.
original_text: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband.

translated_text: Then she arose with her daughters in law, that she might return from the country of Moab: for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the LORD had visited his people in giving them bread.
original_text: Then she arose with her daughters in law, that she might return from the country of Moab: for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the LORD had visited his people in giving them bread.

translated_text: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters in law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah.
original_text: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters in law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah.

translated_text: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law, Go, return each to her mother’s house: the LORD deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.
original_text: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law, Go, return each to her mother’s house: the LORD deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.

translated_text:
The LORD grant you that ye may find rest, each
of you in the house of her husband. Then she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.
original_text:
The LORD grant you that ye may find rest, each
of you in the house of her husband. Then she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.

translated_text: And they said unto her, Surely we will return with thee unto thy people.
original_text: And they said unto her, Surely we will return with thee unto thy people.

translated_text:
And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters: why will ye go with me?
are there yet
any more sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?
original_text:
And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters: why will ye go with me?
are there yet
any more sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?

translated_text: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown? would ye stay for them from having husbands? nay, my daughters; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the LORD is gone out against me.
original_text: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown? would ye stay for them from having husbands? nay, my daughters; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the LORD is gone out against me.

translated_text: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.
original_text: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.

translated_text: And she said, Behold, thy sister in law is gone back unto her people, and unto her gods: return thou after thy sister in law.
original_text: And she said, Behold, thy sister in law is gone back unto her people, and unto her gods: return thou after thy sister in law.

translated_text:
And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee,
or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people
shall be my people, and thy God my God:
original_text:
And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee,
or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people
shall be my people, and thy God my God:

translated_text:
Where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: the LORD do so to me, and more also,
if ought but death part thee and me.
original_text:
Where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: the LORD do so to me, and more also,
if ought but death part thee and me.

translated_text: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her, then she left speaking unto her.
original_text: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her, then she left speaking unto her.

translated_text:
So they two went until they came to Bethlehem. And it came to pass, when they were come to Bethlehem, that all the city was moved about them, and they said,
Is this Naomi?
original_text:
So they two went until they came to Bethlehem. And it came to pass, when they were come to Bethlehem, that all the city was moved about them, and they said,
Is this Naomi?

translated_text: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.
original_text: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.

translated_text:
I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again empty: why
then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?
original_text:
I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again empty: why
then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?

translated_text: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.
original_text: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
original_text: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

translated_text: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father’s house.
original_text: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father’s house.

translated_text: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.
original_text: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

translated_text:
And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that
was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.
original_text:
And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that
was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.

translated_text:
And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him,
and behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.
original_text:
And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him,
and behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.

translated_text: And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick.
original_text: And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick.

translated_text:
And the women answered
one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.
original_text:
And the women answered
one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.

translated_text:
And Saul was very wroth, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed
but thousands: and

original_text: And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took, and went, as Jesse had commanded him; and he came to the trench, as the host was going forth to the fight, and shouted for the battle.

translated_text: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army against army.
original_text: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army against army.

translated_text: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage, and ran into the army, and came and saluted his brethren.
original_text: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage, and ran into the army, and came and saluted his brethren.

translated_text:
And as he talked with them, behold, there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the armies of the Philistines, and spake according to the same words: and David heard
them.
original_text:
And as he talked with them, behold, there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the armies of the Philistines, and spake according to the same words: and David heard
them.

translated_text: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were sore afraid.
original_text: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were sore afraid.

translated_text:
And the men of Israel said, Have ye seen this man that is come up? surely to defy Israel is he come up: and it shall be,
that the man who killeth him, the king will enrich him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father’s house free in Israel.
original_text:
And the men of Israel said, Have ye seen this man that is come up? surely to defy Israel is he come up: and it shall be,
that the man who killeth him, the king will enrich him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father’s house free in Israel.

translated_text:
And David spake to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that killeth this Philistine, and taketh away the reproach from Israel? for who
is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?
original_text:
And David spake to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that killeth this Philistine, and taketh away the reproach from Israel? for who
is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?

translated_text: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that killeth him.
original_text: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that killeth him.

translated_text: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men; and Eliab’s anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why camest thou down hither? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know thy pride, and the naughtiness of thine heart; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle.
original_text: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men; and Eliab’s anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why camest thou down hither? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know thy pride, and the naughtiness of thine heart; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle.

translated_text:
And David said, What have I now done?
Is there not a cause?
original_text:
And David said, What have I now done?
Is there not a cause?

translated_text: And he turned from him toward another, and spake after the same manner: and the people answered him again after the former manner.
original_text: And he turned from him toward another, and spake after the same manner: and the people answered him again after the former manner.

translated_text:
And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed
them before Saul: and he sent for him.
original_text:
And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed
them before Saul: and he sent for him.

translated_text: And David said to Saul, Let no man’s heart fail because of him; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine.
original_text: And David said to Saul, Let no man’s heart fail because of him; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine.

translated_text:
And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou
art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.
original_text:
And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou
art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.

translated_text: And David said unto Saul, Thy servant kept his father’s sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:
original_text: And David said unto Saul, Thy servant kept his father’s sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:

translated_text:
And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered
it
 out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught
him
 by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.
original_text:
And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered
it
 out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught
him
 by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.

translated_text: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God.
original_text: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God.

translated_text: David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the LORD be with thee.
original_text: David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the LORD be with thee.

translated_text: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.
original_text: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.

translated_text:
And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved
it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved
them. And David put them off him.
original_text:
And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved
it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved
them. And David put them off him.

translated_text:
And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd’s bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling
was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.
original_text:
And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd’s bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling
was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.

translated_text:
And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield
went before him.
original_text:
And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield
went before him.

translated_text:
And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was
but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.
original_text:
And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was
but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.

translated_text:
And the Philistine said unto David,
Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
original_text:
And the Philistine said unto David,
Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.

translated_text: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field.
original_text: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field.

translated_text: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.
original_text: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.

translated_text: This day will the LORD deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee, and take thine head from thee; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.
original_text: This day will the LORD deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee, and take thine head from thee; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.

translated_text:
And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle
is the LORD’S, and he will give you into our hands.
original_text:
And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle
is the LORD’S, and he will give you into our hands.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came and drew nigh to meet David, that David hasted, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.
original_text: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came and drew nigh to meet David, that David hasted, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.

translated_text:
And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang
it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.
original_text:
And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang
it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.

translated_text:
So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but
there was no sword in the hand of David.
original_text:
So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but
there was no sword in the hand of David.

translated_text: Therefore David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of the sheath thereof, and slew him, and cut off his head therewith. And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead, they fled.
original_text: Therefore David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of the sheath thereof, and slew him, and cut off his head therewith. And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead, they fled.

translated_text: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, until thou come to the valley, and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even unto Gath, and unto Ekron.
original_text: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, until thou come to the valley, and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even unto Gath, and unto Ekron.

translated_text: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they spoiled their tents.
original_text: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they spoiled their tents.

translated_text: And David took the head of the Philistine, and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armour in his tent.
original_text: And David took the head of the Philistine, and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armour in his tent.

translated_text:
And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said unto Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose son
is this youth? And Abner said,
As thy soul liveth, O king, I cannot tell.
original_text:
And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said unto Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose son
is this youth? And Abner said,
As thy soul liveth, O king, I cannot tell.

translated_text:
And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the stripling
is.
original_text:
And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the stripling
is.

translated_text: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him, and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.
original_text: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him, and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

translated_text:
And Saul said to him, Whose son
art thou,
thou
 young man? And David answered,
I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.
original_text:
And Saul said to him, Whose son
art thou,
thou
 young man? And David answered,
I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.

translated_text:
Now it came to pass upon a day, that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over to the Philistines’ garrison, that
is on the other side. But he told not his father.
original_text:
Now it came to pass upon a day, that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over to the Philistines’ garrison, that
is on the other side. But he told not his father.

translated_text:
And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people that
were with him
were
 about six hundred men;
original_text:
And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people that
were with him
were
 about six hundred men;

translated_text: And Ahiah, the son of Ahitub, I-chabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the LORD’S priest in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. And the people knew not that Jonathan was gone.
original_text: And Ahiah, the son of Ahitub, I-chabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the LORD’S priest in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. And the people knew not that Jonathan was gone.

translated_text:
And between the passages, by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines’ garrison,
there was a sharp rock on the one side and a sharp rock on the other side: and the name of the one
was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.
original_text:
And between the passages, by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines’ garrison,
there was a sharp rock on the one side and a sharp rock on the other side: and the name of the one
was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

translated_text:
The forefront of the one
was situate northward over against Michmash, and the other southward over against Gibeah.
original_text:
The forefront of the one
was situate northward over against Michmash, and the other southward over against Gibeah.

translated_text:
And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the LORD will work for us: for
there is no restraint to the LORD to save by many or by few.
original_text:
And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the LORD will work for us: for
there is no restraint to the LORD to save by many or by few.

translated_text:
And his armourbearer said unto him, Do all that
is in thine heart: turn thee; behold, I
am with thee according to thy heart.
original_text:
And his armourbearer said unto him, Do all that
is in thine heart: turn thee; behold, I
am with thee according to thy heart.

translated_text:
Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over unto
these men, and we will discover ourselves unto them.
original_text:
Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over unto
these men, and we will discover ourselves unto them.

translated_text: If they say thus unto us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up unto them.
original_text: If they say thus unto us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up unto them.

translated_text:
But if they say thus, Come up unto us; then we will go up: for the LORD hath delivered them into our hand: and this
shall be a sign unto us.
original_text:
But if they say thus, Come up unto us; then we will go up: for the LORD hath delivered them into our hand: and this
shall be a sign unto us.

translated_text: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves.
original_text: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves.

translated_text: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer, and said, Come up to us, and we will shew you a thing. And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer, Come up after me: for the LORD hath delivered them into the hand of Israel.
original_text: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer, and said, Come up to us, and we will shew you a thing. And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer, Come up after me: for the LORD hath delivered them into the hand of Israel.

translated_text: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armourbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armourbearer slew after him.
original_text: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armourbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armourbearer slew after him.

translated_text:
And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land,
which
 a yoke
of oxen might plow.
original_text:
And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land,
which
 a yoke
of oxen might plow.

translated_text: And there was trembling in the host, in the field, and among all the people: the garrison, and the spoilers, they also trembled, and the earth quaked: so it was a very great trembling.
original_text: And there was trembling in the host, in the field, and among all the people: the garrison, and the spoilers, they also trembled, and the earth quaked: so it was a very great trembling.

translated_text:
And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and, behold, the multitude melted away, and they went on beating down
one another.
original_text:
And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and, behold, the multitude melted away, and they went on beating down
one another.

translated_text:
Then said Saul unto the people that
were with him, Number now, and see who is gone from us. And when they had numbered, behold, Jonathan and his armourbearer
were not
there.
original_text:
Then said Saul unto the people that
were with him, Number now, and see who is gone from us. And when they had numbered, behold, Jonathan and his armourbearer
were not
there.

translated_text: And Saul said unto Ahiah, Bring hither the ark of God. For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel.
original_text: And Saul said unto Ahiah, Bring hither the ark of God. For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, while Saul talked unto the priest, that the noise that
was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased: and Saul said unto the priest, Withdraw thine hand.
original_text:
And it came to pass, while Saul talked unto the priest, that the noise that
was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased: and Saul said unto the priest, Withdraw thine hand.

translated_text:
And Saul and all the people that
were with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man’s sword was against his fellow,
and there was a very great discomfiture.
original_text:
And Saul and all the people that
were with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man’s sword was against his fellow,
and there was a very great discomfiture.

translated_text:
Moreover the Hebrews
that were with the Philistines before that time, which went up with them into the camp
from the country
 round about, even they also
turned to be with the Israelites that
were with Saul and Jonathan.
original_text:
Moreover the Hebrews
that were with the Philistines before that time, which went up with them into the camp
from the country
 round about, even they also
turned to be with the Israelites that
were with Saul and Jonathan.

translated_text:
Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim,
when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.
original_text:
Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim,
when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.

translated_text: So the LORD saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over unto Beth-aven.
original_text: So the LORD saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over unto Beth-aven.

translated_text:
And the men of Israel were distressed that day: for Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed
be the man that eateth
any food until evening, that I may be avenged on mine enemies. So none of the people tasted
any food.
original_text:
And the men of Israel were distressed that day: for Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed
be the man that eateth
any food until evening, that I may be avenged on mine enemies. So none of the people tasted
any food.

translated_text:
And all
they of the land came to a wood; and there was honey upon the ground.
original_text:
And all
they of the land came to a wood; and there was honey upon the ground.

translated_text: And when the people were come into the wood, behold, the honey dropped; but no man put his hand to his mouth: for the people feared the oath.
original_text: And when the people were come into the wood, behold, the honey dropped; but no man put his hand to his mouth: for the people feared the oath.

translated_text:
But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath: wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that
was in his hand, and dipped it in an honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.
original_text:
But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath: wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that
was in his hand, and dipped it in an honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.

translated_text:
Then answered one of the people, and said, Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed
be the man that eateth
any food this day. And the people were faint.
original_text:
Then answered one of the people, and said, Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed
be the man that eateth
any food this day. And the people were faint.

translated_text: Then said Jonathan, My father hath troubled the land: see, I pray you, how mine eyes have been enlightened, because I tasted a little of this honey.
original_text: Then said Jonathan, My father hath troubled the land: see, I pray you, how mine eyes have been enlightened, because I tasted a little of this honey.

translated_text: How much more, if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?
original_text: How much more, if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?

translated_text: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon: and the people were very faint.
original_text: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon: and the people were very faint.

translated_text:
And the people flew upon the spoil, and took sheep, and oxen, and calves, and slew
them on the ground: and the people did eat
them with the blood.
original_text:
And the people flew upon the spoil, and took sheep, and oxen, and calves, and slew
them on the ground: and the people did eat
them with the blood.

translated_text: Then they told Saul, saying, Behold, the people sin against the LORD, in that they eat with the blood. And he said, Ye have transgressed: roll a great stone unto me this day.
original_text: Then they told Saul, saying, Behold, the people sin against the LORD, in that they eat with the blood. And he said, Ye have transgressed: roll a great stone unto me this day.

translated_text:
And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people, and say unto them, Bring me hither every man his ox, and every man his sheep, and slay
them here, and eat; and sin not against the LORD in eating with the blood. And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and slew
them there.
original_text:
And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people, and say unto them, Bring me hither every man his ox, and every man his sheep, and slay
them here, and eat; and sin not against the LORD in eating with the blood. And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and slew
them there.

translated_text: And Saul built an altar unto the LORD: the same was the first altar that he built unto the LORD.
original_text: And Saul built an altar unto the LORD: the same was the first altar that he built unto the LORD.

translated_text: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and spoil them until the morning light, and let us not leave a man of them. And they said, Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee. Then said the priest, Let us draw near hither unto God.
original_text: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and spoil them until the morning light, and let us not leave a man of them. And they said, Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee. Then said the priest, Let us draw near hither unto God.

translated_text: And Saul asked counsel of God, Shall I go down after the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel? But he answered him not that day.
original_text: And Saul asked counsel of God, Shall I go down after the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel? But he answered him not that day.

translated_text: And Saul said, Draw ye near hither, all the chief of the people: and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day.
original_text: And Saul said, Draw ye near hither, all the chief of the people: and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day.

translated_text:
For,
as the LORD liveth, which saveth Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die. But
there was not a man among all the people
that answered him.
original_text:
For,
as the LORD liveth, which saveth Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die. But
there was not a man among all the people
that answered him.

translated_text: Then said he unto all Israel, Be ye on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said unto Saul, Do what seemeth good unto thee.
original_text: Then said he unto all Israel, Be ye on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said unto Saul, Do what seemeth good unto thee.

translated_text:
Therefore Saul said unto the LORD God of Israel, Give a perfect
lot. And Saul and Jonathan were taken: but the people escaped.
original_text:
Therefore Saul said unto the LORD God of Israel, Give a perfect
lot. And Saul and Jonathan were taken: but the people escaped.

translated_text:
And Saul said, Cast
lots between me and Jonathan my son. And Jonathan was taken.
original_text:
And Saul said, Cast
lots between me and Jonathan my son. And Jonathan was taken.

translated_text:
Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done. And Jonathan told him, and said, I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that
was in mine hand,
and, lo, I must die.
original_text:
Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done. And Jonathan told him, and said, I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that
was in mine hand,
and, lo, I must die.

translated_text: And Saul answered, God do so and more also: for thou shalt surely die, Jonathan.
original_text: And Saul answered, God do so and more also: for thou shalt surely die, Jonathan.

translated_text:
And the people said unto Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel? God forbid:
as the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground; for he hath wrought with God this day. So the people rescued Jonathan, that he died not.
original_text:
And the people said unto Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel? God forbid:
as the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground; for he hath wrought with God this day. So the people rescued Jonathan, that he died not.

translated_text: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines: and the Philistines went to their own place.
original_text: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines: and the Philistines went to their own place.

translated_text:
So Saul took the kingdom over Israel, and fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines: and whithersoever he turned himself, he vexed
them.
original_text:
So Saul took the kingdom over Israel, and fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines: and whithersoever he turned himself, he vexed
them.

translated_text: And he gathered an host, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them.
original_text: And he gathered an host, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them.

translated_text:
Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Ishui, and Melchi-shua: and the names of his two daughters
were these; the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal:
original_text:
Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Ishui, and Melchi-shua: and the names of his two daughters
were these; the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal:

translated_text:
And the name of Saul’s wife
was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz: and the name of the captain of his host
was Abner, the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.
original_text:
And the name of Saul’s wife
was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz: and the name of the captain of his host
was Abner, the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.

translated_text:
And Kish
was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner
was the son of Abiel.
original_text:
And Kish
was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner
was the son of Abiel.

translated_text: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he took him unto him.
original_text: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he took him unto him.

translated_text:
Samuel also said unto Saul, The LORD sent me to anoint thee
to be
 king over his people, over Israel: now therefore hearken thou unto the voice of the words of the LORD.
original_text:
Samuel also said unto Saul, The LORD sent me to anoint thee
to be
 king over his people, over Israel: now therefore hearken thou unto the voice of the words of the LORD.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I remember
that which Amalek did to Israel, how he laid
wait for him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I remember
that which Amalek did to Israel, how he laid
wait for him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.

translated_text: Now go and smite Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and spare them not; but slay both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and ass.
original_text: Now go and smite Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and spare them not; but slay both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and ass.

translated_text: And Saul gathered the people together, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.
original_text: And Saul gathered the people together, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.

translated_text: And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and laid wait in the valley.
original_text: And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and laid wait in the valley.

translated_text: And Saul said unto the Kenites, Go, depart, get you down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them: for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel, when they came up out of Egypt. So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.
original_text: And Saul said unto the Kenites, Go, depart, get you down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them: for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel, when they came up out of Egypt. So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

translated_text:
And Saul smote the Amalekites from Havilah
until thou comest to Shur, that
is over against Egypt.
original_text:
And Saul smote the Amalekites from Havilah
until thou comest to Shur, that
is over against Egypt.

translated_text: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.
original_text: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

translated_text:
But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, and of the oxen, and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all
that was
 good, and would not utterly destroy them: but every thing
that was
 vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.
original_text:
But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, and of the oxen, and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all
that was
 good, and would not utterly destroy them: but every thing
that was
 vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.

translated_text: Then came the word of the LORD unto Samuel, saying,
original_text: Then came the word of the LORD unto Samuel, saying,

translated_text:
It repenteth me that I have set up Saul
to be king: for he is turned back from following me, and hath not performed my commandments. And it grieved Samuel; and he cried unto the LORD all night.
original_text:
It repenteth me that I have set up Saul
to be king: for he is turned back from following me, and hath not performed my commandments. And it grieved Samuel; and he cried unto the LORD all night.

translated_text: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, he set him up a place, and is gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.
original_text: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, he set him up a place, and is gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.

translated_text:
And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said unto him, Blessed
be
 thou of the LORD: I have performed the commandment of the LORD.
original_text:
And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said unto him, Blessed
be
 thou of the LORD: I have performed the commandment of the LORD.

translated_text:
And Samuel said, What
meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?
original_text:
And Samuel said, What
meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?

translated_text: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.
original_text: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.

translated_text: Then Samuel said unto Saul, Stay, and I will tell thee what the LORD hath said to me this night. And he said unto him, Say on.
original_text: Then Samuel said unto Saul, Stay, and I will tell thee what the LORD hath said to me this night. And he said unto him, Say on.

translated_text:
And Samuel said, When thou
wast little in thine own sight,
wast thou not
made the head of the tribes of Israel, and the LORD anointed thee king over Israel?
original_text:
And Samuel said, When thou
wast little in thine own sight,
wast thou not
made the head of the tribes of Israel, and the LORD anointed thee king over Israel?

translated_text: And the LORD sent thee on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.
original_text: And the LORD sent thee on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.

translated_text: Wherefore then didst thou not obey the voice of the LORD, but didst fly upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of the LORD?
original_text: Wherefore then didst thou not obey the voice of the LORD, but didst fly upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of the LORD?

translated_text: And Saul said unto Samuel, Yea, I have obeyed the voice of the LORD, and have gone the way which the LORD sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.
original_text: And Saul said unto Samuel, Yea, I have obeyed the voice of the LORD, and have gone the way which the LORD sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

translated_text: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God in Gilgal.
original_text: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God in Gilgal.

translated_text:
And Samuel said, Hath the LORD
as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey
is better than sacrifice,
and to hearken than the fat of rams.
original_text:
And Samuel said, Hath the LORD
as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey
is better than sacrifice,
and to hearken than the fat of rams.

translated_text:
For rebellion
is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness
is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, he hath also rejected thee from
being king.
original_text:
For rebellion
is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness
is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, he hath also rejected thee from
being king.

translated_text: And Saul said unto Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD, and thy words: because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.
original_text: And Saul said unto Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD, and thy words: because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.

translated_text: Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD.
original_text: Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD.

translated_text: And Samuel said unto Saul, I will not return with thee: for thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, and the LORD hath rejected thee from being king over Israel.
original_text: And Samuel said unto Saul, I will not return with thee: for thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, and the LORD hath rejected thee from being king over Israel.

translated_text: And as Samuel turned about to go away, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.
original_text: And as Samuel turned about to go away, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.

translated_text:
And Samuel said unto him, The LORD hath rent the kingdom of Israel from thee this day, and hath given it to a neighbour of thine,
that is
 better than thou.
original_text:
And Samuel said unto him, The LORD hath rent the kingdom of Israel from thee this day, and hath given it to a neighbour of thine,
that is
 better than thou.

translated_text:
And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent: for he
is not a man, that he should repent.
original_text:
And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent: for he
is not a man, that he should repent.

translated_text:
Then he said, I have sinned:
yet honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD thy God.
original_text:
Then he said, I have sinned:
yet honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD thy God.

translated_text: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped the LORD.
original_text: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped the LORD.

translated_text: Then said Samuel, Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him delicately. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.
original_text: Then said Samuel, Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him delicately. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.

translated_text: And Samuel said, As thy sword hath made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.
original_text: And Samuel said, As thy sword hath made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.

translated_text: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.
original_text: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

translated_text: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death: nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul: and the LORD repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.
original_text: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death: nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul: and the LORD repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.

translated_text: And Samuel said unto all Israel, Behold, I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me, and have made a king over you.
original_text: And Samuel said unto all Israel, Behold, I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me, and have made a king over you.

translated_text:
And now, behold, the king walketh before you: and I am old and grayheaded; and, behold, my sons
are with you: and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day.
original_text:
And now, behold, the king walketh before you: and I am old and grayheaded; and, behold, my sons
are with you: and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day.

translated_text:
Behold, here I
am: witness against me before the LORD, and before his anointed: whose ox have I taken? or whose ass have I taken? or whom have I defrauded? whom have I oppressed? or of whose hand have I received
any bribe to blind mine eyes therewith? and I will restore it you.
original_text:
Behold, here I
am: witness against me before the LORD, and before his anointed: whose ox have I taken? or whose ass have I taken? or whom have I defrauded? whom have I oppressed? or of whose hand have I received
any bribe to blind mine eyes therewith? and I will restore it you.

translated_text: And they said, Thou hast not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither hast thou taken ought of any man’s hand.
original_text: And they said, Thou hast not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither hast thou taken ought of any man’s hand.

translated_text:
And he said unto them, The LORD
is witness against you, and his anointed
is witness this day, that ye have not found ought in my hand. And they answered,
He is witness.
original_text:
And he said unto them, The LORD
is witness against you, and his anointed
is witness this day, that ye have not found ought in my hand. And they answered,
He is witness.

translated_text:
And Samuel said unto the people,
It is the LORD that advanced Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.
original_text:
And Samuel said unto the people,
It is the LORD that advanced Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.

translated_text: Now therefore stand still, that I may reason with you before the LORD of all the righteous acts of the LORD, which he did to you and to your fathers.
original_text: Now therefore stand still, that I may reason with you before the LORD of all the righteous acts of the LORD, which he did to you and to your fathers.

translated_text: When Jacob was come into Egypt, and your fathers cried unto the LORD, then the LORD sent Moses and Aaron, which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt, and made them dwell in this place.
original_text: When Jacob was come into Egypt, and your fathers cried unto the LORD, then the LORD sent Moses and Aaron, which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt, and made them dwell in this place.

translated_text: And when they forgat the LORD their God, he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the host of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.
original_text: And when they forgat the LORD their God, he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the host of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.

translated_text: And they cried unto the LORD, and said, We have sinned, because we have forsaken the LORD, and have served Baalim and Ashtaroth: but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve thee.
original_text: And they cried unto the LORD, and said, We have sinned, because we have forsaken the LORD, and have served Baalim and Ashtaroth: but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve thee.

translated_text: And the LORD sent Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side, and ye dwelled safe.
original_text: And the LORD sent Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side, and ye dwelled safe.

translated_text:
And when ye saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, ye said unto me, Nay; but a king shall reign over us: when the LORD your God
was your king.
original_text:
And when ye saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, ye said unto me, Nay; but a king shall reign over us: when the LORD your God
was your king.

translated_text:
Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen,
and whom ye have desired! and, behold, the LORD hath set a king over you.
original_text:
Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen,
and whom ye have desired! and, behold, the LORD hath set a king over you.

translated_text: If ye will fear the LORD, and serve him, and obey his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then shall both ye and also the king that reigneth over you continue following the LORD your God:
original_text: If ye will fear the LORD, and serve him, and obey his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then shall both ye and also the king that reigneth over you continue following the LORD your God:

translated_text:
But if ye will not obey the voice of the LORD, but rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then shall the hand of the LORD be against you, as
it was against your fathers.
original_text:
But if ye will not obey the voice of the LORD, but rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then shall the hand of the LORD be against you, as
it was against your fathers.

translated_text: Now therefore stand and see this great thing, which the LORD will do before your eyes.
original_text: Now therefore stand and see this great thing, which the LORD will do before your eyes.

translated_text:
Is it not wheat harvest to day? I will call unto the LORD, and he shall send thunder and rain; that ye may perceive and see that your wickedness
is great, which ye have done in the sight of the LORD, in asking you a king.
original_text:
Is it not wheat harvest to day? I will call unto the LORD, and he shall send thunder and rain; that ye may perceive and see that your wickedness
is great, which ye have done in the sight of the LORD, in asking you a king.

translated_text: So Samuel called unto the LORD; and the LORD sent thunder and rain that day: and all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.
original_text: So Samuel called unto the LORD; and the LORD sent thunder and rain that day: and all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.

translated_text:
And all the people said unto Samuel, Pray for thy servants unto the LORD thy God, that we die not: for we have added unto all our sins
this
 evil, to ask us a king.
original_text:
And all the people said unto Samuel, Pray for thy servants unto the LORD thy God, that we die not: for we have added unto all our sins
this
 evil, to ask us a king.
