translated_text: And Samuel said unto the people, Fear not: ye have done all this wickedness: yet turn not aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart;
original_text: And Samuel said unto the people, Fear not: ye have done all this wickedness: yet turn not aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart;

translated_text:
And turn ye not aside: for
then should ye go after vain
things, which cannot profit nor deliver; for they
are
 vain.
original_text:
And turn ye not aside: for
then should ye go after vain
things, which cannot profit nor deliver; for they
are
 vain.

translated_text: For the LORD will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake: because it hath pleased the LORD to make you his people.
original_text: For the LORD will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake: because it hath pleased the LORD to make you his people.

translated_text: Moreover as for me, God forbid that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way:
original_text: Moreover as for me, God forbid that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way:

translated_text:
Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great
things he hath done for you.
original_text:
Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great
things he hath done for you.

translated_text: But if ye shall still do wickedly, ye shall be consumed, both ye and your king.
original_text: But if ye shall still do wickedly, ye shall be consumed, both ye and your king.

translated_text: Saul reigned one year; and when he had reigned two years over Israel,
original_text: Saul reigned one year; and when he had reigned two years over Israel,

translated_text:
Saul chose him three thousand
men of Israel;
whereof
 two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.
original_text:
Saul chose him three thousand
men of Israel;
whereof
 two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.

translated_text:
And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that
was
 in Geba, and the Philistines heard
of it. And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.
original_text:
And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that
was
 in Geba, and the Philistines heard
of it. And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.

translated_text:
And all Israel heard say
that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines, and
that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines. And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal.
original_text:
And all Israel heard say
that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines, and
that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines. And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal.

translated_text:
And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which
is on the sea shore in multitude: and they came up, and pitched in Michmash, eastward from Beth-aven.
original_text:
And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which
is on the sea shore in multitude: and they came up, and pitched in Michmash, eastward from Beth-aven.

translated_text: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait, (for the people were distressed,) then the people did hide themselves in caves, and in thickets, and in rocks, and in high places, and in pits.
original_text: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait, (for the people were distressed,) then the people did hide themselves in caves, and in thickets, and in rocks, and in high places, and in pits.

translated_text:
And
some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. As for Saul, he
was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.
original_text:
And
some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. As for Saul, he
was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

translated_text:
And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel
had appointed: but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.
original_text:
And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel
had appointed: but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.

translated_text: And Saul said, Bring hither a burnt offering to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.
original_text: And Saul said, Bring hither a burnt offering to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.

translated_text: And it came to pass, that as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might salute him.
original_text: And it came to pass, that as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might salute him.

translated_text: Therefore said I, The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal, and I have not made supplication unto the LORD: I forced myself therefore, and offered a burnt offering.
original_text: Therefore said I, The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal, and I have not made supplication unto the LORD: I forced myself therefore, and offered a burnt offering.

translated_text: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly: thou hast not kept the commandment of the LORD thy God, which he commanded thee: for now would the LORD have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever.
original_text: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly: thou hast not kept the commandment of the LORD thy God, which he commanded thee: for now would the LORD have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever.

translated_text:
But now thy kingdom shall not continue: the LORD hath sought him a man after his own heart, and the LORD hath commanded him
to be captain over his people, because thou hast not kept
that which the LORD commanded thee.
original_text:
But now thy kingdom shall not continue: the LORD hath sought him a man after his own heart, and the LORD hath commanded him
to be captain over his people, because thou hast not kept
that which the LORD commanded thee.

translated_text:
And Samuel arose, and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people
that were present with him, about six hundred men.
original_text:
And Samuel arose, and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people
that were present with him, about six hundred men.

translated_text:
And Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people
that were
 present with them, abode in Gibeah of Benjamin: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.
original_text:
And Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people
that were
 present with them, abode in Gibeah of Benjamin: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.

translated_text:
And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned unto the way
that leadeth to Ophrah, unto the land of Shual:
original_text:
And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned unto the way
that leadeth to Ophrah, unto the land of Shual:

translated_text:
And another company turned the way
to Beth-horon: and another company turned
to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.
original_text:
And another company turned the way
to Beth-horon: and another company turned
to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

translated_text:
Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel: for the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make
them swords or spears:
original_text:
Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel: for the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make
them swords or spears:

translated_text: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, to sharpen every man his share, and his coulter, and his axe, and his mattock.
original_text: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, to sharpen every man his share, and his coulter, and his axe, and his mattock.

translated_text: Yet they had a file for the mattocks, and for the coulters, and for the forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the goads.
original_text: Yet they had a file for the mattocks, and for the coulters, and for the forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the goads.

translated_text:
So it came to pass in the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that
were with Saul and Jonathan: but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found.
original_text:
So it came to pass in the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that
were with Saul and Jonathan: but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found.

translated_text: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash.
original_text: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash.

translated_text:
Then Samuel took a vial of oil, and poured
it upon his head, and kissed him, and said,
Is it not because the LORD hath anointed thee
to be captain over his inheritance?
original_text:
Then Samuel took a vial of oil, and poured
it upon his head, and kissed him, and said,
Is it not because the LORD hath anointed thee
to be captain over his inheritance?

translated_text: When thou art departed from me to day, then thou shalt find two men by Rachel’s sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah; and they will say unto thee, The asses which thou wentest to seek are found: and, lo, thy father hath left the care of the asses, and sorroweth for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?
original_text: When thou art departed from me to day, then thou shalt find two men by Rachel’s sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah; and they will say unto thee, The asses which thou wentest to seek are found: and, lo, thy father hath left the care of the asses, and sorroweth for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?

translated_text: Then shalt thou go on forward from thence, and thou shalt come to the plain of Tabor, and there shall meet thee three men going up to God to Bethel, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a bottle of wine:
original_text: Then shalt thou go on forward from thence, and thou shalt come to the plain of Tabor, and there shall meet thee three men going up to God to Bethel, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a bottle of wine:

translated_text:
And they will salute thee, and give thee two
loaves of bread; which thou shalt receive of their hands.
original_text:
And they will salute thee, and give thee two
loaves of bread; which thou shalt receive of their hands.

translated_text:
After that thou shalt come to the hill of God, where
is the garrison of the Philistines: and it shall come to pass, when thou art come thither to the city, that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery, and a tabret, and a pipe, and a harp, before them; and they shall prophesy:
original_text:
After that thou shalt come to the hill of God, where
is the garrison of the Philistines: and it shall come to pass, when thou art come thither to the city, that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery, and a tabret, and a pipe, and a harp, before them; and they shall prophesy:

translated_text: And the Spirit of the LORD will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.
original_text: And the Spirit of the LORD will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.

translated_text:
And let it be, when these signs are come unto thee,
that thou do as occasion serve thee; for God
is with thee.
original_text:
And let it be, when these signs are come unto thee,
that thou do as occasion serve thee; for God
is with thee.

translated_text:
And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal; and, behold, I will come down unto thee, to offer burnt offerings,
and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings: seven days shalt thou tarry, till I come to thee, and shew thee what thou shalt do.
original_text:
And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal; and, behold, I will come down unto thee, to offer burnt offerings,
and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings: seven days shalt thou tarry, till I come to thee, and shew thee what thou shalt do.

translated_text:
And it was
so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart: and all those signs came to pass that day.
original_text:
And it was
so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart: and all those signs came to pass that day.

translated_text: And when they came thither to the hill, behold, a company of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came upon him, and he prophesied among them.
original_text: And when they came thither to the hill, behold, a company of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came upon him, and he prophesied among them.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when all that knew him beforetime saw that, behold, he prophesied among the prophets, then the people said one to another, What
is this
that is come unto the son of Kish?
Is
 Saul also among the prophets?
original_text:
And it came to pass, when all that knew him beforetime saw that, behold, he prophesied among the prophets, then the people said one to another, What
is this
that is come unto the son of Kish?
Is
 Saul also among the prophets?

translated_text:
And one of the same place answered and said, But who
is their father? Therefore it became a proverb,
Is Saul also among the prophets?
original_text:
And one of the same place answered and said, But who
is their father? Therefore it became a proverb,
Is Saul also among the prophets?

translated_text: And when he had made an end of prophesying, he came to the high place.
original_text: And when he had made an end of prophesying, he came to the high place.

translated_text:
And Saul’s uncle said unto him and to his servant, Whither went ye? And he said, To seek the asses: and when we saw that
they were no where, we came to Samuel.
original_text:
And Saul’s uncle said unto him and to his servant, Whither went ye? And he said, To seek the asses: and when we saw that
they were no where, we came to Samuel.

translated_text: And Saul’s uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said unto you.
original_text: And Saul’s uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said unto you.

translated_text: And Saul said unto his uncle, He told us plainly that the asses were found. But of the matter of the kingdom, whereof Samuel spake, he told him not.
original_text: And Saul said unto his uncle, He told us plainly that the asses were found. But of the matter of the kingdom, whereof Samuel spake, he told him not.

translated_text: And Samuel called the people together unto the LORD to Mizpeh;
original_text: And Samuel called the people together unto the LORD to Mizpeh;

translated_text:
And said unto the children of Israel, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought up Israel out of Egypt, and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all kingdoms,
and of them that oppressed you:
original_text:
And said unto the children of Israel, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought up Israel out of Egypt, and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all kingdoms,
and of them that oppressed you:

translated_text:
And ye have this day rejected your God, who himself saved you out of all your adversities and your tribulations; and ye have said unto him,
Nay,
 but set a king over us. Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes, and by your thousands.
original_text:
And ye have this day rejected your God, who himself saved you out of all your adversities and your tribulations; and ye have said unto him,
Nay,
 but set a king over us. Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes, and by your thousands.

translated_text: And when Samuel had caused all the tribes of Israel to come near, the tribe of Benjamin was taken.
original_text: And when Samuel had caused all the tribes of Israel to come near, the tribe of Benjamin was taken.

translated_text: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families, the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken: and when they sought him, he could not be found.
original_text: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families, the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken: and when they sought him, he could not be found.

translated_text: Therefore they enquired of the LORD further, if the man should yet come thither. And the LORD answered, Behold, he hath hid himself among the stuff.
original_text: Therefore they enquired of the LORD further, if the man should yet come thither. And the LORD answered, Behold, he hath hid himself among the stuff.

translated_text: And they ran and fetched him thence: and when he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
original_text: And they ran and fetched him thence: and when he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.

translated_text:
And Samuel said to all the people, See ye him whom the LORD hath chosen, that
there is none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, God save the king.
original_text:
And Samuel said to all the people, See ye him whom the LORD hath chosen, that
there is none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, God save the king.

translated_text:
Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote
it in a book, and laid
it
up before the LORD. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
original_text:
Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote
it in a book, and laid
it
up before the LORD. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.

translated_text: And Saul also went home to Gibeah; and there went with him a band of men, whose hearts God had touched.
original_text: And Saul also went home to Gibeah; and there went with him a band of men, whose hearts God had touched.

translated_text: But the children of Belial said, How shall this man save us? And they despised him, and brought him no presents. But he held his peace.
original_text: But the children of Belial said, How shall this man save us? And they despised him, and brought him no presents. But he held his peace.

translated_text: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabesh-gilead: and all the men of Jabesh said unto Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.
original_text: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabesh-gilead: and all the men of Jabesh said unto Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.

translated_text:
And Nahash the Ammonite answered them, On this
condition will I make
a covenant with you, that I may thrust out all your right eyes, and lay it
for a reproach upon all Israel.
original_text:
And Nahash the Ammonite answered them, On this
condition will I make
a covenant with you, that I may thrust out all your right eyes, and lay it
for a reproach upon all Israel.

translated_text:
And the elders of Jabesh said unto him, Give us seven days respite, that we may send messengers unto all the coasts of Israel: and then, if
there be no man to save us, we will come out to thee.
original_text:
And the elders of Jabesh said unto him, Give us seven days respite, that we may send messengers unto all the coasts of Israel: and then, if
there be no man to save us, we will come out to thee.

translated_text: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul, and told the tidings in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voices, and wept.
original_text: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul, and told the tidings in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voices, and wept.

translated_text:
And, behold, Saul came after the herd out of the field; and Saul said, What
aileth the people that they weep? And they told him the tidings of the men of Jabesh.
original_text:
And, behold, Saul came after the herd out of the field; and Saul said, What
aileth the people that they weep? And they told him the tidings of the men of Jabesh.

translated_text: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those tidings, and his anger was kindled greatly.
original_text: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those tidings, and his anger was kindled greatly.

translated_text:
And he took a yoke of oxen, and hewed them in pieces, and sent
them throughout all the coasts of Israel by the hands of messengers, saying, Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done unto his oxen. And the fear of the LORD fell on the people, and they came out with one consent.
original_text:
And he took a yoke of oxen, and hewed them in pieces, and sent
them throughout all the coasts of Israel by the hands of messengers, saying, Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done unto his oxen. And the fear of the LORD fell on the people, and they came out with one consent.

translated_text: And when he numbered them in Bezek, the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
original_text: And when he numbered them in Bezek, the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

translated_text:
And they said unto the messengers that came, Thus shall ye say unto the men of Jabesh-gilead, To morrow, by
that time the sun be hot, ye shall have help. And the messengers came and shewed
it to the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.
original_text:
And they said unto the messengers that came, Thus shall ye say unto the men of Jabesh-gilead, To morrow, by
that time the sun be hot, ye shall have help. And the messengers came and shewed
it to the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.

translated_text: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, To morrow we will come out unto you, and ye shall do with us all that seemeth good unto you.
original_text: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, To morrow we will come out unto you, and ye shall do with us all that seemeth good unto you.

translated_text:
And it was
so on the morrow, that Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the midst of the host in the morning watch, and slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day: and it came to pass, that they which remained were scattered, so that two of them were not left together.
original_text:
And it was
so on the morrow, that Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the midst of the host in the morning watch, and slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day: and it came to pass, that they which remained were scattered, so that two of them were not left together.

translated_text:
And the people said unto Samuel, Who
is he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? bring the men, that we may put them to death.
original_text:
And the people said unto Samuel, Who
is he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? bring the men, that we may put them to death.

translated_text: And Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day: for to day the LORD hath wrought salvation in Israel.
original_text: And Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day: for to day the LORD hath wrought salvation in Israel.

translated_text: Then said Samuel to the people, Come, and let us go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.
original_text: Then said Samuel to the people, Come, and let us go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.

translated_text: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.
original_text: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.

translated_text:
And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what
is mine iniquity? and what
is
 my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?
original_text:
And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what
is mine iniquity? and what
is
 my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?

translated_text:
And he said unto him, God forbid; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, but that he will shew it me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it
is not
so.
original_text:
And he said unto him, God forbid; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, but that he will shew it me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it
is not
so.

translated_text:
And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly
as the LORD liveth, and
as thy soul liveth,
there is but a step between me and death.
original_text:
And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly
as the LORD liveth, and
as thy soul liveth,
there is but a step between me and death.

translated_text:
Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do
it for thee.
original_text:
Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do
it for thee.

translated_text:
And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to morrow
is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third
day at even.
original_text:
And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to morrow
is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third
day at even.

translated_text:
If thy father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked
leave
 of me that he might run to Bethlehem his city: for
there is
 a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.
original_text:
If thy father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked
leave
 of me that he might run to Bethlehem his city: for
there is
 a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.

translated_text:
If he say thus,
It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth,
then be sure that evil is determined by him.
original_text:
If he say thus,
It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth,
then be sure that evil is determined by him.

translated_text: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the LORD with thee: notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?
original_text: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the LORD with thee: notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?

translated_text: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee: for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?
original_text: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee: for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?

translated_text:
Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what
if
 thy father answer thee roughly?
original_text:
Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what
if
 thy father answer thee roughly?

translated_text: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.
original_text: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.

translated_text:
And Jonathan said unto David, O LORD God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time,
or the third
day,
 and, behold,
if there be good toward David, and I then send not unto thee, and shew it thee;
original_text:
And Jonathan said unto David, O LORD God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time,
or the third
day,
 and, behold,
if there be good toward David, and I then send not unto thee, and shew it thee;

translated_text:
The LORD do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my father
to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the LORD be with thee, as he hath been with my father.
original_text:
The LORD do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my father
to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the LORD be with thee, as he hath been with my father.

translated_text: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the LORD, that I die not:
original_text: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the LORD, that I die not:

translated_text:
But
also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever: no, not when the LORD hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.
original_text:
But
also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever: no, not when the LORD hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.

translated_text:
So Jonathan made
a covenant with the house of David,
saying, Let the LORD even require
it at the hand of David’s enemies.
original_text:
So Jonathan made
a covenant with the house of David,
saying, Let the LORD even require
it at the hand of David’s enemies.

translated_text: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
original_text: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

translated_text:
Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow
is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.
original_text:
Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow
is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.

translated_text:
And
when thou hast stayed three days,
then thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was
in hand, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.
original_text:
And
when thou hast stayed three days,
then thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was
in hand, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.

translated_text:
And I will shoot three arrows on the side
thereof, as though I shot at a mark.
original_text:
And I will shoot three arrows on the side
thereof, as though I shot at a mark.

translated_text:
And, behold, I will send a lad,
saying, Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for
there is peace to thee, and no hurt;
as the LORD liveth.
original_text:
And, behold, I will send a lad,
saying, Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for
there is peace to thee, and no hurt;
as the LORD liveth.

translated_text:
But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows
are
 beyond thee; go thy way: for the LORD hath sent thee away.
original_text:
But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows
are
 beyond thee; go thy way: for the LORD hath sent thee away.

translated_text:
And
as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, the LORD
be between thee and me for ever.
original_text:
And
as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, the LORD
be between thee and me for ever.

translated_text: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.
original_text: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.

translated_text:
And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times,
even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, and David’s place was empty.
original_text:
And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times,
even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, and David’s place was empty.

translated_text:
Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he
is not clean.
original_text:
Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he
is not clean.

translated_text:
And it came to pass on the morrow,
which was the second
day of the month, that David’s place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?
original_text:
And it came to pass on the morrow,
which was the second
day of the month, that David’s place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?

translated_text:
And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked
leave of me
to go to Bethlehem:
original_text:
And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked
leave of me
to go to Bethlehem:

translated_text:
And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me
to be there: and now, if I have found favour in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not unto the king’s table.
original_text:
And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me
to be there: and now, if I have found favour in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not unto the king’s table.

translated_text:
Then Saul’s anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious
woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother’s nakedness?
original_text:
Then Saul’s anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious
woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother’s nakedness?

translated_text: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.
original_text: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.

translated_text: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?
original_text: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?

translated_text: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.
original_text: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.

translated_text: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.
original_text: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.

translated_text: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.
original_text: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.

translated_text:
And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot.
And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
original_text:
And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot.
And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

translated_text:
And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said,
Is not the arrow beyond thee?
original_text:
And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said,
Is not the arrow beyond thee?

translated_text: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan’s lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
original_text: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan’s lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.

translated_text: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
original_text: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

translated_text:
And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry
them to the city.
original_text:
And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry
them to the city.

translated_text:
And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of
a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.
original_text:
And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of
a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.

translated_text: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.
original_text: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.

translated_text:
Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek: and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which
is in Jezreel.
original_text:
Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek: and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which
is in Jezreel.

translated_text: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by thousands: but David and his men passed on in the rereward with Achish.
original_text: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by thousands: but David and his men passed on in the rereward with Achish.

translated_text:
Then said the princes of the Philistines, What
do these Hebrews
here? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines,
Is not this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, which hath been with me these days, or these years, and I have found no fault in him since he fell
unto me unto this day?
original_text:
Then said the princes of the Philistines, What
do these Hebrews
here? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines,
Is not this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, which hath been with me these days, or these years, and I have found no fault in him since he fell
unto me unto this day?

translated_text:
And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him, Make this fellow return, that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he be an adversary to us: for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master?
should it not
be with the heads of these men?
original_text:
And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him, Make this fellow return, that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he be an adversary to us: for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master?
should it not
be with the heads of these men?

translated_text: Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, Saul slew his thousands, and David his ten thousands?
original_text: Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, Saul slew his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

translated_text:
Then Achish called David, and said unto him, Surely,
as the LORD liveth, thou hast been upright, and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host
is good in my sight: for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the lords favour thee not.
original_text:
Then Achish called David, and said unto him, Surely,
as the LORD liveth, thou hast been upright, and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host
is good in my sight: for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the lords favour thee not.

translated_text: Wherefore now return, and go in peace, that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines.
original_text: Wherefore now return, and go in peace, that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines.

translated_text: And David said unto Achish, But what have I done? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day, that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?
original_text: And David said unto Achish, But what have I done? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day, that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?

translated_text:
And Achish answered and said to David, I know that thou
art
 good in my sight, as an angel of God: notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, He shall not go up with us to the battle.
original_text:
And Achish answered and said to David, I know that thou
art
 good in my sight, as an angel of God: notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, He shall not go up with us to the battle.

translated_text: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master’s servants that are come with thee: and as soon as ye be up early in the morning, and have light, depart.
original_text: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master’s servants that are come with thee: and as soon as ye be up early in the morning, and have light, depart.

translated_text: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
original_text: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

translated_text:
And David said in his heart, I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul:
there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul shall despair of me, to seek me any more in any coast of Israel: so shall I escape out of his hand.
original_text:
And David said in his heart, I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul:
there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul shall despair of me, to seek me any more in any coast of Israel: so shall I escape out of his hand.

translated_text:
And David arose, and he passed over with the six hundred men that
were with him unto Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.
original_text:
And David arose, and he passed over with the six hundred men that
were with him unto Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

translated_text:
And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household,
even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.
original_text:
And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household,
even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.

translated_text: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.
original_text: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.

translated_text: And David said unto Achish, If I have now found grace in thine eyes, let them give me a place in some town in the country, that I may dwell there: for why should thy servant dwell in the royal city with thee?
original_text: And David said unto Achish, If I have now found grace in thine eyes, let them give me a place in some town in the country, that I may dwell there: for why should thy servant dwell in the royal city with thee?

translated_text: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day.
original_text: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day.

translated_text: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.
original_text: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.

translated_text:
And David and his men went up, and invaded the Geshurites, and the Gezrites, and the Amalekites: for those
nations were of old the inhabitants of the land, as thou goest to Shur, even unto the land of Egypt.
original_text:
And David and his men went up, and invaded the Geshurites, and the Gezrites, and the Amalekites: for those
nations were of old the inhabitants of the land, as thou goest to Shur, even unto the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And David smote the land, and left neither man nor woman alive, and took away the sheep, and the oxen, and the asses, and the camels, and the apparel, and returned, and came to Achish.
original_text: And David smote the land, and left neither man nor woman alive, and took away the sheep, and the oxen, and the asses, and the camels, and the apparel, and returned, and came to Achish.

translated_text: And Achish said, Whither have ye made a road to day? And David said, Against the south of Judah, and against the south of the Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.
original_text: And Achish said, Whither have ye made a road to day? And David said, Against the south of Judah, and against the south of the Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.

translated_text:
And David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring
tidings
 to Gath, saying, Lest they should tell on us, saying, So did David, and so
will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines.
original_text:
And David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring
tidings
 to Gath, saying, Lest they should tell on us, saying, So did David, and so
will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines.

translated_text: And Achish believed David, saying, He hath made his people Israel utterly to abhor him; therefore he shall be my servant for ever.
original_text: And Achish believed David, saying, He hath made his people Israel utterly to abhor him; therefore he shall be my servant for ever.

translated_text: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. And Achish said unto David, Know thou assuredly, that thou shalt go out with me to battle, thou and thy men.
original_text: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. And Achish said unto David, Know thou assuredly, that thou shalt go out with me to battle, thou and thy men.

translated_text: And David said to Achish, Surely thou shalt know what thy servant can do. And Achish said to David, Therefore will I make thee keeper of mine head for ever.
original_text: And David said to Achish, Surely thou shalt know what thy servant can do. And Achish said to David, Therefore will I make thee keeper of mine head for ever.

translated_text: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had lamented him, and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.
original_text: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had lamented him, and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.

translated_text: And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and pitched in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they pitched in Gilboa.
original_text: And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and pitched in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they pitched in Gilboa.

translated_text: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart greatly trembled.
original_text: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart greatly trembled.

translated_text: And when Saul enquired of the LORD, the LORD answered him not, neither by dreams nor by Urim, nor by prophets.
original_text: And when Saul enquired of the LORD, the LORD answered him not, neither by dreams nor by Urim, nor by prophets.

translated_text:
Then said Saul unto his servants, Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and enquire of her. And his servants said to him, Behold,
there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at Endor.
original_text:
Then said Saul unto his servants, Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and enquire of her. And his servants said to him, Behold,
there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at Endor.

translated_text:
And Saul disguised himself, and put on other raiment, and he went, and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night: and he said, I pray thee, divine unto me by the familiar spirit, and bring me
him up, whom I shall name unto thee.
original_text:
And Saul disguised himself, and put on other raiment, and he went, and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night: and he said, I pray thee, divine unto me by the familiar spirit, and bring me
him up, whom I shall name unto thee.

translated_text: And the woman said unto him, Behold, thou knowest what Saul hath done, how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land: wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life, to cause me to die?
original_text: And the woman said unto him, Behold, thou knowest what Saul hath done, how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land: wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life, to cause me to die?

translated_text:
And Saul sware to her by the LORD, saying,
As the LORD liveth, there shall no punishment happen to thee for this thing.
original_text:
And Saul sware to her by the LORD, saying,
As the LORD liveth, there shall no punishment happen to thee for this thing.

translated_text: Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto thee? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.
original_text: Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto thee? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.

translated_text:
And when the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice: and the woman spake to Saul, saying, Why hast thou deceived me? for thou
art
 Saul.
original_text:
And when the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice: and the woman spake to Saul, saying, Why hast thou deceived me? for thou
art
 Saul.

translated_text: And the king said unto her, Be not afraid: for what sawest thou? And the woman said unto Saul, I saw gods ascending out of the earth.
original_text: And the king said unto her, Be not afraid: for what sawest thou? And the woman said unto Saul, I saw gods ascending out of the earth.

translated_text:
And he said unto her, What form
is he of? And she said, An old man cometh up; and he
is covered with a mantle. And Saul perceived that it
was Samuel, and he stooped with
his face to the ground, and bowed himself.
original_text:
And he said unto her, What form
is he of? And she said, An old man cometh up; and he
is covered with a mantle. And Saul perceived that it
was Samuel, and he stooped with
his face to the ground, and bowed himself.

translated_text: And Samuel said to Saul, Why hast thou disquieted me, to bring me up? And Saul answered, I am sore distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God is departed from me, and answereth me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called thee, that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do.
original_text: And Samuel said to Saul, Why hast thou disquieted me, to bring me up? And Saul answered, I am sore distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God is departed from me, and answereth me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called thee, that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do.

translated_text: Then said Samuel, Wherefore then dost thou ask of me, seeing the LORD is departed from thee, and is become thine enemy?
original_text: Then said Samuel, Wherefore then dost thou ask of me, seeing the LORD is departed from thee, and is become thine enemy?

translated_text:
And the LORD hath done to him, as he spake by me: for the LORD hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand, and given it to thy neighbour,
even
 to David:
original_text:
And the LORD hath done to him, as he spake by me: for the LORD hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand, and given it to thy neighbour,
even
 to David:

translated_text: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the LORD, nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore hath the LORD done this thing unto thee this day.
original_text: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the LORD, nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore hath the LORD done this thing unto thee this day.

translated_text:
Moreover the LORD will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines: and to morrow
shalt thou and thy sons
be
 with me: the LORD also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines.
original_text:
Moreover the LORD will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines: and to morrow
shalt thou and thy sons
be
 with me: the LORD also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines.

translated_text: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.
original_text: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.

translated_text: And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that he was sore troubled, and said unto him, Behold, thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me.
original_text: And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that he was sore troubled, and said unto him, Behold, thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me.

translated_text: Now therefore, I pray thee, hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before thee; and eat, that thou mayest have strength, when thou goest on thy way.
original_text: Now therefore, I pray thee, hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before thee; and eat, that thou mayest have strength, when thou goest on thy way.

translated_text: But he refused, and said, I will not eat. But his servants, together with the woman, compelled him; and he hearkened unto their voice. So he arose from the earth, and sat upon the bed.
original_text: But he refused, and said, I will not eat. But his servants, together with the woman, compelled him; and he hearkened unto their voice. So he arose from the earth, and sat upon the bed.

translated_text:
And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she hasted, and killed it, and took flour, and kneaded
it, and did bake unleavened bread thereof:
original_text:
And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she hasted, and killed it, and took flour, and kneaded
it, and did bake unleavened bread thereof:

translated_text:
And she brought
it before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.
original_text:
And she brought
it before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.

translated_text: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.
original_text: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

translated_text:
And
there was a man in Maon, whose possessions
were
 in Carmel; and the man
was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.
original_text:
And
there was a man in Maon, whose possessions
were
 in Carmel; and the man
was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

translated_text:
Now the name of the man
was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and
she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man
was churlish and evil in his doings; and he
was of the house of Caleb.
original_text:
Now the name of the man
was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and
she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man
was churlish and evil in his doings; and he
was of the house of Caleb.

translated_text: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.
original_text: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.

translated_text: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:
original_text: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:

translated_text:
And thus shall ye say to him that liveth
in prosperity, Peace
be both to thee, and peace
be to thine house, and peace
be unto all that thou hast.
original_text:
And thus shall ye say to him that liveth
in prosperity, Peace
be both to thee, and peace
be to thine house, and peace
be unto all that thou hast.

translated_text: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers: now thy shepherds which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.
original_text: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers: now thy shepherds which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.

translated_text: Ask thy young men, and they will shew thee. Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray thee, whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants, and to thy son David.
original_text: Ask thy young men, and they will shew thee. Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray thee, whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants, and to thy son David.

translated_text: And when David’s young men came, they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.
original_text: And when David’s young men came, they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.

translated_text:
And Nabal answered David’s servants, and said, Who
is David? and who
is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.
original_text:
And Nabal answered David’s servants, and said, Who
is David? and who
is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.

translated_text:
Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give
it unto men, whom I know not whence they
be?
original_text:
Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give
it unto men, whom I know not whence they
be?

translated_text: So David’s young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.
original_text: So David’s young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.

translated_text: And David said unto his men, Gird ye on every man his sword. And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the stuff.
original_text: And David said unto his men, Gird ye on every man his sword. And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the stuff.

translated_text: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master; and he railed on them.
original_text: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master; and he railed on them.

translated_text:
But the men
were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:
original_text:
But the men
were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:

translated_text: They were a wall unto us both by night and day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.
original_text: They were a wall unto us both by night and day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

translated_text:
Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he
is such a son of Belial, that
a man cannot speak to him.
original_text:
Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he
is such a son of Belial, that
a man cannot speak to him.

translated_text:
Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched
corn,
 and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid
them on asses.
original_text:
Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched
corn,
 and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid
them on asses.

translated_text: And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.
original_text: And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.

translated_text:
And it was
so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert of the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.
original_text:
And it was
so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert of the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.

translated_text:
Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this
fellow
 hath in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that
pertained unto him: and he hath requited me evil for good.
original_text:
Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this
fellow
 hath in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that
pertained unto him: and he hath requited me evil for good.

translated_text:
So and more also do God unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that
pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.
original_text:
So and more also do God unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that
pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.

translated_text: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,
original_text: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,

translated_text:
And fell at his feet, and said, Upon me, my lord,
upon me
let this iniquity
be: and let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak in thine audience, and hear the words of thine handmaid.
original_text:
And fell at his feet, and said, Upon me, my lord,
upon me
let this iniquity
be: and let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak in thine audience, and hear the words of thine handmaid.

translated_text:
Let not my lord, I pray thee, regard this man of Belial,
even
 Nabal: for as his name
is, so
is he; Nabal
is his name, and folly
is with him: but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord, whom thou didst send.
original_text:
Let not my lord, I pray thee, regard this man of Belial,
even
 Nabal: for as his name
is, so
is he; Nabal
is his name, and folly
is with him: but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord, whom thou didst send.

translated_text:
Now therefore, my lord,
as the LORD liveth, and
as
 thy soul liveth, seeing the LORD hath withholden thee from coming to
shed blood, and from avenging thyself with thine own hand, now let thine enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.
original_text:
Now therefore, my lord,
as the LORD liveth, and
as
 thy soul liveth, seeing the LORD hath withholden thee from coming to
shed blood, and from avenging thyself with thine own hand, now let thine enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.

translated_text: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord, let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord.
original_text: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord, let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord.

translated_text:
I pray thee, forgive the trespass of thine handmaid: for the LORD will certainly make my lord a sure house; because my lord fighteth the battles of the LORD, and evil hath not been found in thee
all thy days.
original_text:
I pray thee, forgive the trespass of thine handmaid: for the LORD will certainly make my lord a sure house; because my lord fighteth the battles of the LORD, and evil hath not been found in thee
all thy days.

translated_text:
Yet a man is risen to pursue thee, and to seek thy soul: but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the LORD thy God; and the souls of thine enemies, them shall he sling out,
as out of the middle of a sling.
original_text:
Yet a man is risen to pursue thee, and to seek thy soul: but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the LORD thy God; and the souls of thine enemies, them shall he sling out,
as out of the middle of a sling.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee, and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel;
original_text: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee, and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel;

translated_text: That this shall be no grief unto thee, nor offence of heart unto my lord, either that thou hast shed blood causeless, or that my lord hath avenged himself: but when the LORD shall have dealt well with my lord, then remember thine handmaid.
original_text: That this shall be no grief unto thee, nor offence of heart unto my lord, either that thou hast shed blood causeless, or that my lord hath avenged himself: but when the LORD shall have dealt well with my lord, then remember thine handmaid.

translated_text:
And David said to Abigail, Blessed
be the LORD God of Israel, which sent thee this day to meet me:
original_text:
And David said to Abigail, Blessed
be the LORD God of Israel, which sent thee this day to meet me:

translated_text:
And blessed
be thy advice, and blessed
be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to
shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.
original_text:
And blessed
be thy advice, and blessed
be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to
shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.

translated_text:
For in very deed,
as the LORD God of Israel liveth, which hath kept me back from hurting thee, except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.
original_text:
For in very deed,
as the LORD God of Israel liveth, which hath kept me back from hurting thee, except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.

translated_text:
So David received of her hand
that which she had brought him, and said unto her, Go up in peace to thine house; see, I have hearkened to thy voice, and have accepted thy person.
original_text:
So David received of her hand
that which she had brought him, and said unto her, Go up in peace to thine house; see, I have hearkened to thy voice, and have accepted thy person.

translated_text:
And Abigail came to Nabal; and, behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king; and Nabal’s heart
was merry within him, for he
was very drunken: wherefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.
original_text:
And Abigail came to Nabal; and, behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king; and Nabal’s heart
was merry within him, for he
was very drunken: wherefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.

translated_text:
But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became
as a stone.
original_text:
But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became
as a stone.

translated_text:
And it came to pass about ten days
after, that the LORD smote Nabal, that he died.
original_text:
And it came to pass about ten days
after, that the LORD smote Nabal, that he died.

translated_text:
And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed
be
 the LORD, that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his servant from evil: for the LORD hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.
original_text:
And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed
be
 the LORD, that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his servant from evil: for the LORD hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.

translated_text: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto thee to take thee to him to wife.
original_text: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto thee to take thee to him to wife.

translated_text:
And she arose, and bowed herself on
her face to the earth, and said, Behold,
let thine handmaid
be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.
original_text:
And she arose, and bowed herself on
her face to the earth, and said, Behold,
let thine handmaid
be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.

translated_text: And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.
original_text: And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

translated_text: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of them his wives.
original_text: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of them his wives.

translated_text:
But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Phalti the son of Laish, which
was of Gallim.
original_text:
But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Phalti the son of Laish, which
was of Gallim.

translated_text:
And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah,
which is before Jeshimon?
original_text:
And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah,
which is before Jeshimon?

translated_text: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.
original_text: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.

translated_text:
And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which
is before Jeshimon, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.
original_text:
And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which
is before Jeshimon, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

translated_text: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come in very deed.
original_text: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come in very deed.

translated_text: And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had pitched: and David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people pitched round about him.
original_text: And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had pitched: and David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people pitched round about him.

translated_text: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, saying, Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp? And Abishai said, I will go down with thee.
original_text: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, saying, Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp? And Abishai said, I will go down with thee.

translated_text: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the trench, and his spear stuck in the ground at his bolster: but Abner and the people lay round about him.
original_text: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the trench, and his spear stuck in the ground at his bolster: but Abner and the people lay round about him.

translated_text:
Then said Abishai to David, God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day: now therefore let me smite him, I pray thee, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not
smite him the second time.
original_text:
Then said Abishai to David, God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day: now therefore let me smite him, I pray thee, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not
smite him the second time.

translated_text: And David said to Abishai, Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the LORD’S anointed, and be guiltless?
original_text: And David said to Abishai, Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the LORD’S anointed, and be guiltless?

translated_text:
David said furthermore,
As the LORD liveth, the LORD shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall descend into battle, and perish.
original_text:
David said furthermore,
As the LORD liveth, the LORD shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall descend into battle, and perish.

translated_text:
The LORD forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the LORD’S anointed: but, I pray thee, take thou now the spear that
is at his bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.
original_text:
The LORD forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the LORD’S anointed: but, I pray thee, take thou now the spear that
is at his bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.

translated_text:
So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul’s bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw
it, nor knew
it, neither awaked: for they
were all asleep; because a deep sleep from the LORD was fallen upon them.
original_text:
So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul’s bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw
it, nor knew
it, neither awaked: for they
were all asleep; because a deep sleep from the LORD was fallen upon them.

translated_text:
Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of an hill afar off; a great space
being between them:
original_text:
Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of an hill afar off; a great space
being between them:

translated_text:
And David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, Answerest thou not, Abner? Then Abner answered and said, Who
art
 thou
that criest to the king?
original_text:
And David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, Answerest thou not, Abner? Then Abner answered and said, Who
art
 thou
that criest to the king?

translated_text:
And David said to Abner,
Art not thou a
valiant
 man? and who
is like to thee in Israel? wherefore then hast thou not kept thy lord the king? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king thy lord.
original_text:
And David said to Abner,
Art not thou a
valiant
 man? and who
