translated_text: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD.
original_text: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD.

translated_text: And the LORD said to Samuel, Hearken unto their voice, and make them a king. And Samuel said unto the men of Israel, Go ye every man unto his city.
original_text: And the LORD said to Samuel, Hearken unto their voice, and make them a king. And Samuel said unto the men of Israel, Go ye every man unto his city.

translated_text: And the men of Kirjath-jearim came, and brought up the ark of the LORD, and brought it into the house of Abinadab in the hill, and sanctified Eleazar his son to keep the ark of the LORD.
original_text: And the men of Kirjath-jearim came, and brought up the ark of the LORD, and brought it into the house of Abinadab in the hill, and sanctified Eleazar his son to keep the ark of the LORD.

translated_text: And it came to pass, while the ark abode in Kirjath-jearim, that the time was long; for it was twenty years: and all the house of Israel lamented after the LORD.
original_text: And it came to pass, while the ark abode in Kirjath-jearim, that the time was long; for it was twenty years: and all the house of Israel lamented after the LORD.

translated_text:
And Samuel spake unto all the house of Israel, saying, If ye do return unto the LORD with all your hearts,
then put away the strange gods and Ashtaroth from among you, and prepare your hearts unto the LORD, and serve him only: and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.
original_text:
And Samuel spake unto all the house of Israel, saying, If ye do return unto the LORD with all your hearts,
then put away the strange gods and Ashtaroth from among you, and prepare your hearts unto the LORD, and serve him only: and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.

translated_text: Then the children of Israel did put away Baalim and Ashtaroth, and served the LORD only.
original_text: Then the children of Israel did put away Baalim and Ashtaroth, and served the LORD only.

translated_text: And Samuel said, Gather all Israel to Mizpeh, and I will pray for you unto the LORD.
original_text: And Samuel said, Gather all Israel to Mizpeh, and I will pray for you unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And they gathered together to Mizpeh, and drew water, and poured
it out before the LORD, and fasted on that day, and said there, We have sinned against the LORD. And Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpeh.
original_text:
And they gathered together to Mizpeh, and drew water, and poured
it out before the LORD, and fasted on that day, and said there, We have sinned against the LORD. And Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpeh.

translated_text:
And when the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together to Mizpeh, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. And when the children of Israel heard
it, they were afraid of the Philistines.
original_text:
And when the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together to Mizpeh, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. And when the children of Israel heard
it, they were afraid of the Philistines.

translated_text: And the children of Israel said to Samuel, Cease not to cry unto the LORD our God for us, that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.
original_text: And the children of Israel said to Samuel, Cease not to cry unto the LORD our God for us, that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.

translated_text:
And Samuel took a sucking lamb, and offered
it for a burnt offering wholly unto the LORD: and Samuel cried unto the LORD for Israel; and the LORD heard him.
original_text:
And Samuel took a sucking lamb, and offered
it for a burnt offering wholly unto the LORD: and Samuel cried unto the LORD for Israel; and the LORD heard him.

translated_text: And as Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to battle against Israel: but the LORD thundered with a great thunder on that day upon the Philistines, and discomfited them; and they were smitten before Israel.
original_text: And as Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to battle against Israel: but the LORD thundered with a great thunder on that day upon the Philistines, and discomfited them; and they were smitten before Israel.

translated_text:
And the men of Israel went out of Mizpeh, and pursued the Philistines, and smote them, until
they came under Beth-car.
original_text:
And the men of Israel went out of Mizpeh, and pursued the Philistines, and smote them, until
they came under Beth-car.

translated_text:
Then Samuel took a stone, and set
it between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Eben-ezer, saying, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.
original_text:
Then Samuel took a stone, and set
it between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Eben-ezer, saying, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.

translated_text: So the Philistines were subdued, and they came no more into the coast of Israel: and the hand of the LORD was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.
original_text: So the Philistines were subdued, and they came no more into the coast of Israel: and the hand of the LORD was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.

translated_text: And the cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even unto Gath; and the coasts thereof did Israel deliver out of the hands of the Philistines. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.
original_text: And the cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even unto Gath; and the coasts thereof did Israel deliver out of the hands of the Philistines. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.

translated_text: And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.
original_text: And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.

translated_text: And he went from year to year in circuit to Bethel, and Gilgal, and Mizpeh, and judged Israel in all those places.
original_text: And he went from year to year in circuit to Bethel, and Gilgal, and Mizpeh, and judged Israel in all those places.

translated_text:
And his return
was to Ramah; for there
was his house; and there he judged Israel; and there he built an altar unto the LORD.
original_text:
And his return
was to Ramah; for there
was his house; and there he judged Israel; and there he built an altar unto the LORD.

translated_text: And Hannah prayed, and said, My heart rejoiceth in the LORD, mine horn is exalted in the LORD: my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies; because I rejoice in thy salvation.
original_text: And Hannah prayed, and said, My heart rejoiceth in the LORD, mine horn is exalted in the LORD: my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies; because I rejoice in thy salvation.

translated_text:
There is none holy as the LORD: for
there is none beside thee: neither
is there any rock like our God.
original_text:
There is none holy as the LORD: for
there is none beside thee: neither
is there any rock like our God.

translated_text:
Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let
not arrogancy come out of your mouth: for the LORD is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.
original_text:
Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let
not arrogancy come out of your mouth: for the LORD is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.

translated_text:
The bows of the mighty men
are broken, and they that stumbled are girded with strength.
original_text:
The bows of the mighty men
are broken, and they that stumbled are girded with strength.

translated_text:
They that were full have hired out themselves for bread; and
they that were hungry ceased: so that the barren hath born seven; and she that hath many children is waxed feeble.
original_text:
They that were full have hired out themselves for bread; and
they that were hungry ceased: so that the barren hath born seven; and she that hath many children is waxed feeble.

translated_text: The LORD killeth, and maketh alive: he bringeth down to the grave, and bringeth up.
original_text: The LORD killeth, and maketh alive: he bringeth down to the grave, and bringeth up.

translated_text: The LORD maketh poor, and maketh rich: he bringeth low, and lifteth up.
original_text: The LORD maketh poor, and maketh rich: he bringeth low, and lifteth up.

translated_text:
He raiseth up the poor out of the dust,
and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set
them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth
are
 the LORD’S, and he hath set the world upon them.
original_text:
He raiseth up the poor out of the dust,
and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set
them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth
are
 the LORD’S, and he hath set the world upon them.

translated_text: He will keep the feet of his saints, and the wicked shall be silent in darkness; for by strength shall no man prevail.
original_text: He will keep the feet of his saints, and the wicked shall be silent in darkness; for by strength shall no man prevail.

translated_text: The adversaries of the LORD shall be broken to pieces; out of heaven shall he thunder upon them: the LORD shall judge the ends of the earth; and he shall give strength unto his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.
original_text: The adversaries of the LORD shall be broken to pieces; out of heaven shall he thunder upon them: the LORD shall judge the ends of the earth; and he shall give strength unto his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.

translated_text: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child did minister unto the LORD before Eli the priest.
original_text: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child did minister unto the LORD before Eli the priest.

translated_text:
Now the sons of Eli
were sons of Belial; they knew not the LORD.
original_text:
Now the sons of Eli
were sons of Belial; they knew not the LORD.

translated_text:
And the priest’s custom with the people
was, that, when any man offered sacrifice, the priest’s servant came, while the flesh was in seething, with a fleshhook of three teeth in his hand;
original_text:
And the priest’s custom with the people
was, that, when any man offered sacrifice, the priest’s servant came, while the flesh was in seething, with a fleshhook of three teeth in his hand;

translated_text:
And he struck
it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; all that the fleshhook brought up the priest took for himself. So they did in Shiloh unto all the Israelites that came thither.
original_text:
And he struck
it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; all that the fleshhook brought up the priest took for himself. So they did in Shiloh unto all the Israelites that came thither.

translated_text: Also before they burnt the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have sodden flesh of thee, but raw.
original_text: Also before they burnt the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have sodden flesh of thee, but raw.

translated_text:
And
if any man said unto him, Let them not fail to burn the fat presently, and
then take
as much as thy soul desireth; then he would answer him,
Nay; but thou shalt give
it me
 now: and if not, I will take
it by force.
original_text:
And
if any man said unto him, Let them not fail to burn the fat presently, and
then take
as much as thy soul desireth; then he would answer him,
Nay; but thou shalt give
it me
 now: and if not, I will take
it by force.

translated_text: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the LORD: for men abhorred the offering of the LORD.
original_text: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the LORD: for men abhorred the offering of the LORD.

translated_text:
But Samuel ministered before the LORD,
being a child, girded with a linen ephod.
original_text:
But Samuel ministered before the LORD,
being a child, girded with a linen ephod.

translated_text:
Moreover his mother made him a little coat, and brought
it
 to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
original_text:
Moreover his mother made him a little coat, and brought
it
 to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

translated_text: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, The LORD give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the LORD. And they went unto their own home.
original_text: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, The LORD give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the LORD. And they went unto their own home.

translated_text: And the LORD visited Hannah, so that she conceived, and bare three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the LORD.
original_text: And the LORD visited Hannah, so that she conceived, and bare three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the LORD.

translated_text:
Now Eli was very old, and heard all that his sons did unto all Israel; and how they lay with the women that assembled
at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
original_text:
Now Eli was very old, and heard all that his sons did unto all Israel; and how they lay with the women that assembled
at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

translated_text: And he said unto them, Why do ye such things? for I hear of your evil dealings by all this people.
original_text: And he said unto them, Why do ye such things? for I hear of your evil dealings by all this people.

translated_text:
Nay, my sons; for
it is no good report that I hear: ye make the LORD’S people to transgress.
original_text:
Nay, my sons; for
it is no good report that I hear: ye make the LORD’S people to transgress.

translated_text: If one man sin against another, the judge shall judge him: but if a man sin against the LORD, who shall intreat for him? Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father, because the LORD would slay them.
original_text: If one man sin against another, the judge shall judge him: but if a man sin against the LORD, who shall intreat for him? Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father, because the LORD would slay them.

translated_text: And the child Samuel grew on, and was in favour both with the LORD, and also with men.
original_text: And the child Samuel grew on, and was in favour both with the LORD, and also with men.

translated_text: And there came a man of God unto Eli, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Did I plainly appear unto the house of thy father, when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh’s house?
original_text: And there came a man of God unto Eli, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Did I plainly appear unto the house of thy father, when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh’s house?

translated_text:
And did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel
to be
 my priest, to offer upon mine altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? and did I give unto the house of thy father all the offerings made by fire of the children of Israel?
original_text:
And did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel
to be
 my priest, to offer upon mine altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? and did I give unto the house of thy father all the offerings made by fire of the children of Israel?

translated_text:
Wherefore kick ye at my sacrifice and at mine offering, which I have commanded
in my habitation; and honourest thy sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people?
original_text:
Wherefore kick ye at my sacrifice and at mine offering, which I have commanded
in my habitation; and honourest thy sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people?

translated_text:
Wherefore the LORD God of Israel saith, I said indeed
that
 thy house, and the house of thy father, should walk before me for ever: but now the LORD saith, Be it far from me; for them that honour me I will honour, and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed.
original_text:
Wherefore the LORD God of Israel saith, I said indeed
that
 thy house, and the house of thy father, should walk before me for ever: but now the LORD saith, Be it far from me; for them that honour me I will honour, and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed.

translated_text: Behold, the days come, that I will cut off thine arm, and the arm of thy father’s house, that there shall not be an old man in thine house.
original_text: Behold, the days come, that I will cut off thine arm, and the arm of thy father’s house, that there shall not be an old man in thine house.

translated_text:
And thou shalt see an enemy
in my habitation, in all
the wealth which
God shall give Israel: and there shall not be an old man in thine house for ever.
original_text:
And thou shalt see an enemy
in my habitation, in all
the wealth which
God shall give Israel: and there shall not be an old man in thine house for ever.

translated_text:
And the man of thine,
whom I shall not cut off from mine altar,
shall be to consume thine eyes, and to grieve thine heart: and all the increase of thine house shall die in the flower of their age.
original_text:
And the man of thine,
whom I shall not cut off from mine altar,
shall be to consume thine eyes, and to grieve thine heart: and all the increase of thine house shall die in the flower of their age.

translated_text:
And this
shall be a sign unto thee, that shall come upon thy two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas; in one day they shall die both of them.
original_text:
And this
shall be a sign unto thee, that shall come upon thy two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas; in one day they shall die both of them.

translated_text:
And I will raise me up a faithful priest,
that shall do according to
that which
is in mine heart and in my mind: and I will build him a sure house; and he shall walk before mine anointed for ever.
original_text:
And I will raise me up a faithful priest,
that shall do according to
that which
is in mine heart and in my mind: and I will build him a sure house; and he shall walk before mine anointed for ever.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that every one that is left in thine house shall come
and crouch to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread, and shall say, Put me, I pray thee, into one of the priests’ offices, that I may eat a piece of bread.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that every one that is left in thine house shall come
and crouch to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread, and shall say, Put me, I pray thee, into one of the priests’ offices, that I may eat a piece of bread.

translated_text: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim-zophim, of mount Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite:
original_text: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim-zophim, of mount Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite:

translated_text:
And he had two wives; the name of the one
was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
original_text:
And he had two wives; the name of the one
was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

translated_text:
And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the LORD of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the LORD,
were there.
original_text:
And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the LORD of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the LORD,
were there.

translated_text: And when the time was that Elkanah offered, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions:
original_text: And when the time was that Elkanah offered, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions:

translated_text: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion; for he loved Hannah: but the LORD had shut up her womb.
original_text: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion; for he loved Hannah: but the LORD had shut up her womb.

translated_text: And her adversary also provoked her sore, for to make her fret, because the LORD had shut up her womb.
original_text: And her adversary also provoked her sore, for to make her fret, because the LORD had shut up her womb.

translated_text:
And
as he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of the LORD, so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.
original_text:
And
as he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of the LORD, so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.

translated_text:
Then said Elkanah her husband to her, Hannah, why weepest thou? and why eatest thou not? and why is thy heart grieved?
am not I better to thee than ten sons?
original_text:
Then said Elkanah her husband to her, Hannah, why weepest thou? and why eatest thou not? and why is thy heart grieved?
am not I better to thee than ten sons?

translated_text: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk. Now Eli the priest sat upon a seat by a post of the temple of the LORD.
original_text: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk. Now Eli the priest sat upon a seat by a post of the temple of the LORD.

translated_text:
And she
was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto the LORD, and wept sore.
original_text:
And she
was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto the LORD, and wept sore.

translated_text: And she vowed a vow, and said, O LORD of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid, but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto the LORD all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.
original_text: And she vowed a vow, and said, O LORD of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid, but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto the LORD all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.

translated_text: And it came to pass, as she continued praying before the LORD, that Eli marked her mouth.
original_text: And it came to pass, as she continued praying before the LORD, that Eli marked her mouth.

translated_text: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.
original_text: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.

translated_text: And Eli said unto her, How long wilt thou be drunken? put away thy wine from thee.
original_text: And Eli said unto her, How long wilt thou be drunken? put away thy wine from thee.

translated_text:
And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I
am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunken neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the LORD.
original_text:
And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I
am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunken neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the LORD.

translated_text: Count not thine handmaid for a daughter of Belial: for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto.
original_text: Count not thine handmaid for a daughter of Belial: for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto.

translated_text:
Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace: and the God of Israel grant
thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him.
original_text:
Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace: and the God of Israel grant
thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him.

translated_text:
And she said, Let thine handmaid find grace in thy sight. So the woman went her way, and did eat, and her countenance was no more
sad.
original_text:
And she said, Let thine handmaid find grace in thy sight. So the woman went her way, and did eat, and her countenance was no more
sad.

translated_text: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshipped before the LORD, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah: and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the LORD remembered her.
original_text: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshipped before the LORD, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah: and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the LORD remembered her.

translated_text:
Wherefore it came to pass, when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived, that she bare a son, and called his name Samuel,
saying,
 Because I have asked him of the LORD.
original_text:
Wherefore it came to pass, when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived, that she bare a son, and called his name Samuel,
saying,
 Because I have asked him of the LORD.

translated_text: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto the LORD the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.
original_text: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto the LORD the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.

translated_text:
But Hannah went not up; for she said unto her husband,
I will not go up until the child be weaned, and
then I will bring him, that he may appear before the LORD, and there abide for ever.
original_text:
But Hannah went not up; for she said unto her husband,
I will not go up until the child be weaned, and
then I will bring him, that he may appear before the LORD, and there abide for ever.

translated_text: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Do what seemeth thee good; tarry until thou have weaned him; only the LORD establish his word. So the woman abode, and gave her son suck until she weaned him.
original_text: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Do what seemeth thee good; tarry until thou have weaned him; only the LORD establish his word. So the woman abode, and gave her son suck until she weaned him.

translated_text:
And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bullocks, and one ephah of flour, and a bottle of wine, and brought him unto the house of the LORD in Shiloh: and the child
was young.
original_text:
And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bullocks, and one ephah of flour, and a bottle of wine, and brought him unto the house of the LORD in Shiloh: and the child
was young.

translated_text: And they slew a bullock, and brought the child to Eli.
original_text: And they slew a bullock, and brought the child to Eli.

translated_text:
And she said, Oh my lord,
as thy soul liveth, my lord, I
am the woman that stood by thee here, praying unto the LORD.
original_text:
And she said, Oh my lord,
as thy soul liveth, my lord, I
am the woman that stood by thee here, praying unto the LORD.

translated_text: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:
original_text: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:

translated_text: Therefore also I have lent him to the LORD; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the LORD. And he worshipped the LORD there.
original_text: Therefore also I have lent him to the LORD; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the LORD. And he worshipped the LORD there.

translated_text: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and pitched beside Eben-ezer: and the Philistines pitched in Aphek.
original_text: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and pitched beside Eben-ezer: and the Philistines pitched in Aphek.

translated_text: And the Philistines put themselves in array against Israel: and when they joined battle, Israel was smitten before the Philistines: and they slew of the army in the field about four thousand men.
original_text: And the Philistines put themselves in array against Israel: and when they joined battle, Israel was smitten before the Philistines: and they slew of the army in the field about four thousand men.

translated_text: And when the people were come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, Wherefore hath the LORD smitten us to day before the Philistines? Let us fetch the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of Shiloh unto us, that, when it cometh among us, it may save us out of the hand of our enemies.
original_text: And when the people were come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, Wherefore hath the LORD smitten us to day before the Philistines? Let us fetch the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of Shiloh unto us, that, when it cometh among us, it may save us out of the hand of our enemies.

translated_text:
So the people sent to Shiloh, that they might bring from thence the ark of the covenant of the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth
between the cherubims: and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas,
were there with the ark of the covenant of God.
original_text:
So the people sent to Shiloh, that they might bring from thence the ark of the covenant of the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth

translated_text: And when the ark of the covenant of the LORD came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth rang again.
original_text: And when the ark of the covenant of the LORD came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth rang again.

translated_text:
And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, What
meaneth the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews? And they understood that the ark of the LORD was come into the camp.
original_text:
And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, What
meaneth the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews? And they understood that the ark of the LORD was come into the camp.

translated_text: And the Philistines were afraid, for they said, God is come into the camp. And they said, Woe unto us! for there hath not been such a thing heretofore.
original_text: And the Philistines were afraid, for they said, God is come into the camp. And they said, Woe unto us! for there hath not been such a thing heretofore.

translated_text:
Woe unto us! who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods? these
are the Gods that smote the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness.
original_text:
Woe unto us! who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods? these
are the Gods that smote the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness.

translated_text: Be strong, and quit yourselves like men, O ye Philistines, that ye be not servants unto the Hebrews, as they have been to you: quit yourselves like men, and fight.
original_text: Be strong, and quit yourselves like men, O ye Philistines, that ye be not servants unto the Hebrews, as they have been to you: quit yourselves like men, and fight.

translated_text: And the Philistines fought, and Israel was smitten, and they fled every man into his tent: and there was a very great slaughter; for there fell of Israel thirty thousand footmen.
original_text: And the Philistines fought, and Israel was smitten, and they fled every man into his tent: and there was a very great slaughter; for there fell of Israel thirty thousand footmen.

translated_text: And the ark of God was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.
original_text: And the ark of God was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.

translated_text: And there ran a man of Benjamin out of the army, and came to Shiloh the same day with his clothes rent, and with earth upon his head.
original_text: And there ran a man of Benjamin out of the army, and came to Shiloh the same day with his clothes rent, and with earth upon his head.

translated_text:
And when he came, lo, Eli sat upon a seat by the wayside watching: for his heart trembled for the ark of God. And when the man came into the city, and told
it, all the city cried out.
original_text:
And when he came, lo, Eli sat upon a seat by the wayside watching: for his heart trembled for the ark of God. And when the man came into the city, and told
it, all the city cried out.

translated_text:
And when Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, What
meaneth
 the noise of this tumult? And the man came in hastily, and told Eli.
original_text:
And when Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, What
meaneth
 the noise of this tumult? And the man came in hastily, and told Eli.

translated_text: Now Eli was ninety and eight years old; and his eyes were dim, that he could not see.
original_text: Now Eli was ninety and eight years old; and his eyes were dim, that he could not see.

translated_text:
And the man said unto Eli, I
am he that came out of the army, and I fled to day out of the army. And he said, What is there done, my son?
original_text:
And the man said unto Eli, I
am he that came out of the army, and I fled to day out of the army. And he said, What is there done, my son?

translated_text: And the messenger answered and said, Israel is fled before the Philistines, and there hath been also a great slaughter among the people, and thy two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God is taken.
original_text: And the messenger answered and said, Israel is fled before the Philistines, and there hath been also a great slaughter among the people, and thy two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God is taken.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when he made mention of the ark of God, that he fell from off the seat backward by the side of the gate, and his neck brake, and he died: for he was an old man, and heavy. And he had judged Israel forty years.
original_text: And it came to pass, when he made mention of the ark of God, that he fell from off the seat backward by the side of the gate, and his neck brake, and he died: for he was an old man, and heavy. And he had judged Israel forty years.

translated_text:
And his daughter in law, Phinehas’ wife, was with child,
near
 to be delivered: and when she heard the tidings that the ark of God was taken, and that her father in law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and travailed; for her pains came upon her.
original_text:
And his daughter in law, Phinehas’ wife, was with child,
near
 to be delivered: and when she heard the tidings that the ark of God was taken, and that her father in law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and travailed; for her pains came upon her.

translated_text:
And about the time of her death the women that stood by her said unto her, Fear not; for thou hast born a son. But she answered not, neither did she regard
it.
original_text:
And about the time of her death the women that stood by her said unto her, Fear not; for thou hast born a son. But she answered not, neither did she regard
it.

translated_text: And she named the child I-chabod, saying, The glory is departed from Israel: because the ark of God was taken, and because of her father in law and her husband.
original_text: And she named the child I-chabod, saying, The glory is departed from Israel: because the ark of God was taken, and because of her father in law and her husband.

translated_text: And she said, The glory is departed from Israel: for the ark of God is taken.
original_text: And she said, The glory is departed from Israel: for the ark of God is taken.

translated_text:
And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days;
there was no open vision.
original_text:
And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days;
there was no open vision.

translated_text:
That the LORD called Samuel: and he answered, Here
am I.
original_text:
That the LORD called Samuel: and he answered, Here
am I.

translated_text:
And he ran unto Eli, and said, Here
am I; for thou calledst me. And he said, I called not; lie down again. And he went and lay down.
original_text:
And he ran unto Eli, and said, Here
am I; for thou calledst me. And he said, I called not; lie down again. And he went and lay down.

translated_text:
And the LORD called yet again, Samuel. And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, Here
am I; for thou didst call me. And he answered, I called not, my son; lie down again.
original_text:
And the LORD called yet again, Samuel. And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, Here
am I; for thou didst call me. And he answered, I called not, my son; lie down again.

translated_text: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, neither was the word of the LORD yet revealed unto him.
original_text: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, neither was the word of the LORD yet revealed unto him.

translated_text:
And the LORD called Samuel again the third time. And he arose and went to Eli, and said, Here
am I; for thou didst call me. And Eli perceived that the LORD had called the child.
original_text:
And the LORD called Samuel again the third time. And he arose and went to Eli, and said, Here

translated_text: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel, Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, LORD; for thy servant heareth. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
original_text: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel, Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, LORD; for thy servant heareth. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

translated_text: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.
original_text: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.

translated_text: And the LORD said to Samuel, Behold, I will do a thing in Israel, at which both the ears of every one that heareth it shall tingle.
original_text: And the LORD said to Samuel, Behold, I will do a thing in Israel, at which both the ears of every one that heareth it shall tingle.

translated_text:
In that day I will perform against Eli all
things which I have spoken concerning his house: when I begin, I will also make an end.
original_text:
In that day I will perform against Eli all
things which I have spoken concerning his house: when I begin, I will also make an end.

translated_text: For I have told him that I will judge his house for ever for the iniquity which he knoweth; because his sons made themselves vile, and he restrained them not.
original_text: For I have told him that I will judge his house for ever for the iniquity which he knoweth; because his sons made themselves vile, and he restrained them not.

translated_text: And therefore I have sworn unto the house of Eli, that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering for ever.
original_text: And therefore I have sworn unto the house of Eli, that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering for ever.

translated_text: And Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the house of the LORD. And Samuel feared to shew Eli the vision.
original_text: And Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the house of the LORD. And Samuel feared to shew Eli the vision.

translated_text:
Then Eli called Samuel, and said, Samuel, my son. And he answered, Here
am I.
original_text:
Then Eli called Samuel, and said, Samuel, my son. And he answered, Here
am I.

translated_text:
And he said, What
is the thing that
the LORD hath said unto thee? I pray thee hide
it not from me: God do so to thee, and more also, if thou hide
any thing from me of all the things that he said unto thee.
original_text:
And he said, What
is the thing that
the LORD hath said unto thee? I pray thee hide
it not from me: God do so to thee, and more also, if thou hide
any thing from me of all the things that he said unto thee.

translated_text:
And Samuel told him every whit, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It
is the LORD: let him do what seemeth him good.
original_text:
And Samuel told him every whit, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It
is the LORD: let him do what seemeth him good.

translated_text: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the ground.
original_text: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the ground.

translated_text:
And all Israel from Dan even to Beer-sheba knew that Samuel
was
 established
to be a prophet of the LORD.
original_text:
And all Israel from Dan even to Beer-sheba knew that Samuel
was
 established
to be a prophet of the LORD.

translated_text: And the LORD appeared again in Shiloh: for the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the LORD.
original_text: And the LORD appeared again in Shiloh: for the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the LORD.

translated_text: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;
original_text: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;

translated_text:
It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and
so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.
original_text:
It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and
so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.

translated_text: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.
original_text: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.

translated_text: And David said unto him, How went the matter? I pray thee, tell me. And he answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.
original_text: And David said unto him, How went the matter? I pray thee, tell me. And he answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.

translated_text: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?
original_text: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?

translated_text: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.
original_text: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.

translated_text:
And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here
am I.
original_text:
And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here
am I.

translated_text:
And he said unto me, Who
art thou? And I answered him, I
am an Amalekite.
original_text:
And he said unto me, Who
art thou? And I answered him, I
am an Amalekite.

translated_text:
And he said unto me again, Stand, I pray thee, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life
is yet whole in me.
original_text:
And he said unto me again, Stand, I pray thee, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life
is yet whole in me.

translated_text:
So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that
was upon his head, and the bracelet that
was on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.
original_text:
So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that
was upon his head, and the bracelet that
was on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.

translated_text:
Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that
were with him:
original_text:
Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that
were with him:

translated_text: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.
original_text: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.

translated_text:
And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence
art
 thou? And he answered, I
am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.
original_text:
And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence
art
 thou? And he answered, I
am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.

translated_text: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the LORD’S anointed?
original_text: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the LORD’S anointed?

translated_text:
And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near,
and
 fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.
original_text:
And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near,
and
 fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.

translated_text:
And David said unto him, Thy blood
be upon thy head; for thy mouth hath testified against thee, saying, I have slain the LORD’S anointed.
original_text:
And David said unto him, Thy blood
be upon thy head; for thy mouth hath testified against thee, saying, I have slain the LORD’S anointed.

translated_text: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:
original_text: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:

translated_text:
(Also he bade them teach the children of Judah
the use of
 the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)
original_text:
(Also he bade them teach the children of Judah
the use of
 the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)

translated_text: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!
original_text: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!

translated_text:
Tell
it not in Gath, publish
it not in the streets of Askelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.
original_text:
Tell
it not in Gath, publish
it not in the streets of Askelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

translated_text:
Ye mountains of Gilboa,
let there be no dew, neither
let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul,
as though he had not
been anointed with oil.
original_text:
Ye mountains of Gilboa,
let there be no dew, neither
let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul,
as though he had not
been anointed with oil.

translated_text: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.
original_text: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.

translated_text:
Saul and Jonathan
were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
original_text:
Saul and Jonathan
were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.

translated_text:
Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with
other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.
original_text:
Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with
other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.

translated_text:
How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan,
thou wast slain in thine high places.
original_text:
How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan,
thou wast slain in thine high places.

translated_text: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.
original_text: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.

translated_text: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!
original_text: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!

translated_text: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.
original_text: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.

translated_text: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
original_text: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

translated_text: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
original_text: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

translated_text: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
original_text: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

translated_text: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.
original_text: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

translated_text: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.
original_text: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.

translated_text:
And Saul had a concubine, whose name
was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and
Ish-bosheth said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father’s concubine?
original_text:
And Saul had a concubine, whose name
was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and
Ish-bosheth said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father’s concubine?

translated_text:
Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ish-bosheth, and said,
Am I a dog’s head, which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered thee into the hand of David, that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?
original_text:
Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ish-bosheth, and said,
Am I a dog’s head, which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered thee into the hand of David, that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?

translated_text: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the LORD hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;
original_text: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the LORD hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;

translated_text: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beer-sheba.
original_text: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beer-sheba.

translated_text: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.
original_text: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.

translated_text:
And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose
is the land? saying
also, Make thy league with me, and, behold, my hand
shall be with thee, to bring about all Israel unto thee.
original_text:
And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose
is the land? saying
also, Make thy league with me, and, behold, my hand
shall be with thee, to bring about all Israel unto thee.

translated_text: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Saul’s daughter, when thou comest to see my face.
original_text: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Saul’s daughter, when thou comest to see my face.

translated_text:
And David sent messengers to Ish-bosheth Saul’s son, saying, Deliver
me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.
original_text:
And David sent messengers to Ish-bosheth Saul’s son, saying, Deliver
me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.

translated_text:
And Ish-bosheth sent, and took her from
her husband,
even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.
original_text:
And Ish-bosheth sent, and took her from
her husband,
even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.

translated_text: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.
original_text: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.

translated_text:
And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past
to be king over you:
original_text:
And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past
to be king over you:

translated_text:
Now then do
it: for the LORD hath spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.
original_text:
Now then do
it: for the LORD hath spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.

translated_text: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.
original_text: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.

translated_text:
So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that
were with him a feast.
original_text:
So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that
were with him a feast.

translated_text: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.
original_text: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

translated_text:
And, Behold, the servants of David and Joab came from
pursuing
 a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner
was
 not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.
original_text:
And, Behold, the servants of David and Joab came from
pursuing
 a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner
was
 not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.

translated_text:
When Joab and all the host that
was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.
original_text:
When Joab and all the host that
was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.

translated_text:
Then Joab came to the king, and said, What hast thou done? behold, Abner came unto thee; why
is it
that thou hast sent him away, and he is quite gone?
original_text:
Then Joab came to the king, and said, What hast thou done? behold, Abner came unto thee; why
is it
that thou hast sent him away, and he is quite gone?

translated_text: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all that thou doest.
original_text: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all that thou doest.

translated_text:
And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew
it
 not.
original_text:
And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew
it
 not.

translated_text:
And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth
rib,
 that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.
original_text:
And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth
rib,
 that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.

translated_text:
And afterward when David heard
it, he said, I and my kingdom
are guiltless before the LORD for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:
original_text:
And afterward when David heard
it, he said, I and my kingdom
are guiltless before the LORD for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:

translated_text: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father’s house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falleth on the sword, or that lacketh bread.
original_text: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father’s house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falleth on the sword, or that lacketh bread.

translated_text: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
original_text: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

translated_text:
And David said to Joab, and to all the people that
were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David
himself followed the bier.
original_text:
And David said to Joab, and to all the people that
were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David
himself followed the bier.

translated_text: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.
original_text: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.

translated_text: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?
original_text: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?

translated_text:
Thy hands
were not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men,
so fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him.
original_text:
Thy hands
were not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men,
so fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him.

translated_text: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.
original_text: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.

translated_text:
And all the people took notice
of it, and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.
original_text:
And all the people took notice
of it, and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.

translated_text: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.
original_text: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.

translated_text: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?
original_text: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?

translated_text:
And I
am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah
be too hard for me: the LORD shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness.
original_text:
And I
am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah
be too hard for me: the LORD shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness.

translated_text: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the LORD said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.
original_text: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the LORD said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.

translated_text: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal’s wife the Carmelite.
original_text: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal’s wife the Carmelite.

translated_text:
And his men that
were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.
original_text:
And his men that
were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.

translated_text:
And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying,
That the men of Jabesh-gilead
were they that buried Saul.
original_text:
And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying,
That the men of Jabesh-gilead
were they that buried Saul.

translated_text:
And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh-gilead, and said unto them, Blessed
be ye of the LORD, that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord,
even unto Saul, and have buried him.
original_text:
And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh-gilead, and said unto them, Blessed
be ye of the LORD, that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord,
even unto Saul, and have buried him.

translated_text: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.
original_text: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.

translated_text: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.
original_text: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.

translated_text: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s host, took Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;
original_text: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s host, took Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;

translated_text: And made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.
original_text: And made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

translated_text:
Ish-bosheth Saul’s son
was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.
original_text:
Ish-bosheth Saul’s son
was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

translated_text: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
original_text: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

translated_text: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
original_text: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

translated_text: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.
original_text: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.

translated_text: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.
original_text: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.

translated_text:
Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which
pertained to Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.
original_text:
Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which
pertained to Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.

translated_text:
And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and
thrust
 his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkath-hazzurim, which
is in Gibeon.
original_text:
And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and
thrust
 his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkath-hazzurim, which
is in Gibeon.

translated_text: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.
original_text: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.

translated_text:
And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel
was as light of foot as a wild roe.
original_text:
And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel
was as light of foot as a wild roe.

translated_text: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.
original_text: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.

translated_text:
Then Abner looked behind him, and said,
Art thou Asahel? And he answered, I
am.
original_text:
Then Abner looked behind him, and said,
Art thou Asahel? And he answered, I
am.

translated_text: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.
original_text: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.

translated_text: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?
original_text: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?

translated_text:
Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth
rib, that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass,
that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.
original_text:
Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth
rib, that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass,
that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

translated_text:
Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that
lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
original_text:
Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that
lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

translated_text: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.
original_text: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.

translated_text: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?
original_text: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?

translated_text:
And Joab said,
As God liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.
original_text:
And Joab said,
As God liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.

translated_text: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.
original_text: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.

translated_text: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.
original_text: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.

translated_text: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David’s servants nineteen men and Asahel.
original_text: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David’s servants nineteen men and Asahel.

translated_text:
But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner’s men,
so that three hundred and threescore men died.
original_text:
But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner’s men,
so that three hundred and threescore men died.

translated_text:
And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which
was in Bethlehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.
original_text:
And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which
was in Bethlehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.

translated_text:
Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we
are thy bone and thy flesh.
original_text:
Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we
are thy bone and thy flesh.

translated_text: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.
original_text: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.

translated_text: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD: and they anointed David king over Israel.
original_text: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD: and they anointed David king over Israel.

translated_text:
David
was thirty years old when he began to reign,
and
 he reigned forty years.
original_text:
David
was thirty years old when he began to reign,
and
 he reigned forty years.

translated_text: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.
original_text: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.

translated_text: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.
original_text: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.

translated_text:
Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same
is
 the city of David.
original_text:
Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same
is
 the city of David.

translated_text:
And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind,
that are hated of David’s soul,
he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.
original_text:
And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind,
that are hated of David’s soul,
he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.

translated_text: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.
original_text: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.

translated_text:
And David went on, and grew great, and the LORD God of hosts
was
 with him.
original_text:
And David went on, and grew great, and the LORD God of hosts
was
 with him.

translated_text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.
original_text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.

translated_text: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.
original_text: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.

translated_text:
And David took
him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.
original_text:
And David took
him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.

translated_text:
And these
be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammuah, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,
original_text:
And these
be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammuah, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,

translated_text: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
original_text: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

translated_text: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.
original_text: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.

translated_text:
But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard
of it, and went down to the hold.
original_text:
But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard
of it, and went down to the hold.

translated_text: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
original_text: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

translated_text: And David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.
original_text: And David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.

translated_text: And David came to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there, and said, The LORD hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
original_text: And David came to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there, and said, The LORD hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baal-perazim.

translated_text: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.
original_text: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.

translated_text: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
