that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:

translated_text: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.
original_text: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.

translated_text:
And after him
was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.
original_text:
And after him
was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.

translated_text: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the LORD wrought a great victory.
original_text: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the LORD wrought a great victory.

translated_text: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.
original_text: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.

translated_text:
And David
was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines
was then
in Bethlehem.
original_text:
And David
was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines
was then
in Bethlehem.

translated_text:
And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which
is by the gate!
original_text:
And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which
is by the gate!

translated_text:
And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that
was by the gate, and took
it, and brought
it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD.
original_text:
And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that
was by the gate, and took
it, and brought
it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this:
is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.
original_text:
And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this:
is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.

translated_text:
And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred,
and slew
them, and had the name among three.
original_text:
And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred,
and slew
them, and had the name among three.

translated_text:
Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the
first three.
original_text:
Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the
first three.

translated_text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:
original_text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:

translated_text: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.
original_text: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.

translated_text:
These
things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.
original_text:
These
things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.

translated_text:
He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the
first three. And David set him over his guard.
original_text:
He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the
first three. And David set him over his guard.

translated_text:
Asahel the brother of Joab
was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
original_text:
Asahel the brother of Joab
was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

translated_text: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
original_text: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

translated_text: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
original_text: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

translated_text: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
original_text: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

translated_text: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
original_text: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

translated_text: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
original_text: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

translated_text: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,
original_text: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,

translated_text: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
original_text: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

translated_text: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
original_text: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

translated_text: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,
original_text: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,

translated_text: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
original_text: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

translated_text: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
original_text: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

translated_text: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
original_text: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

translated_text: Zelek the Ammonite, Nahari the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
original_text: Zelek the Ammonite, Nahari the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

translated_text: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,
original_text: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,

translated_text: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.
original_text: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.

translated_text:
And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day
that the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:
original_text:
And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day
that the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:

translated_text:
And he said, The LORD
is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
original_text:
And he said, The LORD
is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

translated_text:
The God of my rock; in him will I trust:
he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.
original_text:
The God of my rock; in him will I trust:
he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.

translated_text:
I will call on the LORD,
who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
original_text:
I will call on the LORD,
who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

translated_text: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;
original_text: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;

translated_text: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;
original_text: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;

translated_text:
In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry
did enter into his ears.
original_text:
In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry
did enter into his ears.

translated_text: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.
original_text: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.

translated_text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
original_text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

translated_text:
He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness
was
 under his feet.
original_text:
He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness
was
 under his feet.

translated_text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.
original_text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.

translated_text:
And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters,
and
 thick clouds of the skies.
original_text:
And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters,
and
 thick clouds of the skies.

translated_text: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.
original_text: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.

translated_text: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.
original_text: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.

translated_text: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.
original_text: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.

translated_text: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
original_text: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

translated_text: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;
original_text: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;

translated_text:
He delivered me from my strong enemy,
and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.
original_text:
He delivered me from my strong enemy,
and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.

translated_text: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
original_text: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

translated_text: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
original_text: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

translated_text: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
original_text: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

translated_text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
original_text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

translated_text:
For all his judgments
were before me: and
as for
 his statutes, I did not depart from them.
original_text:
For all his judgments
were before me: and
as for
 his statutes, I did not depart from them.

translated_text: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.
original_text: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.

translated_text: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.
original_text: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.

translated_text:
With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful,
and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.
original_text:
With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful,
and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.

translated_text: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.
original_text: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.

translated_text:
And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes
are
 upon the haughty,
that thou mayest bring
them down.
original_text:
And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes
are
 upon the haughty,
that thou mayest bring
them down.

translated_text:
For thou
art my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.
original_text:
For thou
art my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.

translated_text: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.
original_text: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.

translated_text:
As for God, his way
is perfect; the word of the LORD
is tried: he
is a buckler to all them that trust in him.
original_text:
As for God, his way
is perfect; the word of the LORD
is tried: he
is a buckler to all them that trust in him.

translated_text:
For who
is God, save the LORD? and who
is a rock, save our God?
original_text:
For who
is God, save the LORD? and who
is a rock, save our God?

translated_text:
God
is my strength
and power: and he maketh my way perfect.
original_text:
God
is my strength
and power: and he maketh my way perfect.

translated_text:
He maketh my feet like hinds
feet: and setteth me upon my high places.
original_text:
He maketh my feet like hinds
feet: and setteth me upon my high places.

translated_text: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
original_text: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

translated_text: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.
original_text: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.

translated_text: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.
original_text: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.

translated_text: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.
original_text: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.

translated_text: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.
original_text: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.

translated_text: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.
original_text: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.

translated_text: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.
original_text: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.

translated_text:
Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street,
and did spread them abroad.
original_text:
Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street,
and did spread them abroad.

translated_text:
Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me
to be head of the heathen: a people
which I knew not shall serve me.
original_text:
Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me
to be head of the heathen: a people
which I knew not shall serve me.

translated_text: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.
original_text: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.

translated_text: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.
original_text: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.

translated_text:
The LORD liveth; and blessed
be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
original_text:
The LORD liveth; and blessed
be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.

translated_text:
It
is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,
original_text:
It
is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,

translated_text: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
original_text: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

translated_text: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.
original_text: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.

translated_text: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.
original_text: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.

translated_text:
Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of the LORD. And the LORD answered,
It is
 for Saul, and for
his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.
original_text:
Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of the LORD. And the LORD answered,
It is
 for Saul, and for
his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.

translated_text:
And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites
were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)
original_text:
And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites
were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)

translated_text: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the LORD?
original_text: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the LORD?

translated_text:
And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say,
that will I do for you.
original_text:
And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say,
that will I do for you.

translated_text:
And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us
that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel,
original_text:
And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us
that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel,

translated_text:
Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the LORD in Gibeah of Saul,
whom the LORD did choose. And the king said, I will give
them.
original_text:
Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the LORD in Gibeah of Saul,
whom the LORD did choose. And the king said, I will give
them.

translated_text:
But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD’S oath that
was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
original_text:
But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD’S oath that
was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

translated_text: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:
original_text: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:

translated_text:
And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the LORD: and they fell
all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first
days,
 in the beginning of barley harvest.
original_text:
And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the LORD: and they fell
all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first
days,
 in the beginning of barley harvest.

translated_text: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.
original_text: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.

translated_text: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
original_text: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

translated_text: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh-gilead, which had stolen them from the street of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:
original_text: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh-gilead, which had stolen them from the street of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:

translated_text: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.
original_text: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.

translated_text: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.
original_text: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.

translated_text: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.
original_text: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.

translated_text:
And Ishbi-benob, which
was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear
weighed three hundred
shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new
sword, thought to have slain David.
original_text:
And Ishbi-benob, which
was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear
weighed three hundred
shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new
sword, thought to have slain David.

translated_text: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel.
original_text: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel.

translated_text:
And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which
was
 of the sons of the giant.
original_text:
And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which
was
 of the sons of the giant.

translated_text:
And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim, a Bethlehemite, slew
the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear
was like a weaver’s beam.
original_text:
And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim, a Bethlehemite, slew
the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear
was like a weaver’s beam.

translated_text:
And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of
great
 stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.
original_text:
And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of
great
 stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.

translated_text: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David slew him.
original_text: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David slew him.

translated_text: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
original_text: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

translated_text:
And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name
was
 Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.
original_text:
And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name
was
 Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.

translated_text:
So every man of Israel went up from after David,
and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.
original_text:
So every man of Israel went up from after David,
and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women
his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.
original_text:
And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women
his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.

translated_text: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.
original_text: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.

translated_text:
So Amasa went to assemble
the men of Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.
original_text:
So Amasa went to assemble
the men of Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.

translated_text:
And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than
did Absalom: take thou thy lord’s servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.
original_text:
And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than
did Absalom: take thou thy lord’s servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.

translated_text: And there went out after him Joab’s men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
original_text: And there went out after him Joab’s men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

translated_text:
When they
were at the great stone which
is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab’s garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle
with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.
original_text:
When they
were at the great stone which
is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab’s garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle
with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.

translated_text:
And Joab said to Amasa,
Art thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.
original_text:
And Joab said to Amasa,
Art thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.

translated_text:
But Amasa took no heed to the sword that
was in Joab’s hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth
rib, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.
original_text:
But Amasa took no heed to the sword that
was in Joab’s hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth
rib, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.

translated_text:
And one of Joab’s men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that
is for David,
let him go after Joab.
original_text:
And one of Joab’s men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that
is for David,
let him go after Joab.

translated_text: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.
original_text: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.

translated_text: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
original_text: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

translated_text: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Beth-maachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.
original_text: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Beth-maachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.

translated_text:
And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that
were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.
original_text:
And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that
were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.

translated_text: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.
original_text: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.

translated_text:
And when he was come near unto her, the woman said,
Art thou Joab? And he answered, I
am he. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.
original_text:
And when he was come near unto her, the woman said,
Art thou Joab? And he answered, I
am he. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.

translated_text:
Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask
counsel at Abel: and so they ended
the matter.
original_text:
Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask
counsel at Abel: and so they ended
the matter.

translated_text:
I
am one of them that are peaceable
and faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the LORD?
original_text:
I
am one of them that are peaceable
and faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the LORD?

translated_text: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.
original_text: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

translated_text:
The matter
is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king,
even
 against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.
original_text:
The matter
is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king,
even
 against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.

translated_text:
Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast
it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.
original_text:
Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast
it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.

translated_text:
Now Joab
was over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada
was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:
original_text:
Now Joab
was over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada
was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:

translated_text:
And Adoram
was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud
was recorder:
original_text:
And Adoram
was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud
was recorder:

translated_text:
And Sheva
was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar
were
 the priests:
original_text:
And Sheva
was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar
were
 the priests:

translated_text: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.
original_text: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.

translated_text:
And it came to pass
after many days, that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.
original_text:
And it came to pass
after many days, that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.

translated_text:
And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And
there was a sore famine in Samaria.
original_text:
And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And
there was a sore famine in Samaria.

translated_text:
And Ahab called Obadiah, which
was the governor of
his
 house. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly:
original_text:
And Ahab called Obadiah, which
was the governor of
his
 house. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly:

translated_text:
For it was
so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)
original_text:
For it was
so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

translated_text: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.
original_text: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.

translated_text: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
original_text: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

translated_text:
And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said,
Art thou that my lord Elijah?
original_text:
And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said,
Art thou that my lord Elijah?

translated_text:
And he answered him, I
am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah
is here.
original_text:
And he answered him, I
am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah
is here.

translated_text: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?
original_text: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?

translated_text:
As the LORD thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said,
He is
 not
there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.
original_text:
As the LORD thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said,
He is
 not
there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.

translated_text:
And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah
is here.
original_text:
And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah
is here.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the LORD shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the LORD from my youth.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the LORD shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the LORD from my youth.

translated_text: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the LORD, how I hid an hundred men of the LORD’S prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
original_text: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the LORD, how I hid an hundred men of the LORD’S prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

translated_text:
And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah
is here:
 and he shall slay me.
original_text:
And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah
is here:
 and he shall slay me.

translated_text:
And Elijah said,
As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.
original_text:
And Elijah said,
As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.

translated_text: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
original_text: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him,
Art thou he that troubleth Israel?
original_text:
And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him,
Art thou he that troubleth Israel?

translated_text: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father’s house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD, and thou hast followed Baalim.
original_text: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father’s house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD, and thou hast followed Baalim.

translated_text:
Now therefore send,
and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel’s table.
original_text:
Now therefore send,
and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel’s table.

translated_text: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.
original_text: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.

translated_text:
And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD
be God, follow him: but if Baal,
then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.
original_text:
And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD
be God, follow him: but if Baal,
then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.

translated_text:
Then said Elijah unto the people, I,
even I only, remain a prophet of the LORD; but Baal’s prophets
are four hundred and fifty men.
original_text:
Then said Elijah unto the people, I,
even I only, remain a prophet of the LORD; but Baal’s prophets
are four hundred and fifty men.

translated_text:
Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay
it on wood, and put no fire
under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay
it
 on wood, and put no fire
under:
original_text:
Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay
it on wood, and put no fire
under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay
it
 on wood, and put no fire
under:

translated_text: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD: and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.
original_text: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD: and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.

translated_text:
And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress
it first; for ye
are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire
under.
original_text:
And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress
it first; for ye
are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire
under.

translated_text:
And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed
it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But
there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.
original_text:
And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed
it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But
there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.

translated_text:
And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he
is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey,
or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.
original_text:
And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he
is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey,
or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.

translated_text: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.
original_text: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the
time of the offering of the
evening sacrifice, that
there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the
time of the offering of the
evening sacrifice, that
there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.

translated_text:
And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD
that was broken down.
original_text:
And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD
that was broken down.

translated_text: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:
original_text: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:

translated_text: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.
original_text: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.

translated_text:
And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid
him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour
it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.
original_text:
And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid
him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour
it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.

translated_text:
And he said, Do
it the second time. And they did
it
 the second time. And he said, Do
it the third time. And they did
it the third time.
original_text:
And he said, Do
it the second time. And they did
it
 the second time. And he said, Do
it the third time. And they did
it the third time.

translated_text: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.
original_text: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.

translated_text:
And it came to pass at
the time of the offering of the
evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and
that I
am thy servant, and
that
 I have done all these things at thy word.
original_text:
And it came to pass at
the time of the offering of the
evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and
that I
am thy servant, and
that
 I have done all these things at thy word.

translated_text:
Hear me, O LORD, hear me, that this people may know that thou
art the LORD God, and
that thou hast turned their heart back again.
original_text:
Hear me, O LORD, hear me, that this people may know that thou
art the LORD God, and
that thou hast turned their heart back again.

translated_text:
Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that
was in the trench.
original_text:
Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that
was in the trench.

translated_text:
And when all the people saw
it, they fell on their faces: and they said, The LORD, he
is the God; the LORD, he
is the God.
original_text:
And when all the people saw
it, they fell on their faces: and they said, The LORD, he
is the God; the LORD, he
is the God.

translated_text: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.
original_text: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.

translated_text:
And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for
there is a sound of abundance of rain.
original_text:
And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for
there is a sound of abundance of rain.

translated_text: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,
original_text: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,

translated_text:
And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said,
There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.
original_text:
And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said,
There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.

translated_text:
And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man’s hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare
thy chariot, and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.
original_text:
And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man’s hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare
thy chariot, and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.

translated_text: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
original_text: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

translated_text: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
original_text: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

translated_text:
And Elijah the Tishbite,
who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab,
As the LORD God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.
original_text:
And Elijah the Tishbite,
who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab,
As the LORD God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,

translated_text:
Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that
is before Jordan.
original_text:
Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that
is before Jordan.

translated_text:
And it shall be,
that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.
original_text:
And it shall be,
that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.

translated_text:
So he went and did according unto the word of the LORD: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that
is before Jordan.
original_text:
So he went and did according unto the word of the LORD: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that
is before Jordan.

translated_text: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
original_text: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.

translated_text: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.
original_text: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,

translated_text:
Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which
belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.
original_text:
Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which
belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.

translated_text:
So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman
was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.
original_text:
So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman
was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.

translated_text:
And as she was going to fetch
it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.
original_text:
And as she was going to fetch
it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.

translated_text:
And she said,
As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I
am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
original_text:
And she said,
As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I
am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.

translated_text:
And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go
and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring
it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.
original_text:
And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go
and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring
it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.

translated_text:
For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day
that
 the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.
original_text:
For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day
that
 the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.

translated_text:
And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat
many days.
original_text:
And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat
many days.

translated_text: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.
original_text: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.

translated_text:
And it came to pass after these things,
that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.
original_text:
And it came to pass after these things,
that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.

translated_text: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?
original_text: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?

translated_text: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.
original_text: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.

translated_text: And he cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?
original_text: And he cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?

translated_text: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, I pray thee, let this child’s soul come into him again.
original_text: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, I pray thee, let this child’s soul come into him again.

translated_text: And the LORD heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
original_text: And the LORD heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

translated_text: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.
original_text: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.

translated_text:
And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou
art
 a man of God,
and that the word of the LORD in thy mouth
is truth.
original_text:
And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou
art
 a man of God,
and that the word of the LORD in thy mouth
is truth.

translated_text: Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
original_text: Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

translated_text: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;
original_text: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;

translated_text: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
original_text: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

translated_text: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.
original_text: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

translated_text: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the LORD against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD, in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.
original_text: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the LORD against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD, in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.

translated_text: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.
original_text: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.

translated_text:
And his servant Zimri, captain of half
his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of
his house in Tirzah.
original_text:
And his servant Zimri, captain of half
his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of
his house in Tirzah.

translated_text: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne,
that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne,
that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.

translated_text: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,
original_text: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

translated_text: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
original_text: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

translated_text:
In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people
were encamped against Gibbethon, which
belonged to the Philistines.
original_text:
In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people
were encamped against Gibbethon, which
belonged to the Philistines.

translated_text:
And the people
that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.
original_text:
And the people
that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.

translated_text: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
original_text: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king’s house, and burnt the king’s house over him with fire, and died,
original_text: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king’s house, and burnt the king’s house over him with fire, and died,

translated_text: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.
original_text: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

translated_text: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.
original_text: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.

translated_text: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
original_text: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

translated_text: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.
original_text: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.

translated_text: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.
original_text: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.

translated_text:
But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD, and did worse than all that
were before him.
original_text:
But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD, and did worse than all that
were before him.

translated_text: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
original_text: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

translated_text: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.
original_text: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.

translated_text:
And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all that
were before him.
original_text:
And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all that
were before him.

translated_text: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.
original_text: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.

translated_text: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
original_text: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

translated_text: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.
original_text: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.

translated_text:
In his days did Hiel the Bethelite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest
son Segub, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.
original_text:
In his days did Hiel the Bethelite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest
son Segub, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.

translated_text: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.
original_text: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.

translated_text:
Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was
 Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
original_text:
Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was
 Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

translated_text: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.
original_text: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.

translated_text: Nevertheless for David’s sake did the LORD his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:
original_text: Nevertheless for David’s sake did the LORD his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:

translated_text:
Because David did
that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, and turned not aside from any
thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
original_text:
Because David did
that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, and turned not aside from any
thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

translated_text: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
original_text: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

translated_text: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.
original_text: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.

translated_text:
And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
original_text:
And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

translated_text:
And Asa did
that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, as
did David his father.
original_text:
And Asa did
that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, as
did David his father.

translated_text: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
original_text: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

translated_text:
And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from
being
 queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt
it by the brook Kidron.
original_text:
And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from
being
 queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt
it by the brook Kidron.

translated_text: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa’s heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.
original_text: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa’s heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.

translated_text: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD, silver, and gold, and vessels.
original_text: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD, silver, and gold, and vessels.

translated_text: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
original_text: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

translated_text: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
original_text: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

translated_text:
Then Asa took all the silver and the gold
that were left in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Ben-hadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
original_text:
Then Asa took all the silver and the gold
that were left in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Ben-hadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

translated_text:
There is a league between me and thee,
and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
original_text:
There is a league between me and thee,
and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

translated_text: So Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-beth-maachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
original_text: So Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-beth-maachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when Baasha heard
thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when Baasha heard
thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.

translated_text:
Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none
was
 exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
original_text:
Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none
was
 exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

translated_text:
The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
original_text:
The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

translated_text: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.
original_text: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.

translated_text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
