original_text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.

translated_text:
And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which
belonged
 to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.
original_text:
And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which
belonged
 to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.

translated_text: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.
original_text: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when he reigned,
that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:
original_text:
And it came to pass, when he reigned,
that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:

translated_text: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger.
original_text: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

translated_text: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
original_text: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

translated_text: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.
original_text: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.

translated_text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
original_text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.

translated_text: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.
original_text: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.

translated_text:
Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do
to me, and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.
original_text:
Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do
to me, and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.

translated_text:
And when he saw
that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beer-sheba, which
belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.
original_text:
And when he saw
that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beer-sheba, which
belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.

translated_text:
But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O LORD, take away my life; for I
am not better than my fathers.
original_text:
But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O LORD, take away my life; for I
am not better than my fathers.

translated_text:
And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise
and eat.
original_text:
And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise
and eat.

translated_text:
And he looked, and, behold,
there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.
original_text:
And he looked, and, behold,
there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.

translated_text:
And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise
and eat; because the journey
is too great for thee.
original_text:
And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise
and eat; because the journey
is too great for thee.

translated_text: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.
original_text: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.

translated_text:
And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of the LORD
came to him, and he said unto him, What doest thou here, Elijah?
original_text:
And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of the LORD
came to him, and he said unto him, What doest thou here, Elijah?

translated_text:
And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I,
even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
original_text:
And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I,
even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

translated_text:
And after the earthquake a fire;
but the LORD
was
 not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
original_text:
And after the earthquake a fire;
but the LORD
was
 not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

translated_text:
And it was
so, when Elijah heard
it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold,
there came a voice unto him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?
original_text:
And it was
so, when Elijah heard
it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold,
there came a voice unto him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?

translated_text:
And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I,
even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
original_text:
And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I,
even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when thou comest, anoint Hazael
to be king over Syria:
original_text:
And the LORD said unto him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when thou comest, anoint Hazael
to be king over Syria:

translated_text:
And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint
to be king over Israel: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah shalt thou anoint
to be prophet in thy room.
original_text:
And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint
to be king over Israel: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah shalt thou anoint
to be prophet in thy room.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.

translated_text:
Yet I have left
me seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which hath not kissed him.
original_text:
Yet I have left
me seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which hath not kissed him.

translated_text:
So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who
was plowing
with twelve yoke
of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.
original_text:
So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who
was plowing
with twelve yoke
of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.

translated_text:
And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray thee, kiss my father and my mother, and
then I will follow thee. And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to thee?
original_text:
And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray thee, kiss my father and my mother, and
then I will follow thee. And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to thee?

translated_text: And he returned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave unto the people, and they did eat. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and ministered unto him.
original_text: And he returned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave unto the people, and they did eat. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and ministered unto him.

translated_text: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard questions.
original_text: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard questions.

translated_text: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
original_text: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

translated_text:
And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not
any
 thing hid from the king, which he told her not.
original_text:
And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not
any
 thing hid from the king, which he told her not.

translated_text: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon’s wisdom, and the house that he had built,
original_text: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon’s wisdom, and the house that he had built,

translated_text: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.
original_text: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.

translated_text: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom.
original_text: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom.

translated_text:
Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen
it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.
original_text:
Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen
it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.

translated_text:
Happy
are thy men, happy
are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee,
and that hear thy wisdom.
original_text:
Happy
are thy men, happy
are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee,
and that hear thy wisdom.

translated_text: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the LORD loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.
original_text: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the LORD loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.

translated_text: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
original_text: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.

translated_text: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.
original_text: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.

translated_text: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD, and for the king’s house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.
original_text: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD, and for the king’s house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.

translated_text:
And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside
that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.
original_text:
And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside
that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.

translated_text: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold.
original_text: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold.

translated_text:
Beside
that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.
original_text:
Beside
that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.

translated_text:
And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred
shekels of gold went to one target.
original_text:
And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred
shekels of gold went to one target.

translated_text: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
original_text: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

translated_text: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.
original_text: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.

translated_text:
The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne
was round behind: and
there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.
original_text:
The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne
was round behind: and
there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.

translated_text: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.
original_text: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.

translated_text:
And all king Solomon’s drinking vessels
were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon
were of pure gold; none
were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
original_text:
And all king Solomon’s drinking vessels
were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon
were of pure gold; none
were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

translated_text: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
original_text: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

translated_text: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.
original_text: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.

translated_text: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
original_text: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

translated_text: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
original_text: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

translated_text: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.
original_text: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And the king made silver
to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he
to be as the sycomore trees that
are in the vale, for abundance.
original_text:
And the king made silver
to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he
to be as the sycomore trees that
are in the vale, for abundance.

translated_text: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
original_text: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

translated_text:
And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred
shekels
 of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring
them
 out by their means.
original_text:
And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred
shekels
 of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring
them
 out by their means.

translated_text: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.
original_text: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.

translated_text:
And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there
is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that
I should be king over this people.
original_text:
And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there
is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that
I should be king over this people.

translated_text: And take with thee ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child.
original_text: And take with thee ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child.

translated_text: And Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
original_text: And Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her: for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall feign herself
to be another
woman.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her: for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall feign herself
to be another
woman.

translated_text:
And it was
so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself
to be another? for I
am sent to thee
with heavy
tidings.
original_text:
And it was
so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself
to be another? for I
am sent to thee
with heavy
tidings.

translated_text: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,
original_text: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,

translated_text:
And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do
that only
which was
 right in mine eyes;
original_text:
And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do
that only
which was
 right in mine eyes;

translated_text: But hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:
original_text: But hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:

translated_text:
Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall,
and
 him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.
original_text:
Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall,
and
 him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.

translated_text: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the LORD hath spoken it.
original_text: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the LORD hath spoken it.

translated_text:
Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house:
and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.
original_text:
Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house:
and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.

translated_text:
And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found
some
 good thing toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.
original_text:
And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found
some
 good thing toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.

translated_text: Moreover the LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.
original_text: Moreover the LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.

translated_text: For the LORD shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the LORD to anger.
original_text: For the LORD shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the LORD to anger.

translated_text: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.
original_text: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.

translated_text: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.
original_text: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.

translated_text:
And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they
are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
original_text:
And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they
are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

translated_text:
And the days which Jeroboam reigned
were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.
original_text:
And the days which Jeroboam reigned
were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam
was
 forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD did choose out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother’s name
was Naamah an Ammonitess.
original_text:
And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam
was
 forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD did choose out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother’s name
was Naamah an Ammonitess.

translated_text: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.
original_text: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.

translated_text: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.
original_text: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.

translated_text:
And there were also sodomites in the land:
and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
original_text:
And there were also sodomites in the land:
and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam,
that
 Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:
original_text:
And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam,
that
 Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:

translated_text: And he took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king’s house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
original_text: And he took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king’s house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

translated_text:
And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed
them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king’s house.
original_text:
And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed
them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king’s house.

translated_text:
And it was
so, when the king went into the house of the LORD, that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.
original_text:
And it was
so, when the king went into the house of the LORD, that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

translated_text:
And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all
their
 days.
original_text:
And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all
their
 days.

translated_text:
And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother’s name
was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.
original_text:
And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother’s name
was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the LORD unto Bethel: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.
original_text: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the LORD unto Bethel: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.

translated_text: And he cried against the altar in the word of the LORD, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the LORD; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men’s bones shall be burnt upon thee.
original_text: And he cried against the altar in the word of the LORD, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the LORD; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men’s bones shall be burnt upon thee.

translated_text:
And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This
is the sign which the LORD hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that
are upon it shall be poured out.
original_text:
And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This
is the sign which the LORD hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that
are upon it shall be poured out.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Bethel, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.
original_text: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Bethel, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.

translated_text: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the LORD.
original_text: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the LORD.

translated_text:
And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the LORD thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored him again, and became as
it was before.
original_text:
And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the LORD thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored him again, and became as
it was before.

translated_text: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.
original_text: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.

translated_text: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:
original_text: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:

translated_text: For so was it charged me by the word of the LORD, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.
original_text: For so was it charged me by the word of the LORD, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.

translated_text: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Bethel.
original_text: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Bethel.

translated_text: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Bethel; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.
original_text: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Bethel; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.

translated_text: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.
original_text: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.

translated_text: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,
original_text: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,

translated_text:
And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him,
Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I
am.
original_text:
And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him,
Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I
am.

translated_text: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.
original_text: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.

translated_text: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:
original_text: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:

translated_text: For it was said to me by the word of the LORD, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.
original_text: For it was said to me by the word of the LORD, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.

translated_text:
He said unto him, I
am a prophet also as thou
art;
 and an angel spake unto me by the word of the LORD, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water.
But he lied unto him.
original_text:
He said unto him, I
am a prophet also as thou
art;
 and an angel spake unto me by the word of the LORD, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water.
But he lied unto him.

translated_text: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.
original_text: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.

translated_text: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the LORD came unto the prophet that brought him back:
original_text: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the LORD came unto the prophet that brought him back:

translated_text: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the LORD, and hast not kept the commandment which the LORD thy God commanded thee,
original_text: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the LORD, and hast not kept the commandment which the LORD thy God commanded thee,

translated_text:
But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which
the LORD did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.
original_text:
But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which
the LORD did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass,
to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.
original_text:
And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass,
to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.

translated_text: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.
original_text: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.

translated_text: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.
original_text: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.

translated_text:
And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard
thereof, he said, It
is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the LORD: therefore the LORD hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake unto him.
original_text:
And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard
thereof, he said, It
is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the LORD: therefore the LORD hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake unto him.

translated_text:
And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled
him.
original_text:
And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled
him.

translated_text: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.
original_text: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.

translated_text: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.
original_text: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.

translated_text:
And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him,
saying, Alas, my brother!
original_text:
And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him,
saying, Alas, my brother!

translated_text:
And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God
is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:
original_text:
And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God
is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:

translated_text:
For the saying which he cried by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which
are
 in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.
original_text:
For the saying which he cried by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which
are
 in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.

translated_text:
After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became
one of the priests of the high places.
original_text:
After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became
one of the priests of the high places.

translated_text:
And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut
it off, and to destroy
it from off the face of the earth.
original_text:
And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut
it off, and to destroy
it from off the face of the earth.

translated_text: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.
original_text: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard
of it, (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)
original_text:
And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard
of it, (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)

translated_text: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,
original_text: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,

translated_text: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.
original_text: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.

translated_text:
And he said unto them, Depart yet
for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.
original_text:
And he said unto them, Depart yet
for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.

translated_text: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?
original_text: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?

translated_text: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.
original_text: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.

translated_text:
But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him,
and which stood before him:
original_text:
But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him,
and which stood before him:

translated_text: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?
original_text: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?

translated_text:
And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou
it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little
finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.
original_text:
And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou
it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little
finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.

translated_text: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
original_text: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

translated_text: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.
original_text: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.

translated_text: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men’s counsel that they gave him;
original_text: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men’s counsel that they gave him;

translated_text:
And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father
also
 chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
original_text:
And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father
also
 chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

translated_text: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from the LORD, that he might perform his saying, which the LORD spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
original_text: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from the LORD, that he might perform his saying, which the LORD spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

translated_text:
So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither
have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.
original_text:
So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither
have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.

translated_text:
But
as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
original_text:
But
as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

translated_text:
Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who
was over the tribute; and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
original_text:
Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who
was over the tribute; and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

translated_text: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
original_text: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.
original_text: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.

translated_text: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
original_text: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

translated_text: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
original_text: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

translated_text: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
original_text: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of the LORD, and returned to depart, according to the word of the LORD.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of the LORD, and returned to depart, according to the word of the LORD.

translated_text: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.
original_text: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.

translated_text: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:
original_text: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:

translated_text:
If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord,
even unto Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.
original_text:
If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord,
even unto Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.

translated_text:
Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves
of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
original_text:
Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves
of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And he set the one in Bethel, and the other put he in Dan.
original_text: And he set the one in Bethel, and the other put he in Dan.

translated_text:
And this thing became a sin: for the people went
to worship
 before the one,
even unto Dan.
original_text:
And this thing became a sin: for the people went
to worship
 before the one,
even unto Dan.

translated_text: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.
original_text: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.

translated_text:
And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that
is in Judah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Bethel, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places which he had made.
original_text:
And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that
is in Judah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Bethel, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places which he had made.

translated_text:
So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Bethel the fifteenth day of the eighth month,
even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.
original_text:
So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Bethel the fifteenth day of the eighth month,
even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.

translated_text:
Of the nations
concerning which the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you:
for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.
original_text:
Of the nations
concerning which the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you:
for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.

translated_text: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.
original_text: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.

translated_text:
For it came to pass, when Solomon was old,
that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as
was the heart of David his father.
original_text:
For it came to pass, when Solomon was old,
that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as
was the heart of David his father.

translated_text: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
original_text: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

translated_text:
And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD, and went not fully after the LORD, as
did David his father.
original_text:
And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD, and went not fully after the LORD, as
did David his father.

translated_text:
Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that
is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.
original_text:
Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that
is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.

translated_text: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
original_text: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.

translated_text: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,
original_text: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,

translated_text: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.
original_text: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.

translated_text: Wherefore the LORD said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.
original_text: Wherefore the LORD said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.

translated_text:
Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father’s sake:
but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.
original_text:
Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father’s sake:
but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.

translated_text:
Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom;
but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.
original_text:
Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom;
but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.

translated_text:
And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he
was of the king’s seed in Edom.
original_text:
And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he
was of the king’s seed in Edom.

translated_text: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;
original_text: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;

translated_text: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)
original_text: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)

translated_text:
That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad
being yet a little child.
original_text:
That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad
being yet a little child.

translated_text: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.
original_text: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.

translated_text: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
original_text: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

translated_text: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s household among the sons of Pharaoh.
original_text: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s household among the sons of Pharaoh.

translated_text: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.
original_text: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.

translated_text: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.
original_text: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.

translated_text:
And God stirred him up
another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:
original_text:
And God stirred him up
another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:

translated_text:
And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them
of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.
original_text:
And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them
of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.

translated_text:
And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad
did: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
original_text:
And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad
did: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

translated_text:
And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon’s servant, whose mother’s name
was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up
his hand against the king.
original_text:
And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon’s servant, whose mother’s name
was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up
his hand against the king.

translated_text:
And this
was the cause that he lifted up
his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo,
and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.
original_text:
And this
was the cause that he lifted up
his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo,
and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.

translated_text:
And the man Jeroboam
was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.
original_text:
And the man Jeroboam
was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.

translated_text:
And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two
were alone in the field:
original_text:
And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two
were alone in the field:

translated_text:
And Ahijah caught the new garment that
was on him, and rent it
in twelve pieces:
original_text:
And Ahijah caught the new garment that
was on him, and rent it
in twelve pieces:

translated_text: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:
original_text: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:

translated_text: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)
original_text: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)

translated_text:
Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do
that which is right in mine eyes, and
to keep my statutes and my judgments, as
did David his father.
original_text:
Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do
that which is right in mine eyes, and
to keep my statutes and my judgments, as
did David his father.

translated_text: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:
original_text: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:

translated_text:
But I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand, and will give it unto thee,
even ten tribes.
original_text:
But I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand, and will give it unto thee,
even ten tribes.

translated_text: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.
original_text: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.

translated_text: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.
original_text: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.

translated_text:
And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do
that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.
original_text:
And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do
that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.

translated_text: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.
original_text: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.

translated_text: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
original_text: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

translated_text:
And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom,
are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
original_text:
And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom,
are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

translated_text:
And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel
was forty years.
original_text:
And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel
was forty years.

translated_text: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
And it came to pass after these things,
that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which
was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
original_text:
And it came to pass after these things,
that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which
was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

translated_text: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.
original_text: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.

translated_text: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him: for he had said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers. And he laid him down upon his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.
original_text: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him: for he had said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers. And he laid him down upon his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.

translated_text: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said unto him, Why is thy spirit so sad, that thou eatest no bread?
original_text: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said unto him, Why is thy spirit so sad, that thou eatest no bread?

translated_text:
And he said unto her, Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite, and said unto him, Give me thy vineyard for money; or else, if it please thee, I will give thee
another vineyard for it: and he answered, I will not give thee my vineyard.
original_text:
And he said unto her, Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite, and said unto him, Give me thy vineyard for money; or else, if it please thee, I will give thee
another vineyard for it: and he answered, I will not give thee my vineyard.

translated_text:
And Jezebel his wife said unto him, Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel? arise,
and eat bread, and let thine heart be merry: I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.
original_text:
And Jezebel his wife said unto him, Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel? arise,
and eat bread, and let thine heart be merry: I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.

translated_text:
So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name, and sealed
them with his seal, and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that
were
 in his city, dwelling with Naboth.
original_text:
So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name, and sealed
them with his seal, and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that
were
 in his city, dwelling with Naboth.

translated_text: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people:
original_text: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people:

translated_text:
And set two men, sons of Belial, before him, to bear witness against him, saying, Thou didst blaspheme God and the king. And
then carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.
original_text:
And set two men, sons of Belial, before him, to bear witness against him, saying, Thou didst blaspheme God and the king. And
then carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.

translated_text:
And the men of his city,
even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them,
and as it
was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.
original_text:
And the men of his city,
even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them,
and as it
was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.

translated_text: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
original_text: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

translated_text:
And there came in two men, children of Belial, and sat before him: and the men of Belial witnessed against him,
even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth did blaspheme God and the king. Then they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.
original_text:
And there came in two men, children of Belial, and sat before him: and the men of Belial witnessed against him,
even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth did blaspheme God and the king. Then they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.

translated_text: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.
original_text: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.
original_text: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
original_text: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

translated_text:
Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, which
is in Samaria: behold,
he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to possess it.
original_text:
Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, which
is in Samaria: behold,
he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to possess it.

translated_text: And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou killed, and also taken possession? And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood, even thine.
original_text: And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou killed, and also taken possession? And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood, even thine.

translated_text:
And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast thou found me, O mine enemy? And he answered, I have found
thee: because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the LORD.
original_text:
And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast thou found me, O mine enemy? And he answered, I have found
thee: because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the LORD.

translated_text: Behold, I will bring evil upon thee, and will take away thy posterity, and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel,
original_text: Behold, I will bring evil upon thee, and will take away thy posterity, and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel,

translated_text:
And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked
me to anger, and made Israel to sin.
original_text:
And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked
me to anger, and made Israel to sin.

translated_text: And of Jezebel also spake the LORD, saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.
original_text: And of Jezebel also spake the LORD, saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.

translated_text: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.
original_text: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.

translated_text: But there was none like unto Ahab, which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the LORD, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.
original_text: But there was none like unto Ahab, which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the LORD, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.

translated_text:
And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all
things as did the Amorites, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
original_text:
And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all
things as did the Amorites, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.
original_text: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

translated_text:
Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days:
but in his son’s days will I bring the evil upon his house.
original_text:
Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days:
but in his son’s days will I bring the evil upon his house.

translated_text:
And Ben-hadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and
there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots: and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.
original_text:
And Ben-hadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and
there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots: and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.

translated_text: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said unto him, Thus saith Ben-hadad,
original_text: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said unto him, Thus saith Ben-hadad,

translated_text:
Thy silver and thy gold
is mine; thy wives also and thy children,
even the goodliest,
are mine.
original_text:
Thy silver and thy gold
is mine; thy wives also and thy children,
even the goodliest,
are mine.
