translated_text:
And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I
am thine, and all that I have.
original_text:
And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I
am thine, and all that I have.

translated_text: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Ben-hadad, saying, Although I have sent unto thee, saying, Thou shalt deliver me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;
original_text: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Ben-hadad, saying, Although I have sent unto thee, saying, Thou shalt deliver me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;

translated_text:
Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be,
that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put
it in their hand, and take
it away.
original_text:
Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be,
that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put
it in their hand, and take
it away.

translated_text:
Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this
man seeketh mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.
original_text:
Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this
man seeketh mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.

translated_text:
And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not
unto him, nor consent.
original_text:
And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not
unto him, nor consent.

translated_text: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Ben-hadad, Tell my lord the king, All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.
original_text: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Ben-hadad, Tell my lord the king, All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.

translated_text: And Ben-hadad sent unto him, and said, The gods do so unto me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.
original_text: And Ben-hadad sent unto him, and said, The gods do so unto me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.

translated_text:
And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell
him, Let not him that girdeth on
his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.
original_text:
And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell
him, Let not him that girdeth on
his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when
Ben-hadad heard this message, as he
was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, that he said unto his servants, Set
yourselves in array. And they set
themselves in array against the city.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when
Ben-hadad heard this message, as he
was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, that he said unto his servants, Set
yourselves in array. And they set
themselves in array against the city.

translated_text:
And, behold, there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into thine hand this day; and thou shalt know that I
am
 the LORD.
original_text:
And, behold, there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into thine hand this day; and thou shalt know that I
am
 the LORD.

translated_text:
And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus saith the LORD,
Even
 by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, Thou.
original_text:
And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus saith the LORD,
Even
 by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, Thou.

translated_text:
Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people,
even all the children of Israel,
being seven thousand.
original_text:
Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people,
even all the children of Israel,
being seven thousand.

translated_text:
And they went out at noon. But Ben-hadad
was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped him.
original_text:
And they went out at noon. But Ben-hadad
was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped him.

translated_text: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben-hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.
original_text: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben-hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.

translated_text: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.
original_text: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.

translated_text: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.
original_text: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.

translated_text: And they slew every one his man: and the Syrians fled; and Israel pursued them: and Ben-hadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen.
original_text: And they slew every one his man: and the Syrians fled; and Israel pursued them: and Ben-hadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen.

translated_text: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.
original_text: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.

translated_text: And the prophet came to the king of Israel, and said unto him, Go, strengthen thyself, and mark, and see what thou doest: for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee.
original_text: And the prophet came to the king of Israel, and said unto him, Go, strengthen thyself, and mark, and see what thou doest: for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee.

translated_text:
And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him, Their gods
are gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.
original_text:
And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him, Their gods
are gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.

translated_text: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:
original_text: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:

translated_text:
And number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain,
and surely we shall be stronger than they. And he hearkened unto their voice, and did so.
original_text:
And number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain,
and surely we shall be stronger than they. And he hearkened unto their voice, and did so.

translated_text: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Ben-hadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.
original_text: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Ben-hadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.

translated_text: And the children of Israel were numbered, and were all present, and went against them: and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.
original_text: And the children of Israel were numbered, and were all present, and went against them: and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.

translated_text:
And there came a man of God, and spake unto the king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the LORD, Because the Syrians have said, The LORD
is
 God of the hills, but he
is not God of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand, and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And there came a man of God, and spake unto the king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the LORD, Because the Syrians have said, The LORD
is
 God of the hills, but he
is not God of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand, and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: And they pitched one over against the other seven days. And so it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.
original_text: And they pitched one over against the other seven days. And so it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.

translated_text:
But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and
there a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men
that were left. And Ben-hadad fled, and came into the city, into an inner chamber.
original_text:
But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and
there a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men
that were left. And Ben-hadad fled, and came into the city, into an inner chamber.

translated_text:
And his servants said unto him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel
are merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel: peradventure he will save thy life.
original_text:
And his servants said unto him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel
are merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel: peradventure he will save thy life.

translated_text:
So they girded sackcloth on their loins, and
put ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, Thy servant Ben-hadad saith, I pray thee, let me live. And he said,
Is he yet alive? he is my brother.
original_text:
So they girded sackcloth on their loins, and
put ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, Thy servant Ben-hadad saith, I pray thee, let me live. And he said,
Is he yet alive? he is my brother.

translated_text:
Now the men did diligently observe whether
any thing would come
 from him, and did hastily catch
it: and they said, Thy brother Ben-hadad. Then he said, Go ye, bring him. Then Ben-hadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.
original_text:
Now the men did diligently observe whether
any thing would come
 from him, and did hastily catch
it: and they said, Thy brother Ben-hadad. Then he said, Go ye, bring him. Then Ben-hadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

translated_text:
And
Ben-hadad said unto him, The cities, which my father took from thy father, I will restore; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then
said Ahab, I will send thee away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.
original_text:
And
Ben-hadad said unto him, The cities, which my father took from thy father, I will restore; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then
said Ahab, I will send thee away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.

translated_text: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the LORD, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man refused to smite him.
original_text: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the LORD, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man refused to smite him.

translated_text: Then said he unto him, Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the LORD, behold, as soon as thou art departed from me, a lion shall slay thee. And as soon as he was departed from him, a lion found him, and slew him.
original_text: Then said he unto him, Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the LORD, behold, as soon as thou art departed from me, a lion shall slay thee. And as soon as he was departed from him, a lion found him, and slew him.

translated_text:
Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded
him.
original_text:
Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded
him.

translated_text: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.
original_text: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.

translated_text: And as the king passed by, he cried unto the king: and he said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver.
original_text: And as the king passed by, he cried unto the king: and he said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver.

translated_text:
And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Israel said unto him, So
shall thy judgment
be; thyself hast decided
it.
original_text:
And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Israel said unto him, So
shall thy judgment
be; thyself hast decided
it.

translated_text:
And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Israel discerned him that he
was of the prophets.
original_text:
And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Israel discerned him that he
was of the prophets.

translated_text:
And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Because thou hast let go out of
thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore thy life shall go for his life, and thy people for his people.
original_text:
And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Because thou hast let go out of
thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore thy life shall go for his life, and thy people for his people.

translated_text: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased, and came to Samaria.
original_text: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased, and came to Samaria.

translated_text: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.
original_text: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

translated_text: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.
original_text: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

translated_text:
And the king of Israel said unto his servants, Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead
is ours, and we
be still,
and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?
original_text:
And the king of Israel said unto his servants, Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead
is ours, and we
be still,
and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?

translated_text:
And he said unto Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramoth-gilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I
am as thou
art, my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.
original_text:
And he said unto Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramoth-gilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I
am as thou
art, my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.

translated_text: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.
original_text: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.

translated_text:
Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the Lord shall deliver
it into the hand of the king.
original_text:
Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the Lord shall deliver
it into the hand of the king.

translated_text:
And Jehoshaphat said,
Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?
original_text:
And Jehoshaphat said,
Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?

translated_text:
And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat,
There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
original_text:
And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat,
There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

translated_text:
Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten
hither
 Micaiah the son of Imlah.
original_text:
Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten
hither
 Micaiah the son of Imlah.

translated_text: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
original_text: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

translated_text: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus saith the LORD, With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have consumed them.
original_text: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus saith the LORD, With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have consumed them.

translated_text:
And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver
it into the king’s hand.
original_text:
And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver
it into the king’s hand.

translated_text:
And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets
declare good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak
that which is good.
original_text:
And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets
declare good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak
that which is good.

translated_text:
And Micaiah said,
As the LORD liveth, what the LORD saith unto me, that will I speak.
original_text:
And Micaiah said,
As the LORD liveth, what the LORD saith unto me, that will I speak.

translated_text:
So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver
it into the hand of the king.
original_text:
So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver
it into the hand of the king.

translated_text:
And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but
that which is true in the name of the LORD?
original_text:
And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but
that which is true in the name of the LORD?

translated_text: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.
original_text: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.

translated_text: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?
original_text: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?

translated_text: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
original_text: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

translated_text: And the LORD said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.
original_text: And the LORD said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.

translated_text: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will persuade him.
original_text: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will persuade him.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade
him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade
him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.

translated_text: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil concerning thee.
original_text: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil concerning thee.

translated_text: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?
original_text: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?

translated_text: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
original_text: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

translated_text: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;
original_text: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;

translated_text:
And say, Thus saith the king, Put this
fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.
original_text:
And say, Thus saith the king, Put this
fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.

translated_text: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the LORD hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.
original_text: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the LORD hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.

translated_text: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.
original_text: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.

translated_text: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.
original_text: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.

translated_text: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.
original_text: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it
is the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it
is the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it
was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it
was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.

translated_text:
And a
certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
original_text:
And a
certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

translated_text: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.
original_text: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.

translated_text: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.
original_text: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.

translated_text: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
original_text: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

translated_text:
And
one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the LORD which he spake.
original_text:
And
one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the LORD which he spake.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

translated_text: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
original_text: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

translated_text:
Jehoshaphat
was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
original_text:
Jehoshaphat
was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

translated_text: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
original_text: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

translated_text: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.
original_text: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.

translated_text:
There was then no king in Edom: a deputy
was king.
original_text:
There was then no king in Edom: a deputy
was king.

translated_text: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Ezion-geber.
original_text: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Ezion-geber.

translated_text: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.
original_text: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.

translated_text: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.
original_text: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.

translated_text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:
original_text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:

translated_text: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the LORD God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.
original_text: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the LORD God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD, and the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,
original_text: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD, and the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,

translated_text: That the LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.
original_text: That the LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.
original_text: And the LORD said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

translated_text:
And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee,
and wilt keep my statutes and my judgments:
original_text:
And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee,
and wilt keep my statutes and my judgments:

translated_text: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.
original_text: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.

translated_text:
But if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments
and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:
original_text:
But if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments
and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:

translated_text: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:
original_text: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:

translated_text:
And at this house,
which is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and to this house?
original_text:
And at this house,
which is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and to this house?

translated_text: And they shall answer, Because they forsook the LORD their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the LORD brought upon them all this evil.
original_text: And they shall answer, Because they forsook the LORD their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the LORD brought upon them all this evil.

translated_text: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the LORD, and the king’s house,
original_text: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the LORD, and the king’s house,

translated_text: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
original_text: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

translated_text: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.
original_text: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.

translated_text:
And he said, What cities
are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.
original_text:
And he said, What cities
are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.

translated_text: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.
original_text: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.

translated_text:
And this
is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the LORD, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.
original_text:
And this
is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the LORD, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.

translated_text:
For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it
for a present unto his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
original_text:
For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it
for a present unto his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

translated_text: And Solomon built Gezer, and Beth-horon the nether,
original_text: And Solomon built Gezer, and Beth-horon the nether,

translated_text: and Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,
original_text: and Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,

translated_text: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
original_text: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

translated_text:
And all the people
that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which
were not of the children of Israel,
original_text:
And all the people
that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which
were not of the children of Israel,

translated_text: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.
original_text: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.

translated_text:
But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they
were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.
original_text:
But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they
were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.

translated_text:
These
were the chief of the officers that
were
 over Solomon’s work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.
original_text:
These
were the chief of the officers that
were
 over Solomon’s work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.

translated_text:
But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which
Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.
original_text:
But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which
Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.

translated_text:
And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the LORD, and he burnt incense upon the altar that
was before the LORD. So he finished the house.
original_text:
And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the LORD, and he burnt incense upon the altar that
was before the LORD. So he finished the house.

translated_text: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion-geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.
original_text: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion-geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.

translated_text: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
original_text: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

translated_text:
And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought
it to king Solomon.
original_text:
And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought
it to king Solomon.

translated_text:
Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which
is Zion.
original_text:
Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which
is Zion.

translated_text:
And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which
is the seventh month.
original_text:
And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which
is the seventh month.

translated_text: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.
original_text: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.

translated_text:
And they brought up the ark of the LORD, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that
were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.
original_text:
And they brought up the ark of the LORD, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that
were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.

translated_text:
And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that
were
 assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
original_text:
And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that
were
 assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

translated_text:
And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy
place, even
 under the wings of the cherubims.
original_text:
And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy
place, even
 under the wings of the cherubims.

translated_text:
For the cherubims spread forth
their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
original_text:
For the cherubims spread forth
their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

translated_text:
And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy
place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.
original_text:
And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy
place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.

translated_text:
There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made
a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.
original_text:
There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made
a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy
place, that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,
original_text:
And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy
place, that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,

translated_text: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD.
original_text: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD.

translated_text: Then spake Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in thick darkness.
original_text: Then spake Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in thick darkness.

translated_text: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.
original_text: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.

translated_text: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)
original_text: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)

translated_text:
And he said, Blessed
be the LORD God of Israel, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled
it, saying,
original_text:
And he said, Blessed
be the LORD God of Israel, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled
it, saying,

translated_text: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.
original_text: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.

translated_text: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
original_text: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.
original_text: And the LORD said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.

translated_text: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.
original_text: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.

translated_text: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
original_text: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

translated_text:
And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein
is the covenant of the LORD, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.
original_text:
And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein
is the covenant of the LORD, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:
original_text: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:

translated_text:
And he said, LORD God of Israel,
there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:
original_text:
And he said, LORD God of Israel,
there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:

translated_text:
Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled
it with thine hand, as
it is this day.
original_text:
Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled
it with thine hand, as
it is this day.

translated_text: Therefore now, LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.
original_text: Therefore now, LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.

translated_text: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.
original_text: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.

translated_text: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?
original_text: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?

translated_text: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:
original_text: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:

translated_text:
That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day,
even
 toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.
original_text:
That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day,
even
 toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.

translated_text: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.
original_text: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.

translated_text: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:
original_text: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:

translated_text: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.
original_text: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

translated_text: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house:
original_text: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house:

translated_text: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.
original_text: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.

translated_text: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:
original_text: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:

translated_text: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.
original_text: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.

translated_text:
What prayer and supplication soever be
made by any man,
or by all thy people Israel, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:
original_text:
What prayer and supplication soever be
made by any man,
or by all thy people Israel, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:

translated_text:
Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou,
even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)
original_text:
Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou,
even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)

translated_text: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
original_text: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.

translated_text:
Moreover concerning a stranger, that
is not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name’s sake;
original_text:
Moreover concerning a stranger, that
is not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name’s sake;

translated_text: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;
original_text: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;

translated_text:
Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as
do thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name.
original_text:
Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as
do thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name.

translated_text:
If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the LORD toward the city which thou hast chosen, and
toward the house that I have built for thy name:
original_text:
If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the LORD toward the city which thou hast chosen, and
toward the house that I have built for thy name:

translated_text: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
original_text: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

translated_text:
If they sin against thee, (for
there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;
original_text:
If they sin against thee, (for
there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;

translated_text: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;
original_text: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;

translated_text:
And
so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:
original_text:
And
so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:

translated_text: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,
original_text: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,

translated_text: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:
original_text: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:

translated_text:
For they
be thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:
original_text:
For they
be thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:

translated_text: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.
original_text: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.

translated_text:
For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth,
to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord GOD.
original_text:
For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth,
to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord GOD.

translated_text:
And it was
so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the LORD, he arose from before the altar of the LORD, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.
original_text:
And it was
so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the LORD, he arose from before the altar of the LORD, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.

translated_text: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,
original_text: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

translated_text:
Blessed
be the LORD, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.
original_text:
Blessed
be the LORD, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.

translated_text: The LORD our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:
original_text: The LORD our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:

translated_text: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.
original_text: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.

translated_text: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the LORD, be nigh unto the LORD our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:
original_text: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the LORD, be nigh unto the LORD our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:

translated_text:
That all the people of the earth may know that the LORD
is
 God,
and that there is none else.
original_text:
That all the people of the earth may know that the LORD
is
 God,
and that there is none else.

translated_text: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.
original_text: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.

translated_text: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.
original_text: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.

translated_text: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the LORD, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.
original_text: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the LORD, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that
was before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that
was before the LORD
was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.
original_text:
The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that
was before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that
was before the LORD
was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.

translated_text:
And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven days,
even fourteen days.
original_text:
And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven days,
even fourteen days.

translated_text: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.
original_text: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.

translated_text: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
original_text: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

translated_text:
He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof
was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.
original_text:
He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof
was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.

translated_text:
And
it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that
lay on forty five pillars, fifteen
in a row.
original_text:
And
it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that
lay on forty five pillars, fifteen
in a row.

translated_text:
And
there were windows
in three rows, and light
was against light
in three ranks.
original_text:
And
there were windows
in three rows, and light
was against light
in three ranks.

translated_text:
And all the doors and posts
were square, with the windows: and light
was against light
in three ranks.
original_text:
And all the doors and posts
were square, with the windows: and light
was against light
in three ranks.

translated_text:
And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof
was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the
other pillars and the thick beam
were before them.
original_text:
And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof
was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the
other pillars and the thick beam
were before them.

translated_text:
Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge,
even
 the porch of judgment: and
it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.
original_text:
Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge,
even
 the porch of judgment: and
it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.

translated_text:
And his house where he dwelt
had another court within the porch,
which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had taken
to wife, like unto this porch.
original_text:
And his house where he dwelt
had another court within the porch,
which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had taken
to wife, like unto this porch.

translated_text:
All these
were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.
original_text:
All these
were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.

translated_text:
And the foundation
was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
original_text:
And the foundation
was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.

translated_text:
And above
were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
original_text:
And above
were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.

translated_text:
And the great court round about
was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house.
original_text:
And the great court round about
was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house.

translated_text: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.
original_text: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.

translated_text:
He
was a widow’s son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father
was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.
original_text:
He
was a widow’s son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father
was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.

translated_text: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.
original_text: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.

translated_text:
And he made two chapiters
of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter
was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter
was five cubits:
original_text:
And he made two chapiters
of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter
was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter
was five cubits:

translated_text:
And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which
were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.
original_text:
And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which
were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.

translated_text:
And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that
were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.
original_text:
And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that
were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.

translated_text:
And the chapiters that
were upon the top of the pillars
were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.
original_text:
And the chapiters that
were upon the top of the pillars
were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.

translated_text:
And the chapiters upon the two pillars
had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which
was by the network: and the pomegranates
were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.
original_text:
And the chapiters upon the two pillars
had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which
was by the network: and the pomegranates
were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.

translated_text: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and he called the name thereof Boaz.
original_text: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and he called the name thereof Boaz.

translated_text:
And upon the top of the pillars
was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
original_text:
And upon the top of the pillars
was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.

translated_text:
And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other:
it was round all about, and his height
was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
original_text:
And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other:
it was round all about, and his height
was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

translated_text:
And under the brim of it round about
there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops
were cast in two rows, when it was cast.
original_text:
And under the brim of it round about
there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops
were cast in two rows, when it was cast.

translated_text:
It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea
was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts
were inward.
original_text:
It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea
was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts
were inward.

translated_text:
And it
was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.
original_text:
And it
was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.

translated_text:
And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits
was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
original_text:
And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits
was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.

translated_text:
And the work of the bases
was on this
manner: they had borders, and the borders
were between the ledges:
original_text:
And the work of the bases
was on this
manner: they had borders, and the borders
were between the ledges:

translated_text:
And on the borders that
were between the ledges
were
 lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges
there was
 a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen
were certain additions made of thin work.
original_text:
And on the borders that
were between the ledges
were
 lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges
there was
 a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen
were certain additions made of thin work.

translated_text:
And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver
were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.
original_text:
And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver
were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.

translated_text:
And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above
was a cubit: but the mouth thereof
was round
after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it
were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.
original_text:
And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above
was a cubit: but the mouth thereof
was round
after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it
were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.

translated_text:
And under the borders
were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels
were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel
was a cubit and a half a cubit.
original_text:
And under the borders
were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels
were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel
was a cubit and a half a cubit.

translated_text:
And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes,
were
 all molten.
original_text:
And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes,
were
 all molten.

translated_text:
And
there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base:
and the undersetters
were of the very base itself.
original_text:
And
there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base:
and the undersetters
were of the very base itself.

translated_text:
And in the top of the base
was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof
were of the same.
original_text:
And in the top of the base
was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof
were of the same.

translated_text: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.
original_text: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.

translated_text:
After this
manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure,
and one size.
original_text:
After this
manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure,
and one size.

translated_text:
Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths:
and every laver was four cubits:
and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.
original_text:
Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths:
and every laver was four cubits:
and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.
