translated_text: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.
original_text: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.

translated_text: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD:
original_text: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD:

translated_text:
The two pillars, and the
two bowls of the chapiters that
were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which
were upon the top of the pillars;
original_text:
The two pillars, and the
two bowls of the chapiters that
were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which
were upon the top of the pillars;

translated_text:
And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks,
even
 two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that
were upon the pillars;
original_text:
And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks,
even
 two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that
were upon the pillars;

translated_text: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;
original_text: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;

translated_text: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;
original_text: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;

translated_text:
And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD,
were of
 bright brass.
original_text:
And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD,
were of
 bright brass.

translated_text: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.
original_text: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.

translated_text:
And Solomon left all the vessels
unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.
original_text:
And Solomon left all the vessels
unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.

translated_text:
And Solomon made all the vessels that
pertained unto the house of the LORD: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread
was,
original_text:
And Solomon made all the vessels that
pertained unto the house of the LORD: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread
was,

translated_text:
And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right
side,
 and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs
of gold,
original_text:
And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right
side,
 and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs
of gold,

translated_text:
And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers
of pure gold; and the hinges
of gold,
both
 for the doors of the inner house, the most holy
place, and
 for the doors of the house,
to wit, of the temple.
original_text:
And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers
of pure gold; and the hinges
of gold,
both
 for the doors of the inner house, the most holy
place, and
 for the doors of the house,
to wit, of the temple.

translated_text:
So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated;
even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the LORD.
original_text:
So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated;
even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which
is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.
original_text:
And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which
is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD, the length thereof
was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty
cubits,
 and the height thereof thirty cubits.
original_text:
And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD, the length thereof
was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty
cubits,
 and the height thereof thirty cubits.

translated_text:
And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits
was
 the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house;
and
 ten cubits
was the breadth thereof before the house.
original_text:
And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits
was
 the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house;
and
 ten cubits
was the breadth thereof before the house.

translated_text: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
original_text: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.

translated_text:
And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about,
against the walls of the house round about,
both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:
original_text:
And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about,
against the walls of the house round about,
both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:

translated_text:
The nethermost chamber
was five cubits broad, and the middle
was six cubits broad, and the third
was seven cubits broad: for without
in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that
the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.
original_text:
The nethermost chamber
was five cubits broad, and the middle
was six cubits broad, and the third
was seven cubits broad: for without
in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that
the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.

translated_text:
And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe
nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
original_text:
And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe
nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.

translated_text:
The door for the middle chamber
was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle
chamber,
 and out of the middle into the third.
original_text:
The door for the middle chamber
was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle
chamber,
 and out of the middle into the third.

translated_text: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.
original_text: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.

translated_text:
And
then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house
with timber of cedar.
original_text:
And
then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house
with timber of cedar.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying,

translated_text: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:
original_text: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:

translated_text: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.
original_text: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.

translated_text: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
original_text: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

translated_text:
And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the cieling:
and he covered
them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.
original_text:
And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the cieling:
and he covered
them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.

translated_text:
And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built
them for it within,
even for the oracle,
even for the most holy
place.
original_text:
And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built
them for it within,
even for the oracle,
even for the most holy
place.

translated_text:
And the house, that
is, the temple before it, was forty cubits
long.
original_text:
And the house, that
is, the temple before it, was forty cubits
long.

translated_text:
And the cedar of the house within
was carved with knops and open flowers: all
was cedar; there was no stone seen.
original_text:
And the cedar of the house within
was carved with knops and open flowers: all
was cedar; there was no stone seen.

translated_text: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
original_text: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

translated_text:
And the oracle in the forepart
was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar
which was of
 cedar.
original_text:
And the oracle in the forepart
was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar
which was of
 cedar.

translated_text: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.
original_text: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.

translated_text:
And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that
was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.
original_text:
And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that
was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.

translated_text:
And within the oracle he made two cherubims
of olive tree,
each ten cubits high.
original_text:
And within the oracle he made two cherubims
of olive tree,
each ten cubits high.

translated_text:
And five cubits
was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other
were ten cubits.
original_text:
And five cubits
was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other
were ten cubits.

translated_text:
And the other cherub
was ten cubits: both the cherubims
were of one measure and one size.
original_text:
And the other cherub
was ten cubits: both the cherubims
were of one measure and one size.

translated_text:
The height of the one cherub
was ten cubits, and so
was it of the other cherub.
original_text:
The height of the one cherub
was ten cubits, and so
was it of the other cherub.

translated_text:
And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the
one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
original_text:
And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the
one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.

translated_text: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.
original_text: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.

translated_text: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.
original_text: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.

translated_text: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
original_text: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.

translated_text:
And for the entering of the oracle he made doors
of olive tree: the lintel
and side posts
were a fifth part
of the wall.
original_text:
And for the entering of the oracle he made doors
of olive tree: the lintel
and side posts
were a fifth part
of the wall.

translated_text:
The two doors also
were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid
them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.
original_text:
The two doors also
were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid
them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.

translated_text:
So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part
of the wall.
original_text:
So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part
of the wall.

translated_text:
And the two doors
were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door
were folding, and the two leaves of the other door
were
 folding.
original_text:
And the two doors
were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door
were folding, and the two leaves of the other door
were
 folding.

translated_text:
And he carved
thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered
them with gold fitted upon the carved work.
original_text:
And he carved
thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered
them with gold fitted upon the carved work.

translated_text: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.
original_text: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.

translated_text: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:
original_text: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:

translated_text:
And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which
is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
original_text:
And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which
is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.

translated_text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.
original_text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.

translated_text: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
original_text: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

translated_text: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.
original_text: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.

translated_text:
But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side,
so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.
original_text:
But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side,
so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.

translated_text: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.
original_text: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.

translated_text:
Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that
there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.
original_text:
Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that
there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed
be the LORD this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed
be the LORD this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.

translated_text:
And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for:
and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.
original_text:
And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for:
and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.

translated_text:
My servants shall bring
them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive
them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.
original_text:
My servants shall bring
them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive
them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.

translated_text:
So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees
according to
 all his desire.
original_text:
So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees
according to
 all his desire.

translated_text:
And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat
for
 food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.
original_text:
And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat
for
 food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.

translated_text: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.
original_text: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.

translated_text: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
original_text: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

translated_text:
And he sent them to Lebanon ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon,
and two months at home: and Adoniram
was over the levy.
original_text:
And he sent them to Lebanon ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon,
and two months at home: and Adoniram
was over the levy.

translated_text: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;
original_text: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;

translated_text:
Beside the chief of Solomon’s officers which
were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.
original_text:
Beside the chief of Solomon’s officers which
were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.

translated_text:
And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones,
and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.
original_text:
And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones,
and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.

translated_text:
And Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders did hew
them,
 and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.
original_text:
And Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders did hew
them,
 and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.

translated_text: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.
original_text: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.

translated_text:
And these
were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,
original_text:
And these
were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,

translated_text: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.
original_text: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.

translated_text:
And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada
was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar
were the priests:
original_text:
And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada
was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar
were the priests:

translated_text:
And Azariah the son of Nathan
was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan
was principal officer,
and the king’s friend:
original_text:
And Azariah the son of Nathan
was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan
was principal officer,
and the king’s friend:

translated_text:
And Ahishar
was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda
was over the tribute.
original_text:
And Ahishar
was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda
was over the tribute.

translated_text: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.
original_text: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.

translated_text:
And these
are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:
original_text:
And these
are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:

translated_text: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth-shemesh, and Elon-beth-hanan:
original_text: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth-shemesh, and Elon-beth-hanan:

translated_text:
The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him
pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:
original_text:
The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him
pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:

translated_text: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
original_text: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

translated_text:
Baana the son of Ahilud;
to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth-shean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah,
even unto
the place that is beyond Jokneam:
original_text:
Baana the son of Ahilud;
to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth-shean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah,
even unto
the place that is beyond Jokneam:

translated_text:
The son of Geber, in Ramoth-gilead; to him
pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which
are in Gilead; to him
also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:
original_text:
The son of Geber, in Ramoth-gilead; to him
pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which
are in Gilead; to him
also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:

translated_text:
Ahinadab the son of Iddo
had Mahanaim:
original_text:
Ahinadab the son of Iddo
had Mahanaim:

translated_text:
Ahimaaz
was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
original_text:
Ahimaaz
was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

translated_text:
Baanah the son of Hushai
was in Asher and in Aloth:
original_text:
Baanah the son of Hushai
was in Asher and in Aloth:

translated_text: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:
original_text: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:

translated_text: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:
original_text: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:

translated_text:
Geber the son of Uri
was in the country of Gilead,
in
 the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and
he was the only officer which
was in the land.
original_text:
Geber the son of Uri
was in the country of Gilead,
in
 the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and
he was the only officer which
was in the land.

translated_text:
Judah and Israel
were many, as the sand which
is
 by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.
original_text:
Judah and Israel
were many, as the sand which
is
 by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.

translated_text: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.
original_text: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.

translated_text: And Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,
original_text: And Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,

translated_text: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.
original_text: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.

translated_text:
For he had dominion over all
the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
original_text:
For he had dominion over all
the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.

translated_text: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.
original_text: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.

translated_text: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
original_text: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

translated_text: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon’s table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.
original_text: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon’s table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.

translated_text:
Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where
the officers were, every man according to his charge.
original_text:
Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where
the officers were, every man according to his charge.

translated_text:
And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that
is on the sea shore.
original_text:
And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that
is on the sea shore.

translated_text: And Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
original_text: And Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.

translated_text: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.
original_text: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.

translated_text: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
original_text: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.

translated_text:
And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that
is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
original_text:
And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that
is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.

translated_text: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.
original_text: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.

translated_text: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the LORD, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.
original_text: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the LORD, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.

translated_text: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the LORD, until those days.
original_text: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the LORD, until those days.

translated_text: And Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.
original_text: And Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.

translated_text:
And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that
was
 the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.
original_text:
And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that
was
 the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.

translated_text: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
original_text: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.

translated_text:
And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as
it is
 this day.
original_text:
And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as
it is
 this day.

translated_text:
And now, O LORD my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I
am but a little child: I know not
how
 to go out or come in.
original_text:
And now, O LORD my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I
am but a little child: I know not
how
 to go out or come in.

translated_text:
And thy servant
is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.
original_text:
And thy servant
is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.

translated_text: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?
original_text: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?

translated_text: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
original_text: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

translated_text: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;
original_text: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;

translated_text: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.
original_text: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.

translated_text: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.
original_text: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.

translated_text: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.
original_text: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.

translated_text:
And Solomon awoke; and, behold,
it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.
original_text:
And Solomon awoke; and, behold,
it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.

translated_text:
Then came there two women,
that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.
original_text:
Then came there two women,
that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.

translated_text: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
original_text: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.

translated_text:
And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we
were together;
there was
 no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
original_text:
And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we
were together;
there was
 no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.

translated_text: And this woman’s child died in the night; because she overlaid it.
original_text: And this woman’s child died in the night; because she overlaid it.

translated_text: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
original_text: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

translated_text: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.
original_text: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.

translated_text:
And the other woman said, Nay; but the living
is my son, and the dead
is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead
is
 thy son, and the living
is my son. Thus they spake before the king.
original_text:
And the other woman said, Nay; but the living
is my son, and the dead
is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead
is
 thy son, and the living
is my son. Thus they spake before the king.

translated_text:
Then said the king, The one saith, This
is my son that liveth, and thy son
is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son
is the dead, and my son
is the living.
original_text:
Then said the king, The one saith, This
is my son that liveth, and thy son
is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son
is the dead, and my son
is the living.

translated_text: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
original_text: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.

translated_text: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
original_text: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.

translated_text:
Then spake the woman whose the living child
was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine,
but divide
it.
original_text:
Then spake the woman whose the living child
was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine,
but divide
it.

translated_text:
Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she
is the mother thereof.
original_text:
Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she
is the mother thereof.

translated_text:
And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God
was in him, to do judgment.
original_text:
And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God
was in him, to do judgment.

translated_text: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,
original_text: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,

translated_text: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;
original_text: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;

translated_text: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:
original_text: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:

translated_text: That the LORD may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.
original_text: That the LORD may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.

translated_text:
Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me,
and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that
was about his loins, and in his shoes that
were on his feet.
original_text:
Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me,
and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that
was about his loins, and in his shoes that
were on his feet.

translated_text: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.
original_text: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.

translated_text: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.
original_text: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.

translated_text:
And, behold,
thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the LORD, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.
original_text:
And, behold,
thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the LORD, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.

translated_text:
Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou
art a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.
original_text:
Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou
art a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.

translated_text: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
original_text: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.

translated_text:
And the days that David reigned over Israel
were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
original_text:
And the days that David reigned over Israel
were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

translated_text: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
original_text: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.

translated_text: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.
original_text: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.

translated_text: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.
original_text: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.

translated_text:
And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and
that
 all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother’s: for it was his from the LORD.
original_text:
And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and
that
 all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother’s: for it was his from the LORD.

translated_text: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.
original_text: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.

translated_text: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.
original_text: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.

translated_text: And Bath-sheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.
original_text: And Bath-sheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.

translated_text: Bath-sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.
original_text: Bath-sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.

translated_text: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.
original_text: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.

translated_text:
And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he
is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.
original_text:
And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he
is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.

translated_text: Then king Solomon sware by the LORD, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.
original_text: Then king Solomon sware by the LORD, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.

translated_text:
Now therefore,
as the LORD liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.
original_text:
Now therefore,
as the LORD liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.

translated_text: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.
original_text: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.

translated_text:
And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou
art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord GOD before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.
original_text:
And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou
art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord GOD before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.

translated_text: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the LORD; that he might fulfil the word of the LORD, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
original_text: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the LORD; that he might fulfil the word of the LORD, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

translated_text: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
original_text: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

translated_text:
And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD; and, behold,
he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.
original_text:
And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD; and, behold,
he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.

translated_text: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.
original_text: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.

translated_text: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.
original_text: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.

translated_text:
And the LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing
thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.
original_text:
And the LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing
thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.

translated_text: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the LORD.
original_text: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the LORD.

translated_text: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
original_text: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

translated_text: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
original_text: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.

translated_text: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.
original_text: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.

translated_text:
For it shall be,
that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.
original_text:
For it shall be,
that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.

translated_text:
And Shimei said unto the king, The saying
is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
original_text:
And Shimei said unto the king, The saying
is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.

translated_text:
And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants
be in Gath.
original_text:
And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants
be in Gath.

translated_text: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
original_text: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.

translated_text: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
original_text: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.

translated_text:
And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the LORD, and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word
that I have heard
is good.
original_text:
And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the LORD, and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word
that I have heard
is good.

translated_text: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the LORD, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?
original_text: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the LORD, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?

translated_text: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the LORD shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;
original_text: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the LORD shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;

translated_text:
And king Solomon
shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.
original_text:
And king Solomon
shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.

translated_text: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
original_text: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

translated_text:
Now king David was old
and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.
original_text:
Now king David was old
and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.

translated_text: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.
original_text: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.

translated_text: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
original_text: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

translated_text:
And the damsel
was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.
original_text:
And the damsel
was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.

translated_text: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
original_text: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

translated_text:
And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also
was a very goodly
man; and
his mother bare him after Absalom.
original_text:
And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also
was a very goodly
man; and
his mother bare him after Absalom.

translated_text:
And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped
him.
original_text:
And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped
him.

translated_text:
But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which
belonged
 to David, were not with Adonijah.
original_text:
But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which
belonged
 to David, were not with Adonijah.

translated_text:
And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which
is by En-rogel, and called all his brethren the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah the king’s servants:
original_text:
And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which
is by En-rogel, and called all his brethren the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah the king’s servants:

translated_text: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.
original_text: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.

translated_text:
Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth
it not?
original_text:
Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth
it not?

translated_text: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.
original_text: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.

translated_text: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?
original_text: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?

translated_text: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.
original_text: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.

translated_text: And Bath-sheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.
original_text: And Bath-sheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.

translated_text: And Bath-sheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?
original_text: And Bath-sheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?

translated_text:
And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the LORD thy God unto thine handmaid,
saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.
original_text:
And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the LORD thy God unto thine handmaid,
saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.

translated_text:
And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest
it not:
original_text:
And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest
it not:

translated_text: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.
original_text: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.

translated_text:
And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel
are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
original_text:
And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel
are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

translated_text: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.
original_text: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.

translated_text: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.
original_text: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.

translated_text: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
original_text: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

translated_text: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?
original_text: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?

translated_text: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king’s sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.
original_text: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king’s sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.

translated_text:
But me,
even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.
original_text:
But me,
even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.

translated_text:
Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed
it unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?
original_text:
Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed
it unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?

translated_text: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bath-sheba. And she came into the king’s presence, and stood before the king.
original_text: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bath-sheba. And she came into the king’s presence, and stood before the king.

translated_text:
And the king sware, and said,
As the LORD liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,
original_text:
And the king sware, and said,
As the LORD liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,

translated_text: Even as I sware unto thee by the LORD God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.
original_text: Even as I sware unto thee by the LORD God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.

translated_text:
Then Bath-sheba bowed with
her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.
original_text:
Then Bath-sheba bowed with
her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.

translated_text: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.
original_text: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.

translated_text: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:
original_text: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:

translated_text: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.
original_text: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.

translated_text: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.
original_text: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.

translated_text:
And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so
too.
original_text:
And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so
too.

translated_text: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.
original_text: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.

translated_text: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.
original_text: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.

translated_text: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
original_text: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.

translated_text: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.
original_text: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.

translated_text:
And Adonijah and all the guests that
were with him heard
it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore
is this noise of the city being in an uproar?
original_text:
And Adonijah and all the guests that
were with him heard
it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore
is this noise of the city being in an uproar?

translated_text:
And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou
art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.
original_text:
And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou
art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.

translated_text: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.
original_text: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.

translated_text: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king’s mule:
original_text: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king’s mule:

translated_text:
And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This
is the noise that ye have heard.
original_text:
And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This
is the noise that ye have heard.

translated_text: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.
original_text: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.

translated_text: And moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.
original_text: And moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.

translated_text:
And also thus said the king, Blessed
be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given
one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing
it.
original_text:
And also thus said the king, Blessed
be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given
one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing
it.

translated_text:
And all the guests that
were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.
original_text:
And all the guests that
were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.

translated_text: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
original_text: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

translated_text: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.
original_text: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.

translated_text: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.
original_text: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.

translated_text: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.
original_text: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth
day of the month,
that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.
original_text:
And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth
day of the month,
that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.

translated_text: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
original_text: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

translated_text:
And on the ninth
day of the
fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.
original_text:
And on the ninth
day of the
fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.

translated_text:
And the city was broken up, and all the men of war
fled by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which
is by the king’s garden: (now the Chaldees
were against the city round about:) and
the king went the way toward the plain.
original_text:
And the city was broken up, and all the men of war
fled by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which
is by the king’s garden: (now the Chaldees
were against the city round about:) and
the king went the way toward the plain.

translated_text: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.
original_text: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.

translated_text: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.
original_text: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.

translated_text: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.
original_text: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.

translated_text:
And in the fifth month, on the seventh
day of the month, which
is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:
original_text:
And in the fifth month, on the seventh
day of the month, which
is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:

translated_text:
And he burnt the house of the LORD, and the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great
man’s house burnt he with fire.
original_text:
And he burnt the house of the LORD, and the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great
man’s house burnt he with fire.

translated_text:
And all the army of the Chaldees, that
were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.
original_text:
And all the army of the Chaldees, that
were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the people
that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carry away.
original_text:
Now the rest of the people
that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carry away.

translated_text:
But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land
to be
 vinedressers and husbandmen.
original_text:
But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land
to be
 vinedressers and husbandmen.

translated_text:
And the pillars of brass that
were in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that
was in the house of the LORD, did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.
original_text:
And the pillars of brass that
were in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that
was in the house of the LORD, did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.

translated_text: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
