original_text: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

translated_text:
And the firepans, and the bowls,
and such things as
were of gold,
in gold, and of silver,
in silver, the captain of the guard took away.
original_text:
And the firepans, and the bowls,
and such things as
were of gold,
in gold, and of silver,
in silver, the captain of the guard took away.

translated_text: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the LORD; the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
original_text: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the LORD; the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

translated_text:
The height of the one pillar
was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it
was brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.
original_text:
The height of the one pillar
was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it
was brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.

translated_text: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
original_text: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

translated_text:
And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king’s presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land
that were found in the city:
original_text:
And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king’s presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land
that were found in the city:

translated_text: And Nebuzar-adan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:
original_text: And Nebuzar-adan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:

translated_text: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.
original_text: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.

translated_text:
And
as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.
original_text:
And
as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.

translated_text: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
original_text: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

translated_text: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.
original_text: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.

translated_text: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.
original_text: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.

translated_text: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.
original_text: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.

translated_text:
And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that
were with him in Babylon;
original_text:
And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that
were with him in Babylon;

translated_text: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.
original_text: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.

translated_text:
And his allowance
was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.
original_text:
And his allowance
was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.

translated_text: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.
original_text: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.

translated_text: And the LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldees, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servants the prophets.
original_text: And the LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldees, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servants the prophets.

translated_text: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the LORD would not pardon.
original_text: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the LORD would not pardon.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

translated_text: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.
original_text: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.

translated_text:
Jehoiachin
was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother’s name
was
 Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
original_text:
Jehoiachin
was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother’s name
was
 Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father had done.
original_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father had done.

translated_text: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.
original_text: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

translated_text: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.
original_text: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.

translated_text: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.
original_text: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.

translated_text: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD, as the LORD had said.
original_text: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD, as the LORD had said.

translated_text:
And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour,
even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.
original_text:
And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour,
even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.

translated_text:
And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king’s mother, and the king’s wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land,
those
 carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.
original_text:
And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king’s mother, and the king’s wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land,
those
 carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

translated_text:
And all the men of might,
even seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all
that were strong
and apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.
original_text:
And all the men of might,
even seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all
that were strong
and apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

translated_text: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father’s brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
original_text: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father’s brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

translated_text:
Zedekiah
was twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was
 Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
original_text:
Zedekiah
was twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was
 Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
original_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

translated_text: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
original_text: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

translated_text: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.
original_text: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

translated_text: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the LORD.
original_text: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all
their heart and all
their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.
original_text:
And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all
their heart and all
their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.

translated_text: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the LORD all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Bethel.
original_text: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the LORD all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Bethel.

translated_text: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.
original_text: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.

translated_text:
And he brought out the grove from the house of the LORD, without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped
it small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.
original_text:
And he brought out the grove from the house of the LORD, without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped
it small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.

translated_text:
And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that
were by the house of the LORD, where the women wove hangings for the grove.
original_text:
And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that
were by the house of the LORD, where the women wove hangings for the grove.

translated_text:
And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that
were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which
were
 on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.
original_text:
And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that
were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which
were
 on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.

translated_text: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.
original_text: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.

translated_text:
And he defiled Topheth, which
is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.
original_text:
And he defiled Topheth, which
is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

translated_text:
And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the LORD, by the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which
was in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
original_text:
And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the LORD, by the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which
was in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

translated_text:
And the altars that
were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the LORD, did the king beat down, and brake
them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.
original_text:
And the altars that
were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the LORD, did the king beat down, and brake
them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.

translated_text:
And the high places that
were before Jerusalem, which
were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.
original_text:
And the high places that
were before Jerusalem, which
were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.

translated_text: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.
original_text: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.

translated_text:
Moreover the altar that
was at Bethel,
and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place,
and stamped
it small to powder, and burned the grove.
original_text:
Moreover the altar that
was at Bethel,
and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place,
and stamped
it small to powder, and burned the grove.

translated_text:
And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that
were
 there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned
them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the LORD which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.
original_text:
And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that
were
 there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned
them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the LORD which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.

translated_text:
Then he said, What title
is that that I see? And the men of the city told him,
It is the sepulchre of the man of God, which came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Bethel.
original_text:
Then he said, What title
is that that I see? And the men of the city told him,
It is the sepulchre of the man of God, which came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Bethel.

translated_text: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.
original_text: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.

translated_text:
And all the houses also of the high places that
were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke
the LORD to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.
original_text:
And all the houses also of the high places that
were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke
the LORD to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.

translated_text:
And he slew all the priests of the high places that
were
 there upon the altars, and burned men’s bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.
original_text:
And he slew all the priests of the high places that
were
 there upon the altars, and burned men’s bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the LORD your God, as
it is written in the book of this covenant.
original_text:
And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the LORD your God, as
it is written in the book of this covenant.

translated_text: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;
original_text: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

translated_text:
But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah,
wherein this passover was holden to the LORD in Jerusalem.
original_text:
But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah,
wherein this passover was holden to the LORD in Jerusalem.

translated_text:
Moreover the
workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the LORD.
original_text:
Moreover the
workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there
any like him.
original_text:
And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there
any like him.

translated_text: Notwithstanding the LORD turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.
original_text: Notwithstanding the LORD turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.

translated_text: And the LORD said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.
original_text: And the LORD said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

translated_text: In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.
original_text: In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

translated_text: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s stead.
original_text: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s stead.

translated_text:
Jehoahaz
was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
original_text:
Jehoahaz
was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.
original_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.

translated_text: And Pharaoh-nechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.
original_text: And Pharaoh-nechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.

translated_text: And Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.
original_text: And Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.

translated_text:
And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give
it unto Pharaoh-nechoh.
original_text:
And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give
it unto Pharaoh-nechoh.

translated_text:
Jehoiakim
was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
original_text:
Jehoiakim
was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.
original_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.

translated_text:
Josiah
was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was
 Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.
original_text:
Josiah
was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was
 Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.
original_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah,
that
 the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the LORD, saying,
original_text:
And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah,
that
 the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the LORD, saying,

translated_text: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the LORD, which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:
original_text: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the LORD, which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:

translated_text:
And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD: and let them give it to the doers of the work which
is in the house of the LORD, to repair the breaches of the house,
original_text:
And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD: and let them give it to the doers of the work which
is in the house of the LORD, to repair the breaches of the house,

translated_text: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.
original_text: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.

translated_text: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.
original_text: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.

translated_text: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
original_text: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

translated_text: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD.
original_text: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD.

translated_text: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
original_text: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.
original_text: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.

translated_text: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king’s, saying,
original_text: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king’s, saying,

translated_text: Go ye, enquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.
original_text: Go ye, enquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.

translated_text: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.
original_text: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.

translated_text: And she said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,
original_text: And she said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof,
even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof,
even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:

translated_text: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.
original_text: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.

translated_text:
Because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the LORD, when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard
thee,
 saith the LORD.
original_text:
Because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the LORD, when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard
thee,
 saith the LORD.

translated_text: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.
original_text: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.

translated_text:
Manasseh
was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was
 Hephzi-bah.
original_text:
Manasseh
was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was
 Hephzi-bah.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, after the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
original_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, after the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

translated_text: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
original_text: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

translated_text: And he built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.
original_text: And he built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.

translated_text: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.
original_text: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the LORD, to provoke
him to anger.
original_text:
And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the LORD, to provoke
him to anger.

translated_text: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the LORD said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:
original_text: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the LORD said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

translated_text: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.
original_text: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.

translated_text: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.
original_text: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.

translated_text: And the LORD spake by his servants the prophets, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake by his servants the prophets, saying,

translated_text:
Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations,
and
 hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which
were
 before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:
original_text:
Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations,
and
 hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which
were
 before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I
am
 bringing
such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I
am
 bringing
such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.

translated_text:
And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as
a man wipeth a dish, wiping
it, and turning
it upside down.
original_text:
And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as
a man wipeth a dish, wiping
it, and turning
it upside down.

translated_text: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;
original_text: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;

translated_text:
Because they have done
that which was evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.
original_text:
Because they have done
that which was evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.

translated_text:
Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin, in doing
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD.
original_text:
Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin, in doing
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

translated_text: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
Amon
was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
original_text:
Amon
was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his father Manasseh did.
original_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his father Manasseh did.

translated_text: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:
original_text: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:

translated_text: And he forsook the LORD God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the LORD.
original_text: And he forsook the LORD God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the LORD.

translated_text: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.
original_text: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.

translated_text: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
original_text: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

translated_text: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.
original_text: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.

translated_text: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto the LORD, saying,
original_text: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto the LORD, saying,

translated_text:
I beseech thee, O LORD, remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done
that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
original_text:
I beseech thee, O LORD, remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done
that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

translated_text: And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of the LORD came to him, saying,
original_text: And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of the LORD came to him, saying,

translated_text: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD.
original_text: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD.

translated_text: And I will add unto thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.
original_text: And I will add unto thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

translated_text:
And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid
it
 on the boil, and he recovered.
original_text:
And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid
it
 on the boil, and he recovered.

translated_text:
And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah, What
shall be the sign that the LORD will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of the LORD the third day?
original_text:
And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah, What
shall be the sign that the LORD will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of the LORD the third day?

translated_text: And Isaiah said, This sign shalt thou have of the LORD, that the LORD will do the thing that he hath spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?
original_text: And Isaiah said, This sign shalt thou have of the LORD, that the LORD will do the thing that he hath spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?

translated_text: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.
original_text: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.

translated_text: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.
original_text: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.

translated_text: At that time Berodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.
original_text: At that time Berodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

translated_text:
And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and
all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
original_text:
And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and
all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

translated_text:
Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country,
even from Babylon.
original_text:
Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country,
even from Babylon.

translated_text:
And he said, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All
the things that
are in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
original_text:
And he said, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All
the things that
are in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

translated_text: And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD.
original_text: And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD.

translated_text:
Behold, the days come, that all that
is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Behold, the days come, that all that
is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.

translated_text: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
original_text: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

translated_text:
Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. And he said,
Is it not
good, if peace and truth be in my days?
original_text:
Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. And he said,
Is it not
good, if peace and truth be in my days?

translated_text:
And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
original_text:
And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

translated_text: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard
it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard
it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
And he sent Eliakim, which
was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
original_text:
And he sent Eliakim, which
was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

translated_text:
And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day
is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and
there is not strength to bring forth.
original_text:
And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day
is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and
there is not strength to bring forth.

translated_text:
It may be the LORD thy God will hear all the words of Rab-shakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up
thy prayer for the remnant that are left.
original_text:
It may be the LORD thy God will hear all the words of Rab-shakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up
thy prayer for the remnant that are left.

translated_text: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
original_text: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

translated_text: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
original_text: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

translated_text: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
original_text: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

translated_text: So Rab-shakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
original_text: So Rab-shakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

translated_text: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against thee: he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah, saying,
original_text: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against thee: he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah, saying,

translated_text: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
original_text: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

translated_text: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?
original_text: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?

translated_text:
Where
is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?
original_text:
Where
is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?

translated_text: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
original_text: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.

translated_text:
And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD, and said, O LORD God of Israel, which dwellest
between the cherubims, thou art the God,
even
 thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.
original_text:
And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD, and said, O LORD God of Israel, which dwellest
between the cherubims, thou art the God,
even
 thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.

translated_text: LORD, bow down thine ear, and hear: open, LORD, thine eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent him to reproach the living God.
original_text: LORD, bow down thine ear, and hear: open, LORD, thine eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent him to reproach the living God.

translated_text: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,
original_text: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,

translated_text:
And have cast their gods into the fire: for they
were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.
original_text:
And have cast their gods into the fire: for they
were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

translated_text:
Now therefore, O LORD our God, I beseech thee, save thou us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou
art
 the LORD God,
even thou only.
original_text:
Now therefore, O LORD our God, I beseech thee, save thou us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou
art
 the LORD God,
even thou only.

translated_text:
Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel,
That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.
original_text:
Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel,
That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.

translated_text:
This
is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee,
and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.
original_text:
This
is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee,
and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

translated_text:
Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted
thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high?
even
 against the Holy
One of Israel.
original_text:
Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted
thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high?
even
 against the Holy
One of Israel.

translated_text:
By the messengers thou hast reproached the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof,
and
 the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders,
and into the forest of his Carmel.
original_text:
By the messengers thou hast reproached the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof,
and
 the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders,
and into the forest of his Carmel.

translated_text: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.
original_text: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.

translated_text:
Hast thou not heard long ago
how I have done it,
and
 of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities
into ruinous heaps.
original_text:
Hast thou not heard long ago
how I have done it,
and
 of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities
into ruinous heaps.

translated_text:
Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were
as the grass of the field, and
as
 the green herb,
as the grass on the house tops, and
as corn blasted before it be grown up.
original_text:
Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were
as the grass of the field, and
as
 the green herb,
as the grass on the house tops, and
as corn blasted before it be grown up.

translated_text: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.
original_text: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

translated_text: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.
original_text: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

translated_text:
And this
shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.
original_text:
And this
shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.

translated_text: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
original_text: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

translated_text:
For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD
of hosts shall do this.
original_text:
For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD
of hosts shall do this.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.

translated_text: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.
original_text: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.

translated_text: For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.
original_text: For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

translated_text:
And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the LORD went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they
were all dead corpses.
original_text:
And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the LORD went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they
were all dead corpses.

translated_text: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
original_text: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

translated_text: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel,
that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.
original_text:
Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel,
that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

translated_text:
Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also
was
 Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.
original_text:
Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also
was
 Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father did.
original_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father did.

translated_text: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.
original_text: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.

translated_text:
He trusted in the LORD God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor
any that were before him.
original_text:
He trusted in the LORD God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor
any that were before him.

translated_text:
For he clave to the LORD,
and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.
original_text:
For he clave to the LORD,
and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.

translated_text:
And the LORD was with him;
and he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.
original_text:
And the LORD was with him;
and he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.

translated_text:
He smote the Philistines,
even unto Gaza, and the borders thereof, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
original_text:
He smote the Philistines,
even unto Gaza, and the borders thereof, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which
was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel,
that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.
original_text:
And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which
was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel,
that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.

translated_text:
And at the end of three years they took it:
even in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that
is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.
original_text:
And at the end of three years they took it:
even in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that
is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.

translated_text:
And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor
by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:
original_text:
And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor
by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:

translated_text:
Because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD their God, but transgressed his covenant,
and all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear
them, nor do
them.
original_text:
Because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD their God, but transgressed his covenant,
and all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear
them, nor do
them.

translated_text: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah, and took them.
original_text: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah, and took them.

translated_text: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
original_text: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

translated_text:
And Hezekiah gave
him all the silver that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king’s house.
original_text:
And Hezekiah gave
him all the silver that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king’s house.

translated_text:
At that time did Hezekiah cut off
the gold from the doors of the temple of the LORD, and
from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
original_text:
At that time did Hezekiah cut off
the gold from the doors of the temple of the LORD, and
from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

translated_text: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rab-shakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller’s field.
original_text: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rab-shakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller’s field.

translated_text:
And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which
was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.
original_text:
And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which
was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.

translated_text: And Rab-shakeh said unto them, Speak ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
original_text: And Rab-shakeh said unto them, Speak ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?

translated_text:
Thou sayest, (but
they are but vain words,)
I have
 counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
original_text:
Thou sayest, (but
they are but vain words,)
I have
 counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?

translated_text:
Now, behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed,
even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him.
original_text:
Now, behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed,
even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him.

translated_text:
But if ye say unto me, We trust in the LORD our God:
is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?
original_text:
But if ye say unto me, We trust in the LORD our God:
is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?

translated_text: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
original_text: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

translated_text: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
original_text: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

translated_text: Am I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
original_text: Am I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

translated_text:
Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto Rab-shakeh, Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand
it: and talk not with us in the Jews’ language in the ears of the people that
are on the wall.
original_text:
Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto Rab-shakeh, Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand
it: and talk not with us in the Jews’ language in the ears of the people that
are on the wall.

translated_text:
But Rab-shakeh said unto them, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words?
hath he not
sent me to the men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you.
original_text:
But Rab-shakeh said unto them, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words?
hath he not
sent me to the men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you.

translated_text: Then Rab-shakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews language, and spake, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:
original_text: Then Rab-shakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews language, and spake, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:

translated_text: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:
original_text: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:

translated_text: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
original_text: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

translated_text:
Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make
an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and
then eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern:
original_text:
Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make
an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and
then eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern:

translated_text: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil olive and of honey, that ye may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, The LORD will deliver us.
original_text: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil olive and of honey, that ye may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, The LORD will deliver us.

translated_text: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
original_text: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

translated_text:
Where
are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where
are
 the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand?
original_text:
Where
are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where
are
 the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand?

translated_text:
Who
are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of mine hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand?
original_text:
Who
are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of mine hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand?

translated_text: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
original_text: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

translated_text:
Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which
was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with
their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rab-shakeh.
original_text:
Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which
was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with
their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rab-shakeh.

translated_text: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.
