original_text: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.
original_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.

translated_text: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.
original_text: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.

translated_text:
And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as
he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.
original_text:
And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as
he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.

translated_text: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
original_text: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

translated_text:
In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor
by
 the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
original_text:
In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor
by
 the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

translated_text:
For
so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,
original_text:
For
so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

translated_text: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.
original_text: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.

translated_text:
And the children of Israel did secretly
those things that
were not right against the LORD their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
original_text:
And the children of Israel did secretly
those things that
were not right against the LORD their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

translated_text: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:
original_text: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:

translated_text:
And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as
did
 the heathen whom the LORD carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger:
original_text:
And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as
did
 the heathen whom the LORD carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger:

translated_text: For they served idols, whereof the LORD had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.
original_text: For they served idols, whereof the LORD had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.

translated_text:
Yet the LORD testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets,
and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments
and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.
original_text:
Yet the LORD testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets,
and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments
and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.

translated_text: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the LORD their God.
original_text: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the LORD their God.

translated_text:
And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that
were
 round about them,
concerning whom the LORD had charged them, that they should not do like them.
original_text:
And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that
were
 round about them,
concerning whom the LORD had charged them, that they should not do like them.

translated_text:
And they left all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made them molten images,
even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.
original_text:
And they left all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made them molten images,
even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.

translated_text: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
original_text: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.

translated_text: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.
original_text: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

translated_text: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the LORD their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
original_text: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the LORD their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.

translated_text: And the LORD rejected all the seed of Israel, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.
original_text: And the LORD rejected all the seed of Israel, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.

translated_text: For he rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the LORD, and made them sin a great sin.
original_text: For he rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the LORD, and made them sin a great sin.

translated_text: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;
original_text: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;

translated_text: Until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.
original_text: Until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.

translated_text:
And the king of Assyria brought
men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed
them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.
original_text:
And the king of Assyria brought
men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed
them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.

translated_text:
And
so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there,
that they feared not the LORD: therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which slew
some of them.
original_text:
And
so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there,
that they feared not the LORD: therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which slew
some of them.

translated_text: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.
original_text: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.

translated_text: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.
original_text: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.

translated_text: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the LORD.
original_text: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the LORD.

translated_text:
Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put
them
 in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.
original_text:
Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put
them
 in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.

translated_text: And the men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,
original_text: And the men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

translated_text: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
original_text: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

translated_text: So they feared the LORD, and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.
original_text: So they feared the LORD, and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.

translated_text: They feared the LORD, and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.
original_text: They feared the LORD, and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.

translated_text: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the LORD, neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;
original_text: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the LORD, neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

translated_text: With whom the LORD had made a covenant, and charged them saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:
original_text: With whom the LORD had made a covenant, and charged them saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:

translated_text: But the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm, him shall ye fear, and him shall ye worship, and to him shall ye do sacrifice.
original_text: But the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm, him shall ye fear, and him shall ye worship, and to him shall ye do sacrifice.

translated_text: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.
original_text: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.

translated_text: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget; neither shall ye fear other gods.
original_text: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget; neither shall ye fear other gods.

translated_text: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.
original_text: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.

translated_text: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.
original_text: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.

translated_text: So these nations feared the LORD, and served their graven images, both their children, and their children’s children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.
original_text: So these nations feared the LORD, and served their graven images, both their children, and their children’s children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.

translated_text: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.
original_text: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

translated_text:
Twenty years old
was Ahaz when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not
that which was right in the sight of the LORD his God, like David his father.
original_text:
Twenty years old
was Ahaz when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not
that which was right in the sight of the LORD his God, like David his father.

translated_text: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.
original_text: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.

translated_text: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
original_text: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

translated_text:
Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome
him.
original_text:
Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome
him.

translated_text: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Jews from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there unto this day.
original_text: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Jews from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there unto this day.

translated_text:
So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, I
am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, which rise up against me.
original_text:
So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, I
am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, which rise up against me.

translated_text:
And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent
it for
 a present to the king of Assyria.
original_text:
And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent
it for
 a present to the king of Assyria.

translated_text:
And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried
the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.
original_text:
And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried
the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.

translated_text:
And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that
was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.
original_text:
And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that
was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.

translated_text:
And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made
it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.
original_text:
And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made
it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.

translated_text: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.
original_text: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.

translated_text: and he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.
original_text: and he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.

translated_text:
And he brought also the brasen altar, which
was before the LORD, from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of the LORD, and put it on the north side of the altar.
original_text:
And he brought also the brasen altar, which
was before the LORD, from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of the LORD, and put it on the north side of the altar.

translated_text:
And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king’s burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire
by.
original_text:
And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king’s burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire
by.

translated_text: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.
original_text: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.

translated_text:
And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that
were
 under it, and put it upon a pavement of stones.
original_text:
And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that
were
 under it, and put it upon a pavement of stones.

translated_text: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s entry without, turned he from the house of the LORD for the king of Assyria.
original_text: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s entry without, turned he from the house of the LORD for the king of Assyria.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

translated_text: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign.
original_text: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign.

translated_text:
Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.
original_text:
Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah had done;
original_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah had done;

translated_text: Save that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places.
original_text: Save that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places.

translated_text:
And the LORD smote the king, so that he was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house. And Jotham the king’s son
was
 over the house, judging the people of the land.
original_text:
And the LORD smote the king, so that he was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house. And Jotham the king’s son
was
 over the house, judging the people of the land.

translated_text:
And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did,

original_text:
And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

translated_text: So Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: So Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.
original_text: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his fathers had done: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
original_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his fathers had done: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

translated_text: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
And the rest of the acts of Zachariah, behold, they
are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
original_text:
And the rest of the acts of Zachariah, behold, they
are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

translated_text:
This
was the word of the LORD which he spake unto Jehu, saying, Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth
generation.
 And so it came to pass.
original_text:
This
was the word of the LORD which he spake unto Jehu, saying, Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth
generation.
 And so it came to pass.

translated_text: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.
original_text: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.

translated_text: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
original_text: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they
are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
original_text:
And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they
are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

translated_text:
Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that
were therein, and the coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not
to him, therefore he smote
it; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up.
original_text:

translated_text:
In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel,
and reigned ten years in Samaria.
original_text:
In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel,
and reigned ten years in Samaria.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
original_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

translated_text: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.
original_text: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

translated_text:
And Menahem exacted the money of Israel,
even of all the mighty men of wealth, of each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and stayed not there in the land.
original_text:

translated_text:
And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did,

original_text:
And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

translated_text: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria,
and reigned two years.
original_text:
In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria,
and reigned two years.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
original_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

translated_text: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.
original_text: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.

translated_text:

original_text:
And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they

translated_text:

original_text:

original_text:

translated_text: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abel-beth-maachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.
original_text: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abel-beth-maachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.

translated_text: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.
original_text: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

translated_text:
And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they

original_text:
And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they
are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

translated_text: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign.
original_text: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign.

translated_text:
Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name

original_text:
Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name

translated_text:

original_text:

translated_text: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of the LORD.
original_text: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did,

original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did,

 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

translated_text: In those days the LORD began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.
original_text: In those days the LORD began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.

translated_text: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah.
original_text: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah.

translated_text:
He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
original_text:
He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, yet not like David his father: he did according to all things as Joash his father did.
original_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, yet not like David his father: he did according to all things as Joash his father did.

translated_text: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places.
original_text: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places.

translated_text: And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand, that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father.
original_text: And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand, that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father.

translated_text: But the children of the murderers he slew not: according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, wherein the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
original_text: But the children of the murderers he slew not: according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, wherein the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

translated_text: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.
original_text: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.

translated_text: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.
original_text: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.

translated_text:
And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that
was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that
was
 in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that
was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
original_text:
And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that
was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that
was
 in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that
was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.

translated_text:
Thou hast indeed smitten Edom, and thine heart hath lifted thee up: glory
of this, and tarry at home: for why shouldest thou meddle to
thy hurt, that thou shouldest fall,
even thou, and Judah with thee?
original_text:
Thou hast indeed smitten Edom, and thine heart hath lifted thee up: glory
of this, and tarry at home: for why shouldest thou meddle to
thy hurt, that thou shouldest fall,
even thou, and Judah with thee?

translated_text:
But Amaziah would not hear. Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth-shemesh, which
belongeth to Judah.
original_text:
But Amaziah would not hear. Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth-shemesh, which
belongeth to Judah.

translated_text: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel; and they fled every man to their tents.
original_text: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel; and they fled every man to their tents.

translated_text: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
original_text: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

translated_text: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.
original_text: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

translated_text: And Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.
original_text: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.

translated_text:
And the rest of the acts of Amaziah,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
original_text:
And the rest of the acts of Amaziah,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

translated_text: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem: and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.
original_text: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem: and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.

translated_text: And they brought him on horses: and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.
original_text: And they brought him on horses: and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.

translated_text:
And all the people of Judah took Azariah, which
was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.
original_text:
And all the people of Judah took Azariah, which
was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.

translated_text: He built Elath, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
original_text: He built Elath, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.

translated_text:
In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria,
and reigned
 forty and one years.
original_text:
In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria,
and reigned
 forty and one years.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
original_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

translated_text:
He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of the LORD God of Israel, which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which
was of Gath-hepher.
original_text:
He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of the LORD God of Israel, which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which
was of Gath-hepher.

translated_text:
For the LORD saw the affliction of Israel,
that it was very bitter: for
there was not any shut up, nor any left, nor any helper for Israel.
original_text:
For the LORD saw the affliction of Israel,
that it was very bitter: for
there was not any shut up, nor any left, nor any helper for Israel.

translated_text: And the LORD said not that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven: but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.
original_text: And the LORD said not that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven: but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath,
which belonged to Judah, for Israel, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath,
which belonged to Judah, for Israel, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

translated_text:
And Jeroboam slept with his fathers,
even with the kings of Israel; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead.
original_text:
And Jeroboam slept with his fathers,
even with the kings of Israel; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria,
and reigned seventeen years.
original_text:
In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria,
and reigned seventeen years.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
original_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.

translated_text:
And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael, all
their days.
original_text:
And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael, all
their days.

translated_text: And Jehoahaz besought the LORD, and the LORD hearkened unto him: for he saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.
original_text: And Jehoahaz besought the LORD, and the LORD hearkened unto him: for he saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.

translated_text: (And the LORD gave Israel a saviour, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians: and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents, as beforetime.
original_text: (And the LORD gave Israel a saviour, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians: and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents, as beforetime.

translated_text:
Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Israel sin,
but walked therein: and there remained the grove also in Samaria.)
original_text:
Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Israel sin,
but walked therein: and there remained the grove also in Samaria.)

translated_text: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.
original_text: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

translated_text: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria,
and reigned sixteen years.
original_text:
In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria,
and reigned sixteen years.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin:
but he walked therein.
original_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin:
but he walked therein.

translated_text:
And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
original_text:
And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

translated_text: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
original_text: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

translated_text: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died. And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him, and wept over his face, and said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof.
original_text: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died. And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him, and wept over his face, and said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof.

translated_text: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows. And he took unto him bow and arrows.
original_text: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows. And he took unto him bow and arrows.

translated_text:
And he said to the king of Israel, Put thine hand upon the bow. And he put his hand
upon it: and Elisha put his hands upon the king’s hands.
original_text:
And he said to the king of Israel, Put thine hand upon the bow. And he put his hand
upon it: and Elisha put his hands upon the king’s hands.

translated_text:
And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened
it.
 Then Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the LORD’S deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou have consumed
them.
original_text:
And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened
it.
 Then Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the LORD’S deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou have consumed
them.

translated_text:
And he said, Take the arrows. And he took
them. And he said unto the king of Israel, Smite upon the ground. And he smote thrice, and stayed.
original_text:
And he said, Take the arrows. And he took
them. And he said unto the king of Israel, Smite upon the ground. And he smote thrice, and stayed.

translated_text:
And the man of God was wroth with him, and said, Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed
it: whereas now thou shalt smite Syria
but thrice.
original_text:
And the man of God was wroth with him, and said, Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed
it: whereas now thou shalt smite Syria
but thrice.

translated_text: And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.
original_text: And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band
of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
original_text:
And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band
of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.

translated_text: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.
original_text: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.

translated_text: And the LORD was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.
original_text: And the LORD was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.

translated_text: So Hazael king of Syria died; and Ben-hadad his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: So Hazael king of Syria died; and Ben-hadad his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael the cities, which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash beat him, and recovered the cities of Israel.
original_text: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael the cities, which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash beat him, and recovered the cities of Israel.

translated_text:
In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign; and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.
original_text:
In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign; and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.

translated_text:
And Jehoash did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
original_text:
And Jehoash did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

translated_text: But the high places were not taken away: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.
original_text: But the high places were not taken away: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.

translated_text:
And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the LORD,
even the money of every one that passeth
the account, the money that every man is set at,
and all the money that cometh into any man’s heart to bring into the house of the LORD,
original_text:
And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the LORD,
even the money of every one that passeth
the account, the money that every man is set at,
and all the money that cometh into any man’s heart to bring into the house of the LORD,

translated_text:
Let the priests take
it to them, every man of his acquaintance: and let them repair the breaches of the house, wheresoever any breach shall be found.
original_text:
Let the priests take
it to them, every man of his acquaintance: and let them repair the breaches of the house, wheresoever any breach shall be found.

translated_text:
But it was
so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.
original_text:
But it was
so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.

translated_text:
Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the
other
 priests, and said unto them, Why repair ye not the breaches of the house? now therefore receive no
more money of your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.
original_text:
Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the
other
 priests, and said unto them, Why repair ye not the breaches of the house? now therefore receive no
more money of your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.

translated_text:
And the priests consented to receive no
more money of the people, neither to repair the breaches of the house.
original_text:
And the priests consented to receive no
more money of the people, neither to repair the breaches of the house.

translated_text:
But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the LORD: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money
that was brought into the house of the LORD.
original_text:
But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the LORD: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money

translated_text:
And it was
so, when they saw that
there was much money in the chest, that the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags, and told the money that was found in the house of the LORD.
original_text:
And it was
so, when they saw that
there was much money in the chest, that the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags, and told the money that was found in the house of the LORD.

translated_text: And they gave the money, being told, into the hands of them that did the work, that had the oversight of the house of the LORD: and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders, that wrought upon the house of the LORD,
original_text: And they gave the money, being told, into the hands of them that did the work, that had the oversight of the house of the LORD: and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders, that wrought upon the house of the LORD,

translated_text:

original_text:

Howbeit there were not made for the house of the LORD bowls of silver, snuffers, basons, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money

translated_text: But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of the LORD.
original_text: But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of the LORD.

translated_text: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.
original_text: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.

translated_text: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the LORD: it was the priests’.
original_text: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the LORD: it was the priests’.

translated_text: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.
original_text: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own hallowed things, and all the gold

it to Hazael king of Syria: and he went away from Jerusalem.
original_text:

translated_text:
And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did,

 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
original_text:
And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

translated_text: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in the house of Millo, which goeth down to Silla.
original_text: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in the house of Millo, which goeth down to Silla.

translated_text: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.
original_text: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.

original_text:

which were
 slain; and they hid him,

translated_text: And he was with her hid in the house of the LORD six years. And Athaliah did reign over the land.
original_text: And he was with her hid in the house of the LORD six years. And Athaliah did reign over the land.

translated_text: And the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over hundreds, with the captains and the guard, and brought them to him into the house of the LORD, and made a covenant with them, and took an oath of them in the house of the LORD, and shewed them the king’s son.
original_text: And the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over hundreds, with the captains and the guard, and brought them to him into the house of the LORD, and made a covenant with them, and took an oath of them in the house of the LORD, and shewed them the king’s son.

translated_text: And he commanded them, saying, This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;
original_text: And he commanded them, saying, This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;

translated_text:
And a third part
shall be at the gate of Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall ye keep the watch of the house, that it be not broken down.
original_text:
And a third part
shall be at the gate of Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall ye keep the watch of the house, that it be not broken down.

translated_text: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of the LORD about the king.
original_text: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of the LORD about the king.

translated_text: And ye shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that cometh within the ranges, let him be slain: and be ye with the king as he goeth out and as he cometh in.
original_text: And ye shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that cometh within the ranges, let him be slain: and be ye with the king as he goeth out and as he cometh in.

translated_text:
And the captains over the hundreds did according to all
things
 that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that should go out on the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.
original_text:
And the captains over the hundreds did according to all
things
 that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that should go out on the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

translated_text:
And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David’s spears and shields, that
were in the temple of the LORD.
original_text:
And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David’s spears and shields, that
were in the temple of the LORD.

translated_text:
And the guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, round about the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple,
along by the altar and the temple.
original_text:
And the guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, round about the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple,
along by the altar and the temple.

translated_text:
And he brought forth the king’s son, and put the crown upon him, and
gave him the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, God save the king.
original_text:
And he brought forth the king’s son, and put the crown upon him, and
gave him the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, God save the king.

translated_text:
And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard
and of the people, she came to the people into the temple of the LORD.
original_text:
And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard
and of the people, she came to the people into the temple of the LORD.

translated_text:
And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner
was, and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.
original_text:
And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner
was, and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.

translated_text: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the host, and said unto them, Have her forth without the ranges: and him that followeth her kill with the sword. For the priest had said, Let her not be slain in the house of the LORD.
original_text: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the host, and said unto them, Have her forth without the ranges: and him that followeth her kill with the sword. For the priest had said, Let her not be slain in the house of the LORD.

translated_text: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king’s house: and there was she slain.
original_text: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king’s house: and there was she slain.

translated_text: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people that they should be the LORD’S people; between the king also and the people.
original_text: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people that they should be the LORD’S people; between the king also and the people.

translated_text: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and brake it down; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of the LORD.
original_text: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and brake it down; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of the LORD.

translated_text: And he took the rulers over hundreds, and the captains, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the house of the LORD, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.
original_text: And he took the rulers over hundreds, and the captains, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the house of the LORD, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.

translated_text:
And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was in quiet: and they slew Athaliah with the sword
beside the king’s house.
original_text:
And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was in quiet: and they slew Athaliah with the sword
beside the king’s house.

translated_text:
Seven years old
was Jehoash when he began to reign.
original_text:
Seven years old
was Jehoash when he began to reign.

translated_text:
And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab’s
children, saying,
original_text:
And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab’s
children, saying,

translated_text:
Look even out the best and meetest of your master’s sons, and set
him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.
original_text:
Look even out the best and meetest of your master’s sons, and set
him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.

translated_text: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?
original_text: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?

translated_text:
And he that
was over the house, and he that
was
 over the city, the elders also, and the bringers up
of the children, sent to Jehu, saying, We are thy servants, and will do all that thou shalt bid us; we will not make any king: do thou
that which is
 good in thine eyes.
original_text:
And he that
was over the house, and he that
was
 over the city, the elders also, and the bringers up
of the children, sent to Jehu, saying, We are thy servants, and will do all that thou shalt bid us; we will not make any king: do thou
that which is
 good in thine eyes.

translated_text:
Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If ye
be
 mine, and
if ye will hearken unto my voice, take ye the heads of the men your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king’s sons,
being seventy persons,
were
 with the great men of the city, which brought them up.
original_text:
Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If ye
be
 mine, and
if ye will hearken unto my voice, take ye the heads of the men your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king’s sons,
being seventy persons,
were
 with the great men of the city, which brought them up.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king’s sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent him
them to Jezreel.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king’s sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent him
them to Jezreel.

translated_text: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king’s sons. And he said, Lay ye them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.
original_text: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king’s sons. And he said, Lay ye them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, Ye
be righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?
original_text:
And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, Ye
be righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?

translated_text:
Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the LORD, which the LORD spake concerning the house of Ahab: for the LORD hath done
that which he spake by his servant Elijah.
original_text:
Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the LORD, which the LORD spake concerning the house of Ahab: for the LORD hath done
that which he spake by his servant Elijah.

translated_text: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsfolks, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.
original_text: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsfolks, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.

translated_text:
And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria.
And as he
was at the shearing house in the way,
original_text:
And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria.
And as he
was at the shearing house in the way,

translated_text:
Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who
are ye? And they answered, We
are the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen.
original_text:
Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who
are ye? And they answered, We
are the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen.

translated_text:
And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house,
even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.
original_text:
And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house,
even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.

translated_text:
And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab
coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is thine heart right, as my heart
is with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give
me thine hand. And he gave
him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.
original_text:
And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab
coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is thine heart right, as my heart
is with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give
me thine hand. And he gave
him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

translated_text: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD. So they made him ride in his chariot.
original_text: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD. So they made him ride in his chariot.

translated_text: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spake to Elijah.
original_text: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spake to Elijah.

translated_text:
And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said unto them, Ahab served Baal a little;
but Jehu shall serve him much.
original_text:
And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said unto them, Ahab served Baal a little;
but Jehu shall serve him much.

translated_text:
Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be wanting: for I have a great sacrifice
to do to Baal; whosoever shall be wanting, he shall not live. But Jehu did
it in subtilty, to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal.
original_text:
Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be wanting: for I have a great sacrifice
to do to Baal; whosoever shall be wanting, he shall not live. But Jehu did
it in subtilty, to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal.

translated_text:
And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed
it.
original_text:
And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed
it.

translated_text: And Jehu sent through all Israel: and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not. And they came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another.
original_text: And Jehu sent through all Israel: and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not. And they came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another.

translated_text:
And he said unto him that
was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.
original_text:
And he said unto him that
was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.

translated_text: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of the LORD, but the worshippers of Baal only.
original_text: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of the LORD, but the worshippers of Baal only.

translated_text:
And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said,
If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape,
he that letteth him go, his life
shall be for the life of him.
original_text:
And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said,
If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape,
he that letteth him go, his life
shall be for the life of him.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in,
and
 slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast
them out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.
original_text:
And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in,
and
 slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast
them out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.

translated_text: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.
original_text: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.

translated_text: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.
original_text: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.

translated_text: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.
original_text: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

translated_text:
Howbeit
from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them,
to wit, the golden calves that
were in Bethel, and that
were in Dan.
original_text:
Howbeit
from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them,
to wit, the golden calves that
were in Bethel, and that
were in Dan.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto Jehu, Because thou hast done well in executing
that which is right in mine eyes,
and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that
was in mine heart, thy children of the fourth
generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto Jehu, Because thou hast done well in executing
that which is right in mine eyes,
and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that
was in mine heart, thy children of the fourth
generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.

translated_text: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD God of Israel with all his heart: for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, which made Israel to sin.
original_text: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD God of Israel with all his heart: for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, which made Israel to sin.

translated_text: In those days the LORD began to cut Israel short: and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel;
original_text: In those days the LORD began to cut Israel short: and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel;

translated_text: From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.
original_text: From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might,
are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

translated_text: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria
was
 twenty and eight years.
original_text:
And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria
was
 twenty and eight years.

translated_text: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha, Behold now, the place where we dwell with thee is too strait for us.
original_text: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha, Behold now, the place where we dwell with thee is too strait for us.

translated_text: Let us go, we pray thee, unto Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And he answered, Go ye.
original_text: Let us go, we pray thee, unto Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And he answered, Go ye.

translated_text: And one said, Be content, I pray thee, and go with thy servants. And he answered, I will go.
