original_text: And one said, Be content, I pray thee, and go with thy servants. And he answered, I will go.

translated_text: So he went with them. And when they came to Jordan, they cut down wood.
original_text: So he went with them. And when they came to Jordan, they cut down wood.

translated_text: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.
original_text: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.

translated_text:
And the man of God said, Where fell it? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast
it in thither; and the iron did swim.
original_text:
And the man of God said, Where fell it? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast
it in thither; and the iron did swim.

translated_text:
Therefore said he, Take
it up to thee. And he put out his hand, and took it.
original_text:
Therefore said he, Take
it up to thee. And he put out his hand, and took it.

translated_text:
Then the king of Syria warred against Israel, and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place
shall be my camp.
original_text:
Then the king of Syria warred against Israel, and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place
shall be my camp.

translated_text: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.
original_text: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.

translated_text: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.
original_text: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.

translated_text:
Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said unto them, Will ye not shew me which of us
is for the king of Israel?
original_text:
Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said unto them, Will ye not shew me which of us
is for the king of Israel?

translated_text:
And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that
is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber.
original_text:
And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that
is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber.

translated_text:
And he said, Go and spy where he
is, that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold,
he is in Dothan.
original_text:
And he said, Go and spy where he
is, that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold,
he is in Dothan.

translated_text: Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and compassed the city about.
original_text: Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and compassed the city about.

translated_text: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?
original_text: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?

translated_text:
And he answered, Fear not: for they that
be with us
are more than they that
be with them.
original_text:
And he answered, Fear not: for they that
be with us
are more than they that
be with them.

translated_text:
And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain
was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.
original_text:
And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain
was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.

translated_text: And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed unto the LORD, and said, Smite this people, I pray thee, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.
original_text: And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed unto the LORD, and said, Smite this people, I pray thee, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.

translated_text:
And Elisha said unto them, This
is not the way, neither
is this the city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek. But he led them to Samaria.
original_text:
And Elisha said unto them, This
is not the way, neither
is this the city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek. But he led them to Samaria.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when they were come into Samaria, that Elisha said, LORD, open the eyes of these
men, that they may see. And the LORD opened their eyes, and they saw; and, behold,
they were in the midst of Samaria.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when they were come into Samaria, that Elisha said, LORD, open the eyes of these
men, that they may see. And the LORD opened their eyes, and they saw; and, behold,
they were in the midst of Samaria.

translated_text:
And the king of Israel said unto Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite
them? shall I smite
them?
original_text:
And the king of Israel said unto Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite
them? shall I smite
them?

translated_text:
And he answered, Thou shalt not smite
them: wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow? set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.
original_text:
And he answered, Thou shalt not smite
them: wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow? set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.

translated_text: And he prepared great provision for them: and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.
original_text: And he prepared great provision for them: and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.

translated_text: And it came to pass after this, that Ben-hadad king of Syria gathered all his host, and went up, and besieged Samaria.
original_text: And it came to pass after this, that Ben-hadad king of Syria gathered all his host, and went up, and besieged Samaria.

translated_text:
And there was a great famine in Samaria: and, behold, they besieged it, until an ass’s head was
sold for fourscore
pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a cab of dove’s dung for five
pieces
 of silver.
original_text:
And there was a great famine in Samaria: and, behold, they besieged it, until an ass’s head was
sold for fourscore
pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a cab of dove’s dung for five
pieces
 of silver.

translated_text: And as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman unto him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.
original_text: And as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman unto him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.

translated_text: And he said, If the LORD do not help thee, whence shall I help thee? out of the barnfloor, or out of the winepress?
original_text: And he said, If the LORD do not help thee, whence shall I help thee? out of the barnfloor, or out of the winepress?

translated_text: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, This woman said unto me, Give thy son, that we may eat him to day, and we will eat my son to morrow.
original_text: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, This woman said unto me, Give thy son, that we may eat him to day, and we will eat my son to morrow.

translated_text: So we boiled my son, and did eat him: and I said unto her on the next day, Give thy son, that we may eat him: and she hath hid her son.
original_text: So we boiled my son, and did eat him: and I said unto her on the next day, Give thy son, that we may eat him: and she hath hid her son.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the woman, that he rent his clothes; and he passed by upon the wall, and the people looked, and, behold,
he had sackcloth within upon his flesh.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the woman, that he rent his clothes; and he passed by upon the wall, and the people looked, and, behold,
he had sackcloth within upon his flesh.

translated_text: Then he said, God do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.
original_text: Then he said, God do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.

translated_text:
But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him; and
the king sent a man from before him: but ere the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head? look, when the messenger cometh, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door:
is not the sound of his master’s feet behind him?
original_text:
But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him; and
the king sent a man from before him: but ere the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head? look, when the messenger cometh, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door:
is not the sound of his master’s feet behind him?

translated_text:
And while he yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down unto him: and he said, Behold, this evil
is of the LORD; what should I wait for the LORD any longer?
original_text:
And while he yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down unto him: and he said, Behold, this evil
is of the LORD; what should I wait for the LORD any longer?

translated_text:
Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the LORD had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour,
but he was a leper.
original_text:
Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the LORD had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour,
but he was a leper.

translated_text: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman’s wife.
original_text: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman’s wife.

translated_text:
And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord
were with the prophet that
is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.
original_text:
And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord
were with the prophet that
is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.

translated_text:
And
one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that
is of the land of Israel.
original_text:
And
one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that
is of the land of Israel.

translated_text:
And the king of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand
pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.
original_text:
And the king of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand
pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.

translated_text:
And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now when this letter is come unto thee, behold, I have
therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy.
original_text:
And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now when this letter is come unto thee, behold, I have
therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said,
Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said,
Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me.

translated_text:
And it was
so, when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.
original_text:
And it was
so, when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.

translated_text: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.
original_text: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

translated_text: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.
original_text: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.

translated_text: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.
original_text: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.

translated_text: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
original_text: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.

translated_text:
And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father,
if the prophet had bid thee
do some great thing, wouldest thou not have done
it? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?
original_text:
And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father,
if the prophet had bid thee
do some great thing, wouldest thou not have done
it? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?

translated_text: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
original_text: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

translated_text:
And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that
there is
 no God in all earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray thee, take a blessing of thy servant.
original_text:
And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that
there is
 no God in all earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray thee, take a blessing of thy servant.

translated_text:
But he said,
As the LORD liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take
it; but he refused.
original_text:
But he said,
As the LORD liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take
it; but he refused.

translated_text: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given to thy servant two mules’ burden of earth? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto the LORD.
original_text: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given to thy servant two mules’ burden of earth? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto the LORD.

translated_text:
In this thing the LORD pardon thy servant,
that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, the LORD pardon thy servant in this thing.
original_text:
In this thing the LORD pardon thy servant,
that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, the LORD pardon thy servant in this thing.

translated_text: And he said unto him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.
original_text: And he said unto him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.

translated_text:
But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but,
as the LORD liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.
original_text:
But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but,
as the LORD liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.

translated_text:
So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw
him
 running after him, he lighted down from the chariot to meet him, and said,
Is all well?
original_text:
So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw
him
 running after him, he lighted down from the chariot to meet him, and said,
Is all well?

translated_text:
And he said, All
is well. My master hath sent me, saying, Behold, even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.
original_text:
And he said, All
is well. My master hath sent me, saying, Behold, even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.

translated_text:
And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid
them upon two of his servants; and they bare
them
 before him.
original_text:
And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid
them upon two of his servants; and they bare
them
 before him.

translated_text:
And when he came to the tower, he took
them from their hand, and bestowed
them in the house: and he let the men go, and they departed.
original_text:
And when he came to the tower, he took
them from their hand, and bestowed
them in the house: and he let the men go, and they departed.

translated_text:
But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence
comest thou, Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither.
original_text:
But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence
comest thou, Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither.

translated_text:
And he said unto him, Went not mine heart
with thee, when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee?
Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and maidservants?
original_text:
And he said unto him, Went not mine heart
with thee, when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee?
Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and maidservants?

translated_text:
The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee, and unto thy seed for ever. And he went out from his presence a leper
as white
 as snow.
original_text:
The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee, and unto thy seed for ever. And he went out from his presence a leper
as white
 as snow.

translated_text: Then spake Elisha unto the woman, whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise, and go thou and thine household, and sojourn wheresoever thou canst sojourn: for the LORD hath called for a famine; and it shall also come upon the land seven years.
original_text: Then spake Elisha unto the woman, whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise, and go thou and thine household, and sojourn wheresoever thou canst sojourn: for the LORD hath called for a famine; and it shall also come upon the land seven years.

translated_text: And the woman arose, and did after the saying of the man of God: and she went with her household, and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.
original_text: And the woman arose, and did after the saying of the man of God: and she went with her household, and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.

translated_text: And it came to pass at the seven years’ end, that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines: and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land.
original_text: And it came to pass at the seven years’ end, that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines: and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land.

translated_text: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, Tell me, I pray thee, all the great things that Elisha hath done.
original_text: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, Tell me, I pray thee, all the great things that Elisha hath done.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, that, behold, the woman, whose son he had restored to life, cried to the king for her house and for her land. And Gehazi said, My lord, O king, this
is the woman, and this
is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.
original_text:
And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, that, behold, the woman, whose son he had restored to life, cried to the king for her house and for her land. And Gehazi said, My lord, O king, this
is the woman, and this
is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.

translated_text:
And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that
was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.
original_text:
And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that
was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.

translated_text: And Elisha came to Damascus; and Ben-hadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told him, saying, The man of God is come hither.
original_text: And Elisha came to Damascus; and Ben-hadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told him, saying, The man of God is come hither.

translated_text: And the king said unto Hazael, Take a present in thine hand, and go, meet the man of God, and enquire of the LORD by him, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?
original_text: And the king said unto Hazael, Take a present in thine hand, and go, meet the man of God, and enquire of the LORD by him, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?

translated_text: So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Thy son Ben-hadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?
original_text: So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Thy son Ben-hadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?

translated_text: And Elisha said unto him, Go, say unto him, Thou mayest certainly recover: howbeit the LORD hath shewed me that he shall surely die.
original_text: And Elisha said unto him, Go, say unto him, Thou mayest certainly recover: howbeit the LORD hath shewed me that he shall surely die.

translated_text: And he settled his countenance stedfastly, until he was ashamed: and the man of God wept.
original_text: And he settled his countenance stedfastly, until he was ashamed: and the man of God wept.

translated_text: And Hazael said, Why weepeth my lord? And he answered, Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel: their strong holds wilt thou set on fire, and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword, and wilt dash their children, and rip up their women with child.
original_text: And Hazael said, Why weepeth my lord? And he answered, Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel: their strong holds wilt thou set on fire, and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword, and wilt dash their children, and rip up their women with child.

translated_text:
And Hazael said, But what,
is thy servant a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha answered, The LORD hath shewed me that thou
shalt be king over Syria.
original_text:
And Hazael said, But what,
is thy servant a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha answered, The LORD hath shewed me that thou
shalt be king over Syria.

translated_text:
So he departed from Elisha, and came to his master; who said to him, What said Elisha to thee? And he answered, He told me
that
thou shouldest surely recover.
original_text:
So he departed from Elisha, and came to his master; who said to him, What said Elisha to thee? And he answered, He told me
that
thou shouldest surely recover.

translated_text:
And it came to pass on the morrow, that he took a thick cloth, and dipped
it in water, and spread
it on his face, so that he died: and Hazael reigned in his stead.
original_text:
And it came to pass on the morrow, that he took a thick cloth, and dipped
it in water, and spread
it on his face, so that he died: and Hazael reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat
being then king of Judah, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.
original_text:
And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat
being then king of Judah, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.

translated_text: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
original_text: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

translated_text: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab: for the daughter of Ahab was his wife: and he did evil in the sight of the LORD.
original_text: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab: for the daughter of Ahab was his wife: and he did evil in the sight of the LORD.

translated_text:
Yet the LORD would not destroy Judah for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give him alway a light,
and to his children.
original_text:
Yet the LORD would not destroy Judah for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give him alway a light,
and to his children.

translated_text: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.
original_text: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

translated_text: So Joram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with him: and he rose by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots: and the people fled into their tents.
original_text: So Joram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with him: and he rose by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots: and the people fled into their tents.

translated_text: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.
original_text: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.

translated_text:
And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
original_text:
And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did,
are
 they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

translated_text: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign.
original_text: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign.

translated_text:
Two and twenty years old
was Ahaziah when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was
 Athaliah, the daughter of Omri king of Israel.
original_text:
Two and twenty years old
was Ahaziah when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was
 Athaliah, the daughter of Omri king of Israel.

translated_text:
And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of the LORD, as
did the house of Ahab: for he
was the son in law of the house of Ahab.
original_text:
And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of the LORD, as
did the house of Ahab: for he
was the son in law of the house of Ahab.

translated_text: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramoth-gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.
original_text: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramoth-gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.

translated_text: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
original_text: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

translated_text:
Then Elisha said, Hear ye the word of the LORD; Thus saith the LORD, To morrow about this time
shall a measure of fine flour
be sold
 for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.
original_text:
Then Elisha said, Hear ye the word of the LORD; Thus saith the LORD, To morrow about this time
shall a measure of fine flour
be sold
 for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.

translated_text:
Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, Behold,
if the LORD would make windows in heaven, might this thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see
it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.
original_text:
Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, Behold,
if the LORD would make windows in heaven, might this thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see
it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.

translated_text: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?
original_text: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?

translated_text:
If we say, We will enter into the city, then the famine
is
 in the city, and we shall die there: and if we sit still here, we die also. Now therefore come, and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians: if they save us alive, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall but die.
original_text:
If we say, We will enter into the city, then the famine
is
 in the city, and we shall die there: and if we sit still here, we die also. Now therefore come, and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians: if they save us alive, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall but die.

translated_text:
And they rose up in the twilight, to go unto the camp of the Syrians: and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria, behold,
there was no man there.
original_text:
And they rose up in the twilight, to go unto the camp of the Syrians: and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria, behold,
there was no man there.

translated_text:
For the Lord had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots, and a noise of horses,
even the noise of a great host: and they said one to another, Lo, the king of Israel hath hired against us the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of the Egyptians, to come upon us.
original_text:
For the Lord had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots, and a noise of horses,
even the noise of a great host: and they said one to another, Lo, the king of Israel hath hired against us the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of the Egyptians, to come upon us.

translated_text:
Wherefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their asses, even the camp as it
was, and fled for their life.
original_text:
Wherefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their asses, even the camp as it
was, and fled for their life.

translated_text:
And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and did eat and drink, and carried thence silver, and gold, and raiment, and went and hid
it; and came again, and entered into another tent, and carried thence
also, and went and hid
it.
original_text:
And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and did eat and drink, and carried thence silver, and gold, and raiment, and went and hid
it; and came again, and entered into another tent, and carried thence
also, and went and hid
it.

translated_text:
Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day
is
 a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king’s household.
original_text:
Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day
is
 a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king’s household.

translated_text:
So they came and called unto the porter of the city: and they told them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold,
there was
 no man there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and asses tied, and the tents as they
were.
original_text:
So they came and called unto the porter of the city: and they told them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold,
there was
 no man there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and asses tied, and the tents as they
were.

translated_text:
And he called the porters; and they told
it to the king’s house within.
original_text:
And he called the porters; and they told
it to the king’s house within.

translated_text:
And the king arose in the night, and said unto his servants, I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we
be
 hungry; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, When they come out of the city, we shall catch them alive, and get into the city.
original_text:
And the king arose in the night, and said unto his servants, I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we
be
 hungry; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, When they come out of the city, we shall catch them alive, and get into the city.

translated_text:
And one of his servants answered and said, Let
some take, I pray thee, five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city, (behold, they
are as all the multitude of Israel that are left in it: behold,
I say, they
are even as all the multitude of the Israelites that are consumed:) and let us send and see.
original_text:
And one of his servants answered and said, Let
some take, I pray thee, five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city, (behold, they
are as all the multitude of Israel that are left in it: behold,
I say, they
are even as all the multitude of the Israelites that are consumed:) and let us send and see.

translated_text: They took therefore two chariot horses; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.
original_text: They took therefore two chariot horses; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.

translated_text:
And they went after them unto Jordan: and, lo, all the way
was
 full of garments and vessels, which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. And the messengers returned, and told the king.
original_text:
And they went after them unto Jordan: and, lo, all the way
was
 full of garments and vessels, which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. And the messengers returned, and told the king.

translated_text:
And the people went out, and spoiled the tents of the Syrians. So a measure of fine flour was
sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the word of the LORD.
original_text:
And the people went out, and spoiled the tents of the Syrians. So a measure of fine flour was
sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the word of the LORD.

translated_text: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate: and the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died, as the man of God had said, who spake when the king came down to him.
original_text: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate: and the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died, as the man of God had said, who spake when the king came down to him.

translated_text: And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, Two measures of barley for a shekel, and a measure of fine flour for a shekel, shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria:
original_text: And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, Two measures of barley for a shekel, and a measure of fine flour for a shekel, shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria:

translated_text:
And that lord answered the man of God, and said, Now, behold,
if the LORD should make windows in heaven, might such a thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.
original_text:
And that lord answered the man of God, and said, Now, behold,
if the LORD should make windows in heaven, might such a thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.

translated_text: And so it fell out unto him: for the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died.
original_text: And so it fell out unto him: for the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died.

translated_text: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets, and said unto him, Gird up thy loins, and take this box of oil in thine hand, and go to Ramoth-gilead:
original_text: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets, and said unto him, Gird up thy loins, and take this box of oil in thine hand, and go to Ramoth-gilead:

translated_text: And when thou comest thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;
original_text: And when thou comest thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;

translated_text:
Then take the box of oil, and pour
it on his head, and say, Thus saith the LORD, I have anointed thee king over Israel. Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.
original_text:
Then take the box of oil, and pour
it on his head, and say, Thus saith the LORD, I have anointed thee king over Israel. Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.

translated_text:
So the young man,
even the young man the prophet, went to Ramoth-gilead.
original_text:
So the young man,
even the young man the prophet, went to Ramoth-gilead.

translated_text:
And when he came, behold, the captains of the host
were sitting; and he said, I have an errand to thee, O captain. And Jehu said, Unto which of all us? And he said, To thee, O captain.
original_text:
And when he came, behold, the captains of the host
were sitting; and he said, I have an errand to thee, O captain. And Jehu said, Unto which of all us? And he said, To thee, O captain.

translated_text:
And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I have anointed thee king over the people of the LORD,
even over Israel.
original_text:
And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I have anointed thee king over the people of the LORD,
even over Israel.

translated_text: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD, at the hand of Jezebel.
original_text: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD, at the hand of Jezebel.

translated_text: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel:
original_text: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel:

translated_text: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah:
original_text: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah:

translated_text:
And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and
there shall be none to bury
her. And he opened the door, and fled.
original_text:
And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and
there shall be none to bury
her. And he opened the door, and fled.

translated_text:
Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and
one
 said unto him,
Is all well? wherefore came this mad
fellow to thee? And he said unto them, Ye know the man, and his communication.
original_text:
Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and
one
 said unto him,
Is all well? wherefore came this mad
fellow to thee? And he said unto them, Ye know the man, and his communication.

translated_text:
And they said,
It is false; tell us now. And he said, Thus and thus spake he to me, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I have anointed thee king over Israel.
original_text:
And they said,
It is false; tell us now. And he said, Thus and thus spake he to me, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I have anointed thee king over Israel.

translated_text:
Then they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put
it
 under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.
original_text:
Then they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put
it
 under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.

translated_text: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramoth-gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria.
original_text: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramoth-gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria.

translated_text:
But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, If it be your minds,
then let none go forth
nor
 escape out of the city to go to tell
it in Jezreel.
original_text:
But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, If it be your minds,
then let none go forth
nor
 escape out of the city to go to tell
it in Jezreel.

translated_text: So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram.
original_text: So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram.

translated_text:
And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say,
Is it peace?
original_text:
And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say,
Is it peace?

translated_text:
So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus saith the king,
Is it peace? And Jehu said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he cometh not again.
original_text:
So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus saith the king,
Is it peace? And Jehu said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he cometh not again.

translated_text:
Then he sent out a second on horseback, which came to them, and said, Thus saith the king,
Is it peace? And Jehu answered, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me.
original_text:
Then he sent out a second on horseback, which came to them, and said, Thus saith the king,
Is it peace? And Jehu answered, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me.

translated_text: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.
original_text: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.

translated_text: And Joram said, Make ready. And his chariot was made ready. And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.
original_text: And Joram said, Make ready. And his chariot was made ready. And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said,
Is it
 peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts
are so many?
original_text:
And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said,
Is it
 peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts
are so many?

translated_text:
And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah,
There is treachery, O Ahaziah.
original_text:
And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah,
There is treachery, O Ahaziah.

translated_text: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.
original_text: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

translated_text:
Then said
Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up,
and
 cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden upon him;
original_text:
Then said
Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up,
and
 cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden upon him;

translated_text:
Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith the LORD; and I will requite thee in this plat, saith the LORD. Now therefore take
and cast him into the plat
of ground,
 according to the word of the LORD.
original_text:
Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith the LORD; and I will requite thee in this plat, saith the LORD. Now therefore take
and cast him into the plat
of ground,
 according to the word of the LORD.

translated_text:
But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw
this, he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot.
And they did so at the going up to Gur, which
is by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.
original_text:
But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw
this, he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot.
And they did so at the going up to Gur, which
is by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.

translated_text: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.
original_text: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.

translated_text: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.
original_text: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.

translated_text:
And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard
of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.
original_text:
And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard
of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.

translated_text:
And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said,
Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?
original_text:
And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said,
Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?

translated_text:
And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who
is
 on my side? who? And there looked out to him two
or three eunuchs.
original_text:
And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who
is
 on my side? who? And there looked out to him two
or three eunuchs.

translated_text:
And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and
some
 of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.
original_text:
And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and
some
 of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.

translated_text:
And when he was come in, he did eat and drink, and said, Go, see now this cursed
woman, and bury her: for she
is a king’s daughter.
original_text:
And when he was come in, he did eat and drink, and said, Go, see now this cursed
woman, and bury her: for she
is a king’s daughter.

translated_text:
And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of
her hands.
original_text:
And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of
her hands.

translated_text:
Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This
is
 the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:
original_text:
Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This
is
 the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:

translated_text: And it came to pass, when the LORD would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
original_text: And it came to pass, when the LORD would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

translated_text:
And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Bethel. And Elisha said
unto him, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they went down to Bethel.
original_text:
And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Bethel. And Elisha said
unto him, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they went down to Bethel.

translated_text:
And the sons of the prophets that
were at Bethel came forth to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he said, Yea, I know
it; hold ye your peace.
original_text:
And the sons of the prophets that
were at Bethel came forth to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he said, Yea, I know
it; hold ye your peace.

translated_text:
And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Jericho. And he said,
As the LORD liveth, and
as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they came to Jericho.
original_text:
And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Jericho. And he said,
As the LORD liveth, and
as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they came to Jericho.

translated_text:
And the sons of the prophets that
were at Jericho came to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he answered, Yea, I know
it; hold ye your peace.
original_text:
And the sons of the prophets that
were at Jericho came to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he answered, Yea, I know
it; hold ye your peace.

translated_text:
And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray thee, here; for the LORD hath sent me to Jordan. And he said,
As the LORD liveth, and
as
 thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And they two went on.
original_text:
And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray thee, here; for the LORD hath sent me to Jordan. And he said,
As the LORD liveth, and
as
 thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And they two went on.

translated_text: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.
original_text: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.

translated_text:
And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped
it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.
original_text:
And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped
it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.
original_text: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.

translated_text:
And he said, Thou hast asked a hard thing:
nevertheless,
 if thou see me
when I am taken from thee, it shall be so unto thee; but if not, it shall not be so.
original_text:
And he said, Thou hast asked a hard thing:
nevertheless,
 if thou see me
when I am taken from thee, it shall be so unto thee; but if not, it shall not be so.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold,
there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
original_text:
And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold,
there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

translated_text:
And Elisha saw
it, and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.
original_text:
And Elisha saw
it, and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.

translated_text: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;
original_text: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;

translated_text:
And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where
is the LORD God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.
original_text:
And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where
is the LORD God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.

translated_text:
And when the sons of the prophets which
were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.
original_text:
And when the sons of the prophets which
were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

translated_text: And they said unto him, Behold now, there be with thy servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master: lest peradventure the Spirit of the LORD hath taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, Ye shall not send.
original_text: And they said unto him, Behold now, there be with thy servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master: lest peradventure the Spirit of the LORD hath taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, Ye shall not send.

translated_text: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.
original_text: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.

translated_text: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?
original_text: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?

translated_text:
And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city
is pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water
is naught, and the ground barren.
original_text:
And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city
is pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water
is naught, and the ground barren.

translated_text:
And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they bring
it to him.
original_text:
And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they bring
it to him.

translated_text:
And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus saith the LORD, I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren
land.
original_text:
And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus saith the LORD, I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren
land.

translated_text: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spake.
original_text: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spake.

translated_text: And he went up from thence unto Bethel: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.
original_text: And he went up from thence unto Bethel: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.

translated_text: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of the LORD. And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tare forty and two children of them.
original_text: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of the LORD. And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tare forty and two children of them.

translated_text: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.
original_text: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.

translated_text: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.
original_text: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

translated_text:
And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that
was in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said unto them, Go, enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.
original_text:
And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that
was in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said unto them, Go, enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.

translated_text:
But the angel of the LORD said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say unto them,
Is it
 not because
there is not a God in Israel,
that
 ye go to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron?
original_text:
But the angel of the LORD said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say unto them,
Is it
 not because
there is not a God in Israel,
that
 ye go to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron?

translated_text: Now therefore thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die. And Elijah departed.
original_text: Now therefore thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die. And Elijah departed.

translated_text: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are ye now turned back?
original_text: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are ye now turned back?

translated_text:
And they said unto him, There came a man up to meet us, and said unto us, Go, turn again unto the king that sent you, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD,
Is it not because
there is not a God in Israel,
that thou sendest to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.
original_text:
And they said unto him, There came a man up to meet us, and said unto us, Go, turn again unto the king that sent you, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD,
Is it not because
there is not a God in Israel,
that thou sendest to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.

translated_text:
And he said unto them, What manner of man
was he which came up to meet you, and told you these words?
original_text:
And he said unto them, What manner of man
was he which came up to meet you, and told you these words?

translated_text:
And they answered him,
He was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It
is Elijah the Tishbite.
original_text:
And they answered him,
He was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It
is Elijah the Tishbite.

translated_text: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him: and, behold, he sat on the top of an hill. And he spake unto him, Thou man of God, the king hath said, Come down.
original_text: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him: and, behold, he sat on the top of an hill. And he spake unto him, Thou man of God, the king hath said, Come down.

translated_text:
And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I
be
 a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
original_text:
And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I
be
 a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

translated_text: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said unto him, O man of God, thus hath the king said, Come down quickly.
original_text: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said unto him, O man of God, thus hath the king said, Come down quickly.

translated_text:

original_text:

be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

translated_text: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty. original_text: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty. translated_text: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight.
original_text: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight.

translated_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him. And he arose, and went down with him unto the king.
original_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him. And he arose, and went down with him unto the king.

translated_text:
And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron,
is it not because
there is no God in Israel to enquire of his word? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.
original_text:

is it not because

translated_text: So he died according to the word of the LORD which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; because he had no son.
original_text: So he died according to the word of the LORD which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; because he had no son.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did,

original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did,

translated_text: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the LORD: and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.
original_text: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the LORD: and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.

translated_text: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.
original_text: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.

translated_text:
Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours,
even empty vessels; borrow not a few.
original_text:
Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours,
even empty vessels; borrow not a few.

translated_text: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.
original_text: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.

translated_text:
So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought
the vessels to her; and she poured out.
original_text:
So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought
the vessels to her; and she poured out.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her,
There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her,
There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.

translated_text: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.
original_text: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.

translated_text:
And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where
was
 a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was,
that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.
original_text:

was
 a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was,

translated_text:
And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this
is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.
original_text:
And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this
is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.

translated_text: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.
original_text: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.

translated_text: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.
original_text: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.

translated_text: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.
original_text: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.

translated_text:
And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what
is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among mine own people.
original_text:
And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what

translated_text:
And he said, What then
is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.
original_text:
And he said, What then
is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.

translated_text: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.
original_text: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.

translated_text:
And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord,
thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.
original_text:
And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord,
thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.

translated_text: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.
original_text: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.

translated_text: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
original_text: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.

translated_text: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.
original_text: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.

translated_text:
And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and

original_text:
And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and

translated_text:
And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut
the door upon him, and went out.
original_text:
And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut
the door upon him, and went out.

translated_text: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.
original_text: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.

translated_text:
And he said, Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day?
it is
 neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said,
It shall be
 well.
original_text:

it is
 neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said,
It shall be

translated_text:

original_text:

it from me, and hath not told me.
original_text:

translated_text: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.
original_text: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.

As the LORD liveth, and

original_text:

As the LORD liveth, and

original_text:
And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead,

translated_text: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto the LORD.
original_text: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto the LORD.

translated_text: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.
original_text: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.

translated_text: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
original_text: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

translated_text: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.
original_text: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.

translated_text: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.
original_text: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.

translated_text:

there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets

original_text:

translated_text: And there came a man from Baal-shalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.
original_text: And there came a man from Baal-shalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.

original_text:

translated_text: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.
original_text: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.

translated_text: And he wrought evil in the sight of the LORD; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.
original_text: And he wrought evil in the sight of the LORD; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.
