original_text: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.

translated_text: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.
original_text: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.

translated_text: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
original_text: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

translated_text:

translated_text: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
original_text: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.

translated_text:
He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I
will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
original_text:
He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I
will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.

translated_text: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.
original_text: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.

translated_text: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.
original_text: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.

translated_text: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.
original_text: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.

translated_text: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.
original_text: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.

translated_text:
Moreover
there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.
original_text:
Moreover
there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.

translated_text:
Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron,
there is
 no number. Arise
therefore, and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.
original_text:
Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron,
there is
 no number. Arise
therefore, and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.

translated_text:
David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son,
saying,
original_text:
David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son,
saying,

translated_text:
Is not the LORD your God with you? and hath he
not
 given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD, and before his people.
original_text:
Is not the LORD your God with you? and hath he
not
 given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD, and before his people.

translated_text: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD.
original_text: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD.

translated_text: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
original_text: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

translated_text: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
original_text: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

translated_text: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
original_text: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.

translated_text:
Of which, twenty and four thousand
were to set forward the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand
were officers and judges:
original_text:
Of which, twenty and four thousand
were to set forward the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand
were officers and judges:

translated_text:
Moreover four thousand
were porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made,
said David, to praise
therewith.
original_text:
Moreover four thousand
were porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made,
said David, to praise
therewith.

translated_text:
And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi,
namely,
 Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
original_text:
And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi,
namely,
 Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

translated_text:
Of the Gershonites
were, Laadan, and Shimei.
original_text:
Of the Gershonites
were, Laadan, and Shimei.

translated_text:
The sons of Laadan; the chief
was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
original_text:
The sons of Laadan; the chief
was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

translated_text:
The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These
were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.
original_text:
The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These
were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.

translated_text:
And the sons of Shimei
were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four
were the sons of Shimei.
original_text:
And the sons of Shimei
were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four
were the sons of Shimei.

translated_text:
And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to
their
 father’s house.
original_text:
And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to
their
 father’s house.

translated_text: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
original_text: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

translated_text: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.
original_text: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.

translated_text:
Now
concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
original_text:
Now
concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.

translated_text:
The sons of Moses
were, Gershom, and Eliezer.
original_text:
The sons of Moses
were, Gershom, and Eliezer.

translated_text:
Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel
was the chief.
original_text:
Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel
was the chief.

translated_text:
And the sons of Eliezer
were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
original_text:
And the sons of Eliezer
were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

translated_text: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.
original_text: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.

translated_text: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
original_text: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

translated_text: Of the sons of Uzziel; Micah the first, and Jesiah the second.
original_text: Of the sons of Uzziel; Micah the first, and Jesiah the second.

translated_text: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.
original_text: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.

translated_text: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
original_text: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.

translated_text: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
original_text: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

translated_text: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:
original_text: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:

translated_text:
And also unto the Levites; they shall no
more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.
original_text:
And also unto the Levites; they shall no
more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.

translated_text:
For by the last words of David the Levites
were numbered from twenty years old and above:
original_text:
For by the last words of David the Levites
were numbered from twenty years old and above:

translated_text:
Because their office
was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;
original_text:
Because their office
was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;

translated_text:
Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for
that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;
original_text:
Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for
that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;

translated_text: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;
original_text: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;

translated_text: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD:
original_text: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD:

translated_text:
And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy
place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD.
original_text:
And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy
place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out
to battle, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.
original_text:
And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out
to battle, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.

translated_text:
And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and
there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David’s head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.
original_text:
And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and
there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David’s head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.

translated_text:
And he brought out the people that
were in it, and cut
them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
original_text:
And he brought out the people that
were in it, and cut
them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai,
that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.
original_text:
And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai,
that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.

translated_text:
And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff
was
 like a weaver’s beam.
original_text:
And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff
was
 like a weaver’s beam.

translated_text:
And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of
great
 stature, whose fingers and toes
were four and twenty, six
on each hand, and six
on each foot: and he also was the son of the giant.
original_text:
And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of
great
 stature, whose fingers and toes
were four and twenty, six
on each hand, and six
on each foot: and he also was the son of the giant.

translated_text: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David’s brother slew him.
original_text: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David’s brother slew him.

translated_text: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
original_text: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

translated_text: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.
original_text: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.

translated_text:
And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beer-sheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know
it.
original_text:
And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beer-sheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know
it.

translated_text:
And Joab answered, The LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as they
be: but, my lord the king,
are they not all my lord’s servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?
original_text:
And Joab answered, The LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as they
be: but, my lord the king,
are they not all my lord’s servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?

translated_text: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
original_text: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all
they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah
was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.
original_text:
And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all
they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah
was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.

translated_text: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.
original_text: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

translated_text: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.
original_text: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.

translated_text: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
original_text: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

translated_text: And the LORD spake unto Gad, David’s seer, saying,
original_text: And the LORD spake unto Gad, David’s seer, saying,

translated_text:
Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three
things: choose thee one of them, that I may do
it unto thee.
original_text:
Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three
things: choose thee one of them, that I may do
it unto thee.

translated_text: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Choose thee
original_text: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Choose thee

translated_text:
Either three years’ famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh
thee; or else three days the sword of the LORD, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.
original_text:
Either three years’ famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh
thee; or else three days the sword of the LORD, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.

translated_text:
And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD; for very great
are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.
original_text:
And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD; for very great
are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.

translated_text: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
original_text: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.

translated_text: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the LORD beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
original_text: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the LORD beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

translated_text:
And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders
of Israel, who were
 clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
original_text:
And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders
of Israel, who were
 clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

translated_text:
And David said unto God,
Is it not I
that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but
as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O LORD my God, be on me, and on my father’s house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.
original_text:
And David said unto God,
Is it not I
that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but
as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O LORD my God, be on me, and on my father’s house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.

translated_text: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
original_text: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

translated_text: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the LORD.
original_text: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the LORD.

translated_text: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
original_text: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

translated_text:
And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with
his face to the ground.
original_text:
And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with
his face to the ground.

translated_text:
Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of
this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.
original_text:
Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of
this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.

translated_text:
And Ornan said unto David, Take
it to thee, and let my lord the king do
that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give
thee
 the oxen
also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.
original_text:
And Ornan said unto David, Take
it to thee, and let my lord the king do
that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give
thee
 the oxen
also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.

translated_text:
And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take
that which
is thine for the LORD, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.
original_text:
And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take
that which
is thine for the LORD, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

translated_text: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
original_text: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

translated_text: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the LORD; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.
original_text: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the LORD; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.

translated_text: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.
original_text: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.

translated_text: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
original_text: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

translated_text:
For the tabernacle of the LORD, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering,
were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.
original_text:
For the tabernacle of the LORD, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering,
were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.

translated_text: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD.
original_text: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD.

translated_text: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
original_text: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.

translated_text: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?
original_text: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?

translated_text: Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.
original_text: Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.

translated_text:
Then there went
certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and
then
 return.
original_text:
Then there went
certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and
then
 return.

translated_text: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria-maachah, and out of Zobah.
original_text: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria-maachah, and out of Zobah.

translated_text: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
original_text: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

translated_text:
And when David heard
of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
original_text:
And when David heard
of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

translated_text:
And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come
were by themselves in the field.
original_text:
And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come
were by themselves in the field.

translated_text:
Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put
them in array against the Syrians.
original_text:
Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put
them in array against the Syrians.

translated_text:
And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set
themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
original_text:
And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set
themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

translated_text: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
original_text: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.

translated_text:
Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the LORD do
that which is
 good in his sight.
original_text:
Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the LORD do
that which is
 good in his sight.

translated_text:
So Joab and the people that
were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.
original_text:
So Joab and the people that
were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.

translated_text: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
original_text: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that
were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer
went
 before them.
original_text:
And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that
were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer
went
 before them.

translated_text:
And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set
the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
original_text:
And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set
the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

translated_text:
But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand
men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.
original_text:
But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand
men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.

translated_text: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.
original_text: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.

translated_text:
Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD
remaineth under curtains.
original_text:
Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD
remaineth under curtains.

translated_text:
Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God
is with thee.
original_text:
Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God
is with thee.

translated_text: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
original_text: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

translated_text: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:
original_text: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:

translated_text:
For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from
one tabernacle
to another.
original_text:
For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from
one tabernacle
to another.

translated_text: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?
original_text: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?

translated_text:
Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote,
even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:
original_text:
Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote,
even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:

translated_text:
And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that
are in the earth.
original_text:
And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that
are in the earth.

translated_text: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,
original_text: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,

translated_text:
And since the time that I commanded judges
to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.
original_text:
And since the time that I commanded judges
to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go
to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go
to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

translated_text: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.
original_text: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.

translated_text:
I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took
it from
him that was before thee:
original_text:
I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took
it from
him that was before thee:

translated_text: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.
original_text: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.

translated_text: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
original_text: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

translated_text:
And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who
am I, O LORD God, and what
is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
original_text:
And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who
am I, O LORD God, and what
is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

translated_text:
And
yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast
also spoken of thy servant’s house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.
original_text:
And
yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast
also spoken of thy servant’s house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.

translated_text:
What can David
speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.
original_text:
What can David
speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.

translated_text: O LORD, for thy servant’s sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.
original_text: O LORD, for thy servant’s sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.

translated_text:
O LORD,
there is none like thee, neither
is there any
 God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
original_text:
O LORD,
there is none like thee, neither
is there any
 God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

translated_text:
And what one nation in the earth
is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem
to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?
original_text:
And what one nation in the earth
is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem
to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?

translated_text: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, LORD, becamest their God.
original_text: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, LORD, becamest their God.

translated_text: Therefore now, LORD, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.
original_text: Therefore now, LORD, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.

translated_text:
Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts
is the God of Israel,
even
 a God to Israel: and
let the house of David thy servant
be established before thee.
original_text:
Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts
is the God of Israel,
even
 a God to Israel: and
let the house of David thy servant
be established before thee.

translated_text:
For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found
in his heart to pray before thee.
original_text:
For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found
in his heart to pray before thee.

translated_text: And now, LORD, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
original_text: And now, LORD, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

translated_text:
Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD, and
it shall be blessed for ever.
original_text:
Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD, and
it shall be blessed for ever.

translated_text: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
original_text: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

translated_text:
And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David’s servants,
and
 brought gifts.
original_text:
And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David’s servants,
and
 brought gifts.

translated_text: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
original_text: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

translated_text:
And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot
horses,
 but reserved of them an hundred chariots.
original_text:
And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot
horses,
 but reserved of them an hundred chariots.

translated_text: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
original_text: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

translated_text:
Then David put
garrisons in Syria-damascus; and the Syrians became David’s servants,
and brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
original_text:
Then David put
garrisons in Syria-damascus; and the Syrians became David’s servants,
and brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

translated_text: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
original_text: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

translated_text: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
original_text: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.

translated_text: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
original_text: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;

translated_text:
He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and
with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
original_text:
He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and
with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.

translated_text:
Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all
these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
original_text:
Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all
these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

translated_text: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.
original_text: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.

translated_text: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David’s servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
original_text: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David’s servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

translated_text: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
original_text: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.

translated_text: And Joab the son Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.
original_text: And Joab the son Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.

translated_text:
And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar,
were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
original_text:
And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar,
were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;

translated_text:
And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada
was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David
were chief about the king.
original_text:
And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada
was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David
were chief about the king.

translated_text: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.
original_text: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.

translated_text:
Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people:
As for me, I
had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:
original_text:
Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people:
As for me, I
had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:

translated_text:
But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou
hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.
original_text:
But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou
hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.

translated_text:
Howbeit the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah
to be
 the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make
me king over all Israel:
original_text:
Howbeit the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah
to be
 the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make
me king over all Israel:

translated_text: And of all my sons, (for the LORD hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.
original_text: And of all my sons, (for the LORD hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.

translated_text:
And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him
to be my son, and I will be his father.
original_text:
And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him
to be my son, and I will be his father.

translated_text: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.
original_text: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.

translated_text:
Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave
it
 for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.
original_text:
Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave
it
 for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.

translated_text: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
original_text: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.

translated_text:
Take heed now; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do
it.
original_text:
Take heed now; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do
it.

translated_text: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,
original_text: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,

translated_text: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the LORD, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:
original_text: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the LORD, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:

translated_text: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD.
original_text: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight,
both for the candlestick, and
also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.
original_text:
Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight,
both for the candlestick, and
also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.

translated_text:
And by weight
he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and
likewise silver for the tables of silver:
original_text:
And by weight
he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and
likewise silver for the tables of silver:

translated_text:
Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons
he gave gold by weight for every bason; and
likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:
original_text:
Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons
he gave gold by weight for every bason; and
likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:

translated_text:
And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out
their wings,
 and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
original_text:
And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out
their wings,
 and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

translated_text:
All
this, said David, the LORD made me understand in writing by
his hand upon me,
even all the works of this pattern.
original_text:
All
this, said David, the LORD made me understand in writing by
his hand upon me,
even all the works of this pattern.

translated_text:
And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do
it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God,
even
 my God,
will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.
original_text:
And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do
it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God,
even
 my God,
will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites,
even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and
there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people
will be wholly at thy commandment.
original_text:
And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites,
even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and
there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people
will be wholly at thy commandment.

translated_text:
Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen,
is yet young and tender, and the work
is great: for the palace
is not for man, but for the LORD God.
original_text:
Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen,
is yet young and tender, and the work
is great: for the palace
is not for man, but for the LORD God.

translated_text:
Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for
things to be made of gold, and the silver for
things
 of silver, and the brass for
things of brass, the iron for
things of iron, and wood for
things of wood; onyx stones, and
stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
original_text:
Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for
things to be made of gold, and the silver for
things
 of silver, and the brass for
things of brass, the iron for
things of iron, and wood for
things of wood; onyx stones, and
stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

translated_text:
Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver,
which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
original_text:
Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver,
which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,

translated_text:
Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses
withal:
original_text:
Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses
withal:

translated_text:
The gold for
things of gold, and the silver for
things
 of silver, and for all manner of work
to be made by the hands of artificers. And who
then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the LORD?
original_text:
The gold for
things of gold, and the silver for
things
 of silver, and for all manner of work
to be made by the hands of artificers. And who
then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the LORD?

translated_text: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king’s work, offered willingly,
original_text: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king’s work, offered willingly,

translated_text: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
original_text: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

translated_text:
And they with whom
precious stones were found gave
them
 to the treasure of the house of the LORD, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
original_text:
And they with whom
precious stones were found gave
them
 to the treasure of the house of the LORD, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

translated_text: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
original_text: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

translated_text:
Wherefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed
be thou, LORD God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.
original_text:
Wherefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed
be thou, LORD God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.

translated_text:
Thine, O LORD,
is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all
that is in the heaven and in the earth
is thine; thine
is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.
original_text:
Thine, O LORD,
is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all
that is in the heaven and in the earth
is thine; thine
is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.

translated_text:
Both riches and honour
come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand
is power and might; and in thine hand
it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.
original_text:
Both riches and honour
come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand
is power and might; and in thine hand
it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.

translated_text: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
original_text: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.

translated_text:
But who
am I, and what
is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things
come
 of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.
original_text:
But who
am I, and what
is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things
come
 of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.

translated_text:
For we
are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as
were all our fathers: our days on the earth
are as a shadow, and
there is none abiding.
original_text:
For we
are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as
were all our fathers: our days on the earth
are as a shadow, and
there is none abiding.

translated_text:
O LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name
cometh of thine hand, and
is
 all thine own.
original_text:
O LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name
cometh of thine hand, and
is
 all thine own.

translated_text: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.
original_text: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.

translated_text: O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:
original_text: O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:

translated_text:
And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all
these things,
 and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.
original_text:
And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all
these things,
 and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.

translated_text: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD your God. And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the LORD, and the king.
original_text: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD your God. And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the LORD, and the king.

translated_text:
And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings unto the LORD, on the morrow after that day,
even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams,
and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:
original_text:
And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings unto the LORD, on the morrow after that day,
even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams,
and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:

translated_text:
And did eat and drink before the LORD on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed
him unto the LORD
to be the chief governor, and Zadok
to be priest.
original_text:
And did eat and drink before the LORD on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed
him unto the LORD
to be the chief governor, and Zadok
to be priest.

translated_text: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
original_text: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

translated_text: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.
original_text: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.

translated_text:
And the LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him
such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
original_text:
And the LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him
such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

translated_text: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
original_text: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

translated_text:
And the time that he reigned over Israel
was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three
years reigned he in Jerusalem.
original_text:
And the time that he reigned over Israel
was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three
years reigned he in Jerusalem.

translated_text: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they
are
 written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,
original_text:
Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they
are
 written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,

translated_text: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.
original_text: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.

translated_text:
And
David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
original_text:
And
David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.

translated_text: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.
original_text: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.

translated_text: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place, which he had prepared for it.
original_text: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place, which he had prepared for it.

translated_text: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:
original_text: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:

translated_text: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:
original_text: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:

translated_text: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:
original_text: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:

translated_text: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:
original_text: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:

translated_text: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:
original_text: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:

translated_text: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:
original_text: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:

translated_text: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.
original_text: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.

translated_text: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
original_text: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,

translated_text:
And said unto them, Ye
are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves,
both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto
the place that
 I have prepared for it.
original_text:
And said unto them, Ye
are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves,
both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto
the place that
 I have prepared for it.

translated_text:
For because ye
did it not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
original_text:
For because ye
did it not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.

translated_text: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.
original_text: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.

translated_text: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.
original_text: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.

translated_text:
And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren
to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.
original_text:
And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren
to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.

translated_text: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
original_text: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

translated_text:
And with them their brethren of the second
degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the porters.
original_text:
And with them their brethren of the second
degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the porters.

translated_text:
So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan,
were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;
original_text:
So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan,
were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;

translated_text: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;
original_text: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;

translated_text: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.
original_text: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.

translated_text:
And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites,
was for song: he instructed about the song, because he
was skilful.
original_text:
And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites,
was for song: he instructed about the song, because he
was skilful.

translated_text:
And Berechiah and Elkanah
were doorkeepers for the ark.
original_text:
And Berechiah and Elkanah
were doorkeepers for the ark.

translated_text:
And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed-edom and Jehiah
were doorkeepers for the ark.
original_text:
And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed-edom and Jehiah
were doorkeepers for the ark.

translated_text: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.
original_text: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.
original_text: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.

translated_text:
And David
was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also
had upon him an ephod of linen.
original_text:
And David
was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also
had upon him an ephod of linen.

translated_text: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.
original_text: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.

translated_text:
And it came to pass,
as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.
original_text:
And it came to pass,
as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.

translated_text: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.
original_text: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.

translated_text: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.
original_text: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.

translated_text:
And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon
of wine.
original_text:
And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon
of wine.

translated_text:
And he appointed
certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:
original_text:
And he appointed
certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:

translated_text: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;
original_text: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;

translated_text: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
original_text: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.

translated_text:
Then on that day David delivered first
this psalm to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
original_text:
Then on that day David delivered first
this psalm to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.

translated_text: Give thanks unto the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
original_text: Give thanks unto the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.

translated_text: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
original_text: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
