translated_text: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
original_text: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.

translated_text: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.
original_text: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.

translated_text: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
original_text: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

translated_text: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
original_text: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

translated_text:
He
is the LORD our God; his judgments
are in all the earth.
original_text:
He
is the LORD our God; his judgments
are in all the earth.

translated_text:
Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word
which he commanded to a thousand generations;
original_text:
Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word
which he commanded to a thousand generations;

translated_text: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;
original_text: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;

translated_text: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;
original_text: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;

translated_text: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.
original_text: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.

translated_text:
And
when they went from nation to nation, and from
one
 kingdom to another people;
original_text:
And
when they went from nation to nation, and from
one
 kingdom to another people;

translated_text: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
original_text: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

translated_text: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
original_text: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

translated_text: Sing unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
original_text: Sing unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.

translated_text: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.
original_text: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.

translated_text:
For great
is the LORD, and greatly to be praised: he also
is to be feared above all gods.
original_text:
For great
is the LORD, and greatly to be praised: he also
is to be feared above all gods.

translated_text:
For all the gods of the people
are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
original_text:
For all the gods of the people
are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.

translated_text:
Glory and honour
are in his presence; strength and gladness
are in his place.
original_text:
Glory and honour
are in his presence; strength and gladness
are in his place.

translated_text: Give unto the LORD, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
original_text: Give unto the LORD, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

translated_text:
Give unto the LORD the glory
due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
original_text:
Give unto the LORD the glory
due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

translated_text: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.
original_text: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.

translated_text:
Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let
men
 say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.
original_text:
Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let
men
 say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.

translated_text:
Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that
is therein.
original_text:
Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that
is therein.

translated_text: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the LORD, because he cometh to judge the earth.
original_text: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the LORD, because he cometh to judge the earth.

translated_text:
O give thanks unto the LORD; for
he is good; for his mercy
endureth for ever.
original_text:
O give thanks unto the LORD; for
he is good; for his mercy
endureth for ever.

translated_text:
And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name,
and glory in thy praise.
original_text:
And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name,
and glory in thy praise.

translated_text:
Blessed
be the LORD God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD.
original_text:
Blessed
be the LORD God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD.

translated_text: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required:
original_text: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required:

translated_text:
And Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed-edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah
to be porters:
original_text:
And Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed-edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah
to be porters:

translated_text:
And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that
was at Gibeon,
original_text:
And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that
was at Gibeon,

translated_text:
To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and
to do according to all that is written in the law of the LORD, which he commanded Israel;
original_text:
To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and
to do according to all that is written in the law of the LORD, which he commanded Israel;

translated_text:
And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his mercy
endureth for ever;
original_text:
And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his mercy
endureth for ever;

translated_text:
And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun
were porters.
original_text:
And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun
were porters.

translated_text: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
original_text: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.

translated_text:
And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds,
and with every leader.
original_text:
And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds,
and with every leader.

translated_text:
And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If
it seem
 good unto you, and
that it be of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where,
that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them
also to the priests and Levites
which are in their cities
and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:
original_text:
And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If
it seem
 good unto you, and
that it be of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where,
that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them
also to the priests and Levites
which are in their cities
and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:

translated_text: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.
original_text: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.

translated_text: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
original_text: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

translated_text: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.
original_text: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.

translated_text:
And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah,
that is, to Kirjath-jearim, which
belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD, that dwelleth
between the cherubims, whose name is called
on it.
original_text:
And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah,
that is, to Kirjath-jearim, which
belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD, that dwelleth
between the cherubims, whose name is called
on it.

translated_text: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.
original_text: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.

translated_text:
And David and all Israel played before God with all
their
 might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
original_text:
And David and all Israel played before God with all
their
 might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

translated_text: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
original_text: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.

translated_text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.
original_text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.

translated_text: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.
original_text: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.

translated_text:
And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God
home to me?
original_text:
And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God
home to me?

translated_text:
So David brought not the ark
home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
original_text:
So David brought not the ark
home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

translated_text: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that he had.
original_text: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that he had.

translated_text: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.
original_text: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.

translated_text: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.
original_text: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.

translated_text: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.
original_text: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.

translated_text:
Now these
are the names of
his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
original_text:
Now these
are the names of
his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

translated_text: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
original_text: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,

translated_text: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
original_text: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

translated_text: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.
original_text: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.

translated_text:
And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard
of it, and went out against them.
original_text:
And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard
of it, and went out against them.

translated_text: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
original_text: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

translated_text: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.
original_text: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.

translated_text: So they came up to Baal-perazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
original_text: So they came up to Baal-perazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.

translated_text: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
original_text: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.

translated_text: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.
original_text: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.

translated_text: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
original_text: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

translated_text:
And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees,
that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.
original_text:
And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees,
that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.

translated_text: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.
original_text: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.

translated_text: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.
original_text: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.

translated_text:
Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we
are thy bone and thy flesh.
original_text:
Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we
are thy bone and thy flesh.

translated_text:
And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou
wast
 he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.
original_text:
And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou
wast
 he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.

translated_text: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.
original_text: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.

translated_text:
And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which
is Jebus; where the Jebusites
were, the inhabitants of the land.
original_text:
And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which
is Jebus; where the Jebusites
were, the inhabitants of the land.

translated_text:
And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which
is the city of David.
original_text:
And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which
is the city of David.

translated_text: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
original_text: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.

translated_text: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.
original_text: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.

translated_text: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
original_text: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

translated_text:
So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts
was
 with him.
original_text:
So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts
was
 with him.

translated_text:
These also
are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom,
and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
original_text:
These also
are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom,
and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.

translated_text:
And this
is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain
by him at one time.
original_text:
And this
is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain
by him at one time.

translated_text:
And after him
was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who
was one of the three mighties.
original_text:
And after him
was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who
was one of the three mighties.

translated_text: He was with David at Pas-dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
original_text: He was with David at Pas-dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

translated_text:
And they set themselves in the midst of
that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved
them
 by a great deliverance.
original_text:
And they set themselves in the midst of
that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved
them
 by a great deliverance.

translated_text: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
original_text: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

translated_text:
And David
was then in the hold, and the Philistines’ garrison
was then at Bethlehem.
original_text:
And David
was then in the hold, and the Philistines’ garrison
was then at Bethlehem.

translated_text:
And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that
is at the gate!
original_text:
And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that
is at the gate!

translated_text:
And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that
was by the gate, and took
it, and brought
it to David: but David would not drink
of it, but poured it out to the LORD,
original_text:
And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that
was by the gate, and took
it, and brought
it to David: but David would not drink
of it, but poured it out to the LORD,

translated_text:
And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with
the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.
original_text:
And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with
the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.

translated_text:
And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew
them, and had a name among the three.
original_text:
And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew
them, and had a name among the three.

translated_text:
Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the
first three.
original_text:
Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the
first three.

translated_text: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.
original_text: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.

translated_text:
And he slew an Egyptian, a man of
great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian’s hand
was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.
original_text:
And he slew an Egyptian, a man of
great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian’s hand
was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.

translated_text:
These
things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.
original_text:
These
things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.

translated_text:
Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the
first three: and David set him over his guard.
original_text:
Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the
first three: and David set him over his guard.

translated_text:
Also the valiant men of the armies
were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
original_text:
Also the valiant men of the armies
were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

translated_text: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
original_text: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

translated_text: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi-ezer the Antothite,
original_text: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi-ezer the Antothite,

translated_text: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
original_text: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

translated_text: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
original_text: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

translated_text:
Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah,
that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
original_text:
Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah,
that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

translated_text: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
original_text: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

translated_text: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
original_text: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

translated_text: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,
original_text: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,

translated_text: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
original_text: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

translated_text: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
original_text: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

translated_text: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
original_text: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

translated_text: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,
original_text: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,

translated_text: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
original_text: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

translated_text: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
original_text: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

translated_text: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
original_text: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

translated_text: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
original_text: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

translated_text: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
original_text: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

translated_text: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,
original_text: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,

translated_text: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
original_text: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

translated_text: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
original_text: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

translated_text: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.
original_text: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.

translated_text:
Now these
are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they
were
 among the mighty men, helpers of the war.
original_text:
Now these
are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they
were
 among the mighty men, helpers of the war.

translated_text:
They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in
hurling stones and
shooting arrows out of a bow,
even of Saul’s brethren of Benjamin.
original_text:
They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in
hurling stones and
shooting arrows out of a bow,
even of Saul’s brethren of Benjamin.

translated_text:
The chief
was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,
original_text:
The chief
was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,

translated_text: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,
original_text: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,

translated_text: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
original_text: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,

translated_text: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,
original_text: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,

translated_text: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
original_text: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

translated_text:
And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might,
and men of war
fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces
were like
 the faces of lions, and
were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;
original_text:
And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might,
and men of war
fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces
were like
 the faces of lions, and
were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;

translated_text: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
original_text: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

translated_text: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
original_text: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

translated_text: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
original_text: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

translated_text: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
original_text: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

translated_text: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.
original_text: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.

translated_text:
These
were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least
was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
original_text:
These
were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least
was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

translated_text:
These
are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all
them
 of the valleys,
both toward the east, and toward the west.
original_text:
These
are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all
them
 of the valleys,
both toward the east, and toward the west.

translated_text: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.
original_text: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.

translated_text:
And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if
ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing
there is
 no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look
thereon,
 and rebuke
it.
original_text:
And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if
ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing
there is
 no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look
thereon,
 and rebuke

translated_text:
Then the spirit came upon Amasai,
who was chief of the captains,
and he said, Thine
are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace
be unto thee, and peace
be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
original_text:
Then the spirit came upon Amasai,

and he said, Thine
are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace

translated_text:
And there fell
some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to
the jeopardy of our heads.
original_text:

translated_text:

were of Manasseh.
original_text:

translated_text:
And they helped David against the band
of the rovers: for they
were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.
original_text:
And they helped David against the band
of the rovers: for they
were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.

translated_text:
For at
that time day by day there came to David to help him, until
it was a great host, like the host of God.
original_text:
For at
that time day by day there came to David to help him, until
it was a great host, like the host of God.

translated_text:
And these
are the numbers of the bands
that were
 ready armed to the war,
and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD.
original_text:
And these
are the numbers of the bands
that were
 ready armed to the war,
and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD.

translated_text:
The children of Judah that bare shield and spear
were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.
original_text:
The children of Judah that bare shield and spear
were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.

translated_text: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
original_text: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.

translated_text: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
original_text: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.

translated_text: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father’s house twenty and two captains.
original_text: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father’s house twenty and two captains.

translated_text: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.
original_text: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.

translated_text: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.
original_text: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.

translated_text: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.
original_text: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.

translated_text:
And of the children of Issachar,
which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them
were two hundred; and all their brethren
were at their commandment.
original_text:
And of the children of Issachar,
which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them
were two hundred; and all their brethren
were at their commandment.

 not of double heart.
original_text:
Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank:
they were
 not of double heart.

translated_text: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
original_text: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.

translated_text: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
original_text: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.

translated_text: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
original_text: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.

translated_text: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.
original_text: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.

translated_text:
All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel
were of one heart to make David king.
original_text:
All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel
were of one heart to make David king.

translated_text: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.
original_text: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.

translated_text:
Moreover they that were nigh them,
even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen,
and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for
there was joy in Israel.
original_text:
Moreover they that were nigh them,
even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen,
and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for
there was joy in Israel.

translated_text: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
original_text: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

translated_text: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
original_text: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.

translated_text: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.
original_text: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.

translated_text: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
original_text: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

translated_text: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
original_text: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.

translated_text: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
original_text: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.

translated_text:
And when all the men of Israel that
were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
original_text:
And when all the men of Israel that
were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

translated_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
original_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

translated_text: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
original_text: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.

translated_text: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
original_text: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.

translated_text: And when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
original_text: And when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

translated_text: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
original_text: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

translated_text:
So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD,
even against the word of the LORD, which he kept not, and also for asking
counsel of
one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire
of it;
original_text:
So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD,
even against the word of the LORD, which he kept not, and also for asking
counsel of
one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire
of it;

translated_text: And enquired not of the LORD: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.
original_text: And enquired not of the LORD: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.

translated_text:
Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the LORD was finished: and Solomon brought in
all the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of God.
original_text:
Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the LORD was finished: and Solomon brought in
all the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of God.

translated_text:
Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which
is Zion.
original_text:
Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which
is Zion.

translated_text:
Wherefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which
was in the seventh month.
original_text:
Wherefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which
was in the seventh month.

translated_text: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.
original_text: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.

translated_text:
And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that
were in the tabernacle, these did the priests and the Levites bring up.
original_text:
And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that
were in the tabernacle, these did the priests and the Levites bring up.

translated_text: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
original_text: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

translated_text:
And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy
place, even
 under the wings of the cherubims:
original_text:
And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy
place, even
 under the wings of the cherubims:

translated_text:
For the cherubims spread forth
their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
original_text:
For the cherubims spread forth
their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

translated_text:
And they drew out the staves
of the ark, that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.
original_text:
And they drew out the staves
of the ark, that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.

translated_text:
There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put
therein at Horeb, when the LORD made
a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.
original_text:
There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put
therein at Horeb, when the LORD made
a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy
place: (for all the priests
that were present were sanctified,
and did not
then wait by course:
original_text:
And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy
place: (for all the priests
that were present were sanctified,
and did not
then wait by course:

translated_text:
Also the Levites
which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren,
being
 arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)
original_text:
Also the Levites
which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren,
being
 arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)

translated_text:
It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers
were
 as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up
their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the LORD,
saying, For
he is good; for his mercy
endureth for ever: that
then the house was filled with a cloud,
even the house of the LORD;
original_text:
It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers
were
 as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up
their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the LORD,
saying, For
he is good; for his mercy
endureth for ever: that
then the house was filled with a cloud,
even the house of the LORD;

translated_text: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of God.
original_text: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of God.

translated_text: Then said Solomon, The LORD hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
original_text: Then said Solomon, The LORD hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

translated_text: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.
original_text: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.

translated_text: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.
original_text: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.

translated_text:
And he said, Blessed
be the LORD God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled
that which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,
original_text:
And he said, Blessed
be the LORD God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled
that which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,

translated_text: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:
original_text: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:

translated_text: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.
original_text: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.

translated_text: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
original_text: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

translated_text: But the LORD said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:
original_text: But the LORD said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:

translated_text: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.
original_text: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.

translated_text: The LORD therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
original_text: The LORD therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

translated_text:
And in it have I put the ark, wherein
is the covenant of the LORD, that he made with the children of Israel.
original_text:
And in it have I put the ark, wherein
is the covenant of the LORD, that he made with the children of Israel.

translated_text: And he stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:
original_text: And he stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:

translated_text: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,
original_text: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,

translated_text:
And said, O LORD God of Israel,
there is no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and
shewest
 mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:
original_text:
And said, O LORD God of Israel,
there is no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and
shewest
 mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:

translated_text:
Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled
it
 with thine hand, as
it is this day.
original_text:
Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled
it
 with thine hand, as
it is this day.

translated_text: Now therefore, O LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.
original_text: Now therefore, O LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.

translated_text: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.
original_text: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.

translated_text: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!
original_text: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!

translated_text: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:
original_text: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:

translated_text: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.
original_text: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.

translated_text:
Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place,
even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.
original_text:
Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place,
even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.

translated_text: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;
original_text: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;

translated_text: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.
original_text: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.

translated_text: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;
original_text: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;

translated_text: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.
original_text: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.

translated_text:
When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee;
yet if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;
original_text:
When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee;
yet if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;

translated_text: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.
original_text: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.

translated_text:
If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness
there be:
original_text:
If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness
there be:

translated_text:
Then what prayer
or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:
original_text:
Then what prayer
or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:

translated_text: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)
original_text: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)

translated_text: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
original_text: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.

translated_text: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name’s sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;
original_text: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name’s sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;

translated_text:
Then hear thou from the heavens,
even from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as
doth thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.
original_text:
Then hear thou from the heavens,
even from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as
doth thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.

translated_text: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;
original_text: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;

translated_text: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
original_text: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

translated_text:
If they sin against thee, (for
there is no man which sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before
their
 enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;
original_text:
If they sin against thee, (for
there is no man which sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before
their
 enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;

translated_text:
Yet
if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;
original_text:
Yet
if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;

translated_text:
If they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, and
toward
 the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:
original_text:
If they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, and
toward
 the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:

translated_text:
Then hear thou from the heavens,
even from thy dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people which have sinned against thee.
original_text:
Then hear thou from the heavens,
even from thy dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people which have sinned against thee.

translated_text:
Now, my God, let, I beseech thee, thine eyes be open, and
let
 thine ears
be attent unto the prayer
that is made
 in this place.
original_text:
Now, my God, let, I beseech thee, thine eyes be open, and
let
 thine ears
be attent unto the prayer
that is made
 in this place.

translated_text: Now therefore arise, O LORD God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.
original_text: Now therefore arise, O LORD God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.

translated_text: O LORD God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.
original_text: O LORD God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.

translated_text: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the house.
original_text: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the house.

translated_text: And the priests could not enter into the house of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD’S house.
original_text: And the priests could not enter into the house of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD’S house.

translated_text:
And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the LORD upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the LORD,
saying, For
he is good; for his mercy
endureth
 for ever.
original_text:
And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the LORD upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the LORD,
saying, For
he is good; for his mercy
endureth
 for ever.

translated_text: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.
original_text: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.

translated_text: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
original_text: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.

translated_text:
And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of the LORD, which David the king had made to praise the LORD, because his mercy
endureth for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.
original_text:
And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of the LORD, which David the king had made to praise the LORD, because his mercy
endureth for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.

translated_text:
Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that
was
 before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.
original_text:
Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that
was
 before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.

translated_text: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt.
original_text: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt.

translated_text: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.
original_text: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

translated_text: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the LORD had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.
original_text: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the LORD had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

translated_text: Thus Solomon finished the house of the LORD, and the king’s house: and all that came into Solomon’s heart to make in the house of the LORD, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.
original_text: Thus Solomon finished the house of the LORD, and the king’s house: and all that came into Solomon’s heart to make in the house of the LORD, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.

translated_text: And the LORD appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto him, I have heard thy prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.
original_text: And the LORD appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto him, I have heard thy prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.

translated_text: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;
original_text: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;

translated_text: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
original_text: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

translated_text:
Now mine eyes shall be open, and mine ears attent unto the prayer
that is made in this place.
original_text:
Now mine eyes shall be open, and mine ears attent unto the prayer
that is made in this place.

translated_text: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.
original_text: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

translated_text: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments;
original_text: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments;

translated_text:
Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man
to be ruler in Israel.
original_text:
Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man
to be ruler in Israel.

translated_text: But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;
original_text: But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;

translated_text:
Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it
to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.
original_text:
Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it
to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.

translated_text: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and unto this house?
original_text: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and unto this house?

translated_text: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.
original_text: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.

translated_text: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the LORD, and his own house,
original_text: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the LORD, and his own house,

translated_text: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
original_text: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

translated_text: And Solomon went to Hamath-zobah, and prevailed against it.
original_text: And Solomon went to Hamath-zobah, and prevailed against it.

translated_text: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.
original_text: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.

translated_text: Also he built Beth-horon the upper, and Beth-horon the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
original_text: Also he built Beth-horon the upper, and Beth-horon the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;

translated_text: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.
original_text: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.

translated_text:
As for all the people
that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which
were not of Israel,
original_text:
As for all the people
that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which
were not of Israel,

translated_text: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.
original_text: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.

translated_text:
But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they
were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.
original_text:
But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they
were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.

translated_text:
And these
were the chief of king Solomon’s officers,
even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.
original_text:
And these
were the chief of king Solomon’s officers,
even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.

translated_text:
And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because
the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the LORD hath come.
original_text:
And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because
the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the LORD hath come.

translated_text: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the LORD on the altar of the LORD, which he had built before the porch,
original_text: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the LORD on the altar of the LORD, which he had built before the porch,

translated_text:
Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year,
even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
original_text:
Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year,
even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.

translated_text: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.
original_text: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.

translated_text: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
original_text: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.

translated_text: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the LORD, and until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was perfected.
