original_text: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the LORD, and until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was perfected.

translated_text: Then went Solomon to Ezion-geber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.
original_text: Then went Solomon to Ezion-geber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.

translated_text:
And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought
them to king Solomon.
original_text:
And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought
them to king Solomon.

translated_text:
And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the LORD his God
was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.
original_text:
And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the LORD his God
was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.

translated_text: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.
original_text: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.

translated_text:
So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that
was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.
original_text:
So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that
was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.

translated_text:
But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjath-jearim to
the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.
original_text:
But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjath-jearim to
the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

translated_text: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the LORD: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.
original_text: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the LORD: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.

translated_text:
And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the LORD, which
was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.
original_text:
And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the LORD, which
was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.

translated_text: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.
original_text: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.

translated_text: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.
original_text: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.

translated_text: Now, O LORD God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
original_text: Now, O LORD God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

translated_text:
Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people,
that is so great?
original_text:
Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people,
that is so great?

translated_text: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:
original_text: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:

translated_text:
Wisdom and knowledge
is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that
have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.
original_text:
Wisdom and knowledge
is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that
have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.

translated_text:
Then Solomon came
from his journey to the high place that
was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.
original_text:
Then Solomon came
from his journey to the high place that
was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.

translated_text: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
original_text: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem
as plenteous
 as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that
are in the vale for abundance.
original_text:
And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem
as plenteous
 as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that
are in the vale for abundance.

translated_text: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
original_text: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

translated_text:
And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred
shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out
horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.
original_text:
And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred
shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out
horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.

translated_text: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.
original_text: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.

translated_text: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
original_text: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.

translated_text:
And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein,
even so deal with me.
original_text:
And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein,
even so deal with me.

translated_text:
Behold, I build an house to the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate
it to him,
and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD our God. This
is an ordinance for ever to Israel.
original_text:
Behold, I build an house to the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate
it to him,
and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD our God. This
is an ordinance for ever to Israel.

translated_text:
And the house which I build
is great: for great
is
 our God above all gods.
original_text:
And the house which I build
is great: for great
is
 our God above all gods.

translated_text:
But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who
am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?
original_text:
But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who
am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?

translated_text:
Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that
are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.
original_text:
Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that
are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.

translated_text:
Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants
shall be with thy servants,
original_text:
Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants
shall be with thy servants,

translated_text:
Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build
shall be wonderful great.
original_text:
Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build
shall be wonderful great.

translated_text: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.
original_text: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.

translated_text: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the LORD hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.
original_text: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the LORD hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.

translated_text:
Huram said moreover, Blessed
be the LORD God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.
original_text:
Huram said moreover, Blessed
be the LORD God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.

translated_text: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father’s,
original_text: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father’s,

translated_text:
The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father
was
 a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.
original_text:
The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father
was
 a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.

translated_text: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:
original_text: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:

translated_text: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in flotes by sea to Joppa; and thou shall carry it up to Jerusalem.
original_text: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in flotes by sea to Joppa; and thou shall carry it up to Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And Solomon numbered all the strangers that
were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.
original_text:
And Solomon numbered all the strangers that
were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.

translated_text:
And he set threescore and ten thousand of them
to be bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand
to be hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.
original_text:
And he set threescore and ten thousand of them
to be bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand
to be hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.

translated_text:
Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where
the LORD appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
original_text:
Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where
the LORD appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

translated_text:
And he began to build in the second
day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
original_text:
And he began to build in the second
day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

translated_text:
Now these
are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure
was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
original_text:
Now these
are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure
was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.

translated_text:
And the porch that
was in the front
of the house,
 the length
of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height
was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
original_text:
And the porch that
was in the front
of the house,
 the length
of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height
was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

translated_text: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.
original_text: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.

translated_text:
And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold
was gold of Parvaim.
original_text:
And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold
was gold of Parvaim.

translated_text: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.
original_text: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.

translated_text:
And he made the most holy house, the length whereof
was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold,
amounting to six hundred talents.
original_text:
And he made the most holy house, the length whereof
was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold,
amounting to six hundred talents.

translated_text:
And the weight of the nails
was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
original_text:
And the weight of the nails
was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.

translated_text: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.
original_text: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.

translated_text:
And the wings of the cherubims
were twenty cubits long: one wing
of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing
was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
original_text:
And the wings of the cherubims
were twenty cubits long: one wing
of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing
was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

translated_text:
And
one wing of the other cherub
was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing
was five cubits
also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
original_text:
And
one wing of the other cherub
was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing
was five cubits
also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

translated_text:
The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces
were inward.
original_text:
The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces
were inward.

translated_text:
And he made the vail
of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.
original_text:
And he made the vail
of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.

translated_text:
Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that
was on the top of each of them
was five cubits.
original_text:
Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that
was on the top of each of them
was five cubits.

translated_text:
And he made chains,
as in the oracle, and put
them
 on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put
them on the chains.
original_text:
And he made chains,
as in the oracle, and put
them
 on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put
them on the chains.

translated_text: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
original_text: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.

translated_text: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.
original_text: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.

translated_text: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
original_text: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

translated_text:
And under it
was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen
were cast, when it was cast.
original_text:
And under it
was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen
were cast, when it was cast.

translated_text:
It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea
was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts
were inward.
original_text:
It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea
was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts
were inward.

translated_text:
And the thickness of it
was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies;
and
 it received and held three thousand baths.
original_text:
And the thickness of it
was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies;
and
 it received and held three thousand baths.

translated_text:
He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea
was for the priests to wash in.
original_text:
He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea
was for the priests to wash in.

translated_text:
And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set
them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
original_text:
And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set
them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.

translated_text:
He made also ten tables, and placed
them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.
original_text:
He made also ten tables, and placed
them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.

translated_text: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
original_text: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.

translated_text: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.
original_text: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.

translated_text: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;
original_text: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;

translated_text:
And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which
were upon the pillars.
original_text:
And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which
were upon the pillars.

translated_text: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;
original_text: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;

translated_text: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
original_text: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.

translated_text: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass.
original_text: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass.

translated_text: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.
original_text: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.

translated_text: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
original_text: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.

translated_text: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;
original_text: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;

translated_text:
And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs,
made he of
 gold,
and that perfect gold;
original_text:
And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs,
made he of
 gold,
and that perfect gold;

translated_text:
And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers,
of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy
place, and the doors of the house of the temple,
were of gold.
original_text:
And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers,
of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy
place, and the doors of the house of the temple,
were of gold.

translated_text: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
original_text: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

translated_text: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.
original_text: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.

translated_text: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,
original_text: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,

translated_text: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.
original_text: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.

translated_text:
And she said to the king,
It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:
original_text:
And she said to the king,
It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:

translated_text:
Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen
it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me:
for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.
original_text:
Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen
it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me:
for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.

translated_text:
Happy
are thy men, and happy
are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.
original_text:
Happy
are thy men, and happy
are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.

translated_text:
Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne,
to be king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.
original_text:
Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne,
to be king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.

translated_text: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.
original_text: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.

translated_text: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.
original_text: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.

translated_text:
And the king made
of the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD, and to the king’s palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.
original_text:
And the king made
of the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD, and to the king’s palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.

translated_text:
And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside
that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.
original_text:
And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside
that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.

translated_text: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;
original_text: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;

translated_text:
Beside
that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
original_text:
Beside
that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

translated_text:
And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred
shekels of beaten gold went to one target.
original_text:
And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred
shekels of beaten gold went to one target.

translated_text:
And three hundred shields
made he of beaten gold: three hundred
shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
original_text:
And three hundred shields
made he of beaten gold: three hundred
shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

translated_text: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
original_text: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

translated_text:
And
there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold,
which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:
original_text:
And
there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold,
which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:

translated_text: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.
original_text: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.

translated_text:
And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon
were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon
were of pure gold: none
were of silver; it was
not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
original_text:
And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon
were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon
were of pure gold: none
were of silver; it was
not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

translated_text: For the king’s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
original_text: For the king’s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

translated_text: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
original_text: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

translated_text: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.
original_text: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.

translated_text: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
original_text: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

translated_text: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
original_text: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

translated_text: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
original_text: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

translated_text:
And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that
are in the low plains in abundance.
original_text:
And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that
are in the low plains in abundance.

translated_text: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.
original_text: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last,
are
 they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last,
are
 they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

translated_text: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
original_text: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

translated_text: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel.
original_text: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel.

translated_text: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.
original_text: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.

translated_text: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.
original_text: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.

translated_text: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.
original_text: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.

translated_text:
So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beer-sheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel at Jerusalem: for they had not done
it of a long
time in such sort as it was written.
original_text:
So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beer-sheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel at Jerusalem: for they had not done
it of a long
time in such sort as it was written.

translated_text: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, Ye children of Israel, turn again unto the LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and he will return to the remnant of you, that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.
original_text: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, Ye children of Israel, turn again unto the LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and he will return to the remnant of you, that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.

translated_text:
And be not ye like your fathers, and like your brethren, which trespassed against the LORD God of their fathers,
who therefore gave them up to desolation, as ye see.
original_text:
And be not ye like your fathers, and like your brethren, which trespassed against the LORD God of their fathers,
who therefore gave them up to desolation, as ye see.

translated_text:
Now be ye not stiffnecked, as your fathers
were, but yield yourselves unto the LORD, and enter into his sanctuary, which he hath sanctified for ever: and serve the LORD your God, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.
original_text:
Now be ye not stiffnecked, as your fathers
were, but yield yourselves unto the LORD, and enter into his sanctuary, which he hath sanctified for ever: and serve the LORD your God, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.

translated_text:
For if ye turn again unto the LORD, your brethren and your children
shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the LORD your God
is
 gracious and merciful, and will not turn away
his face from you, if ye return unto him.
original_text:
For if ye turn again unto the LORD, your brethren and your children
shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the LORD your God
is
 gracious and merciful, and will not turn away
his face from you, if ye return unto him.

translated_text: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.
original_text: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.

translated_text: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.
original_text: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.

translated_text: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of the LORD.
original_text: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of the LORD.

translated_text: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.
original_text: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.

translated_text:
And they arose and took away the altars that
were in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast
them
 into the brook Kidron.
original_text:
And they arose and took away the altars that
were in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast
them
 into the brook Kidron.

translated_text:
Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth
day of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of the LORD.
original_text:
Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth
day of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
And they stood in their place after their manner, according to the law of Moses the man of God: the priests sprinkled the blood,
which they received of the hand of the Levites.
original_text:
And they stood in their place after their manner, according to the law of Moses the man of God: the priests sprinkled the blood,
which they received of the hand of the Levites.

translated_text:
For
there were many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one
that was not clean, to sanctify
them
 unto the LORD.
original_text:
For
there were many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one
that was not clean, to sanctify
them
 unto the LORD.

translated_text:
For a multitude of the people,
even many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good LORD pardon every one
original_text:
For a multitude of the people,
even many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good LORD pardon every one

translated_text:
That prepareth his heart to seek God, the LORD God of his fathers, though
he be not
cleansed according to the purification of the sanctuary.
original_text:
That prepareth his heart to seek God, the LORD God of his fathers, though
he be not
cleansed according to the purification of the sanctuary.

translated_text: And the LORD hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.
original_text: And the LORD hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

translated_text:
And the children of Israel that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised the LORD day by day,
singing with loud instruments unto the LORD.
original_text:
And the children of Israel that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised the LORD day by day,
singing with loud instruments unto the LORD.

translated_text: And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto all the Levites that taught the good knowledge of the LORD: and they did eat throughout the feast seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to the LORD God of their fathers.
original_text: And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto all the Levites that taught the good knowledge of the LORD: and they did eat throughout the feast seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to the LORD God of their fathers.

translated_text:
And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept
other seven days with gladness.
original_text:
And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept
other seven days with gladness.

translated_text: For Hezekiah king of Judah did give to the congregation a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.
original_text: For Hezekiah king of Judah did give to the congregation a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.

translated_text: And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and that dwelt in Judah, rejoiced.
original_text: And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and that dwelt in Judah, rejoiced.

translated_text:
So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel
there was not the like in Jerusalem.
original_text:
So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel
there was not the like in Jerusalem.

translated_text:
Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came
up to his holy dwelling place,
even unto heaven.
original_text:
Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came
up to his holy dwelling place,
even unto heaven.

translated_text: Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.
original_text: Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

translated_text: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the LORD.
original_text: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the LORD.

translated_text:
He appointed also the king’s portion of his substance for the burnt offerings,
to wit, for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as
it is written in the law of the LORD.
original_text:
He appointed also the king’s portion of his substance for the burnt offerings,
to wit, for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as
it is written in the law of the LORD.

translated_text: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the LORD.
original_text: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the LORD.

translated_text:
And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all
things brought they in abundantly.
original_text:
And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all
things brought they in abundantly.

translated_text:
And
concerning the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the LORD their God, and laid
them by heaps.
original_text:
And
concerning the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the LORD their God, and laid
them by heaps.

translated_text:
In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished
them in the seventh month.
original_text:
In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished
them in the seventh month.

translated_text: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD, and his people Israel.
original_text: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD, and his people Israel.

translated_text: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.
original_text: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.

translated_text:
And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since
the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the LORD hath blessed his people; and that which is left
is this great store.
original_text:
And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since
the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the LORD hath blessed his people; and that which is left
is this great store.

translated_text:
Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the LORD; and they prepared
them,
original_text:
Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the LORD; and they prepared
them,

translated_text:
And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated
things faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite
was
 ruler, and Shimei his brother
was the next.
original_text:
And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated
things faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite
was
 ruler, and Shimei his brother
was the next.

translated_text:
And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah,
were
 overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.
original_text:
And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah,
were
 overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.

translated_text:
And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east,
was over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the oblations of the LORD, and the most holy things.
original_text:
And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east,
was over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the oblations of the LORD, and the most holy things.

translated_text:
And next him
were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in
their
 set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:
original_text:
And next him
were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in
their
 set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:

translated_text:
Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward,
even unto every one that entereth into the house of the LORD, his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;
original_text:
Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward,
even unto every one that entereth into the house of the LORD, his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;

translated_text: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;
original_text: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;

translated_text: And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:
original_text: And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:

translated_text:
Also of the sons of Aaron the priests,
which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.
original_text:
Also of the sons of Aaron the priests,
which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.

translated_text:
And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah, and wrought
that which was good and right and truth before the LORD his God.
original_text:
And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah, and wrought
that which was good and right and truth before the LORD his God.

translated_text:
And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did
it
 with all his heart, and prospered.
original_text:
And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did
it
 with all his heart, and prospered.

translated_text: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father’s stead in Jerusalem.
original_text: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father’s stead in Jerusalem.

translated_text:
Jehoahaz
was twenty and three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.
original_text:
Jehoahaz
was twenty and three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

translated_text: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
original_text: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

translated_text: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and turned his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.
original_text: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and turned his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.

translated_text:
Jehoiakim
was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and he did
that which was
 evil in the sight of the LORD his God.
original_text:
Jehoiakim
was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and he did
that which was
 evil in the sight of the LORD his God.

translated_text: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.
original_text: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.

translated_text: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of the LORD to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.
original_text: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of the LORD to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they
are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they
are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
Jehoiachin
was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD.
original_text:
Jehoiachin
was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD.

translated_text: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of the LORD, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.
original_text: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of the LORD, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

translated_text:
Zedekiah
was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.
original_text:
Zedekiah
was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God,
and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet
speaking
 from the mouth of the LORD.
original_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God,
and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet
speaking
 from the mouth of the LORD.

translated_text: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto the LORD God of Israel.
original_text: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto the LORD God of Israel.

translated_text: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of the LORD which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.
original_text: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of the LORD which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.

translated_text: And the LORD God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up betimes, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:
original_text: And the LORD God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up betimes, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:

translated_text:
But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till
there was no remedy.
original_text:
But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till
there was no remedy.

translated_text:
Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldees, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or him that stooped for age: he gave
them all into his hand.
original_text:
Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldees, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or him that stooped for age: he gave
them all into his hand.

translated_text:
And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all
these he brought to Babylon.
original_text:
And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all
these he brought to Babylon.

translated_text: And they burnt the house of God, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.
original_text: And they burnt the house of God, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.

translated_text: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:
original_text: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:

translated_text:
To fulfil the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths:
for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.
original_text:
To fulfil the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths:
for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.

translated_text:
Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD
spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and
put it also in writing, saying,
original_text:
Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD
spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and
put it also in writing, saying,

translated_text:
Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath the LORD God of heaven given me; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem, which
is in Judah. Who
is there among you of all his people? The LORD his God
be with him, and let him go up.
original_text:
Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath the LORD God of heaven given me; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem, which
is in Judah. Who
is there among you of all his people? The LORD his God
be with him, and let him go up.

translated_text: After these things, and the establishment thereof, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, and entered into Judah, and encamped against the fenced cities, and thought to win them for himself.
original_text: After these things, and the establishment thereof, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, and entered into Judah, and encamped against the fenced cities, and thought to win them for himself.

translated_text: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem,
original_text: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem,

translated_text:
He took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which
were without the city: and they did help him.
original_text:
He took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which
were without the city: and they did help him.

translated_text: So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?
original_text: So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?

translated_text:
Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised
it up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo
in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance.
original_text:
Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised
it up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo
in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance.

translated_text: And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying,
original_text: And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying,

translated_text:
Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that
is with him: for
there be more with us than with him:
original_text:
Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that
is with him: for
there be more with us than with him:

translated_text:
With him
is an arm of flesh; but with us
is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
original_text:
With him
is an arm of flesh; but with us
is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

translated_text:
After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem, (but he
himself laid siege against Lachish, and all his power with him,) unto Hezekiah king of Judah, and unto all Judah that
were at Jerusalem, saying,
original_text:
After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem, (but he
himself laid siege against Lachish, and all his power with him,) unto Hezekiah king of Judah, and unto all Judah that
were at Jerusalem, saying,

translated_text: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria, Whereon do ye trust, that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem?
original_text: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria, Whereon do ye trust, that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem?

translated_text: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst, saying, The LORD our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
original_text: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst, saying, The LORD our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

translated_text: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall worship before one altar, and burn incense upon it?
original_text: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall worship before one altar, and burn incense upon it?

translated_text:
Know ye not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of
other lands? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of mine hand?
original_text:
Know ye not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of
other lands? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of mine hand?

translated_text:
Who
was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of mine hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand?
original_text:
Who
was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of mine hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand?

translated_text: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you on this manner, neither yet believe him: for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand?
original_text: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you on this manner, neither yet believe him: for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand?

translated_text:
And his servants spake yet
more against the LORD God, and against his servant Hezekiah.
original_text:
And his servants spake yet
more against the LORD God, and against his servant Hezekiah.

translated_text:
He wrote also letters to rail on the LORD God of Israel, and to speak against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of
other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand.
original_text:
He wrote also letters to rail on the LORD God of Israel, and to speak against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of
other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand.

translated_text:
Then they cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ speech unto the people of Jerusalem that
were on the wall, to affright them, and to trouble them; that they might take the city.
original_text:
Then they cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ speech unto the people of Jerusalem that
were on the wall, to affright them, and to trouble them; that they might take the city.

translated_text:
And they spake against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the people of the earth,
which were the work of the hands of man.
original_text:
And they spake against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the people of the earth,
which were the work of the hands of man.

translated_text:
And for this
cause Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.
original_text:
And for this
cause Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.

translated_text: And the LORD sent an angel, which cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword.
original_text: And the LORD sent an angel, which cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword.

translated_text:
Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all
other,
 and guided them on every side.
original_text:
Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all
other,
 and guided them on every side.

translated_text: And many brought gifts unto the LORD to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah: so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.
original_text: And many brought gifts unto the LORD to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah: so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.

translated_text: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death, and prayed unto the LORD: and he spake unto him, and he gave him a sign.
original_text: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death, and prayed unto the LORD: and he spake unto him, and he gave him a sign.

translated_text:
But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit
done
 unto him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem.
original_text:
But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit
done
 unto him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem.

translated_text:
Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart,
both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the LORD came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.
original_text:
Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart,
both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the LORD came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.

translated_text: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour: and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels;
original_text: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour: and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels;

translated_text: Storehouses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and cotes for flocks.
original_text: Storehouses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and cotes for flocks.

translated_text: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for God had given him substance very much.
original_text: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for God had given him substance very much.

translated_text: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.
original_text: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

translated_text:
Howbeit in
the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was
done
 in the land, God left him, to try him, that he might know all
that was in his heart.
original_text:
Howbeit in
the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was
done
 in the land, God left him, to try him, that he might know all
that was in his heart.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they
are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz,
and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they
are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz,
and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

translated_text: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
Manasseh
was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem:
original_text:
Manasseh
was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem:

translated_text:
But did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, like unto the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.
original_text:
But did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, like unto the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.

translated_text: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
original_text: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

translated_text: Also he built altars in the house of the LORD, whereof the LORD had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.
original_text: Also he built altars in the house of the LORD, whereof the LORD had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.

translated_text: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.
original_text: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.

translated_text: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom: also he observed times, and used enchantments, and used witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
original_text: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom: also he observed times, and used enchantments, and used witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
