translated_text: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:
original_text: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

translated_text: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.
original_text: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.

translated_text:
So Manasseh made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err,
and to do worse than the heathen, whom the LORD had destroyed before the children of Israel.
original_text:
So Manasseh made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err,
and to do worse than the heathen, whom the LORD had destroyed before the children of Israel.

translated_text: And the LORD spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.
original_text: And the LORD spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.

translated_text: Wherefore the LORD brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
original_text: Wherefore the LORD brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

translated_text: And when he was in affliction, he besought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,
original_text: And when he was in affliction, he besought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,

translated_text:
And prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD he
was God.
original_text:
And prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD he
was God.

translated_text: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah.
original_text: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah.

translated_text:
And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of the LORD, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the LORD, and in Jerusalem, and cast
them out of the city.
original_text:
And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of the LORD, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the LORD, and in Jerusalem, and cast
them out of the city.

translated_text: And he repaired the altar of the LORD, and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Judah to serve the LORD God of Israel.
original_text: And he repaired the altar of the LORD, and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Judah to serve the LORD God of Israel.

translated_text: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, yet unto the LORD their God only.
original_text: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, yet unto the LORD their God only.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his God, and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the LORD God of Israel, behold, they
are written in the book of the kings of Israel.
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his God, and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the LORD God of Israel, behold, they
are written in the book of the kings of Israel.

translated_text:
His prayer also, and
how God was intreated of him, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they
are
 written among the sayings of the seers.
original_text:
His prayer also, and
how God was intreated of him, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they
are
 written among the sayings of the seers.

translated_text: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
Amon
was two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.
original_text:
Amon
was two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.

translated_text:
But he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;
original_text:
But he did
that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;

translated_text: And humbled not himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.
original_text: And humbled not himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.

translated_text: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.
original_text: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.

translated_text: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
original_text: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

translated_text:
Josiah
was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.
original_text:
Josiah
was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined
neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
original_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined
neither to the right hand, nor to the left.

translated_text: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.
original_text: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.

translated_text:
And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that
were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust
of them, and strowed
it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.
original_text:
And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that
were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust
of them, and strowed
it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.

translated_text: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.
original_text: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And
so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.
original_text:
And
so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.

translated_text: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.
original_text: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.

translated_text: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.
original_text: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.

translated_text: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.
original_text: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And they put
it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the LORD, and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the LORD, to repair and amend the house:
original_text:
And they put
it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the LORD, and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the LORD, to repair and amend the house:

translated_text:
Even to the artificers and builders gave they
it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.
original_text:
Even to the artificers and builders gave they
it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

translated_text:
And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them
were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set
it
 forward; and
other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.
original_text:
And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them
were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set
it
 forward; and
other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.

translated_text:
Also
they were over the bearers of burdens, and
were
 overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites
there were scribes, and officers, and porters.
original_text:
Also
they were over the bearers of burdens, and
were
 overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites
there were scribes, and officers, and porters.

translated_text:
And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the LORD
given
 by Moses.
original_text:
And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the LORD
given
 by Moses.

translated_text: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.
original_text: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

translated_text:
And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they do
it.
original_text:
And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they do
it.

translated_text: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the LORD, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.
original_text: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the LORD, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.

translated_text: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
original_text: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.
original_text: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.

translated_text: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king’s, saying,
original_text: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king’s, saying,

translated_text:
Go, enquire of the LORD for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great
is the wrath of the LORD that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD, to do after all that is written in this book.
original_text:
Go, enquire of the LORD for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great
is the wrath of the LORD that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD, to do after all that is written in this book.

translated_text:
And Hilkiah, and
they that the king
had appointed,
 went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that
effect.
original_text:
And Hilkiah, and
they that the king
had appointed,
 went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that
effect.

translated_text: And she answered them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell ye the man that sent you to me,
original_text: And she answered them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell ye the man that sent you to me,

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof,
even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah:
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof,
even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah:

translated_text: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.
original_text: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.

translated_text:
Because thine heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou heardest his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend thy clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard
thee also, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Because thine heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou heardest his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend thy clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard
thee also, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.
original_text: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.

translated_text: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
original_text: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

translated_text: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the LORD.
original_text: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the LORD.

translated_text: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.
original_text: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.

translated_text:
And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand
to it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
original_text:
And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand
to it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

translated_text:
And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that
pertained to the children of Israel, and made all that were present in Israel to serve,
even to serve the LORD their God.
And
 all his days they departed not from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.
original_text:
And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that
pertained to the children of Israel, and made all that were present in Israel to serve,
even to serve the LORD their God.
And
 all his days they departed not from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.

translated_text:
Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the LORD in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth
day of the first month.
original_text:
Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the LORD in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth
day of the first month.

translated_text: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the LORD,
original_text: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the LORD,

translated_text:
And said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, which were holy unto the LORD, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build;
it shall not
be a burden upon
your shoulders: serve now the LORD your God, and his people Israel,
original_text:
And said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, which were holy unto the LORD, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build;
it shall not
be a burden upon
your shoulders: serve now the LORD your God, and his people Israel,

translated_text:
And prepare
yourselves by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.
original_text:
And prepare
yourselves by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

translated_text:
And stand in the holy
place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and
after
 the division of the families of the Levites.
original_text:
And stand in the holy
place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and
after
 the division of the families of the Levites.

translated_text:
So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brethren, that
they may do according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
original_text:
So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brethren, that
they may do according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

translated_text:
And Josiah gave to the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all for the passover offerings, for all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these
were of the king’s substance.
original_text:
And Josiah gave to the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all for the passover offerings, for all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these
were of the king’s substance.

translated_text:
And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred
small cattle, and three hundred oxen.
original_text:
And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred
small cattle, and three hundred oxen.

translated_text:
Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand
small cattle, and five hundred oxen.
original_text:
Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand
small cattle, and five hundred oxen.

translated_text: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their courses, according to the king’s commandment.
original_text: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their courses, according to the king’s commandment.

translated_text:
And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled
the blood
 from their hands, and the Levites flayed
them.
original_text:
And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled
the blood
 from their hands, and the Levites flayed
them.

translated_text:
And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto the LORD, as
it is written in the book of Moses. And so
did they with the oxen.
original_text:
And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto the LORD, as
it is written in the book of Moses. And so
did they with the oxen.

translated_text:
And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the
other holy
offerings sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided
them speedily among all the people.
original_text:
And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the
other holy
offerings sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided
them speedily among all the people.

translated_text:
And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron
were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.
original_text:
And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron
were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

translated_text:
And the singers the sons of Asaph
were in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the porters
waited at every gate; they might not depart from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.
original_text:
And the singers the sons of Asaph
were in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the porters
waited at every gate; they might not depart from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.

translated_text: So all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the LORD, according to the commandment of king Josiah.
original_text: So all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the LORD, according to the commandment of king Josiah.

translated_text: And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.
original_text: And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

translated_text: And there was no passover like to that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; neither did all the kings of Israel keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
original_text: And there was no passover like to that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; neither did all the kings of Israel keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

translated_text: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept.
original_text: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept.

translated_text: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Charchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him.
original_text: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Charchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him.

translated_text:
But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah?
I come not against thee this day, but against the house wherewith I have war: for God commanded me to make haste: forbear thee from
meddling with God, who
is with me, that he destroy thee not.
original_text:
But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah?
I come not against thee this day, but against the house wherewith I have war: for God commanded me to make haste: forbear thee from
meddling with God, who
is with me, that he destroy thee not.

translated_text: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not unto the words of Necho from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.
original_text: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not unto the words of Necho from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

translated_text: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.
original_text: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.

translated_text:
His servants therefore took him out of that chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in
one of the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.
original_text:
His servants therefore took him out of that chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in
one of the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

translated_text:
And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and made them an ordinance in Israel: and, behold, they
are written in the lamentations.
original_text:
And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and made them an ordinance in Israel: and, behold, they
are written in the lamentations.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to
that which was written in the law of the LORD,
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to
that which was written in the law of the LORD,

translated_text:
And his deeds, first and last, behold, they
are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
original_text:
And his deeds, first and last, behold, they
are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

translated_text:
Hezekiah began to reign
when he was five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
original_text:
Hezekiah began to reign
when he was five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father had done.
original_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father had done.

translated_text: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of the LORD, and repaired them.
original_text: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of the LORD, and repaired them.

translated_text: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,
original_text: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,

translated_text:
And said unto them, Hear me, ye Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy
place.
original_text:
And said unto them, Hear me, ye Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy
place.

translated_text:
For our fathers have trespassed, and done
that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD, and turned
their backs.
original_text:
For our fathers have trespassed, and done
that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD, and turned
their backs.

translated_text:
Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy
place
 unto the God of Israel.
original_text:
Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy
place
 unto the God of Israel.

translated_text: Wherefore the wrath of the LORD was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.
original_text: Wherefore the wrath of the LORD was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.

translated_text: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
original_text: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.

translated_text:
Now
it is in mine heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.
original_text:
Now
it is in mine heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.

translated_text: My sons, be not now negligent: for the LORD hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense.
original_text: My sons, be not now negligent: for the LORD hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense.

translated_text: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:
original_text: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:

translated_text: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:
original_text: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:

translated_text: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.
original_text: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.

translated_text: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of the LORD, to cleanse the house of the LORD.
original_text: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of the LORD, to cleanse the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD, to cleanse
it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD into the court of the house of the LORD. And the Levites took
it, to carry
it out abroad into the brook Kidron.
original_text:
And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD, to cleanse
it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD into the court of the house of the LORD. And the Levites took
it, to carry
it out abroad into the brook Kidron.

translated_text:
Now they began on the first
day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of the LORD: so they sanctified the house of the LORD in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.
original_text:
Now they began on the first
day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of the LORD: so they sanctified the house of the LORD in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.

translated_text: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of the LORD, and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.
original_text: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of the LORD, and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.

translated_text:
Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they
are before the altar of the LORD.
original_text:
Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they
are before the altar of the LORD.

translated_text: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD.
original_text: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer
them
 on the altar of the LORD.
original_text:
And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer
them
 on the altar of the LORD.

translated_text:
So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled
it on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.
original_text:
So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled
it on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.

translated_text:
And they brought forth the he goats
for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:
original_text:
And they brought forth the he goats
for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:

translated_text:
And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded
that the burnt offering and the sin offering
should be made for all Israel.
original_text:
And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded
that the burnt offering and the sin offering
should be made for all Israel.

translated_text:
And he set the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet: for
so was the commandment of the LORD by his prophets.
original_text:
And he set the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet: for
so was the commandment of the LORD by his prophets.

translated_text: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.
original_text: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

translated_text:
And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began
also
 with the trumpets, and with the instruments
ordained by David king of Israel.
original_text:
And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began
also
 with the trumpets, and with the instruments
ordained by David king of Israel.

translated_text:
And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded:
and all
this continued until the burnt offering was finished.
original_text:
And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded:
and all
this continued until the burnt offering was finished.

translated_text: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.
original_text: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.

translated_text: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.
original_text: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.

translated_text: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves unto the LORD, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.
original_text: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves unto the LORD, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.

translated_text:
And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams,
and two hundred lambs: all these
were for a burnt offering to the LORD.
original_text:
And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams,
and two hundred lambs: all these
were for a burnt offering to the LORD.

translated_text:
And the consecrated things
were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.
original_text:
And the consecrated things
were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.

translated_text:
But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the
other priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites
were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.
original_text:
But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the
other priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites
were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.

translated_text:
And also the burnt offerings
were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for
every burnt offering. So the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.
original_text:
And also the burnt offerings
were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for
every burnt offering. So the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.

translated_text:
And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people: for the thing was
done suddenly.
original_text:
And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people: for the thing was
done suddenly.

translated_text:
It came to pass after this also,
that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them
other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
original_text:
It came to pass after this also,
that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them
other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.

translated_text:
Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they
be Hazazon-tamar, which
is En-gedi.
original_text:
Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they
be Hazazon-tamar, which
is En-gedi.

translated_text: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the LORD, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
original_text: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the LORD, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.

translated_text:
And Judah gathered themselves together, to ask
help of the LORD: even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the LORD.
original_text:
And Judah gathered themselves together, to ask
help of the LORD: even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the LORD.

translated_text: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the LORD, before the new court,
original_text: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the LORD, before the new court,

translated_text:
And said, O LORD God of our fathers,
art not thou God in heaven? and rulest
not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand
is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?
original_text:
And said, O LORD God of our fathers,
art not thou God in heaven? and rulest
not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand
is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?

translated_text:
Art not thou our God,
who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel, and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?
original_text:
Art not thou our God,
who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel, and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?

translated_text: And they dwelt therein, and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name, saying,
original_text: And they dwelt therein, and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name, saying,

translated_text:
If,
when evil cometh upon us,
as the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in thy presence, (for thy name
is in this house,) and cry unto thee in our affliction, then thou wilt hear and help.
original_text:
If,
when evil cometh upon us,
as the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in thy presence, (for thy name
is in this house,) and cry unto thee in our affliction, then thou wilt hear and help.

translated_text: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom thou wouldest not let Israel invade, when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;
original_text: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom thou wouldest not let Israel invade, when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;

translated_text:
Behold,
I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to inherit.
original_text:
Behold,
I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to inherit.

translated_text:
O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes
are upon thee.
original_text:
O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes
are upon thee.

translated_text: And all Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.
original_text: And all Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.

translated_text: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of the LORD in the midst of the congregation;
original_text: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of the LORD in the midst of the congregation;

translated_text:
And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle
is not yours, but God’s.
original_text:
And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle
is not yours, but God’s.

translated_text: To morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.
original_text: To morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.

translated_text:
Ye shall not
need to fight in this
battle: set yourselves, stand ye
still, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD
will be with you.
original_text:
Ye shall not
need to fight in this
battle: set yourselves, stand ye
still, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD
will be with you.

translated_text:
And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with
his face to the ground: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the LORD, worshipping the LORD.
original_text:
And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with
his face to the ground: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the LORD, worshipping the LORD.

translated_text: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise the LORD God of Israel with a loud voice on high.
original_text: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise the LORD God of Israel with a loud voice on high.

translated_text: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.
original_text: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.

translated_text:
And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the LORD, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD; for his mercy
endureth for ever.
original_text:
And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the LORD, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD; for his mercy
endureth for ever.

translated_text: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Judah; and they were smitten.
original_text: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Judah; and they were smitten.

translated_text:
For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy
them: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.
original_text:
For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy
them: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.

translated_text:
And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they
were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.
original_text:
And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they
were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.

translated_text: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.
original_text: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.

translated_text: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed the LORD: therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.
original_text: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed the LORD: therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.

translated_text: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.
original_text: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.

translated_text: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the LORD.
original_text: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of
those countries, when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.
original_text:
And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of
those countries, when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.

translated_text: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest round about.
original_text: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest round about.

translated_text:
And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah:
he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
original_text:
And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah:
he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

translated_text:
And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing
that which was right in the sight of the LORD.
original_text:
And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing
that which was right in the sight of the LORD.

translated_text: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers.
original_text: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they
are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel.
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they
are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel.

translated_text: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly:
original_text: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly:

translated_text: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Ezion-gaber.
original_text: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Ezion-gaber.

translated_text: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the LORD hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
original_text: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the LORD hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.

translated_text:
Amaziah
was twenty and five years old
when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
original_text:
Amaziah
was twenty and five years old
when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, but not with a perfect heart.
original_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, but not with a perfect heart.

translated_text: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father.
original_text: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father.

translated_text:
But he slew not their children, but
did as
it is
 written in the law in the book of Moses, where the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.
original_text:
But he slew not their children, but
did as
it is
 written in the law in the book of Moses, where the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.

translated_text:
Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of
their
 fathers, throughout all Judah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice
men, able to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.
original_text:
Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of
their
 fathers, throughout all Judah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice
men, able to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.

translated_text: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver.
original_text: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver.

translated_text:
But there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Israel go with thee; for the LORD
is not with Israel,
to wit, with all the children of Ephraim.
original_text:
But there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Israel go with thee; for the LORD
is not with Israel,
to wit, with all the children of Ephraim.

translated_text:
But if thou wilt go, do
it, be strong for the battle: God shall make thee fall before the enemy: for God hath power to help, and to cast down.
original_text:
But if thou wilt go, do
it, be strong for the battle: God shall make thee fall before the enemy: for God hath power to help, and to cast down.

translated_text: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God answered, The LORD is able to give thee much more than this.
original_text: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God answered, The LORD is able to give thee much more than this.

translated_text:
Then Amaziah separated them,
to wit, the army that was come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.
original_text:
Then Amaziah separated them,
to wit, the army that was come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.

translated_text: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.
original_text: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.

translated_text:
And
other ten thousand
left alive did the children of Judah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.
original_text:
And
other ten thousand
left alive did the children of Judah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.

translated_text: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Judah, from Samaria even unto Beth-horon, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.
original_text: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Judah, from Samaria even unto Beth-horon, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.

translated_text:
Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up
to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense unto them.
original_text:
Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up
to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense unto them.

translated_text: Wherefore the anger of the LORD was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand?
original_text: Wherefore the anger of the LORD was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand?

translated_text:
And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that
the king
 said unto him, Art thou made of the king’s counsel? forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that God hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened unto my counsel.
original_text:
And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that
the king
 said unto him, Art thou made of the king’s counsel? forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that God hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened unto my counsel.

translated_text: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us see one another in the face.
original_text: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us see one another in the face.

translated_text:
And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that
was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that
was
 in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that
was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
original_text:
And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that
was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that
was
 in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that
was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.

translated_text:
Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to
thine
 hurt, that thou shouldest fall,
even thou, and Judah with thee?
original_text:
Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to
thine
 hurt, that thou shouldest fall,
even thou, and Judah with thee?

translated_text:
But Amaziah would not hear; for it
came of God, that he might deliver them into the hand
of their enemies, because they sought after the gods of Edom.
original_text:
But Amaziah would not hear; for it
came of God, that he might deliver them into the hand
of their enemies, because they sought after the gods of Edom.

translated_text:
So Joash the king of Israel went up; and they saw one another in the face,
both he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, which
belongeth to Judah.
original_text:
So Joash the king of Israel went up; and they saw one another in the face,
both he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, which
belongeth to Judah.

translated_text: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.
original_text: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.

translated_text: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
original_text: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

translated_text:
And
he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obed-edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.
original_text:
And
he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obed-edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

translated_text: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.
original_text: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold,
are
 they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold,
are
 they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

translated_text: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the LORD they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there.
original_text: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the LORD they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there.

translated_text: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah.
original_text: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah.

translated_text:
Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who
was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.
original_text:
Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who
was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.

translated_text: He built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
original_text: He built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.

translated_text:
Sixteen years old
was Uzziah when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
original_text:
Sixteen years old
was Uzziah when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah did.
original_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah did.

translated_text: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him to prosper.
original_text: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him to prosper.

translated_text: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.
original_text: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

translated_text: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur-baal, and the Mehunims.
original_text: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur-baal, and the Mehunims.

translated_text:
And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad
even to the entering in of Egypt; for he strengthened
himself
 exceedingly.
original_text:
And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad
even to the entering in of Egypt; for he strengthened
himself
 exceedingly.

translated_text:
Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning
of the wall, and fortified them.
original_text:
Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning
of the wall, and fortified them.

translated_text:
Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen
also, and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.
original_text:
Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen
also, and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.

translated_text:
Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah,
one
 of the king’s captains.
original_text:
Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah,
one
 of the king’s captains.

translated_text:
The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour
were two thousand and six hundred.
original_text:
The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour
were two thousand and six hundred.

translated_text:
And under their hand
was an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.
original_text:
And under their hand
was an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

translated_text:
And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings
to cast
 stones.
original_text:
And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings
to cast
 stones.

translated_text: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.
original_text: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.

translated_text:
But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to
his destruction: for he transgressed against the LORD his God, and went into the temple of the LORD to burn incense upon the altar of incense.
original_text:
But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to
his destruction: for he transgressed against the LORD his God, and went into the temple of the LORD to burn incense upon the altar of incense.

translated_text:
And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him fourscore priests of the LORD,
that were valiant men:
original_text:
And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him fourscore priests of the LORD,
that were valiant men:

translated_text:
And they withstood Uzziah the king, and said unto him,
It appertaineth not unto thee, Uzziah, to burn incense unto the LORD, but to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for thou hast trespassed; neither
shall it be for thine honour from the LORD God.
original_text:
And they withstood Uzziah the king, and said unto him,
It appertaineth not unto thee, Uzziah, to burn incense unto the LORD, but to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for thou hast trespassed; neither
shall it be for thine honour from the LORD God.

translated_text:
Then Uzziah was wroth, and
had a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the LORD, from beside the incense altar.
original_text:
Then Uzziah was wroth, and
had a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the LORD, from beside the incense altar.

translated_text:
And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he
was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because the LORD had smitten him.
original_text:
And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he
was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because the LORD had smitten him.

translated_text:
And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house,
being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of the LORD: and Jotham his son
was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.
original_text:
And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house,
being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of the LORD: and Jotham his son
was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.

translated_text: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.
original_text: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.

translated_text:
So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which
belonged to the kings; for they said, He
is a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
original_text:
So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which
belonged to the kings; for they said, He
is a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
Jotham
was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also
was
 Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.
original_text:
Jotham
was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also
was
 Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Uzziah did: howbeit he entered not into the temple of the LORD. And the people did yet corruptly.
original_text:
And he did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Uzziah did: howbeit he entered not into the temple of the LORD. And the people did yet corruptly.

translated_text: He built the high gate of the house of the LORD, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.
original_text: He built the high gate of the house of the LORD, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.

translated_text: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.
original_text: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.

translated_text: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them. And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him, both the second year, and the third.
