original_text: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them. And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him, both the second year, and the third.

translated_text: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God.
original_text: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God.

translated_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they
are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
original_text:
Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they
are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

translated_text: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.
original_text: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

translated_text: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
Ahaz
was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: but he did not
that which was
 right in the sight of the LORD, like David his father:
original_text:
Ahaz
was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: but he did not
that which was
 right in the sight of the LORD, like David his father:

translated_text: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made also molten images for Baalim.
original_text: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made also molten images for Baalim.

translated_text: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.
original_text: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.

translated_text: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
original_text: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

translated_text:
Wherefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought
them to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who smote him with a great slaughter.
original_text:
Wherefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought
them to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who smote him with a great slaughter.

translated_text:
For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day,
which were all valiant men; because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers.
original_text:
For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day,
which were all valiant men; because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers.

translated_text:
And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king’s son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah
that was next to the king.
original_text:
And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king’s son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah
that was next to the king.

translated_text: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.
original_text: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.

translated_text:
But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name
was Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because the LORD God of your fathers was wroth with Judah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage
that reacheth up unto heaven.
original_text:
But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name
was Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because the LORD God of your fathers was wroth with Judah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage
that reacheth up unto heaven.

translated_text:
And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you:
but are there not with you, even with you, sins against the LORD your God?
original_text:
And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you:
but are there not with you, even with you, sins against the LORD your God?

translated_text:
Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which ye have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of the LORD
is
 upon you.
original_text:
Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which ye have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of the LORD
is
 upon you.

translated_text: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,
original_text: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,

translated_text:
And said unto them, Ye shall not bring in the captives hither: for whereas we have offended against the LORD
already, ye intend to add
more to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and
there is fierce wrath against Israel.
original_text:
And said unto them, Ye shall not bring in the captives hither: for whereas we have offended against the LORD
already, ye intend to add
more to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and
there is fierce wrath against Israel.

translated_text: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.
original_text: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.

translated_text: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.
original_text: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.

translated_text: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him.
original_text: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him.

translated_text: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives.
original_text: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives.

translated_text: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Judah, and had taken Beth-shemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof: and they dwelt there.
original_text: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Judah, and had taken Beth-shemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof: and they dwelt there.

translated_text: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel; for he made Judah naked, and transgressed sore against the LORD.
original_text: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel; for he made Judah naked, and transgressed sore against the LORD.

translated_text: And Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.
original_text: And Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.

translated_text:
For Ahaz took away a portion
out of the house of the LORD, and
out of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave
it unto the king of Assyria: but he helped him not.
original_text:
For Ahaz took away a portion
out of the house of the LORD, and
out of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave
it unto the king of Assyria: but he helped him not.

translated_text:
And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against the LORD: this
is that king Ahaz.
original_text:
And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against the LORD: this
is that king Ahaz.

translated_text:
For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them,
therefore
 will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel.
original_text:
For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them,
therefore
 will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel.

translated_text: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shut up the doors of the house of the LORD, and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem.
original_text: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shut up the doors of the house of the LORD, and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

translated_text: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods, and provoked to anger the LORD God of his fathers.
original_text: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods, and provoked to anger the LORD God of his fathers.

translated_text:
Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they
are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
original_text:
Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they
are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

translated_text:
And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city,
even in Jerusalem: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
original_text:
And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city,
even in Jerusalem: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text:
And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these
were
 the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
original_text:
And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these
were
 the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

translated_text:
And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Judah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he
was the firstborn.
original_text:
And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Judah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he
was the firstborn.

translated_text:
Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and
divers also of the princes of Israel.
original_text:
Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and
divers also of the princes of Israel.

translated_text:
Jehoram
was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
original_text:
Jehoram
was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought
that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD.
original_text:
And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought
that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD.

translated_text: Howbeit the LORD would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.
original_text: Howbeit the LORD would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.

translated_text: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah, and made themselves a king.
original_text: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah, and made themselves a king.

translated_text: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.
original_text: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.

translated_text:
So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. The same time
also did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken the LORD God of his fathers.
original_text:
So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. The same time
also did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken the LORD God of his fathers.

translated_text:
Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Judah
thereto.
original_text:
Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Judah
thereto.

translated_text: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of David thy father, Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,
original_text: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of David thy father, Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

translated_text:
But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father’s house,
which were better than thyself:
original_text:
But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father’s house,
which were better than thyself:

translated_text: Behold, with a great plague will the LORD smite thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy goods:
original_text: Behold, with a great plague will the LORD smite thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy goods:

translated_text:
And thou
shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.
original_text:
And thou
shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.

translated_text:
Moreover the LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that
were near the Ethiopians:
original_text:
Moreover the LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that
were near the Ethiopians:

translated_text: And they came up into Judah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king’s house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
original_text: And they came up into Judah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king’s house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.

translated_text: And after all this the LORD smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
original_text: And after all this the LORD smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

translated_text: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.
original_text: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.

translated_text: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.
original_text: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.

translated_text: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.
original_text: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

translated_text:
Forty and two years old
was Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also
was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.
original_text:
Forty and two years old
was Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also
was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

translated_text: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.
original_text: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.

translated_text: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.
original_text: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.

translated_text: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.
original_text: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.

translated_text: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.
original_text: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.

translated_text: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.
original_text: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.

translated_text: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.
original_text: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.

translated_text:
And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he
is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.
original_text:
And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he
is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.

translated_text: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.
original_text: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.

translated_text: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king’s sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.
original_text: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king’s sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.

translated_text: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.
original_text: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.

translated_text: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.
original_text: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.

translated_text: And they went about in Judah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the chief of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.
original_text: And they went about in Judah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the chief of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

translated_text: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said unto them, Behold, the king’s son shall reign, as the LORD hath said of the sons of David.
original_text: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said unto them, Behold, the king’s son shall reign, as the LORD hath said of the sons of David.

translated_text:
This
is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites,
shall be
 porters of the doors;
original_text:
This
is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites,
shall be
 porters of the doors;

translated_text:
And a third part
shall be at the king’s house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people
shall be in the courts of the house of the LORD.
original_text:
And a third part
shall be at the king’s house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people
shall be in the courts of the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
But let none come into the house of the LORD, save the priests, and they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they
are holy: but all the people shall keep the watch of the LORD.
original_text:
But let none come into the house of the LORD, save the priests, and they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they
are holy: but all the people shall keep the watch of the LORD.

translated_text:
And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whosoever
else cometh into the house, he shall be put to death: but be ye with the king when he cometh in, and when he goeth out.
original_text:
And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whosoever
else cometh into the house, he shall be put to death: but be ye with the king when he cometh in, and when he goeth out.

translated_text:
So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go
out on the sabbath: for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.
original_text:
So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go
out on the sabbath: for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.

translated_text:
Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that
had been king David’s, which
were in the house of God.
original_text:
Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that
had been king David’s, which
were in the house of God.

translated_text: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.
original_text: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.

translated_text:
Then they brought out the king’s son, and put upon him the crown, and
gave him the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, God save the king.
original_text:
Then they brought out the king’s son, and put upon him the crown, and
gave him the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, God save the king.

translated_text: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of the LORD:
original_text: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of the LORD:

translated_text: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.
original_text: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.

translated_text: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the ranges: and whoso followeth her, let him be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of the LORD.
original_text: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the ranges: and whoso followeth her, let him be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of the LORD.

translated_text: So they laid hands on her; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king’s house, they slew her there.
original_text: So they laid hands on her; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king’s house, they slew her there.

translated_text: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be the LORD’S people.
original_text: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be the LORD’S people.

translated_text: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
original_text: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

translated_text:
Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the LORD by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the house of the LORD, to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD, as
it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing,
as it was ordained
 by David.
original_text:
Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the LORD by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the house of the LORD, to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD, as
it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing,
as it was ordained
 by David.

translated_text:
And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the LORD, that none
which was unclean in any thing should enter in.
original_text:
And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the LORD, that none
which was unclean in any thing should enter in.

translated_text: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of the LORD: and they came through the high gate into the king’s house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.
original_text: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of the LORD: and they came through the high gate into the king’s house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.

translated_text: And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet, after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword.
original_text: And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet, after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword.

translated_text:
Joash
was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also
was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.
original_text:
Joash
was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also
was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.

translated_text:
And Joash did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
original_text:
And Joash did
that which was right in the sight of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

translated_text: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begat sons and daughters.
original_text: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begat sons and daughters.

translated_text:
And it came to pass after this,
that Joash was minded to repair the house of the LORD.
original_text:
And it came to pass after this,
that Joash was minded to repair the house of the LORD.

translated_text: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Judah, and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year, and see that ye hasten the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened it not.
original_text: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Judah, and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year, and see that ye hasten the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened it not.

translated_text:
And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection,
according to the commandment of Moses the servant of the LORD, and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?
original_text:
And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection,
according to the commandment of Moses the servant of the LORD, and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?

translated_text: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of God; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD did they bestow upon Baalim.
original_text: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of God; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD did they bestow upon Baalim.

translated_text: And at the king’s commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of the LORD.
original_text: And at the king’s commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in to the LORD the collection
that Moses the servant of God
laid
 upon Israel in the wilderness.
original_text:
And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in to the LORD the collection
that Moses the servant of God
laid
 upon Israel in the wilderness.

translated_text: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.
original_text: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.

translated_text:
Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king’s office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that
there was much money, the king’s scribe and the high priest’s officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.
original_text:
Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king’s office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that
there was much money, the king’s scribe and the high priest’s officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.

translated_text: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the LORD, and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the LORD.
original_text: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the LORD, and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the LORD.

translated_text: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in his state, and strengthened it.
original_text: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in his state, and strengthened it.

translated_text:
And when they had finished
it, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of the LORD,
even vessels to minister, and to offer
withal,
 and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the LORD continually all the days of Jehoiada.
original_text:
And when they had finished
it, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of the LORD,
even vessels to minister, and to offer
withal,
 and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the LORD continually all the days of Jehoiada.

translated_text:
But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old
was he when he died.
original_text:
But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old
was he when he died.

translated_text: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house.
original_text: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house.

translated_text: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.
original_text: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.

translated_text: And they left the house of the LORD God of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.
original_text: And they left the house of the LORD God of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.

translated_text: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto the LORD; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.
original_text: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto the LORD; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.

translated_text: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus saith God, Why transgress ye the commandments of the LORD, that ye cannot prosper? because ye have forsaken the LORD, he hath also forsaken you.
original_text: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus saith God, Why transgress ye the commandments of the LORD, that ye cannot prosper? because ye have forsaken the LORD, he hath also forsaken you.

translated_text: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the LORD.
original_text: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, The LORD look upon
it, and require
it.
original_text:
Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, The LORD look upon
it, and require
it.

translated_text:
And it came to pass at the end of the year,
that the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.
original_text:
And it came to pass at the end of the year,
that the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.

translated_text: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the LORD delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.
original_text: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the LORD delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.

translated_text: And when they were departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.
original_text: And when they were departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.

translated_text: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.
original_text: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.

translated_text:
Now
concerning his sons, and the greatness of the burdens
laid upon him, and the repairing of the house of God, behold, they
are written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
original_text:
Now
concerning his sons, and the greatness of the burdens
laid upon him, and the repairing of the house of God, behold, they
are written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined affinity with Ahab.
original_text: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined affinity with Ahab.

translated_text:
And after
certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that
he had with him, and persuaded him to go up
with him
 to Ramoth-gilead.
original_text:
And after
certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that
he had with him, and persuaded him to go up
with him
 to Ramoth-gilead.

translated_text:
And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramoth-gilead? And he answered him, I
am as thou
art, and my people as thy people; and
we will be with thee in the war.
original_text:
And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramoth-gilead? And he answered him, I
am as thou
art, and my people as thy people; and
we will be with thee in the war.

translated_text: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.
original_text: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.

translated_text:
Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for God will deliver
it into the king’s hand.
original_text:
Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for God will deliver
it into the king’s hand.

translated_text:
But Jehoshaphat said,
Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?
original_text:
But Jehoshaphat said,
Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?

translated_text:
And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat,
There is yet one man, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
original_text:
And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat,
There is yet one man, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

translated_text:
And the king of Israel called for one
of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.
original_text:
And the king of Israel called for one
of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.

translated_text:
And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne, clothed in
their robes, and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
original_text:
And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne, clothed in
their robes, and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

translated_text: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus saith the LORD, With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed.
original_text: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus saith the LORD, With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed.

translated_text:
And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver
it into the hand of the king.
original_text:
And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver
it into the hand of the king.

translated_text:
And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets
declare good to the king with one assent; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.
original_text:
And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets
declare good to the king with one assent; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.

translated_text:
And Micaiah said,
As the LORD liveth, even what my God saith, that will I speak.
original_text:
And Micaiah said,
As the LORD liveth, even what my God saith, that will I speak.

translated_text: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.
original_text: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.

translated_text: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the LORD?
original_text: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the LORD?

translated_text:
Then he said, I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master; let them return
therefore every man to his house in peace.
original_text:
Then he said, I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master; let them return
therefore every man to his house in peace.

translated_text:
And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee
that he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?
original_text:
And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee
that he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?

translated_text:
Again he said, Therefore hear the word of the LORD; I saw the LORD sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and
on his left.
original_text:
Again he said, Therefore hear the word of the LORD; I saw the LORD sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and
on his left.

translated_text: And the LORD said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.
original_text: And the LORD said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.

translated_text: Then there came out a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will entice him. And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith?
original_text: Then there came out a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will entice him. And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith?

translated_text:
And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And
the LORD said, Thou shalt entice
him,
 and thou shalt also prevail: go out, and do
even so.
original_text:
And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And
the LORD said, Thou shalt entice
him,
 and thou shalt also prevail: go out, and do
even so.

translated_text: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil against thee.
original_text: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil against thee.

translated_text: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?
original_text: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?

translated_text: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
original_text: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

translated_text: Then the king of Israel said, Take ye Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;
original_text: Then the king of Israel said, Take ye Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;

translated_text:
And say, Thus saith the king, Put this
fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.
original_text:
And say, Thus saith the king, Put this
fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.

translated_text:
And Micaiah said, If thou certainly return in peace,
then
 hath not the LORD spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all ye people.
original_text:
And Micaiah said, If thou certainly return in peace,
then
 hath not the LORD spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all ye people.

translated_text: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.
original_text: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.

translated_text: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will go to the battle; but put thou on thy robes. So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went to the battle.
original_text: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will go to the battle; but put thou on thy robes. So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went to the battle.

translated_text:
Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that
were with him, saying, Fight ye not with small or great, save only with the king of Israel.
original_text:
Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that
were with him, saying, Fight ye not with small or great, save only with the king of Israel.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It
is the king of Israel. Therefore they compassed about him to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him; and God moved them
to depart from him.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It
is the king of Israel. Therefore they compassed about him to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him; and God moved them
to depart from him.

translated_text: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back again from pursuing him.
original_text: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back again from pursuing him.

translated_text:
And a
certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
original_text:
And a
certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

translated_text:
And the battle increased that day: howbeit the king of Israel stayed
himself up in
his chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.
original_text:
And the battle increased that day: howbeit the king of Israel stayed
himself up in
his chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.

translated_text: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.
original_text: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

translated_text: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate the LORD? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the LORD.
original_text: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate the LORD? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the LORD.

translated_text: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thine heart to seek God.
original_text: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thine heart to seek God.

translated_text: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beer-sheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto the LORD God of their fathers.
original_text: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beer-sheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto the LORD God of their fathers.

translated_text: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah, city by city,
original_text: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah, city by city,

translated_text: And said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the LORD, who is with you in the judgment.
original_text: And said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the LORD, who is with you in the judgment.

translated_text:
Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you; take heed and do
it: for
there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.
original_text:
Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you; take heed and do
it: for
there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.

translated_text:
Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and
of
 the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of the LORD, and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.
original_text:
Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and
of
 the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of the LORD, and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.

translated_text: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of the LORD, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.
original_text: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of the LORD, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.

translated_text: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the LORD, and so wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and ye shall not trespass.
original_text: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the LORD, and so wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and ye shall not trespass.

translated_text:
And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king’s matters: also the Levites
shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and the LORD shall be with the good.
original_text:
And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king’s matters: also the Levites
shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and the LORD shall be with the good.

translated_text: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.
original_text: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.

translated_text:
And Asa did
that which was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God:
original_text:
And Asa did
that which was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God:

translated_text:
For he took away the altars of the strange
gods, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:
original_text:
For he took away the altars of the strange
gods, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:

translated_text: And commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.
original_text: And commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.

translated_text: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.
original_text: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.

translated_text: And he built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the LORD had given him rest.
original_text: And he built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the LORD had given him rest.

translated_text:
Therefore he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about
them walls, and towers, gates, and bars,
while the land
is yet before us; because we have sought the LORD our God, we have sought
him, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.
original_text:
Therefore he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about
them walls, and towers, gates, and bars,
while the land
is yet before us; because we have sought the LORD our God, we have sought
him, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.

translated_text:
And Asa had an army
of men that bare targets and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these
were mighty men of valour.
original_text:
And Asa had an army
of men that bare targets and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these
were mighty men of valour.

translated_text: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.
original_text: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.

translated_text: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
original_text: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

translated_text:
And Asa cried unto the LORD his God, and said, LORD,
it is
 nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O LORD our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O LORD, thou
art our God; let not man prevail against thee.
original_text:
And Asa cried unto the LORD his God, and said, LORD,
it is
 nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O LORD our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O LORD, thou
art our God; let not man prevail against thee.

translated_text: So the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.
original_text: So the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.

translated_text:
And Asa and the people that
were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before the LORD, and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.
original_text:
And Asa and the people that
were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before the LORD, and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.

translated_text: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of the LORD came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.
original_text: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of the LORD came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.

translated_text: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.
original_text: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.

translated_text: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:
original_text: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:

translated_text:
And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD
is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
original_text:
And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD
is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.

translated_text:
Now for a long season Israel
hath been without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.
original_text:
Now for a long season Israel
hath been without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.

translated_text: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the LORD God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.
original_text: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the LORD God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.

translated_text:
And in those times
there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations
were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.
original_text:
And in those times
there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations
were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.

translated_text: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for God did vex them with all adversity.
original_text: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for God did vex them with all adversity.

translated_text: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.
original_text: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.

translated_text:
And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the LORD, that
was before the porch of the LORD.
original_text:
And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the LORD, that
was before the porch of the LORD.

translated_text:
And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the LORD his God
was with him.
original_text:
And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the LORD his God
was with him.

translated_text: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
original_text: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.

translated_text:
And they offered unto the LORD the same time, of the spoil
which
 they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
original_text:
And they offered unto the LORD the same time, of the spoil
which
 they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.

translated_text: And they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;
original_text: And they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;

translated_text: That whosoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
original_text: That whosoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

translated_text: And they sware unto the LORD with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.
original_text: And they sware unto the LORD with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.

translated_text: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the LORD gave them rest round about.
original_text: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the LORD gave them rest round about.

translated_text:
And also
concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from
being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped
it, and burnt
it at the brook Kidron.
original_text:
And also
concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from
being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped
it, and burnt
it at the brook Kidron.

translated_text: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
original_text: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

translated_text: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
original_text: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.

translated_text:
And there was no
more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
original_text:
And there was no
more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.

translated_text: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
original_text: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

translated_text: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben-hadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
original_text: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben-hadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

translated_text:
There is a league between me and thee, as
there was
 between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
original_text:
There is a league between me and thee, as
there was
 between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

translated_text: And Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-maim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.
original_text: And Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-maim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when Baasha heard
it, that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when Baasha heard
it, that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.

translated_text: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.
original_text: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.

translated_text: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on the LORD thy God, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand.
original_text: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on the LORD thy God, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand.

translated_text: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on the LORD, he delivered them into thine hand.
original_text: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on the LORD, he delivered them into thine hand.

translated_text:
For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of
them whose heart
is
 perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.
original_text:
For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of
them whose heart
is
 perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.

translated_text:
Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for
he was in a rage with him because of this
thing. And Asa oppressed
some of the people the same time.
original_text:
Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for
he was in a rage with him because of this
thing. And Asa oppressed
some of the people the same time.

translated_text:
And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they
are
 written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
original_text:
And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they
are
 written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

translated_text:
And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease
was exceeding
great: yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD, but to the physicians.
original_text:
And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease
was exceeding
great: yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD, but to the physicians.

translated_text: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.
original_text: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.

translated_text:
And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had made for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds
of spices prepared by the apothecaries’ art: and they made a very great burning for him.
original_text:
And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had made for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds
of spices prepared by the apothecaries’ art: and they made a very great burning for him.

translated_text: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.
original_text: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.

translated_text: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
original_text: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

translated_text: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim;
original_text: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim;

translated_text:
But sought to the
LORD God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.
original_text:
But sought to the
LORD God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.

translated_text: Therefore the LORD stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.
original_text: Therefore the LORD stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.

translated_text: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.
original_text: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.

translated_text:
Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes,
even
 to Ben-hail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.
original_text:
Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes,
even
 to Ben-hail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.

translated_text:
And with them
he sent Levites,
even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.
original_text:
And with them
he sent Levites,
even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.

translated_text:
And they taught in Judah, and
had the book of the law of the LORD with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.
original_text:
And they taught in Judah, and
had the book of the law of the LORD with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.

translated_text:
And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that
were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
original_text:
And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that
were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

translated_text:
Also
some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.
original_text:
Also
some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.
