translated_text: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.
original_text: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.

translated_text:
And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour,
were in Jerusalem.
original_text:
And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour,
were in Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And these
are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.
original_text:
And these
are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.

translated_text:
And next to him
was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.
original_text:
And next to him
was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.

translated_text:
And next him
was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.
original_text:
And next him
was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.

translated_text: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.
original_text: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.

translated_text:
And next him
was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.
original_text:
And next him
was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.

translated_text:
These waited on the king, beside
those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.
original_text:
These waited on the king, beside
those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.

translated_text: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.
original_text: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who
was
 in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard
it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who
was
 in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard
it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

translated_text: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,
original_text: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,

translated_text: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.
original_text: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.

translated_text: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.
original_text: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.

translated_text:
And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye
me to return answer to this people?
original_text:
And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye
me to return answer to this people?

translated_text: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.
original_text: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.

translated_text: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.
original_text: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.

translated_text: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?
original_text: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?

translated_text:
And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou
it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little
finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.
original_text:
And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou
it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little
finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.

translated_text:
For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I
will chastise you
 with scorpions.
original_text:
For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I
will chastise you
 with scorpions.

translated_text: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.
original_text: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.

translated_text: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,
original_text: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,

translated_text:
And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I
will chastise you with scorpions.
original_text:
And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I
will chastise you with scorpions.

translated_text: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the LORD might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
original_text: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the LORD might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

translated_text:
And when all Israel
saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and
we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel:
and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.
original_text:
And when all Israel
saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and
we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel:
and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.

translated_text:
But
as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
original_text:
But
as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

translated_text:
Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that
was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to
his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
original_text:
Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that
was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to
his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

translated_text: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
original_text: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

translated_text:
And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen
men,
 which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
original_text:
And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen
men,
 which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

translated_text: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
original_text: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

translated_text: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
original_text: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

translated_text: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.
original_text: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.

translated_text: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
original_text: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,

translated_text: And Beth-zur, and Shoco, and Adullam,
original_text: And Beth-zur, and Shoco, and Adullam,

translated_text: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,
original_text: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

translated_text: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,
original_text: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,

translated_text:
And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which
are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.
original_text:
And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which
are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.

translated_text: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.
original_text: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.

translated_text:
And in every several city
he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.
original_text:
And in every several city
he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.

translated_text:
And the priests and the Levites that
were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.
original_text:
And the priests and the Levites that
were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.

translated_text: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest’s office unto the LORD:
original_text: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest’s office unto the LORD:

translated_text: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.
original_text: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.

translated_text: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the LORD God of their fathers.
original_text: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the LORD God of their fathers.

translated_text: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.
original_text: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.

translated_text:
And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife,
and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;
original_text:
And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife,
and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;

translated_text: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.
original_text: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.

translated_text: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
original_text: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.

translated_text: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)
original_text: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)

translated_text:
And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for
he thought to make him king.
original_text:
And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for
he thought to make him king.

translated_text: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.
original_text: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him.
original_text: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him.

translated_text:
And it came to pass,
that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the LORD,
original_text:
And it came to pass,
that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the LORD,

translated_text:
With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people
were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubim, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.
original_text:
With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people
were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubim, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.

translated_text:
And he took the fenced cities which
pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.
original_text:
And he took the fenced cities which
pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

translated_text:
Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and
to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.
original_text:
Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and
to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.

translated_text:
Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The LORD
is righteous.
original_text:
Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The LORD
is righteous.

translated_text: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.
original_text: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.

translated_text: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king’s house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
original_text: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king’s house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

translated_text:
Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed
them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king’s house.
original_text:
Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed
them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king’s house.

translated_text: And when the king entered into the house of the LORD, the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.
original_text: And when the king entered into the house of the LORD, the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.

translated_text:
And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from him that he would not destroy
him altogether: and also in Judah things went well.
original_text:
And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from him that he would not destroy
him altogether: and also in Judah things went well.

translated_text:
So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam
was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother’s name
was Naamah an Ammonitess.
original_text:
So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam
was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother’s name
was Naamah an Ammonitess.

translated_text: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the LORD.
original_text: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the LORD.

translated_text:
Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last,
are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And
there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
original_text:
Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last,
are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And
there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

translated_text: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.
original_text: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.

translated_text:
He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also
was
 Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
original_text:
He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also
was
 Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

translated_text:
And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war,
even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men,
being
 mighty men of valour.
original_text:
And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war,
even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men,
being
 mighty men of valour.

translated_text:
And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which
is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;
original_text:
And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which
is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;

translated_text:
Ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever,
even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?
original_text:
Ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever,
even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

translated_text: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.
original_text: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.

translated_text: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.
original_text: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.

translated_text:
And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David; and ye
be a great multitude, and
there are
 with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.
original_text:
And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David; and ye
be a great multitude, and
there are
 with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.

translated_text:
Have ye not cast out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of
other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams,
the same may be a priest of
them that are no gods.
original_text:
Have ye not cast out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of
other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams,
the same may be a priest of
them that are no gods.

translated_text:
But as for us, the LORD
is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the LORD,
are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites
wait upon
their business:
original_text:
But as for us, the LORD
is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the LORD,
are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites
wait upon
their business:

translated_text:
And they burn unto the LORD every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also
set they in order
 upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the LORD our God; but ye have forsaken him.
original_text:
And they burn unto the LORD every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also
set they in order
 upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the LORD our God; but ye have forsaken him.

translated_text:
And, behold, God himself is with us for
our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the LORD God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.
original_text:
And, behold, God himself is with us for
our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the LORD God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.

translated_text:
But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment
was behind them.
original_text:
But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment
was behind them.

translated_text:
And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle
was before and behind: and they cried unto the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
original_text:
And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle
was before and behind: and they cried unto the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

translated_text: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.

translated_text: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD God of their fathers.

translated_text: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephrain with the towns thereof.

Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and
put it also in writing, saying,

translated_text:
Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, The LORD God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which
is in Judah.
original_text:
Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, The LORD God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which
is in Judah.

translated_text:
Who
is there among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD God of Israel, (he
is the God,) which
is in Jerusalem.
original_text:
Who
is there among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD God of Israel, (he
is the God,) which
is in Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And whosoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of God that
is
 in Jerusalem.
original_text:
And whosoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of God that
is
 in Jerusalem.

translated_text:
Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all
them whose spirit God had raised, to go up to build the house of the LORD which
is in Jerusalem.
original_text:
Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all
them whose spirit God had raised, to go up to build the house of the LORD which
is in Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And all they that
were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, beside all
that was willingly offered.
original_text:
And all they that
were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, beside all
that was willingly offered.

translated_text: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the LORD, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;
original_text: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the LORD, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;

translated_text: Even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.
original_text: Even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.

translated_text:
And this
is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, nine and twenty knives,
original_text:
And this
is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, nine and twenty knives,

translated_text:
Thirty basons of gold, silver basons of a second
sort four hundred and ten,
and other vessels a thousand.
original_text:
Thirty basons of gold, silver basons of a second
sort four hundred and ten,
and other vessels a thousand.

translated_text:
All the vessels of gold and of silver
were five thousand and four hundred. All
these did Sheshbazzar bring up with
them of
 the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.
original_text:
All the vessels of gold and of silver
were five thousand and four hundred. All
these did Sheshbazzar bring up with
them of
 the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.

translated_text:
These
are now the chief of their fathers, and
this is
 the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.
original_text:
These
are now the chief of their fathers, and
this is
 the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.

translated_text: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.
original_text: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.

translated_text: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.
original_text: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.

translated_text: Of the sons of Pahath-moab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
original_text: Of the sons of Pahath-moab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.

translated_text: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.
original_text: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.

translated_text: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.
original_text: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.

translated_text: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.
original_text: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.

translated_text: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.
original_text: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.

translated_text: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
original_text: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.

translated_text: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.
original_text: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.

translated_text: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.
original_text: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.

translated_text: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.
original_text: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.

translated_text:
And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names
are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.
original_text:
And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names
are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.

translated_text: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.
original_text: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.

translated_text: And I gathered them together to the river than runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.
original_text: And I gathered them together to the river than runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.

translated_text: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.
original_text: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.

translated_text:
And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo,
and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.
original_text:
And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo,
and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.

translated_text: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;
original_text: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;

translated_text: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;
original_text: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;

translated_text: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.
original_text: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.

translated_text: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
original_text: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.

translated_text:
For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God
is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath
is against all them that forsake him.
original_text:
For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God
is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath
is against all them that forsake him.

translated_text: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
original_text: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.

translated_text: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,
original_text: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,

translated_text:
And weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels,
even the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel
there present, had offered:
original_text:
And weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels,
even the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel
there present, had offered:

translated_text:
I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents,
and of gold an hundred talents;
original_text:
I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents,
and of gold an hundred talents;

translated_text: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
original_text: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.

translated_text:
And I said unto them, Ye
are holy unto the LORD; the vessels
are holy also; and the silver and the gold
are a freewill offering unto the LORD God of your fathers.
original_text:
And I said unto them, Ye
are holy unto the LORD; the vessels
are holy also; and the silver and the gold
are a freewill offering unto the LORD God of your fathers.

translated_text:
Watch ye, and keep
them, until ye weigh
them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the LORD.
original_text:
Watch ye, and keep
them, until ye weigh
them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring
them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.
original_text:
So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring
them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.

translated_text:
Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth
day
 of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.
original_text:
Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth
day
 of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.

translated_text: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.
original_text: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.

translated_text:
By number
and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.
original_text:
By number
and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.

translated_text:
Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats
for a sin offering: all
this was
 a burnt offering unto the LORD.
original_text:
Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats
for a sin offering: all
this was
 a burnt offering unto the LORD.

translated_text: And they delivered the king’s commissions unto the king’s lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.
original_text: And they delivered the king’s commissions unto the king’s lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.

translated_text: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
original_text: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

translated_text: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
original_text: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

translated_text: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
original_text: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

translated_text: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
original_text: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

translated_text: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:
original_text: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:

translated_text:
This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he
was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.
original_text:
This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he
was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.

translated_text:
And there went up
some of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, unto Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
original_text:
And there went up
some of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, unto Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

translated_text:
And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which
was in the seventh year of the king.
original_text:
And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which
was in the seventh year of the king.

translated_text:
For upon the first
day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first
day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.
original_text:
For upon the first
day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first
day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.

translated_text:
For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do
it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.
original_text:
For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do
it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.

translated_text:
Now this
is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest, the scribe,
even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD, and of his statutes to Israel.
original_text:
Now this
is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest, the scribe,
even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD, and of his statutes to Israel.

translated_text:
Artaxerxes, king of kings, unto Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect
peace, and at such a time.
original_text:
Artaxerxes, king of kings, unto Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect
peace, and at such a time.

translated_text:
I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and
of
 his priests and Levites, in my realm, which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, go with thee.
original_text:
I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and
of
 his priests and Levites, in my realm, which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, go with thee.

translated_text:
Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king, and of his seven counsellors, to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which
is in thine hand;
original_text:
Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king, and of his seven counsellors, to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which
is in thine hand;

translated_text:
And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel, whose habitation
is
 in Jerusalem,
original_text:
And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel, whose habitation
is
 in Jerusalem,

translated_text:
And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which
is in Jerusalem:
original_text:
And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which
is in Jerusalem:

translated_text:
That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which
is in Jerusalem.
original_text:
That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which
is in Jerusalem.

translated_text: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.
original_text: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.

translated_text:
The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God,
those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem.
original_text:
The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God,
those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow
it out of the king’s treasure house.
original_text:
And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow
it out of the king’s treasure house.

translated_text:
And I,
even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers which
are beyond the river, that whatsoever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,
original_text:
And I,
even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers which
are beyond the river, that whatsoever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,

translated_text:
Unto an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing
how much.
original_text:
Unto an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing
how much.

translated_text: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
original_text: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?

translated_text: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.
original_text: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.

translated_text:
And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God, that
is in thine hand, set magistrates and judges, which may judge all the people that
are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach ye them that know
them not.
original_text:
And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God, that
is in thine hand, set magistrates and judges, which may judge all the people that
are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach ye them that know
them not.

translated_text:
And whosoever will not do the law of thy God, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily upon him, whether
it be unto death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.
original_text:
And whosoever will not do the law of thy God, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily upon him, whether
it be unto death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.

translated_text:
Blessed
be the LORD God of our fathers, which hath put
such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify the house of the LORD which
is in Jerusalem:
original_text:
Blessed
be the LORD God of our fathers, which hath put
such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify the house of the LORD which
is in Jerusalem:

translated_text:
And hath extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. And I was strengthened as the hand of the LORD my God
was upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.
original_text:
And hath extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. And I was strengthened as the hand of the LORD my God
was upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.

translated_text:
Now when these things were done, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands,
doing according to their abominations,
even of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
original_text:
Now when these things were done, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands,
doing according to their abominations,
even of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

translated_text:
For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of
those lands: yea, the hand of the princes and rulers hath been chief in this trespass.
original_text:
For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of
those lands: yea, the hand of the princes and rulers hath been chief in this trespass.

translated_text: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down astonied.
original_text: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down astonied.

translated_text: Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the transgression of those that had been carried away; and I sat astonied until the evening sacrifice.
original_text: Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the transgression of those that had been carried away; and I sat astonied until the evening sacrifice.

translated_text: And at the evening sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness; and having rent my garment and my mantle, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands unto the LORD my God.
original_text: And at the evening sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness; and having rent my garment and my mantle, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands unto the LORD my God.

translated_text:
And said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over
our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.
original_text:
And said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over
our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.

translated_text:
Since the days of our fathers
have we
been in a great trespass unto this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, and
our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to a spoil, and to confusion of face, as
it is this day.
original_text:
Since the days of our fathers
have we
been in a great trespass unto this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, and
our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to a spoil, and to confusion of face, as
it is this day.

translated_text:
And now for a little space grace hath been
shewed from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.
original_text:
And now for a little space grace hath been
shewed from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.

translated_text:
For we
were bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.
original_text:
For we
were bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.

translated_text: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments,
original_text: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments,

translated_text: Which thou hast commanded by thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, unto which ye go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness.
original_text: Which thou hast commanded by thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, unto which ye go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness.

translated_text:
Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave
it
 for an inheritance to your children for ever.
original_text:
Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave
it
 for an inheritance to your children for ever.

translated_text:
Should we again break thy commandments, and join in affinity with the people of these abominations? wouldest not thou be angry with us till thou hadst consumed
us, so that
there should be no remnant nor escaping?
original_text:
Should we again break thy commandments, and join in affinity with the people of these abominations? wouldest not thou be angry with us till thou hadst consumed
us, so that
there should be no remnant nor escaping?

translated_text:
O LORD God of Israel, thou
art righteous: for we remain yet escaped, as
it is this day: behold, we
are before thee in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before thee because of this.
original_text:
O LORD God of Israel, thou
art righteous: for we remain yet escaped, as
it is this day: behold, we
are before thee in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before thee because of this.

translated_text: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the LORD God of Israel;
original_text: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the LORD God of Israel;

translated_text: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the LORD God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.
original_text: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the LORD God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.

translated_text: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building,
original_text: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building,

translated_text: And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.
original_text: And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

translated_text:
And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they
unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.
original_text:
And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they
unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter
was written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.
original_text:
And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter
was written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.

translated_text: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:
original_text: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:

translated_text:
Then
wrote Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites,
and the Elamites,
original_text:
Then
wrote Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites,
and the Elamites,

translated_text:
And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnapper brought over, and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest
that are on this side the river, and at such a time.
original_text:
And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnapper brought over, and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest
that are on this side the river, and at such a time.

translated_text:
This
is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him,
even unto Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.
original_text:
This
is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him,
even unto Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.

translated_text:
Be it known unto the king, that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up the walls
thereof, and joined the foundations.
original_text:
Be it known unto the king, that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up the walls
thereof, and joined the foundations.

translated_text:
Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls set up
again, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and
so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings.
original_text:
Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls set up
again, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and
so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings.

translated_text:
Now because we have maintenance from
the king’s palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king’s dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;
original_text:
Now because we have maintenance from
the king’s palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king’s dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;

translated_text:
That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city
is a rebellious city, and hurtful unto kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city destroyed.
original_text:
That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city
is a rebellious city, and hurtful unto kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city destroyed.

translated_text:
We certify the king that, if this city be builded
again,
 and the walls thereof set up, by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river.
original_text:
We certify the king that, if this city be builded
again,
 and the walls thereof set up, by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river.

translated_text:
Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor, and
to Shimshai the scribe, and
to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and
unto the rest beyond the river, Peace, and at such a time.
original_text:
Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor, and
to Shimshai the scribe, and
to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and
unto the rest beyond the river, Peace, and at such a time.

translated_text: The letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me.
original_text: The letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me.

translated_text:
And I commanded, and search hath been made, and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings, and
that
 rebellion and sedition have been made therein.
original_text:
And I commanded, and search hath been made, and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings, and
that
 rebellion and sedition have been made therein.

translated_text:
There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all
countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.
original_text:
There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all
countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.

translated_text:
Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until
another commandment shall be given from me.
original_text:
Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until
another commandment shall be given from me.

translated_text: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?
original_text: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?

translated_text:
Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes’ letter
was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.
original_text:
Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes’ letter
was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.

translated_text:
Then ceased the work of the house of God which
is at Jerusalem. So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
original_text:
Then ceased the work of the house of God which
is at Jerusalem. So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

translated_text:
And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel
were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.
original_text:
And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel
were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.

translated_text:
Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and builded the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as
it is
 written in the law of Moses the man of God.
original_text:
Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and builded the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as
it is
 written in the law of Moses the man of God.

translated_text:
And they set the altar upon his bases; for fear
was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD,
even burnt offerings morning and evening.
original_text:
And they set the altar upon his bases; for fear
was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD,
even burnt offerings morning and evening.

translated_text:
And afterward
offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the LORD.
original_text:
And afterward
offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the LORD.

translated_text:
From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the LORD. But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not
yet laid.
original_text:
From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the LORD. But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not
yet laid.

translated_text: They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.
original_text: They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.

translated_text: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the LORD.
original_text: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
Then stood Jeshua
with his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to set forward the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad,
with their sons and their brethren the Levites.
original_text:
Then stood Jeshua
with his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to set forward the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad,
with their sons and their brethren the Levites.

translated_text: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD, after the ordinance of David king of Israel.
original_text: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD, after the ordinance of David king of Israel.

translated_text:
And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD; because
he is good, for his mercy
endureth for ever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.
original_text:
And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD; because
he is good, for his mercy
endureth for ever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.

translated_text:
But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers,
who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:
original_text:
But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers,
who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:

translated_text: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.
original_text: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.

translated_text: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.
original_text: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.

translated_text:
And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein
was a record thus written:
original_text:
And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein
was a record thus written:

translated_text:
In the first year of Cyrus the king
the same Cyrus the king made a decree
concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, Let the house be builded, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid; the height thereof threescore cubits,
and the breadth thereof threescore cubits;
original_text:
In the first year of Cyrus the king
the same Cyrus the king made a decree
concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, Let the house be builded, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid; the height thereof threescore cubits,
and the breadth thereof threescore cubits;

translated_text: With three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expences be given out of the king’s house:
original_text: With three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expences be given out of the king’s house:

translated_text:
And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought unto Babylon, be restored, and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem,
every one to his place, and place
them in the house of God.
original_text:
And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought unto Babylon, be restored, and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem,
every one to his place, and place
them in the house of God.

translated_text:
Now
therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shethar-boznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which
are
 beyond the river, be ye far from thence:
original_text:
Now
therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shethar-boznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which
are
 beyond the river, be ye far from thence:

translated_text: Let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place.
original_text: Let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place.

translated_text:
Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king’s goods,
even
 of the tribute beyond the river, forthwith expenses be given unto these men, that they be not hindered.
original_text:
Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king’s goods,
even
 of the tribute beyond the river, forthwith expenses be given unto these men, that they be not hindered.

translated_text:
And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests which
are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:
original_text:
And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests which
are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:

translated_text: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.
original_text: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.

translated_text: Also I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.
original_text: Also I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.

translated_text:
And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter
and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.
original_text:
And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter
and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.

translated_text: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shethar-boznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.
original_text: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shethar-boznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.

translated_text:
And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded, and finished
it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
original_text:
And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded, and finished
it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.

translated_text: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
original_text: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

translated_text: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,
original_text: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,

translated_text: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
original_text: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

translated_text:
And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which
is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.
original_text:
And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which
is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.

translated_text:
And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth
day of the first month.
original_text:
And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth
day of the first month.

translated_text:
