For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them
were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.
original_text:
For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them
were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.

translated_text: And the children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the LORD God of Israel, did eat,
original_text: And the children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the LORD God of Israel, did eat,

translated_text: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the LORD had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
original_text: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the LORD had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.

translated_text:
Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied unto the Jews that
were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel,
even unto them.
original_text:
Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied unto the Jews that
were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel,
even unto them.

translated_text:
Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which
is at Jerusalem: and with them
were the prophets of God helping them.
original_text:
Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which
is at Jerusalem: and with them
were the prophets of God helping them.

translated_text: At the same time came to them Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai, and their companions, and said thus unto them, Who hath commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?
original_text: At the same time came to them Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai, and their companions, and said thus unto them, Who hath commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?

translated_text: Then said we unto them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?
original_text: Then said we unto them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?

translated_text:
But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Darius: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this
matter.
original_text:
But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Darius: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this
matter.

translated_text:
The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, which
were
 on this side the river, sent unto Darius the king:
original_text:
The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, which
were
 on this side the river, sent unto Darius the king:

translated_text: They sent a letter unto him, wherein was written thus; Unto Darius the king, all peace.
original_text: They sent a letter unto him, wherein was written thus; Unto Darius the king, all peace.

translated_text: Be it known unto the king, that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great God, which is builded with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goeth fast on, and prospereth in their hands.
original_text: Be it known unto the king, that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great God, which is builded with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goeth fast on, and prospereth in their hands.

translated_text:
Then asked we those elders,
and said unto them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?
original_text:
Then asked we those elders,
and said unto them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?

translated_text:
We asked their names also, to certify thee, that we might write the names of the men that
were the chief of them.
original_text:
We asked their names also, to certify thee, that we might write the names of the men that
were the chief of them.

translated_text: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and build the house that was builded these many years ago, which a great king of Israel builded and set up.
original_text: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and build the house that was builded these many years ago, which a great king of Israel builded and set up.

translated_text: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Babylon.
original_text: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Babylon.

translated_text:
But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon
the same
 king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God.
original_text:
But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon
the same
 king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God.

translated_text:
And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that
was in Jerusalem, and brought them into the temple of Babylon, those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered unto
one, whose name
was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;
original_text:
And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that
was in Jerusalem, and brought them into the temple of Babylon, those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered unto
one, whose name
was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;

translated_text:
And said unto him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that
is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be builded in his place.
original_text:
And said unto him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that
is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be builded in his place.

translated_text:
Then came the same Sheshbazzar,
and laid the foundation of the house of God which
is in Jerusalem: and since that time even until now hath it been in building, and
yet it is not finished.
original_text:
Then came the same Sheshbazzar,
and laid the foundation of the house of God which
is in Jerusalem: and since that time even until now hath it been in building, and
yet it is not finished.

translated_text:
Now therefore, if
it seem good to the king, let there be search made in the king’s treasure house, which
is there at Babylon, whether it be
so, that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.
original_text:
Now therefore, if
it seem good to the king, let there be search made in the king’s treasure house, which
is there at Babylon, whether it be
so, that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.

translated_text: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.
original_text: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.

translated_text: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.
original_text: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.

translated_text:
And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God
one fourth part of the day; and
another
 fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the LORD their God.
original_text:
And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God
one fourth part of the day; and
another
 fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the LORD their God.

translated_text:
Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani,
and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the LORD their God.
original_text:
Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani,
and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the LORD their God.

translated_text:
Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah,
and Pethahiah, said, Stand up
and
 bless the LORD your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.
original_text:
Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah,
and Pethahiah, said, Stand up
and
 bless the LORD your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.

translated_text:
Thou,
even thou,
art LORD alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all
things that
are therein, the seas, and all that
is therein, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.
original_text:
Thou,
even thou,
art LORD alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all
things that
are therein, the seas, and all that
is therein, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.

translated_text:
Thou
art the LORD the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;
original_text:
Thou
art the LORD the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;

translated_text:
And foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give
it, I say,
 to his seed, and hast performed thy words; for thou
art righteous:
original_text:
And foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give
it, I say,
 to his seed, and hast performed thy words; for thou
art righteous:

translated_text: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;
original_text: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;

translated_text:
And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as
it is this day.
original_text:
And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as
it is this day.

translated_text: And thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.
original_text: And thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.

translated_text: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.
original_text: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.

translated_text: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:
original_text: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:

translated_text: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant:
original_text: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant:

translated_text: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.
original_text: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.

translated_text: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,
original_text: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,

translated_text:
And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou
art a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.
original_text:
And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou
art a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.

translated_text: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.
original_text: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.

translated_text: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.
original_text: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.

translated_text:
Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness,
so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.
original_text:
Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness,
so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.

translated_text: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
original_text: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

translated_text:
Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess
it.
original_text:
Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess
it.

translated_text: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.
original_text: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.

translated_text: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.
original_text: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.

translated_text: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.
original_text: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.

translated_text:
Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest
them from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.
original_text:
Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest
them from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.

translated_text:
But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest
them from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;
original_text:
But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest
them from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;

translated_text: And testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.
original_text: And testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.

translated_text: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.
original_text: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.

translated_text:
Nevertheless for thy great mercies’ sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou
art a gracious and merciful God.
original_text:
Nevertheless for thy great mercies’ sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou
art a gracious and merciful God.

translated_text: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.
original_text: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.

translated_text:
Howbeit thou
art just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:
original_text:
Howbeit thou
art just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:

translated_text: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.
original_text: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.

translated_text: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.
original_text: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.

translated_text:
Behold, we
are servants this day, and
for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we
are servants in it:
original_text:
Behold, we
are servants this day, and
for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we
are servants in it:

translated_text:
And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we
are in great distress.
original_text:
And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we
are in great distress.

translated_text:
And because of all this we make a sure
covenant, and write
it; and our princes, Levites,
and priests, seal
unto it.
original_text:
And because of all this we make a sure
covenant, and write
it; and our princes, Levites,
and priests, seal
unto it.

translated_text:
And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that
was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.
original_text:
And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that
was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.

translated_text: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.
original_text: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.

translated_text:
And he read therein before the street that
was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people
were attentive
 unto the book of the law.
original_text:
And he read therein before the street that
was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people
were attentive
 unto the book of the law.

translated_text:
And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah,
and Meshullam.
original_text:
And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah,
and Meshullam.

translated_text: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:
original_text: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:

translated_text:
And Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the LORD with
their faces to the ground.
original_text:
And Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the LORD with
their faces to the ground.

translated_text:
Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people
stood in their place.
original_text:
Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people
stood in their place.

translated_text:
So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused
them to understand the reading.
original_text:
So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused
them to understand the reading.

translated_text:
And Nehemiah, which
is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day
is holy unto the LORD your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.
original_text:
And Nehemiah, which
is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day
is holy unto the LORD your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.

translated_text:
Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for
this
 day
is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
original_text:
Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for
this
 day
is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

translated_text:
So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day
is holy; neither be ye grieved.
original_text:
So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day
is holy; neither be ye grieved.

translated_text: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.
original_text: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.

translated_text: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.
original_text: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.

translated_text: And they found written in the law which the LORD had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:
original_text: And they found written in the law which the LORD had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:

translated_text:
And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as
it is written.
original_text:
And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as
it is written.

translated_text:
So the people went forth, and brought
them, and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.
original_text:
So the people went forth, and brought
them, and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.

translated_text: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so. And there was very great gladness.
original_text: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so. And there was very great gladness.

translated_text:
Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day
was a solemn assembly, according unto the manner.
original_text:
Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day
was a solemn assembly, according unto the manner.

translated_text: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananeel.
original_text: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananeel.

translated_text: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho. And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri.
original_text: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho. And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri.

translated_text:
But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build, who
also
 laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
original_text:
But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build, who
also
 laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

translated_text: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.
original_text: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.

translated_text: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.
original_text: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.

translated_text: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
original_text: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

translated_text: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, unto the throne of the governor on this side the river.
original_text: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, unto the throne of the governor on this side the river.

translated_text:
Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of
one of the apothecaries, and they fortified Jerusalem unto the broad wall.
original_text:
Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of
one of the apothecaries, and they fortified Jerusalem unto the broad wall.

translated_text: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem.
original_text: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem.

translated_text: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.
original_text: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.

translated_text: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hashub the son of Pahath-moab, repaired the other piece, and the tower of the furnaces.
original_text: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hashub the son of Pahath-moab, repaired the other piece, and the tower of the furnaces.

translated_text: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Halohesh, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.
original_text: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Halohesh, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.

translated_text: The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate.
original_text: The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate.

translated_text: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab, the ruler of part of Beth-haccerem; he build it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
original_text: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab, the ruler of part of Beth-haccerem; he build it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

translated_text: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Col-hozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king’s garden, and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.
original_text: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Col-hozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king’s garden, and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.

translated_text:
After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Beth-zur, unto
the place over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.
original_text:

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king,
that wine
was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave
it unto the king. Now I had not been
beforetime sad in his presence.
original_text:
And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king,
that wine
was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave
it unto the king. Now I had not been
beforetime sad in his presence.

translated_text:
Wherefore the king said unto me, Why
is thy countenance sad, seeing thou
art not sick? this
is nothing
else
 but sorrow of heart. Then I was very sore afraid,
original_text:
Wherefore the king said unto me, Why
is thy countenance sad, seeing thou
art not sick? this
is nothing
else
 but sorrow of heart. Then I was very sore afraid,

translated_text:
And said unto the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ sepulchres,
lieth waste, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire?
original_text:
And said unto the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ sepulchres,
lieth waste, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire?

translated_text: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.
original_text: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.

translated_text: And I said unto the king, If it please the king, and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight, that thou wouldest send me unto Judah, unto the city of my fathers’ sepulchres, that I may build it.
original_text: And I said unto the king, If it please the king, and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight, that thou wouldest send me unto Judah, unto the city of my fathers’ sepulchres, that I may build it.

translated_text: And the king said unto me, (the queen also sitting by him,) For how long shall thy journey be? and when wilt thou return? So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.
original_text: And the king said unto me, (the queen also sitting by him,) For how long shall thy journey be? and when wilt thou return? So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.

translated_text: Moreover I said unto the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may convey me over till I come into Judah;
original_text: Moreover I said unto the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may convey me over till I come into Judah;

translated_text:
And a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which
appertained
 to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into. And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.
original_text:
And a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which
appertained
 to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into. And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.

translated_text: Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.
original_text: Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.

translated_text:
When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard
of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.
original_text:
When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard
of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.

translated_text: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.
original_text: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

translated_text:
And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; neither told I
any man what my God had put in my heart to do at Jerusalem: neither
was there any beast with me, save the beast that I rode upon.
original_text:
And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; neither told I
any man what my God had put in my heart to do at Jerusalem: neither
was there any beast with me, save the beast that I rode upon.

translated_text: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.
original_text: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.

translated_text:
Then I went on to the gate of the fountain, and to the king’s pool: but
there was no place for the beast
that was under me to pass.
original_text:
Then I went on to the gate of the fountain, and to the king’s pool: but
there was no place for the beast
that was under me to pass.

translated_text:
Then went I up in the night by the brook, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and
so returned.
original_text:
Then went I up in the night by the brook, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and
so returned.

translated_text:
And the rulers knew not whither I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told
it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work.
original_text:
And the rulers knew not whither I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told
it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work.

translated_text:
Then said I unto them, Ye see the distress that we
are in, how Jerusalem
lieth waste, and the gates thereof are burned with fire: come, and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we be no more a reproach.
original_text:
Then said I unto them, Ye see the distress that we
are in, how Jerusalem
lieth waste, and the gates thereof are burned with fire: come, and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we be no more a reproach.

translated_text:
Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king’s words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for
this good
work.
original_text:
Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king’s words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for
this good
work.

translated_text:
But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard
it, they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said, What
is this thing that ye do? will ye rebel against the king?
original_text:
But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard
it, they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said, What
is this thing that ye do? will ye rebel against the king?

translated_text: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.
original_text: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.

translated_text: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,
original_text: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,

translated_text:
That Hanani, one of my brethren, came, he and
certain men of Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, which were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
original_text:
That Hanani, one of my brethren, came, he and
certain men of Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, which were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And they said unto me, The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province
are in great affliction and reproach: the wall of Jerusalem also
is broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire.
original_text:
And they said unto me, The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province
are in great affliction and reproach: the wall of Jerusalem also
is broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned
certain days, and fasted, and prayed before the God of heaven,
original_text:
And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned
certain days, and fasted, and prayed before the God of heaven,

translated_text: And said, I beseech thee, O LORD God of heaven, the great and terrible God, that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments:
original_text: And said, I beseech thee, O LORD God of heaven, the great and terrible God, that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments:

translated_text: Let thine ear now be attentive, and thine eyes open, that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before thee now, day and night, for the children of Israel thy servants, and confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against thee: both I and my father’s house have sinned.
original_text: Let thine ear now be attentive, and thine eyes open, that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before thee now, day and night, for the children of Israel thy servants, and confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against thee: both I and my father’s house have sinned.

translated_text: We have dealt very corruptly against thee, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the judgments, which thou commandedst thy servant Moses.
original_text: We have dealt very corruptly against thee, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the judgments, which thou commandedst thy servant Moses.

translated_text:
Remember, I beseech thee, the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses, saying,
If ye transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:
original_text:
Remember, I beseech thee, the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses, saying,
If ye transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:

translated_text:
Now these
are thy servants and thy people, whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power, and by thy strong hand.
original_text:
Now these
are thy servants and thy people, whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power, and by thy strong hand.

translated_text: O Lord, I beseech thee, let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear thy name: and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king’s cupbearer.
original_text: O Lord, I beseech thee, let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear thy name: and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king’s cupbearer.

translated_text: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
original_text: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

translated_text:
That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he

And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar

to be over against his house.

translated_text: And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,
