translated_text:
And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took
one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.
original_text:
And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took
one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.

translated_text:
These sought their register
among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
original_text:
These sought their register
among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

translated_text:
And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood
up a priest with Urim and Thummim.
original_text:
And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood
up a priest with Urim and Thummim.

translated_text:
The whole congregation together
was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
original_text:
The whole congregation together
was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,

translated_text:
Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom
there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.
original_text:
Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom
there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.

translated_text: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:
original_text: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:

translated_text: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.
original_text: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.

translated_text: And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty basons, five hundred and thirty priests’ garments.
original_text: And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty basons, five hundred and thirty priests’ garments.

translated_text:
And
some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pounds of silver.
original_text:
And
some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pounds of silver.

translated_text:
And
that which the rest of the people gave
was
 twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pounds of silver, and threescore and seven priests’ garments.
original_text:
And
that which the rest of the people gave
was
 twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pounds of silver, and threescore and seven priests’ garments.

translated_text:
So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and
some of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel
were in their cities.
original_text:
So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and
some of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel
were in their cities.

translated_text:
Now it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had builded the wall, and
that there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)
original_text:
Now it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had builded the wall, and
that there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)

translated_text:
That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying, Come, let us meet together in
some one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.
original_text:
That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying, Come, let us meet together in
some one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.

translated_text:
And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I
am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?
original_text:
And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I
am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?

translated_text: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.
original_text: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.

translated_text: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;
original_text: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;

translated_text:
Wherein
was written, It is reported among the heathen, and Gashmu saith
it, that thou and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause thou buildest the wall, that thou mayest be their king, according to these words.
original_text:
Wherein
was written, It is reported among the heathen, and Gashmu saith
it, that thou and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause thou buildest the wall, that thou mayest be their king, according to these words.

translated_text:
And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem, saying,
There is a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.
original_text:
And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem, saying,
There is a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.

translated_text: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.
original_text: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.

translated_text:
For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore,
O God, strengthen my hands.
original_text:
For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore,
O God, strengthen my hands.

translated_text:
Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who
was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.
original_text:
Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who
was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.

translated_text:
And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who
is there,
 that,
being as I
am, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.
original_text:
And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who
is there,
 that,
being as I
am, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.

translated_text: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
original_text: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

translated_text:
Therefore
was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and
that they might have
matter for an evil report, that they might reproach me.
original_text:
Therefore
was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and
that they might have
matter for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

translated_text: My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.
original_text: My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.

translated_text:
So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth
day of
the month Elul, in fifty and two days.
original_text:
So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth
day of
the month Elul, in fifty and two days.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard
thereof,
 and all the heathen that
were about us saw
these things,
 they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God.
original_text:
And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard
thereof,
 and all the heathen that
were about us saw
these things,
 they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God.

translated_text:
Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and
the letters of Tobiah came unto them.
original_text:
Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and
the letters of Tobiah came unto them.

translated_text:
For
there were many in Judah sworn unto him, because he
was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.
original_text:
For
there were many in Judah sworn unto him, because he
was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.

translated_text:
Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him.
And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.
original_text:
Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him.
And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

translated_text: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.
original_text: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.

translated_text:
For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters,
are
 many: therefore we take up corn
for them, that we may eat, and live.
original_text:
For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters,
are
 many: therefore we take up corn
for them, that we may eat, and live.

translated_text: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.
original_text: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.

translated_text:
There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute,
and that upon our lands and vineyards.
original_text:
There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute,
and that upon our lands and vineyards.

translated_text:
Yet now our flesh
is as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children: and, lo, we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and
some of our daughters are brought unto bondage
already: neither
is it in our power
to redeem them;
 for other men have our lands and vineyards.
original_text:
Yet now our flesh
is as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children: and, lo, we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and
some of our daughters are brought unto bondage
already: neither
is it in our power
to redeem them;
 for other men have our lands and vineyards.

translated_text: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
original_text: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

translated_text: Then I consulted with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said unto them, Ye exact usury, every one of his brother. And I set a great assembly against them.
original_text: Then I consulted with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said unto them, Ye exact usury, every one of his brother. And I set a great assembly against them.

translated_text:
And I said unto them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews, which were sold unto the heathen; and will ye even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold unto us? Then held they their peace, and found nothing
to answer.
original_text:
And I said unto them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews, which were sold unto the heathen; and will ye even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold unto us? Then held they their peace, and found nothing
to answer.

translated_text:
Also I said, It
is not good that ye do: ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies?
original_text:
Also I said, It
is not good that ye do: ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies?

translated_text:
I likewise,
and my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and corn: I pray you, let us leave off this usury.
original_text:
I likewise,
and my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and corn: I pray you, let us leave off this usury.

translated_text:
Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundredth
part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.
original_text:
Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundredth
part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.

translated_text:
Then said they, We will restore
them, and will require nothing of them; so will we do as thou sayest. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.
original_text:
Then said they, We will restore
them, and will require nothing of them; so will we do as thou sayest. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.

translated_text: Also I shook my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performeth not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised the LORD. And the people did according to this promise.
original_text: Also I shook my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performeth not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised the LORD. And the people did according to this promise.

translated_text:
Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king,
that is, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.
original_text:
Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king,
that is, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.

translated_text:
But the former governors that
had been before me were chargeable unto the people, and had taken of them bread and wine, beside forty shekels of silver; yea, even their servants bare rule over the people: but so did not I, because of the fear of God.
original_text:
But the former governors that
had been before me were chargeable unto the people, and had taken of them bread and wine, beside forty shekels of silver; yea, even their servants bare rule over the people: but so did not I, because of the fear of God.

translated_text:
Yea, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: and all my servants
were gathered thither unto the work.
original_text:
Yea, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: and all my servants
were gathered thither unto the work.

translated_text:
Moreover
there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers, beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that
are about us.
original_text:
Moreover
there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers, beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that
are about us.

translated_text:
Now
that which was prepared
for me daily
was
 one ox
and six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.
original_text:
Now
that which was prepared
for me daily
was
 one ox
and six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.

translated_text:
Think upon me, my God, for good,
according to all that I have done for this people.
original_text:
Think upon me, my God, for good,
according to all that I have done for this people.

translated_text: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.
original_text: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.

translated_text: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?
original_text: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?

translated_text:
Now Tobiah the Ammonite
was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.
original_text:
Now Tobiah the Ammonite
was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.

translated_text: Hear, O our God; for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:
original_text: Hear, O our God; for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:

translated_text:
And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee: for they have provoked
thee to anger before the builders.
original_text:
And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee: for they have provoked
thee to anger before the builders.

translated_text: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.
original_text: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.

translated_text:
But it came to pass,
that when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up,
and that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth,
original_text:
But it came to pass,
that when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up,
and that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth,

translated_text:
And conspired all of them together to come
and to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.
original_text:
And conspired all of them together to come
and to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.

translated_text: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.
original_text: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.

translated_text:
And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and
there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.
original_text:
And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and
there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.

translated_text: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.
original_text: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, that when the Jews which dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times, From all places whence ye shall return unto us
they will be upon you.
original_text:
And it came to pass, that when the Jews which dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times, From all places whence ye shall return unto us
they will be upon you.

translated_text:
Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall,
and
 on the higher places, I even set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
original_text:
Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall,
and
 on the higher places, I even set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

translated_text:
And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: remember the Lord,
which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.
original_text:
And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: remember the Lord,
which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known unto us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.
original_text: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known unto us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.

translated_text:
And it came to pass from that time forth,
that the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the habergeons; and the rulers
were
 behind all the house of Judah.
original_text:
And it came to pass from that time forth,
that the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the habergeons; and the rulers
were
 behind all the house of Judah.

translated_text:
They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded,
every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other
hand held a weapon.
original_text:
They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded,
every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other
hand held a weapon.

translated_text:
For the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and
so builded. And he that sounded the trumpet
was by me.
original_text:
For the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and
so builded. And he that sounded the trumpet
was by me.

translated_text:
And I said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work
is great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another.
original_text:
And I said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work
is great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another.

translated_text:
In what place
therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.
original_text:
In what place
therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.

translated_text: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.
original_text: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.

translated_text: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour on the day.
original_text: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour on the day.

translated_text:
So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard which followed me, none of us put off our clothes,
saving that
 every one put them off for washing.
original_text:
So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard which followed me, none of us put off our clothes,
saving that
 every one put them off for washing.

translated_text:
Now these
are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
original_text:
Now these
are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

translated_text: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
original_text: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

translated_text: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
original_text: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

translated_text: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,
original_text: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,

translated_text: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
original_text: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

translated_text: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,
original_text: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,

translated_text:
Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These
were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.
original_text:
Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These
were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.

translated_text:
Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah,
and Mattaniah,
which was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.
original_text:
Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah,
and Mattaniah,
which was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.

translated_text:
Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren,
were over against them in the watches.
original_text:
Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren,
were over against them in the watches.

translated_text: And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,
original_text: And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,

translated_text: And Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.
original_text: And Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.

translated_text: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
original_text: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

translated_text: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
original_text: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

translated_text: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;
original_text: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

translated_text: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
original_text: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

translated_text: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
original_text: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

translated_text: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;
original_text: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;

translated_text: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
original_text: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

translated_text: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
original_text: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

translated_text: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
original_text: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

translated_text: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.
original_text: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.

translated_text:
The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua,
were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.
original_text:
The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua,
were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.

translated_text:
The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers,
were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
original_text:
The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers,
were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

translated_text:
And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise
and
 to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.
original_text:
And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise
and
 to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.

translated_text:
Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub,
were
 porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.
original_text:
Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub,
were
 porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.

translated_text:
These
were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.
original_text:
These
were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.

translated_text:
And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing,
with
 cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.
original_text:
And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing,
with
 cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.

translated_text: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;
original_text: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;

translated_text: Also from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.
original_text: Also from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.

translated_text: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.
original_text: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.

translated_text:
Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great
companies of them that gave thanks,
whereof one
 went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:
original_text:
Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great
companies of them that gave thanks,
whereof one
 went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:

translated_text: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,
original_text: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,

translated_text: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,
original_text: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,

translated_text: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
original_text: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,

translated_text:
And
certain of the priests’ sons with trumpets;
namely,
 Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:
original_text:
And
certain of the priests’ sons with trumpets;
namely,
 Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:

translated_text: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.
original_text: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.

translated_text: And at the fountain gate, which was over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.
original_text: And at the fountain gate, which was over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.

translated_text: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.
original_text: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.

translated_text:
So stood the two
companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:
original_text:
So stood the two
companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:

translated_text:
And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah,
and Hananiah, with trumpets;
original_text:
And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah,
and Hananiah, with trumpets;

translated_text:
And Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah
their overseer.
original_text:
And Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah
their overseer.

translated_text: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.
original_text: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.

translated_text: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.
original_text: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.

translated_text:
And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David,
and
 of Solomon his son.
original_text:
And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David,
and
 of Solomon his son.

translated_text:
For in the days of David and Asaph of old
there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.
original_text:
For in the days of David and Asaph of old
there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.

translated_text:
And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified
holy things unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified
them unto the children of Aaron.
original_text:
And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified
holy things unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified
them unto the children of Aaron.

translated_text:
And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts
to dwell in
other cities.
original_text:
And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts
to dwell in
other cities.

translated_text: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
original_text: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.

translated_text:
Now these
are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities,
to wit, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants.
original_text:
Now these
are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities,
to wit, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants.

translated_text:
And at Jerusalem dwelt
certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;
original_text:
And at Jerusalem dwelt
certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;

translated_text: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.
original_text: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.

translated_text:
All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem
were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.
original_text:
All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem
were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.

translated_text:
And these
are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.
original_text:
And these
are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.

translated_text: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.
original_text: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.

translated_text:
And Joel the son of Zichri
was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah
was second over the city.
original_text:
And Joel the son of Zichri
was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah
was second over the city.

translated_text: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.
original_text: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.

translated_text:
Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub,
was the ruler of the house of God.
original_text:
Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub,
was the ruler of the house of God.

translated_text:
And their brethren that did the work of the house
were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,
original_text:
And their brethren that did the work of the house
were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,

translated_text: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
original_text: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

translated_text:
And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer
was Zabdiel, the son of
one of the great men.
original_text:
And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer
was Zabdiel, the son of
one of the great men.

translated_text: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
original_text: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

translated_text:
And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites,
had
 the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.
original_text:
And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites,
had
 the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.

translated_text:
And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph,
was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
original_text:
And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph,
was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

translated_text:
All the Levites in the holy city
were two hundred fourscore and four.
original_text:
All the Levites in the holy city
were two hundred fourscore and four.

translated_text:
Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates,
were an hundred seventy and two.
original_text:
Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates,
were an hundred seventy and two.

translated_text:
And the residue of Israel, of the priests,
and the Levites,
were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
original_text:
And the residue of Israel, of the priests,
and the Levites,
were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.

translated_text:
But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa
were
 over the Nethinims.
original_text:
But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa
were
 over the Nethinims.

translated_text:
The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem
was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers
were over the business of the house of God.
original_text:
The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem
was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers
were over the business of the house of God.

translated_text:
For
it was the king’s commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.
original_text:
For
it was the king’s commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.

translated_text:
And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah,
was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.
original_text:
And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah,
was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.

translated_text:
And for the villages, with their fields,
some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjath-arba, and
in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and
in the villages thereof,
original_text:
And for the villages, with their fields,
some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjath-arba, and
in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and
in the villages thereof,

translated_text: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth-phelet,
original_text: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth-phelet,

translated_text:
And at Hazar-shual, and at Beer-sheba, and
in the villages thereof,
original_text:
And at Hazar-shual, and at Beer-sheba, and
in the villages thereof,

translated_text: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,
original_text: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,

translated_text: And at En-rimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,
original_text: And at En-rimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,

translated_text:
Zanoah, Adullam, and
in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and
in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beer-sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
original_text:
Zanoah, Adullam, and
in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and
in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beer-sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.

translated_text:
The children also of Benjamin from Geba
dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Bethel, and
in their villages,
original_text:
The children also of Benjamin from Geba
dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Bethel, and
in their villages,

translated_text: And at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
original_text: And at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

translated_text: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
original_text: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

translated_text: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
original_text: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

translated_text: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
original_text: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

translated_text:
And of the Levites
were divisions
in Judah,
and in Benjamin.
original_text:
And of the Levites
were divisions
in Judah,
and in Benjamin.

translated_text: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;
original_text: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;

translated_text: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.
original_text: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.

translated_text: Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.
original_text: Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.

translated_text:
And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God,
was allied unto Tobiah:
original_text:
And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God,
was allied unto Tobiah:

translated_text:
And he had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded
to be given
 to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.
original_text:
And he had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded
to be given
 to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.

translated_text:
But in all this
time was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:
original_text:
But in all this
time was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:

translated_text: And I came to Jerusalem, and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.
original_text: And I came to Jerusalem, and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.

translated_text: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the chamber.
original_text: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the chamber.

translated_text: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.
original_text: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.

translated_text:
And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given
them: for the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.
original_text:
And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given
them: for the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.

translated_text: Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.
original_text: Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.

translated_text: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.
original_text: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.

translated_text:
And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them
was
 Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office
was to distribute unto their brethren.
original_text:
And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them
was
 Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office
was to distribute unto their brethren.

translated_text: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.
original_text: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.

translated_text:
In those days saw I in Judah
some treading winepresses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all
manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified
against them in the day wherein they sold victuals.
original_text:
In those days saw I in Judah
some treading winepresses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all
manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified
against them in the day wherein they sold victuals.

translated_text: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
original_text: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

translated_text:
Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing
is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?
original_text:
Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing
is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?

translated_text: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.
original_text: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and
some
 of my servants set I at the gates,
that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.
original_text:
And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and
some
 of my servants set I at the gates,
that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.

translated_text: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.
original_text: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.

translated_text:
Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no
more on the sabbath.
original_text:
Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no
more on the sabbath.

translated_text:
And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and
that they should come
and keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember me, O my God,
concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy.
original_text:
And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and
that they should come
and keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember me, O my God,
concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy.

translated_text:
In those days also saw I Jews
that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon,
and of Moab:
original_text:
In those days also saw I Jews
that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon,
and of Moab:

translated_text: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language, but according to the language of each people.
original_text: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language, but according to the language of each people.

translated_text:
And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God,
saying,
 Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.
original_text:
And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God,
saying,
 Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.

translated_text: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.

translated_text: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.
original_text: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.

translated_text:
And he sent the letters unto all the Jews, to the hundred twenty and seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus,
with words of peace and truth,
original_text:
And he sent the letters unto all the Jews, to the hundred twenty and seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus,
with words of peace and truth,

translated_text:
To confirm these days of Purim in their times
appointed,
 according as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their cry.
original_text:
To confirm these days of Purim in their times
appointed,
 according as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their cry.

translated_text: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.
original_text: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

translated_text: On that night could not the king sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.
original_text: On that night could not the king sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.

translated_text: And it was found written, that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s chamberlains, the keepers of the door, who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.
original_text: And it was found written, that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s chamberlains, the keepers of the door, who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.

translated_text: And the king said, What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this? Then said the king’s servants that ministered unto him, There is nothing done for him.
original_text: And the king said, What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this? Then said the king’s servants that ministered unto him, There is nothing done for him.

translated_text:
And the king said, Who
is in the court? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king’s house, to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.
original_text:
And the king said, Who
is in the court? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king’s house, to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

translated_text: And the king’s servants said unto him, Behold, Haman standeth in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.
original_text: And the king’s servants said unto him, Behold, Haman standeth in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.

translated_text: So Haman came in. And the king said unto him, What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself?
original_text: So Haman came in. And the king said unto him, What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself?

translated_text: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king delighteth to honour,
original_text: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king delighteth to honour,

translated_text:
Let the royal apparel be brought which the king
useth to wear, and the horse that the king rideth upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head:
original_text:
Let the royal apparel be brought which the king
useth to wear, and the horse that the king rideth upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head:

translated_text:
And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king’s most noble princes, that they may array the man
withal whom the king delighteth to honour, and bring him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour.
original_text:
And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king’s most noble princes, that they may array the man
withal whom the king delighteth to honour, and bring him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour.

translated_text:
Then the king said to Haman, Make haste,
and take the apparel and the horse, as thou hast said, and do even so to Mordecai the Jew, that sitteth at the king’s gate: let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken.
original_text:
Then the king said to Haman, Make haste,
and take the apparel and the horse, as thou hast said, and do even so to Mordecai the Jew, that sitteth at the king’s gate: let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken.

translated_text: Then took Haman the apparel and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and brought him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaimed before him, Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour.
original_text: Then took Haman the apparel and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and brought him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaimed before him, Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour.

translated_text: And Mordecai came again to the king’s gate. But Haman hasted to his house mourning, and having his head covered.
original_text: And Mordecai came again to the king’s gate. But Haman hasted to his house mourning, and having his head covered.

translated_text:
And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every
thing
 that had befallen him. Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife unto him, If Mordecai
be of the seed of the Jews, before whom thou hast begun to fall, thou shalt not prevail against him, but shalt surely fall before him.
original_text:
And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every
thing
 that had befallen him. Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife unto him, If Mordecai
be of the seed of the Jews, before whom thou hast begun to fall, thou shalt not prevail against him, but shalt surely fall before him.

translated_text:
And while they
were yet talking with him, came the king’s chamberlains, and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared.
original_text:
And while they
were yet talking with him, came the king’s chamberlains, and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared.

translated_text: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.
original_text: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

translated_text:
And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, What
is thy petition, queen Esther? and it shall be granted thee: and what
is thy request? and it shall be performed,
even to the half of the kingdom.
original_text:
And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, What
is thy petition, queen Esther? and it shall be granted thee: and what
is thy request? and it shall be performed,
even to the half of the kingdom.

translated_text: Then Esther the queen answered and said, If I have found favour in thy sight, O king, and if it please the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request:
original_text: Then Esther the queen answered and said, If I have found favour in thy sight, O king, and if it please the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request:

translated_text: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen, I had held my tongue, although the enemy could not countervail the king’s damage.
original_text: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen, I had held my tongue, although the enemy could not countervail the king’s damage.

translated_text: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen, Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume in his heart to do so?
original_text: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen, Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume in his heart to do so?

translated_text:
And Esther said, The adversary and enemy
is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.
original_text:
And Esther said, The adversary and enemy
is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.

translated_text:
And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath
went
 into the palace garden: and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.
original_text:
And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath
went
 into the palace garden: and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

translated_text:
Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther
was.
 Then said the king, Will he force the queen also before me in the house? As the word went out of the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.
original_text:
Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther
was.
 Then said the king, Will he force the queen also before me in the house? As the word went out of the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.

translated_text: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold also, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king, standeth in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him thereon.
original_text: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold also, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king, standeth in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him thereon.

translated_text: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king’s wrath pacified.
original_text: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king’s wrath pacified.

translated_text: When Mordecai perceived all that was done, Mordecai rent his clothes, and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the midst of the city, and cried with a loud and a bitter cry;
original_text: When Mordecai perceived all that was done, Mordecai rent his clothes, and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the midst of the city, and cried with a loud and a bitter cry;

translated_text:
And came even before the king’s gate: for none
might enter into the king’s gate clothed with sackcloth.
original_text:
And came even before the king’s gate: for none
might enter into the king’s gate clothed with sackcloth.

translated_text:
And in every province, whithersoever the king’s commandment and his decree came,
there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.
original_text:
And in every province, whithersoever the king’s commandment and his decree came,
there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

translated_text:
So Esther’s maids and her chamberlains came and told
it her. Then was the queen exceedingly grieved; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai, and to take away his sackcloth from him: but he received
it
 not.
original_text:
So Esther’s maids and her chamberlains came and told
it her. Then was the queen exceedingly grieved; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai, and to take away his sackcloth from him: but he received
it
 not.

translated_text:
Then called Esther for Hatach,
one of the king’s chamberlains, whom he had appointed to attend upon her, and gave him a commandment to Mordecai, to know what it
was, and why it
was.
original_text:
Then called Esther for Hatach,
one of the king’s chamberlains, whom he had appointed to attend upon her, and gave him a commandment to Mordecai, to know what it
was, and why it
was.

translated_text:
So Hatach went forth to Mordecai unto the street of the city, which
was before the king’s gate.
original_text:
So Hatach went forth to Mordecai unto the street of the city, which
was before the king’s gate.

translated_text: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him, and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king’s treasuries for the Jews, to destroy them.
original_text: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him, and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king’s treasuries for the Jews, to destroy them.

translated_text:
Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them, to shew
it unto Esther, and to declare
it unto her, and to charge her that she should go in unto the king, to make supplication unto him, and to make request before him for her people.
original_text:
Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them, to shew
it unto Esther, and to declare
it unto her, and to charge her that she should go in unto the king, to make supplication unto him, and to make request before him for her people.

translated_text: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.
original_text: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

translated_text: Again Esther spake unto Hatach, and gave him commandment unto Mordecai;
original_text: Again Esther spake unto Hatach, and gave him commandment unto Mordecai;

translated_text:
All the king’s servants, and the people of the king’s provinces, do know, that whosoever, whether man or woman, shall come unto the king into the inner court, who is not called,
there is one law of his to put
him to death, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days.
original_text:
All the king’s servants, and the people of the king’s provinces, do know, that whosoever, whether man or woman, shall come unto the king into the inner court, who is not called,
there is one law of his to put
him to death, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days.

translated_text: And they told to Mordecai Esther’s words.
original_text: And they told to Mordecai Esther’s words.

translated_text: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther, Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king’s house, more than all the Jews.
original_text: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther, Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king’s house, more than all the Jews.

translated_text:
For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time,
then
 shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father’s house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for
such a time as this?
original_text:
For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time,
then
 shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father’s house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for
such a time as this?

translated_text:
Then Esther bade
them return Mordecai
this answer,
original_text:
Then Esther bade
them return Mordecai
this answer,

translated_text:
Go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also and my maidens will fast likewise; and so will I go in unto the king, which
is not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish.
original_text:
Go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also and my maidens will fast likewise; and so will I go in unto the king, which
is not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish.

translated_text: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.
original_text: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

translated_text:
Now it came to pass on the third day, that Esther put on
her
 royal
apparel, and stood in the inner court of the king’s house, over against the king’s house: and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house, over against the gate of the house.
original_text:
Now it came to pass on the third day, that Esther put on
her
 royal
apparel, and stood in the inner court of the king’s house, over against the king’s house: and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house, over against the gate of the house.

translated_text:
And it was so, when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court,
that she obtained favour in his sight: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that
was in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.
original_text:
And it was so, when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court,
that she obtained favour in his sight: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that
was in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.

translated_text:
Then said the king unto her, What wilt thou, queen Esther? and what
is thy request? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom.
original_text:
Then said the king unto her, What wilt thou, queen Esther? and what
is thy request? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom.

translated_text:
And Esther answered, If
it seem good unto the king, let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him.
original_text:
And Esther answered, If
it seem good unto the king, let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him.

translated_text: Then the king said, Cause Haman to make haste, that he may do as Esther hath said. So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.
original_text: Then the king said, Cause Haman to make haste, that he may do as Esther hath said. So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

translated_text:
And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine, What
is
 thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: and what
is thy request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.
original_text:
And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine, What
is
 thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: and what
is thy request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.

translated_text:
Then answered Esther, and said, My petition and my request
is;
original_text:
Then answered Esther, and said, My petition and my request
is;

translated_text: If I have found favour in the sight of the king, and if it please the king to grant my petition, and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them, and I will do to morrow as the king hath said.
original_text: If I have found favour in the sight of the king, and if it please the king to grant my petition, and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them, and I will do to morrow as the king hath said.

translated_text: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king’s gate, that he stood not up, nor moved for him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.
original_text: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king’s gate, that he stood not up, nor moved for him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.

translated_text: Nevertheless Haman refrained himself: and when he came home, he sent and called for his friends, and Zeresh his wife.
original_text: Nevertheless Haman refrained himself: and when he came home, he sent and called for his friends, and Zeresh his wife.

translated_text:
And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all
the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.
original_text:
And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all
the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

translated_text: Haman said moreover, Yea, Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king.
original_text: Haman said moreover, Yea, Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king.

translated_text: Yet all this availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.
original_text: Yet all this availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.

translated_text: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him, Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high, and to morrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon: then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet. And the thing pleased Haman; and he caused the gallows to be made.
original_text: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him, Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high, and to morrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon: then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet.
