original_text: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.

translated_text: For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:
original_text: For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:

translated_text:
(For we
are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth
are a shadow:)
original_text:
(For we
are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth
are a shadow:)

translated_text:
Shall not they teach thee,
and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?
original_text:
Shall not they teach thee,
and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?

translated_text: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?
original_text: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?

translated_text:
Whilst it
is yet in his greenness,
and not cut down, it withereth before any
other herb.
original_text:
Whilst it
is yet in his greenness,
and not cut down, it withereth before any
other herb.

translated_text:
So
are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite’s hope shall perish:
original_text:
So
are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite’s hope shall perish:

translated_text:
Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust
shall be a spider’s web.
original_text:
Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust
shall be a spider’s web.

translated_text: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.
original_text: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.

translated_text:
He
is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.
original_text:
He
is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.

translated_text:
His roots are wrapped about the heap,
and seeth the place of stones.
original_text:
His roots are wrapped about the heap,
and seeth the place of stones.

translated_text:
If he destroy him from his place, then
it shall deny him,
saying, I have not seen thee.
original_text:
If he destroy him from his place, then
it shall deny him,
saying, I have not seen thee.

translated_text:
Behold, this
is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.
original_text:
Behold, this
is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.

translated_text:
Behold, God will not cast away a perfect
man, neither will he help the evil doers:
original_text:
Behold, God will not cast away a perfect
man, neither will he help the evil doers:

translated_text: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.
original_text: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.

translated_text: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.
original_text: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.

translated_text: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.
original_text: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.

translated_text: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
original_text: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.

translated_text: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
original_text: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.

translated_text:
Deliver the poor and needy: rid
them out of the hand of the wicked.
original_text:
Deliver the poor and needy: rid
them out of the hand of the wicked.

translated_text: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
original_text: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.

translated_text:
I have said, Ye
are gods; and all of you
are children of the most High.
original_text:
I have said, Ye
are gods; and all of you
are children of the most High.

translated_text: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
original_text: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

translated_text: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
original_text: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.

translated_text: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
original_text: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

translated_text: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
original_text: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

translated_text: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
original_text: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

translated_text:
For this
was a statute for Israel,
and a law of the God of Jacob.
original_text:
For this
was a statute for Israel,
and a law of the God of Jacob.

translated_text:
This he ordained in Joseph
for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt:
where I heard a language
that
 I understood not.
original_text:
This he ordained in Joseph
for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt:
where I heard a language
that
 I understood not.

translated_text: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
original_text: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.

translated_text: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
original_text: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

translated_text: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
original_text: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;

translated_text: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
original_text: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.

translated_text:
I
am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
original_text:
I
am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

translated_text: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.
original_text: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.

translated_text:
So I gave them up unto their own hearts’ lust:
and they walked in their own counsels.
original_text:
So I gave them up unto their own hearts’ lust:
and they walked in their own counsels.

translated_text:
Oh that my people had hearkened unto me,
and Israel had walked in my ways!
original_text:
Oh that my people had hearkened unto me,
and Israel had walked in my ways!

translated_text: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
original_text: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

translated_text: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.
original_text: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.

translated_text: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
original_text: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.

translated_text:
How amiable
are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!
original_text:
How amiable
are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!

translated_text: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
original_text: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.

translated_text:
Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young,
even thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.
original_text:
Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young,
even thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.

translated_text:
Blessed
are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
original_text:
Blessed
are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.

translated_text:
Blessed
is the man whose strength
is in thee; in whose heart
are the ways
of them.
original_text:
Blessed
is the man whose strength
is in thee; in whose heart
are the ways
of them.

translated_text: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
original_text: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.

translated_text:
They go from strength to strength,
every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.
original_text:
They go from strength to strength,
every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.

translated_text: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
original_text: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

translated_text: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.
original_text: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.

translated_text:
For a day in thy courts
is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
original_text:
For a day in thy courts
is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

translated_text:
For the LORD God
is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good
thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
original_text:
For the LORD God
is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good
thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

translated_text:
O LORD of hosts, blessed
is the man that trusteth in thee.
original_text:
O LORD of hosts, blessed
is the man that trusteth in thee.

translated_text: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
original_text: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

translated_text: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
original_text: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

translated_text: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
original_text: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.

translated_text:
They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from
being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
original_text:
They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from
being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

translated_text: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
original_text: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:

translated_text: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
original_text: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;

translated_text: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
original_text: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

translated_text: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
original_text: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.

translated_text:
Do unto them as
unto the Midianites; as
to Sisera, as
to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
original_text:
Do unto them as
unto the Midianites; as
to Sisera, as
to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:

translated_text:
Which perished at Endor: they became
as dung for the earth.
original_text:
Which perished at Endor: they became
as dung for the earth.

translated_text: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
original_text: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

translated_text: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
original_text: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

translated_text: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
original_text: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

translated_text: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
original_text: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

translated_text: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
original_text: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

translated_text: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
original_text: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.

translated_text: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
original_text: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

translated_text:
That
men may know that thou, whose name alone
is
 JEHOVAH,
art the most high over all the earth.
original_text:
That
men may know that thou, whose name alone
is
 JEHOVAH,
art the most high over all the earth.

translated_text:
Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest
between the cherubims, shine forth.
original_text:
Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest
between the cherubims, shine forth.

translated_text:
Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come
and save us.
original_text:
Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come
and save us.

translated_text: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
original_text: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

translated_text: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
original_text: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

translated_text: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
original_text: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.

translated_text: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
original_text: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.

translated_text: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
original_text: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

translated_text: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
original_text: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

translated_text:
Thou preparedst
room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
original_text:
Thou preparedst
room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

translated_text:
The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof
were like the goodly cedars.
original_text:
The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof
were like the goodly cedars.

translated_text: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
original_text: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.

translated_text:
Why hast thou
then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
original_text:
Why hast thou
then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

translated_text: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
original_text: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.

translated_text: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
original_text: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;

translated_text:
And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch
that thou madest strong for thyself.
original_text:
And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch
that thou madest strong for thyself.

translated_text:
It is burned with fire,
it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
original_text:
It is burned with fire,
it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

translated_text:
Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man
whom thou madest strong for thyself.
original_text:
Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man
whom thou madest strong for thyself.

translated_text: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
original_text: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

translated_text: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
original_text: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

translated_text: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
original_text: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

translated_text: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
original_text: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

translated_text: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,
original_text: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

translated_text: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
original_text: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

translated_text: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
original_text: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

translated_text:
For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD?
who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?
original_text:
For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD?
who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?

translated_text:
God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all
them that are about him.
original_text:
God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all
them that are about him.

translated_text:
O LORD God of hosts, who
is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
original_text:
O LORD God of hosts, who
is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?

translated_text: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
original_text: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

translated_text: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
original_text: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.

translated_text:
The heavens
are thine, the earth also
is thine:
as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
original_text:
The heavens
are thine, the earth also
is thine:
as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

translated_text: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
original_text: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

translated_text:
Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand,
and high is thy right hand.
original_text:
Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand,
and high is thy right hand.

translated_text:
Justice and judgment
are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
original_text:
Justice and judgment
are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

translated_text:
Blessed
is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.
original_text:
Blessed
is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.

translated_text: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
original_text: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

translated_text:
For thou
art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
original_text:
For thou
art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

translated_text:
For the LORD
is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel
is our king.
original_text:
For the LORD
is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel
is our king.

translated_text:
Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon
one that is mighty; I have exalted
one chosen out of the people.
original_text:
Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon
one that is mighty; I have exalted
one chosen out of the people.

translated_text: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
original_text: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

translated_text: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
original_text: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

translated_text: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
original_text: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

translated_text: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
original_text: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

translated_text:
But my faithfulness and my mercy
shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
original_text:
But my faithfulness and my mercy
shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

translated_text: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
original_text: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

translated_text:
He shall cry unto me, Thou
art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
original_text:
He shall cry unto me, Thou
art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

translated_text:
Also I will make him
my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
original_text:
Also I will make him
my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

translated_text: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
original_text: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

translated_text:
His seed also will I make
to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
original_text:
His seed also will I make
to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

translated_text: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
original_text: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

translated_text: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
original_text: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

translated_text: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
original_text: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

translated_text: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
original_text: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

translated_text: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
original_text: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

translated_text: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
original_text: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.

translated_text: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
original_text: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.

translated_text:
It shall be established for ever as the moon, and
as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
original_text:
It shall be established for ever as the moon, and
as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

translated_text: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
original_text: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

translated_text:
Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown
by casting it to the ground.
original_text:
Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown
by casting it to the ground.

translated_text: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
original_text: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

translated_text: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
original_text: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

translated_text: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
original_text: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

translated_text: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
original_text: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

translated_text: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
original_text: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.

translated_text: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
original_text: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

translated_text: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
original_text: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?

translated_text: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
original_text: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?

translated_text:
What man
is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
original_text:
What man
is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

translated_text:
Lord, where
are thy former lovingkindnesses,
which
 thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
original_text:
Lord, where
are thy former lovingkindnesses,
which
 thou swarest unto David in thy truth?

translated_text: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
original_text: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

translated_text:
Blessed
be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
original_text:
Blessed
be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

translated_text:
Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I
am poor and needy.
original_text:
Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I
am poor and needy.

translated_text:
Preserve my soul; for I
am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
original_text:
Preserve my soul; for I
am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.

translated_text: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.
original_text: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.

translated_text: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
original_text: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

translated_text:
For thou, Lord,
art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
original_text:
For thou, Lord,
art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

translated_text: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
original_text: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

translated_text: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
original_text: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.

translated_text:
Among the gods
there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither
are there any works like unto thy works.
original_text:
Among the gods
there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither
are there any works like unto thy works.

translated_text: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
original_text: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.

translated_text:
For thou
art great, and doest wondrous things: thou
art God alone.
original_text:
For thou
art great, and doest wondrous things: thou
art God alone.

translated_text: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
original_text: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

translated_text: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
original_text: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

translated_text:
For great
is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
original_text:
For great
is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

translated_text:
O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent
men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
original_text:
O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent
men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.

translated_text:
But thou, O Lord,
art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
original_text:
But thou, O Lord,
art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

translated_text: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
original_text: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

translated_text:
Show me a token for good; that they which hate me may see
it,
 and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast helped me, and comforted me.
original_text:
Show me a token for good; that they which hate me may see
it,
 and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast helped me, and comforted me.

translated_text: LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
original_text: LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

translated_text: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
original_text: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

translated_text:
Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned
thyself
 from the fierceness of thine anger.
original_text:
Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned
thyself
 from the fierceness of thine anger.

translated_text: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
original_text: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.

translated_text: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
original_text: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

translated_text: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
original_text: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

translated_text: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.
original_text: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.

translated_text: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
original_text: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

translated_text:
Surely his salvation
is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
original_text:
Surely his salvation
is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

translated_text:
Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed
each other.
original_text:
Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed
each other.

translated_text: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
original_text: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

translated_text:
Yea, the LORD shall give
that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
original_text:
Yea, the LORD shall give
that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.

translated_text:
Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set
us in the way of his steps.
original_text:
Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set
us in the way of his steps.

translated_text:
O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day
and night before thee:
original_text:
O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day
and night before thee:

translated_text: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
original_text: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;

translated_text: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
original_text: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.

translated_text:
I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man
that hath no strength:
original_text:
I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man
that hath no strength:

translated_text: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
original_text: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.

translated_text: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
original_text: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

translated_text:
Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted
me with all thy waves. Selah.
original_text:
Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted
me with all thy waves. Selah.

translated_text:
Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them:
I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
original_text:
Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them:
I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

translated_text: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
original_text: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.

translated_text:
Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise
and
 praise thee? Selah.
original_text:
Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise
and
 praise thee? Selah.

translated_text:
Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave?
or thy faithfulness in destruction?
original_text:
Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave?
or thy faithfulness in destruction?

translated_text: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
original_text: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

translated_text: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
original_text: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.

translated_text:
LORD, why castest thou off my soul?
why hidest thou thy face from me?
original_text:
LORD, why castest thou off my soul?
why hidest thou thy face from me?

translated_text:
I
am afflicted and ready to die from
my youth up:
while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
original_text:
I
am afflicted and ready to die from
my youth up:
while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

translated_text: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
original_text: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.

translated_text: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
original_text: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.

translated_text:
Lover and friend hast thou put far from me,
and mine acquaintance into darkness.
original_text:
Lover and friend hast thou put far from me,
and mine acquaintance into darkness.

translated_text:
His foundation
is in the holy mountains.
original_text:
His foundation
is in the holy mountains.

translated_text: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
original_text: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

translated_text: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
original_text: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

translated_text:
I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this
man was born there.
original_text:
I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this
man was born there.

translated_text:
And of Zion it shall be said, This and
that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
original_text:
And of Zion it shall be said, This and
that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

translated_text: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
original_text: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.

translated_text:
As well the singers as the players on instruments
shall be there:
 all my springs
are in thee.
original_text:
As well the singers as the players on instruments
shall be there:
 all my springs
are in thee.

translated_text:
The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength,
wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
original_text:
The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength,
wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.

translated_text:
Thy throne
is established of old: thou
art from everlasting.
original_text:
Thy throne
is established of old: thou
art from everlasting.

translated_text: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
original_text: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.

translated_text:
The LORD on high
is mightier than the noise of many waters,
yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
original_text:
The LORD on high
is mightier than the noise of many waters,
yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.

translated_text: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.
original_text: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.

translated_text:
It is a good
thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
original_text:
It is a good
thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:

translated_text: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
original_text: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,

translated_text: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
original_text: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.

translated_text: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
original_text: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

translated_text:
O LORD, how great are thy works!
and thy thoughts are very deep.
original_text:
O LORD, how great are thy works!
and thy thoughts are very deep.

translated_text: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
original_text: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.

translated_text:
When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish;
it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:
original_text:
When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish;
it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:

translated_text:
But thou, LORD,
art most high for evermore.
original_text:
But thou, LORD,
art most high for evermore.

translated_text: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
original_text: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

translated_text:
But my horn shalt thou exalt like
the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
original_text:
But my horn shalt thou exalt like
the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

translated_text:
Mine eye also shall see
my desire on mine enemies,
and
 mine ears shall hear
my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
original_text:
Mine eye also shall see
my desire on mine enemies,
and
 mine ears shall hear
my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.

translated_text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
original_text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

translated_text: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.
original_text: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.

translated_text: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
original_text: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;

translated_text:
To shew that the LORD
is upright:
he is my rock, and
there is no unrighteousness in him.
original_text:
To shew that the LORD
is upright:
he is my rock, and
there is no unrighteousness in him.

translated_text: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
original_text: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

translated_text: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
original_text: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

translated_text:
For the LORD
is a great God, and a great King above all gods.
original_text:
For the LORD
is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

translated_text:
In his hand
are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills
is his also.
original_text:
In his hand
are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills
is his also.

translated_text:
The sea
is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry
land.
original_text:
The sea
is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry
land.

translated_text: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
original_text: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

translated_text:
For he
is our God; and we
are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
original_text:
For he
is our God; and we
are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,

translated_text:
Harden not your heart, as in the provocation,
and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
original_text:
Harden not your heart, as in the provocation,
and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

translated_text: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
original_text: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

translated_text:
Forty years long was I grieved with
this generation, and said, It
is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
original_text:
Forty years long was I grieved with
this generation, and said, It
is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:

translated_text: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.
original_text: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.

translated_text: O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
original_text: O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.

translated_text: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
original_text: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

translated_text: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
original_text: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

translated_text:
How long shall they utter
and speak hard things?
and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
original_text:
How long shall they utter
and speak hard things?
and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

translated_text: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.
original_text: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.

translated_text: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
original_text: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

translated_text:
Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard
it.
original_text:
Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard
it.

translated_text:
Understand, ye brutish among the people: and
ye fools, when will ye be wise?
original_text:
Understand, ye brutish among the people: and
ye fools, when will ye be wise?

translated_text: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
original_text: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

translated_text:
He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge,
shall not he know?
original_text:
He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge,
shall not he know?

translated_text:
The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they
are vanity.
original_text:
The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they
are vanity.

translated_text:
Blessed
is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;
original_text:
Blessed
is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;

translated_text: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
original_text: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

translated_text: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
original_text: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

translated_text: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
original_text: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

translated_text:
Who will rise up for me against the evildoers?
or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
original_text:
Who will rise up for me against the evildoers?
or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

translated_text:
Unless the LORD
had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
original_text:
Unless the LORD
had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

translated_text: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
original_text: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.

translated_text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
original_text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

translated_text: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
original_text: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

translated_text: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
original_text: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

translated_text:
But the LORD is my defence; and my God
is the rock of my refuge.
original_text:
But the LORD is my defence; and my God
is the rock of my refuge.

translated_text:
And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness;
yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.
original_text:
And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness;
yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.

translated_text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
original_text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

translated_text:
I will say of the LORD,
He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
original_text:
I will say of the LORD,
He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

translated_text:
Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler,
and
 from the noisome pestilence.
original_text:
Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler,
and
 from the noisome pestilence.

translated_text:
He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth
shall be thy shield and buckler.
original_text:
He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth
shall be thy shield and buckler.

translated_text:
Nor for the pestilence
that walketh in darkness;
nor for the destruction
that wasteth at noonday.
original_text:
Nor for the pestilence
that walketh in darkness;
nor for the destruction
that wasteth at noonday.

translated_text:
A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand;
but it shall not come nigh thee.
original_text:
A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand;
but it shall not come nigh thee.

translated_text: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
original_text: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.

translated_text: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
original_text: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.

translated_text: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
original_text: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

translated_text:
They shall bear thee up in
their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
original_text:
They shall bear thee up in
their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

translated_text: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
original_text: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.

translated_text: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
original_text: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

translated_text:
He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I
will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
original_text:
He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I
will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.

translated_text: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
original_text: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.

translated_text: LORD, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
original_text: LORD, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.

translated_text:
Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou
art
 God.
original_text:
Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou
art
 God.

translated_text: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
original_text: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.

translated_text:
For a thousand years in thy sight
are but as yesterday when it is past, and
as a watch in the night.
original_text:
For a thousand years in thy sight
are but as yesterday when it is past, and
as a watch in the night.

translated_text:
Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are
as a sleep: in the morning
they are like grass
which groweth up.
original_text:
Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are
as a sleep: in the morning
they are like grass
which groweth up.

translated_text: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
original_text: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

translated_text: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
original_text: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.

translated_text:
Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret
sins
 in the light of thy countenance.
original_text:
Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret
sins
 in the light of thy countenance.

translated_text:
For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale
that is told.
original_text:
For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale
that is told.

translated_text:
The days of our years
are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength
they be fourscore years, yet
is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
original_text:
The days of our years
are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength
they be fourscore years, yet
is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

translated_text:
Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear,
so is thy wrath.
original_text:
Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear,
so is thy wrath.

translated_text:
So teach
us to number our days, that we may apply
our
 hearts unto wisdom.
original_text:
So teach
us to number our days, that we may apply
our
 hearts unto wisdom.

translated_text: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
original_text: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

translated_text: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
original_text: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

translated_text:
Make us glad according to the days
wherein thou hast afflicted us,
and the years
wherein we have seen evil.
original_text:
Make us glad according to the days
wherein thou hast afflicted us,
and the years
wherein we have seen evil.

translated_text: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.
original_text: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.

translated_text: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
original_text: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

translated_text:
The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad
thereof.
original_text:
The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad
thereof.

translated_text:
Clouds and darkness
are round about him: righteousness and judgment
are the habitation of his throne.
original_text:
Clouds and darkness
are round about him: righteousness and judgment
are the habitation of his throne.

translated_text: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
original_text: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

translated_text: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
original_text: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

translated_text: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
original_text: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

translated_text: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
original_text: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

translated_text:
Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all
ye gods.
original_text:
Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all
ye gods.

translated_text: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.
original_text: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.

translated_text:
For thou, LORD,
art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.
original_text:
For thou, LORD,
art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

translated_text: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
original_text: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

translated_text: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
original_text: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

translated_text: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
original_text: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

translated_text: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.
original_text: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.

translated_text: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
original_text: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

translated_text: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
original_text: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.

translated_text:
For the LORD
is great, and greatly to be praised: he
is to be feared above all gods.
original_text:
For the LORD
is great, and greatly to be praised: he
is to be feared above all gods.

translated_text:
For all the gods of the nations
are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
original_text:
For all the gods of the nations
are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.

translated_text:
Honour and majesty
are before him: strength and beauty
are in his sanctuary.
original_text:
Honour and majesty
are before him: strength and beauty
are in his sanctuary.

translated_text: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
original_text: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

translated_text:
Give unto the LORD the glory
due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
original_text:
Give unto the LORD the glory
due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.

translated_text: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
original_text: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.

translated_text:
Say among the heathen
that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
original_text:
Say among the heathen
that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.

translated_text: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
original_text: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.

translated_text:
Let the field be joyful, and all that
is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
original_text:
Let the field be joyful, and all that
is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

translated_text: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
original_text: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.

translated_text:
The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth
between
 the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
original_text:
The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth
between
 the cherubims; let the earth be moved.

translated_text:
The LORD
is great in Zion; and he
is high above all the people.
original_text:
The LORD
is great in Zion; and he
is high above all the people.

translated_text:
Let them praise thy great and terrible name;
for it
is
 holy.
original_text:
Let them praise thy great and terrible name;
for it
is
 holy.

translated_text: The king’s strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
original_text: The king’s strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

translated_text:
Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool;
for
 he
is holy.
original_text:
Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool;
for
 he
is holy.

translated_text: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.
original_text: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.

translated_text:
He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance
that he gave them.
original_text:
He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance
that he gave them.

translated_text: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
original_text: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.

translated_text:
Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God
is holy.
original_text:
Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God
is holy.

translated_text: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
original_text: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.

translated_text: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
original_text: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.

translated_text: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
original_text: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

translated_text: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
original_text: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

translated_text: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
original_text: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

translated_text: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.
original_text: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.

translated_text: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
original_text: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

translated_text:
Let the floods clap
their hands: let the hills be joyful together
original_text:
Let the floods clap
their hands: let the hills be joyful together

translated_text: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
original_text: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.

translated_text: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
original_text: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.

translated_text: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
original_text: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

translated_text: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
original_text: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

translated_text: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
original_text: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

translated_text:
That thy beloved may be delivered; save
with thy right hand, and hear me.
original_text:
That thy beloved may be delivered; save
with thy right hand, and hear me.

translated_text: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
original_text: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

translated_text:
Gilead
is mine, and Manasseh
is mine; Ephraim also
is the strength of mine head; Judah
is my lawgiver;
original_text:
Gilead
is mine, and Manasseh
is mine; Ephraim also
is the strength of mine head; Judah
is my lawgiver;

translated_text:
Moab
is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
original_text:
Moab
is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.

translated_text:
Who will bring me
into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
original_text:
Who will bring me
into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

translated_text:
Wilt not thou, O God,
which hadst cast us off? and
thou, O God,
which didst not go out with our armies?
original_text:
Wilt not thou, O God,
which hadst cast us off? and
thou, O God,
which didst not go out with our armies?

translated_text:
Give us help from trouble: for vain
is the help of man.
original_text:
Give us help from trouble: for vain
is the help of man.

translated_text:
Through God we shall do valiantly: for he
it is that shall tread down our enemies.
original_text:
Through God we shall do valiantly: for he
it is that shall tread down our enemies.

translated_text:
Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him
cometh my salvation.
original_text:
Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him
cometh my salvation.

translated_text:
How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall
shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.
original_text:
How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall
shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.

translated_text:
They only consult to cast
him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
original_text:
They only consult to cast
him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

translated_text:
My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation
is from him.
original_text:
My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation
is from him.

translated_text:
He only
is my rock and my salvation:
he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
original_text:
He only
is my rock and my salvation:
he is my defence; I shall not be moved.

translated_text:
In God
is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength,
and my refuge,
is in God.
original_text:
In God
is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength,
and my refuge,
is in God.

translated_text:
Surely men of low degree
are vanity,
and men of high degree
are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they
are
 altogether
lighter than vanity.
original_text:
Surely men of low degree
are vanity,
and men of high degree
are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they
are
 altogether
lighter than vanity.

translated_text:
Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart
upon them.
original_text:
Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart
upon them.

translated_text:
God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power
belongeth
 unto God.
original_text:
God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power
belongeth
 unto God.

translated_text:
Also unto thee, O Lord,
belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
original_text:
Also unto thee, O Lord,
belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.

translated_text: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
original_text: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.

translated_text:
From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock
that is higher than I.
original_text:
From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock
that is higher than I.

translated_text:
For thou hast been a shelter for me,
and a strong tower from the enemy.
original_text:
For thou hast been a shelter for me,
and a strong tower from the enemy.

translated_text: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
original_text: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

translated_text:
For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given
me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
original_text:
For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given
me the heritage of those that fear thy name.

translated_text:
Thou wilt prolong the king’s life:
and his years as many generations.
original_text:
Thou wilt prolong the king’s life:
and his years as many generations.

translated_text:
He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth,
which may preserve him.
original_text:
He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth,
which may preserve him.

translated_text: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
original_text: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

translated_text: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
original_text: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.

translated_text:
As smoke is driven away,
so drive
them away: as wax melteth before the fire,
so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
original_text:
As smoke is driven away,
so drive
them away: as wax melteth before the fire,
so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

translated_text: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
original_text: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.

translated_text: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.
original_text: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.

translated_text:
A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows,
is
 God in his holy habitation.
original_text:
A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows,
is
 God in his holy habitation.

translated_text:
God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry
land.
original_text:
God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry
land.

translated_text: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:
original_text: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:

translated_text:
The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God:
even Sinai itself
was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
original_text:
The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God:
even Sinai itself
was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

translated_text: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
original_text: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.

translated_text: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
original_text: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.

translated_text:
The Lord gave the word: great
was the company of those that published
it.
original_text:
The Lord gave the word: great
was the company of those that published
it.

translated_text: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
original_text: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.

translated_text:
Though ye have lien among the pots,
yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
original_text:
Though ye have lien among the pots,
yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

translated_text:
When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was
white as snow in Salmon.
original_text:
When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was
white as snow in Salmon.

translated_text:
The hill of God
is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill
as the hill of Bashan.
original_text:
The hill of God
is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill
as the hill of Bashan.

translated_text:
Why leap ye, ye high hills?
this is the hill
which
 God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell
in it
 for ever.
original_text:
Why leap ye, ye high hills?
this is the hill
which
 God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell
in it
 for ever.

translated_text:
The chariots of God
are twenty thousand,
even thousands of angels: the Lord
is among them,
as in Sinai, in the holy
place.
original_text:
The chariots of God
are twenty thousand,
even thousands of angels: the Lord
is among them,
as in Sinai, in the holy
place.

translated_text:
Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea,
for the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell
among them.
original_text:
Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea,
for the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell
among them.

translated_text:
Blessed
be the Lord,
who daily loadeth us
with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
original_text:
Blessed
be the Lord,
who daily loadeth us
with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.

translated_text:
He that is our God
is the God of salvation; and unto God the Lord
belong the issues from death.
original_text:
He that is our God
is the God of salvation; and unto God the Lord
belong the issues from death.

translated_text:
But God shall wound the head of his enemies,
and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
original_text:
But God shall wound the head of his enemies,
and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.

translated_text:
