original_text:
I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law
is within my heart.

translated_text: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.
original_text: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.

translated_text: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
original_text: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

translated_text: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
original_text: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

translated_text: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.
original_text: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.

translated_text: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.
original_text: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.

translated_text: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
original_text: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

translated_text: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
original_text: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

translated_text: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.
original_text: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.

translated_text:
But I
am poor and needy;
yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou
art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
original_text:
But I
am poor and needy;
yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou
art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

translated_text:
God
is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
original_text:
God
is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

translated_text: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
original_text: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;

translated_text:
Though the waters thereof roar
and be troubled,
though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
original_text:
Though the waters thereof roar
and be troubled,
though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

translated_text:
There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy
place of the tabernacles of the most High.
original_text:
There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy
place of the tabernacles of the most High.

translated_text:
God
is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her,
and that right early.
original_text:
God
is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her,
and that right early.

translated_text: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
original_text: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

translated_text:
The LORD of hosts
is with us; the God of Jacob
is
 our refuge. Selah.
original_text:
The LORD of hosts
is with us; the God of Jacob
is
 our refuge. Selah.

translated_text: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
original_text: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.

translated_text: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
original_text: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.

translated_text:
Be still, and know that I
am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
original_text:
Be still, and know that I
am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

translated_text:
The LORD of hosts
is with us; the God of Jacob
is
 our refuge. Selah.
original_text:
The LORD of hosts
is with us; the God of Jacob
is
 our refuge. Selah.

translated_text:
My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue
is the pen of a ready writer.
original_text:
My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue
is the pen of a ready writer.

translated_text: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
original_text: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

translated_text:
Gird thy sword upon
thy thigh, O
most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.
original_text:
Gird thy sword upon
thy thigh, O
most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

translated_text:
And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness
and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
original_text:
And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness
and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

translated_text:
Thy throne, O God,
is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom
is a right sceptre.
original_text:
Thy throne, O God,
is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom
is a right sceptre.

translated_text: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
original_text: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

translated_text:
All thy garments
smell of myrrh, and aloes,
and
 cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.
original_text:
All thy garments
smell of myrrh, and aloes,
and
 cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

translated_text:
Kings’ daughters
were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
original_text:
Kings’ daughters
were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

translated_text: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house;
original_text: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house;

translated_text:
So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he
is thy Lord; and worship thou him.
original_text:
So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he
is thy Lord; and worship thou him.

translated_text:
The king’s daughter
is all glorious within: her clothing
is of wrought gold.
original_text:
The king’s daughter
is all glorious within: her clothing
is of wrought gold.

translated_text: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.
original_text: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.

translated_text: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king’s palace.
original_text: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king’s palace.

translated_text: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
original_text: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

translated_text: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.
original_text: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

translated_text:
Great
is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God,
in the mountain of his holiness.
original_text:
Great
is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God,
in the mountain of his holiness.

translated_text:
Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth,
is mount Zion,
on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
original_text:
Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth,
is mount Zion,
on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

translated_text: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
original_text: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.

translated_text: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
original_text: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.

translated_text:
They saw
it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled,
and hasted away.
original_text:
They saw
it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled,
and hasted away.

translated_text:
Fear took hold upon them there,
and pain, as of a woman in travail.
original_text:
Fear took hold upon them there,
and pain, as of a woman in travail.

translated_text: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
original_text: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

translated_text: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.
original_text: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.

translated_text: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.
original_text: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

translated_text:
According to thy name, O God, so
is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
original_text:
According to thy name, O God, so
is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

translated_text: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.
original_text: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

translated_text: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
original_text: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

translated_text:
Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell
it to the generation following.
original_text:
Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell
it to the generation following.

translated_text:
For this God
is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide
even unto death.
original_text:
For this God
is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide
even unto death.

translated_text: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
original_text: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

translated_text: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
original_text: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.

translated_text: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
original_text: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

translated_text: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
original_text: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

translated_text: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
original_text: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

translated_text:
For God
is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.
original_text:
For God
is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.

translated_text: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
original_text: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.

translated_text:
The princes of the people are gathered together,
even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth
belong
 unto God: he is greatly exalted.
original_text:
The princes of the people are gathered together,
even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth
belong
 unto God: he is greatly exalted.

translated_text: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
original_text: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

translated_text: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?
original_text: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

translated_text:
My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where
is thy God?
original_text:
My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where
is thy God?

translated_text:
When I remember these
things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.
original_text:
When I remember these
things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

translated_text:
Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why
art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him
for the help of his countenance.
original_text:
Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why
art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him
for the help of his countenance.

translated_text: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
original_text: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.

translated_text: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
original_text: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

translated_text:
Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song
shall be with me,
and my prayer unto the God of my life.
original_text:
Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song
shall be with me,
and my prayer unto the God of my life.

translated_text: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
original_text: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

translated_text:
As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where
is thy God?
original_text:
As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where
is thy God?

translated_text:
Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him,
who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
original_text:
Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him,
who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

translated_text:
Blessed
is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.
original_text:
Blessed
is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.

translated_text:
The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive;
and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
original_text:
The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive;
and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.

translated_text: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
original_text: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

translated_text: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
original_text: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

translated_text: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
original_text: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

translated_text:
And if he come to see
me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself;
when he goeth abroad, he telleth
it.
original_text:
And if he come to see
me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself;
when he goeth abroad, he telleth
it.

translated_text: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
original_text: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

translated_text:
An evil disease,
say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and
now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
original_text:
An evil disease,
say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and
now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

translated_text:
Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up
his heel against me.
original_text:
Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up
his heel against me.

translated_text: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
original_text: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

translated_text: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
original_text: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

translated_text: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.
original_text: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

translated_text:
Blessed
be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
original_text:
Blessed
be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

translated_text:
We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us,
what
 work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
original_text:
We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us,
what
 work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.

translated_text:
How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them;
how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
original_text:
How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them;
how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

translated_text: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.
original_text: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

translated_text: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
original_text: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

translated_text: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
original_text: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

translated_text: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
original_text: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

translated_text: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.
original_text: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

translated_text: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
original_text: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.

translated_text: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.
original_text: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

translated_text: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
original_text: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

translated_text:
Thou hast given us like sheep
appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
original_text:
Thou hast given us like sheep
appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.

translated_text:
Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase
thy wealth by their price.
original_text:
Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase
thy wealth by their price.

translated_text: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
original_text: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

translated_text: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
original_text: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

translated_text:
My confusion
is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
original_text:
My confusion
is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

translated_text: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
original_text: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

translated_text: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
original_text: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

translated_text: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
original_text: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;

translated_text: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
original_text: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

translated_text: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
original_text: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

translated_text: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
original_text: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

translated_text: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
original_text: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

translated_text:
Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast
us not off for ever.
original_text:
Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast
us not off for ever.

translated_text:
Wherefore hidest thou thy face,
and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
original_text:
Wherefore hidest thou thy face,
and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

translated_text: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
original_text: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

translated_text: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies’ sake.
original_text: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies’ sake.

translated_text: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
original_text: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

translated_text:
For thou
art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
original_text:
For thou
art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

translated_text: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.
original_text: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

translated_text: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.
original_text: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.

translated_text:
Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him,
who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
original_text:
Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him,
who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

translated_text: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
original_text: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

translated_text: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
original_text: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

translated_text:
For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin
is ever before me.
original_text:
For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin
is ever before me.

translated_text:
Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done
this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest,
and
 be clear when thou judgest.
original_text:
Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done
this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest,
and
 be clear when thou judgest.

translated_text: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
original_text: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.

translated_text:
Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden
part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.
original_text:
Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden
part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.

translated_text: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
original_text: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

translated_text:
Make me to hear joy and gladness;
that the bones
which
 thou hast broken may rejoice.
original_text:
Make me to hear joy and gladness;
that the bones
which
 thou hast broken may rejoice.

translated_text: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
original_text: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

translated_text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
original_text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

translated_text: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
original_text: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.

translated_text:
Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me
with thy
 free spirit.
original_text:
Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me
with thy
 free spirit.

translated_text: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.
original_text: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.

translated_text:
Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation:
and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
original_text:
Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation:
and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

translated_text: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.
original_text: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.

translated_text:
For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give
it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.
original_text:
For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give
it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.

translated_text:
The sacrifices of God
are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
original_text:
The sacrifices of God
are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

translated_text: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
original_text: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

translated_text: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
original_text: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.

translated_text:
The mighty God,
even the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
original_text:
The mighty God,
even the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

translated_text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.
original_text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.

translated_text: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
original_text: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

translated_text: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.
original_text: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

translated_text: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
original_text: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

translated_text:
And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God
is
 judge himself. Selah.
original_text:
And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God
is
 judge himself. Selah.

translated_text:
Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I
am God,
even thy God.
original_text:
Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I
am God,
even thy God.

translated_text:
I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings,
to have been continually before me.
original_text:
I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings,
to have been continually before me.

translated_text:
I will take no bullock out of thy house,
nor he goats out of thy folds.
original_text:
I will take no bullock out of thy house,
nor he goats out of thy folds.

translated_text:
For every beast of the forest
is mine,
and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
original_text:
For every beast of the forest
is mine,
and the cattle upon a thousand hills.

translated_text:
I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field
are mine.
original_text:
I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field
are mine.

translated_text:
If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world
is
 mine, and the fulness thereof.
original_text:
If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world
is
 mine, and the fulness thereof.

translated_text: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
original_text: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

translated_text: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:
original_text: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

translated_text: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
original_text: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

translated_text:
But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or
that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?
original_text:
But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or
that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?

translated_text: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.
original_text: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.

translated_text: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.
original_text: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.

translated_text: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.
original_text: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.

translated_text:
Thou sittest
and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.
original_text:
Thou sittest
and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.

translated_text:
These
things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether
such an one as thyself:
but
 I will reprove thee, and set
them in order before thine eyes.
original_text:
These
things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether
such an one as thyself:
but
 I will reprove thee, and set
them in order before thine eyes.

translated_text:
Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear
you in pieces, and
there be none to deliver.
original_text:
Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear
you in pieces, and
there be none to deliver.

translated_text:
Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth
his conversation
aright will I shew the salvation of God.
original_text:
Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth
his conversation
aright will I shew the salvation of God.

translated_text:
Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until
these
 calamities be overpast.
original_text:
Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until
these
 calamities be overpast.

translated_text:
I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth
all things
 for me.
original_text:
I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth
all things
 for me.

translated_text:
He shall send from heaven, and save
from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
original_text:
He shall send from heaven, and save
from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.

translated_text:
My soul
is among lions:
and I lie
even among
 them that are set on fire,
even the sons of men, whose teeth
are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
original_text:
My soul
is among lions:
and I lie
even among
 them that are set on fire,
even the sons of men, whose teeth
are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

translated_text:
They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen
themselves.
 Selah.
original_text:
They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen
themselves.
 Selah.

translated_text: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
original_text: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.

translated_text:
Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I
myself will awake early.
original_text:
Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I
myself will awake early.

translated_text: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
original_text: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.

translated_text: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
original_text: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.

translated_text:
Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens:
let thy glory
be above all the earth.
original_text:
Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens:
let thy glory
be above all the earth.

translated_text: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
original_text: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.

translated_text:
Mine enemies would daily swallow
me up: for
they be
 many that fight against me, O thou most High.
original_text:
Mine enemies would daily swallow
me up: for
they be
 many that fight against me, O thou most High.

translated_text: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
original_text: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

translated_text: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
original_text: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.

translated_text:
Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts
are against me for evil.
original_text:
Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts
are against me for evil.

translated_text: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
original_text: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.

translated_text:
Shall they escape by iniquity? in
thine anger cast down the people, O God.
original_text:
Shall they escape by iniquity? in
thine anger cast down the people, O God.

translated_text:
Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle:
are they not in thy book?
original_text:
Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle:
are they not in thy book?

translated_text:
When I cry
unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God
is for me.
original_text:
When I cry
unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God
is for me.

translated_text:
In God will I praise
his word: in the LORD will I praise
his word.
original_text:
In God will I praise
his word: in the LORD will I praise
his word.

translated_text: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
original_text: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.

translated_text:
Thy vows
are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.
original_text:
Thy vows
are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.

translated_text:
For thou hast delivered my soul from death:
wilt not
thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
original_text:
For thou hast delivered my soul from death:
wilt not
thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?

translated_text: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.
original_text: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.

translated_text: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
original_text: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

translated_text:
For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not
for my transgression, nor
for my sin, O LORD.
original_text:
For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not
for my transgression, nor
for my sin, O LORD.

translated_text:
They run and prepare themselves without
my fault: awake to help me, and behold.
original_text:
They run and prepare themselves without
my fault: awake to help me, and behold.

translated_text: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
original_text: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

translated_text: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
original_text: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

translated_text:
Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords
are in their lips: for who,
say they, doth hear?
original_text:
Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords
are in their lips: for who,
say they, doth hear?

translated_text: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.
original_text: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.

translated_text:
Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God
is my defence.
original_text:
Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God
is my defence.

translated_text:
The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see
my desire upon mine enemies.
original_text:
The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see
my desire upon mine enemies.

translated_text: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
original_text: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

translated_text:
For the sin of their mouth
and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying
which they speak.
original_text:
For the sin of their mouth
and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying
which they speak.

translated_text:
Consume
them in wrath, consume
them, that they
may not
be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
original_text:
Consume
them in wrath, consume
them, that they
may not
be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

translated_text:
And at evening let them return;
and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
original_text:
And at evening let them return;
and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

translated_text: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
original_text: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

translated_text: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
original_text: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

translated_text:
Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God
is my defence,
and the God of my mercy.
original_text:
Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God
is my defence,
and the God of my mercy.

translated_text: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
original_text: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

translated_text: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
original_text: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

translated_text: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
original_text: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.

translated_text:
Their poison
is like the poison of a serpent:
they are
 like the deaf adder
that stoppeth her ear;
original_text:
Their poison
is like the poison of a serpent:
they are
 like the deaf adder
that stoppeth her ear;

translated_text: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
original_text: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

translated_text: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
original_text: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.

translated_text:
Let them melt away as waters
which run continually:
when
 he bendeth
his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
original_text:
Let them melt away as waters
which run continually:
when
 he bendeth
his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

translated_text:
As a snail
which melteth, let
every one of them
 pass away:
like the untimely birth of a woman,
that
 they may not see the sun.
original_text:
As a snail
which melteth, let
every one of them
 pass away:
like the untimely birth of a woman,
that
 they may not see the sun.

translated_text:
Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in
his wrath.
original_text:
Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in
his wrath.

translated_text: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
original_text: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

translated_text:
So that a man shall say, Verily
there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.
original_text:
So that a man shall say, Verily
there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.

translated_text:
The fool hath said in his heart,
There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity:
there is none that doeth good.
original_text:
The fool hath said in his heart,
There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity:
there is none that doeth good.

translated_text:
God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were
any that did understand, that did seek God.
original_text:
God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were
any that did understand, that did seek God.

translated_text:
Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy;
there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
original_text:
Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy;
there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

translated_text:
Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people
as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.
original_text:
Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people
as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.

translated_text:
There were they in great fear,
where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth
against thee: thou hast put
them to shame, because God hath despised them.
original_text:
There were they in great fear,
where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth
against thee: thou hast put
them to shame, because God hath despised them.

translated_text:
Oh that the salvation of Israel
were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice,
and
 Israel shall be glad.
original_text:
Oh that the salvation of Israel
were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice,
and
 Israel shall be glad.

translated_text:
Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God
endureth
continually.
original_text:
Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God
endureth
continually.

translated_text: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp rasor, working deceitfully.
original_text: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp rasor, working deceitfully.

translated_text:
Thou lovest evil more than good;
and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
original_text:
Thou lovest evil more than good;
and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.

translated_text:
Thou lovest all devouring words, O
thou deceitful tongue.
original_text:
Thou lovest all devouring words, O
thou deceitful tongue.

translated_text:
God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of
thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.
original_text:
God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of
thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.

translated_text: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
original_text: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:

translated_text:
Lo,
this is the man
that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches,
and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
original_text:
Lo,
this is the man
that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches,
and strengthened himself in his wickedness.

translated_text:
But I
am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.
original_text:
But I
am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.

translated_text:
I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done
it: and I will wait on thy name; for
it is good before thy saints.
original_text:
I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done
it: and I will wait on thy name; for
it is good before thy saints.

translated_text: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
original_text: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

translated_text: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
original_text: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

translated_text: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
original_text: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

translated_text: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
original_text: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

translated_text: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
original_text: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

translated_text:
And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove!
for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
original_text:
And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove!
for then would I fly away, and be at rest.

translated_text:
Lo,
then would I wander far off,
and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
original_text:
Lo,
then would I wander far off,
and remain in the wilderness. Selah.

translated_text:
I would hasten my escape from the windy storm
and tempest.
original_text:
I would hasten my escape from the windy storm
and tempest.

translated_text:
Destroy, O Lord,
and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
original_text:
Destroy, O Lord,
and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

translated_text:
Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow
are in the midst of it.
original_text:
Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow
are in the midst of it.

translated_text:
Wickedness
is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
original_text:
Wickedness
is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

translated_text:
For
it was not an enemy
that reproached me; then I could have borne
it: neither
was it he that hated me
that did magnify
himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
original_text:
For
it was not an enemy
that reproached me; then I could have borne
it: neither
was it he that hated me
that did magnify
himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

translated_text:
But
it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
original_text:
But
it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.

translated_text:
We took sweet counsel together,
and walked unto the house of God in company.
original_text:
We took sweet counsel together,
and walked unto the house of God in company.

translated_text:
Let death seize upon them,
and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings,
and among them.
original_text:
Let death seize upon them,
and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings,
and among them.

translated_text: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.
original_text: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.

translated_text: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
original_text: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

translated_text:
He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle
that was
 against me: for there were many with me.
original_text:
He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle
that was
 against me: for there were many with me.

translated_text: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.
original_text: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.

translated_text: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
original_text: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

translated_text:
The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war
was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet
were
 they drawn swords.
original_text:
The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war
was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet
were
 they drawn swords.

translated_text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
original_text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

translated_text: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
original_text: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

translated_text: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.
original_text: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.

translated_text: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
original_text: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

translated_text: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.
original_text: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.

translated_text:
Behold, God
is mine helper: the Lord
is with them that uphold my soul.
original_text:
Behold, God
is mine helper: the Lord
is with them that uphold my soul.

translated_text: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
original_text: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.

translated_text:
I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for
it is good.
original_text:
I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for
it is good.

translated_text:
For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen
his desire upon mine enemies.
original_text:
For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen
his desire upon mine enemies.

translated_text:
Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest,
if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
original_text:
Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest,
if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

translated_text: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
original_text: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

translated_text:
Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief
is in their hearts.
original_text:
Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief
is in their hearts.

translated_text: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
original_text: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

translated_text: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
original_text: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

translated_text:
Blessed
be the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
original_text:
Blessed
be the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

translated_text:
The LORD
is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
original_text:
The LORD
is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

translated_text:
The LORD
is their strength, and he
is the saving strength of his anointed.
original_text:
The LORD
is their strength, and he
is the saving strength of his anointed.

translated_text: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
original_text: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

translated_text:
The LORD
is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD
is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
original_text:
The LORD
is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD
is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

translated_text:
When the wicked,
even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
original_text:
When the wicked,
even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

translated_text:
Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this
will I
be confident.
original_text:
Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this
will I
be confident.

translated_text:
One
thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.
original_text:
One
thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.

translated_text: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.
original_text: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

translated_text: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.
original_text: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.

translated_text:
Hear, O LORD,
when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
original_text:
Hear, O LORD,
when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

translated_text: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.
original_text: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.

translated_text:
Hide not thy face
far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
original_text:
Hide not thy face
far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

translated_text: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
original_text: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

translated_text: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.
original_text: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.

translated_text: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
original_text: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

translated_text: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
original_text: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

translated_text: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
original_text: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

translated_text: Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
original_text: Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

translated_text: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
original_text: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

translated_text:
The voice of the LORD
is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD
is upon many waters.
original_text:
The voice of the LORD
is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD
is upon many waters.

translated_text:
The voice of the LORD
is powerful; the voice of the LORD
is full of majesty.
original_text:
The voice of the LORD
is powerful; the voice of the LORD
is full of majesty.

translated_text: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
original_text: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

translated_text: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
original_text: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

translated_text: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.
original_text: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.

translated_text: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
original_text: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

translated_text:
The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of
his glory.
original_text:
The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of
his glory.

translated_text: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.
original_text: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.

translated_text: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
original_text: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.

translated_text:
The earth
is the LORD’S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
original_text:
The earth
is the LORD’S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

translated_text: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
original_text: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

translated_text: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?
original_text: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?

translated_text: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
original_text: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

translated_text: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
original_text: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

translated_text:
This
is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.
original_text:
This
is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

translated_text: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
original_text: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

translated_text:
Who
is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
original_text:
Who
is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

translated_text:
Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift
them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
original_text:
Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift
them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

translated_text:
Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he
is the King of glory. Selah.
original_text:
Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he
is the King of glory. Selah.

translated_text:
The LORD
is my shepherd; I shall not want.
original_text:
The LORD
is my shepherd; I shall not want.

translated_text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
original_text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

translated_text: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
original_text: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

translated_text:
Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou
art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
original_text:
Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou
art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

translated_text: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
original_text: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

translated_text: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
original_text: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

translated_text:
Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD;
therefore I shall not slide.
original_text:
Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD;
therefore I shall not slide.

translated_text: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
original_text: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

translated_text:
For thy lovingkindness
is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.
original_text:
For thy lovingkindness
is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

translated_text: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
original_text: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

translated_text: I have hated the congregation of evildoers; and will not sit with the wicked.
original_text: I have hated the congregation of evildoers; and will not sit with the wicked.

translated_text: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:
original_text: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:

translated_text: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.
original_text: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

translated_text: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
original_text: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.

translated_text: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:
original_text: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

translated_text:
In whose hands
is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
original_text:
In whose hands
is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

translated_text: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
original_text: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

translated_text: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.
original_text: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.

translated_text: Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.
original_text: Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.

translated_text: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
original_text: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

translated_text: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
original_text: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

translated_text: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.
original_text: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.

translated_text:
Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou
art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
original_text:
Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou
art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

translated_text:
Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they
have been ever of old.
original_text:
Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they
have been ever of old.

translated_text: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness’ sake, O LORD.
original_text: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness’ sake, O LORD.

translated_text:
Good and upright
is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
original_text:
Good and upright
is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

translated_text: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
original_text: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

translated_text:
All the paths of the LORD
are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
original_text:
All the paths of the LORD
are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

translated_text:
For thy name’s sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it
is
 great.
original_text:
For thy name’s sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it
is
 great.

translated_text:
What man
is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way
that he shall choose.
original_text:
What man
is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way
that he shall choose.

translated_text: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
original_text: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

translated_text:
The secret of the LORD
is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
original_text:
The secret of the LORD
is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.

translated_text:
Mine eyes
are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
original_text:
Mine eyes
are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

translated_text:
Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I
am desolate and afflicted.
original_text:
Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I
am desolate and afflicted.

translated_text:
The troubles of my heart are enlarged:
O bring thou me out of my distresses.
original_text:
The troubles of my heart are enlarged:
O bring thou me out of my distresses.

translated_text: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
original_text: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

translated_text: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
original_text: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.

translated_text: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.
original_text: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

translated_text: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
original_text: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

translated_text: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
original_text: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

translated_text: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
original_text: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

translated_text: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;
original_text: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

translated_text: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
original_text: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

translated_text: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
original_text: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

translated_text:
We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up
our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.
original_text:
We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up
our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

translated_text: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
original_text: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

translated_text:
Some
trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
original_text:
Some
trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

translated_text: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
original_text: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

translated_text: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.
original_text: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.

translated_text:
My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
why art thou so
 far from helping me,
and from the words of my roaring?
original_text:
My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
why art thou so
 far from helping me,
and from the words of my roaring?

translated_text: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
original_text: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

translated_text:
But thou
art holy,
O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
original_text:
But thou
art holy,
O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

translated_text: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
original_text: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

translated_text: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.
original_text: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

translated_text:
But I
am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
original_text:
But I
am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

translated_text:
All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head
saying,
original_text:
All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head
saying,

translated_text:
He trusted on the LORD
that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
original_text:
He trusted on the LORD
that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.

translated_text:
But thou
art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope
