when I was upon my mother’s breasts.
original_text:
But thou
art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope
when I was upon my mother’s breasts.

translated_text:
I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou
art my God from my mother’s belly.
original_text:
I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou
art my God from my mother’s belly.

translated_text:
Be not far from me; for trouble
is near; for
there is
 none to help.
original_text:
Be not far from me; for trouble
is near; for
there is
 none to help.

translated_text:
Many bulls have compassed me: strong
bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
original_text:
Many bulls have compassed me: strong
bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

translated_text:
They gaped upon me
with their mouths,
as a ravening and a roaring lion.
original_text:
They gaped upon me
with their mouths,
as a ravening and a roaring lion.

translated_text: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
original_text: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

translated_text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
original_text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

translated_text: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
original_text: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

translated_text:
I may tell all my bones: they look
and stare upon me.
original_text:
I may tell all my bones: they look
and stare upon me.

translated_text: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
original_text: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

translated_text: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.
original_text: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.

translated_text: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.
original_text: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.

translated_text: Save me from the lion’s mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
original_text: Save me from the lion’s mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.

translated_text: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.
original_text: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

translated_text: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.
original_text: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.

translated_text: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
original_text: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.

translated_text:
My praise
shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
original_text:
My praise
shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

translated_text: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
original_text: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

translated_text: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
original_text: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

translated_text:
For the kingdom
is the LORD’S: and he
is the governor among the nations.
original_text:
For the kingdom
is the LORD’S: and he
is the governor among the nations.

translated_text:
All
they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
original_text:
All
they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

translated_text: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.
original_text: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

translated_text:
They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done
this.
original_text:
They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done
this.

translated_text: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
original_text: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

translated_text: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
original_text: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

translated_text: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
original_text: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

translated_text:
He asked life of thee,
and thou gavest
it him,
even length of days for ever and ever.
original_text:
He asked life of thee,
and thou gavest
it him,
even length of days for ever and ever.

translated_text:
His glory
is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
original_text:
His glory
is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

translated_text: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
original_text: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.

translated_text: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
original_text: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

translated_text: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
original_text: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

translated_text: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
original_text: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

translated_text: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
original_text: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

translated_text:
For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device,
which they are not able
to perform.
original_text:
For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device,
which they are not able
to perform.

translated_text:
Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back,
when thou shalt make ready
thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.
original_text:
Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back,
when thou shalt make ready
thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.

translated_text:
Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength:
so will we sing and praise thy power.
original_text:
Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength:
so will we sing and praise thy power.

translated_text: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
original_text: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.

translated_text:
I was dumb with silence, I held my peace,
even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
original_text:
I was dumb with silence, I held my peace,
even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

translated_text:
My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned:
then spake I with my tongue,
original_text:
My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned:
then spake I with my tongue,

translated_text:
LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it
is; that I may know how frail I
am.
original_text:
LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it
is; that I may know how frail I
am.

translated_text:
Behold, thou hast made my days
as an handbreadth; and mine age
is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state
is altogether vanity. Selah.
original_text:
Behold, thou hast made my days
as an handbreadth; and mine age
is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state
is altogether vanity. Selah.

translated_text:
Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up
riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.
original_text:
Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up
riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

translated_text:
And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope
is in thee.
original_text:
And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope
is in thee.

translated_text: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
original_text: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

translated_text:
I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst
it.
original_text:
I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst
it.

translated_text: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.
original_text: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.

translated_text:
When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man
is vanity. Selah.
original_text:
When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man
is vanity. Selah.

translated_text:
Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I
am a stranger with thee,
and a sojourner, as all my fathers
were.
original_text:
Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I
am a stranger with thee,
and a sojourner, as all my fathers
were.

translated_text: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
original_text: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

translated_text: O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
original_text: O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

translated_text: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
original_text: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

translated_text:
There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither
is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
original_text:
There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither
is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.

translated_text: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
original_text: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

translated_text:
My wounds stink
and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
original_text:
My wounds stink
and are corrupt because of my foolishness.

translated_text: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
original_text: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

translated_text:
For my loins are filled with a loathsome
disease: and
there is no soundness in my flesh.
original_text:
For my loins are filled with a loathsome
disease: and
there is no soundness in my flesh.

translated_text: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
original_text: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

translated_text:
Lord, all my desire
is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
original_text:
Lord, all my desire
is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

translated_text: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
original_text: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

translated_text: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
original_text: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

translated_text:
They also that seek after my life lay snares
for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
original_text:
They also that seek after my life lay snares
for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

translated_text:
But I, as a deaf
man, heard not; and
I was as a dumb man
that openeth not his mouth.
original_text:
But I, as a deaf
man, heard not; and
I was as a dumb man
that openeth not his mouth.

translated_text:
Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth
are
 no reproofs.
original_text:
Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth
are
 no reproofs.

translated_text: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
original_text: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

translated_text:
For I said,
Hear me, lest
otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify
themselves
 against me.
original_text:
For I said,
Hear me, lest
otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify
themselves
 against me.

translated_text:
For I
am ready to halt, and my sorrow
is continually before me.
original_text:
For I
am ready to halt, and my sorrow
is continually before me.

translated_text: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
original_text: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

translated_text:
But mine enemies
are lively,
and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
original_text:
But mine enemies
are lively,
and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

translated_text:
They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow
the thing that good
is.
original_text:
They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow
the thing that good
is.

translated_text: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.
original_text: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.

translated_text: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
original_text: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

translated_text:
Plead
my cause, O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
original_text:
Plead
my cause, O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.

translated_text: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
original_text: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.

translated_text:
Draw out also the spear, and stop
the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I
am thy salvation.
original_text:
Draw out also the spear, and stop
the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I
am thy salvation.

translated_text: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
original_text: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

translated_text:
Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase
them.
original_text:
Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase
them.

translated_text: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.
original_text: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.

translated_text:
For without cause have they hid for me their net
in a pit,
which without cause they have digged for my soul.
original_text:
For without cause have they hid for me their net
in a pit,
which without cause they have digged for my soul.

translated_text: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
original_text: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.

translated_text: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
original_text: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.

translated_text:
All my bones shall say, LORD, who
is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
original_text:
All my bones shall say, LORD, who
is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?

translated_text:
False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge
things
 that I knew not.
original_text:
False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge
things
 that I knew not.

translated_text:
They rewarded me evil for good
to the spoiling of my soul.
original_text:
They rewarded me evil for good
to the spoiling of my soul.

translated_text:
But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing
was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
original_text:
But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing
was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.

translated_text:
I behaved myself as though
he had been my friend
or
 brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth
for his
 mother.
original_text:
I behaved myself as though
he had been my friend
or
 brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth
for his
 mother.

translated_text:
But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together:
yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew
it not; they did tear
me, and ceased not:
original_text:
But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together:
yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew
it not; they did tear
me, and ceased not:

translated_text: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
original_text: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

translated_text: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
original_text: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.

translated_text: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
original_text: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.

translated_text:
Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me:
neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
original_text:
Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me:
neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

translated_text:
For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against
them that are quiet in the land.
original_text:
For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against
them that are quiet in the land.

translated_text:
Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me,
and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen
it.
original_text:
Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me,
and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen
it.

translated_text: This thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
original_text: This thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

translated_text:
Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment,
even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
original_text:
Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment,
even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

translated_text: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
original_text: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

translated_text: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
original_text: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

translated_text:
Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify
themselves against me.
original_text:
Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify
themselves against me.

translated_text: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
original_text: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

translated_text:
And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness
and of thy praise all the day long.
original_text:
And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness
and of thy praise all the day long.

translated_text:
I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise
shall continually
be in my mouth.
original_text:
I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise
shall continually
be in my mouth.

translated_text:
My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear
thereof, and be glad.
original_text:
My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear
thereof, and be glad.

translated_text: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
original_text: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.

translated_text: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
original_text: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

translated_text: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
original_text: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

translated_text:
This poor man cried, and the LORD heard
him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
original_text:
This poor man cried, and the LORD heard
him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

translated_text: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
original_text: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

translated_text:
O taste and see that the LORD
is good: blessed
is
 the man
that trusteth in him.
original_text:
O taste and see that the LORD
is good: blessed
is
 the man
that trusteth in him.

translated_text:
O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for
there is no want to them that fear him.
original_text:
O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for
there is no want to them that fear him.

translated_text:
The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good
thing.
original_text:
The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good
thing.

translated_text: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
original_text: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

translated_text:
What man
is he that desireth life,
and loveth
many days, that he may see good?
original_text:
What man
is he that desireth life,
and loveth
many days, that he may see good?

translated_text: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
original_text: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

translated_text: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
original_text: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

translated_text:
The eyes of the LORD
are upon the righteous, and his ears
are open unto their cry.
original_text:
The eyes of the LORD
are upon the righteous, and his ears
are open unto their cry.

translated_text:
The face of the LORD
is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
original_text:
The face of the LORD
is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

translated_text: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
original_text: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

translated_text:
The LORD
is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
original_text:
The LORD
is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

translated_text:
Many
are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
original_text:
Many
are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.

translated_text: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
original_text: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

translated_text: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
original_text: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

translated_text: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
original_text: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.

translated_text: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
original_text: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

translated_text: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
original_text: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

translated_text:
Trust in the LORD, and do good;
so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
original_text:
Trust in the LORD, and do good;
so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.

translated_text: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
original_text: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

translated_text:
Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring
it to pass.
original_text:
Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring
it to pass.

translated_text: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
original_text: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

translated_text: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
original_text: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

translated_text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
original_text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

translated_text: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.
original_text: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.

translated_text:
For yet a little while, and the wicked
shall not
be:
 yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it
shall
 not
be.
original_text:
For yet a little while, and the wicked
shall not
be:
 yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it
shall
 not
be.

translated_text: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
original_text: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

translated_text: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
original_text: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

translated_text: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
original_text: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

translated_text:
The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy,
and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
original_text:
The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy,
and to slay such as be of upright conversation.

translated_text: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
original_text: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

translated_text:
A little that a righteous man hath
is better than the riches of many wicked.
original_text:
A little that a righteous man hath
is better than the riches of many wicked.

translated_text: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.
original_text: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.

translated_text: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
original_text: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

translated_text: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
original_text: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

translated_text:
But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD
shall be
 as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
original_text:
But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD
shall be
 as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

translated_text: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
original_text: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

translated_text:
For
such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and
they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
original_text:
For
such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and
they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.

translated_text:
The steps of a
good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
original_text:
The steps of a
good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.

translated_text:
Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth
him with his hand.
original_text:
Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth
him with his hand.

translated_text:
I have been young, and
now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
original_text:
I have been young, and
now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

translated_text:
He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed
is
 blessed.
original_text:
He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed
is
 blessed.

translated_text: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
original_text: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

translated_text: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
original_text: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

translated_text: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
original_text: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

translated_text: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
original_text: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

translated_text:
The law of his God
is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
original_text:
The law of his God
is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

translated_text: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
original_text: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

translated_text: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
original_text: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

translated_text:
Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see
it.
original_text:
Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see
it.

translated_text: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
original_text: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

translated_text:
Yet he passed away, and, lo, he
was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
original_text:
Yet he passed away, and, lo, he
was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

translated_text:
Mark the perfect
man, and behold the upright: for the end of
that man
is peace.
original_text:
Mark the perfect
man, and behold the upright: for the end of
that man
is peace.

translated_text: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
original_text: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

translated_text:
But the salvation of the righteous
is of the LORD:
he is
 their strength in the time of trouble.
original_text:
But the salvation of the righteous
is of the LORD:
he is
 their strength in the time of trouble.

translated_text: And the LORD shall help them and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
original_text: And the LORD shall help them and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

translated_text:
The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart,
that there is no fear of God before his eyes.
original_text:
The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart,
that there is no fear of God before his eyes.

translated_text: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
original_text: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

translated_text:
The words of his mouth
are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise,
and to do good.
original_text:
The words of his mouth
are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise,
and to do good.

translated_text:
He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way
that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.
original_text:
He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way
that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.

translated_text:
Thy mercy, O LORD,
is in the heavens;
and thy faithfulness
reacheth unto the clouds.
original_text:
Thy mercy, O LORD,
is in the heavens;
and thy faithfulness
reacheth unto the clouds.

translated_text:
Thy righteousness
is like the great mountains; thy judgments
are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.
original_text:
Thy righteousness
is like the great mountains; thy judgments
are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.

translated_text:
How excellent
is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
original_text:
How excellent
is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.

translated_text: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
original_text: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

translated_text:
For with thee
is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
original_text:
For with thee
is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

translated_text: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
original_text: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

translated_text: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
original_text: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

translated_text: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
original_text: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

translated_text: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.
original_text: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

translated_text: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
original_text: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.

translated_text:
For thou
art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name’s sake lead me, and guide me.
original_text:
For thou
art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name’s sake lead me, and guide me.

translated_text:
Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou
art my strength.
original_text:
Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou
art my strength.

translated_text: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.
original_text: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.

translated_text: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.
original_text: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.

translated_text: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;
original_text: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

translated_text: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.
original_text: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

translated_text:
Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief,
yea, my soul and my belly.
original_text:
Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief,
yea, my soul and my belly.

translated_text: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
original_text: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

translated_text: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
original_text: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

translated_text: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
original_text: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

translated_text:
For I have heard the slander of many: fear
was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
original_text:
For I have heard the slander of many: fear
was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

translated_text:
But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou
art my God.
original_text:
But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou
art my God.

translated_text:
My times
are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
original_text:
My times
are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

translated_text: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies’ sake.
original_text: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies’ sake.

translated_text:
Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed,
and let them be silent in the grave.
original_text:
Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed,
and let them be silent in the grave.

translated_text: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
original_text: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

translated_text: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
original_text: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

translated_text:
Blessed
be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
original_text:
Blessed
be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

translated_text: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
original_text: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

translated_text:
O love the LORD, all ye his saints:
for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
original_text:
O love the LORD, all ye his saints:
for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

translated_text: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
original_text: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

translated_text: I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
original_text: I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

translated_text: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
original_text: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

translated_text: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
original_text: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

translated_text: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
original_text: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

translated_text:
For his anger
endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy
cometh in the morning.
original_text:
For his anger
endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy
cometh in the morning.

translated_text: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
original_text: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

translated_text:
LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face,
and I was troubled.
original_text:
LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face,
and I was troubled.

translated_text: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.
original_text: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.

translated_text:
What profit
is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
original_text:
What profit
is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

translated_text: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.
original_text: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.

translated_text: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
original_text: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

translated_text:
To the end that
my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
original_text:
To the end that
my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

translated_text:
Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous:
for praise is comely for the upright.
original_text:
Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous:
for praise is comely for the upright.

translated_text:
Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery
and
 an instrument of ten strings.
original_text:
Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery
and
 an instrument of ten strings.

translated_text: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
original_text: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

translated_text:
For the word of the LORD
is right; and all his works
are done in truth.
original_text:
For the word of the LORD
is right; and all his works
are done in truth.

translated_text: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.
original_text: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.

translated_text: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
original_text: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

translated_text: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
original_text: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.

translated_text: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
original_text: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

translated_text:
For he spake, and it was
done; he commanded, and it stood fast.
original_text:
For he spake, and it was
done; he commanded, and it stood fast.

translated_text: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
original_text: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.

translated_text: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
original_text: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

translated_text:
Blessed
is the nation whose God
is the LORD:
and the people
whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
original_text:
Blessed
is the nation whose God
is the LORD:
and the people
whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

translated_text: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.
original_text: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

translated_text: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
original_text: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

translated_text: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
original_text: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

translated_text: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
original_text: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

translated_text:
An horse
is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver
any by his great strength.
original_text:
An horse
is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver
any by his great strength.

translated_text:
Behold, the eye of the LORD
is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
original_text:
Behold, the eye of the LORD
is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

translated_text: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
original_text: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

translated_text:
Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he
is our help and our shield.
original_text:
Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he
is our help and our shield.

translated_text: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
original_text: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

translated_text: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
original_text: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.

translated_text:
Blessed
is he whose transgression
is forgiven,
whose sin
is covered.
original_text:
Blessed
is he whose transgression
is forgiven,
whose sin
is covered.

translated_text:
Blessed
is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit
there is no guile.
original_text:
Blessed
is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit
there is no guile.

translated_text: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
original_text: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

translated_text: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
original_text: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

translated_text: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
original_text: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

translated_text: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
original_text: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

translated_text:
Thou
art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
original_text:
Thou
art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

translated_text: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
original_text: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

translated_text:
Be ye not as the horse,
or as the mule,
which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
original_text:
Be ye not as the horse,
or as the mule,
which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

translated_text:
Many sorrows
shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.
original_text:
Many sorrows
shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.

translated_text:
Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all
ye that are upright in heart.
original_text:
Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all
ye that are upright in heart.

translated_text:
Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer,
that goeth not out of feigned lips.
original_text:
Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer,
that goeth not out of feigned lips.

translated_text: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.
original_text: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.

translated_text:
Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited
me in the night; thou hast tried me,
and shalt find nothing; I am purposed
that my mouth shall not transgress.
original_text:
Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited
me in the night; thou hast tried me,
and shalt find nothing; I am purposed
that my mouth shall not transgress.

translated_text:
Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept
me from the paths of the destroyer.
original_text:
Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept
me from the paths of the destroyer.

translated_text:
Hold up my goings in thy paths,
that my footsteps slip not.
original_text:
Hold up my goings in thy paths,
that my footsteps slip not.

translated_text:
I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me,
and hear my speech.
original_text:
I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me,
and hear my speech.

translated_text:
Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust
in thee from those that rise up
against them.
original_text:
Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust
in thee from those that rise up
against them.

translated_text: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
original_text: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

translated_text: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
original_text: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

translated_text: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;
original_text: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

translated_text:
Like as a lion
that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
original_text:
Like as a lion
that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

translated_text:
Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked,
which is thy sword:
original_text:
Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked,
which is thy sword:

translated_text:
From men
which are thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world,
which have their portion in
this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid
treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their
substance to their babes.
original_text:
From men
which are thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world,
which have their portion in
this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid
treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their
substance to their babes.

translated_text: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
original_text: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

translated_text: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.
original_text: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.

translated_text:
O my soul, thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou
art
 my Lord: my goodness
extendeth not to thee;
original_text:
O my soul, thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou
art
 my Lord: my goodness
extendeth not to thee;

translated_text:
But to the saints that
are in the earth, and
to the excellent, in whom
is all my delight.
original_text:
But to the saints that
are in the earth, and
to the excellent, in whom
is all my delight.

translated_text:
Their sorrows shall be multiplied
that hasten
after
 another
god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.
original_text:
Their sorrows shall be multiplied
that hasten
after
 another
god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.

translated_text:
The LORD
is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
original_text:
The LORD
is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

translated_text:
The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant
places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
original_text:
The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant
places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

translated_text: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
original_text: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

translated_text:
I have set the LORD always before me: because
he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
original_text:
I have set the LORD always before me: because
he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

translated_text: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
original_text: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.

translated_text: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
original_text: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

translated_text:
Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence
is fulness of joy; at thy right hand
there are pleasures for evermore.
original_text:
Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence
is fulness of joy; at thy right hand
there are pleasures for evermore.

translated_text: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
original_text: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

translated_text: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
original_text: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

translated_text:
There is no speech nor language,
where their voice is not heard.
original_text:
There is no speech nor language,
where their voice is not heard.

translated_text: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
original_text: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

translated_text:
Which
is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber,
and
 rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
original_text:
Which
is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber,
and
 rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.

translated_text:
His going forth
is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
original_text:
His going forth
is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

translated_text:
The law of the LORD
is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD
is sure, making wise the simple.
original_text:
The law of the LORD
is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD
is sure, making wise the simple.

translated_text:
The statutes of the LORD
are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD
is pure, enlightening the eyes.
original_text:
The statutes of the LORD
are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD
is pure, enlightening the eyes.

translated_text:
The fear of the LORD
is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD
are true
and righteous altogether.
original_text:
The fear of the LORD
is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD
are true
and righteous altogether.

translated_text:
More to be desired
are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
original_text:
More to be desired
are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

translated_text:
Moreover by them is thy servant warned:
and in keeping of them
there is great reward.
original_text:
Moreover by them is thy servant warned:
and in keeping of them
there is great reward.

translated_text:
Who can understand
his errors? cleanse thou me from secret
faults.
original_text:
Who can understand
his errors? cleanse thou me from secret
faults.

translated_text:
Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous
sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
original_text:
Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous
sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.

translated_text: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
original_text: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.

translated_text: I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.
original_text: I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.

translated_text:
The LORD
is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation,
and my high tower.
original_text:
The LORD
is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation,
and my high tower.

translated_text:
I will call upon the LORD,
who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
original_text:
I will call upon the LORD,
who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

translated_text: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
original_text: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

translated_text: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.
original_text: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.

translated_text:
In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him,
even into his ears.
original_text:
In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him,
even into his ears.

translated_text: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
original_text: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

translated_text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
original_text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

translated_text:
He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness
was
 under his feet.
original_text:
He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness
was
 under his feet.

translated_text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
original_text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

translated_text:
He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him
were dark waters
and thick clouds of the skies.
original_text:
He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him
were dark waters
and thick clouds of the skies.

translated_text:
At the brightness
that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail
stones and coals of fire.
original_text:
At the brightness
that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail
stones and coals of fire.

translated_text:
The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail
stones and coals of fire.
original_text:
The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail
stones and coals of fire.

translated_text: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
original_text: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

translated_text: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
original_text: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

translated_text: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.
original_text: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

translated_text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
original_text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

translated_text: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
original_text: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

translated_text: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
original_text: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

translated_text: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
original_text: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

translated_text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
original_text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

translated_text:
For all his judgments
were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
original_text:
For all his judgments
were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

translated_text: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
original_text: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.

translated_text: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
original_text: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

translated_text: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
original_text: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

translated_text: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
original_text: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.

translated_text: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
original_text: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

translated_text: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
original_text: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.

translated_text: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
original_text: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.

translated_text:
As for God, his way
is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he
is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
original_text:
As for God, his way
is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he
is a buckler to all those that trust in him.

translated_text:
For who
is God save the LORD? or who
is a rock save our God?
original_text:
For who
is God save the LORD? or who
is a rock save our God?

translated_text: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
original_text: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

translated_text:
He maketh my feet like hinds’
feet, and setteth me upon my high places.
original_text:
He maketh my feet like hinds’
feet, and setteth me upon my high places.

translated_text: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
original_text: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

translated_text: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.
original_text: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.

translated_text: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
original_text: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

translated_text: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
original_text: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

translated_text: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
original_text: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

translated_text: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
original_text: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

translated_text: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
original_text: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

translated_text:
They cried, but
there was none to save
them: even
 unto the LORD, but he answered them not.
original_text:
They cried, but
there was none to save
them: even
 unto the LORD, but he answered them not.

translated_text: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
original_text: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

translated_text:
Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people;
and
 thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people
whom
 I have not known shall serve me.
original_text:
Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people;
and
 thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people
whom
 I have not known shall serve me.

translated_text: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
original_text: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.

translated_text: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
original_text: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.

translated_text:
The LORD liveth; and blessed
be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
original_text:
The LORD liveth; and blessed
be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

translated_text: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.
original_text: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.

translated_text: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
original_text: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

translated_text: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.
original_text: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.

translated_text: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
original_text: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

translated_text: How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
original_text: How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

translated_text:
How long shall I take counsel in my soul,
having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
original_text:
How long shall I take counsel in my soul,
having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

translated_text:
Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him;
and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
original_text:
Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him;
and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

translated_text: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
original_text: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

translated_text: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
original_text: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

translated_text: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
original_text: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.

translated_text:
They speak vanity every one with his neighbour:
with flattering lips
and with a double heart do they speak.
original_text:
They speak vanity every one with his neighbour:
with flattering lips
and with a double heart do they speak.

translated_text:
The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips,
and the tongue that speaketh proud things:
original_text:
The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips,
and the tongue that speaketh proud things:

translated_text:
Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips
are
 our own: who
is lord over us?
original_text:
Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips
are
 our own: who
is lord over us?

translated_text:
For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set
him in safety
from him that
 puffeth at him.
original_text:
For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set
him in safety
from him that
 puffeth at him.

translated_text:
The words of the LORD
are pure words:
as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
original_text:
The words of the LORD
are pure words:
as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

translated_text: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
original_text: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.

translated_text: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
original_text: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.

translated_text: LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
original_text: LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?

translated_text: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
original_text: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.

translated_text: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.
original_text: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.

translated_text:
In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD.
He that sweareth to
his own hurt, and changeth not.
original_text:
In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD.
He that sweareth to
his own hurt, and changeth not.

translated_text:
He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these
things shall never be moved.
original_text:
He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these
things shall never be moved.

translated_text:
The fool hath said in his heart,
There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works,
there is none that doeth good.
original_text:
The fool hath said in his heart,
There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works,
there is none that doeth good.

translated_text:
The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand,
and seek God.
original_text:
The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand,
and seek God.

translated_text:
They are all gone aside, they are
all together become filthy:
there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
original_text:
They are all gone aside, they are
all together become filthy:
there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

translated_text:
Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people
as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.
original_text:
Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people
as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.

translated_text:
There were they in great fear: for God
is in the generation of the righteous.
original_text:
There were they in great fear: for God
is in the generation of the righteous.

translated_text:
Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD
is
 his refuge.
original_text:
Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD
is
 his refuge.

translated_text:
Oh that the salvation of Israel
