were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice,
and Israel shall be glad.
original_text:
Oh that the salvation of Israel
were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice,
and Israel shall be glad.

translated_text:
In the LORD put I my trust: How say ye to my soul, Flee
as
 a bird to your mountain?
original_text:
In the LORD put I my trust: How say ye to my soul, Flee
as
 a bird to your mountain?

translated_text:
For, lo, the wicked bend
their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
original_text:
For, lo, the wicked bend
their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.

translated_text: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
original_text: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?

translated_text:
The LORD
is in his holy temple, the LORD’S throne
is
 in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
original_text:
The LORD
is in his holy temple, the LORD’S throne
is
 in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

translated_text: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
original_text: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

translated_text:
Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest:
this shall be the portion of their cup.
original_text:
Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest:
this shall be the portion of their cup.

translated_text: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
original_text: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.

translated_text:
Why standest thou afar off, O LORD?
why hidest thou
thyself
 in times of trouble?
original_text:
Why standest thou afar off, O LORD?
why hidest thou
thyself
 in times of trouble?

translated_text:
The wicked in
his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
original_text:
The wicked in
his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

translated_text:
For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesseth the covetous,
whom the LORD abhorreth.
original_text:
For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesseth the covetous,
whom the LORD abhorreth.

translated_text:
The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek
after God: God
is not in all his thoughts.
original_text:
The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek
after God: God
is not in all his thoughts.

translated_text:
His ways are always grievous; thy judgments
are far above out of his sight:
as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
original_text:
His ways are always grievous; thy judgments
are far above out of his sight:
as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

translated_text:
He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for
I shall
 never
be in adversity.
original_text:
He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for
I shall
 never
be in adversity.

translated_text:
His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue
is mischief and vanity.
original_text:
His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue
is mischief and vanity.

translated_text: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
original_text: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

translated_text: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.
original_text: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

translated_text:
He croucheth,
and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
original_text:
He croucheth,
and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

translated_text:
He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see
it.
original_text:
He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see
it.

translated_text: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.
original_text: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

translated_text:
Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require
it.
original_text:
Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require
it.

translated_text:
Thou hast seen
it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite
it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.
original_text:
Thou hast seen
it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite
it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.

translated_text:
Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil
man: seek out his wickedness
till thou find none.
original_text:
Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil
man: seek out his wickedness
till thou find none.

translated_text:
The LORD
is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
original_text:
The LORD
is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

translated_text: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:
original_text: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:

translated_text: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
original_text: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

translated_text: O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
original_text: O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

translated_text:
Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I
am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
original_text:
Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I
am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.

translated_text: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?
original_text: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?

translated_text: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies’ sake.
original_text: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies’ sake.

translated_text:
For in death
there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
original_text:
For in death
there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

translated_text: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
original_text: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

translated_text: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
original_text: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

translated_text: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.
original_text: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.

translated_text: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.
original_text: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.

translated_text:
Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return
and be ashamed suddenly.
original_text:
Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return
and be ashamed suddenly.

translated_text: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
original_text: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.

translated_text: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.
original_text: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

translated_text:
My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct
my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
original_text:
My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct
my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

translated_text:
For thou
art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
original_text:
For thou
art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

translated_text: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
original_text: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

translated_text: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
original_text: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

translated_text:
But as for me, I will come
into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy:
and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
original_text:
But as for me, I will come
into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy:
and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

translated_text: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
original_text: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

translated_text:
For
there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part
is very wickedness; their throat
is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
original_text:
For
there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part
is very wickedness; their throat
is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

translated_text: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
original_text: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

translated_text: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
original_text: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

translated_text:
For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as
with a shield.
original_text:
For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as
with a shield.

translated_text:
Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me
when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
original_text:
Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me
when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

translated_text:
O ye sons of men, how long
will ye turn my glory into shame?
how long will ye love vanity,
and seek after leasing? Selah.
original_text:
O ye sons of men, how long
will ye turn my glory into shame?
how long will ye love vanity,
and seek after leasing? Selah.

translated_text: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.
original_text: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.

translated_text: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
original_text: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

translated_text: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.
original_text: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.

translated_text:
There be many that say, Who will shew us
any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
original_text:
There be many that say, Who will shew us
any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

translated_text:
Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time
that
 their corn and their wine increased.
original_text:
Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time
that
 their corn and their wine increased.

translated_text: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
original_text: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

translated_text:
LORD, how are they increased that trouble me! many
are they that rise up against me.
original_text:
LORD, how are they increased that trouble me! many
are they that rise up against me.

translated_text:
Many
there be which say of my soul,
There is no help for him in God. Selah.
original_text:
Many
there be which say of my soul,
There is no help for him in God. Selah.

translated_text:
But thou, O LORD,
art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
original_text:
But thou, O LORD,
art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

translated_text: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
original_text: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.

translated_text: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
original_text: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.

translated_text:
I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set
themselves against me round about.
original_text:
I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set
themselves against me round about.

translated_text:
Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies
upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
original_text:
Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies
upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.

translated_text:
Salvation
belongeth unto the LORD: thy blessing
is
 upon thy people. Selah.
original_text:
Salvation
belongeth unto the LORD: thy blessing
is
 upon thy people. Selah.

translated_text:
I will praise
thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
original_text:
I will praise
thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

translated_text: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
original_text: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

translated_text: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
original_text: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

translated_text: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
original_text: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.

translated_text: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
original_text: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

translated_text: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
original_text: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

translated_text: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
original_text: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

translated_text: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
original_text: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

translated_text: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
original_text: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

translated_text: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
original_text: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

translated_text: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
original_text: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

translated_text: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
original_text: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.

translated_text:
Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble
which I suffer
 of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
original_text:
Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble
which I suffer
 of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

translated_text: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
original_text: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

translated_text:
The heathen are sunk down in the pit
that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
original_text:
The heathen are sunk down in the pit
that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

translated_text:
The LORD is known
by the judgment
which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
original_text:
The LORD is known
by the judgment
which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

translated_text:
The wicked shall be turned into hell,
and all the nations that forget God.
original_text:
The wicked shall be turned into hell,
and all the nations that forget God.

translated_text:
For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall
not perish for ever.
original_text:
For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall
not perish for ever.

translated_text: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
original_text: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

translated_text:
Put them in fear, O LORD:
that the nations may know themselves
to be but men. Selah.
original_text:
Put them in fear, O LORD:
that the nations may know themselves
to be but men. Selah.

translated_text:
O LORD our Lord, how excellent
is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
original_text:
O LORD our Lord, how excellent
is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

translated_text: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
original_text: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

translated_text: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
original_text: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

translated_text: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
original_text: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

translated_text: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.
original_text: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

translated_text:
Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all
things under his feet:
original_text:
Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all
things under his feet:

translated_text: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
original_text: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;

translated_text:
The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea,
and whatsoever
 passeth through the paths of the seas.
original_text:
The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea,
and whatsoever
 passeth through the paths of the seas.

translated_text: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
original_text: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!

translated_text: O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
original_text: O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

translated_text:
Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending
it in pieces, while
there is none to deliver.
original_text:
Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending
it in pieces, while
there is none to deliver.

translated_text: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
original_text: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

translated_text: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
original_text: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)

translated_text:
Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take
it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
original_text:
Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take
it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.

translated_text:
Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me
to the judgment
that thou hast commanded.
original_text:
Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me
to the judgment
that thou hast commanded.

translated_text: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
original_text: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.

translated_text:
The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity
that is in me.
original_text:
The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity
that is in me.

translated_text: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
original_text: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.

translated_text:
My defence
is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
original_text:
My defence
is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.

translated_text:
God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry
with the wicked
 every day.
original_text:
God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry
with the wicked
 every day.

translated_text: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
original_text: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

translated_text: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
original_text: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

translated_text: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
original_text: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

translated_text:
He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch
which
 he made.
original_text:
He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch
which
 he made.

translated_text: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
original_text: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

translated_text: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.
original_text: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.

translated_text: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
original_text: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?

translated_text:
The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed,
saying,
original_text:
The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed,
saying,

translated_text: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
original_text: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

translated_text: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.
original_text: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.

translated_text: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
original_text: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.

translated_text: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
original_text: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

translated_text:
I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou
art
 my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
original_text:
I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou
art
 my Son; this day have I begotten thee.

translated_text:
Ask of me, and I shall give
thee the heathen
for
 thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth
for
 thy possession.
original_text:
Ask of me, and I shall give
thee the heathen
for
 thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth
for
 thy possession.

translated_text: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.
original_text: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.

translated_text: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
original_text: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

translated_text: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
original_text: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

translated_text:
Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish
from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed
are all they that put their trust in him.
original_text:
Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish
from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed
are all they that put their trust in him.

translated_text:
Blessed
is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
original_text:
Blessed
is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.

translated_text:
But his delight
is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
original_text:
But his delight
is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

translated_text: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
original_text: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

translated_text:
The ungodly
are not so: but
are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
original_text:
The ungodly
are not so: but
are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

translated_text: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
original_text: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

translated_text: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
original_text: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

translated_text: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.
original_text: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.

translated_text: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
original_text: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

translated_text:
I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside;
it shall not cleave to me.
original_text:
I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside;
it shall not cleave to me.

translated_text:
A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked
person.
original_text:
A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked
person.

translated_text: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
original_text: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

translated_text:
Mine eyes
shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
original_text:
Mine eyes
shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

translated_text: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
original_text: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

translated_text: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
original_text: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.

translated_text: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
original_text: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.

translated_text: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
original_text: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

translated_text:
Know ye that the LORD he
is God:
it is he
that
 hath made us, and not we ourselves;
we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
original_text:
Know ye that the LORD he
is God:
it is he
that
 hath made us, and not we ourselves;
we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

translated_text:
Enter into his gates with thanksgiving,
and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him,
and bless his name.
original_text:
Enter into his gates with thanksgiving,
and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him,
and bless his name.

translated_text:
For the LORD
is good; his mercy
is everlasting; and his truth
endureth to all generations.
original_text:
For the LORD
is good; his mercy
is everlasting; and his truth
endureth to all generations.

translated_text: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
original_text: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

translated_text: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
original_text: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

translated_text: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
original_text: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.

translated_text: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
original_text: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

translated_text: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
original_text: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

translated_text: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
original_text: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.

translated_text:
He
is the LORD our God: his judgments
are in all the earth.
original_text:
He
is the LORD our God: his judgments
are in all the earth.

translated_text:
He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word
which he commanded to a thousand generations.
original_text:
He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word
which he commanded to a thousand generations.

translated_text:
Which
covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
original_text:
Which
covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;

translated_text: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
original_text: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:

translated_text:
When they were
but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
original_text:
When they were
but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

translated_text:
When they went from one nation to another, from
one kingdom to another people;
original_text:
When they went from one nation to another, from
one kingdom to another people;

translated_text: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
original_text: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

translated_text: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
original_text: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

translated_text: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
original_text: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

translated_text:
He sent a man before them,
even Joseph,
who was sold for a servant:
original_text:
He sent a man before them,
even Joseph,
who was sold for a servant:

translated_text: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
original_text: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

translated_text: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.
original_text: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.

translated_text:
The king sent and loosed him;
even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
original_text:
The king sent and loosed him;
even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

translated_text: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
original_text: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:

translated_text: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
original_text: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

translated_text: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
original_text: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

translated_text: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
original_text: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

translated_text: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
original_text: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

translated_text:
He sent Moses his servant;
and Aaron whom he had chosen.
original_text:
He sent Moses his servant;
and Aaron whom he had chosen.

translated_text: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
original_text: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

translated_text: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
original_text: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

translated_text: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
original_text: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

translated_text: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
original_text: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.

translated_text:
He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies,
and lice in all their coasts.
original_text:
He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies,
and lice in all their coasts.

translated_text:
He gave them hail for rain,
and flaming fire in their land.
original_text:
He gave them hail for rain,
and flaming fire in their land.

translated_text: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
original_text: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.

translated_text: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
original_text: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,

translated_text: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
original_text: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

translated_text: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
original_text: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

translated_text:
He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and
there was
 not one feeble
person among their tribes.
original_text:
He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and
there was
 not one feeble
person among their tribes.

translated_text: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
original_text: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.

translated_text: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
original_text: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.

translated_text: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
original_text: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

translated_text:
He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places
like a river.
original_text:
He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places
like a river.

translated_text:
For he remembered his holy promise,
and Abraham his servant.
original_text:
For he remembered his holy promise,
and Abraham his servant.

translated_text:
And he brought forth his people with joy,
and his chosen with gladness:
original_text:
And he brought forth his people with joy,
and his chosen with gladness:

translated_text: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
original_text: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;

translated_text: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.
original_text: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.

translated_text: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
original_text: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

translated_text:
Who coverest
thyself with light as
with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
original_text:
Who coverest
thyself with light as
with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

translated_text: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
original_text: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

translated_text: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
original_text: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

translated_text:
Who laid the foundations of the earth,
that it should not be removed for ever.
original_text:
Who laid the foundations of the earth,
that it should not be removed for ever.

translated_text:
Thou coveredst it with the deep as
with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
original_text:
Thou coveredst it with the deep as
with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

translated_text: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
original_text: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

translated_text: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
original_text: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.

translated_text: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
original_text: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

translated_text:
He sendeth the springs into the valleys,
which run among the hills.
original_text:
He sendeth the springs into the valleys,
which run among the hills.

translated_text: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
original_text: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

translated_text:
By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation,
which
 sing among the branches.
original_text:
By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation,
which
 sing among the branches.

translated_text: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
original_text: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

translated_text: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
original_text: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

translated_text:
And wine
that maketh glad the heart of man,
and
 oil to make
his face to shine, and bread
which
 strengtheneth man’s heart.
original_text:
And wine
that maketh glad the heart of man,
and
 oil to make
his face to shine, and bread
which
 strengtheneth man’s heart.

translated_text:
The trees of the LORD are full
of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
original_text:
The trees of the LORD are full
of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

translated_text:
Where the birds make their nests:
as for the stork, the fir trees
are her house.
original_text:
Where the birds make their nests:
as for the stork, the fir trees
are her house.

translated_text:
The high hills
are a refuge for the wild goats;
and
 the rocks for the conies.
original_text:
The high hills
are a refuge for the wild goats;
and
 the rocks for the conies.

translated_text: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
original_text: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

translated_text:
Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep
forth.
original_text:
Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep
forth.

translated_text: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
original_text: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

translated_text: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
original_text: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

translated_text: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
original_text: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

translated_text: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
original_text: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

translated_text:
So is this great and wide sea, wherein
are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
original_text:
So is this great and wide sea, wherein
are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

translated_text:
There go the ships:
there is that leviathan,
whom
 thou hast made to play therein.
original_text:
There go the ships:
there is that leviathan,
whom
 thou hast made to play therein.

translated_text:
These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give
them their meat in due season.
original_text:
These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give
them their meat in due season.

translated_text: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
original_text: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

translated_text: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
original_text: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

translated_text: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
original_text: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

translated_text: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.
original_text: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.

translated_text: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
original_text: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

translated_text: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
original_text: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

translated_text: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.
original_text: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.

translated_text: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.
original_text: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.

translated_text:
Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me,
bless
 his holy name.
original_text:
Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me,
bless
 his holy name.

translated_text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
original_text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

translated_text: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
original_text: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

translated_text: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
original_text: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

translated_text:
Who satisfieth thy mouth with good
things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
original_text:
Who satisfieth thy mouth with good
things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

translated_text: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
original_text: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.

translated_text: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.
original_text: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.

translated_text:
The LORD
is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
original_text:
The LORD
is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

translated_text:
He will not always chide: neither will he keep
his anger for ever.
original_text:
He will not always chide: neither will he keep
his anger for ever.

translated_text: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
original_text: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

translated_text:
For as the heaven is high above the earth,
so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
original_text:
For as the heaven is high above the earth,
so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.

translated_text:
As far as the east is from the west,
so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
original_text:
As far as the east is from the west,
so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

translated_text:
Like as a father pitieth
his children,
so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
original_text:
Like as a father pitieth
his children,
so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.

translated_text:
For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we
are dust.
original_text:
For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we
are dust.

translated_text:
As for man, his days
are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
original_text:
As for man, his days
are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

translated_text: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
original_text: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.

translated_text:
But the mercy of the LORD
is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children’s children;
original_text:
But the mercy of the LORD
is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children’s children;

translated_text: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
original_text: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

translated_text: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
original_text: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

translated_text: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
original_text: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.

translated_text: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.
original_text: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.

translated_text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.
original_text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.

translated_text:
Hide not thy face from me in the day
when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day
when I call answer me speedily.
original_text:
Hide not thy face from me in the day
when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day
when I call answer me speedily.

translated_text: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
original_text: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.

translated_text: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
original_text: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.

translated_text: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
original_text: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

translated_text: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
original_text: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.

translated_text: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
original_text: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

translated_text:
Mine enemies reproach me all the day;
and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
original_text:
Mine enemies reproach me all the day;
and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

translated_text: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
original_text: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

translated_text: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
original_text: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

translated_text:
My days
are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
original_text:
My days
are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

translated_text: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
original_text: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.

translated_text:
Thou shalt arise,
and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
original_text:
Thou shalt arise,
and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

translated_text: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
original_text: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

translated_text: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
original_text: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

translated_text: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
original_text: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.

translated_text: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
original_text: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.

translated_text: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.
original_text: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.

translated_text: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;
original_text: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;

translated_text: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
original_text: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;

translated_text: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
original_text: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

translated_text: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
original_text: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

translated_text: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
original_text: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.

translated_text:
I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years
are throughout all generations.
original_text:
I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years
are throughout all generations.

translated_text:
Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens
are the work of thy hands.
original_text:
Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens
are the work of thy hands.

translated_text: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
original_text: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

translated_text:
But thou
art the same, and thy years shall have no end.
original_text:
But thou
art the same, and thy years shall have no end.

translated_text: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
original_text: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.

translated_text: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
original_text: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

translated_text: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
original_text: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

translated_text: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
original_text: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

translated_text:
For my love they are my adversaries: but I
give myself unto
 prayer.
original_text:
For my love they are my adversaries: but I
give myself unto
 prayer.

translated_text: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
original_text: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

translated_text: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
original_text: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

translated_text: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
original_text: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

translated_text:
Let his days be few;
and let another take his office.
original_text:
Let his days be few;
and let another take his office.

translated_text: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
original_text: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

translated_text:
Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek
their bread also out of their desolate places.
original_text:
Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek
their bread also out of their desolate places.

translated_text: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
original_text: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

translated_text: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
original_text: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

translated_text:
Let his posterity be cut off;
and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
original_text:
Let his posterity be cut off;
and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

translated_text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
original_text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

translated_text: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
original_text: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

translated_text: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
original_text: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

translated_text: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
original_text: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

translated_text: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
original_text: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

translated_text:
Let it be unto him as the garment
which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
original_text:
Let it be unto him as the garment
which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

translated_text:
Let this
be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
original_text:
Let this
be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

translated_text:
But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name’s sake: because thy mercy
is good, deliver thou me.
original_text:
But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name’s sake: because thy mercy
is good, deliver thou me.

translated_text:
For I
am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
original_text:
For I
am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

translated_text: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
original_text: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

translated_text: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
original_text: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

translated_text:
I became also a reproach unto them:
when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
original_text:
I became also a reproach unto them:
when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

translated_text: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
original_text: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

translated_text:
That they may know that this
is thy hand;
that
 thou, LORD, hast done it.
original_text:
That they may know that this
is thy hand;
that
 thou, LORD, hast done it.

translated_text: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
original_text: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

translated_text: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
original_text: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

translated_text: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
original_text: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

translated_text:
For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save
him
 from those that condemn his soul.
original_text:
For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save
him
 from those that condemn his soul.

translated_text: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
original_text: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

translated_text:
Awake, psaltery and harp: I
myself will awake early.
original_text:
Awake, psaltery and harp: I
myself will awake early.

translated_text: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
original_text: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

translated_text:
For thy mercy
is great above the heavens: and thy truth
reacheth unto the clouds.
original_text:
For thy mercy
is great above the heavens: and thy truth
reacheth unto the clouds.

translated_text: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
original_text: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;

translated_text:
That thy beloved may be delivered: save
with thy right hand, and answer me.
original_text:
That thy beloved may be delivered: save
with thy right hand, and answer me.

translated_text: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
original_text: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

translated_text:
Gilead
is mine; Manasseh
is mine; Ephraim also
is the strength of mine head; Judah
is my lawgiver;
original_text:
Gilead
is mine; Manasseh
is mine; Ephraim also
is the strength of mine head; Judah
is my lawgiver;

translated_text:
Moab
is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
original_text:
Moab
is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

translated_text: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
original_text: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

translated_text:
Wilt not
thou, O God,
who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
original_text:
Wilt not
thou, O God,
who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

translated_text:
Give us help from trouble: for vain
is the help of man.
original_text:
Give us help from trouble: for vain
is the help of man.

translated_text:
Through God we shall do valiantly: for he
it is that shall tread down our enemies.
original_text:
Through God we shall do valiantly: for he
it is that shall tread down our enemies.

translated_text:
O give thanks unto the LORD, for
he is good: for his mercy
endureth for ever.
original_text:
O give thanks unto the LORD, for
he is good: for his mercy
endureth for ever.

translated_text: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
original_text: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

translated_text: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
original_text: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

translated_text: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
original_text: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.

translated_text: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
original_text: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

translated_text:
Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble,
and he delivered them out of their distresses.
original_text:
Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble,
and he delivered them out of their distresses.

translated_text: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
original_text: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

translated_text:
Oh that
men would praise the LORD
for his goodness, and
for his wonderful works to the children of men!
original_text:
Oh that
men would praise the LORD
for his goodness, and
for his wonderful works to the children of men!

translated_text: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
original_text: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

translated_text: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:
original_text: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:

translated_text:
Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and
there was none to help.
original_text:
Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and
there was none to help.

translated_text:
Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble,
and he saved them out of their distresses.
original_text:
Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble,
and he saved them out of their distresses.

translated_text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
original_text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.

translated_text:
Oh that
men would praise the LORD
for his goodness, and
for his wonderful works to the children of men!
original_text:
Oh that
men would praise the LORD
for his goodness, and
for his wonderful works to the children of men!

translated_text: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
original_text: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.

translated_text: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
original_text: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

translated_text: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
original_text: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.

translated_text:
Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble,
and he saveth them out of their distresses.
original_text:
Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble,
and he saveth them out of their distresses.

translated_text:
He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered
them from their destructions.
original_text:
He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered
them from their destructions.

translated_text:
Oh that
men would praise the LORD
for his goodness, and
for his wonderful works to the children of men!
original_text:
Oh that
men would praise the LORD
for his goodness, and
for his wonderful works to the children of men!

translated_text: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
original_text: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.

translated_text: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
original_text: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;

translated_text: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.
original_text: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.

translated_text: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
original_text: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.

translated_text: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
original_text: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.

translated_text: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit’s end.
original_text: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit’s end.

translated_text: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
original_text: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.

translated_text: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
original_text: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

translated_text: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
original_text: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

translated_text:
Oh that
men would praise the LORD
for his goodness, and
for his wonderful works to the children of men!
original_text:
Oh that
men would praise the LORD
for his goodness, and
for his wonderful works to the children of men!

translated_text: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
original_text: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

translated_text: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
original_text: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;

translated_text: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
original_text: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

translated_text: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
original_text: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.

translated_text: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
original_text: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;

translated_text: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
original_text: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.

translated_text: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
original_text: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

translated_text: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
original_text: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.

translated_text:
He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness,
where there is no way.
original_text:
He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness,
where there is no way.

translated_text:
Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh
him
 families like a flock.
original_text:
Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh
him
 families like a flock.

translated_text:
The righteous shall see
it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
original_text:
The righteous shall see
it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

translated_text:
Whoso
is wise, and will observe these
things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.
original_text:
Whoso
is wise, and will observe these
things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.

translated_text:
Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for
he is
 good: for his mercy
endureth for ever.
original_text:
Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for
he is
 good: for his mercy
endureth for ever.

translated_text:
Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD?
who can shew forth all his praise?
original_text:
Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD?
who can shew forth all his praise?

translated_text:
Blessed
are they that keep judgment,
and he that doeth righteousness at all times.
original_text:
Blessed
are they that keep judgment,
and he that doeth righteousness at all times.

translated_text: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
original_text: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

translated_text: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
original_text: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

translated_text:
Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked
him at the sea,
even
 at the Red sea.
original_text:
Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked
him at the sea,
even
 at the Red sea.

translated_text: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
original_text: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.

translated_text: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
original_text: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

translated_text:
And he saved them from the hand of him that hated
them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
original_text:
And he saved them from the hand of him that hated
them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

translated_text: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
original_text: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

translated_text: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
original_text: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

translated_text: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
original_text: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:

translated_text: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.
original_text: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.

translated_text: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
original_text: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

translated_text:
They envied Moses also in the camp,
and Aaron the saint of the LORD.
original_text:
They envied Moses also in the camp,
and Aaron the saint of the LORD.

translated_text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
original_text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

translated_text: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
original_text: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

translated_text: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
original_text: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

translated_text: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
original_text: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.

translated_text: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;
original_text: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;

translated_text:
Wondrous works in the land of Ham,
and terrible things by the Red sea.
original_text:
Wondrous works in the land of Ham,
and terrible things by the Red sea.

translated_text:
Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy
them.
original_text:
