Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy
them.

translated_text: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
original_text: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:

translated_text:
But murmured in their tents,
and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.
original_text:
But murmured in their tents,
and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.

translated_text: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
original_text: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:

translated_text: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
original_text: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

translated_text: They joined themselves also unto Baal-peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
original_text: They joined themselves also unto Baal-peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

translated_text:
Thus they provoked
him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.
original_text:
Thus they provoked
him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.

translated_text:
Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and
so the plague was stayed.
original_text:
Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and
so the plague was stayed.

translated_text: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
original_text: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.

translated_text:
They angered
him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
original_text:
They angered
him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:

translated_text: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
original_text: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

translated_text: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:
original_text: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:

translated_text: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
original_text: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

translated_text: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.
original_text: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.

translated_text: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
original_text: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,

translated_text:
And shed innocent blood,
even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
original_text:
And shed innocent blood,
even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.

translated_text: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
original_text: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.

translated_text: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
original_text: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

translated_text: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
original_text: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.

translated_text: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
original_text: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

translated_text:
Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked
him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.
original_text:
Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked
him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.

translated_text: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
original_text: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

translated_text: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
original_text: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

translated_text: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.
original_text: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.

translated_text:
Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name,
and to triumph in thy praise.
original_text:
Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name,
and to triumph in thy praise.

translated_text:
Blessed
be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.
original_text:
Blessed
be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.

translated_text:
Praise ye the LORD. Blessed
is the man
that feareth the LORD,
that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
original_text:
Praise ye the LORD. Blessed
is the man
that feareth the LORD,
that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

translated_text: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
original_text: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

translated_text:
Wealth and riches
shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
original_text:
Wealth and riches
shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

translated_text:
Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness:
he is
 gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
original_text:
Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness:
he is
 gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

translated_text: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
original_text: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

translated_text: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
original_text: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

translated_text: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
original_text: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.

translated_text:
His heart
is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see
his desire upon his enemies.
original_text:
His heart
is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see
his desire upon his enemies.

translated_text: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
original_text: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.

translated_text:
The wicked shall see
it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
original_text:
The wicked shall see
it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

translated_text:
Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with
my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and
in the congregation.
original_text:
Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with
my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and
in the congregation.

translated_text:
The works of the LORD
are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
original_text:
The works of the LORD
are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

translated_text:
His work
is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
original_text:
His work
is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

translated_text:
He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD
is
 gracious and full of compassion.
original_text:
He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD
is
 gracious and full of compassion.

translated_text: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
original_text: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.

translated_text: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
original_text: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

translated_text:
The works of his hands
are verity and judgment; all his commandments
are sure.
original_text:
The works of his hands
are verity and judgment; all his commandments
are sure.

translated_text:
They stand fast for ever and ever,
and are done in truth and uprightness.
original_text:
They stand fast for ever and ever,
and are done in truth and uprightness.

translated_text:
He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend
is his name.
original_text:
He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend
is his name.

translated_text:
The fear of the LORD
is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do
his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
original_text:
The fear of the LORD
is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do
his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.

translated_text: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
original_text: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

translated_text: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
original_text: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

translated_text:
Thy people
shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
original_text:
Thy people
shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

translated_text:
The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou
art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
original_text:
The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou
art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

translated_text: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
original_text: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

translated_text:
He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill
the places
 with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
original_text:
He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill
the places
 with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

translated_text: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
original_text: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

translated_text:
I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice
and my supplications.
original_text:
I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice
and my supplications.

translated_text:
Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon
him as long as I live.
original_text:
Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon
him as long as I live.

translated_text: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
original_text: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

translated_text: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
original_text: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

translated_text:
Gracious
is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God
is
 merciful.
original_text:
Gracious
is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God
is
 merciful.

translated_text: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
original_text: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

translated_text: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
original_text: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.

translated_text:
For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears,
and my feet from falling.
original_text:
For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears,
and my feet from falling.

translated_text: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
original_text: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

translated_text: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
original_text: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:

translated_text:
I said in my haste, All men
are liars.
original_text:
I said in my haste, All men
are liars.

translated_text:
What shall I render unto the LORD
for all his benefits toward me?
original_text:
What shall I render unto the LORD
for all his benefits toward me?

translated_text: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.
original_text: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.

translated_text: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.
original_text: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.

translated_text:
Precious in the sight of the LORD
is the death of his saints.
original_text:
Precious in the sight of the LORD
is the death of his saints.

translated_text:
O LORD, truly I
am thy servant; I
am thy servant,
and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
original_text:
O LORD, truly I
am thy servant; I
am thy servant,
and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

translated_text: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.
original_text: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.

translated_text: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,
original_text: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,

translated_text: In the courts of the LORD’S house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
original_text: In the courts of the LORD’S house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.

translated_text:
Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy,
and for thy truth’s sake.
original_text:
Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy,
and for thy truth’s sake.

translated_text:
Wherefore should the heathen say, Where
is now their God?
original_text:
Wherefore should the heathen say, Where
is now their God?

translated_text:
But our God
is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
original_text:
But our God
is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

translated_text:
Their idols
are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
original_text:
Their idols
are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

translated_text: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
original_text: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

translated_text: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
original_text: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

translated_text: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
original_text: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

translated_text:
They that make them are like unto them;
so is every one that trusteth in them.
original_text:
They that make them are like unto them;
so is every one that trusteth in them.

translated_text:
O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he
is their help and their shield.
original_text:
O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he
is their help and their shield.

translated_text:
O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he
is their help and their shield.
original_text:
O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he
is their help and their shield.

translated_text:
Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he
is their help and their shield.
original_text:
Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he
is their help and their shield.

translated_text:
The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless
us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
original_text:
The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless
us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

translated_text:
He will bless them that fear the LORD,
both small and great.
original_text:
He will bless them that fear the LORD,
both small and great.

translated_text: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
original_text: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.

translated_text:
Ye
are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.
original_text:
Ye
are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.

translated_text:
The heaven,
even the heavens,
are the LORD’S: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
original_text:
The heaven,
even the heavens,
are the LORD’S: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

translated_text: The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.
original_text: The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.

translated_text: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.
original_text: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.

translated_text: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
original_text: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

translated_text:
Judah was his sanctuary,
and Israel his dominion.
original_text:
Judah was his sanctuary,
and Israel his dominion.

translated_text:
The sea saw
it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
original_text:
The sea saw
it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.

translated_text:
The mountains skipped like rams,
and the little hills like lambs.
original_text:
The mountains skipped like rams,
and the little hills like lambs.

translated_text:
What
ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan,
that thou wast driven back?
original_text:
What
ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan,
that thou wast driven back?

translated_text: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;
original_text: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;

translated_text:
Which turned the rock
into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
original_text:
Which turned the rock
into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

translated_text: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
original_text: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.

translated_text: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.
original_text: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.

translated_text:
From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’S name
is to be praised.
original_text:
From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’S name
is to be praised.

translated_text:
The LORD
is high above all nations,
and his glory above the heavens.
original_text:
The LORD
is high above all nations,
and his glory above the heavens.

translated_text:
Who
is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,
original_text:
Who
is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,

translated_text:
Who humbleth
himself to behold
the things that are
 in heaven, and in the earth!
original_text:
Who humbleth
himself to behold
the things that are
 in heaven, and in the earth!

translated_text:
He raiseth up the poor out of the dust,
and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
original_text:
He raiseth up the poor out of the dust,
and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

translated_text:
That he may set
him with princes,
even with the princes of his people.
original_text:
That he may set
him with princes,
even with the princes of his people.

translated_text:
He maketh the barren woman to keep house,
and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
original_text:
He maketh the barren woman to keep house,
and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.

translated_text:
Blessed
are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
original_text:
Blessed
are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.

translated_text:
Blessed
are they that keep his testimonies,
and that
 seek him with the whole heart.
original_text:
Blessed
are they that keep his testimonies,
and that
 seek him with the whole heart.

translated_text: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
original_text: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

translated_text:
Thou hast commanded
us to keep thy precepts diligently.
original_text:
Thou hast commanded
us to keep thy precepts diligently.

translated_text: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
original_text: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

translated_text: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
original_text: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

translated_text: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
original_text: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

translated_text: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
original_text: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

translated_text:
Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed
thereto
 according to thy word.
original_text:
Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed
thereto
 according to thy word.

translated_text: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
original_text: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.

translated_text: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
original_text: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

translated_text:
Blessed
art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.
original_text:
Blessed
art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.

translated_text: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
original_text: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

translated_text:
I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as
much as
 in all riches.
original_text:
I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as
much as
 in all riches.

translated_text: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
original_text: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

translated_text: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
original_text: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

translated_text:
Deal bountifully with thy servant,
that I may live, and keep thy word.
original_text:
Deal bountifully with thy servant,
that I may live, and keep thy word.

translated_text: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
original_text: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

translated_text:
I
am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
original_text:
I
am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

translated_text:
My soul breaketh for the longing
that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.
original_text:
My soul breaketh for the longing
that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.

translated_text:
Thou hast rebuked the proud
that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
original_text:
Thou hast rebuked the proud
that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

translated_text: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
original_text: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.

translated_text:
Princes also did sit
and speak against me:
but
 thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
original_text:
Princes also did sit
and speak against me:
but
 thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

translated_text:
Thy testimonies also
are my delight
and my counsellors.
original_text:
Thy testimonies also
are my delight
and my counsellors.

translated_text: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
original_text: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

translated_text: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
original_text: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.

translated_text: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
original_text: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

translated_text: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
original_text: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

translated_text: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
original_text: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

translated_text:
I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid
before me.
original_text:
I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid
before me.

translated_text: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.
original_text: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.

translated_text: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
original_text: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

translated_text:
Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it
unto the end.
original_text:
Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it
unto the end.

translated_text:
Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with
my whole heart.
original_text:
Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with
my whole heart.

translated_text: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
original_text: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

translated_text: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
original_text: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

translated_text:
Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity;
and quicken thou me in thy way.
original_text:
Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity;
and quicken thou me in thy way.

translated_text:
Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who
is devoted to thy fear.
original_text:
Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who
is devoted to thy fear.

translated_text:
Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments
are
 good.
original_text:
Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments
are
 good.

translated_text: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
original_text: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.

translated_text:
Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD,
even thy salvation, according to thy word.
original_text:
Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD,
even thy salvation, according to thy word.

translated_text: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.
original_text: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.

translated_text: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
original_text: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.

translated_text: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
original_text: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.

translated_text: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
original_text: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.

translated_text: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
original_text: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

translated_text: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
original_text: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.

translated_text: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
original_text: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.

translated_text: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
original_text: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

translated_text:
This
is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
original_text:
This
is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.

translated_text:
The proud have had me greatly in derision:
yet have I not declined from thy law.
original_text:
The proud have had me greatly in derision:
yet have I not declined from thy law.

translated_text: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.
original_text: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.

translated_text: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
original_text: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

translated_text: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
original_text: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

translated_text: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.
original_text: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.

translated_text: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
original_text: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.

translated_text: Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.
original_text: Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.

translated_text:
I intreated thy favour with
my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
original_text:
I intreated thy favour with
my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.

translated_text: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
original_text: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

translated_text: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
original_text: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.

translated_text:
The bands of the wicked have robbed me:
but I have not forgotten thy law.
original_text:
The bands of the wicked have robbed me:
but I have not forgotten thy law.

translated_text: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
original_text: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.

translated_text:
I
am a companion of all
them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
original_text:
I
am a companion of all
them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

translated_text: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
original_text: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.

translated_text: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.
original_text: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.

translated_text: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
original_text: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.

translated_text: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
original_text: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.

translated_text:
Thou
art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
original_text:
Thou
art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

translated_text:
The proud have forged a lie against me:
but I will keep thy precepts with
my whole heart.
original_text:
The proud have forged a lie against me:
but I will keep thy precepts with
my whole heart.

translated_text:
Their heart is as fat as grease;
but I delight in thy law.
original_text:
Their heart is as fat as grease;
but I delight in thy law.

translated_text: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
original_text: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

translated_text:
The law of thy mouth
is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
original_text:
The law of thy mouth
is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

translated_text: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
original_text: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

translated_text: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
original_text: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.

translated_text:
I know, O LORD, that thy judgments
are right, and that
thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
original_text:
I know, O LORD, that thy judgments
are right, and that
thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

translated_text: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
original_text: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.

translated_text:
Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law
is my delight.
original_text:
Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law
is my delight.

translated_text:
Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause:
but I will meditate in thy precepts.
original_text:
Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause:
but I will meditate in thy precepts.

translated_text: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
original_text: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.

translated_text: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
original_text: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

translated_text:
My soul fainteth for thy salvation:
but I hope in thy word.
original_text:
My soul fainteth for thy salvation:
but I hope in thy word.

translated_text: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
original_text: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

translated_text:
For I am become like a bottle in the smoke;
yet do I not forget thy statutes.
original_text:
For I am become like a bottle in the smoke;
yet do I not forget thy statutes.

translated_text:
How many
are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
original_text:
How many
are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

translated_text:
The proud have digged pits for me, which
are not after thy law.
original_text:
The proud have digged pits for me, which
are not after thy law.

translated_text:
All thy commandments
are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
original_text:
All thy commandments
are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

translated_text: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
original_text: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

translated_text: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
original_text: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.

translated_text: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
original_text: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.

translated_text:
Thy faithfulness
is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
original_text:
Thy faithfulness
is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

translated_text:
They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all
are thy servants.
original_text:
They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all
are thy servants.

translated_text:
Unless thy law
had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
original_text:
Unless thy law
had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

translated_text: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
original_text: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.

translated_text:
I
am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
original_text:
I
am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.

translated_text:
The wicked have waited for me to destroy me:
but I will consider thy testimonies.
original_text:
The wicked have waited for me to destroy me:
but I will consider thy testimonies.

translated_text:
I have seen an end of all perfection:
but thy commandment
is exceeding broad.
original_text:
I have seen an end of all perfection:
but thy commandment
is exceeding broad.

translated_text:
O how love I thy law! it
is my meditation all the day.
original_text:
O how love I thy law! it
is my meditation all the day.

translated_text:
Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they
are ever with me.
original_text:
Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they
are ever with me.

translated_text:
I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies
are my meditation.
original_text:
I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies
are my meditation.

translated_text: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
original_text: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

translated_text: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
original_text: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

translated_text: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
original_text: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.

translated_text:
How sweet are thy words unto my taste!
yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
original_text:
How sweet are thy words unto my taste!
yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

translated_text: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
original_text: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.

translated_text:
Thy word
is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
original_text:
Thy word
is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

translated_text:
I have sworn, and I will perform
it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
original_text:
I have sworn, and I will perform
it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

translated_text: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.
original_text: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.

translated_text: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.
original_text: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.

translated_text:
My soul
is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
original_text:
My soul
is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

translated_text: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
original_text: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.

translated_text:
Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they
are the rejoicing of my heart.
original_text:
Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they
are the rejoicing of my heart.

translated_text:
I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway,
even unto the end.
original_text:
I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway,
even unto the end.

translated_text:
I hate
vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
original_text:
I hate
vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.

translated_text:
Thou
art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
original_text:
Thou
art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

translated_text: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
original_text: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.

translated_text: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
original_text: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

translated_text: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
original_text: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

translated_text:
Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit
is falsehood.
original_text:
Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit
is falsehood.

translated_text:
Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth
like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
original_text:
Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth
like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.

translated_text: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
original_text: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

translated_text: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
original_text: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

translated_text: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
original_text: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

translated_text: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
original_text: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

translated_text: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
original_text: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.

translated_text:
I
am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
original_text:
I
am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

translated_text:
It is time for
thee, LORD, to work:
for
 they have made void thy law.
original_text:
It is time for
thee, LORD, to work:
for
 they have made void thy law.

translated_text: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
original_text: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

translated_text:
Therefore I esteem all
thy precepts
concerning
 all
things to be right;
and I hate every false way.
original_text:
Therefore I esteem all
thy precepts
concerning
 all
things to be right;
and I hate every false way.

translated_text:
Thy testimonies
are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
original_text:
Thy testimonies
are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

translated_text: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
original_text: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

translated_text: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
original_text: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

translated_text: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
original_text: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

translated_text: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
original_text: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

translated_text: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
original_text: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

translated_text: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
original_text: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

translated_text: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
original_text: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.

translated_text:
Righteous
art thou, O LORD, and upright
are thy judgments.
original_text:
Righteous
art thou, O LORD, and upright
are thy judgments.

translated_text:
Thy testimonies
that thou hast commanded
are righteous and very faithful.
original_text:
Thy testimonies
that thou hast commanded
are righteous and very faithful.

translated_text: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
original_text: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

translated_text:
Thy word
is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
original_text:
Thy word
is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.

translated_text:
I
am small and despised:
yet do not I forget thy precepts.
original_text:
I
am small and despised:
yet do not I forget thy precepts.

translated_text:
Thy righteousness
is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law
is the truth.
original_text:
Thy righteousness
is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law
is the truth.

translated_text:
Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me:
yet thy commandments
are my delights.
original_text:
Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me:
yet thy commandments
are my delights.

translated_text:
The righteousness of thy testimonies
is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
original_text:
The righteousness of thy testimonies
is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.

translated_text:
I cried with
my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
original_text:
I cried with
my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.

translated_text: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
original_text: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.

translated_text: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
original_text: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.

translated_text:
Mine eyes prevent the
night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
original_text:
Mine eyes prevent the
night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.

translated_text: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.
original_text: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.

translated_text: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
original_text: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.

translated_text:
Thou
art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments
are
 truth.
original_text:
Thou
art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments
are
 truth.

translated_text: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
original_text: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.

translated_text: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
original_text: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.

translated_text: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
original_text: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

translated_text:
Salvation
is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
original_text:
Salvation
is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.

translated_text:
Great
are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.
original_text:
Great
are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.

translated_text:
Many
are my persecutors and mine enemies;
yet
 do I not decline from thy testimonies.
original_text:
Many
are my persecutors and mine enemies;
yet
 do I not decline from thy testimonies.

translated_text: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
original_text: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.

translated_text: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.
original_text: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.

translated_text:
Thy word
is true
from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments
endureth for ever.
original_text:
Thy word
is true
from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments
endureth for ever.

translated_text: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
original_text: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

translated_text: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
original_text: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.

translated_text:
I hate and abhor lying:
but thy law do I love.
original_text:
I hate and abhor lying:
but thy law do I love.

translated_text: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
original_text: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

translated_text: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
original_text: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.

translated_text: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
original_text: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.

translated_text: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
original_text: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

translated_text:
I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways
are before thee.
original_text:
I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways
are before thee.

translated_text: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.
original_text: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.

translated_text: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
original_text: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.

translated_text: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
original_text: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

translated_text:
My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments
are
 righteousness.
original_text:
My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments
are
 righteousness.

translated_text: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
original_text: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.

translated_text:
I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law
is
 my delight.
original_text:
I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law
is
 my delight.

translated_text: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
original_text: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

translated_text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
original_text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.

translated_text:
O give thanks unto the LORD; for
he is good: because his mercy
endureth for ever.
original_text:
O give thanks unto the LORD; for
he is good: because his mercy
endureth for ever.

translated_text:
Let Israel now say, that his mercy
endureth for ever.
original_text:
Let Israel now say, that his mercy
endureth for ever.

translated_text:
Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy
endureth for ever.
original_text:
Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy
endureth for ever.

translated_text:
Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy
endureth
 for ever.
original_text:
Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy
endureth
 for ever.

translated_text:
I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me,
and set me in a large place.
original_text:
I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me,
and set me in a large place.

translated_text:
The LORD
is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
original_text:
The LORD
is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

translated_text:
The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see
my desire upon them that hate me.
original_text:
The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see
my desire upon them that hate me.

translated_text: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.
original_text: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.

translated_text: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.
original_text: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.

translated_text: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.
original_text: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.

translated_text: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
original_text: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

translated_text: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
original_text: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

translated_text: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.
original_text: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.

translated_text:
The LORD
is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
original_text:
The LORD
is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

translated_text:
The voice of rejoicing and salvation
is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
original_text:
The voice of rejoicing and salvation
is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

translated_text: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
original_text: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

translated_text: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.
original_text: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.

translated_text: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.
original_text: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.

translated_text:
Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them,
and
 I will praise the LORD:
original_text:
Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them,
and
 I will praise the LORD:

translated_text: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.
original_text: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.

translated_text: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.
original_text: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

translated_text:
The stone
which the builders refused is become the head
stone of the corner.
original_text:
The stone
which the builders refused is become the head
stone of the corner.

translated_text:
This is the LORD’S doing; it
is marvellous in our eyes.
original_text:
This is the LORD’S doing; it
is marvellous in our eyes.

translated_text:
This
is the day
which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
original_text:
This
is the day
which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

translated_text: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
original_text: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.

translated_text:
Blessed
be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.
original_text:
Blessed
be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
God
is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords,
even unto the horns of the altar.
original_text:
God
is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords,
even unto the horns of the altar.

translated_text:
Thou
art my God, and I will praise thee:
thou art
 my God, I will exalt thee.
original_text:
Thou
art my God, and I will praise thee:
thou art
 my God, I will exalt thee.

translated_text:
O give thanks unto the LORD; for
he is good: for his mercy
endureth for ever.
original_text:
O give thanks unto the LORD; for
he is good: for his mercy
endureth for ever.

translated_text: O praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
original_text: O praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.

translated_text:
For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD
endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.
original_text:
For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD
endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.

translated_text: LORD, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
original_text: LORD, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.

translated_text:
Let my prayer be set forth before thee
as incense;
and
 the lifting up of my hands
as the evening sacrifice.
original_text:
Let my prayer be set forth before thee
as incense;
and
 the lifting up of my hands
as the evening sacrifice.

translated_text: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
original_text: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

translated_text:
Incline not my heart to
any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
original_text:
Incline not my heart to
any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

translated_text: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
original_text: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

translated_text:
Our bones are scattered at the grave’s mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth
wood upon the earth.
original_text:
Our bones are scattered at the grave’s mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth
wood upon the earth.

translated_text:
But mine eyes
are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
original_text:
But mine eyes
are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.

translated_text:
Keep me from the snares
which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
original_text:
Keep me from the snares
which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

translated_text: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
original_text: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.

translated_text: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
original_text: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;

translated_text:
Which imagine mischiefs in
their heart; continually are they gathered together
for war.
original_text:
Which imagine mischiefs in
their heart; continually are they gathered together
for war.

translated_text:
They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison
is under their lips. Selah.
original_text:
They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison
is under their lips. Selah.

translated_text: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
original_text: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.

translated_text: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
original_text: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.

translated_text:
I said unto the LORD, Thou
art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.
original_text:
I said unto the LORD, Thou
art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.

translated_text: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
original_text: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

translated_text:
Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device;
lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
original_text:
Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device;
lest they exalt themselves. Selah.

translated_text: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
original_text: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

translated_text: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
original_text: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

translated_text:
Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow
him.
original_text:
Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow
him.

translated_text:
I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted,
and the right of the poor.
original_text:
I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted,
and the right of the poor.

translated_text: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
original_text: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

translated_text: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
original_text: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

translated_text: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
original_text: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

translated_text:
Great
is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness
is unsearchable.
original_text:
Great
is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness
is unsearchable.

translated_text: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
original_text: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.

translated_text: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
original_text: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.

translated_text:
And
men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
original_text:
And
men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.

translated_text: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.
original_text: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.

translated_text:
The LORD
is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
original_text:
The LORD
is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

translated_text:
The LORD
is good to all: and his tender mercies
are
 over all his works.
original_text:
The LORD
is good to all: and his tender mercies
are
 over all his works.

translated_text: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.
original_text: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.

translated_text: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;
original_text: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;

translated_text: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
original_text: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.

translated_text:
Thy kingdom
is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion
endureth throughout all generations.
original_text:
Thy kingdom
is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion
endureth throughout all generations.

translated_text:
The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all
those that be
 bowed down.
original_text:
The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all
those that be
 bowed down.

translated_text: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.
original_text: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.

translated_text: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
original_text: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

translated_text:
The LORD
is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
original_text:
The LORD
is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.

translated_text:
The LORD
is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
original_text:
The LORD
is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

translated_text: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
original_text: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.

translated_text: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
original_text: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.

translated_text: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
original_text: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

translated_text:
Blessed
be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war,
and my fingers to fight:
original_text:
Blessed
be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war,
and my fingers to fight:

translated_text:
My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and
he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
original_text:
My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and
he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.

translated_text:
LORD, what
is man, that thou takest knowledge of him!
or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
original_text:
LORD, what
is man, that thou takest knowledge of him!
or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!

translated_text:
Man is like to vanity: his days
are as a shadow that passeth away.
original_text:
Man is like to vanity: his days
are as a shadow that passeth away.

translated_text: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
original_text: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

translated_text: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.
original_text: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.

translated_text: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
original_text: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;

translated_text:
Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand
is a right hand of falsehood.
original_text:
Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand
is a right hand of falsehood.

translated_text:
I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery
and
 an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
original_text:
I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery
and
 an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

translated_text: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
original_text: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.

translated_text:
Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand
is a right hand of falsehood:
original_text:
Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand
is a right hand of falsehood:

translated_text:
That our sons
may be as plants grown up in their youth;
that our daughters
may be as corner stones, polished
after the similitude of a palace:
original_text:
That our sons
may be as plants grown up in their youth;
that our daughters
may be as corner stones, polished
after the similitude of a palace:

translated_text:
That our garners
may be full, affording all manner of store:
that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
original_text:
That our garners
may be full, affording all manner of store:
that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:

translated_text:
That our oxen
may be strong to labour;
that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that
there be no complaining in our streets.
original_text:
That our oxen
may be strong to labour;
that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that
there be no complaining in our streets.

translated_text:
Happy
is that people, that is in such a case:
yea,
 happy
is that people, whose God
is the LORD.
original_text:
Happy
is that people, that is in such a case:
yea,
 happy
is that people, whose God
is the LORD.

translated_text:
Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me,
and in thy righteousness.
original_text:
Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me,
and in thy righteousness.

translated_text: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
original_text: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.

translated_text: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
original_text: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

translated_text: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
original_text: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.

translated_text: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
original_text: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.

translated_text:
I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul
thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
original_text:
I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul
thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.

translated_text: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
original_text: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

translated_text: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
original_text: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

translated_text: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
original_text: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.

translated_text:
Teach me to do thy will; for thou
art my God: thy spirit
is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
original_text:
Teach me to do thy will; for thou
art my God: thy spirit
is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

translated_text: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name’s sake: for thy righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.
original_text: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name’s sake: for thy righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.

translated_text:
And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I
am thy servant.
original_text:
And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I
am thy servant.

translated_text: I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.
original_text: I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.

translated_text: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
original_text: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

translated_text: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
original_text: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.

translated_text:
I looked on
my right hand, and beheld, but
there was
 no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
original_text:
I looked on
my right hand, and beheld, but
there was
 no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.

translated_text:
I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou
art my refuge
and my portion in the land of the living.
original_text:
I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou
art my refuge
and my portion in the land of the living.

translated_text: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
original_text: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.

translated_text: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
original_text: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

translated_text:
Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song,
and his praise in the congregation of saints.
original_text:
Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song,
and his praise in the congregation of saints.

translated_text: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
original_text: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

translated_text: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
original_text: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.

translated_text: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
original_text: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.

translated_text: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
original_text: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.

translated_text:
To execute vengeance upon the heathen,
and punishments upon the people;
original_text:
To execute vengeance upon the heathen,
and punishments upon the people;

translated_text: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
original_text: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

translated_text: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.
original_text: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.

translated_text: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
original_text: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.

translated_text: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
original_text: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.

translated_text: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
original_text: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.

translated_text:
Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that
be above the heavens.
original_text:
Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that
be above the heavens.

translated_text: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.
original_text: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.

translated_text: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
original_text: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.

translated_text: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
original_text: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:

translated_text: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapours; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
original_text: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapours; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
