translated_text: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
original_text: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

translated_text: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
original_text: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:

translated_text: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
original_text: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:

translated_text: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
original_text: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:

translated_text:
Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory
is above the earth and heaven.
original_text:
Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory
is above the earth and heaven.

translated_text:
He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints;
even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.
original_text:
He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints;
even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.

translated_text:
Praise ye the LORD: for
it is good to sing praises unto our God; for
it is pleasant;
and praise is comely.
original_text:
Praise ye the LORD: for
it is good to sing praises unto our God; for
it is pleasant;
and praise is comely.

translated_text: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
original_text: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.

translated_text: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
original_text: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

translated_text:
He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by
their
 names.
original_text:
He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by
their
 names.

translated_text:
Great
is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding
is infinite.
original_text:
Great
is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding
is infinite.

translated_text: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
original_text: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.

translated_text: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
original_text: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:

translated_text: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
original_text: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.

translated_text:
He giveth to the beast his food,
and to the young ravens which cry.
original_text:
He giveth to the beast his food,
and to the young ravens which cry.

translated_text: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
original_text: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.

translated_text: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
original_text: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.

translated_text: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
original_text: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.

translated_text: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.
original_text: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.

translated_text:
He maketh peace
in thy borders,
and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
original_text:
He maketh peace
in thy borders,
and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.

translated_text:
He sendeth forth his commandment
upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
original_text:
He sendeth forth his commandment
upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.

translated_text: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoar frost like ashes.
original_text: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoar frost like ashes.

translated_text: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
original_text: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?

translated_text:
He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow,
and the waters flow.
original_text:
He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow,
and the waters flow.

translated_text: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.
original_text: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.

translated_text:
He hath not dealt so with any nation: and
as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.
original_text:
He hath not dealt so with any nation: and
as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.

translated_text: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
original_text: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.

translated_text: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
original_text: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

translated_text:
Put not your trust in princes,
nor in the son of man, in whom
there is no help.
original_text:
Put not your trust in princes,
nor in the son of man, in whom
there is no help.

translated_text: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
original_text: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.

translated_text:
Happy
is he that
hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope
is in the LORD his God:
original_text:
Happy
is he that
hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope
is in the LORD his God:

translated_text:
Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein
is:
 which keepeth truth for ever:
original_text:
Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein
is:
 which keepeth truth for ever:

translated_text: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:
original_text: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:

translated_text:
The LORD openeth
the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:
original_text:
The LORD openeth
the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:

translated_text: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
original_text: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

translated_text:
The LORD shall reign for ever,
even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.
original_text:
The LORD shall reign for ever,
even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.

translated_text: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
original_text: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.

translated_text: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
original_text: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.

translated_text: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
original_text: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.

translated_text: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
original_text: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.

translated_text: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
original_text: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.

translated_text: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
original_text: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.

translated_text: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
original_text: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

translated_text:
Behold, as the eyes of servants
look unto the hand of their masters,
and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes
wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.
original_text:
Behold, as the eyes of servants
look unto the hand of their masters,
and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes
wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

translated_text: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
original_text: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

translated_text:
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease,
and with the contempt of the proud.
original_text:
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease,
and with the contempt of the proud.

translated_text: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
original_text: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.

translated_text: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
original_text: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

translated_text: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
original_text: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

translated_text: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.
original_text: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.

translated_text: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
original_text: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

translated_text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
original_text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

translated_text:
Peace be within thy walls,
and prosperity within thy palaces.
original_text:
Peace be within thy walls,
and prosperity within thy palaces.

translated_text:
For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace
be
 within thee.
original_text:
For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace
be
 within thee.

translated_text: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
original_text: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.

translated_text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
original_text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

translated_text:
My help
cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
original_text:
My help
cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

translated_text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
original_text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

translated_text: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
original_text: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

translated_text:
The LORD
is thy keeper: the LORD
is thy shade upon thy right hand.
original_text:
The LORD
is thy keeper: the LORD
is thy shade upon thy right hand.

translated_text: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
original_text: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

translated_text: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
original_text: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

translated_text: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
original_text: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

translated_text: In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
original_text: In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.

translated_text:
Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips,
and from a deceitful tongue.
original_text:
Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips,
and from a deceitful tongue.

translated_text: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
original_text: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?

translated_text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
original_text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

translated_text:
Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech,
that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
original_text:
Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech,
that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

translated_text: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
original_text: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

translated_text:
I
am for peace: but when I speak, they
are for war.
original_text:
I
am for peace: but when I speak, they
are for war.

translated_text:
Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh
but in vain.
original_text:
Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh
but in vain.

translated_text:
It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows:
for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
original_text:
It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows:
for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

translated_text:
Lo, children
are an heritage of the LORD:
and the fruit of the womb
is his reward.
original_text:
Lo, children
are an heritage of the LORD:
and the fruit of the womb
is his reward.

translated_text:
As arrows
are in the hand of a mighty man; so
are
 children of the youth.
original_text:
As arrows
are in the hand of a mighty man; so
are
 children of the youth.

translated_text:
Happy
is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
original_text:
Happy
is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

translated_text: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
original_text: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

translated_text: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.
original_text: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.

translated_text:
The LORD hath done great things for us;
whereof we are glad.
original_text:
The LORD hath done great things for us;
whereof we are glad.

translated_text: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.
original_text: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.

translated_text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
original_text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

translated_text:
He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves
with him.
original_text:
He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves
with him.

translated_text:
They that trust in the LORD
shall be as mount Zion,
which
 cannot be removed,
but abideth for ever.
original_text:
They that trust in the LORD
shall be as mount Zion,
which
 cannot be removed,
but abideth for ever.

translated_text:
As the mountains
are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD
is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
original_text:
As the mountains
are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD
is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

translated_text: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
original_text: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

translated_text:
Do good, O LORD, unto
those that be good, and
to them that are upright in their hearts.
original_text:
Do good, O LORD, unto
those that be good, and
to them that are upright in their hearts.

translated_text:
As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity:
but peace
shall be
 upon Israel.
original_text:
As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity:
but peace
shall be
 upon Israel.

translated_text:
If
it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;
original_text:
If
it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;

translated_text:
If
it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
original_text:
If
it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

translated_text: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
original_text: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

translated_text: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
original_text: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

translated_text: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
original_text: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

translated_text:
Blessed
be the LORD, who hath not given us
as a prey to their teeth.
original_text:
Blessed
be the LORD, who hath not given us
as a prey to their teeth.

translated_text: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
original_text: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

translated_text:
Our help
is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
original_text:
Our help
is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

translated_text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
original_text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:

translated_text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
original_text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

translated_text: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
original_text: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

translated_text:
The LORD
is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
original_text:
The LORD
is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

translated_text: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
original_text: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

translated_text:
Let them be as the grass
upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
original_text:
Let them be as the grass
upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

translated_text: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
original_text: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

translated_text:
Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD
be
 upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
original_text:
Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD
be
 upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.

translated_text:
Blessed
is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
original_text:
Blessed
is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.

translated_text:
For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy
shalt
 thou
be, and
it shall be well with thee.
original_text:
For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy
shalt
 thou
be, and
it shall be well with thee.

translated_text:
Thy wife
shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
original_text:
Thy wife
shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

translated_text: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.
original_text: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.

translated_text: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
original_text: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

translated_text:
Yea, thou shalt see thy children’s children,
and peace upon Israel.
original_text:
Yea, thou shalt see thy children’s children,
and peace upon Israel.

translated_text: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
original_text: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.

translated_text: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
original_text: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

translated_text: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
original_text: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

translated_text:
But
there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
original_text:
But
there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

translated_text: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
original_text: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

translated_text:
My soul
waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning:
I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
original_text:
My soul
waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning:
I say, more than they that watch for the morning.

translated_text:
Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD
there is mercy, and with him
is plenteous redemption.
original_text:
Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD
there is mercy, and with him
is plenteous redemption.

translated_text: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
original_text: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

translated_text:
Behold, bless ye the LORD, all
ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.
original_text:
Behold, bless ye the LORD, all
ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
Lift up your hands
in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
original_text:
Lift up your hands
in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.

translated_text: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
original_text: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.

translated_text:
Behold, how good and how pleasant
it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
original_text:
Behold, how good and how pleasant
it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

translated_text:
It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard,
even Aaron’s beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
original_text:
It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard,
even Aaron’s beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;

translated_text:
As the dew of Hermon,
and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing,
even
 life for evermore.
original_text:
As the dew of Hermon,
and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing,
even
 life for evermore.

translated_text:
LORD, remember David,
and all his afflictions:
original_text:
LORD, remember David,
and all his afflictions:

translated_text: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
original_text: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;

translated_text:
I will not give sleep to mine eyes,
or slumber to mine eyelids,
original_text:
I will not give sleep to mine eyes,
or slumber to mine eyelids,

translated_text:
Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty
God of Jacob.
original_text:
Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty
God of Jacob.

translated_text: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
original_text: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.

translated_text: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
original_text: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.

translated_text: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
original_text: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.

translated_text: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
original_text: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.

translated_text: For thy servant David’s sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
original_text: For thy servant David’s sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.

translated_text:
The LORD hath sworn
in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
original_text:
The LORD hath sworn
in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

translated_text: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
original_text: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.

translated_text:
For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired
it for his habitation.
original_text:
For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired
it for his habitation.

translated_text:
This
is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
original_text:
This
is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

translated_text: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
original_text: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

translated_text: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
original_text: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

translated_text: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
original_text: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

translated_text: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
original_text: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

translated_text: LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
original_text: LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

translated_text:
Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul
is even as a weaned child.
original_text:
Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul
is even as a weaned child.

translated_text: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.
original_text: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.

translated_text: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
original_text: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.

translated_text: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
original_text: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

translated_text:
In the day when I cried thou answeredst me,
and strengthenedst me
with strength in my soul.
original_text:
In the day when I cried thou answeredst me,
and strengthenedst me
with strength in my soul.

translated_text: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
original_text: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.

translated_text:
Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great
is
 the glory of the LORD.
original_text:
Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great
is
 the glory of the LORD.

translated_text:
Though the LORD
be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
original_text:
Though the LORD
be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.

translated_text: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
original_text: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.

translated_text:
The LORD will perfect
that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD,
endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
original_text:
The LORD will perfect
that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD,
endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

translated_text: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
original_text: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

translated_text: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
original_text: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

translated_text:
For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us
required of us mirth,
saying, Sing us
one of the songs of Zion.
original_text:
For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us
required of us mirth,
saying, Sing us
one of the songs of Zion.

translated_text: How shall we sing the LORD’S song in a strange land?
original_text: How shall we sing the LORD’S song in a strange land?

translated_text:
If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget
her cunning.
original_text:
If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget
her cunning.

translated_text: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
original_text: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.

translated_text:
Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase
it, rase
it, even to the foundation thereof.
original_text:
Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase
it, rase
it, even to the foundation thereof.

translated_text:
O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy
shall he be,
 that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
original_text:
O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy
shall he be,
 that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.

translated_text:
Happy
shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
original_text:
Happy
shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.

translated_text:
O give thanks unto the LORD; for
he is good: for his mercy
endureth for ever.
original_text:
O give thanks unto the LORD; for
he is good: for his mercy
endureth for ever.

translated_text:
O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy
endureth
 for ever.
original_text:
O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy
endureth
 for ever.

translated_text:
O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy
endureth
 for ever.
original_text:
O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy
endureth
 for ever.

translated_text:
To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy
endureth
 for ever.
original_text:
To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy
endureth
 for ever.

translated_text:
To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy
endureth
 for ever.
original_text:
To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy
endureth
 for ever.

translated_text:
To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy
endureth for ever.
original_text:
To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy
endureth for ever.

translated_text:
To him that made great lights: for his mercy
endureth for ever:
original_text:
To him that made great lights: for his mercy
endureth for ever:

translated_text:
The sun to rule by day: for his mercy
endureth for ever:
original_text:
The sun to rule by day: for his mercy
endureth for ever:

translated_text:
The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy
endureth
 for ever.
original_text:
The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy
endureth
 for ever.

translated_text:
With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy
endureth for ever.
original_text:
With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy
endureth for ever.

translated_text:
And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy
endureth for ever:
original_text:
And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy
endureth for ever:

translated_text:
But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy
endureth for ever.
original_text:
But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy
endureth for ever.

translated_text:
To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy
endureth for ever.
original_text:
To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy
endureth for ever.

translated_text:
To him which smote great kings: for his mercy
endureth for ever:
original_text:
To him which smote great kings: for his mercy
endureth for ever:

translated_text:
And slew famous kings: for his mercy
endureth for ever:
original_text:
And slew famous kings: for his mercy
endureth for ever:

translated_text:
Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy
endureth for ever:
original_text:
Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy
endureth for ever:

translated_text:
And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy
endureth for ever:
original_text:
And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy
endureth for ever:

translated_text:
Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy
endureth for ever.
original_text:
Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy
endureth for ever.

translated_text:
And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy
endureth
 for ever.
original_text:
And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy
endureth
 for ever.

translated_text:
Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy
endureth for ever.
original_text:
Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy
endureth for ever.

translated_text:
O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy
endureth
 for ever.
original_text:
O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy
endureth
 for ever.

translated_text:
Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise
him,
 O ye servants of the LORD.
original_text:
Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise
him,
 O ye servants of the LORD.

translated_text: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,
original_text: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,

translated_text:
Praise the LORD; for the LORD
is good: sing praises unto his name; for
it is pleasant.
original_text:
Praise the LORD; for the LORD
is good: sing praises unto his name; for
it is pleasant.

translated_text:
For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself,
and Israel for his peculiar treasure.
original_text:
For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself,
and Israel for his peculiar treasure.

translated_text:
For I know that the LORD
is great, and
that our Lord
is above all gods.
original_text:
For I know that the LORD
is great, and
that our Lord
is above all gods.

translated_text:
Whatsoever the LORD pleased,
that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
original_text:
Whatsoever the LORD pleased,
that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.

translated_text: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.
original_text: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.

translated_text: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.
original_text: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.

translated_text: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
original_text: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

translated_text: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
original_text: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;

translated_text: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:
original_text: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:

translated_text:
And gave their land
for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.
original_text:
And gave their land
for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.

translated_text: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.
original_text: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.

translated_text:
The idols of the heathen
are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
original_text:
The idols of the heathen
are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

translated_text: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
original_text: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;

translated_text:
They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there
any breath in their mouths.
original_text:
They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there
any breath in their mouths.

translated_text:
They that make them are like unto them:
so is every one that trusteth in them.
original_text:
They that make them are like unto them:
so is every one that trusteth in them.

translated_text: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel: bless the LORD, O house of Aaron:
original_text: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel: bless the LORD, O house of Aaron:

translated_text: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.
original_text: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.

translated_text: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
original_text: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.

translated_text:
O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known
me.
original_text:
O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known
me.

translated_text: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
original_text: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.

translated_text:
Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted
with
 all my ways.
original_text:
Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted
with
 all my ways.

translated_text:
For
there is not a word in my tongue,
but, lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.
original_text:
For
there is not a word in my tongue,
but, lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.

translated_text: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
original_text: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.

translated_text:
Such knowledge
is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot
attain unto it.
original_text:
Such knowledge
is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot
attain unto it.

translated_text: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
original_text: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

translated_text:
If I ascend up into heaven, thou
art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou
art there.
original_text:
If I ascend up into heaven, thou
art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou
art there.

translated_text:
If I take the wings of the morning,
and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
original_text:
If I take the wings of the morning,
and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

translated_text: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
original_text: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

translated_text: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
original_text: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.

translated_text:
Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light
are both alike
to thee.
original_text:
Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light
are both alike
to thee.

translated_text: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother’s womb.
original_text: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother’s womb.

translated_text:
I will praise thee; for I am fearfully
and wonderfully made: marvellous
are thy works; and
that my soul knoweth right well.
original_text:
I will praise thee; for I am fearfully
and wonderfully made: marvellous
are thy works; and
that my soul knoweth right well.

translated_text:
My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret,
and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
original_text:
My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret,
and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

translated_text:
Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all
my members were written,
which in continuance were fashioned, when
as yet there was none of them.
original_text:
Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all
my members were written,
which in continuance were fashioned, when
as yet there was none of them.

translated_text: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
original_text: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!

translated_text: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
original_text: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.

translated_text: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
original_text: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.

translated_text:
For they speak against thee wickedly,
and thine enemies take
thy name in vain.
original_text:
For they speak against thee wickedly,
and thine enemies take
thy name in vain.

translated_text: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
original_text: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

translated_text: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
original_text: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.

translated_text: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
original_text: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:

translated_text:
And see if
there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
original_text:
And see if
there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

translated_text: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
original_text: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?

translated_text: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
original_text: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.

translated_text: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.
original_text: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.

translated_text:
Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice
is to the sons of man.
original_text:
Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice
is to the sons of man.

translated_text: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
original_text: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.

translated_text:
Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips
shall be right things.
original_text:
Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips
shall be right things.

translated_text:
For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness
is an abomination to my lips.
original_text:
For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness
is an abomination to my lips.

translated_text:
All the words of my mouth
are in righteousness;
there is
 nothing froward or perverse in them.
original_text:
All the words of my mouth
are in righteousness;
there is
 nothing froward or perverse in them.

translated_text:
They
are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
original_text:
They
are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.

translated_text: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.
original_text: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.

translated_text:
For wisdom
is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
original_text:
For wisdom
is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.

translated_text: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
original_text: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.

translated_text:
The fear of the LORD
is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.
original_text:
The fear of the LORD
is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.

translated_text:
Counsel
is mine, and sound wisdom: I
am understanding; I have strength.
original_text:
Counsel
is mine, and sound wisdom: I
am understanding; I have strength.

translated_text: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
original_text: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

translated_text:
By me princes rule, and nobles,
even all the judges of the earth.
original_text:
By me princes rule, and nobles,
even all the judges of the earth.

translated_text: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
original_text: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.

translated_text:
My fruit
is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.
original_text:
My fruit
is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.

translated_text: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:
original_text: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:

translated_text: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
original_text: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.

translated_text: The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
original_text: The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.

translated_text: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.
original_text: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.

translated_text:
When
there were no depths, I was brought forth; when
there were no fountains abounding with water.
original_text:
When
there were no depths, I was brought forth; when
there were no fountains abounding with water.

translated_text: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
original_text: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:

translated_text: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
original_text: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.

translated_text:
When he prepared the heavens, I
was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
original_text:
When he prepared the heavens, I
was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:

translated_text: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
original_text: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:

translated_text: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
original_text: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:

translated_text:
Then I was by him,
as one brought up
with him:
 and I was daily
his delight, rejoicing always before him;
original_text:
Then I was by him,
as one brought up
with him:
 and I was daily
his delight, rejoicing always before him;

translated_text:
Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights
were with the sons of men.
original_text:
Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights
were with the sons of men.

translated_text:
Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed
are they that keep my ways.
original_text:
Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed
are they that keep my ways.

translated_text: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
original_text: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.

translated_text:
Blessed
is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
original_text:
Blessed
is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.

translated_text: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD.
original_text: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD.

translated_text: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
original_text: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.

translated_text: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
original_text: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:

translated_text: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.
original_text: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.

translated_text: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,
original_text: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,

translated_text:
Whoso
is simple, let him turn in hither:
as for
 him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
original_text:
Whoso
is simple, let him turn in hither:
as for
 him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

translated_text:
Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine
which I have mingled.
original_text:
Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine
which I have mingled.

translated_text: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.
original_text: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.

translated_text:
He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked
man getteth himself a blot.
original_text:
He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked
man getteth himself a blot.

translated_text: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.
original_text: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.

translated_text:
Give
instruction to a wise
man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just
man, and he will increase in learning.
original_text:
Give
instruction to a wise
man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just
man, and he will increase in learning.

translated_text:
The fear of the LORD
is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy
is understanding.
original_text:
The fear of the LORD
is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy
is understanding.

translated_text: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
original_text: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.

translated_text:
If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but
if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear
it.
original_text:
If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but
if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear
it.

translated_text:
A foolish woman
is clamorous:
she is simple, and knoweth nothing.
original_text:
A foolish woman
is clamorous:
she is simple, and knoweth nothing.

translated_text: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
original_text: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

translated_text: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
original_text: To call passengers who go right on their ways:

translated_text:
Whoso
is simple, let him turn in hither: and
as for
 him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
original_text:
Whoso
is simple, let him turn in hither: and
as for
 him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

translated_text:
Stolen waters are sweet, and bread
eaten in secret is pleasant.
original_text:
Stolen waters are sweet, and bread
eaten in secret is pleasant.

translated_text:
But he knoweth not that the dead
are there;
and that
 her guests
are in the depths of hell.
original_text:
But he knoweth not that the dead
are there;
and that
 her guests
are in the depths of hell.

translated_text: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;
original_text: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;

translated_text:
So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom,
and apply thine heart to understanding;
original_text:
So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom,
and apply thine heart to understanding;

translated_text:
Yea, if thou criest after knowledge,
and liftest up thy voice for understanding;
original_text:
Yea, if thou criest after knowledge,
and liftest up thy voice for understanding;

translated_text: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
original_text: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.

translated_text:
For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth
cometh knowledge and understanding.
original_text:
For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth
cometh knowledge and understanding.

translated_text:
He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous:
he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
original_text:
He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous:
he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.

translated_text: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.
original_text: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.

translated_text:
Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity;
yea, every good path.
original_text:
Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity;
yea, every good path.

translated_text: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
original_text: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;

translated_text: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
original_text: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:

translated_text:
To deliver thee from the way of the evil
man, from the man that speaketh froward things;
original_text:
To deliver thee from the way of the evil
man, from the man that speaketh froward things;

translated_text: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
original_text: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;

translated_text:
Who rejoice to do evil,
and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
original_text:
Who rejoice to do evil,
and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;

translated_text:
Whose ways
are crooked, and
they froward in their paths:
original_text:
Whose ways
are crooked, and
they froward in their paths:

translated_text: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.
original_text: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.

translated_text: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
original_text: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.

translated_text: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
original_text: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.

translated_text:
That thou mayest walk in the way of good
men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
original_text:
That thou mayest walk in the way of good
men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

translated_text: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
original_text: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.

translated_text: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
original_text: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.

translated_text: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
original_text: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:

translated_text: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.
original_text: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.

translated_text: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
original_text: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:

translated_text: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
original_text: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

translated_text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
original_text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

translated_text: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
original_text: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

translated_text: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
original_text: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.

translated_text: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
original_text: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.

translated_text: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
original_text: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:

translated_text: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
original_text: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.

translated_text: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:
original_text: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:

translated_text:
For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son
in whom he delighteth.
original_text:
For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son
in whom he delighteth.

translated_text:
Happy
is the man
that findeth wisdom, and the man
that getteth understanding.
original_text:
Happy
is the man
that findeth wisdom, and the man
that getteth understanding.

translated_text:
For the merchandise of it
is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
original_text:
For the merchandise of it
is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.

translated_text:
She
is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
original_text:
She
is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.

translated_text:
Her ways
are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths
are peace.
original_text:
Her ways
are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths
are peace.

translated_text:
She
is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy
is every one that retaineth her.
original_text:
She
is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy
is every one that retaineth her.

translated_text: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
original_text: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.

translated_text: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
original_text: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.

translated_text: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
original_text: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:

translated_text: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
original_text: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.

translated_text: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
original_text: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.

translated_text: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
original_text: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

translated_text: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
original_text: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.

translated_text: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
original_text: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.

translated_text:
Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do
it.
original_text:
Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do
it.

translated_text: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
original_text: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.

translated_text: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
original_text: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

translated_text: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
original_text: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.

translated_text: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
original_text: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.

translated_text:
For the froward
is abomination to the LORD: but his secret
is with the righteous.
original_text:
For the froward
is abomination to the LORD: but his secret
is with the righteous.

translated_text:
The curse of the LORD
is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
original_text:
The curse of the LORD
is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.

translated_text: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
original_text: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.

translated_text: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
original_text: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.

translated_text: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
original_text: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

translated_text: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
original_text: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;

translated_text: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
original_text: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;

translated_text: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
original_text: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.

translated_text:
A wise
man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
original_text:
A wise
man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:

translated_text: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
original_text: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

translated_text:
The fear of the LORD
is the beginning of knowledge:
but
 fools despise wisdom and instruction.
original_text:
The fear of the LORD
is the beginning of knowledge:
but
 fools despise wisdom and instruction.

translated_text: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
original_text: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

translated_text:
For they
shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
original_text:
For they
shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.

translated_text: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
original_text: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.

translated_text: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
original_text: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:

translated_text: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
original_text: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:

translated_text: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
original_text: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:

translated_text: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
original_text: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:

translated_text: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
original_text: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:

translated_text: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
original_text: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.

translated_text: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.
original_text: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.

translated_text:
And they lay wait for their
own blood; they lurk privily for their
own lives.
original_text:
And they lay wait for their
own blood; they lurk privily for their
own lives.

translated_text: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:
original_text: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:

translated_text:
She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words,
saying,
original_text:
She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words,
saying,

translated_text: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
original_text: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?

translated_text: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
original_text: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.

translated_text: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
original_text: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;

translated_text: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
original_text: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:

translated_text: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
original_text: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;

translated_text: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
original_text: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.

translated_text: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
original_text: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:

translated_text: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:
original_text: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:

translated_text: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
original_text: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.

translated_text: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
original_text: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.

translated_text: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
original_text: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.

translated_text: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
original_text: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.

translated_text:
My son, if thou be surety for thy friend,
if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
original_text:
My son, if thou be surety for thy friend,
if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,

translated_text: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
original_text: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.

translated_text: Do this now, my son, deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.
original_text: Do this now, my son, deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.

translated_text: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
original_text: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.

translated_text:
Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand
of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
original_text:
Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand
of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

translated_text: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
original_text: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:

translated_text: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
original_text: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,

translated_text:
Provideth her meat in the summer,
and gathereth her food in the harvest.
original_text:
Provideth her meat in the summer,
and gathereth her food in the harvest.

translated_text: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
original_text: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?

translated_text: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
original_text: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

translated_text: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
original_text: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.

translated_text: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
original_text: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.

translated_text: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
original_text: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;

translated_text:
Frowardness
is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.
original_text:
Frowardness
is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.

translated_text: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
original_text: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.

translated_text:
These six
things doth the LORD hate: yea, seven
are
 an abomination unto him:
original_text:
These six
things doth the LORD hate: yea, seven
are
 an abomination unto him:

translated_text: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
original_text: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,

translated_text: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
original_text: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,

translated_text:
A false witness
that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
original_text:
A false witness
that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.

translated_text: My son, keep thy father’s commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
original_text: My son, keep thy father’s commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

translated_text:
Bind them continually upon thine heart,
and tie them about thy neck.
original_text:
Bind them continually upon thine heart,
and tie them about thy neck.

translated_text:
When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and
when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
original_text:
When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and
when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.

translated_text:
For the commandment
is a lamp; and the law
is light; and reproofs of instruction
are the way of life:
original_text:
For the commandment
is a lamp; and the law
is light; and reproofs of instruction
are the way of life:

translated_text: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.
original_text: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.

translated_text: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
original_text: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.

translated_text:
For by means of a whorish woman
a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.
original_text:
For by means of a whorish woman
a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.

translated_text: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
original_text: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?

translated_text: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
original_text: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?

translated_text: So he that goeth in to his neighbour’s wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
original_text: So he that goeth in to his neighbour’s wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.

translated_text: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
original_text: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;

translated_text:
But
if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
original_text:
But
if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.

translated_text:
But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he
that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.
original_text:
But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he
that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.

translated_text: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
original_text: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.

translated_text:
For jealousy
is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
original_text:
For jealousy
is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

translated_text: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
original_text: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.

translated_text: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
original_text: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.

translated_text: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.
original_text: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.
