translated_text: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.
original_text: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.

translated_text:
Say unto wisdom, Thou
art my sister; and call understanding
thy kinswoman:
original_text:
Say unto wisdom, Thou
art my sister; and call understanding
thy kinswoman:

translated_text:
That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger
which flattereth with her words.
original_text:
That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger
which flattereth with her words.

translated_text: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
original_text: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,

translated_text: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
original_text: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,

translated_text: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,
original_text: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,

translated_text: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:
original_text: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:

translated_text:
And, behold, there met him a woman
with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.
original_text:
And, behold, there met him a woman
with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.

translated_text:
(She
is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:
original_text:
(She
is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:

translated_text:
Now
is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)
original_text:
Now
is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)

translated_text:
So she caught him, and kissed him,
and with an impudent face said unto him,
original_text:
So she caught him, and kissed him,
and with an impudent face said unto him,

translated_text: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.
original_text: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.

translated_text: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
original_text: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.

translated_text:
I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved
works,
 with fine linen of Egypt.
original_text:
I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved
works,
 with fine linen of Egypt.

translated_text: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
original_text: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

translated_text: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
original_text: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.

translated_text:
For the goodman
is not at home, he is gone a long journey:
original_text:
For the goodman
is not at home, he is gone a long journey:

translated_text:
He hath taken a bag of money with him,
and will come home at the day appointed.
original_text:
He hath taken a bag of money with him,
and will come home at the day appointed.

translated_text: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
original_text: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.

translated_text: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;
original_text: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;

translated_text:
Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it
is for his life.
original_text:
Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it
is for his life.

translated_text: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
original_text: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.

translated_text: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
original_text: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.

translated_text:
For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong
men
 have been slain by her.
original_text:
For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong
men
 have been slain by her.

translated_text:
Her house
is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
original_text:
Her house
is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.

translated_text: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
original_text: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.

translated_text: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
original_text: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.

translated_text:
For I was my father’s son, tender and only
beloved in the sight of my mother.
original_text:
For I was my father’s son, tender and only
beloved in the sight of my mother.

translated_text: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
original_text: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.

translated_text:
Get wisdom, get understanding: forget
it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
original_text:
Get wisdom, get understanding: forget
it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.

translated_text: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
original_text: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.

translated_text: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
original_text: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.

translated_text: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.
original_text: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.

translated_text: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
original_text: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.

translated_text: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
original_text: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.

translated_text: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
original_text: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.

translated_text:
Take fast hold of instruction; let
her not go: keep her; for she
is thy life.
original_text:
Take fast hold of instruction; let
her not go: keep her; for she
is thy life.

translated_text:
Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil
men.
original_text:
Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil
men.

translated_text: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
original_text: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.

translated_text:
For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause
some to fall.
original_text:
For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause
some to fall.

translated_text: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
original_text: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.

translated_text:
But the path of the just
is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
original_text:
But the path of the just
is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

translated_text:
The way of the wicked
is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
original_text:
The way of the wicked
is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.

translated_text: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
original_text: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.

translated_text: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
original_text: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.

translated_text:
For they
are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
original_text:
For they
are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.

translated_text:
Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it
are the issues of life.
original_text:
Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it
are the issues of life.

translated_text: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.
original_text: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.

translated_text: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
original_text: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.

translated_text: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
original_text: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.

translated_text: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
original_text: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.

translated_text:
My son, attend unto my wisdom,
and bow thine ear to my understanding:
original_text:
My son, attend unto my wisdom,
and bow thine ear to my understanding:

translated_text:
That thou mayest regard discretion, and
that thy lips may keep knowledge.
original_text:
That thou mayest regard discretion, and
that thy lips may keep knowledge.

translated_text:
For the lips of a strange woman drop
as an honeycomb, and her mouth
is smoother than oil:
original_text:
For the lips of a strange woman drop
as an honeycomb, and her mouth
is smoother than oil:

translated_text: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.
original_text: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.

translated_text: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
original_text: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.

translated_text:
Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable,
that thou canst not know
them.
original_text:
Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable,
that thou canst not know
them.

translated_text: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.
original_text: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.

translated_text: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:
original_text: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:

translated_text: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:
original_text: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:

translated_text: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
original_text: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,

translated_text: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
original_text: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;

translated_text: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
original_text: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!

translated_text: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
original_text: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.

translated_text: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.
original_text: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.

translated_text:
Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad,
and rivers of waters in the streets.
original_text:
Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad,
and rivers of waters in the streets.

translated_text: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers’ with thee.
original_text: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers’ with thee.

translated_text: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
original_text: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.

translated_text: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.
original_text: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.

translated_text: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?
original_text: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?

translated_text:
For the ways of man
are before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.
original_text:
For the ways of man
are before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.

translated_text: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.
original_text: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.

translated_text: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
original_text: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.

translated_text:
The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son
is the heaviness of his mother.
original_text:
The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son
is the heaviness of his mother.

translated_text: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.
original_text: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.

translated_text: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.
original_text: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.

translated_text:
He becometh poor that dealeth
with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
original_text:
He becometh poor that dealeth
with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.

translated_text:
He that gathereth in summer
is a wise son:
but he that sleepeth in harvest
is a son that causeth shame.
original_text:
He that gathereth in summer
is a wise son:
but he that sleepeth in harvest
is a son that causeth shame.

translated_text:
Blessings
are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
original_text:
Blessings
are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

translated_text: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
original_text: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.

translated_text: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
original_text: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.

translated_text: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
original_text: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.

translated_text: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
original_text: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.

translated_text:
The mouth of a righteous
man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
original_text:
The mouth of a righteous
man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

translated_text: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
original_text: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.

translated_text:
In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod
is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
original_text:
In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod
is for the back of him that is void of understanding.

translated_text:
Wise
men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish
is near destruction.
original_text:
Wise
men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish
is near destruction.

translated_text:
The rich man’s wealth
is his strong city: the destruction of the poor
is their poverty.
original_text:
The rich man’s wealth
is his strong city: the destruction of the poor
is their poverty.

translated_text:
The labour of the righteous
tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
original_text:
The labour of the righteous
tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.

translated_text:
He
is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
original_text:
He
is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.

translated_text:
He that hideth hatred
with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander,
is a fool.
original_text:
He that hideth hatred
with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander,
is a fool.

translated_text:
In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips
is wise.
original_text:
In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips
is wise.

translated_text:
The tongue of the just
is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked
is little worth.
original_text:
The tongue of the just
is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked
is little worth.

translated_text: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
original_text: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.

translated_text: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
original_text: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.

translated_text: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
original_text: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.

translated_text: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
original_text: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

translated_text:
As the whirlwind passeth, so
is the wicked no
more:
 but the righteous
is an everlasting foundation.
original_text:
As the whirlwind passeth, so
is the wicked no
more:
 but the righteous
is an everlasting foundation.

translated_text:
As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so
is
 the sluggard to them that send him.
original_text:
As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so
is
 the sluggard to them that send him.

translated_text: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
original_text: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

translated_text:
The hope of the righteous
shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
original_text:
The hope of the righteous
shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.

translated_text:
The way of the LORD
is strength to the upright: but destruction
shall be to the workers of iniquity.
original_text:
The way of the LORD
is strength to the upright: but destruction
shall be to the workers of iniquity.

translated_text: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
original_text: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.

translated_text: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
original_text: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.

translated_text:
The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked
speaketh frowardness.
original_text:
The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked
speaketh frowardness.

translated_text:
Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof
is brutish.
original_text:
Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof
is brutish.

translated_text:
A good
man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
original_text:
A good
man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.

translated_text: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
original_text: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

translated_text:
A virtuous woman
is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed
is as rottenness in his bones.
original_text:
A virtuous woman
is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed
is as rottenness in his bones.

translated_text:
The thoughts of the righteous
are right:
but the counsels of the wicked
are deceit.
original_text:
The thoughts of the righteous
are right:
but the counsels of the wicked
are deceit.

translated_text:
The words of the wicked
are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
original_text:
The words of the wicked
are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

translated_text:
The wicked are overthrown, and
are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
original_text:
The wicked are overthrown, and
are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.

translated_text: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
original_text: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.

translated_text:
He that is despised, and hath a servant,
is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
original_text:
He that is despised, and hath a servant,
is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.

translated_text:
A righteous
man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked
are cruel.
original_text:
A righteous
man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked
are cruel.

translated_text:
He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain
persons is void of understanding.
original_text:
He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain
persons is void of understanding.

translated_text:
The wicked desireth the net of evil
men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth
fruit.
original_text:
The wicked desireth the net of evil
men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth
fruit.

translated_text:
The wicked is snared by the transgression of
his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
original_text:
The wicked is snared by the transgression of
his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.

translated_text:
A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of
his mouth: and the recompense of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.
original_text:
A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of
his mouth: and the recompense of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.

translated_text:
The way of a fool
is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel
is wise.
original_text:
The way of a fool
is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel
is wise.

translated_text:
A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent
man covereth shame.
original_text:
A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent
man covereth shame.

translated_text: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
original_text: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.

translated_text:
There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise
is health.
original_text:
There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise
is health.

translated_text:
The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue
is but for a moment.
original_text:
The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue
is but for a moment.

translated_text:
Deceit
is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace
is joy.
original_text:
Deceit
is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace
is joy.

translated_text: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
original_text: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.

translated_text:
Lying lips
are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly
are his delight.
original_text:
Lying lips
are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly
are his delight.

translated_text: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
original_text: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.

translated_text: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
original_text: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.

translated_text: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
original_text: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.

translated_text:
The righteous
is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
original_text:
The righteous
is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.

translated_text:
The slothful
man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man
is precious.
original_text:
The slothful
man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man
is precious.

translated_text:
In the way of righteousness
is life; and
in the pathway
thereof there is no death.
original_text:
In the way of righteousness
is life; and
in the pathway
thereof there is no death.

translated_text:
A false balance
is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight
is his delight.
original_text:
A false balance
is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight
is his delight.

translated_text:
When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly
is wisdom.
original_text:
When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly
is wisdom.

translated_text: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
original_text: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.

translated_text: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
original_text: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.

translated_text: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
original_text: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

translated_text:
The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in
their own naughtiness.
original_text:
The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in
their own naughtiness.

translated_text:
When a wicked man dieth,
his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust
men perisheth.
original_text:
When a wicked man dieth,
his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust
men perisheth.

translated_text: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
original_text: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.

translated_text:
An hypocrite with
his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
original_text:
An hypocrite with
his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.

translated_text:
When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish,
there is shouting.
original_text:
When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish,
there is shouting.

translated_text: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
original_text: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

translated_text: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
original_text: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.

translated_text: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
original_text: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.

translated_text:
Where no counsel
is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors
there is safety.
original_text:
Where no counsel
is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors
there is safety.

translated_text:
He that is surety for a stranger shall smart
for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
original_text:
He that is surety for a stranger shall smart
for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.

translated_text:
A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong
men retain riches.
original_text:
A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong
men retain riches.

translated_text:
The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but
he that is
 cruel troubleth his own flesh.
original_text:
The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but
he that is
 cruel troubleth his own flesh.

translated_text:
The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness
shall be a sure reward.
original_text:
The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness
shall be a sure reward.

translated_text:
As righteousness
tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil
pursueth it to his own death.
original_text:
As righteousness
tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil
pursueth it to his own death.

translated_text:
They that are of a froward heart
are abomination to the LORD: but
such as are upright in
their way
are his delight.
original_text:
They that are of a froward heart
are abomination to the LORD: but
such as are upright in
their way
are his delight.

translated_text:
Though hand
join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
original_text:
Though hand
join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

translated_text:
As a jewel of gold in a swine’s snout,
so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
original_text:
As a jewel of gold in a swine’s snout,
so is a fair woman which is without discretion.

translated_text:
The desire of the righteous
is only good:
but the expectation of the wicked
is wrath.
original_text:
The desire of the righteous
is only good:
but the expectation of the wicked
is wrath.

translated_text:
There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and
there is
 that withholdeth more than is meet, but
it tendeth to poverty.
original_text:
There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and
there is
 that withholdeth more than is meet, but
it tendeth to poverty.

translated_text: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
original_text: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

translated_text:
He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing
shall be upon the head of him that selleth
it.
original_text:
He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing
shall be upon the head of him that selleth
it.

translated_text: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
original_text: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.

translated_text: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
original_text: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.

translated_text:
He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool
shall be servant to the wise of heart.
original_text:
He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool
shall be servant to the wise of heart.

translated_text:
The fruit of the righteous
is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls
is wise.
original_text:
The fruit of the righteous
is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls
is wise.

translated_text: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
original_text: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.

translated_text: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
original_text: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.

translated_text:
He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but
he that is
 perverse in his ways despiseth him.
original_text:
He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but
he that is
 perverse in his ways despiseth him.

translated_text: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
original_text: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.

translated_text:
Where no oxen
are, the crib
is clean: but much increase
is by the strength of the ox.
original_text:
Where no oxen
are, the crib
is clean: but much increase
is by the strength of the ox.

translated_text: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
original_text: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.

translated_text:
A scorner seeketh wisdom, and
findeth it not: but knowledge
is easy unto him that understandeth.
original_text:
A scorner seeketh wisdom, and
findeth it not: but knowledge
is easy unto him that understandeth.

translated_text:
Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not
in him the lips of knowledge.
original_text:
Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not
in him the lips of knowledge.

translated_text:
The wisdom of the prudent
is to understand his way: but the folly of fools
is deceit.
original_text:
The wisdom of the prudent
is to understand his way: but the folly of fools
is deceit.

translated_text:
Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous
there is
 favour.
original_text:
Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous
there is
 favour.

translated_text: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
original_text: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.

translated_text: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
original_text: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.

translated_text:
There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof
are the ways of death.
original_text:
There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof
are the ways of death.

translated_text:
Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth
is heaviness.
original_text:
Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth
is heaviness.

translated_text:
The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man
shall be satisfied from himself.
original_text:
The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man
shall be satisfied from himself.

translated_text:
The simple believeth every word: but the prudent
man looketh well to his going.
original_text:
The simple believeth every word: but the prudent
man looketh well to his going.

translated_text:
A wise
man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
original_text:
A wise
man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.

translated_text: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
original_text: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.

translated_text: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
original_text: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

translated_text: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
original_text: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

translated_text:
The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich
hath
 many friends.
original_text:
The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich
hath
 many friends.

translated_text:
He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy
is he.
original_text:
He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy
is he.

translated_text:
Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth
shall be
 to them that devise good.
original_text:
Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth
shall be
 to them that devise good.

translated_text:
In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips
tendeth
 only to penury.
original_text:
In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips
tendeth
 only to penury.

translated_text:
The crown of the wise is their riches:
but the foolishness of fools
is folly.
original_text:
The crown of the wise is their riches:
but the foolishness of fools
is folly.

translated_text:
A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful
witness
 speaketh lies.
original_text:
A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful
witness
 speaketh lies.

translated_text:
In the fear of the LORD
is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
original_text:
In the fear of the LORD
is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.

translated_text:
The fear of the LORD
is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
original_text:
The fear of the LORD
is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

translated_text:
In the multitude of people
is the king’s honour: but in the want of people
is the destruction of the prince.
original_text:
In the multitude of people
is the king’s honour: but in the want of people
is the destruction of the prince.

translated_text:
He that is slow to wrath
is of great understanding: but
he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
original_text:
He that is slow to wrath
is of great understanding: but
he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

translated_text:
A sound heart
is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
original_text:
A sound heart
is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.

translated_text: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
original_text: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.

translated_text: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
original_text: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.

translated_text:
Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but
that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
original_text:
Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but
that which is in the midst of fools is made known.

translated_text:
Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin
is a reproach to any people.
original_text:
Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin
is a reproach to any people.

translated_text:
The king’s favour
is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is
against him that causeth shame.
original_text:
The king’s favour
is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is
against him that causeth shame.

translated_text:
A wise son
heareth his father’s instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
original_text:
A wise son
heareth his father’s instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.

translated_text:
A man shall eat good by the fruit of
his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors
shall eat violence.
original_text:
A man shall eat good by the fruit of
his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors
shall eat violence.

translated_text:
He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life:
but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
original_text:
He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life:
but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.

translated_text:
The soul of the sluggard desireth, and
hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
original_text:
The soul of the sluggard desireth, and
hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.

translated_text:
A righteous
man hateth lying: but a wicked
man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
original_text:
A righteous
man hateth lying: but a wicked
man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.

translated_text:
Righteousness keepeth
him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
original_text:
Righteousness keepeth
him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

translated_text:
There is that maketh himself rich, yet
hath nothing:
there is that maketh himself poor, yet
hath great riches.
original_text:
There is that maketh himself rich, yet
hath nothing:
there is that maketh himself poor, yet
hath great riches.

translated_text:
The ransom of a man’s life
are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
original_text:
The ransom of a man’s life
are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.

translated_text: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
original_text: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

translated_text:
Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised
is
 wisdom.
original_text:
Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised
is
 wisdom.

translated_text:
Wealth
gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
original_text:
Wealth
gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.

translated_text:
Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but
when the desire cometh,
it is a tree of life.
original_text:
Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but
when the desire cometh,
it is a tree of life.

translated_text: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
original_text: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.

translated_text:
The law of the wise
is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
original_text:
The law of the wise
is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

translated_text:
Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors
is hard.
original_text:
Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors
is hard.

translated_text:
Every prudent
man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open
his folly.
original_text:
Every prudent
man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open
his folly.

translated_text:
A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador
is health.
original_text:
A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador
is health.

translated_text:
Poverty and shame
shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
original_text:
Poverty and shame
shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.

translated_text:
The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but
it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.
original_text:
The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but
it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.

translated_text:
He that walketh with wise
men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
original_text:
He that walketh with wise
men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.

translated_text: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repaid.
original_text: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repaid.

translated_text:
A good
man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
original_text:
A good
man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.

translated_text:
Much food
is in the tillage of the poor: but there is
that is destroyed for want of judgment.
original_text:
Much food
is in the tillage of the poor: but there is
that is destroyed for want of judgment.

translated_text: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
original_text: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.

translated_text: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
original_text: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.

translated_text:
The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue,
is from the LORD.
original_text:
The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue,
is from the LORD.

translated_text:
All the ways of a man
are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.
original_text:
All the ways of a man
are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.

translated_text: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
original_text: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.

translated_text:
The LORD hath made all
things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
original_text:
The LORD hath made all
things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

translated_text:
Every one
that is proud in heart
is an abomination to the LORD:
though hand
join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
original_text:
Every one
that is proud in heart
is an abomination to the LORD:
though hand
join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.

translated_text:
By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD
men depart from evil.
original_text:
By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD
men depart from evil.

translated_text: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
original_text: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.

translated_text:
Better
is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
original_text:
Better
is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.

translated_text: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
original_text: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.

translated_text:
A divine sentence
is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
original_text:
A divine sentence
is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.

translated_text:
A just weight and balance
are the LORD’S: all the weights of the bag
are his work.
original_text:
A just weight and balance
are the LORD’S: all the weights of the bag
are his work.

translated_text: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
original_text: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.

translated_text:
Righteous lips
are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
original_text:
Righteous lips
are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.

translated_text:
The wrath of a king
is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
original_text:
The wrath of a king
is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.

translated_text:
In the light of the king’s countenance
is life; and his favour
is as a cloud of the latter rain.
original_text:
In the light of the king’s countenance
is life; and his favour
is as a cloud of the latter rain.

translated_text:
How much better
is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
original_text:
How much better
is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

translated_text:
The highway of the upright
is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
original_text:
The highway of the upright
is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.

translated_text:
Pride
goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
original_text:
Pride
goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.

translated_text:
Better
it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
original_text:
Better
it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.

translated_text:
He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy
is he.
original_text:
He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy
is he.

translated_text: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
original_text: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.

translated_text:
Understanding
is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools
is folly.
original_text:
Understanding
is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools
is folly.

translated_text: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
original_text: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.

translated_text:
Pleasant words
are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
original_text:
Pleasant words
are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

translated_text:
There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof
are the ways of death.
original_text:
There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof
are the ways of death.

translated_text: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
original_text: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.

translated_text:
An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips
there is
 as a burning fire.
original_text:
An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips
there is
 as a burning fire.

translated_text: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
original_text: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.

translated_text:
A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way
that is not good.
original_text:
A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way
that is not good.

translated_text: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
original_text: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.

translated_text:
The hoary head
is a crown of glory,
if it be found in the way of righteousness.
original_text:
The hoary head
is a crown of glory,
if it be found in the way of righteousness.

translated_text:
He that is slow to anger
is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
original_text:
He that is slow to anger
is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

translated_text:
The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof
is of the LORD.
original_text:
The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof
is of the LORD.

translated_text: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
original_text: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

translated_text: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
original_text: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.

translated_text:
The eyes of the LORD
are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
original_text:
The eyes of the LORD
are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.

translated_text:
A wholesome tongue
is a tree of life: but perverseness therein
is a breach in the spirit.
original_text:
A wholesome tongue
is a tree of life: but perverseness therein
is a breach in the spirit.

translated_text: A fool despiseth his father’s instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
original_text: A fool despiseth his father’s instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.

translated_text:
In the house of the righteous
is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
original_text:
In the house of the righteous
is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.

translated_text:
The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish
doeth not so.
original_text:
The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish
doeth not so.

translated_text:
The sacrifice of the wicked
is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright
is his delight.
original_text:
The sacrifice of the wicked
is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright
is his delight.

translated_text:
The way of the wicked
is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
original_text:
The way of the wicked
is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.

translated_text:
Correction
is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way:
and he that hateth reproof shall die.
original_text:
Correction
is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way:
and he that hateth reproof shall die.

translated_text:
Hell and destruction
are before the LORD: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
original_text:
Hell and destruction
are before the LORD: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?

translated_text: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
original_text: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.

translated_text: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
original_text: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

translated_text: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
original_text: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.

translated_text:
All the days of the afflicted
are evil: but he that is of a merry heart
hath a continual feast.
original_text:
All the days of the afflicted
are evil: but he that is of a merry heart
hath a continual feast.

translated_text:
Better
is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
original_text:
Better
is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.

translated_text:
Better
is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
original_text:
Better
is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.

translated_text:
A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but
he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
original_text:
A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but
he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.

translated_text:
The way of the slothful
man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous
is made plain.
original_text:
The way of the slothful
man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous
is made plain.

translated_text: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
original_text: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.

translated_text:
Folly
is joy to
him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.
original_text:
Folly
is joy to
him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.

translated_text: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
original_text: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.

translated_text:
A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word
spoken
 in due season, how good
is it!
original_text:
A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word
spoken
 in due season, how good
is it!

translated_text:
The way of life
is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
original_text:
The way of life
is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.

translated_text: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
original_text: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.

translated_text:
The thoughts of the wicked
are an abomination to the LORD: but
the words of the pure
are pleasant words.
original_text:
The thoughts of the wicked
are an abomination to the LORD: but
the words of the pure
are pleasant words.

translated_text: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
original_text: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.

translated_text: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
original_text: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.

translated_text:
The LORD
is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
original_text:
The LORD
is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.

translated_text:
The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart:
and a good report maketh the bones fat.
original_text:
The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart:
and a good report maketh the bones fat.

translated_text: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
original_text: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.

translated_text: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
original_text: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.

translated_text:
The fear of the LORD
is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour
is humility.
original_text:
The fear of the LORD
is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour
is humility.

translated_text:
Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh
and
 intermeddleth with all wisdom.
original_text:
Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh
and
 intermeddleth with all wisdom.

translated_text: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
original_text: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.

translated_text:
When the wicked cometh,
then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.
original_text:
When the wicked cometh,
then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.

translated_text:
The words of a man’s mouth
are as deep waters,
and
 the wellspring of wisdom
as a flowing brook.
original_text:
The words of a man’s mouth
are as deep waters,
and
 the wellspring of wisdom
as a flowing brook.

translated_text: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
original_text: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.

translated_text: A fool’s lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.
original_text: A fool’s lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.

translated_text:
A fool’s mouth
is his destruction, and his lips
are
 the snare of his soul.
original_text:
A fool’s mouth
is his destruction, and his lips
are
 the snare of his soul.

translated_text:
The words of a talebearer
are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
original_text:
The words of a talebearer
are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

translated_text: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
original_text: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.

translated_text:
The name of the LORD
is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
original_text:
The name of the LORD
is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

translated_text:
The rich man’s wealth
is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
original_text:
The rich man’s wealth
is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.

translated_text:
Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour
is humility.
original_text:
Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour
is humility.

translated_text:
He that answereth a matter before he heareth
it, it
is folly and shame unto him.
original_text:
He that answereth a matter before he heareth
it, it
is folly and shame unto him.

translated_text: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
original_text: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?

translated_text: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
original_text: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

translated_text: A man’s gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.
original_text: A man’s gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.

translated_text:
He that is first in his own cause
seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.
original_text:
He that is first in his own cause
seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.

translated_text: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
original_text: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.

translated_text:
A brother offended
is harder to be won than a strong city: and
their contentions
are like the bars of a castle.
original_text:
A brother offended
is harder to be won than a strong city: and
their contentions
are like the bars of a castle.

translated_text:
A man’s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth;
and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
original_text:
A man’s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth;
and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.

translated_text:
Death and life
are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
original_text:
Death and life
are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.

translated_text:
Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good
thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
original_text:
Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good
thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.

translated_text: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
original_text: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.

translated_text:
A man
that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend
that sticketh closer than a brother.
original_text:
A man
that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend
that sticketh closer than a brother.

translated_text:
Better
is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices
with strife.
original_text:
Better
is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices
with strife.

translated_text: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
original_text: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.

translated_text:
The fining pot
is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.
original_text:
The fining pot
is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.

translated_text:
A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips;
and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
original_text:
A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips;
and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.

translated_text:
Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker:
and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
original_text:
Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker:
and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.

translated_text:
Children’s children
are the crown of old men; and the glory of children
are their fathers.
original_text:
Children’s children
are the crown of old men; and the glory of children
are their fathers.

translated_text: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
original_text: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.

translated_text:
A gift
is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
original_text:
A gift
is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.

translated_text:
He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth
very friends.
original_text:
He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth
very friends.

translated_text: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
original_text: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.

translated_text:
An evil
man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
original_text:
An evil
man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

translated_text: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
original_text: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

translated_text: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
original_text: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

translated_text:
The beginning of strife
is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
original_text:
The beginning of strife
is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.

translated_text:
He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both
are abomination to the LORD.
original_text:
He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both
are abomination to the LORD.

translated_text:
Wherefore
is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing
he hath no heart
to it?
original_text:
Wherefore
is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing
he hath no heart
to it?

translated_text: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
original_text: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

translated_text:
A man void of understanding striketh hands,
and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.
original_text:
A man void of understanding striketh hands,
and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.

translated_text:
He loveth transgression that loveth strife:
and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
original_text:
He loveth transgression that loveth strife:
and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.

translated_text: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
original_text: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.

translated_text:
He that begetteth a fool
doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.
original_text:
He that begetteth a fool
doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.

translated_text:
A merry heart doeth good
like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
original_text:
A merry heart doeth good
like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

translated_text:
A wicked
man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
original_text:
A wicked
man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.

translated_text:
Wisdom
is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool
are in the ends of the earth.
original_text:
Wisdom
is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool
are in the ends of the earth.

translated_text:
A foolish son
is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
original_text:
A foolish son
is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.

translated_text:
Also to punish the just
is not good,
nor to strike princes for equity.
original_text:
Also to punish the just
is not good,
nor to strike princes for equity.

translated_text:
He that hath knowledge spareth his words:
and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
original_text:
He that hath knowledge spareth his words:
and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.

translated_text:
Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise:
and
 he that shutteth his lips
is esteemed a man of understanding.
original_text:
Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise:
and
 he that shutteth his lips
is esteemed a man of understanding.

translated_text:
The words of Agur the son of Jakeh,
even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
original_text:
The words of Agur the son of Jakeh,
even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,

translated_text:
Surely I
am more brutish than
any man, and have not the understanding of a man.
original_text:
Surely I
am more brutish than
any man, and have not the understanding of a man.

translated_text: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.
original_text: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.

translated_text:
Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what
is his name, and what
is his son’s name, if thou canst tell?
original_text:
Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what
is his name, and what
is his son’s name, if thou canst tell?

translated_text:
Every word of God
is pure: he
is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
original_text:
Every word of God
is pure: he
is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.

translated_text: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.
original_text: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.

translated_text:
Two
things have I required of thee; deny me
them
 not before I die:
original_text:
Two
things have I required of thee; deny me
them
 not before I die:

translated_text: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
original_text: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:

translated_text:
Lest I be full, and deny
thee, and say, Who
is the LORD? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God
in vain.
original_text:
Lest I be full, and deny
thee, and say, Who
is the LORD? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God
in vain.

translated_text: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.
original_text: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.

translated_text:
There is a generation
that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.
original_text:
There is a generation
that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.

translated_text:
There is a generation
that are pure in their own eyes, and
yet is not washed from their filthiness.
original_text:
There is a generation
that are pure in their own eyes, and
yet is not washed from their filthiness.

translated_text: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.
original_text: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.

translated_text:
There is a generation, whose teeth
are as swords, and their jaw teeth
as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from
among men.
original_text:
There is a generation, whose teeth
are as swords, and their jaw teeth
as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from
among men.

translated_text:
The horseleach hath two daughters,
crying, Give, give. There are three
things that are never satisfied,
yea, four
things say not,
It is enough:
original_text:
The horseleach hath two daughters,
crying, Give, give. There are three
things that are never satisfied,
yea, four
things say not,
It is enough:

translated_text:
The grave; and the barren womb; the earth
that is not filled with water; and the fire
that saith not,
It is enough.
original_text:
The grave; and the barren womb; the earth
that is not filled with water; and the fire
that saith not,
It is enough.

translated_text:
The eye
that mocketh at
his father, and despiseth to obey
his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.
original_text:
The eye
that mocketh at
his father, and despiseth to obey
his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.

translated_text:
There be three
things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:
original_text:
There be three
things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:

translated_text: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.
original_text: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.

translated_text:
Such
is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.
original_text:
Such
is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.

translated_text:
For three
things the earth is disquieted, and for four
which it cannot bear:
original_text:
For three
things the earth is disquieted, and for four
which it cannot bear:

translated_text: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;
original_text: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;

translated_text:
For an odious
woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
original_text:
For an odious
woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.

translated_text:
There be four
things which are little upon the earth, but they
are exceeding wise:
original_text:
There be four
things which are little upon the earth, but they
are exceeding wise:

translated_text:
The ants
are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
original_text:
The ants
are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;

translated_text:
The conies
are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;
original_text:
The conies
are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;

translated_text: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;
original_text: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;

translated_text: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings’ palaces.
original_text: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings’ palaces.

translated_text:
There be three
things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:
original_text:
There be three
things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:

translated_text:
A lion
which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;
original_text:
A lion
which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;

translated_text:
A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom
there is
 no rising up.
original_text:
A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom
there is
 no rising up.

translated_text:
If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil,
lay thine hand upon thy mouth.
original_text:
If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil,
lay thine hand upon thy mouth.

translated_text: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.
original_text: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.

translated_text: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
original_text: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.

translated_text: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
original_text: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?

translated_text: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
original_text: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.

translated_text:
It is not for kings, O Lemuel,
it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
original_text:
It is not for kings, O Lemuel,
it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:

translated_text: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
original_text: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.

translated_text: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
original_text: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
