is my beloved, and this
is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
original_text:
His mouth
is most sweet: yea, he
is altogether lovely. This
is my beloved, and this
is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.

translated_text:
Behold, thou
art fair, my love; behold, thou
art
 fair; thou
hast doves’ eyes within thy locks: thy hair
is as a flock of goats, that appear from mount Gilead.
original_text:
Behold, thou
art fair, my love; behold, thou
art
 fair; thou
hast doves’ eyes within thy locks: thy hair
is as a flock of goats, that appear from mount Gilead.

translated_text:
Thy teeth
are like a flock
of sheep that are even
 shorn, which came up from the washing; whereof every one bear twins, and none
is barren among them.
original_text:
Thy teeth
are like a flock
of sheep that are even
 shorn, which came up from the washing; whereof every one bear twins, and none
is barren among them.

translated_text:
Thy lips
are like a thread of scarlet, and thy speech
is comely: thy temples
are like a piece of a pomegranate within thy locks.
original_text:
Thy lips
are like a thread of scarlet, and thy speech
is comely: thy temples
are like a piece of a pomegranate within thy locks.

translated_text:
Thy neck
is like the tower of David builded for an armoury, whereon there hang a thousand bucklers, all shields of mighty men.
original_text:
Thy neck
is like the tower of David builded for an armoury, whereon there hang a thousand bucklers, all shields of mighty men.

translated_text:
Thy two breasts
are like two young roes that are twins, which feed among the lilies.
original_text:
Thy two breasts
are like two young roes that are twins, which feed among the lilies.

translated_text: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, and to the hill of frankincense.
original_text: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, and to the hill of frankincense.

translated_text:
Come with me from Lebanon,
my spouse, with me from Lebanon: look from the top of Amana, from the top of Shenir and Hermon, from the lions’ dens, from the mountains of the leopards.
original_text:
Come with me from Lebanon,
my spouse, with me from Lebanon: look from the top of Amana, from the top of Shenir and Hermon, from the lions’ dens, from the mountains of the leopards.

translated_text:
Thou hast ravished my heart, my sister,
my spouse; thou hast ravished my heart with one of thine eyes, with one chain of thy neck.
original_text:
Thou hast ravished my heart, my sister,
my spouse; thou hast ravished my heart with one of thine eyes, with one chain of thy neck.

translated_text:
How fair is thy love, my sister,
my spouse! how much better is thy love than wine! and the smell of thine ointments than all spices!
original_text:
How fair is thy love, my sister,
my spouse! how much better is thy love than wine! and the smell of thine ointments than all spices!

translated_text:
Thy lips, O
my spouse, drop
as the honeycomb: honey and milk
are under thy tongue; and the smell of thy garments
is like the smell of Lebanon.
original_text:
Thy lips, O
my spouse, drop
as the honeycomb: honey and milk
are under thy tongue; and the smell of thy garments
is like the smell of Lebanon.

translated_text:
A garden inclosed
is my sister,
my spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed.
original_text:
A garden inclosed
is my sister,
my spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed.

translated_text:
Thy plants
are an orchard of pomegranates, with pleasant fruits; camphire, with spikenard,
original_text:
Thy plants
are an orchard of pomegranates, with pleasant fruits; camphire, with spikenard,

translated_text: Spikenard and saffron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices:
original_text: Spikenard and saffron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices:

translated_text: A fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, and streams from Lebanon.
original_text: A fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, and streams from Lebanon.

translated_text:
Awake, O north wind; and come, thou south; blow upon my garden,
that the spices thereof may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and eat his pleasant fruits.
original_text:
Awake, O north wind; and come, thou south; blow upon my garden,
that the spices thereof may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and eat his pleasant fruits.

translated_text:
The song of songs, which
is Solomon’s.
original_text:
The song of songs, which
is Solomon’s.

translated_text:
Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love
is
 better than wine.
original_text:
Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love
is
 better than wine.

translated_text:
Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name
is as
 ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.
original_text:
Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name
is as
 ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.

translated_text: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.
original_text: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.

translated_text:
I
am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.
original_text:
I
am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.

translated_text:
Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, where thou feedest, where thou makest
thy flock to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions?
original_text:
Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, where thou feedest, where thou makest
thy flock to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions?

translated_text: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds’ tents.
original_text: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds’ tents.

translated_text: I have compared thee, O my love, to a company of horses in Pharaoh’s chariots.
original_text: I have compared thee, O my love, to a company of horses in Pharaoh’s chariots.

translated_text:
Thy cheeks are comely with rows
of jewels, thy neck with chains
of gold.
original_text:
Thy cheeks are comely with rows
of jewels, thy neck with chains
of gold.

translated_text: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.
original_text: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.

translated_text:
While the king
sitteth at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.
original_text:
While the king
sitteth at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.

translated_text:
A bundle of myrrh
is my wellbeloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.
original_text:
A bundle of myrrh
is my wellbeloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.

translated_text:
My beloved
is unto me
as a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of En-gedi.
original_text:
My beloved
is unto me
as a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of En-gedi.

translated_text:
Behold, thou
art fair, my love; behold, thou
art
 fair; thou
hast doves’ eyes.
original_text:
Behold, thou
art fair, my love; behold, thou
art
 fair; thou
hast doves’ eyes.

translated_text:
Behold, thou
art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed
is green.
original_text:
Behold, thou
art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed
is green.

translated_text:
The beams of our house
are cedar,
and our rafters of fir.
original_text:
The beams of our house
are cedar,
and our rafters of fir.

translated_text: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.
original_text: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.

translated_text: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.
original_text: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.

translated_text:
Wherefore have we fasted,
say they, and thou seest not?
wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.
original_text:
Wherefore have we fasted,
say they, and thou seest not?
wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.

translated_text:
Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as
ye do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.
original_text:
Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as
ye do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.

translated_text:
Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul?
is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes
under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD?
original_text:
Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul?
is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes
under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD?

translated_text: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
original_text: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?

translated_text: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?
original_text: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?

translated_text: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the LORD shall be thy rereward.
original_text: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the LORD shall be thy rereward.

translated_text:
Then shalt thou call, and the LORD shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I
am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;
original_text:
Then shalt thou call, and the LORD shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I
am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;

translated_text:
And
if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness
be as the noonday:
original_text:
And
if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness
be as the noonday:

translated_text: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
original_text: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

translated_text:
And
they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
original_text:
And
they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.

translated_text:
If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath,
from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the LORD, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking
thine own words:
original_text:
If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath,
from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the LORD, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking
thine own words:

translated_text:
Then shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken
it.
original_text:
Then shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken
it.

translated_text:
The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth
it to heart: and merciful men
are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil
to come.
original_text:
The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth
it to heart: and merciful men
are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil
to come.

translated_text:
He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds,
each one
 walking
in his uprightness.
original_text:
He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds,
each one
 walking
in his uprightness.

translated_text: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.
original_text: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.

translated_text:
Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth,
and draw out the tongue?
are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,
original_text:
Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth,
and draw out the tongue?
are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,

translated_text: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?
original_text: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?

translated_text:
Among the smooth
stones of the stream
is thy portion; they, they
are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
original_text:
Among the smooth
stones of the stream
is thy portion; they, they
are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?

translated_text: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.
original_text: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.

translated_text:
Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered
thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee
a covenant with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest
it.
original_text:
Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered
thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee
a covenant with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest
it.

translated_text:
And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase
thyself even unto hell.
original_text:
And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase
thyself even unto hell.

translated_text:
Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way;
yet saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.
original_text:
Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way;
yet saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.

translated_text:
And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid
it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?
original_text:
And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid
it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?

translated_text: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.
original_text: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.

translated_text:
When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take
them: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;
original_text:
When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take
them: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;

translated_text: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
original_text: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.

translated_text:
For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name
is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy
place, with him also
that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
original_text:
For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name
is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy
place, with him also
that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.

translated_text:
For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls
which I have made.
original_text:
For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls
which I have made.

translated_text: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.
original_text: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.

translated_text: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
original_text: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.

translated_text:
I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to
him that is
 far off, and to
him that is near, saith the LORD; and I will heal him.
original_text:
I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to
him that is
 far off, and to
him that is near, saith the LORD; and I will heal him.

translated_text:
But the wicked
are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
original_text:
But the wicked
are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.

translated_text: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.
original_text: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.

translated_text: Behold, the LORD’S hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
original_text: Behold, the LORD’S hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:

translated_text:
But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid
his face from you, that he will not hear.
original_text:
But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid
his face from you, that he will not hear.

translated_text: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.
original_text: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.

translated_text:
None calleth for justice, nor
any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.
original_text:
None calleth for justice, nor
any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.

translated_text: They hatch cockatrice’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.
original_text: They hatch cockatrice’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.

translated_text:
Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works
are works of iniquity, and the act of violence
is in their hands.
original_text:
Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works
are works of iniquity, and the act of violence
is in their hands.

translated_text:
Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts
are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction
are in their paths.
original_text:
Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts
are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction
are in their paths.

translated_text:
The way of peace they know not; and
there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.
original_text:
The way of peace they know not; and
there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.

translated_text:
Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness,
but we walk in darkness.
original_text:
Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness,
but we walk in darkness.

translated_text:
We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if
we had
 no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night;
we are in desolate places as dead
men.
original_text:
We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if
we had
 no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night;
we are in desolate places as dead
men.

translated_text:
We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but
there is none; for salvation,
but it is far off from us.
original_text:
We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but
there is none; for salvation,
but it is far off from us.

translated_text:
For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions
are with us; and
as for
 our iniquities, we know them;
original_text:
For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions
are with us; and
as for
 our iniquities, we know them;

translated_text: In transgressing and lying against the LORD, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
original_text: In transgressing and lying against the LORD, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

translated_text: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.
original_text: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.

translated_text:
Yea, truth faileth; and he
that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the LORD saw
it, and it displeased him that
there was no judgment.
original_text:
Yea, truth faileth; and he
that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the LORD saw
it, and it displeased him that
there was no judgment.

translated_text:
And he saw that
there was no man, and wondered that
there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.
original_text:
And he saw that
there was no man, and wondered that
there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.

translated_text:
For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance
for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.
original_text:
For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance
for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.

translated_text:
According to
their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
original_text:
According to
their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.

translated_text: So shall they fear the name of the LORD from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD shall lift up a standard against him.
original_text: So shall they fear the name of the LORD from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD shall lift up a standard against him.

translated_text: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the LORD.
original_text: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
As for me, this
is my covenant with them, saith the LORD; My spirit that
is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed’s seed, saith the LORD, from henceforth and for ever.
original_text:
As for me, this
is my covenant with them, saith the LORD; My spirit that
is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed’s seed, saith the LORD, from henceforth and for ever.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, Where
is the bill of your mother’s divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors
is it
 to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, Where
is the bill of your mother’s divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors
is it
 to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.

translated_text:
Wherefore, when I came,
was there no man? when I called,
was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because
there is no water, and dieth for thirst.
original_text:
Wherefore, when I came,
was there no man? when I called,
was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because
there is no water, and dieth for thirst.

translated_text: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.
original_text: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.

translated_text:
The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to
him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
original_text:
The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to
him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.

translated_text: The Lord GOD hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.
original_text: The Lord GOD hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.

translated_text: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
original_text: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.

translated_text: For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
original_text: For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.

translated_text:
He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who
is mine adversary? let him come near to me.
original_text:
He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who
is mine adversary? let him come near to me.

translated_text:
Behold, the Lord GOD will help me; who
is he
that
 shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.
original_text:
Behold, the Lord GOD will help me; who
is he
that
 shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.

translated_text:
Who
is among you that feareth the LORD, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh
in darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the LORD, and stay upon his God.
original_text:
Who
is among you that feareth the LORD, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh
in darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the LORD, and stay upon his God.

translated_text:
Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass
yourselves
 about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks
that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.
original_text:
Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass
yourselves
 about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks
that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.

translated_text: Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.
original_text: Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.

translated_text:
Shake thyself from the dust; arise,
and sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.
original_text:
Shake thyself from the dust; arise,
and sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD, Ye have sold yourselves for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.
original_text: For thus saith the LORD, Ye have sold yourselves for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.

translated_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD, My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.
original_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD, My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.

translated_text: Now therefore, what have I here, saith the LORD, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, saith the LORD; and my name continually every day is blasphemed.
original_text: Now therefore, what have I here, saith the LORD, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, saith the LORD; and my name continually every day is blasphemed.

translated_text:
Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore
they shall know
 in that day that I
am he that doth speak: behold,
it is
 I.
original_text:
Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore
they shall know
 in that day that I
am he that doth speak: behold,
it is
 I.

translated_text: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!
original_text: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!

translated_text: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the LORD shall bring again Zion.
original_text: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the LORD shall bring again Zion.

translated_text: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem: for the LORD hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.
original_text: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem: for the LORD hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.

translated_text: The LORD hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.
original_text: The LORD hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.

translated_text:
Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean
thing; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the LORD.
original_text:
Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean
thing; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the LORD.

translated_text:
For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel
will be your rereward.
original_text:
For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel
will be your rereward.

translated_text: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.
original_text: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.

translated_text: As many were astonied at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:
original_text: As many were astonied at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:

translated_text:
So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for
that which had not been told them shall they see; and
that which they had not heard shall they consider.
original_text:
So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for
that which had not been told them shall they see; and
that which they had not heard shall they consider.

translated_text:
Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the LORD: look unto the rock
whence ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit
whence ye are digged.
original_text:
Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the LORD: look unto the rock
whence ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit
whence ye are digged.

translated_text:
Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah
that bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.
original_text:
Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah
that bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.

translated_text: For the LORD shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
original_text: For the LORD shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

translated_text: Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.
original_text: Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.

translated_text:
My righteousness
is near; my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm shall they trust.
original_text:
My righteousness
is near; my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm shall they trust.

translated_text: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.
original_text: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.

translated_text:
Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart
is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.
original_text:
Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart
is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.

translated_text: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.
original_text: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.

translated_text:
Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old.
Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab,
and wounded the dragon?
original_text:
Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old.
Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab,
and wounded the dragon?

translated_text: Art thou not it which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?
original_text: Art thou not it which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?

translated_text:
I,
even I,
am he that comforteth you: who
art thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man
that
 shall die, and of the son of man
which shall be made as grass;
original_text:
I,
even I,
am he that comforteth you: who
art thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man
that
 shall die, and of the son of man
which shall be made as grass;

translated_text:
And forgettest the LORD thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where
is the fury of the oppressor?
original_text:
And forgettest the LORD thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where
is the fury of the oppressor?

translated_text: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.
original_text: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.

translated_text:
But I
am the LORD thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The LORD of hosts
is his name.
original_text:
But I
am the LORD thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The LORD of hosts
is his name.

translated_text:
And I have put my words in thy mouth, and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou
art my people.
original_text:
And I have put my words in thy mouth, and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou
art my people.

translated_text:
Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the LORD the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling,
and wrung
them out.
original_text:
Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the LORD the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling,
and wrung
them out.

translated_text:
There is none to guide her among all the sons
whom
 she hath brought forth; neither
is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons
that she hath brought up.
original_text:
There is none to guide her among all the sons
whom
 she hath brought forth; neither
is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons
that she hath brought up.

translated_text:
These two
things are come unto thee; who shall be sorry for thee? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort thee?
original_text:
These two
things are come unto thee; who shall be sorry for thee? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort thee?

translated_text: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the LORD, the rebuke of thy God.
original_text: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the LORD, the rebuke of thy God.

translated_text: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:
original_text: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:

translated_text:
Thus saith thy Lord the LORD, and thy God
that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling,
even the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again:
original_text:
Thus saith thy Lord the LORD, and thy God
that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling,
even the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again:

translated_text: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee; which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.
original_text: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee; which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.

translated_text:
Sing, O barren, thou
that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou
that didst not travail with child: for more
are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Sing, O barren, thou
that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou
that didst not travail with child: for more
are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;
original_text: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;

translated_text: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
original_text: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.

translated_text: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.
original_text: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.

translated_text:
For thy Maker
is thine husband; the LORD of hosts
is
 his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.
original_text:
For thy Maker
is thine husband; the LORD of hosts
is
 his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.

translated_text: For the LORD hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.
original_text: For the LORD hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.

translated_text: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
original_text: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.

translated_text: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the LORD thy Redeemer.
original_text: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the LORD thy Redeemer.

translated_text:
For this
is as the waters of Noah unto me: for
as
 I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.
original_text:
For this
is as the waters of Noah unto me: for
as
 I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.

translated_text: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
original_text: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.

translated_text:
O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest,
and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colors, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.
original_text:
O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest,
and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colors, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.

translated_text: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.
original_text: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.

translated_text:
And all thy children
shall be taught of the LORD; and great
shall be the peace of thy children.
original_text:
And all thy children
shall be taught of the LORD; and great
shall be the peace of thy children.

translated_text: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.
original_text: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.

translated_text:
Behold, they shall surely gather together,
but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.
original_text:
Behold, they shall surely gather together,
but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.

translated_text: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.
original_text: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.

translated_text:
No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue
that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This
is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness
is of me, saith the LORD.
original_text:
No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue
that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This
is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness
is of me, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the LORD revealed?
original_text: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the LORD revealed?

translated_text:
For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him,
there is no beauty that we should desire him.
original_text:
For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him,
there is no beauty that we should desire him.

translated_text:
He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were
our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
original_text:
He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were
our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.

translated_text: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.
original_text: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.

translated_text:
But he
was wounded for our transgressions,
he was
 bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace
was
 upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
original_text:
But he
was wounded for our transgressions,
he was
 bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace
was
 upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

translated_text: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
original_text: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.

translated_text: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
original_text: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.

translated_text: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.
original_text: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.

translated_text:
And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither
was any deceit in his mouth.
original_text:
And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither
was any deceit in his mouth.

translated_text:
Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him; he hath put
him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see
his seed, he shall prolong
his days, and the pleasure of the LORD shall prosper in his hand.
original_text:
Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him; he hath put
him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see
his seed, he shall prolong
his days, and the pleasure of the LORD shall prosper in his hand.

translated_text:
He shall see of the travail of his soul,
and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
original_text:
He shall see of the travail of his soul,
and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.

translated_text:
Therefore will I divide him
a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
original_text:
Therefore will I divide him
a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation
is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation
is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.

translated_text:
Blessed
is the man
that doeth this, and the son of man
that layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.
original_text:
Blessed
is the man
that doeth this, and the son of man
that layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.

translated_text:
Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to the LORD, speak, saying, The LORD hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I
am a dry tree.
original_text:
Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to the LORD, speak, saying, The LORD hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I
am a dry tree.

translated_text:
For thus saith the LORD unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose
the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;
original_text:
For thus saith the LORD unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose
the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;

translated_text: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.
original_text: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.

translated_text: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the LORD, to serve him, and to love the name of the LORD, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;
original_text: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the LORD, to serve him, and to love the name of the LORD, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;

translated_text:
Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices
shall be
 accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.
original_text:
Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices
shall be
 accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.

translated_text:
The Lord GOD which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith, Yet will I gather
others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
original_text:
The Lord GOD which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith, Yet will I gather
others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.

translated_text:
All ye beasts of the field, come to devour,
yea, all ye beasts in the forest.
original_text:
All ye beasts of the field, come to devour,
yea, all ye beasts in the forest.

translated_text:
His watchmen
are blind: they are all ignorant, they
are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.
original_text:
His watchmen
are blind: they are all ignorant, they
are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.

translated_text:
Yea,
they are greedy dogs
which can never have enough, and they
are shepherds
that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.
original_text:
Yea,
they are greedy dogs
which can never have enough, and they
are shepherds
that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.

translated_text:
Come ye,
say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day,
and
 much more abundant.
original_text:
Come ye,
say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day,
and
 much more abundant.

translated_text: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
original_text: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

translated_text:
Wherefore do ye spend money for
that which is not bread? and your labour for
that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye
that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.
original_text:
Wherefore do ye spend money for
that which is not bread? and your labour for
that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye
that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.

translated_text:
Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you,
even the sure mercies of David.
original_text:
Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you,
even the sure mercies of David.

translated_text:
Behold, I have given him
for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.
original_text:
Behold, I have given him
for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.

translated_text:
Behold, thou shalt call a nation
that thou knowest not, and nations
that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the LORD thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.
original_text:
Behold, thou shalt call a nation
that thou knowest not, and nations
that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the LORD thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.

translated_text: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:
original_text: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:

translated_text: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the LORD, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.
original_text: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the LORD, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.

translated_text:
For my thoughts
are not your thoughts, neither
are
 your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
original_text:
For my thoughts
are not your thoughts, neither
are
 your ways my ways, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
For
as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
original_text:
For
as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

translated_text: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:
original_text: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:

translated_text:
So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper
in the thing whereto I sent it.
original_text:
So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper
in the thing whereto I sent it.

translated_text:
For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap
their hands.
original_text:
For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap
their hands.

translated_text:
Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the LORD for a name, for an everlasting sign
that shall not be cut off.
original_text:
Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the LORD for a name, for an everlasting sign
that shall not be cut off.

translated_text:
Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground:
there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.
original_text:
Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground:
there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.

translated_text: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.
original_text: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.

translated_text:
Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet
thee as a man.
original_text:
Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet
thee as a man.

translated_text:
As for our redeemer, the LORD of hosts
is his name, the Holy One of Israel.
original_text:
As for our redeemer, the LORD of hosts
is his name, the Holy One of Israel.

translated_text: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.
original_text: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.

translated_text: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.
original_text: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.

translated_text:
And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever:
so that thou didst not lay these
things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.
original_text:
And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever:
so that thou didst not lay these
things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.

translated_text:
Therefore hear now this,
thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I
am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit
as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:
original_text:
Therefore hear now this,
thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I
am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit
as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:

translated_text:
But these two
things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries,
and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.
original_text:
But these two
things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries,
and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.

translated_text:
For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I
am, and none else beside me.
original_text:
For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I
am, and none else beside me.

translated_text:
Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put if off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly,
which thou shalt not know.
original_text:
Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put if off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly,
which thou shalt not know.

translated_text: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.
original_text: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.

translated_text:
Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from
these things that shall come upon thee.
original_text:
Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from
these things that shall come upon thee.

translated_text:
Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame:
there shall
 not
be a coal to warm at,
nor fire to sit before it.
original_text:
Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame:
there shall
 not
be a coal to warm at,
nor fire to sit before it.

translated_text:
Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured,
even
 thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.
original_text:
Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured,
even
 thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.

translated_text:
Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages
were heavy loaden;
they are
 a burden to the weary
beast.
original_text:
Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages
were heavy loaden;
they are
 a burden to the weary
beast.

translated_text: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.
original_text: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.

translated_text:
Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, which are borne
by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:
original_text:
Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, which are borne
by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:

translated_text:
And
even to
your old age I
am he; and
even to hoar hairs will I carry
you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver
you.
original_text:
And
even to
your old age I
am he; and
even to hoar hairs will I carry
you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver
you.

translated_text:
To whom will ye liken me, and make
me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?
original_text:
To whom will ye liken me, and make
me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?

translated_text:
They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance,
and hire a goldsmith; and he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.
original_text:
They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance,
and hire a goldsmith; and he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.

translated_text:
They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he standeth; from his place shall he not remove: yea,
one
 shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.
original_text:
They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he standeth; from his place shall he not remove: yea,
one
 shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.

translated_text: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.
original_text: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.

translated_text:
Remember the former things of old: for I
am God, and
there is none else;
I am God, and
there is
 none like me,
original_text:
Remember the former things of old: for I
am God, and
there is none else;
I am God, and
there is
 none like me,

translated_text:
Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times
the things that are not
yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:
original_text:
Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times
the things that are not
yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:

translated_text:
Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken
it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed
it, I will also do it.
original_text:
Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken
it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed
it, I will also do it.

translated_text:
Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that
are far from righteousness:
original_text:
Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that
are far from righteousness:

translated_text: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.
original_text: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.

translated_text: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The LORD hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.
original_text: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The LORD hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.

translated_text: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;
original_text: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;

translated_text:
And said unto me, Thou
art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.
original_text:
And said unto me, Thou
art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.

translated_text:
Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain:
yet surely my judgment
is with the LORD, and my work with my God.
original_text:
Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain:
yet surely my judgment
is with the LORD, and my work with my God.

translated_text:
And now, saith the LORD that formed me from the womb
to be
 his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the LORD, and my God shall be my strength.
original_text:
And now, saith the LORD that formed me from the womb
to be
 his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the LORD, and my God shall be my strength.

translated_text: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.
original_text: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, the Redeemer of Israel,
and his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the LORD that is faithful,
and the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, the Redeemer of Israel,
and his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the LORD that is faithful,
and the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;
original_text: Thus saith the LORD, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;

translated_text:
That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that
are
 in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures
shall be in all high places.
original_text:
That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that
are
 in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures
shall be in all high places.

translated_text: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.
original_text: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.

translated_text: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.
original_text: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.

translated_text: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
original_text: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.

translated_text: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the LORD hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.
original_text: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the LORD hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.

translated_text: But Zion said, The LORD hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.
original_text: But Zion said, The LORD hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.

translated_text: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.
original_text: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.

translated_text:
Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of
my hands; thy walls
are continually before me.
original_text:
Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of
my hands; thy walls
are continually before me.

translated_text: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee.
original_text: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee.

translated_text:
Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together,
and come to thee.
As I live, saith the LORD, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them
on thee, as a bride
doeth.
original_text:
Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together,
and come to thee.
As I live, saith the LORD, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them
on thee, as a bride
doeth.
