translated_text: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.
original_text: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.

translated_text:
The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place
is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.
original_text:
The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place
is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.

translated_text:
Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where
had they
been?
original_text:
Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where
had they
been?

translated_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in
their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon
their
 shoulders.
original_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in
their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon
their
 shoulders.

translated_text:
And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with
their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I
am the LORD: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.
original_text:
And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with
their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I
am the LORD: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.

translated_text: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?
original_text: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?

translated_text: But thus saith the LORD, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.
original_text: But thus saith the LORD, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.

translated_text:
And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the LORD
am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
original_text:
And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the LORD
am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

translated_text:
Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the LORD, and make mention of the God of Israel,
but not in truth, nor in righteousness.
original_text:
Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the LORD, and make mention of the God of Israel,
but not in truth, nor in righteousness.

translated_text:
For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The LORD of hosts
is his name.
original_text:
For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The LORD of hosts
is his name.

translated_text:
I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did
them suddenly, and they came to pass.
original_text:
I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did
them suddenly, and they came to pass.

translated_text:
I have even from the beginning declared
it to thee; before it came to pass I shewed
it thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.
original_text:
I have even from the beginning declared
it to thee; before it came to pass I shewed
it thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.

translated_text:
Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare
it?
 I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.
original_text:
Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare
it?
 I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.

translated_text: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.
original_text: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.

translated_text:
Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time
that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.
original_text:
Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time
that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.

translated_text: For my name’s sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.
original_text: For my name’s sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.

translated_text: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
original_text: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.

translated_text:
For mine own sake,
even for mine own sake, will I do
it: for how should
my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.
original_text:
For mine own sake,
even for mine own sake, will I do
it: for how should
my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.

translated_text:
Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I
am he; I
am the first, I also
am the last.
original_text:
Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I
am he; I
am the first, I also
am the last.

translated_text:
Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens:
when I call unto them, they stand up together.
original_text:
Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens:
when I call unto them, they stand up together.

translated_text:
All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these
things? The LORD hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm
shall be on the Chaldeans.
original_text:
All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these
things? The LORD hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm
shall be on the Chaldeans.

translated_text:
I,
even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
original_text:
I,
even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.

translated_text:
Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there
am I: and now the Lord GOD, and his Spirit, hath sent me.
original_text:
Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there
am I: and now the Lord GOD, and his Spirit, hath sent me.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I
am
 the LORD thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way
that thou shouldest go.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I
am
 the LORD thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way
that thou shouldest go.

translated_text: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:
original_text: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:

translated_text: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.
original_text: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.

translated_text:
Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it
even to the end of the earth; say ye, The LORD hath redeemed his servant Jacob.
original_text:
Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it
even to the end of the earth; say ye, The LORD hath redeemed his servant Jacob.

translated_text:
And they thirsted not
when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
original_text:
And they thirsted not
when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.

translated_text: There is no peace, saith the LORD, unto the wicked.
original_text: There is no peace, saith the LORD, unto the wicked.

translated_text:
Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew
their
 strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.
original_text:
Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew
their
 strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.

translated_text:
Who raised up the righteous
man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made
him rule over kings? he gave
them as the dust to his sword,
and as driven stubble to his bow.
original_text:
Who raised up the righteous
man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made
him rule over kings? he gave
them as the dust to his sword,
and as driven stubble to his bow.

translated_text:
He pursued them,
and passed safely;
even by the way
that he had not gone with his feet.
original_text:
He pursued them,
and passed safely;
even by the way
that he had not gone with his feet.

translated_text:
Who hath wrought and done
it, calling the generations from the beginning? I the LORD, the first, and with the last; I
am he.
original_text:
Who hath wrought and done
it, calling the generations from the beginning? I the LORD, the first, and with the last; I
am he.

translated_text:
The isles saw
it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.
original_text:
The isles saw
it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.

translated_text:
They helped every one his neighbour; and
every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.
original_text:
They helped every one his neighbour; and
every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.

translated_text:
So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith,
and he that smootheth
with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails,
that it should not be moved.
original_text:
So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith,
and he that smootheth
with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails,
that it should not be moved.

translated_text:
But thou, Israel,
art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.
original_text:
But thou, Israel,
art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.

translated_text:
Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou
art my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.
original_text:
Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou
art my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.

translated_text:
Fear thou not; for I
am with thee: be not dismayed; for I
am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
original_text:
Fear thou not; for I
am with thee: be not dismayed; for I
am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

translated_text: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.
original_text: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.

translated_text:
Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them,
even them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.
original_text:
Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them,
even them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.

translated_text: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
original_text: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.

translated_text:
Fear not, thou worm Jacob,
and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the LORD, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.
original_text:
Fear not, thou worm Jacob,
and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the LORD, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

translated_text:
Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat
them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.
original_text:
Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat
them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.

translated_text:
Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the LORD,
and
 shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.
original_text:
Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the LORD,
and
 shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.

translated_text:
When the poor and needy seek water, and
there is
 none,
and their tongue faileth for thirst, I the LORD will hear them,
I the God of Israel will not forsake them.
original_text:
When the poor and needy seek water, and
there is
 none,
and their tongue faileth for thirst, I the LORD will hear them,
I the God of Israel will not forsake them.

translated_text: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
original_text: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

translated_text:
I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree,
and
 the pine, and the box tree together:
original_text:
I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree,
and
 the pine, and the box tree together:

translated_text: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the LORD hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.
original_text: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the LORD hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.

translated_text:
Produce your cause, saith the LORD; bring forth your strong
reasons,
 saith the King of Jacob.
original_text:
Produce your cause, saith the LORD; bring forth your strong
reasons,
 saith the King of Jacob.

translated_text:
Let them bring
them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they
be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.
original_text:
Let them bring
them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they
be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.

translated_text:
Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye
are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold
it together.
original_text:
Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye
are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold
it together.

translated_text:
Behold, ye
are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination
is he that chooseth you.
original_text:
Behold, ye
are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination
is he that chooseth you.

translated_text:
I have raised up
one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as
upon morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.
original_text:
I have raised up
one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as
upon morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.

translated_text:
Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say,
He is righteous? yea,
there is none that sheweth, yea,
there is none that declareth, yea,
there is
 none that heareth your words.
original_text:
Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say,
He is righteous? yea,
there is none that sheweth, yea,
there is none that declareth, yea,
there is
 none that heareth your words.

translated_text:
The first
shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.
original_text:
The first
shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.

translated_text:
For I beheld, and
there was no man; even among them, and
there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.
original_text:
For I beheld, and
there was no man; even among them, and
there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.

translated_text:
Behold, they
are all vanity; their works
are nothing: their molten images
are wind and confusion.
original_text:
Behold, they
are all vanity; their works
are nothing: their molten images
are wind and confusion.

translated_text: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
original_text: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.

translated_text: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the LORD’S hand double for all her sins.
original_text: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the LORD’S hand double for all her sins.

translated_text: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the LORD, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
original_text: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the LORD, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.

translated_text: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
original_text: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:

translated_text:
And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see
it together: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken
it.
original_text:
And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see
it together: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken
it.

translated_text:
The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh
is
 grass, and all the goodliness thereof
is as the flower of the field:
original_text:
The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh
is
 grass, and all the goodliness thereof
is as the flower of the field:

translated_text:
The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the LORD bloweth upon it: surely the people
is grass.
original_text:
The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the LORD bloweth upon it: surely the people
is grass.

translated_text: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
original_text: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.

translated_text:
O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift
it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!
original_text:
O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift
it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!

translated_text:
Behold, the Lord GOD will come with strong
hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward
is with him, and his work before him.
original_text:
Behold, the Lord GOD will come with strong
hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward
is with him, and his work before him.

translated_text:
He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry
them in his bosom,
and shall gently lead those that are with young.
original_text:
He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry
them in his bosom,
and shall gently lead those that are with young.

translated_text: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
original_text: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

translated_text:
Who hath directed the Spirit of the LORD, or
being his counsellor hath taught him?
original_text:
Who hath directed the Spirit of the LORD, or
being his counsellor hath taught him?

translated_text:
With whom took he counsel, and
who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?
original_text:
With whom took he counsel, and
who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?

translated_text:
Behold, the nations
are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
original_text:
Behold, the nations
are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.

translated_text:
And Lebanon
is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.
original_text:
And Lebanon
is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.

translated_text:
All nations before him
are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.
original_text:
All nations before him
are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.

translated_text: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?
original_text: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?

translated_text: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.
original_text: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.

translated_text:
He that
is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree
that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image,
that shall not be moved.
original_text:
He that
is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree
that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image,
that shall not be moved.

translated_text: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?
original_text: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?

translated_text:
It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof
are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:
original_text:
It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof
are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:

translated_text: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.
original_text: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.

translated_text: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.
original_text: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.

translated_text: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.
original_text: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.

translated_text:
Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these
things,
 that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that
he is strong in power; not one faileth.
original_text:
Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these
things,
 that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that
he is strong in power; not one faileth.

translated_text: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the LORD, and my judgment is passed over from my God?
original_text: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the LORD, and my judgment is passed over from my God?

translated_text:
Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard,
that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary?
there is no searching of his understanding.
original_text:
Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard,
that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary?
there is no searching of his understanding.

translated_text:
He giveth power to the faint; and to
them that have no might he increaseth strength.
original_text:
He giveth power to the faint; and to
them that have no might he increaseth strength.

translated_text: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:
original_text: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:

translated_text:
But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called
thee by thy name; thou
art mine.
original_text:
But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called
thee by thy name; thou
art mine.

translated_text:
When thou passest through the waters, I
will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
original_text:
When thou passest through the waters, I
will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

translated_text:
For I
am the LORD thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt
for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.
original_text:
For I
am the LORD thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt
for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.

translated_text: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.
original_text: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.

translated_text:
Fear not: for I
am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;
original_text:
Fear not: for I
am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;

translated_text: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;
original_text: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;

translated_text: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
original_text: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.

translated_text: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.
original_text: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.

translated_text:
Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say,
It is truth.
original_text:
Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say,
It is truth.

translated_text:
Ye
are my witnesses, saith the LORD, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I
am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.
original_text:
Ye
are my witnesses, saith the LORD, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I
am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.

translated_text:
I,
even I,
am the LORD; and beside me
there is
 no saviour.
original_text:
I,
even I,
am the LORD; and beside me
there is
 no saviour.

translated_text:
I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when
there was
 no strange
god among you: therefore ye
are my witnesses, saith the LORD, that I
am God.
original_text:
I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when
there was
 no strange
god among you: therefore ye
are my witnesses, saith the LORD, that I
am God.

translated_text:
Yea, before the day
was I
am he; and
there is
 none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?
original_text:
Yea, before the day
was I
am he; and
there is
 none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry
is in the ships.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry
is in the ships.

translated_text:
I
am the LORD, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.
original_text:
I
am the LORD, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;
original_text: Thus saith the LORD, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;

translated_text: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.
original_text: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.

translated_text: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
original_text: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.

translated_text:
Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness,
and rivers in the desert.
original_text:
Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness,
and rivers in the desert.

translated_text:
The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness,
and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.
original_text:
The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness,
and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.

translated_text: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
original_text: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.

translated_text: But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.
original_text: But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.

translated_text: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.
original_text: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.

translated_text: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.
original_text: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.

translated_text:
I,
even I,
am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
original_text:
I,
even I,
am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.

translated_text: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.
original_text: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.

translated_text: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.
original_text: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.

translated_text: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.
original_text: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.

translated_text:
Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect,
in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.
original_text:
Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect,
in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.

translated_text: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.
original_text: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.

translated_text: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
original_text: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.

translated_text: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.
original_text: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.

translated_text: Thus saith God the LORD, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:
original_text: Thus saith God the LORD, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:

translated_text: I the LORD have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;
original_text: I the LORD have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;

translated_text:
To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison,
and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.
original_text:
To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison,
and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.

translated_text:
I
am the LORD: that
is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.
original_text:
I
am the LORD: that
is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.

translated_text: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.
original_text: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.

translated_text:
Sing unto the LORD a new song,
and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.
original_text:
Sing unto the LORD a new song,
and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.

translated_text:
Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up
their voice,
 the villages
that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.
original_text:
Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up
their voice,
 the villages
that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.

translated_text: Let them give glory unto the LORD, and declare his praise in the islands.
original_text: Let them give glory unto the LORD, and declare his praise in the islands.

translated_text: The LORD shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.
original_text: The LORD shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.

translated_text:
I have long time holden my peace; I have been still,
and
 refrained myself:
now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.
original_text:
I have long time holden my peace; I have been still,
and
 refrained myself:
now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.

translated_text: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.
original_text: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.

translated_text:
And I will bring the blind by a way
that they knew not; I will lead them in paths
that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.
original_text:
And I will bring the blind by a way
that they knew not; I will lead them in paths
that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.

translated_text:
They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye
are our gods.
original_text:
They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye
are our gods.

translated_text: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.
original_text: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.

translated_text:
Who
is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger
that I sent? who
is blind as
he that is perfect, and blind as the LORD’S servant?
original_text:
Who
is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger
that I sent? who
is blind as
he that is perfect, and blind as the LORD’S servant?

translated_text: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.
original_text: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.

translated_text:
The LORD is well pleased for his righteousness’ sake; he will magnify the law, and make
it honourable.
original_text:
The LORD is well pleased for his righteousness’ sake; he will magnify the law, and make
it honourable.

translated_text:
But this
is a people robbed and spoiled;
they are
 all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.
original_text:
But this
is a people robbed and spoiled;
they are
 all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.

translated_text:
Who among you will give ear to this?
who will hearken and hear for the time to come?
original_text:
Who among you will give ear to this?
who will hearken and hear for the time to come?

translated_text: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the LORD, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.
original_text: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the LORD, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.

translated_text:
Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid
it not to heart.
original_text:
Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid
it not to heart.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;
original_text: Thus saith the LORD to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;

translated_text: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
original_text: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:

translated_text:
And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the LORD, which call
thee
 by thy name,
am the God of Israel.
original_text:
And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the LORD, which call
thee
 by thy name,
am the God of Israel.

translated_text: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.
original_text: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.

translated_text:
I
am the LORD, and
there is none else,
there is
 no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:
original_text:
I
am the LORD, and
there is none else,
there is
 no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:

translated_text:
That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that
there is none beside me. I
am the LORD, and
there is
 none else.
original_text:
That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that
there is none beside me. I
am the LORD, and
there is
 none else.

translated_text:
I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the LORD do all these
things.
original_text:
I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the LORD do all these
things.

translated_text: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the LORD have created it.
original_text: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the LORD have created it.

translated_text:
Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker!
Let the potsherd
strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?
original_text:
Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker!
Let the potsherd
strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?

translated_text:
Woe unto him that saith unto
his father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?
original_text:
Woe unto him that saith unto
his father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.

translated_text:
I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I,
even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.
original_text:
I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I,
even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.

translated_text: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the LORD of hosts.
original_text: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the LORD of hosts.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee,
saying,
 Surely God
is in thee; and
there is none else,
there is no God.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee,
saying,
 Surely God
is in thee; and
there is none else,
there is no God.

translated_text:
Verily thou
art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.
original_text:
Verily thou
art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.

translated_text:
They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together
that are makers of idols.
original_text:
They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together
that are makers of idols.

translated_text: But Israel shall be saved in the LORD with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.
original_text: But Israel shall be saved in the LORD with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.

translated_text:
For thus saith the LORD that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I
am the LORD; and
there is none else.
original_text:
For thus saith the LORD that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I
am the LORD; and
there is none else.

translated_text: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the LORD speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
original_text: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the LORD speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.

translated_text:
Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye
that are
 escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god
that cannot save.
original_text:
Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye
that are
 escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god
that cannot save.

translated_text:
Tell ye, and bring
them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time?
who hath told it from that time?
have not I the LORD? and
there is no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour;
there is none beside me.
original_text:
Tell ye, and bring
them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time?
who hath told it from that time?
have not I the LORD? and
there is no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour;
there is none beside me.

translated_text:
Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I
am God, and
there is none else.
original_text:
Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I
am God, and
there is none else.

translated_text:
I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth
in
 righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.
original_text:
I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth
in
 righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.

translated_text:
Surely, shall
one say, in the LORD have I righteousness and strength:
even to him shall
men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.
original_text:
Surely, shall
one say, in the LORD have I righteousness and strength:
even to him shall
men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.

translated_text: In the LORD shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.
original_text: In the LORD shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.

translated_text: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen:
original_text: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen:

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD that made thee, and formed thee from the womb,
which will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD that made thee, and formed thee from the womb,
which will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.

translated_text: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
original_text: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:

translated_text: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.
original_text: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.

translated_text:
One shall say, I
am the LORD’S; and another shall call
himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe
with his hand unto the LORD, and surname
himself by the name of Israel.
original_text:
One shall say, I
am the LORD’S; and another shall call
himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe
with his hand unto the LORD, and surname
himself by the name of Israel.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD the King of Israel, and his redeemer the LORD of hosts; I
am the first, and I
am the last; and beside me
there is no God.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD the King of Israel, and his redeemer the LORD of hosts; I
am the first, and I
am the last; and beside me
there is no God.

translated_text: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.
original_text: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.

translated_text:
Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared
it? ye
are even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea,
there is no God; I know not
any.
original_text:
Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared
it? ye
are even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea,
there is no God; I know not
any.

translated_text:
They that make a graven image
are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they
are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.
original_text:
They that make a graven image
are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they
are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.

translated_text:
Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image
that is profitable for nothing?
original_text:
Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image
that is profitable for nothing?

translated_text:
Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they
are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up;
yet they shall fear,
and they shall be ashamed together.
original_text:
Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they
are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up;
yet they shall fear,
and they shall be ashamed together.

translated_text: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.
original_text: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.

translated_text:
The carpenter stretcheth out
his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.
original_text:
The carpenter stretcheth out
his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.

translated_text:
He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish
it.
original_text:
He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish
it.

translated_text:
Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth
it, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth
it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.
original_text:
Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth
it, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth
it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.

translated_text:
He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth
himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:
original_text:
He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth
himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:

translated_text:
And the residue thereof he maketh a god,
even his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth
it, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou
art my god.
original_text:
And the residue thereof he maketh a god,
even his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth
it, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou
art my god.

translated_text:
They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see;
and their hearts, that they cannot understand.
original_text:
They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see;
and their hearts, that they cannot understand.

translated_text:
And none considereth in his heart, neither
is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten
it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?
original_text:
And none considereth in his heart, neither
is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten
it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?

translated_text:
He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say,
Is there not a lie in my right hand?
original_text:
He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say,
Is there not a lie in my right hand?

translated_text:
Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou
art my servant: I have formed thee; thou
art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.
original_text:
Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou
art my servant: I have formed thee; thou
art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.

translated_text: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
original_text: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.

translated_text:
Sing, O ye heavens; for the LORD hath done
it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.
original_text:
Sing, O ye heavens; for the LORD hath done
it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.

translated_text:
That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise
men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;
original_text:
That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise
men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;

translated_text: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:
original_text: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:

translated_text: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:
original_text: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:

translated_text:
That saith of Cyrus,
He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.
original_text:
That saith of Cyrus,
He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.

translated_text: To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;
original_text: To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;

translated_text: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.
original_text: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.

translated_text: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.
original_text: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.

translated_text:
And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien
shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.
original_text:
And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien
shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.

translated_text:
But ye shall be named the Priests of the LORD:
men shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.
original_text:
But ye shall be named the Priests of the LORD:
men shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.

translated_text:
For your shame
ye shall have double; and
for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.
original_text:
For your shame
ye shall have double; and
for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.

translated_text: For I the LORD love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
original_text: For I the LORD love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

translated_text:
And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they
are the seed
which the LORD hath blessed.
original_text:
And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they
are the seed
which the LORD hath blessed.

translated_text:
I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh
himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth
herself with her jewels.
original_text:
I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh
himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth
herself with her jewels.

translated_text: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
original_text: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.

translated_text: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
original_text: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.

translated_text: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.
original_text: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.

translated_text: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.
original_text: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.

translated_text:
Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at
thy side.
original_text:
Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at
thy side.

translated_text: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.
original_text: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.

translated_text: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the LORD.
original_text: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the LORD.

translated_text: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.
original_text: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.

translated_text:
Who
are these
that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
original_text:
Who
are these
that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

translated_text: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of the LORD thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.
original_text: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of the LORD thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.

translated_text: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.
original_text: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.

translated_text:
Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that
men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and
that their kings
may be brought.
original_text:
Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that
men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and
that their kings
may be brought.

translated_text:
For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea,
those nations shall be utterly wasted.
original_text:
For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea,
those nations shall be utterly wasted.

translated_text: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
original_text: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.

translated_text: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the LORD, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
original_text: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the LORD, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

translated_text:
Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through
thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
original_text:
Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through
thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.

translated_text:
Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the LORD
am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
original_text:
Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the LORD
am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

translated_text: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.
original_text: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.

translated_text: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.
original_text: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.

translated_text: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the LORD shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.
original_text: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the LORD shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.

translated_text: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the LORD shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.
original_text: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the LORD shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.

translated_text:
Thy people also
shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
original_text:
Thy people also
shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.

translated_text: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in his time.
original_text: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in his time.

translated_text:
Who
is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this
that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
original_text:
Who
is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this
that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.

translated_text:
Wherefore
art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?
original_text:
Wherefore
art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?

translated_text:
I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people
there was
 none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.
original_text:
I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people
there was
 none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.

translated_text:
For the day of vengeance
is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.
original_text:
For the day of vengeance
is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.

translated_text:
And I looked, and
there was none to help; and I wondered that
there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.
original_text:
And I looked, and
there was none to help; and I wondered that
there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.

translated_text: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.
original_text: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.

translated_text:
I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the LORD,
and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
original_text:
I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the LORD,
and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

translated_text:
For he said, Surely they
are my people, children
that
 will not lie: so he was their Saviour.
original_text:
For he said, Surely they
are my people, children
that
 will not lie: so he was their Saviour.

translated_text: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
original_text: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.

translated_text:
But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy,
and he fought against them.
original_text:
But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy,
and he fought against them.

translated_text:
Then he remembered the days of old, Moses,
and his people,
saying, Where
is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where
is he that put his holy Spirit within him?
original_text:
Then he remembered the days of old, Moses,
and his people,
saying, Where
is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where
is he that put his holy Spirit within him?

translated_text:
That led
them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
original_text:
That led
them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

translated_text:
That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness,
that they should not stumble?
original_text:
That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness,
that they should not stumble?
