translated_text: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the LORD caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.
original_text: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the LORD caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.

translated_text:
Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where
is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?
original_text:
Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where
is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?

translated_text:
Doubtless thou
art our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O LORD,
art our father, our redeemer; thy name
is from everlasting.
original_text:
Doubtless thou
art our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O LORD,
art our father, our redeemer; thy name
is from everlasting.

translated_text:
O LORD, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways,
and hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants’ sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.
original_text:
O LORD, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways,
and hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants’ sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.

translated_text:
The people of thy holiness have possessed
it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.
original_text:
The people of thy holiness have possessed
it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.

translated_text:
We are
thine: thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name.
original_text:
We are
thine: thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name.

translated_text:
For Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp
that burneth.
original_text:
For Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp
that burneth.

translated_text: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD shall name.
original_text: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD shall name.

translated_text: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
original_text: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

translated_text: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzi-bah, and thy land Beulah: for the LORD delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.
original_text: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzi-bah, and thy land Beulah: for the LORD delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.

translated_text:
For
as a young man marrieth a virgin,
so shall thy sons marry thee: and
as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride,
so shall thy God rejoice over thee.
original_text:
For
as a young man marrieth a virgin,
so shall thy sons marry thee: and
as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride,
so shall thy God rejoice over thee.

translated_text:
I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem,
which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,
original_text:
I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem,
which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,

translated_text: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
original_text: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

translated_text:
The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn
to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:
original_text:
The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn
to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:

translated_text: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the LORD; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.
original_text: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the LORD; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.

translated_text: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highways; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.
original_text: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highways; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.

translated_text:
Behold, the LORD hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward
is with him, and his work before him.
original_text:
Behold, the LORD hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward
is with him, and his work before him.

translated_text: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the LORD: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.
original_text: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the LORD: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.

translated_text:
I am sought of
them that asked not
for me; I am found of
them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation
that was not called by my name.
original_text:
I am sought of
them that asked not
for me; I am found of
them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation
that was not called by my name.

translated_text:
I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way
that was not good, after their own thoughts;
original_text:
I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way
that was not good, after their own thoughts;

translated_text: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;
original_text: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;

translated_text:
Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable
things is in their vessels;
original_text:
Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable
things is in their vessels;

translated_text:
Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou.
These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.
original_text:
Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou.
These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.

translated_text:
Behold,
it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,
original_text:
Behold,
it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,

translated_text: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith the LORD, which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.
original_text: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith the LORD, which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and
one saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing
is in it: so will I do for my servants’ sakes, that I may not destroy them all.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and
one saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing
is in it: so will I do for my servants’ sakes, that I may not destroy them all.

translated_text: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.
original_text: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.

translated_text: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.
original_text: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.

translated_text:
But ye
are they that forsake the LORD, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.
original_text:
But ye
are they that forsake the LORD, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.

translated_text:
Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, and did choose
that wherein I delighted not.
original_text:
Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, and did choose
that wherein I delighted not.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:
original_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:

translated_text: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.
original_text: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.

translated_text: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord GOD shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:
original_text: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord GOD shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:

translated_text: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.
original_text: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.

translated_text: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.
original_text: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.

translated_text:
But be ye glad and rejoice for ever
in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.
original_text:
But be ye glad and rejoice for ever
in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.

translated_text: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.
original_text: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.

translated_text:
There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner
being an hundred years old shall be accursed.
original_text:
There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner
being an hundred years old shall be accursed.

translated_text:
And they shall build houses, and inhabit
them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
original_text:
And they shall build houses, and inhabit
them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

translated_text:
They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree
are the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
original_text:
They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree
are the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.

translated_text:
They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they
are the seed of the blessed of the LORD, and their offspring with them.
original_text:
They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they
are the seed of the blessed of the LORD, and their offspring with them.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
original_text: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

translated_text:
The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust
shall be the serpent’s meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the LORD.
original_text:
The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust
shall be the serpent’s meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,
original_text: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,

translated_text:
As
when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries,
that the nations may tremble at thy presence!
original_text:
As
when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries,
that the nations may tremble at thy presence!

translated_text:
When thou didst terrible things
which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.
original_text:
When thou didst terrible things
which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.

translated_text:
For since the beginning of the world
men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee,
what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.
original_text:
For since the beginning of the world
men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee,
what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.

translated_text:
Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness,
those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.
original_text:
Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness,
those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.

translated_text:
But we are all as an unclean
thing, and all our righteousnesses
are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
original_text:
But we are all as an unclean
thing, and all our righteousnesses
are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.

translated_text:
And
there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.
original_text:
And
there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.

translated_text:
But now, O LORD, thou
art our father; we
are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all
are the work of thy hand.
original_text:
But now, O LORD, thou
art our father; we
are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all
are the work of thy hand.

translated_text:
Be not wroth very sore, O LORD, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we
are all thy people.
original_text:
Be not wroth very sore, O LORD, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we
are all thy people.

translated_text: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
original_text: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

translated_text: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.
original_text: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.

translated_text:
Wilt thou refrain thyself for these
things, O LORD? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?
original_text:
Wilt thou refrain thyself for these
things, O LORD? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, The heaven
is my throne, and the earth
is my footstool: where
is the house that ye build unto me? and where
is the place of my rest?
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, The heaven
is my throne, and the earth
is my footstool: where
is the house that ye build unto me? and where
is the place of my rest?

translated_text:
For all those
things hath mine hand made, and all those
things have been, saith the LORD: but to this
man will I look,
even to
him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.
original_text:
For all those
things hath mine hand made, and all those
things have been, saith the LORD: but to this
man will I look,
even to
him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.

translated_text:
He that killeth an ox
is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb,
as if he cut off a dog’s neck; he that offereth an oblation,
as if he offered swine’s blood; he that burneth incense,
as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations.
original_text:
He that killeth an ox
is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb,
as if he cut off a dog’s neck; he that offereth an oblation,
as if he offered swine’s blood; he that burneth incense,
as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations.

translated_text:
I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose
that in which I delighted not.
original_text:
I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose
that in which I delighted not.

translated_text: Hear the word of the LORD, ye that tremble at his word; your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name’s sake, said, Let the LORD be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.
original_text: Hear the word of the LORD, ye that tremble at his word; your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name’s sake, said, Let the LORD be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.

translated_text: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that rendereth recompence to his enemies.
original_text: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that rendereth recompence to his enemies.

translated_text: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.
original_text: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.

translated_text:
Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day?
or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.
original_text:
Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day?
or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.

translated_text:
Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith the LORD: shall I cause to bring forth, and shut
the womb? saith thy God.
original_text:
Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith the LORD: shall I cause to bring forth, and shut
the womb? saith thy God.

translated_text: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn for her:
original_text: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn for her:

translated_text: That ye may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.
original_text: That ye may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.

translated_text:
For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall ye suck, ye shall be borne upon
her sides, and be dandled upon
her knees.
original_text:
For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall ye suck, ye shall be borne upon
her sides, and be dandled upon
her knees.

translated_text: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
original_text: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And when ye see
this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the LORD shall be known toward his servants, and
his indignation toward his enemies.
original_text:
And when ye see
this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the LORD shall be known toward his servants, and
his indignation toward his enemies.

translated_text: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
original_text: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

translated_text: For by fire and by his sword will the LORD plead with all flesh: and the slain of the LORD shall be many.
original_text: For by fire and by his sword will the LORD plead with all flesh: and the slain of the LORD shall be many.

translated_text:
They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one
tree in the midst, eating swine’s flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the LORD.
original_text:
They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one
tree in the midst, eating swine’s flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
For I
know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.
original_text:
For I
know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.

translated_text:
And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations,
to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow,
to Tubal, and Javan,
to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.
original_text:
And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations,
to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow,
to Tubal, and Javan,
to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.

translated_text:
And they shall bring all your brethren
for an offering unto the LORD out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the LORD, as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the LORD.
original_text:
And they shall bring all your brethren
for an offering unto the LORD out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the LORD, as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
And I will also take of them for priests
and for Levites, saith the LORD.
original_text:
And I will also take of them for priests
and for Levites, saith the LORD.

translated_text: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the LORD, so shall your seed and your name remain.
original_text: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the LORD, so shall your seed and your name remain.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the LORD.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the LORD.

translated_text: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.
original_text: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.

translated_text: For the LORD will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
original_text: For the LORD will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.

translated_text: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the LORD for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
original_text: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the LORD for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,
original_text: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,

translated_text: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!
original_text: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!

translated_text:
The LORD hath broken the staff of the wicked,
and the sceptre of the rulers.
original_text:
The LORD hath broken the staff of the wicked,
and the sceptre of the rulers.

translated_text:
He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted,
and none hindereth.
original_text:
He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted,
and none hindereth.

translated_text:
The whole earth is at rest,
and is quiet: they break forth into singing.
original_text:
The whole earth is at rest,
and is quiet: they break forth into singing.

translated_text:
Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee,
and the cedars of Lebanon,
saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.
original_text:
Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee,
and the cedars of Lebanon,
saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.

translated_text:
Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet
thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee,
even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
original_text:
Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet
thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee,
even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

translated_text: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?
original_text: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?

translated_text:
Thy pomp is brought down to the grave,
and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.
original_text:
Thy pomp is brought down to the grave,
and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.

translated_text:
How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning!
how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!
original_text:
How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning!
how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!

translated_text: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
original_text: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:

translated_text: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.
original_text: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.

translated_text: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.
original_text: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.

translated_text:
That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof;
that opened not the house of his prisoners?
original_text:
That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof;
that opened not the house of his prisoners?

translated_text:
All the kings of the nations,
even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.
original_text:
All the kings of the nations,
even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.

translated_text:
But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch,
and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.
original_text:
But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch,
and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.

translated_text:
Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land,
and slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.
original_text:
Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land,
and slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.

translated_text: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.
original_text: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.

translated_text: For I will rise up against them, saith the LORD of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the LORD.
original_text: For I will rise up against them, saith the LORD of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the LORD.

translated_text: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the LORD of hosts.
original_text: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the LORD of hosts.

translated_text:
The LORD of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed,
so shall it stand:
original_text:
The LORD of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed,
so shall it stand:

translated_text: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.
original_text: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.

translated_text:
This
is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this
is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
original_text:
This
is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this
is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.

translated_text:
For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul
it?
 and his hand
is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
original_text:
For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul
it?
 and his hand
is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?

translated_text: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.
original_text: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.

translated_text:
Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit
shall be a fiery flying serpent.
original_text:
Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit
shall be a fiery flying serpent.

translated_text: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.
original_text: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.

translated_text:
Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina,
art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none
shall be alone in his appointed times.
original_text:
Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina,
art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none
shall be alone in his appointed times.

translated_text:
What shall
one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.
original_text:
What shall
one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.

translated_text: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.
original_text: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.

translated_text: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
original_text: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

translated_text:
I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger,
even them that rejoice in my highness.
original_text:
I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger,
even them that rejoice in my highness.

translated_text: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.
original_text: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.

translated_text:
They come from a far country, from the end of heaven,
even
 the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
original_text:
They come from a far country, from the end of heaven,
even
 the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

translated_text:
Howl ye; for the day of the LORD
is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.
original_text:
Howl ye; for the day of the LORD
is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.

translated_text: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man’s heart shall melt:
original_text: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man’s heart shall melt:

translated_text:
And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces
shall be as flames.
original_text:
And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces
shall be as flames.

translated_text: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
original_text: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.

translated_text: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
original_text: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.

translated_text:
And I will punish the world for
their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
original_text:
And I will punish the world for
their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.

translated_text: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
original_text: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.

translated_text: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.
original_text: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.

translated_text: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.
original_text: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.

translated_text:
Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined
unto them shall fall by the sword.
original_text:
Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined
unto them shall fall by the sword.

translated_text: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
original_text: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.

translated_text:
Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and
as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
original_text:
Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and
as for gold, they shall not delight in it.

translated_text: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.
original_text: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.

translated_text: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
original_text: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

translated_text: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
original_text: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.

translated_text: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
original_text: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.

translated_text:
And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in
their pleasant palaces: and her time
is
 near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.
original_text:
And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in
their pleasant palaces: and her time
is
 near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.

translated_text: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
original_text: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.

translated_text:
For it shall be,
that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.
original_text:
For it shall be,
that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.

translated_text: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.
original_text: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.

translated_text: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.
original_text: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.

translated_text: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.
original_text: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.

translated_text:
We have heard of the pride of Moab;
he is very proud:
even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath:
but
 his lies
shall not
be so.
original_text:
We have heard of the pride of Moab;
he is very proud:
even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath:
but
 his lies
shall not
be so.

translated_text:
Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kir-hareseth shall ye mourn; surely
they are stricken.
original_text:
Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kir-hareseth shall ye mourn; surely
they are stricken.

translated_text:
For the fields of Heshbon languish,
and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come
even unto Jazer, they wandered
through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.
original_text:
For the fields of Heshbon languish,
and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come
even unto Jazer, they wandered
through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.

translated_text: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.
original_text: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.

translated_text:
And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in
their presses; I have made
their vintage shouting to cease.
original_text:
And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in
their presses; I have made
their vintage shouting to cease.

translated_text: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kir-haresh.
original_text: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kir-haresh.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.
original_text: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.

translated_text:
This
is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.
original_text:
This
is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.

translated_text:
But now the LORD hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant
shall be very small
and feeble.
original_text:
But now the LORD hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant
shall be very small
and feeble.

translated_text:
He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads
shall be
 baldness,
and every beard cut off.
original_text:
He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads
shall be
 baldness,
and every beard cut off.

translated_text: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.
original_text: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.

translated_text:
And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard
even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.
original_text:
And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard
even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.

translated_text:
My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives
shall flee
 unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.
original_text:
My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives
shall flee
 unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.

translated_text: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.
original_text: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.

translated_text: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.
original_text: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.

translated_text: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beer-elim.
original_text: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beer-elim.

translated_text: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.
original_text: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.

translated_text:
Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which
is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:
original_text:
Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which
is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:

translated_text:
That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters,
saying, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!
original_text:
That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters,
saying, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!

translated_text: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.
original_text: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.

translated_text:
For so the LORD said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs,
and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
original_text:
For so the LORD said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs,
and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.

translated_text:
For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruninghooks, and take away
and cut down the branches.
original_text:
For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruninghooks, and take away
and cut down the branches.

translated_text: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
original_text: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.

translated_text: In that time shall the present be brought unto the LORD of hosts of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, the mount Zion.
original_text: In that time shall the present be brought unto the LORD of hosts of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, the mount Zion.

translated_text:
The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from
being
 a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
original_text:
The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from
being
 a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.

translated_text:
The cities of Aroer
are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make
them afraid.
original_text:
The cities of Aroer
are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make
them afraid.

translated_text: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the LORD of hosts.
original_text: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the LORD of hosts.

translated_text:
And in that day it shall come to pass,
that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
original_text:
And in that day it shall come to pass,
that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.

translated_text: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.
original_text: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.

translated_text:
Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two
or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four
or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the LORD God of Israel.
original_text:
Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two
or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four
or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the LORD God of Israel.

translated_text: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
original_text: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.

translated_text:
And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect
that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.
original_text:
And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect
that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.

translated_text: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.
original_text: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.

translated_text: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:
original_text: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:

translated_text:
In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish:
but the harvest
shall be
 a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
original_text:
In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish:
but the harvest
shall be
 a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

translated_text:
Woe to the multitude of many people,
which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations,
that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!
original_text:
Woe to the multitude of many people,
which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations,
that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!

translated_text:
The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but
God
 shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.
original_text:
The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but
God
 shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.

translated_text:
And behold at eveningtide trouble;
and before the morning he
is not. This
is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
original_text:
And behold at eveningtide trouble;
and before the morning he
is not. This
is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.

translated_text: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the LORD rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.
original_text: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the LORD rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.

translated_text:
And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city,
and kingdom against kingdom.
original_text:
And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city,
and kingdom against kingdom.

translated_text: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.
original_text: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.

translated_text: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts.
original_text: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts.

translated_text: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
original_text: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.

translated_text:
And they shall turn the rivers far away;
and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.
original_text:
And they shall turn the rivers far away;
and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.

translated_text:
The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no
more.
original_text:
The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no
more.

translated_text: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
original_text: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.

translated_text: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.
original_text: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.

translated_text:
And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices
and ponds for fish.
original_text:
And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices
and ponds for fish.

translated_text:
Surely the princes of Zoan
are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I
am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?
original_text:
Surely the princes of Zoan
are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I
am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?

translated_text:
Where
are they? where
are thy wise
men?
 and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the LORD of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.
original_text:
Where
are they? where
are thy wise
men?
 and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the LORD of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.

translated_text:
The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt,
even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.
original_text:
The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt,
even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.

translated_text:
The LORD hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken
man
 staggereth in his vomit.
original_text:
The LORD hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken
man
 staggereth in his vomit.

translated_text:
Neither shall there be
any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.
original_text:
Neither shall there be
any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.

translated_text: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which he shaketh over it.
original_text: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which he shaketh over it.

translated_text: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts, which he hath determined against it.
original_text: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts, which he hath determined against it.

translated_text: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.
original_text: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.

translated_text: In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the LORD.
original_text: In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the LORD.

translated_text: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the LORD because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.
original_text: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the LORD because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.

translated_text:
And the LORD shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the LORD in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the LORD, and perform
it.
original_text:
And the LORD shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the LORD in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the LORD, and perform
it.

translated_text:
And the LORD shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal
it:
 and they shall return
even to the LORD, and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.
original_text:
And the LORD shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal
it:
 and they shall return
even to the LORD, and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.

translated_text: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.
original_text: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.

translated_text:
In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria,
even a blessing in the midst of the land:
original_text:
In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria,
even a blessing in the midst of the land:

translated_text:
Whom the LORD of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed
be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.
original_text:
Whom the LORD of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed
be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.

translated_text:
Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness
which they have prescribed;
original_text:
Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness
which they have prescribed;

translated_text:
To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and
that
 they may rob the fatherless!
original_text:
To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and
that
 they may rob the fatherless!

translated_text:
And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation
which shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?
original_text:
And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation
which shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?

translated_text:
Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand
is stretched out still.
original_text:
Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand
is stretched out still.

translated_text: O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.
original_text: O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.

translated_text: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
original_text: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

translated_text:
Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but
it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.
original_text:
Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but
it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.

translated_text:
For he saith,
Are not my princes altogether kings?
original_text:
For he saith,
Are not my princes altogether kings?

translated_text:
Is not Calno as Carchemish?
is not Hamath as Arpad?
is not Samaria as Damascus?
original_text:
Is not Calno as Carchemish?
is not Hamath as Arpad?
is not Samaria as Damascus?

translated_text: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
original_text: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;

translated_text: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
original_text: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

translated_text:
Wherefore it shall come to pass,
that when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.
original_text:
Wherefore it shall come to pass,
that when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.

translated_text:
For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done
it,
 and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant
man:
original_text:
For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done
it,
 and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant
man:

translated_text:
And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs
that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.
original_text:
And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs
that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.

translated_text:
Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith?
or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake
itself against them that lift it up,
or as if the staff should lift up
itself, as if it were
 no wood.
original_text:
Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith?
or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake
itself against them that lift it up,
or as if the staff should lift up
itself, as if it were
 no wood.

translated_text: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.
original_text: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.

translated_text: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;
original_text: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;

translated_text: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standardbearer fainteth.
original_text: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standardbearer fainteth.

translated_text: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.
original_text: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

translated_text:
The remnant shall return,
even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.
original_text:
The remnant shall return,
even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.

translated_text:
For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea,
yet
 a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.
original_text:
For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea,
yet
 a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.

translated_text: For the Lord GOD of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.
original_text: For the Lord GOD of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.

translated_text: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.
original_text: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.

translated_text:
And the LORD of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and
as his rod
was
 upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.
original_text:
And the LORD of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and
as his rod
was
 upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.

translated_text: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:
original_text: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:

translated_text: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.
original_text: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.

translated_text: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.
original_text: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.

translated_text: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.
original_text: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.

translated_text:
As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand
against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
original_text:
As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand
against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

translated_text:
Behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature
shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.
original_text:
Behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature
shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.

translated_text: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.
original_text: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.

translated_text: And in that day thou shalt say, O LORD, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.
original_text: And in that day thou shalt say, O LORD, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.

translated_text:
Behold, God
is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH
is my strength and
my song; he also is become my salvation.
original_text:
Behold, God
is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH
is my strength and
my song; he also is become my salvation.

translated_text: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
original_text: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.

translated_text: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the LORD, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
