original_text: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the LORD, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.

translated_text:
Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this
is
 known in all the earth.
original_text:
Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this
is
 known in all the earth.

translated_text:
Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great
is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.
original_text:
Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great
is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.

translated_text: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:
original_text: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:

translated_text: And the spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD;
original_text: And the spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD;

translated_text: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the LORD: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:
original_text: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the LORD: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:

translated_text: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.
original_text: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

translated_text: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.
original_text: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.

translated_text: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.
original_text: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.

translated_text: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
original_text: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.

translated_text: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice’ den.
original_text: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice’ den.

translated_text: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
original_text: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

translated_text: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.
original_text: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

translated_text: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
original_text: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

translated_text: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.
original_text: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.

translated_text: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.
original_text: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.

translated_text:
And the LORD shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make
men go over dryshod.
original_text:
And the LORD shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make
men go over dryshod.

translated_text: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
original_text: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah,
that
 Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.
original_text:
Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah,
that
 Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.

translated_text: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field.
original_text: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field.

translated_text: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah’s son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph’s son, the recorder.
original_text: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah’s son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph’s son, the recorder.

translated_text: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
original_text: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?

translated_text:
I say,
sayest thou, (but
they are but vain words)
I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
original_text:
I say,
sayest thou, (but
they are but vain words)
I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?

translated_text:
Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so
is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.
original_text:
Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so
is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.

translated_text:
But if thou say to me, We trust in the LORD our God:
is it
 not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?
original_text:
But if thou say to me, We trust in the LORD our God:
is it
 not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?

translated_text: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
original_text: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

translated_text: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
original_text: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

translated_text: And am I now come up without the LORD against this land to destroy it? the LORD said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
original_text: And am I now come up without the LORD against this land to destroy it? the LORD said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

translated_text:
Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand
it:
 and speak not to us in the Jews’ language, in the ears of the people that
are on the wall.
original_text:
Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand
it:
 and speak not to us in the Jews’ language, in the ears of the people that
are on the wall.

translated_text:
But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words?
hath he not
sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
original_text:
But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words?
hath he not
sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?

translated_text: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.
original_text: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.

translated_text: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.
original_text: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.

translated_text: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
original_text: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

translated_text: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
original_text: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

translated_text: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, The LORD will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
original_text: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, The LORD will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

translated_text:
Where
are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where
are
 the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
original_text:
Where
are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where
are
 the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

translated_text:
Who
are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
original_text:
Who
are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?

translated_text: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
original_text: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

translated_text:
Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that
was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with
their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
original_text:
Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that
was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with
their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

translated_text: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
original_text: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.

translated_text:
It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD,
and the excellency of our God.
original_text:
It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD,
and the excellency of our God.

translated_text: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
original_text: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.

translated_text:
Say to them
that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come
with vengeance,
even God
with a recompence; he will come and save you.
original_text:
Say to them
that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come
with vengeance,
even God
with a recompence; he will come and save you.

translated_text: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
original_text: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.

translated_text:
Then shall the lame
man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
original_text:
Then shall the lame
man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.

translated_text:
And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay,
shall be
 grass with reeds and rushes.
original_text:
And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay,
shall be
 grass with reeds and rushes.

translated_text:
And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it
shall be
 for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err
therein.
original_text:
And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it
shall be
 for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err
therein.

translated_text:
No lion shall be there, nor
any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk
there:
original_text:
No lion shall be there, nor
any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk
there:

translated_text: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
original_text: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

translated_text: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.
original_text: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.

translated_text: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the LORD,
original_text: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the LORD,

translated_text:
And said, Remember now, O LORD, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done
that which is
 good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
original_text:
And said, Remember now, O LORD, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done
that which is
 good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

translated_text: Then came the word of the LORD to Isaiah, saying,
original_text: Then came the word of the LORD to Isaiah, saying,

translated_text: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.
original_text: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.

translated_text: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.
original_text: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.

translated_text:
And this
shall be a sign unto thee from the LORD, that the LORD will do this thing that he hath spoken;
original_text:
And this
shall be a sign unto thee from the LORD, that the LORD will do this thing that he hath spoken;

translated_text: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.
original_text: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.

translated_text: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:
original_text: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:

translated_text: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.
original_text: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.

translated_text:
I said, I shall not see the LORD,
even the LORD, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
original_text:
I said, I shall not see the LORD,
even the LORD, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.

translated_text:
Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd’s tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day
even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
original_text:
Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd’s tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day
even to night wilt thou make an end of me.

translated_text:
I reckoned till morning,
that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day
even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
original_text:
I reckoned till morning,
that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day
even to night wilt thou make an end of me.

translated_text:
Like a crane
or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail
with looking upward: O LORD, I am oppressed; undertake for me.
original_text:
Like a crane
or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail
with looking upward: O LORD, I am oppressed; undertake for me.

translated_text:
What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done
it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
original_text:
What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done
it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.

translated_text:
O Lord, by these
things men live, and in all these
things is the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.
original_text:
O Lord, by these
things men live, and in all these
things is the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.

translated_text:
Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul
delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.
original_text:
Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul
delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.

translated_text:
For the grave cannot praise thee, death can
not celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.
original_text:
For the grave cannot praise thee, death can
not celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.

translated_text:
The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I
do this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.
original_text:
The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I
do this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.

translated_text:
The LORD
was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the LORD.
original_text:
The LORD
was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay
it
 for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.
original_text:
For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay
it
 for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.

translated_text:
Hezekiah also had said, What
is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the LORD?
original_text:
Hezekiah also had said, What
is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the LORD?

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard
it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard
it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
And he sent Eliakim, who
was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
original_text:
And he sent Eliakim, who
was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

translated_text:
And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day
is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and
there is not strength to bring forth.
original_text:
And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day
is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and
there is not strength to bring forth.

translated_text:
It may be the LORD thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up
thy prayer for the remnant that is left.
original_text:
It may be the LORD thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up
thy prayer for the remnant that is left.

translated_text: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
original_text: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

translated_text: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
original_text: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

translated_text: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
original_text: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

translated_text: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
original_text: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

translated_text:
And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with thee. And when he heard
it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
original_text:
And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with thee. And when he heard
it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

translated_text: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
original_text: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

translated_text: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?
original_text: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?

translated_text:
Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed,
as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which
were in Telassar?
original_text:
Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed,
as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which
were in Telassar?

translated_text:
Where
is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?
original_text:
Where
is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?

translated_text: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
original_text: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.

translated_text: And Hezekiah prayed unto the LORD, saying,
original_text: And Hezekiah prayed unto the LORD, saying,

translated_text:
O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest
between the cherubims, thou
art the God,
even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.
original_text:
O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest
between the cherubims, thou
art the God,
even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.

translated_text: Incline thine ear, O LORD, and hear; open thine eyes, O LORD, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living God.
original_text: Incline thine ear, O LORD, and hear; open thine eyes, O LORD, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living God.

translated_text: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,
original_text: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,

translated_text:
And have cast their gods into the fire: for they
were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.
original_text:
And have cast their gods into the fire: for they
were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

translated_text:
Now therefore, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou
art the LORD,
even
 thou only.
original_text:
Now therefore, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou
art the LORD,
even
 thou only.

translated_text: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:
original_text: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:

translated_text:
This
is the word which the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee,
and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.
original_text:
This
is the word which the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee,
and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

translated_text:
Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted
thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high?
even
 against the Holy One of Israel.
original_text:
Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted
thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high?
even
 against the Holy One of Israel.

translated_text:
By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord, and hast said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof,
and
 the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border,
and the forest of his Carmel.
original_text:
By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord, and hast said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof,
and
 the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border,
and the forest of his Carmel.

translated_text: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.
original_text: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.

translated_text:
Hast thou not heard long ago,
how I have done it;
and
 of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities
into ruinous heaps.
original_text:
Hast thou not heard long ago,
how I have done it;
and
 of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities
into ruinous heaps.

translated_text:
Therefore their inhabitants
were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were
as the grass of the field, and
as the green herb,
as the grass on the housetops, and
as corn blasted before it be grown up.
original_text:
Therefore their inhabitants
were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were
as the grass of the field, and
as the green herb,
as the grass on the housetops, and
as corn blasted before it be grown up.

translated_text: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.
original_text: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

translated_text: Because thy rage against me, and thy tumult, is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.
original_text: Because thy rage against me, and thy tumult, is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

translated_text:
And this
shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat
this
 year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.
original_text:
And this
shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat
this
 year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.

translated_text: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:
original_text: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:

translated_text: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.
original_text: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.

translated_text: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.
original_text: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.

translated_text: For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.
original_text: For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

translated_text:
Then the angel of the LORD went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they
were all dead corpses.
original_text:
Then the angel of the LORD went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they
were all dead corpses.

translated_text: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
original_text: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

translated_text: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.
original_text: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.

translated_text: At that time Merodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.
original_text: At that time Merodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.

translated_text: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
original_text: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

translated_text:
Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me,
even from Babylon.
original_text:
Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me,
even from Babylon.

translated_text:
Then said he, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that
is in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
original_text:
Then said he, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that
is in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

translated_text: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD of hosts:
original_text: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD of hosts:

translated_text:
Behold, the days come, that all that
is in thine house, and
that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Behold, the days come, that all that
is in thine house, and
that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.

translated_text: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
original_text: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

translated_text:
Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good
is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.
original_text:
Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good
is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.

translated_text: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the LORD, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:
original_text: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the LORD, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:

translated_text: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!
original_text: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!

translated_text:
Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt
your confusion.
original_text:
Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt
your confusion.

translated_text: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.
original_text: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.

translated_text:
They were all ashamed of a people
that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.
original_text:
They were all ashamed of a people
that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.

translated_text:
The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence
come the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people
that
 shall not profit
them.
original_text:
The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence
come the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people
that
 shall not profit
them.

translated_text:
For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength
is to sit still.
original_text:
For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength
is to sit still.

translated_text: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:
original_text: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:

translated_text:
That this
is a rebellious people, lying children, children
that will not hear the law of the LORD:
original_text:
That this
is a rebellious people, lying children, children
that will not hear the law of the LORD:

translated_text: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:
original_text: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:

translated_text: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.
original_text: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.

translated_text: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:
original_text: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:

translated_text: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.
original_text: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.

translated_text:
And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters’ vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water
withal out of the pit.
original_text:
And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters’ vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water
withal out of the pit.

translated_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
original_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.

translated_text: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.
original_text: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.

translated_text:
One thousand
shall flee at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.
original_text:
One thousand
shall flee at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.

translated_text:
And therefore will the LORD wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the LORD
is a God of judgment: blessed
are all they that wait for him.
original_text:
And therefore will the LORD wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the LORD
is a God of judgment: blessed
are all they that wait for him.

translated_text: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.
original_text: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.

translated_text:
And
though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers:
original_text:
And
though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers:

translated_text:
And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This
is
 the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
original_text:
And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This
is
 the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.

translated_text: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.
original_text: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.

translated_text: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, that thou shalt sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.
original_text: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, that thou shalt sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.

translated_text: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.
original_text: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.

translated_text:
And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers
and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
original_text:
And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers
and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

translated_text: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.
original_text: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.

translated_text:
Behold, the name of the LORD cometh from far, burning
with
 his anger, and the burden
thereof is heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:
original_text:
Behold, the name of the LORD cometh from far, burning
with
 his anger, and the burden
thereof is heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:

translated_text:
And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and
there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing
them to err.
original_text:
And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and
there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing
them to err.

translated_text:
Ye shall have a song, as in the night
when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the LORD, to the mighty One of Israel.
original_text:
Ye shall have a song, as in the night
when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the LORD, to the mighty One of Israel.

translated_text:
And the LORD shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of
his anger, and
with the flame of a devouring fire,
with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.
original_text:
And the LORD shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of
his anger, and
with the flame of a devouring fire,
with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.

translated_text:
For through the voice of the LORD shall the Assyrian be beaten down,
which smote with a rod.
original_text:
For through the voice of the LORD shall the Assyrian be beaten down,
which smote with a rod.

translated_text:
And
in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the LORD shall lay upon him,
it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.
original_text:
And
in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the LORD shall lay upon him,
it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.

translated_text:
For Tophet
is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made
it deep
and large: the pile thereof
is fire and much wood; the breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.
original_text:
For Tophet
is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made
it deep
and large: the pile thereof
is fire and much wood; the breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.

translated_text: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
original_text: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.

translated_text: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
original_text: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.

translated_text: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.
original_text: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.

translated_text: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
original_text: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.

translated_text:
The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said
to be bountiful.
original_text:
The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said
to be bountiful.

translated_text: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
original_text: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

translated_text:
The instruments also of the churl
are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.
original_text:
The instruments also of the churl
are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.

translated_text: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.
original_text: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.

translated_text: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
original_text: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.

translated_text: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.
original_text: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.

translated_text:
Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird
sackcloth upon
your
 loins.
original_text:
Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird
sackcloth upon
your
 loins.

translated_text: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
original_text: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

translated_text:
Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns
and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy
in the joyous city:
original_text:
Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns
and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy
in the joyous city:

translated_text: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
original_text: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;

translated_text: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
original_text: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.

translated_text: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
original_text: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.

translated_text: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
original_text: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.

translated_text: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
original_text: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;

translated_text: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.
original_text: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.

translated_text:
Blessed
are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth
thither the feet of the ox and the ass.
original_text:
Blessed
are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth
thither the feet of the ox and the ass.

translated_text:
Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because
they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the LORD!
original_text:
Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because
they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the LORD!

translated_text:
Yet he also
is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.
original_text:
Yet he also
is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.

translated_text:
Now the Egyptians
are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.
original_text:
Now the Egyptians
are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.

translated_text:
For thus hath the LORD spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him,
he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the LORD of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.
original_text:
For thus hath the LORD spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him,
he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the LORD of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.

translated_text:
As birds flying, so will the LORD of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver
it; and passing over he will preserve
it.
original_text:
As birds flying, so will the LORD of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver
it; and passing over he will preserve
it.

translated_text:
Turn ye unto
him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.
original_text:
Turn ye unto
him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.

translated_text:
For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you
for a sin.
original_text:
For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you
for a sin.

translated_text: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.
original_text: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.

translated_text:
And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the LORD, whose fire
is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
original_text:
And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the LORD, whose fire
is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

translated_text: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.
original_text: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.

translated_text:
For the indignation of the LORD
is upon all nations, and
his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.
original_text:
For the indignation of the LORD
is upon all nations, and
his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.

translated_text: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
original_text: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.

translated_text:
And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling
fig from the fig tree.
original_text:
And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling
fig from the fig tree.

translated_text: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
original_text: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.

translated_text:
The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness,
and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the LORD hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.
original_text:
The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness,
and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the LORD hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.

translated_text: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.
original_text: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.

translated_text:
For
it is the day of the LORD’S vengeance,
and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.
original_text:
For
it is the day of the LORD’S vengeance,
and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.

translated_text: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
original_text: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.

translated_text: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.
original_text: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.

translated_text: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.
original_text: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.

translated_text:
They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none
shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
original_text:
They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none
shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.

translated_text:
And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons,
and
 a court for owls.
original_text:
And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons,
and
 a court for owls.

translated_text: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.
original_text: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.

translated_text: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.
original_text: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.

translated_text: Seek ye out of the book of the LORD, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.
original_text: Seek ye out of the book of the LORD, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.

translated_text: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
original_text: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.

translated_text: O LORD, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
original_text: O LORD, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

translated_text: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
original_text: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.

translated_text:
And your spoil shall be gathered
like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
original_text:
And your spoil shall be gathered
like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.

translated_text: The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
original_text: The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.

translated_text:
And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times,
and
 strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD
is his treasure.
original_text:
And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times,
and
 strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD
is his treasure.

translated_text: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
original_text: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.

translated_text: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
original_text: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.

translated_text:
The earth mourneth
and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed
and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off
their fruits.
original_text:
The earth mourneth
and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed
and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off
their fruits.

translated_text: Now will I rise, saith the LORD; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
original_text: Now will I rise, saith the LORD; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.

translated_text:
Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath,
as fire, shall devour you.
original_text:
Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath,
as fire, shall devour you.

translated_text:
And the people shall be as the burnings of lime:
as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
original_text:
And the people shall be as the burnings of lime:
as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.

translated_text:
Hear, ye
that are far off, what I have done; and, ye
that are near, acknowledge my might.
original_text:
Hear, ye
that are far off, what I have done; and, ye
that are near, acknowledge my might.

translated_text: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
original_text: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?

translated_text: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;
original_text: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;

translated_text:
He shall dwell on high: his place of defence
shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters
shall be
 sure.
original_text:
He shall dwell on high: his place of defence
shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters
shall be
 sure.

translated_text: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.
original_text: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.

translated_text:
Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where
is the scribe? where
is the receiver? where
is he that counted the towers?
original_text:
Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where
is the scribe? where
is the receiver? where
is he that counted the towers?

translated_text:
Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue,
that thou canst not understand.
original_text:
Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue,
that thou canst not understand.

translated_text:
Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle
that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
original_text:
Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle
that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.

translated_text:
But there the glorious LORD
will be unto us a place of broad rivers
and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
original_text:
But there the glorious LORD
will be unto us a place of broad rivers
and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.

translated_text:
For the LORD
is our judge, the LORD
is our lawgiver, the LORD
is our king; he will save us.
original_text:
For the LORD
is our judge, the LORD
is our lawgiver, the LORD
is our king; he will save us.

translated_text: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.
original_text: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.

translated_text:
And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein
shall be forgiven
their iniquity.
original_text:
And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein
shall be forgiven
their iniquity.

translated_text:
O LORD, thou
art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful
things; thy counsels of old
are faithfulness
and truth.
original_text:
O LORD, thou
art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful
things; thy counsels of old
are faithfulness
and truth.

translated_text:
For thou hast made of a city an heap;
of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
original_text:
For thou hast made of a city an heap;
of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.

translated_text: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.
original_text: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.

translated_text:
For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones
is as a storm
against the wall.
original_text:
For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones
is as a storm
against the wall.

translated_text:
Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place;
even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.
original_text:
Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place;
even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.

translated_text: And in this mountain shall the LORD of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.
original_text: And in this mountain shall the LORD of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.

translated_text: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.
original_text: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.

translated_text:
He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken
it.
original_text:
He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken
it.

translated_text:
And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this
is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this
is the LORD; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.
original_text:
And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this
is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this
is the LORD; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.

translated_text: For in this mountain shall the hand of the LORD rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.
original_text: For in this mountain shall the hand of the LORD rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.

translated_text:
And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth
his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.
original_text:
And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth
his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.

translated_text:
And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low,
and bring to the ground,
even to the dust.
original_text:
And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low,
and bring to the ground,
even to the dust.

translated_text: Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.
original_text: Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.

translated_text: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.
original_text: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.

translated_text: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the LORD hath spoken this word.
original_text: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the LORD hath spoken this word.

translated_text:
The earth mourneth
and fadeth away, the world languisheth
and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.
original_text:
The earth mourneth
and fadeth away, the world languisheth
and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.

translated_text: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.
original_text: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.

translated_text: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
original_text: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
