translated_text: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.
original_text: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.

translated_text: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.
original_text: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.

translated_text: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
original_text: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.

translated_text: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
original_text: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

translated_text: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
original_text: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.

translated_text: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
original_text: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.

translated_text:
When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people,
there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree,
and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.
original_text:
When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people,
there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree,
and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.

translated_text: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.
original_text: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.

translated_text:
Wherefore glorify ye the LORD in the fires,
even the name of the LORD God of Israel in the isles of the sea.
original_text:
Wherefore glorify ye the LORD in the fires,
even the name of the LORD God of Israel in the isles of the sea.

translated_text:
From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs,
even
 glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.
original_text:
From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs,
even
 glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.

translated_text:
Fear, and the pit, and the snare,
are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.
original_text:
Fear, and the pit, and the snare,
are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.

translated_text: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.
original_text: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.

translated_text: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.
original_text: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that the LORD shall punish the host of the high ones
that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that the LORD shall punish the host of the high ones
that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.

translated_text:
And they shall be gathered together,
as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.
original_text:
And they shall be gathered together,
as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.

translated_text: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the LORD of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.
original_text: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the LORD of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.

translated_text:
In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that
is in the sea.
original_text:
In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that
is in the sea.

translated_text: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.
original_text: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.

translated_text:
I the LORD do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest
any
 hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
original_text:
I the LORD do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest
any
 hurt it, I will keep it night and day.

translated_text:
Fury
is not in me: who would set the briers
and
 thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
original_text:
Fury
is not in me: who would set the briers
and
 thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.

translated_text: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.
original_text: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.

translated_text:
Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him?
or
 is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?
original_text:
Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him?
or
 is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?

translated_text: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.
original_text: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.

translated_text: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.
original_text: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.

translated_text:
Yet the defenced city
shall be desolate,
and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
original_text:
Yet the defenced city
shall be desolate,
and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.

translated_text:
When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come,
and set them on fire: for it
is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.
original_text:
When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come,
and set them on fire: for it
is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that the LORD shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that the LORD shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the LORD in the holy mount at Jerusalem.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the LORD in the holy mount at Jerusalem.

translated_text:
In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will
God appoint
for walls and bulwarks.
original_text:
In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will
God appoint
for walls and bulwarks.

translated_text: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.
original_text: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.

translated_text:
Thou wilt keep
him in perfect peace,
whose mind
is stayed
on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
original_text:
Thou wilt keep
him in perfect peace,
whose mind
is stayed
on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

translated_text:
Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH
is
 everlasting strength:
original_text:
Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH
is
 everlasting strength:

translated_text:
For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low,
even to the ground; he bringeth it
even to the dust.
original_text:
For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low,
even to the ground; he bringeth it
even to the dust.

translated_text:
The foot shall tread it down,
even the feet of the poor,
and the steps of the needy.
original_text:
The foot shall tread it down,
even the feet of the poor,
and the steps of the needy.

translated_text:
The way of the just
is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
original_text:
The way of the just
is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.

translated_text:
Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O LORD, have we waited for thee; the desire of
our soul
is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.
original_text:
Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O LORD, have we waited for thee; the desire of
our soul
is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.

translated_text:
With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments
are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
original_text:
With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments
are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.

translated_text:
Let favour be shewed to the wicked,
yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.
original_text:
Let favour be shewed to the wicked,
yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.

translated_text:
LORD,
when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see:
but they shall see, and be ashamed for
their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.
original_text:
LORD,
when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see:
but they shall see, and be ashamed for
their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.

translated_text: LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.
original_text: LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.

translated_text:
O LORD our God,
other lords besides thee have had dominion over us:
but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
original_text:
O LORD our God,
other lords besides thee have had dominion over us:
but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.

translated_text:
They are dead, they shall not live;
they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
original_text:
They are dead, they shall not live;
they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.

translated_text:
Thou hast increased the nation, O LORD, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed
it far
unto all the ends of the earth.
original_text:
Thou hast increased the nation, O LORD, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed
it far
unto all the ends of the earth.

translated_text:
LORD, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer
when thy chastening
was upon them.
original_text:
LORD, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer
when thy chastening
was upon them.

translated_text:
Like as a woman with child,
that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain,
and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD.
original_text:
Like as a woman with child,
that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain,
and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD.

translated_text: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
original_text: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

translated_text:
Thy dead
men shall live,
together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew
is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
original_text:
Thy dead
men shall live,
together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew
is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.

translated_text: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
original_text: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.

translated_text: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
original_text: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.

translated_text:
Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city
where David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.
original_text:
Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city
where David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.

translated_text: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.
original_text: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.

translated_text: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.
original_text: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.

translated_text:
And thou shalt be brought down,
and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.
original_text:
And thou shalt be brought down,
and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.

translated_text:
Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones
shall be as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.
original_text:
Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones
shall be as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.

translated_text: Thou shalt be visited of the LORD of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.
original_text: Thou shalt be visited of the LORD of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.

translated_text: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.
original_text: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.

translated_text:
It shall even be as when an hungry
man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold,
he is
 faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.
original_text:
It shall even be as when an hungry
man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold,
he is
 faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.

translated_text: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
original_text: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

translated_text: For the LORD hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.
original_text: For the LORD hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.

translated_text:
And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which
men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it
is sealed:
original_text:
And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which
men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it
is sealed:

translated_text: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.
original_text: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.

translated_text:
Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near
me
 with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:
original_text:
Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near
me
 with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:

translated_text:
Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people,
even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise
men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent
men shall be hid.
original_text:
Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people,
even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise
men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent
men shall be hid.

translated_text: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the LORD, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?
original_text: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the LORD, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?

translated_text: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?
original_text: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?

translated_text: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
original_text: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?

translated_text: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.
original_text: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.

translated_text:
The meek also shall increase
their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
original_text:
The meek also shall increase
their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

translated_text: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:
original_text: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:

translated_text: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.
original_text: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.

translated_text: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.
original_text: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.

translated_text: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.
original_text: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.

translated_text:
Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which
are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!
original_text:
Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which
are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!

translated_text:
Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one,
which as a tempest of hail
and a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.
original_text:
Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one,
which as a tempest of hail
and a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.

translated_text: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:
original_text: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:

translated_text:
And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower,
and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which
when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.
original_text:
And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower,
and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which
when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.

translated_text: In that day shall the LORD of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,
original_text: In that day shall the LORD of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,

translated_text: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.
original_text: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.

translated_text:
But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble
in judgment.
original_text:
But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble
in judgment.

translated_text:
For all tables are full of vomit
and filthiness,
so that there is no place
clean.
original_text:
For all tables are full of vomit
and filthiness,
so that there is no place
clean.

translated_text:
Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine?
them that are weaned from the milk,
and drawn from the breasts.
original_text:
Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine?
them that are weaned from the milk,
and drawn from the breasts.

translated_text:
For precept
must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little,
and there a little:
original_text:
For precept
must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little,
and there a little:

translated_text: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.
original_text: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.

translated_text:
To whom he said, This
is the rest
wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest; and this
is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.
original_text:
To whom he said, This
is the rest
wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest; and this
is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.

translated_text:
But the word of the LORD was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little,
and
 there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.
original_text:
But the word of the LORD was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little,
and
 there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.

translated_text:
Wherefore hear the word of the LORD, ye scornful men, that rule this people which
is in Jerusalem.
original_text:
Wherefore hear the word of the LORD, ye scornful men, that rule this people which
is in Jerusalem.

translated_text: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:
original_text: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner
stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner
stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.

translated_text: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.
original_text: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.

translated_text: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.
original_text: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.

translated_text: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.
original_text: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.

translated_text:
For the bed is shorter than that
a man can stretch himself
on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself
in it.
original_text:
For the bed is shorter than that
a man can stretch himself
on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself
in it.

translated_text:
For the LORD shall rise up as
in mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as
in the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.
original_text:
For the LORD shall rise up as
in mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as
in the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.

translated_text: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord GOD of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.
original_text: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord GOD of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.

translated_text: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.
original_text: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.

translated_text: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?
original_text: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?

translated_text: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and rie in their place?
original_text: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and rie in their place?

translated_text:
For his God doth instruct him to discretion,
and doth teach him.
original_text:
For his God doth instruct him to discretion,
and doth teach him.

translated_text: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.
original_text: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.

translated_text:
Bread
corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break
it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it
with his horsemen.
original_text:
Bread
corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break
it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it
with his horsemen.

translated_text:
This also cometh forth from the LORD of hosts,
which is wonderful in counsel,
and excellent in working.
original_text:
This also cometh forth from the LORD of hosts,
which is wonderful in counsel,
and excellent in working.

translated_text:
The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through;
so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.
original_text:
The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through;
so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.

translated_text: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.
original_text: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.

translated_text:
Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing
of it; I was dismayed at the seeing
of it.
original_text:
Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing
of it; I was dismayed at the seeing
of it.

translated_text: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.
original_text: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.

translated_text:
Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes,
and anoint the shield.
original_text:
Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes,
and anoint the shield.

translated_text: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.
original_text: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.

translated_text:
And he saw a chariot
with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses,
and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:
original_text:
And he saw a chariot
with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses,
and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:

translated_text: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:
original_text: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:

translated_text:
And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men,
with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.
original_text:
And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men,
with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.

translated_text: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.
original_text: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.

translated_text: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
original_text: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?

translated_text: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.
original_text: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.

translated_text: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.
original_text: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.

translated_text: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.
original_text: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.

translated_text: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
original_text: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.

translated_text: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
original_text: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:

translated_text:
And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the LORD God of Israel hath spoken
it.
original_text:
And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the LORD God of Israel hath spoken
it.

translated_text: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;
original_text: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;

translated_text: At the same time spake the LORD by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy shoe from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
original_text: At the same time spake the LORD by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy shoe from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.

translated_text:
And the LORD said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years
for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;
original_text:
And the LORD said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years
for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;

translated_text:
So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with
their
 buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
original_text:
So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with
their
 buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

translated_text: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
original_text: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

translated_text:
And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such
is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?
original_text:
And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such
is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?

translated_text: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
original_text: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.

translated_text: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
original_text: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.

translated_text:
And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river,
is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.
original_text:
And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river,
is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.

translated_text:
Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken,
even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men,
nor bring up virgins.
original_text:
Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken,
even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men,
nor bring up virgins.

translated_text:
As at the report concerning Egypt,
so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
original_text:
As at the report concerning Egypt,
so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.

translated_text: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
original_text: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.

translated_text:
Is this your joyous
city, whose antiquity
is
 of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.
original_text:
Is this your joyous
city, whose antiquity
is
 of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.

translated_text:
Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning
city,
 whose merchants
are princes, whose traffickers
are
 the honourable of the earth?
original_text:
Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning
city,
 whose merchants
are princes, whose traffickers
are
 the honourable of the earth?

translated_text:
The LORD of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory,
and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.
original_text:
The LORD of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory,
and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.

translated_text:
Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish:
there is
 no more strength.
original_text:
Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish:
there is
 no more strength.

translated_text:
He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the LORD hath given a commandment against the merchant
city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.
original_text:
He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the LORD hath given a commandment against the merchant
city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.

translated_text: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.
original_text: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.

translated_text:
Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not,
til
 the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof;
and
 he brought it to ruin.
original_text:
Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not,
til
 the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof;
and
 he brought it to ruin.

translated_text: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
original_text: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.
original_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.

translated_text: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.
original_text: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
original_text: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.

translated_text: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
original_text: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

translated_text: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?
original_text: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?

translated_text:
Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain
men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
original_text:
Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain
men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.

translated_text:
All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together,
which have fled from far.
original_text:
All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together,
which have fled from far.

translated_text: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.
original_text: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.

translated_text:
For
it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord GOD of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.
original_text:
For
it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord GOD of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.

translated_text:
And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men
and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.
original_text:
And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men
and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.

translated_text: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.
original_text: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.

translated_text: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
original_text: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.

translated_text: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.
original_text: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.

translated_text: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
original_text: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.

translated_text: And in that day did the Lord GOD of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
original_text: And in that day did the Lord GOD of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:

translated_text: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.
original_text: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.

translated_text: And it was revealed in mine ears by the LORD of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
original_text: And it was revealed in mine ears by the LORD of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.

translated_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer,
even unto Shebna, which
is over the house,
and say,
original_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer,
even unto Shebna, which
is over the house,
and say,

translated_text:
What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here,
as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high,
and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?
original_text:
What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here,
as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high,
and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?

translated_text: Behold, the LORD will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.
original_text: Behold, the LORD will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.

translated_text:
He will surely violently turn and toss thee
like a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory
shall be the shame of thy lord’s house.
original_text:
He will surely violently turn and toss thee
like a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory
shall be the shame of thy lord’s house.

translated_text: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.
original_text: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:
original_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:

translated_text: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
original_text: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

translated_text: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
original_text: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.

translated_text: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father’s house.
original_text: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father’s house.

translated_text: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.
original_text: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.

translated_text:
In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that
was upon it shall be cut off: for the LORD hath spoken
it.
original_text:
In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that
was upon it shall be cut off: for the LORD hath spoken
it.

translated_text:
The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz,
and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
original_text:
The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz,
and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

translated_text: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the LORD hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
original_text: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the LORD hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.

translated_text:
The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master’s crib:
but
 Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
original_text:
The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master’s crib:
but
 Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.

translated_text: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the LORD, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.
original_text: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the LORD, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.

translated_text: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
original_text: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

translated_text:
Your country
is desolate, your cities
are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and
it is
 desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
original_text:
Your country
is desolate, your cities
are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and
it is
 desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

translated_text: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
original_text: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.

translated_text:
Except the LORD of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom,
and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
original_text:
Except the LORD of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom,
and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.

translated_text: Hear the word of the LORD, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
original_text: Hear the word of the LORD, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.

translated_text:
To what purpose
is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the LORD: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.
original_text:
To what purpose
is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the LORD: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.

translated_text: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?
original_text: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?

translated_text:
Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear
them.
original_text:
Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear
them.

translated_text: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
original_text: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.

translated_text: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
original_text: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;

translated_text: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
original_text: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.

translated_text: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
original_text: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

translated_text: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
original_text: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:

translated_text:
But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken
it.
original_text:
But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken
it.

translated_text: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
original_text: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.

translated_text: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
original_text: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:

translated_text:
Thy princes
are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
original_text:
Thy princes
are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.

translated_text: Therefore saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:
original_text: Therefore saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:

translated_text: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:
original_text: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:

translated_text: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
original_text: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.

translated_text: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
original_text: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.

translated_text:
And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners
shall be together, and they that forsake the LORD shall be consumed.
original_text:
And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners
shall be together, and they that forsake the LORD shall be consumed.

translated_text: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
original_text: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.

translated_text: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
original_text: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.

translated_text:
And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench
them.
original_text:
And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench
them.

translated_text: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
original_text: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:

translated_text: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
original_text: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.

translated_text: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
original_text: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.

translated_text: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
original_text: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?

translated_text:
And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up;
and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
original_text:
And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up;
and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:

translated_text: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
original_text: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.

translated_text:
For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts
is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.
original_text:
For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts
is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.

translated_text:
Woe unto them that join house to house,
that lay field to field, till
there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!
original_text:
Woe unto them that join house to house,
that lay field to field, till
there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!

translated_text:
In mine ears
said the LORD of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate,
even great and fair, without inhabitant.
original_text:
In mine ears
said the LORD of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate,
even great and fair, without inhabitant.

translated_text: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.
original_text: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.

translated_text:
Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning,
that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night,
till wine inflame them!
original_text:
Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning,
that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night,
till wine inflame them!

translated_text: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the LORD, neither consider the operation of his hands.
original_text: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the LORD, neither consider the operation of his hands.

translated_text:
Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because
they have
 no knowledge: and their honourable men
are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.
original_text:
Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because
they have
 no knowledge: and their honourable men
are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.

translated_text: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.
original_text: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.

translated_text: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:
original_text: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:

translated_text: But the LORD of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.
original_text: But the LORD of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.

translated_text: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.
original_text: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.

translated_text: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:
original_text: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:

translated_text:
That say, Let him make speed,
and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know
it!
original_text:
That say, Let him make speed,
and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know
it!

translated_text: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
original_text: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

translated_text:
Woe unto
them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
original_text:
Woe unto
them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

translated_text:
Woe unto
them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:
original_text:
Woe unto
them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:

translated_text: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
original_text: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!

translated_text:
Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff,
so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the LORD of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
original_text:
Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff,
so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the LORD of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

translated_text:
Therefore is the anger of the LORD kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases
were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand
is
 stretched out still.
original_text:
Therefore is the anger of the LORD kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases
were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand
is
 stretched out still.

translated_text: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:
original_text: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:

translated_text: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
original_text: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:

translated_text:
Whose arrows
are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses’ hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:
original_text:
Whose arrows
are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses’ hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:

translated_text:
Their roaring
shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry
it away safe, and none shall deliver
it.
original_text:
Their roaring
shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry
it away safe, and none shall deliver
it.

translated_text:
And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if
one look unto the land, behold darkness
and
 sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.
original_text:
And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if
one look unto the land, behold darkness
and
 sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.

translated_text: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.
original_text: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.

translated_text:
In that day shall the branch of the LORD be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth
shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.
original_text:
In that day shall the branch of the LORD be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth
shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that he that is left in Zion, and
he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy,
even
 every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that he that is left in Zion, and
he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy,
even
 every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:

translated_text: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.
original_text: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.

translated_text:
And the LORD will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory
shall be a defence.
original_text:
And the LORD will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory
shall be a defence.

translated_text: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.
original_text: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.

translated_text: For, behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water,
original_text: For, behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water,

translated_text: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,
original_text: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,

translated_text: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.
original_text: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.

translated_text:
And I will give children
to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
original_text:
And I will give children
to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.

translated_text: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.
original_text: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.

translated_text:
When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father,
saying, Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and
let
 this ruin
be under thy hand:
original_text:
When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father,
saying, Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and
let
 this ruin
be under thy hand:

translated_text:
In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house
is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.
original_text:
In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house
is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.

translated_text:
For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings
are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
original_text:
For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings
are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

translated_text:
The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide
it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.
original_text:
The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide
it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.

translated_text:
Say ye to the righteous, that
it shall be well
with him:
 for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
original_text:
Say ye to the righteous, that
it shall be well
with him:
 for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.

translated_text:
Woe unto the wicked!
it shall be ill
with him:
 for the reward of his hands shall be given him.
original_text:
Woe unto the wicked!
it shall be ill
with him:
 for the reward of his hands shall be given him.

translated_text:
As for my people, children
are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause
thee
 to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.
original_text:
As for my people, children
are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause
thee
 to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.

translated_text: The LORD standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.
original_text: The LORD standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.

translated_text:
The LORD will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor
is in your houses.
original_text:
The LORD will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor
is in your houses.

translated_text:
What mean ye
that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the LORD GOD of hosts.
original_text:
What mean ye
that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the LORD GOD of hosts.

translated_text:
Moreover the LORD saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing
as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:
original_text:
Moreover the LORD saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing
as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:
