translated_text: Therefore the LORD will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will discover their secret parts.
original_text: Therefore the LORD will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will discover their secret parts.

translated_text:
In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of
their
 tinkling ornaments
about their feet, and
their
 cauls, and
their round tires like the moon,
original_text:
In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of
their
 tinkling ornaments
about their feet, and
their
 cauls, and
their round tires like the moon,

translated_text: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,
original_text: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,

translated_text: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,
original_text: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,

translated_text: The rings, and nose jewels,
original_text: The rings, and nose jewels,

translated_text: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,
original_text: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,

translated_text: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
original_text: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth;
and
 burning instead of beauty.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth;
and
 burning instead of beauty.

translated_text: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.
original_text: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.

translated_text:
And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she
being desolate shall sit upon the ground.
original_text:
And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she
being desolate shall sit upon the ground.

translated_text: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
original_text: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass in the last days,
that the mountain of the LORD’S house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass in the last days,
that the mountain of the LORD’S house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.

translated_text: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
original_text: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

translated_text: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
original_text: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

translated_text: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the LORD.
original_text: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the LORD.

translated_text:
Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and
are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
original_text:
Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and
are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.

translated_text:
Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither
is there any
 end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither
is there any end of their chariots:
original_text:
Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither
is there any
 end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither
is there any end of their chariots:

translated_text: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
original_text: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:

translated_text: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
original_text: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.

translated_text: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty.
original_text: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty.

translated_text: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
original_text: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.

translated_text:
For the day of the LORD of hosts
shall be upon every
one that is proud and lofty, and upon every
one that is
 lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
original_text:
For the day of the LORD of hosts
shall be upon every
one that is proud and lofty, and upon every
one that is
 lifted up; and he shall be brought low:

translated_text:
And upon all the cedars of Lebanon,
that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
original_text:
And upon all the cedars of Lebanon,
that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,

translated_text:
And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills
that are
 lifted up,
original_text:
And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills
that are
 lifted up,

translated_text: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
original_text: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,

translated_text: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
original_text: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.

translated_text: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
original_text: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.

translated_text: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
original_text: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.

translated_text: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
original_text: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.

translated_text:
In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made
each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
original_text:
In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made
each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;

translated_text: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
original_text: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.

translated_text:
Cease ye from man, whose breath
is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?
original_text:
Cease ye from man, whose breath
is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?

translated_text:
Nevertheless the dimness
shall not
be such as
was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict
her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.
original_text:
Nevertheless the dimness
shall not
be such as
was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict
her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.

translated_text: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
original_text: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.

translated_text:
Thou hast multiplied the nation,
and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest,
and as
men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
original_text:
Thou hast multiplied the nation,
and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest,
and as
men rejoice when they divide the spoil.

translated_text: For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.
original_text: For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.

translated_text:
For every battle of the warrior
is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but
this shall be with burning
and
 fuel of fire.
original_text:
For every battle of the warrior
is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but
this shall be with burning
and
 fuel of fire.

translated_text: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
original_text: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

translated_text:
Of the increase of
his government and peace
there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will perform this.
original_text:
Of the increase of
his government and peace
there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will perform this.

translated_text: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.
original_text: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.

translated_text:
And all the people shall know,
even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,
original_text:
And all the people shall know,
even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,

translated_text:
The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change
them into cedars.
original_text:
The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change
them into cedars.

translated_text: Therefore the LORD shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;
original_text: Therefore the LORD shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;

translated_text:
The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand
is stretched out still.
original_text:
The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand
is stretched out still.

translated_text: For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the LORD of hosts.
original_text: For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the LORD of hosts.

translated_text: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.
original_text: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.

translated_text:
The ancient and honourable, he
is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he
is the tail.
original_text:
The ancient and honourable, he
is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he
is the tail.

translated_text:
For the leaders of this people cause
them to err; and
they that are led of them
are destroyed.
original_text:
For the leaders of this people cause
them to err; and
they that are led of them
are destroyed.

translated_text:
Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand
is stretched out still.
original_text:
Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand
is stretched out still.

translated_text:
For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up
like the lifting up of smoke.
original_text:
For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up
like the lifting up of smoke.

translated_text: Through the wrath of the LORD of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.
original_text: Through the wrath of the LORD of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.

translated_text: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:
original_text: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:

translated_text:
Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh:
and they together
shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand
is stretched out still.
original_text:
Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh:
and they together
shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand
is stretched out still.

translated_text: Moreover the LORD said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man’s pen concerning Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
original_text: Moreover the LORD said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man’s pen concerning Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

translated_text: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.
original_text: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.

translated_text: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the LORD to me, Call his name Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
original_text: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the LORD to me, Call his name Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

translated_text: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.
original_text: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.

translated_text: The LORD spake also unto me again, saying,
original_text: The LORD spake also unto me again, saying,

translated_text: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;
original_text: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;

translated_text:
Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many,
even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:
original_text:
Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many,
even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:

translated_text:
And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach
even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.
original_text:
And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach
even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.

translated_text: Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.
original_text: Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.

translated_text:
Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God
is with us.
original_text:
Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God
is with us.

translated_text: For the LORD spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,
original_text: For the LORD spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,

translated_text:
Say ye not, A confederacy, to all
them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.
original_text:
Say ye not, A confederacy, to all
them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.

translated_text:
Sanctify the LORD of hosts himself; and
let him
be
 your fear, and
let him
be your dread.
original_text:
Sanctify the LORD of hosts himself; and
let him
be
 your fear, and
let him
be your dread.

translated_text: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
original_text: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

translated_text: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.
original_text: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.

translated_text: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
original_text: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.

translated_text: And I will wait upon the LORD, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
original_text: And I will wait upon the LORD, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

translated_text:
Behold, I and the children whom the LORD hath given me
are
 for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.
original_text:
Behold, I and the children whom the LORD hath given me
are
 for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.

translated_text: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?
original_text: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?

translated_text:
To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word,
it is because
there is no light in them.
original_text:
To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word,
it is because
there is no light in them.

translated_text: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.
original_text: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.

translated_text:
And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and
they shall be driven to darkness.
original_text:
And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and
they shall be driven to darkness.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah,
that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
original_text:
And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah,
that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

translated_text: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.
original_text: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.

translated_text: Then said the LORD unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shear-jashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field;
original_text: Then said the LORD unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shear-jashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field;

translated_text: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
original_text: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.

translated_text: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,
original_text: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,

translated_text:
Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it,
even the son of Tabeal:
original_text:
Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it,
even the son of Tabeal:

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.

translated_text:
For the head of Syria
is Damascus, and the head of Damascus
is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.
original_text:
For the head of Syria
is Damascus, and the head of Damascus
is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.

translated_text:
And the head of Ephraim
is Samaria, and the head of Samaria
is Remaliah’s son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.
original_text:
And the head of Ephraim
is Samaria, and the head of Samaria
is Remaliah’s son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.

translated_text: Moreover the LORD spake again unto Ahaz, saying,
original_text: Moreover the LORD spake again unto Ahaz, saying,

translated_text: Ask thee a sign of the LORD thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
original_text: Ask thee a sign of the LORD thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.

translated_text: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the LORD.
original_text: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the LORD.

translated_text:
And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David;
Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?
original_text:
And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David;
Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?

translated_text: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
original_text: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

translated_text: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
original_text: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.

translated_text: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.
original_text: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.

translated_text:
The LORD shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father’s house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah;
even the king of Assyria.
original_text:
The LORD shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father’s house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah;
even the king of Assyria.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that the LORD shall hiss for the fly that
is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that
is in the land of Assyria.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that the LORD shall hiss for the fly that
is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that
is in the land of Assyria.

translated_text: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.
original_text: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.

translated_text:
In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired,
namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.
original_text:
In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired,
namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;
original_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk
that
 they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk
that
 they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall
even be for briers and thorns.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall
even be for briers and thorns.

translated_text:
With arrows and with bows shall
men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.
original_text:
With arrows and with bows shall
men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.

translated_text:
And
on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.
original_text:
And
on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.

translated_text: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
original_text: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.

translated_text: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
original_text: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.

translated_text:
And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy,
is
 the LORD of hosts: the whole earth
is full of his glory.
original_text:
And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy,
is
 the LORD of hosts: the whole earth
is full of his glory.

translated_text: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
original_text: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.

translated_text:
Then said I, Woe
is me! for I am undone; because I
am
 a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts.
original_text:
Then said I, Woe
is me! for I am undone; because I
am
 a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts.

translated_text:
Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand,
which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:
original_text:
Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand,
which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:

translated_text:
And he laid
it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.
original_text:
And he laid
it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.

translated_text:
Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here
am I; send me.
original_text:
Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here
am I; send me.

translated_text: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
original_text: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.

translated_text: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.
original_text: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.

translated_text: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,
original_text: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,

translated_text:
And the LORD have removed men far away, and
there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.
original_text:
And the LORD have removed men far away, and
there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.

translated_text:
But yet in it
shall be a tenth, and
it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast
their leaves: so the holy seed
shall be
 the substance thereof.
original_text:
But yet in it
shall be a tenth, and
it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast
their leaves: so the holy seed
shall be
 the substance thereof.

translated_text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
original_text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

translated_text:
Stand in the gate of the LORD’S house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the LORD, all
ye of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.
original_text:
Stand in the gate of the LORD’S house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the LORD, all
ye of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

translated_text:
Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD,
are these.
original_text:
Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD,
are these.

translated_text: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;
original_text: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;

translated_text: If ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:
original_text: If ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:

translated_text: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.
original_text: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.

translated_text: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
original_text: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.

translated_text: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not;
original_text: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not;

translated_text: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?
original_text: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?

translated_text:
Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen
it, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen
it, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
But go ye now unto my place which
was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
original_text:
But go ye now unto my place which
was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.

translated_text: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the LORD, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;
original_text: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the LORD, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;

translated_text:
Therefore will I do unto
this house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
original_text:
Therefore will I do unto
this house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.

translated_text:
And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren,
even the whole seed of Ephraim.
original_text:
And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren,
even the whole seed of Ephraim.

translated_text: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.
original_text: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.

translated_text: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
original_text: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

translated_text:
The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead
their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
original_text:
The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead
their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.

translated_text:
Do they provoke me to anger? saith the LORD:
do they not
provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?
original_text:
Do they provoke me to anger? saith the LORD:
do they not
provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.

translated_text: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:
original_text: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:

translated_text: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.
original_text: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.

translated_text:
But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels
and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
original_text:
But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels
and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.

translated_text:
Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending
them:
original_text:
Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending
them:

translated_text: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.
original_text: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.

translated_text: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.
original_text: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.

translated_text:
But thou shalt say unto them, This
is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the LORD their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.
original_text:
But thou shalt say unto them, This
is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the LORD their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.

translated_text:
Cut off thine hair,
O Jerusalem, and cast
it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the LORD hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
original_text:
Cut off thine hair,
O Jerusalem, and cast
it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the LORD hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

translated_text: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith the LORD: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.
original_text: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith the LORD: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.

translated_text:
And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded
them not, neither came it into my heart.
original_text:
And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded
them not, neither came it into my heart.

translated_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
original_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.

translated_text:
And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray
them
 away.
original_text:
And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray
them
 away.

translated_text: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.
original_text: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.

translated_text: O ye children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Beth-haccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.
original_text: O ye children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Beth-haccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.

translated_text:
I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate
woman.
original_text:
I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate
woman.

translated_text:
The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch
their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.
original_text:
The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch
their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.

translated_text: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
original_text: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.

translated_text: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.
original_text: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.

translated_text:
For thus hath the LORD of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this
is the city to be visited; she
is
 wholly oppression in the midst of her.
original_text:
For thus hath the LORD of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this
is the city to be visited; she
is
 wholly oppression in the midst of her.

translated_text: As a fountain casteth out her waters, so she casteth out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.
original_text: As a fountain casteth out her waters, so she casteth out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.

translated_text: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.
original_text: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.

translated_text:
To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear
is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of the LORD is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.
original_text:
To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear
is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of the LORD is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.

translated_text:
Therefore I am full of the fury of the LORD; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with
him that is full of days.
original_text:
Therefore I am full of the fury of the LORD; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with
him that is full of days.

translated_text:
And their houses shall be turned unto others,
with their
 fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD.
original_text:
And their houses shall be turned unto others,
with their
 fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one
is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
original_text:
For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one
is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.

translated_text:
They have healed also the hurt
of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when
there is no peace.
original_text:
They have healed also the hurt
of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when
there is no peace.

translated_text:
Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time
that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time
that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk
therein.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk
therein.

translated_text:
Also I set watchmen over you,
saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.
original_text:
Also I set watchmen over you,
saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.

translated_text:
Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what
is
 among them.
original_text:
Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what
is
 among them.

translated_text:
Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people,
even
 the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.
original_text:
Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people,
even
 the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.

translated_text:
To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings
are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.
original_text:
To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings
are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.

translated_text:
They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they
are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against thee, O daughter of Zion.
original_text:
They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they
are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against thee, O daughter of Zion.

translated_text:
We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us,
and pain, as of a woman in travail.
original_text:
We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us,
and pain, as of a woman in travail.

translated_text:
Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy
and fear
is on every side.
original_text:
Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy
and fear
is on every side.

translated_text:
O daughter of my people, gird
thee with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning,
as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.
original_text:
O daughter of my people, gird
thee with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning,
as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.

translated_text:
I have set thee
for a tower
and a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.
original_text:
I have set thee
for a tower
and a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.

translated_text:
They
are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders:
they are brass and iron; they
are all corrupters.
original_text:
They
are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders:
they are brass and iron; they
are all corrupters.

translated_text: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.
original_text: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.

translated_text:
Reprobate silver shall
men call them, because the LORD hath rejected them.
original_text:
Reprobate silver shall
men call them, because the LORD hath rejected them.

translated_text: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
original_text: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

translated_text:
Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they
be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
original_text:
Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they
be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

translated_text:
And they bend their tongues
like their bow
for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the LORD.
original_text:
And they bend their tongues
like their bow
for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.
original_text: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.

translated_text:
And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies,
and weary themselves to commit iniquity.
original_text:
And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies,
and weary themselves to commit iniquity.

translated_text:
Thine habitation
is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Thine habitation
is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?

translated_text:
Their tongue
is as an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit:
one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait.
original_text:
Their tongue
is as an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit:
one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait.

translated_text:
Shall I not visit them for these
things? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
original_text:
Shall I not visit them for these
things? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

translated_text:
For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through
them; neither can
men hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.
original_text:
For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through
them; neither can
men hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.

translated_text:
And I will make Jerusalem heaps,
and a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant.
original_text:
And I will make Jerusalem heaps,
and a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant.

translated_text:
Who
is the wise man, that may understand this? and
who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth
and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?
original_text:
Who
is the wise man, that may understand this? and
who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth
and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?

translated_text: And the LORD saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;
original_text: And the LORD saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;

translated_text: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:
original_text: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them,
even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them,
even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.

translated_text: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.
original_text: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning
women, that they may come:
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning
women, that they may come:

translated_text: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.
original_text: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.

translated_text:
For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast
us out.
original_text:
For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast
us out.

translated_text: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.
original_text: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.

translated_text:
For death is come up into our windows,
and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without,
and the young men from the streets.
original_text:
For death is come up into our windows,
and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without,
and the young men from the streets.

translated_text:
Speak, Thus saith the LORD, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather
them.
original_text:
Speak, Thus saith the LORD, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather
them.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, Let not the wise
man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty
man glory in his might, let not the rich
man glory in his riches:
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, Let not the wise
man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty
man glory in his might, let not the rich
man glory in his riches:

translated_text:
But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I
am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these
things
 I delight, saith the LORD.
original_text:
But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I
am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these
things
 I delight, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will punish all
them which are circumcised with the uncircumcised;
original_text:
Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will punish all
them which are circumcised with the uncircumcised;

translated_text:
Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all
that are in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all
these nations
are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel
are uncircumcised in the heart.
original_text:
Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all
that are in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all
these nations
are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel
are uncircumcised in the heart.

translated_text: At that time, saith the LORD, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:
original_text: At that time, saith the LORD, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:

translated_text: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
original_text: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.

translated_text: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the LORD of hosts.
original_text: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the LORD of hosts.

translated_text: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?
original_text: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?

translated_text:
Why
then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
original_text:
Why
then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.

translated_text:
I hearkened and heard,
but they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.
original_text:
I hearkened and heard,
but they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.

translated_text: Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of the LORD.
original_text: Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of the LORD.

translated_text:
How do ye say, We
are wise, and the law of the LORD
is
 with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he
it; the pen of the scribes
is in vain.
original_text:
How do ye say, We
are wise, and the law of the LORD
is
 with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he
it; the pen of the scribes
is in vain.

translated_text:
The wise
men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of the LORD; and what wisdom
is in them?
original_text:
The wise
men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of the LORD; and what wisdom
is in them?

translated_text:
Therefore will I give their wives unto others,
and their fields to them that shall inherit
them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
original_text:
Therefore will I give their wives unto others,
and their fields to them that shall inherit
them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.

translated_text:
For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when
there is no peace.
original_text:
For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when
there is no peace.

translated_text: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.
original_text: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
I will surely consume them, saith the LORD:
there shall be
 no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and
the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.
original_text:
I will surely consume them, saith the LORD:
there shall be
 no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and
the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.

translated_text: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for the LORD our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.
original_text: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for the LORD our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.

translated_text:
We looked for peace, but no good
came; and for a time of health, and behold trouble!
original_text:
We looked for peace, but no good
came; and for a time of health, and behold trouble!

translated_text: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.
original_text: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.

translated_text:
For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which
will not
be charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the LORD.
original_text:
For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which
will not
be charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart
is faint in me.
original_text:
When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart
is faint in me.

translated_text:
Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country:
Is not the LORD in Zion?
is
 not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images,
and with strange vanities?
original_text:
Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country:
Is not the LORD in Zion?
is
 not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images,
and with strange vanities?

translated_text: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
original_text: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.

translated_text: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me.
original_text: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me.

translated_text:
Is there no balm in Gilead;
is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
original_text:
Is there no balm in Gilead;
is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?

translated_text:
The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that
were
 in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:
original_text:
The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that
were
 in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

translated_text: To whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
original_text: To whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

translated_text: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
original_text: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

translated_text: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee,
and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
original_text:
Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee,
and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.

translated_text:
Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I
am
 a child.
original_text:
Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I
am
 a child.

translated_text:
But the LORD said unto me, Say not, I
am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.
original_text:
But the LORD said unto me, Say not, I
am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.

translated_text:
Be not afraid of their faces: for I
am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Be not afraid of their faces: for I
am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
original_text: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.

translated_text: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.

translated_text: Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
original_text: Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.

original_text: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.

translated_text: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.
original_text: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.

translated_text: For, behold, I have made thee this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.
original_text: For, behold, I have made thee this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.

translated_text:
And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I

original_text:
And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I

translated_text: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man’s, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith the LORD.
original_text: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man’s, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith the LORD.

original_text: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places, and see where thou hast not been lien with. In the ways hast thou sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness.

translated_text: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; and thou hadst a whore’s forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.
original_text: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; and thou hadst a whore’s forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.

translated_text: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My father, thou art the guide of my youth?
original_text: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My father, thou art the guide of my youth?

original_text:
Will he reserve

original_text:

translated_text:

original_text:

translated_text: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not, but went and played the harlot also.
original_text: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not, but went and played the harlot also.

translated_text: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.
original_text: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.

translated_text: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith the LORD.
original_text: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith the LORD.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto me, The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah.
original_text: And the LORD said unto me, The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah.

original_text: Only acknowledge thine iniquity, that thou hast transgressed against the LORD thy God, and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree, and ye have not obeyed my voice, saith the LORD.

original_text: Turn, O backsliding children, saith the LORD; for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:
