original_text: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.

 be done any more.

translated_text: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the LORD; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of the LORD, to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.
original_text: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the LORD; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of the LORD, to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.

translated_text: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.
original_text: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.

translated_text: But I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, Thou shalt call me, My father; and shalt not turn away from me.
original_text: But I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, Thou shalt call me, My father; and shalt not turn away from me.

translated_text:
Surely
as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Surely
as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith the LORD.

translated_text:

original_text:
A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping
and supplications of the children of Israel: for they have perverted their way,

translated_text:

original_text:
Return, ye backsliding children,
and I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto thee; for thou

translated_text:

original_text:
Truly in vain
is salvation hoped for from the hills,

translated_text: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
original_text: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

translated_text: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covereth us: for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.
original_text: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covereth us: for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.

Israel

original_text:
Israel

original_text: Hear ye the word of the LORD, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel:

original_text: Thus saith the LORD, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?

original_text:

original_text: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.

original_text: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith the LORD, and with your children’s children will I plead.

translated_text: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.
original_text: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.

original_text:
Hath a nation changed
their gods, which

translated_text: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the LORD.
original_text: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the LORD.

translated_text:

original_text:
For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters,

translated_text:
Is Israel a servant?
is he a homeborn

 why is he spoiled?
original_text:
Is Israel a servant?
is he a homeborn
slave?
 why is he spoiled?

translated_text:

and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.
original_text:
The young lions roared upon him,
and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.

translated_text: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head.
original_text: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head.

translated_text: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, when he led thee by the way?
original_text: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, when he led thee by the way?

translated_text: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?
original_text: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?

translated_text:

thing
 and bitter, that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, and that my fear

original_text:

thing
 and bitter, that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, and that my fear

translated_text:

original_text:
For of old time I have broken thy yoke,
and burst thy bands; and thou saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest, playing the harlot.

translated_text: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?
original_text: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?

translated_text:

original_text:
For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much sope,
yet thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord GOD.

original_text:
How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done:

translated_text:
A wild ass used to the wilderness,

original_text:
A wild ass used to the wilderness,
that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.

translated_text: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst: but thou saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.
original_text: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst: but thou saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.

original_text: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,

original_text:

original_text:
But where

original_text: Wherefore will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith the LORD.

original_text: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

original_text: O generation, see ye the word of the LORD. Have I been a wilderness unto Israel? a land of darkness? wherefore say my people, We are lords; we will come no more unto thee?

original_text:
Can a maid forget her ornaments,

translated_text: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways.
original_text: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways.

translated_text: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.
original_text: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.

translated_text: Yet thou sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.
original_text: Yet thou sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.

translated_text: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.
original_text: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.

translated_text: Yea, thou shalt go forth from him, and thine hands upon thine head: for the LORD hath rejected thy confidences, and thou shalt not prosper in them.
original_text: Yea, thou shalt go forth from him, and thine hands upon thine head: for the LORD hath rejected thy confidences, and thou shalt not prosper in them.

translated_text:

original_text:
Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be

translated_text: And though they say, The LORD liveth; surely they swear falsely.
original_text: And though they say, The LORD liveth; surely they swear falsely.

original_text:

original_text:
Therefore I said, Surely these

original_text:

original_text:
How shall I pardon thee for this? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by

original_text:

original_text:

original_text: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith the LORD.

original_text:

original_text: Wherefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.

 all mighty men.

And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread,
which
 thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.
original_text:
And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread,
which
 thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.

translated_text: Nevertheless in those days, saith the LORD, I will not make a full end with you.
original_text: Nevertheless in those days, saith the LORD, I will not make a full end with you.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doeth the LORD our God all these
things unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land
that is not yours.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doeth the LORD our God all these
things unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land
that is not yours.

translated_text: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,
original_text: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,

translated_text: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:
original_text: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:

translated_text:
Fear ye not me? saith the LORD: will ye not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand
for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?
original_text:
Fear ye not me? saith the LORD: will ye not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand
for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?

translated_text: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.
original_text: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.

translated_text: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear the LORD our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.
original_text: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear the LORD our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.

translated_text:
Your iniquities have turned away these
things, and your sins have withholden good
things from you.
original_text:
Your iniquities have turned away these
things, and your sins have withholden good
things from you.

translated_text:
For among my people are found wicked
men: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.
original_text:
For among my people are found wicked
men: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.

translated_text:
As a cage is full of birds, so
are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.
original_text:
As a cage is full of birds, so
are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.

translated_text: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.
original_text: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.

translated_text:
Shall I not visit for these
things? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
original_text:
Shall I not visit for these
things? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

translated_text: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;
original_text: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;

translated_text:
The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love
to have it so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?
original_text:
The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love
to have it so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?

translated_text: If thou wilt return, O Israel, saith the LORD, return unto me: and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight, then shalt thou not remove.
original_text: If thou wilt return, O Israel, saith the LORD, return unto me: and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight, then shalt thou not remove.

translated_text: And thou shalt swear, The LORD liveth, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.
original_text: And thou shalt swear, The LORD liveth, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD to the men of Judah and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.
original_text: For thus saith the LORD to the men of Judah and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.

translated_text:
Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench
it, because of the evil of your doings.
original_text:
Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench
it, because of the evil of your doings.

translated_text: Declare ye in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow ye the trumpet in the land: cry, gather together, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced cities.
original_text: Declare ye in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow ye the trumpet in the land: cry, gather together, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced cities.

translated_text: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.
original_text: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.

translated_text:
The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate;
and thy cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.
original_text:
The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate;
and thy cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.

translated_text: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of the LORD is not turned back from us.
original_text: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of the LORD is not turned back from us.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass at that day, saith the LORD,
that
 the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass at that day, saith the LORD,
that
 the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.

translated_text: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the soul.
original_text: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the soul.

translated_text: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,
original_text: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,

translated_text:
Even
a full wind from those
places
shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.
original_text:
Even
a full wind from those
places
shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.

translated_text:
Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots
shall be
 as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.
original_text:
Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots
shall be
 as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.

translated_text: O Jerusalem, wash thine heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee?
original_text: O Jerusalem, wash thine heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee?

translated_text: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.
original_text: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.

translated_text:
Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem,
that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.
original_text:
Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem,
that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.

translated_text: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith the LORD.
original_text: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
Thy way and thy doings have procured these
things unto thee; this
is thy wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reacheth unto thine heart.
original_text:
Thy way and thy doings have procured these
things unto thee; this
is thy wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reacheth unto thine heart.

translated_text: My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart maketh a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the trump, the alarm of war.
original_text: My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart maketh a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the trump, the alarm of war.

translated_text:
Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is spoiled: suddenly are my tents spoiled,
and my curtains in a moment.
original_text:
Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is spoiled: suddenly are my tents spoiled,
and my curtains in a moment.

translated_text:
How long shall I see the standard,
and hear the sound of the trumpet?
original_text:
How long shall I see the standard,
and hear the sound of the trumpet?

translated_text:
For my people
is foolish, they have not known me; they
are sottish children, and they have none understanding: they
are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.
original_text:
For my people
is foolish, they have not known me; they
are sottish children, and they have none understanding: they
are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.

translated_text:
I beheld the earth, and, lo,
it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they
had no light.
original_text:
I beheld the earth, and, lo,
it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they
had no light.

translated_text: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.
original_text: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.

translated_text:
I beheld, and, lo,
there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.
original_text:
I beheld, and, lo,
there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.

translated_text:
I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place
was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the LORD,
and by his fierce anger.
original_text:
I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place
was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the LORD,
and by his fierce anger.

translated_text: For thus hath the LORD said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.
original_text: For thus hath the LORD said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.

translated_text:
For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken
it, I have purposed
it, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.
original_text:
For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken
it, I have purposed
it, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.

translated_text:
The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city
shall be
 forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.
original_text:
The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city
shall be
 forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.

translated_text:
And
when thou
art spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair;
thy lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.
original_text:
And
when thou
art spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair;
thy lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.

translated_text:
For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail,
and the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion,
that bewaileth herself,
that spreadeth her hands,
saying, Woe
is me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.
original_text:
For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail,
and the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion,
that bewaileth herself,
that spreadeth her hands,
saying, Woe
is me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, Go and get a potter’s earthen bottle, and
take of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, Go and get a potter’s earthen bottle, and
take of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;

translated_text:
And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which
is
 by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee,
original_text:
And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which
is
 by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee,

translated_text: And say, Hear ye the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.
original_text: And say, Hear ye the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.

translated_text: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;
original_text: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;

translated_text:
They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire
for burnt offerings unto Baal, which I commanded not, nor spake
it, neither came
it into my mind:
original_text:
They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire
for burnt offerings unto Baal, which I commanded not, nor spake
it, neither came
it into my mind:

translated_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.
original_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.

translated_text: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
original_text: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

translated_text: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.
original_text: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.

translated_text: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.
original_text: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.

translated_text: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,
original_text: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,

translated_text:
And shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Even so will I break this people and this city, as
one breaketh a potter’s vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury
them in Tophet, till
there be no place to bury.
original_text:
And shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Even so will I break this people and this city, as
one breaketh a potter’s vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury
them in Tophet, till
there be no place to bury.

translated_text:
Thus will I do unto this place, saith the LORD, and to the inhabitants thereof, and
even make this city as Tophet:
original_text:
Thus will I do unto this place, saith the LORD, and to the inhabitants thereof, and
even make this city as Tophet:

translated_text: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.
original_text: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.

translated_text: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither the LORD had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the LORD’S house; and said to all the people,
original_text: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither the LORD had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the LORD’S house; and said to all the people,

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.

translated_text: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
original_text: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

translated_text: Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.
original_text: Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.

translated_text: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.
original_text: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.

translated_text:
And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make
it.
original_text:
And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make
it.

translated_text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
original_text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

translated_text:
O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay
is in the potter’s hand, so
are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.
original_text:
O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay
is in the potter’s hand, so
are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.

translated_text:
At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy
it;
original_text:
At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy
it;

translated_text: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.
original_text: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.

translated_text: If it do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.
original_text: If it do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.

translated_text: Now therefore go to, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return ye now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.
original_text: Now therefore go to, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return ye now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.

translated_text: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.
original_text: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ask ye now among the heathen, who hath heard such things: the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ask ye now among the heathen, who hath heard such things: the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing.

translated_text:
Will
a man leave the snow of Lebanon
which cometh
 from the rock of the field?
or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?
original_text:
Will
a man leave the snow of Lebanon
which cometh
 from the rock of the field?
or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?

translated_text:
To make their land desolate,
and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.
original_text:
To make their land desolate,
and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.

translated_text: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.
original_text: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.

translated_text: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.
original_text: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.

translated_text: Give heed to me, O LORD, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.
original_text: Give heed to me, O LORD, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.

translated_text:
Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them,
and
 to turn away thy wrath from them.
original_text:
Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them,
and
 to turn away thy wrath from them.

translated_text:
Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their
blood by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and
be widows; and let their men be put to death;
let their young men
be slain by the sword in battle.
original_text:
Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their
blood by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and
be widows; and let their men be put to death;
let their young men
be slain by the sword in battle.

translated_text: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.
original_text: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.

translated_text:
Yet, LORD, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay
me:
 forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight, but let them be overthrown before thee; deal
thus with them in the time of thine anger.
original_text:
Yet, LORD, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay
me:
 forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight, but let them be overthrown before thee; deal
thus with them in the time of thine anger.

translated_text:
The sin of Judah
is written with a pen of iron,
and
 with the point of a diamond:
it is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;
original_text:
The sin of Judah
is written with a pen of iron,
and
 with the point of a diamond:
it is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;

translated_text: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.
original_text: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.

translated_text:
O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance
and
 all thy treasures to the spoil,
and thy high places for sin, throughout all thy borders.
original_text:
O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance
and
 all thy treasures to the spoil,
and thy high places for sin, throughout all thy borders.

translated_text:
And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger,
which shall burn for ever.
original_text:
And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger,
which shall burn for ever.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the LORD.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the LORD.

translated_text:
For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness,
in
 a salt land and not inhabited.
original_text:
For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness,
in
 a salt land and not inhabited.

translated_text:
Blessed
is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.
original_text:
Blessed
is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.

translated_text:
For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and
that
 spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
original_text:
For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and
that
 spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

translated_text:
The heart
is deceitful above all
things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
original_text:
The heart
is deceitful above all
things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?

translated_text:
I the LORD search the heart,
I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways,
and according to the fruit of his doings.
original_text:
I the LORD search the heart,
I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways,
and according to the fruit of his doings.

translated_text:
As the partridge sitteth
on eggs, and hatcheth
them
 not;
so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.
original_text:
As the partridge sitteth
on eggs, and hatcheth
them
 not;
so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.

translated_text:
A glorious high throne from the beginning
is the place of our sanctuary.
original_text:
A glorious high throne from the beginning
is the place of our sanctuary.

translated_text:
O LORD, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed,
and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD, the fountain of living waters.
original_text:
O LORD, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed,
and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD, the fountain of living waters.

translated_text:
Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou
art my praise.
original_text:
Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou
art my praise.

translated_text:
Behold, they say unto me, Where
is the word of the LORD? let it come now.
original_text:
Behold, they say unto me, Where
is the word of the LORD? let it come now.

translated_text:
As for me, I have not hastened from
being a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was
right before thee.
original_text:
As for me, I have not hastened from
being a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was
right before thee.

translated_text:
Be not a terror unto me: thou
art my hope in the day of evil.
original_text:
Be not a terror unto me: thou
art my hope in the day of evil.

translated_text: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.
original_text: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

translated_text: Thus said the LORD unto me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by the which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;
original_text: Thus said the LORD unto me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by the which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;

translated_text: And say unto them, Hear ye the word of the LORD, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
original_text: And say unto them, Hear ye the word of the LORD, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD; Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring
it in by the gates of Jerusalem;
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD; Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring
it in by the gates of Jerusalem;

translated_text: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work, but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.
original_text: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work, but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.

translated_text: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.
original_text: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto me, saith the LORD, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;
original_text: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto me, saith the LORD, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;

translated_text: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.
original_text: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.

translated_text: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of the LORD.
original_text: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of the LORD.

translated_text: But if ye will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.
original_text: But if ye will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.

translated_text: The word of the LORD came also unto me, saying,
original_text: The word of the LORD came also unto me, saying,

translated_text: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place.
original_text: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;
original_text: For thus saith the LORD concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;

translated_text:
They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried;
but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
original_text:
They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried;
but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

translated_text:
For thus saith the LORD, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the LORD,
even lovingkindness and mercies.
original_text:
For thus saith the LORD, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the LORD,
even lovingkindness and mercies.

translated_text:
Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall
men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:
original_text:
Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall
men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:

translated_text:
Neither shall
men tear
themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall
men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.
original_text:
Neither shall
men tear
themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall
men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

translated_text: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.
original_text: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.
original_text: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt shew this people all these words, and they shall say unto thee, Wherefore hath the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us? or what
is our iniquity? or what
is our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?
original_text:
And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt shew this people all these words, and they shall say unto thee, Wherefore hath the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us? or what
is our iniquity? or what
is our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?

translated_text: Then shalt thou say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, saith the LORD, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;
original_text: Then shalt thou say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, saith the LORD, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;

translated_text: And ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:
original_text: And ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:

translated_text:
Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not,
neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.
original_text:
Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not,
neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.

translated_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be said, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
original_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be said, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

translated_text: But, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.
original_text: But, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.

translated_text: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the LORD, and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.
original_text: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the LORD, and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.

translated_text:
For mine eyes
are upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes.
original_text:
For mine eyes
are upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes.

translated_text: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.
original_text: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.

translated_text:
O LORD, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and
things
 wherein
there is no profit.
original_text:
O LORD, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and
things
 wherein
there is no profit.

translated_text:
Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they
are no gods?
original_text:
Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they
are no gods?

translated_text:
Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know mine hand and my might; and they shall know that my name
is The LORD.
original_text:
Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know mine hand and my might; and they shall know that my name
is The LORD.

translated_text:
Then said the LORD unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me,
yet my mind
could not
be toward this people: cast
them out of my sight, and let them go forth.
original_text:
Then said the LORD unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me,
yet my mind
could not
be toward this people: cast
them out of my sight, and let them go forth.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass, if they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith the LORD; Such as
are
 for death, to death; and such as
are for the sword, to the sword; and such as
are for the famine, to the famine; and such as
are for the captivity, to the captivity.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass, if they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith the LORD; Such as
are
 for death, to death; and such as
are for the sword, to the sword; and such as
are for the famine, to the famine; and such as
are for the captivity, to the captivity.

translated_text: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith the LORD: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.
original_text: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith the LORD: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.

translated_text:
And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for
that
 which he did in Jerusalem.
original_text:
And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for
that
 which he did in Jerusalem.

translated_text: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest?
original_text: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest?

translated_text: Thou hast forsaken me, saith the LORD, thou art gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee, and destroy thee; I am weary with repenting.
original_text: Thou hast forsaken me, saith the LORD, thou art gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee, and destroy thee; I am weary with repenting.

translated_text:
And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave
them of children, I will destroy my people,
since they return not from their ways.
original_text:
And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave
them of children, I will destroy my people,
since they return not from their ways.

translated_text:
Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused
him to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.
original_text:
Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused
him to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.

translated_text:
She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while
it was yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the LORD.
original_text:
She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while
it was yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury;
yet every one of them doth curse me.
original_text:
Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury;
yet every one of them doth curse me.

translated_text:
The LORD said, Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee
well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.
original_text:
The LORD said, Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee
well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

translated_text: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
original_text: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?

translated_text:
Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and
that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.
original_text:
Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and
that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.

translated_text:
And I will make
thee to pass with thine enemies into a land
which thou knowest not: for a fire is kindled in mine anger,
which shall burn upon you.
original_text:
And I will make
thee to pass with thine enemies into a land
which thou knowest not: for a fire is kindled in mine anger,
which shall burn upon you.

translated_text: O LORD, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.
original_text: O LORD, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.

translated_text: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.
original_text: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.

translated_text: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.
original_text: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.

translated_text:
Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable,
which refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar,
and as
 waters
that fail?
original_text:
Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable,
which refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar,
and as
 waters
that fail?

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the LORD, If thou return, then will I bring thee again,
and thou shalt stand before me: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: let them return unto thee; but return not thou unto them.
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the LORD, If thou return, then will I bring thee again,
and thou shalt stand before me: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: let them return unto thee; but return not thou unto them.

translated_text:
And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I
am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
original_text:
And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I
am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the LORD.

translated_text: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.
original_text: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.

translated_text: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.
original_text: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.

translated_text: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.
original_text: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.

translated_text:
And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits,
and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.
original_text:
And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits,
and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.

translated_text: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.
original_text: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.

translated_text:
Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook
it, because there was no grass.
original_text:
Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook
it, because there was no grass.

translated_text:
And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because
there was no grass.
original_text:
And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because
there was no grass.

translated_text:
O LORD, though our iniquities testify against us, do thou
it
 for thy name’s sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.
original_text:
O LORD, though our iniquities testify against us, do thou
it
 for thy name’s sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.

translated_text:
O the hope of Israel, the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man
that turneth aside to tarry for a night?
original_text:
O the hope of Israel, the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man
that turneth aside to tarry for a night?

translated_text:
Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man
that
 cannot save? yet thou, O LORD,
art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.
original_text:
Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man
that
 cannot save? yet thou, O LORD,
art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore the LORD doth not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore the LORD doth not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.

translated_text:
Then said the LORD unto me, Pray not for this people for
their
 good.
original_text:
Then said the LORD unto me, Pray not for this people for
their
 good.

translated_text: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.
original_text: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.

translated_text: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.
original_text: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.

translated_text: Then the LORD said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.
original_text: Then the LORD said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.

translated_text: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.
original_text: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.

translated_text: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.
original_text: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.

translated_text: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.
original_text: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.

translated_text:
Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul lothed Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and
there is no healing for us? we looked for peace, and
there is no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!
original_text:
Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul lothed Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and
there is no healing for us? we looked for peace, and
there is no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!

translated_text:
We acknowledge, O LORD, our wickedness,
and the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.
original_text:
We acknowledge, O LORD, our wickedness,
and the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.

translated_text:
Do not abhor
us, for thy name’s sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.
original_text:
Do not abhor
us, for thy name’s sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.

translated_text:
Are there
any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers?
art not thou he, O LORD our God? therefore we will wait upon thee: for thou hast made all these
things.
original_text:
Are there
any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers?
art not thou he, O LORD our God? therefore we will wait upon thee: for thou hast made all these
things.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.

translated_text:
So I got a girdle according to the word of the LORD, and put
it
 on my loins.
original_text:
So I got a girdle according to the word of the LORD, and put
it
 on my loins.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying,

translated_text:
Take the girdle that thou hast got, which
is upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.
original_text:
Take the girdle that thou hast got, which
is upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.

translated_text: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.
original_text: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.

translated_text: And it came to pass after many days, that the LORD said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.
original_text: And it came to pass after many days, that the LORD said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.

translated_text: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.
original_text: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.

translated_text: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.

translated_text: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.
original_text: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.

translated_text: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the LORD; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.
original_text: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the LORD; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.

translated_text: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?
original_text: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?

translated_text: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David’s throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
original_text: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David’s throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

translated_text: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the LORD: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.
original_text: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the LORD: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.

translated_text: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the LORD hath spoken.
original_text: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the LORD hath spoken.

translated_text:
Give glory to the LORD your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death,
and make
it gross darkness.
original_text:
Give glory to the LORD your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death,
and make
it gross darkness.

translated_text:
But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for
your pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the LORD’S flock is carried away captive.
original_text:
But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for
your pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the LORD’S flock is carried away captive.

translated_text:
Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down,
even the crown of your glory.
original_text:
Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down,
even the crown of your glory.

translated_text:
The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open
them: Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.
original_text:
The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open
them: Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.

translated_text:
Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where
is the flock
that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?
original_text:
Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where
is the flock
that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?

translated_text:
What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them
to be captains,
and as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?
original_text:
What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them
to be captains,
and as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?

translated_text:
And if thou say in thine heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered,
and
 thy heels made bare.
original_text:
And if thou say in thine heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered,
and
 thy heels made bare.

translated_text:
Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots?
then
 may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
original_text:
Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots?
then
 may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.

translated_text: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.
original_text: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.

translated_text:
This
is thy lot, the portion of thy measures from me, saith the LORD; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.
original_text:
This
is thy lot, the portion of thy measures from me, saith the LORD; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.

translated_text: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.
original_text: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.

translated_text:
I have seen thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom,
