and thine abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when
shall it
 once
be?
original_text:
I have seen thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom,
and thine abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when
shall it
 once
be?

translated_text:
Righteous
art thou, O LORD, when I plead with thee: yet let me talk with thee of
thy judgments: Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper?
wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously?
original_text:
Righteous
art thou, O LORD, when I plead with thee: yet let me talk with thee of
thy judgments: Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper?
wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously?

translated_text:
Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou
art near in their mouth, and far from their reins.
original_text:
Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou
art near in their mouth, and far from their reins.

translated_text: But thou, O LORD, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.
original_text: But thou, O LORD, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

translated_text: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.
original_text: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.

translated_text:
If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and
if in the land of peace,
wherein thou trustedst,
they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?
original_text:
If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and
if in the land of peace,
wherein thou trustedst,
they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?

translated_text: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee.
original_text: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee.

translated_text: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.
original_text: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.

translated_text: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it.
original_text: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it.

translated_text:
Mine heritage
is unto me
as a speckled bird, the birds round about
are against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.
original_text:
Mine heritage
is unto me
as a speckled bird, the birds round about
are against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.

translated_text: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.
original_text: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

translated_text:
They have made it desolate,
and being desolate it mourneth unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth
it
 to heart.
original_text:
They have made it desolate,
and being desolate it mourneth unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth
it
 to heart.

translated_text:
The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of the LORD shall devour from the
one end of the land even to the
other end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.
original_text:
The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of the LORD shall devour from the
one end of the land even to the
other end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.

translated_text:
They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain,
but shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
original_text:
They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain,
but shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the LORD.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD against all mine evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD against all mine evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.
original_text: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, The LORD liveth; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.
original_text: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, The LORD liveth; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.

translated_text: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the LORD.
original_text: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the LORD.

translated_text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
original_text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

translated_text: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
original_text: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;

translated_text:
And say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Cursed
be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,
original_text:
And say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Cursed
be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,

translated_text:
Which I commanded your fathers in the day
that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your God:
original_text:
Which I commanded your fathers in the day
that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your God:

translated_text:
That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as
it is this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O LORD.
original_text:
That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as
it is this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O LORD.

translated_text: Then the LORD said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.
original_text: Then the LORD said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.

translated_text:
For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day
that
 I brought them up out of the land of Egypt,
even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.
original_text:
For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day
that
 I brought them up out of the land of Egypt,
even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.

translated_text:
Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded
them to do; but they did
them not.
original_text:
Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded
them to do; but they did
them not.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
original_text: And the LORD said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

translated_text: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
original_text: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.

translated_text: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.
original_text: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

translated_text:
For
according to the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Judah; and
according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to
that shameful thing,
even altars to burn incense unto Baal.
original_text:
For
according to the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Judah; and
according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to
that shameful thing,
even altars to burn incense unto Baal.

translated_text:
Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear
them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.
original_text:
Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear
them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.

translated_text:
What hath my beloved to do in mine house,
seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.
original_text:
What hath my beloved to do in mine house,
seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.

translated_text:
The LORD called thy name, A green olive tree, fair,
and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.
original_text:
The LORD called thy name, A green olive tree, fair,
and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.

translated_text: For the LORD of hosts, that planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.
original_text: For the LORD of hosts, that planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.

translated_text:
And the LORD hath given me knowledge
of it, and I know
it: then thou shewedst me their doings.
original_text:
And the LORD hath given me knowledge
of it, and I know
it: then thou shewedst me their doings.

translated_text:
But I
was like a lamb
or an ox
that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me,
saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.
original_text:
But I
was like a lamb
or an ox
that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me,
saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.

translated_text: But, O LORD of hosts, that judgest righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I revealed my cause.
original_text: But, O LORD of hosts, that judgest righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I revealed my cause.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the LORD, that thou die not by our hand:
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the LORD, that thou die not by our hand:

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:

translated_text:
And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth,
even the year of their visitation.
original_text:
And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth,
even the year of their visitation.

translated_text: Hear ye the word which the LORD speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:
original_text: Hear ye the word which the LORD speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.

translated_text:
For the customs of the people
are vain: for
one
 cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.
original_text:
For the customs of the people
are vain: for
one
 cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.

translated_text: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.
original_text: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.

translated_text:
They
are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also
is it in them to do good.
original_text:
They
are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also
is it in them to do good.

translated_text:
Forasmuch as
there is none like unto thee, O LORD; thou
art great, and thy name is great in might.
original_text:
Forasmuch as
there is none like unto thee, O LORD; thou
art great, and thy name is great in might.

translated_text:
Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise
men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms,
there is none like unto thee.
original_text:
Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise
men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms,
there is none like unto thee.

translated_text:
But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock
is
 a doctrine of vanities.
original_text:
But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock
is
 a doctrine of vanities.

translated_text:
Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple is their clothing: they
are all the work of cunning
men.
original_text:
Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple is their clothing: they
are all the work of cunning
men.

translated_text:
But the LORD
is the true God, he
is the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.
original_text:
But the LORD
is the true God, he
is the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.

translated_text:
Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth,
even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.
original_text:
Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth,
even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.

translated_text: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.
original_text: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.

translated_text:
When he uttereth his voice,
there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
original_text:
When he uttereth his voice,
there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.

translated_text:
Every man is brutish in
his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and
there is no breath in them.
original_text:
Every man is brutish in
his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and
there is no breath in them.

translated_text:
They
are vanity,
and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
original_text:
They
are vanity,
and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

translated_text:
The portion of Jacob
is not like them: for he
is
 the former of all
things; and Israel
is the rod of his inheritance: The LORD of hosts
is his name.
original_text:
The portion of Jacob
is not like them: for he
is
 the former of all
things; and Israel
is the rod of his inheritance: The LORD of hosts
is his name.

translated_text: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.
original_text: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.

translated_text:
For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find
it
 so.
original_text:
For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find
it
 so.

translated_text:
Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this
is a grief, and I must bear it.
original_text:
Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this
is a grief, and I must bear it.

translated_text:
My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they
are not:
there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.
original_text:
My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they
are not:
there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.

translated_text: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the LORD: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.
original_text: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the LORD: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.

translated_text:
Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate,
and a den of dragons.
original_text:
Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate,
and a den of dragons.

translated_text:
O LORD, I know that the way of man
is not in himself:
it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.
original_text:
O LORD, I know that the way of man
is not in himself:
it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.

translated_text: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.
original_text: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.

translated_text: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.
original_text: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.

translated_text: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem, and they besieged it.
original_text: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem, and they besieged it.

translated_text:
And in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth
day of the month, the city was broken up.
original_text:
And in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth
day of the month, the city was broken up.

translated_text:
And all the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate,
even Nergal-sharezer, Samgar-nebo, Sarsechim, Rab-saris, Nergal-sharezer, Rabmag, with all the residue of the princes of the king of Babylon.
original_text:
And all the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate,
even Nergal-sharezer, Samgar-nebo, Sarsechim, Rab-saris, Nergal-sharezer, Rabmag, with all the residue of the princes of the king of Babylon.

translated_text:
And it came to pass,
that when Zedekiah the king of Judah saw them, and all the men of war, then they fled, and went forth out of the city by night, by the way of the king’s garden, by the gate betwixt the two walls: and he went out the way of the plain.
original_text:
And it came to pass,
that when Zedekiah the king of Judah saw them, and all the men of war, then they fled, and went forth out of the city by night, by the way of the king’s garden, by the gate betwixt the two walls: and he went out the way of the plain.

translated_text: But the Chaldeans’ army pursued after them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho: and when they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he gave judgment upon him.
original_text: But the Chaldeans’ army pursued after them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho: and when they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he gave judgment upon him.

translated_text: Then the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before his eyes: also the king of Babylon slew all the nobles of Judah.
original_text: Then the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before his eyes: also the king of Babylon slew all the nobles of Judah.

translated_text: Moreover he put out Zedekiah’s eyes, and bound him with chains, to carry him to Babylon.
original_text: Moreover he put out Zedekiah’s eyes, and bound him with chains, to carry him to Babylon.

translated_text: And the Chaldeans burned the king’s house, and the houses of the people, with fire, and brake down the walls of Jerusalem.
original_text: And the Chaldeans burned the king’s house, and the houses of the people, with fire, and brake down the walls of Jerusalem.

translated_text: Then Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to him, with the rest of the people that remained.
original_text: Then Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to him, with the rest of the people that remained.

translated_text: But Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, which had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.
original_text: But Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, which had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.

translated_text: Now Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon gave charge concerning Jeremiah to Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard, saying,
original_text: Now Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon gave charge concerning Jeremiah to Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard, saying,

translated_text: Take him, and look well to him, and do him no harm; but do unto him even as he shall say unto thee.
original_text: Take him, and look well to him, and do him no harm; but do unto him even as he shall say unto thee.

translated_text: So Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard sent, and Nebushasban, Rab-saris, and Nergal-sharezer, Rabmag, and all the king of Babylon’s princes;
original_text: So Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard sent, and Nebushasban, Rab-saris, and Nergal-sharezer, Rabmag, and all the king of Babylon’s princes;

translated_text: Even they sent, and took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison, and committed him unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, that he should carry him home: so he dwelt among the people.
original_text: Even they sent, and took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison, and committed him unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, that he should carry him home: so he dwelt among the people.

translated_text: Now the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, while he was shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
original_text: Now the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, while he was shut up in the court of the prison, saying,

translated_text:
Go and speak to Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring my words upon this city for evil, and not for good; and they shall be
accomplished in that day before thee.
original_text:
Go and speak to Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring my words upon this city for evil, and not for good; and they shall be
accomplished in that day before thee.

translated_text:
But I will deliver thee in that day, saith the LORD: and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou
art afraid.
original_text:
But I will deliver thee in that day, saith the LORD: and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou
art afraid.

translated_text: For I will surely deliver thee, and thou shalt not fall by the sword, but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee: because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the LORD.
original_text: For I will surely deliver thee, and thou shalt not fall by the sword, but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee: because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashur the son of Malchiah, heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people, saying,
original_text: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashur the son of Malchiah, heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people, saying,

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD, He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live; for he shall have his life for a prey, and shall live.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD, He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live; for he shall have his life for a prey, and shall live.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD, This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army, which shall take it.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD, This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army, which shall take it.

translated_text: Therefore the princes said unto the king, We beseech thee, let this man be put to death: for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words unto them: for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people, but the hurt.
original_text: Therefore the princes said unto the king, We beseech thee, let this man be put to death: for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words unto them: for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people, but the hurt.

translated_text:
Then Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he is in your hand: for the king
is not
he that can do
any thing against you.
original_text:
Then Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he is in your hand: for the king
is not
he that can do
any thing against you.

translated_text:
Then took they Jeremiah, and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech, that
was in the court of the prison: and they let down Jeremiah with cords. And in the dungeon
there was no water, but mire: so Jeremiah sunk in the mire.
original_text:
Then took they Jeremiah, and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech, that
was in the court of the prison: and they let down Jeremiah with cords. And in the dungeon
there was no water, but mire: so Jeremiah sunk in the mire.

translated_text: Now when Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, one of the eunuchs which was in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon; the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin;
original_text: Now when Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, one of the eunuchs which was in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon; the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin;

translated_text: Ebed-melech went forth out of the king’s house, and spake to the king, saying,
original_text: Ebed-melech went forth out of the king’s house, and spake to the king, saying,

translated_text:
My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is: for
there is no more bread in the city.
original_text:
My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is: for
there is no more bread in the city.

translated_text: Then the king commanded Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from hence thirty men with thee, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he die.
original_text: Then the king commanded Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from hence thirty men with thee, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he die.

translated_text: So Ebed-melech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.
original_text: So Ebed-melech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.

translated_text:
And Ebed-melech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah, Put now
these
 old cast clouts and rotten rags under thine armholes under the cords. And Jeremiah did so.
original_text:
And Ebed-melech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah, Put now
these
 old cast clouts and rotten rags under thine armholes under the cords. And Jeremiah did so.

translated_text: So they drew up Jeremiah with cords, and took him up out of the dungeon: and Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
original_text: So they drew up Jeremiah with cords, and took him up out of the dungeon: and Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.

translated_text:
Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that
is in the house of the LORD: and the king said unto Jeremiah, I will ask thee a thing; hide nothing from me.
original_text:
Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that
is in the house of the LORD: and the king said unto Jeremiah, I will ask thee a thing; hide nothing from me.

translated_text:
Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah, If I declare
it unto thee, wilt thou not surely put me to death? and if I give thee counsel, wilt thou not hearken unto me?
original_text:
Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah, If I declare
it unto thee, wilt thou not surely put me to death? and if I give thee counsel, wilt thou not hearken unto me?

translated_text:
So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah, saying,
As
 the LORD liveth, that made us this soul, I will not put thee to death, neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life.
original_text:
So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah, saying,
As
 the LORD liveth, that made us this soul, I will not put thee to death, neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life.

translated_text: Then said Jeremiah unto Zedekiah, Thus saith the LORD, the God of hosts, the God of Israel; If thou wilt assuredly go forth unto the king of Babylon’s princes, then thy soul shall live, and this city shall not be burned with fire; and thou shalt live, and thine house:
original_text: Then said Jeremiah unto Zedekiah, Thus saith the LORD, the God of hosts, the God of Israel; If thou wilt assuredly go forth unto the king of Babylon’s princes, then thy soul shall live, and this city shall not be burned with fire; and thou shalt live, and thine house:

translated_text: But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and thou shalt not escape out of their hand.
original_text: But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and thou shalt not escape out of their hand.

translated_text: And Zedekiah the king said unto Jeremiah, I am afraid of the Jews that are fallen to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.
original_text: And Zedekiah the king said unto Jeremiah, I am afraid of the Jews that are fallen to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.

translated_text:
But Jeremiah said, They shall not deliver
thee. Obey, I beseech thee, the voice of the LORD, which I speak unto thee: so it shall be well unto thee, and thy soul shall live.
original_text:
But Jeremiah said, They shall not deliver
thee. Obey, I beseech thee, the voice of the LORD, which I speak unto thee: so it shall be well unto thee, and thy soul shall live.

translated_text:
But if thou refuse to go forth, this
is the word that the LORD hath shewed me:
original_text:
But if thou refuse to go forth, this
is the word that the LORD hath shewed me:

translated_text:
And, behold, all the women that are left in the king of Judah’s house
shall be brought forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, and those
women shall say, Thy friends have set thee on, and have prevailed against thee: thy feet are sunk in the mire,
and they are turned away back.
original_text:
And, behold, all the women that are left in the king of Judah’s house
shall be brought forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, and those
women shall say, Thy friends have set thee on, and have prevailed against thee: thy feet are sunk in the mire,
and they are turned away back.

translated_text: So they shall bring out all thy wives and thy children to the Chaldeans: and thou shalt not escape out of their hand, but shalt be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon: and thou shalt cause this city to be burned with fire.
original_text: So they shall bring out all thy wives and thy children to the Chaldeans: and thou shalt not escape out of their hand, but shalt be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon: and thou shalt cause this city to be burned with fire.

translated_text: Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and thou shalt not die.
original_text: Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and thou shalt not die.

translated_text: But if the princes hear that I have talked with thee, and they come unto thee, and say unto thee, Declare unto us now what thou hast said unto the king, hide it not from us, and we will not put thee to death; also what the king said unto thee:
original_text: But if the princes hear that I have talked with thee, and they come unto thee, and say unto thee, Declare unto us now what thou hast said unto the king, hide it not from us, and we will not put thee to death; also what the king said unto thee:

translated_text: Then thou shalt say unto them, I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan’s house, to die there.
original_text: Then thou shalt say unto them, I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan’s house, to die there.

translated_text: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah, and asked him: and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they left off speaking with him; for the matter was not perceived.
original_text: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah, and asked him: and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they left off speaking with him; for the matter was not perceived.

translated_text:
So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken: and he was
there when Jerusalem was taken.
original_text:
So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken: and he was
there when Jerusalem was taken.

translated_text: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.
original_text: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.

translated_text: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, did hearken unto the words of the LORD, which he spake by the prophet Jeremiah.
original_text: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, did hearken unto the words of the LORD, which he spake by the prophet Jeremiah.

translated_text: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, Pray now unto the LORD our God for us.
original_text: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, Pray now unto the LORD our God for us.

translated_text: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people: for they had not put him into prison.
original_text: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people: for they had not put him into prison.

translated_text: Then Pharaoh’s army was come forth out of Egypt: and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them, they departed from Jerusalem.
original_text: Then Pharaoh’s army was come forth out of Egypt: and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them, they departed from Jerusalem.

translated_text: Then came the word of the LORD unto the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
original_text: Then came the word of the LORD unto the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah, that sent you unto me to enquire of me; Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which is come forth to help you, shall return to Egypt into their own land.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah, that sent you unto me to enquire of me; Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which is come forth to help you, shall return to Egypt into their own land.

translated_text: And the Chaldeans shall come again, and fight against this city, and take it, and burn it with fire.
original_text: And the Chaldeans shall come again, and fight against this city, and take it, and burn it with fire.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD; Deceive not yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us: for they shall not depart.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD; Deceive not yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us: for they shall not depart.

translated_text:
For though ye had smitten the whole army of the Chaldeans that fight against you, and there remained
but wounded men among them,
yet should they rise up every man in his tent, and burn this city with fire.
original_text:
For though ye had smitten the whole army of the Chaldeans that fight against you, and there remained
but wounded men among them,
yet should they rise up every man in his tent, and burn this city with fire.

translated_text: And it came to pass, that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,
original_text: And it came to pass, that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,

translated_text: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to separate himself thence in the midst of the people.
original_text: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to separate himself thence in the midst of the people.

translated_text:
And when he was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the ward
was there, whose name
was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he took Jeremiah the prophet, saying, Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans.
original_text:
And when he was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the ward
was there, whose name
was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he took Jeremiah the prophet, saying, Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans.

translated_text:
Then said Jeremiah,
It is false; I fall not away to the Chaldeans. But he hearkened not to him: so Irijah took Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.
original_text:
Then said Jeremiah,
It is false; I fall not away to the Chaldeans. But he hearkened not to him: so Irijah took Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.

translated_text: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah, and smote him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe: for they had made that the prison.
original_text: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah, and smote him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe: for they had made that the prison.

translated_text: When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon, and into the cabins, and Jeremiah had remained there many days;
original_text: When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon, and into the cabins, and Jeremiah had remained there many days;

translated_text:
Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took him out: and the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there
any word from the LORD? And Jeremiah said, There is: for, said he, thou shalt be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.
original_text:
Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took him out: and the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there
any word from the LORD? And Jeremiah said, There is: for, said he, thou shalt be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.

translated_text: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah, What have I offended against thee, or against thy servants, or against this people, that ye have put me in prison?
original_text: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah, What have I offended against thee, or against thy servants, or against this people, that ye have put me in prison?

translated_text:
Where
are now your prophets which prophesied unto you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?
original_text:
Where
are now your prophets which prophesied unto you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?

translated_text: Therefore hear now, I pray thee, O my lord the king: let my supplication, I pray thee, be accepted before thee; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.
original_text: Therefore hear now, I pray thee, O my lord the king: let my supplication, I pray thee, be accepted before thee; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.

translated_text: Then Zedekiah the king commanded that they should commit Jeremiah into the court of the prison, and that they should give him daily a piece of bread out of the bakers street, until all the bread in the city were spent. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
original_text: Then Zedekiah the king commanded that they should commit Jeremiah into the court of the prison, and that they should give him daily a piece of bread out of the bakers street, until all the bread in the city were spent. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah,
that this word came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
original_text:
And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah,
that this word came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

translated_text: Take thee a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto thee, from the days of Josiah, even into this day.
original_text: Take thee a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto thee, from the days of Josiah, even into this day.

translated_text: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.
original_text: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.

translated_text: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD, which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book.
original_text: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD, which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book.

translated_text:
And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I
am shut up; I cannot go into the house of the LORD:
original_text:
And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I
am shut up; I cannot go into the house of the LORD:

translated_text: Therefore go thou, and read in the roll, which thou hast written from my mouth, the words of the LORD in the ears of the people in the LORD’S house upon the fasting day: and also thou shalt read them in the ears of all Judah that come out of their cities.
original_text: Therefore go thou, and read in the roll, which thou hast written from my mouth, the words of the LORD in the ears of the people in the LORD’S house upon the fasting day: and also thou shalt read them in the ears of all Judah that come out of their cities.

translated_text:
It may be they will present their supplication before the LORD, and will return every one from his evil way: for great
is the anger and the fury that the LORD hath pronounced against this people.
original_text:
It may be they will present their supplication before the LORD, and will return every one from his evil way: for great
is the anger and the fury that the LORD hath pronounced against this people.

translated_text: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of the LORD in the LORD’S house.
original_text: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of the LORD in the LORD’S house.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month,
that they proclaimed a fast before the LORD to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem.
original_text:
And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month,
that they proclaimed a fast before the LORD to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem.

translated_text: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the LORD, in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD’S house, in the ears of all the people.
original_text: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the LORD, in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD’S house, in the ears of all the people.

translated_text: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of the LORD,
original_text: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of the LORD,

translated_text:
Then he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there,
even Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.
original_text:
Then he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there,
even Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.

translated_text: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.
original_text: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.

translated_text: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, unto Baruch, saying, Take in thine hand the roll wherein thou hast read in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand, and came unto them.
original_text: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, unto Baruch, saying, Take in thine hand the roll wherein thou hast read in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand, and came unto them.

translated_text:
And they said unto him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read
it in their ears.
original_text:
And they said unto him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read
it in their ears.

translated_text: Now it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they were afraid both one and other, and said unto Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.
original_text: Now it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they were afraid both one and other, and said unto Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.

translated_text: And they asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How didst thou write all these words at his mouth?
original_text: And they asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How didst thou write all these words at his mouth?

translated_text:
Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth, and I wrote
them with ink in the book.
original_text:
Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth, and I wrote
them with ink in the book.

translated_text: Then said the princes unto Baruch, Go, hide thee, thou and Jeremiah; and let no man know where ye be.
original_text: Then said the princes unto Baruch, Go, hide thee, thou and Jeremiah; and let no man know where ye be.

translated_text: And they went in to the king into the court, but they laid up the roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and told all the words in the ears of the king.
original_text: And they went in to the king into the court, but they laid up the roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and told all the words in the ears of the king.

translated_text: So the king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll: and he took it out of Elishama the scribe’s chamber. And Jehudi read it in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the princes which stood beside the king.
original_text: So the king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll: and he took it out of Elishama the scribe’s chamber. And Jehudi read it in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the princes which stood beside the king.

translated_text:
Now the king sat in the winterhouse in the ninth month: and
there was a fire on the hearth burning before him.
original_text:
Now the king sat in the winterhouse in the ninth month: and
there was a fire on the hearth burning before him.

translated_text:
And it came to pass,
that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the penknife, and cast
it into the fire that
was on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that
was on the hearth.
original_text:
And it came to pass,
that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the penknife, and cast
it into the fire that
was on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that
was on the hearth.

translated_text:
Yet they were not afraid, nor rent their garments,
neither
 the king, nor any of his servants that heard all these words.
original_text:
Yet they were not afraid, nor rent their garments,
neither
 the king, nor any of his servants that heard all these words.

translated_text: Nevertheless Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the roll: but he would not hear them.
original_text: Nevertheless Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the roll: but he would not hear them.

translated_text: But the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of Hammelech, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet: but the LORD hid them.
original_text: But the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of Hammelech, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet: but the LORD hid them.

translated_text: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, after that the king had burned the roll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,
original_text: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, after that the king had burned the roll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,

translated_text: Take thee again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned.
original_text: Take thee again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned.

translated_text: And thou shalt say to Jehoiakim the king of Judah, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast burned this roll, saying, Why hast thou written therein, saying, The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land, and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast?
original_text: And thou shalt say to Jehoiakim the king of Judah, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast burned this roll, saying, Why hast thou written therein, saying, The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land, and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast?

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of Jehoiakim king of Judah; He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David: and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of Jehoiakim king of Judah; He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David: and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

translated_text: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity; and I will bring upon them, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and upon the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them; but they hearkened not.
original_text: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity; and I will bring upon them, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and upon the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them; but they hearkened not.

translated_text: Then took Jeremiah another roll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire: and there were added besides unto them many like words.
original_text: Then took Jeremiah another roll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire: and there were added besides unto them many like words.

translated_text: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,
original_text: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,

translated_text: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of the LORD, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.
original_text: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of the LORD, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.

translated_text: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;
original_text: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;

translated_text:
And I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which
was by the chamber of the princes, which
was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:
original_text:
And I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which
was by the chamber of the princes, which
was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:

translated_text: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.
original_text: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.

translated_text:
But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, Ye shall drink no wine,
neither ye, nor your sons for ever:
original_text:
But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, Ye shall drink no wine,
neither ye, nor your sons for ever:

translated_text:
Neither shall ye build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have
any: but all your days ye shall dwell in tents; that ye may live many days in the land where ye
be strangers.
original_text:
Neither shall ye build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have
any: but all your days ye shall dwell in tents; that ye may live many days in the land where ye
be strangers.

translated_text: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;
original_text: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;

translated_text: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:
original_text: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:

translated_text: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
original_text: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

translated_text: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians: so we dwell at Jerusalem.
original_text: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians: so we dwell at Jerusalem.

translated_text: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
original_text: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words? saith the LORD.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words? saith the LORD.

translated_text: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father’s commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye hearkened not unto me.
original_text: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father’s commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye hearkened not unto me.

translated_text:
I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending
them, saying, Return ye now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them, and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but ye have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.
original_text:
I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending
them, saying, Return ye now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them, and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but ye have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.

translated_text: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people hath not hearkened unto me:
original_text: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people hath not hearkened unto me:

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.

translated_text: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he hath commanded you:
original_text: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he hath commanded you:

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.

translated_text: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,
original_text: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:
original_text: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:

translated_text: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand, but shalt surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth, and thou shalt go to Babylon.
original_text: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand, but shalt surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth, and thou shalt go to Babylon.

translated_text: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O Zedekiah king of Judah; Thus saith the LORD of thee, Thou shalt not die by the sword:
original_text: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O Zedekiah king of Judah; Thus saith the LORD of thee, Thou shalt not die by the sword:

translated_text:
But thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn
odours for thee; and they will lament thee,
saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith the LORD.
original_text:
But thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn
odours for thee; and they will lament thee,
saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,
original_text: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,

translated_text: When the king of Babylon’s army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah.
original_text: When the king of Babylon’s army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah.

translated_text:
This is the word that came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which
were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;
original_text:
This is the word that came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which
were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;

translated_text:
That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant,
being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them,
to wit, of a Jew his brother.
original_text:
That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant,
being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them,
to wit, of a Jew his brother.

translated_text:
Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let
them go.
original_text:
Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let
them go.

translated_text: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.
original_text: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.

translated_text: Therefore the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
original_text: Therefore the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,
original_text: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,

translated_text: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew, which hath been sold unto thee; and when he hath served thee six years, thou shalt let him go free from thee: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.
original_text: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew, which hath been sold unto thee; and when he hath served thee six years, thou shalt let him go free from thee: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.

translated_text: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:
original_text: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:

translated_text: But ye turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom ye had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.
original_text: But ye turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom ye had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ye have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, saith the LORD, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ye have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, saith the LORD, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.

translated_text: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,
original_text: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,

translated_text: The princes of Judah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;
original_text: The princes of Judah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;

translated_text: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.
original_text: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.

translated_text: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army, which are gone up from you.
original_text: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army, which are gone up from you.

translated_text: Behold, I will command, saith the LORD, and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant.
original_text: Behold, I will command, saith the LORD, and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant.

translated_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
original_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD the maker thereof, the LORD that formed it, to establish it; the LORD
is his name;
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD the maker thereof, the LORD that formed it, to establish it; the LORD
is his name;

translated_text: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
original_text: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;
original_text: For thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;

translated_text:
They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but
it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.
original_text:
They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but
it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.

translated_text: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.
original_text: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.

translated_text: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.
original_text: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.

translated_text: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.
original_text: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.
