translated_text: And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.
original_text: And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD; Again there shall be heard in this place, which ye say
shall be desolate without man and without beast,
even
 in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD; Again there shall be heard in this place, which ye say
shall be desolate without man and without beast,
even
 in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,

translated_text:
The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise the LORD of hosts: for the LORD
is good; for his mercy
endureth for ever:
and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the LORD. For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, saith the LORD.
original_text:
The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise the LORD of hosts: for the LORD
is good; for his mercy
endureth for ever:
and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the LORD. For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing
their flocks to lie down.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing
their flocks to lie down.

translated_text:
In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth
them, saith the LORD.
original_text:
In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth
them, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.
original_text: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.

translated_text: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.
original_text: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.

translated_text:
In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this
is the name wherewith she shall be called, The LORD our righteousness.
original_text:
In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this
is the name wherewith she shall be called, The LORD our righteousness.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD; David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel;
original_text: For thus saith the LORD; David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel;

translated_text: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.
original_text: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, saying,

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD; If ye can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;
original_text: Thus saith the LORD; If ye can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;

translated_text: Then may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.
original_text: Then may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.

translated_text: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.
original_text: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.

translated_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,
original_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

translated_text: Considerest thou not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the LORD hath chosen, he hath even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.
original_text: Considerest thou not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the LORD hath chosen, he hath even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD; If my covenant be not with day and night,
and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD; If my covenant be not with day and night,
and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;

translated_text:
Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob, and David my servant, so that I will not take
any of his seed
to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.
original_text:
Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob, and David my servant, so that I will not take
any of his seed
to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.

translated_text:
The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which
was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.
original_text:
The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which
was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.

translated_text:
For then the king of Babylon’s army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which
was in the king of Judah’s house.
original_text:
For then the king of Babylon’s army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which
was in the king of Judah’s house.

translated_text: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Wherefore dost thou prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;
original_text: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Wherefore dost thou prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;

translated_text: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;
original_text: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;

translated_text: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, saith the LORD: though ye fight with the Chaldeans, ye shall not prosper?
original_text: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, saith the LORD: though ye fight with the Chaldeans, ye shall not prosper?

translated_text: And Jeremiah said, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: And Jeremiah said, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee, saying, Buy thee my field that
is in Anathoth: for the right of redemption
is thine to buy
it.
original_text:
Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee, saying, Buy thee my field that
is in Anathoth: for the right of redemption
is thine to buy
it.

translated_text:
So Hanameel mine uncle’s son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the LORD, and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray thee, that
is in Anathoth, which
is in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance
is thine, and the redemption
is thine; buy
it for thyself. Then I knew that this
was the word of the LORD.
original_text:
So Hanameel mine uncle’s son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the LORD, and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray thee, that
is in Anathoth, which
is in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance
is thine, and the redemption
is thine; buy
it for thyself. Then I knew that this
was the word of the LORD.

translated_text:
And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle’s son, that
was
 in Anathoth, and weighed him the money,
even seventeen shekels of silver.
original_text:
And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle’s son, that
was
 in Anathoth, and weighed him the money,
even seventeen shekels of silver.

translated_text:
And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed
it, and took witnesses, and weighed
him the money in the balances.
original_text:
And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed
it, and took witnesses, and weighed
him the money in the balances.

translated_text:
So I took the evidence of the purchase,
both that which was sealed
according to the law and custom, and that which was open:
original_text:
So I took the evidence of the purchase,
both that which was sealed
according to the law and custom, and that which was open:

translated_text:
And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle’s
son,
 and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison.
original_text:
And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle’s
son,
 and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison.

translated_text: And I charged Baruch before them, saying,
original_text: And I charged Baruch before them, saying,

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.
original_text: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.

translated_text: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto the LORD, saying,
original_text: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto the LORD, saying,

translated_text:
Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm,
and there is nothing too hard for thee:
original_text:
Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm,
and there is nothing too hard for thee:

translated_text:
Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty God, the LORD of hosts,
is his name,
original_text:
Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty God, the LORD of hosts,
is his name,

translated_text:
Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for thine eyes
are
 open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:
original_text:
Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for thine eyes
are
 open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:

translated_text:
Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt,
even
 unto this day, and in Israel, and among
other men; and hast made thee a name, as at this day;
original_text:
Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt,
even
 unto this day, and in Israel, and among
other men; and hast made thee a name, as at this day;

translated_text: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;
original_text: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;

translated_text: And hast given them this land, which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;
original_text: And hast given them this land, which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;

translated_text: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not thy voice, neither walked in thy law; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do: therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them:
original_text: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not thy voice, neither walked in thy law; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do: therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them:

translated_text:
Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, thou seest
it.
original_text:
Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, thou seest
it.

translated_text: And thou hast said unto me, O Lord GOD, Buy thee the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
original_text: And thou hast said unto me, O Lord GOD, Buy thee the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

translated_text: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
original_text: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,

translated_text:
Behold, I
am the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?
original_text:
Behold, I
am the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:

translated_text: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.
original_text: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.

translated_text: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, saith the LORD.
original_text: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
For this city hath been to me
as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,
original_text:
For this city hath been to me
as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,

translated_text: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
original_text: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching
them, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.
original_text:
And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching
them, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.

translated_text: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.
original_text: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.

translated_text:
And they built the high places of Baal, which
are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through
the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.
original_text:
And they built the high places of Baal, which
are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through
the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.

translated_text: And now therefore thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning this city, whereof ye say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;
original_text: And now therefore thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning this city, whereof ye say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;

translated_text: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in mine anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:
original_text: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in mine anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:

translated_text: And they shall be my people, and I will be their God:
original_text: And they shall be my people, and I will be their God:

translated_text: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:
original_text: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:

translated_text: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.
original_text: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.

translated_text: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.
original_text: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.
original_text: For thus saith the LORD; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.

translated_text:
And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof ye say,
It is
 desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
original_text:
And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof ye say,
It is
 desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

translated_text:
Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal
them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal
them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, saith the LORD.

translated_text: At the same time, saith the LORD, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.
original_text: At the same time, saith the LORD, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.

translated_text:
The LORD hath appeared of old unto me,
saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
original_text:
The LORD hath appeared of old unto me,
saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.

translated_text: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.
original_text: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.

translated_text:
Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat
them as common things.
original_text:
Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat
them as common things.

translated_text:
For there shall be a day,
that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto the LORD our God.
original_text:
For there shall be a day,
that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto the LORD our God.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O LORD, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.
original_text: For thus saith the LORD; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O LORD, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.

translated_text:
Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth,
and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.
original_text:
Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth,
and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.

translated_text:
They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim
is
 my firstborn.
original_text:
They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim
is
 my firstborn.

translated_text:
Hear the word of the LORD, O ye nations, and declare
it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd
doth his flock.
original_text:
Hear the word of the LORD, O ye nations, and declare
it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd
doth his flock.

translated_text:
For the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of
him that was stronger than he.
original_text:
For the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of
him that was stronger than he.

translated_text: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
original_text: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.

translated_text: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
original_text: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.

translated_text: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the LORD.
original_text: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation,
and bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they
were not.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation,
and bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they
were not.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.

translated_text: And there is hope in thine end, saith the LORD, that thy children shall come again to their own border.
original_text: And there is hope in thine end, saith the LORD, that thy children shall come again to their own border.

translated_text:
I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself
thus; Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed
to the yoke: turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou
art the LORD my God.
original_text:
I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself
thus; Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed
to the yoke: turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou
art the LORD my God.

translated_text:
Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon
my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.
original_text:
Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon
my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.

translated_text:
Is Ephraim my dear son?
is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Is Ephraim my dear son?
is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway,
even the way
which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.
original_text:
Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway,
even the way
which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.

translated_text: How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the LORD hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.
original_text: How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the LORD hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; The LORD bless thee, O habitation of justice,
and mountain of holiness.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; The LORD bless thee, O habitation of justice,
and mountain of holiness.

translated_text:
And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they
that go forth with flocks.
original_text:
And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they
that go forth with flocks.

translated_text: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
original_text: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.

translated_text: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.
original_text: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.

translated_text: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.
original_text: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the LORD.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the LORD.

translated_text: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.
original_text: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.

translated_text: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.
original_text: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.

translated_text: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:
original_text: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:

translated_text:
Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day
that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith the LORD:
original_text:
Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day
that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith the LORD:

translated_text:
But this
shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.
original_text:
But this
shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.

translated_text: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD; for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
original_text: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD; for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, which giveth the sun for a light by day,
and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The LORD of hosts
is his name:
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, which giveth the sun for a light by day,
and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The LORD of hosts
is his name:

translated_text:
If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the LORD,
then
 the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.
original_text:
If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the LORD,
then
 the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the LORD.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the city shall be built to the LORD from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.
original_text: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the city shall be built to the LORD from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.

translated_text: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.
original_text: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.

translated_text:
And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east,
shall be holy unto the LORD; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.
original_text:
And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east,
shall be holy unto the LORD; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.

translated_text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
original_text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

translated_text: Thus speaketh the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.
original_text: Thus speaketh the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.

translated_text: For, lo, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith the LORD: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.
original_text: For, lo, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith the LORD: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.

translated_text:
And these
are the words that the LORD spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
original_text:
And these
are the words that the LORD spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
original_text: For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.

translated_text: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?
original_text: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?

translated_text:
Alas! for that day
is great, so that none
is like it: it
is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.
original_text:
Alas! for that day
is great, so that none
is like it: it
is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

translated_text:
For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts,
that I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:
original_text:
For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts,
that I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:

translated_text: But they shall serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.
original_text: But they shall serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.

translated_text:
Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the LORD; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make
him afraid.
original_text:
Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the LORD; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make
him afraid.

translated_text:
For I
am with thee, saith the LORD, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.
original_text:
For I
am with thee, saith the LORD, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.

translated_text:
For thus saith the LORD, Thy bruise
is incurable,
and
 thy wound
is grievous.
original_text:
For thus saith the LORD, Thy bruise
is incurable,
and
 thy wound
is grievous.

translated_text: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.
original_text: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.

translated_text:
All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity;
because thy sins were increased.
original_text:
All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity;
because thy sins were increased.

translated_text:
Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow
is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity:
because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.
original_text:
Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow
is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity:
because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.

translated_text: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.
original_text: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.

translated_text:
For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD; because they called thee an Outcast,
saying, This
is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.
original_text:
For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD; because they called thee an Outcast,
saying, This
is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.

translated_text: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.
original_text: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.

translated_text: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.
original_text: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.

translated_text:
And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who
is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith the LORD.
original_text:
And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who
is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith the LORD.

translated_text: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
original_text: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

translated_text: Behold, the whirlwind of the LORD goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.
original_text: Behold, the whirlwind of the LORD goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.

translated_text:
The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have done
it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.
original_text:
The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have done
it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.

translated_text:
Now these
are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;
original_text:
Now these
are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;

translated_text: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)
original_text: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)

translated_text: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,
original_text: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;
original_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;

translated_text:
Build ye houses, and dwell
in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;
original_text:
Build ye houses, and dwell
in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;

translated_text: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.
original_text: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.

translated_text: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
original_text: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.

translated_text:
For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that
be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.
original_text:
For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that
be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.

translated_text: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the LORD.
original_text: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the LORD.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD, That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
original_text: For thus saith the LORD, That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.

translated_text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
original_text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

translated_text: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
original_text: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.

translated_text:
And ye shall seek me, and find
me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
original_text:
And ye shall seek me, and find
me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

translated_text: And I will be found of you, saith the LORD: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the LORD; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.
original_text: And I will be found of you, saith the LORD: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the LORD; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.

translated_text: Because ye have said, The LORD hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;
original_text: Because ye have said, The LORD hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;

translated_text:
Know that thus saith the LORD of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and of all the people that dwelleth in this city,
and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;
original_text:
Know that thus saith the LORD of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and of all the people that dwelleth in this city,
and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.

translated_text: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:
original_text: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:

translated_text:
Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the LORD, which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending
them; but ye would not hear, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the LORD, which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending
them; but ye would not hear, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Hear ye therefore the word of the LORD, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:
original_text: Hear ye therefore the word of the LORD, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;
original_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;

translated_text:
And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which
are in Babylon, saying, The LORD make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;
original_text:
And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which
are in Babylon, saying, The LORD make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;

translated_text:
Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours’ wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and
am a witness, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours’ wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and
am a witness, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Thus shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,
original_text: Thus shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,

translated_text:
Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that
are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
original_text:
Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that
are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

translated_text:
The LORD hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of the LORD, for every man
that is
 mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.
original_text:
The LORD hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of the LORD, for every man
that is
 mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.

translated_text: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which maketh himself a prophet to you?
original_text: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which maketh himself a prophet to you?

translated_text:
For therefore he sent unto us
in Babylon, saying, This
captivity is long: build ye houses, and dwell
in them;
 and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
original_text:
For therefore he sent unto us
in Babylon, saying, This
captivity is long: build ye houses, and dwell
in them;
 and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

translated_text: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
original_text: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.

translated_text: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
original_text: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,

translated_text: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith the LORD concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:
original_text: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith the LORD concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, saith the LORD; because he hath taught rebellion against the LORD.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, saith the LORD; because he hath taught rebellion against the LORD.

translated_text:
And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year,
and in the fifth month,
that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which
was
 of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of the LORD, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
original_text:
And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year,
and in the fifth month,
that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which
was
 of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of the LORD, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

translated_text: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
original_text: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

translated_text: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD’S house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:
original_text: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD’S house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:

translated_text: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went into Babylon, saith the LORD: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
original_text: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went into Babylon, saith the LORD: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

translated_text: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the LORD,
original_text: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the LORD,

translated_text: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: the LORD do so: the LORD perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD’S house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.
original_text: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: the LORD do so: the LORD perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD’S house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.

translated_text: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people;
original_text: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people;

translated_text: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.
original_text: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.

translated_text:
The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass,
then shall the prophet be known, that the LORD hath truly sent him.
original_text:
The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass,
then shall the prophet be known, that the LORD hath truly sent him.

translated_text: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and brake it.
original_text: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and brake it.

translated_text: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
original_text: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.

translated_text:
Then the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah
the prophet,
 after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
original_text:
Then the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah
the prophet,
 after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

translated_text: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.
original_text: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.
original_text: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.

translated_text: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; The LORD hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.
original_text: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; The LORD hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast taught rebellion against the LORD.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast taught rebellion against the LORD.

translated_text: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
original_text: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.

translated_text: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
original_text: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD to me; Make thee bonds and yokes, and put them upon thy neck,
original_text: Thus saith the LORD to me; Make thee bonds and yokes, and put them upon thy neck,

translated_text: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah;
original_text: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah;

translated_text: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say unto your masters;
original_text: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say unto your masters;

translated_text:
I have made the earth, the man and the beast that
are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.
original_text:
I have made the earth, the man and the beast that
are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.

translated_text: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.
original_text: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.

translated_text: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son’s son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.
original_text: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son’s son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, saith the LORD, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, saith the LORD, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.

translated_text: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon:
original_text: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon:

translated_text: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.
original_text: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.

translated_text: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, saith the LORD; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.
original_text: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, saith the LORD; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.

translated_text: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
original_text: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.

translated_text: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the LORD hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
original_text: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the LORD hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

translated_text: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
original_text: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.

translated_text: For I have not sent them, saith the LORD, yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.
original_text: For I have not sent them, saith the LORD, yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.

translated_text: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the LORD’S house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
original_text: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the LORD’S house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.

translated_text: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?
original_text: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?

translated_text:
But if they
be prophets, and if the word of the LORD be with them, let them now make intercession to the LORD of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the LORD, and
in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.
original_text:
But if they
be prophets, and if the word of the LORD be with them, let them now make intercession to the LORD of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the LORD, and
in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,
original_text: For thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,

translated_text: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;
original_text: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;

translated_text:
Yea, thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain
in the house of the LORD, and
in
 the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem;
original_text:
Yea, thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain
in the house of the LORD, and
in
 the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem;

translated_text: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, saith the LORD; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.
original_text: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, saith the LORD; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.

translated_text: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the LORD, saying,
original_text: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the LORD, saying,

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD; Stand in the court of the LORD’S house, and speak unto all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the LORD’S house, all the words that I command thee to speak unto them; diminish not a word:
original_text: Thus saith the LORD; Stand in the court of the LORD’S house, and speak unto all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the LORD’S house, all the words that I command thee to speak unto them; diminish not a word:

translated_text: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.
original_text: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.

translated_text: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,
original_text: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,

translated_text:
To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending
them, but ye have not hearkened;
original_text:
To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending
them, but ye have not hearkened;

translated_text: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.
original_text: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.

translated_text: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.
original_text: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the LORD had commanded
him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.
original_text:
Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the LORD had commanded
him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.

translated_text: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.
original_text: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.

translated_text:
When the princes of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king’s house unto the house of the LORD, and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the LORD’S
house.
original_text:
When the princes of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king’s house unto the house of the LORD, and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the LORD’S
house.

translated_text:
Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man
is worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.
original_text:
Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man
is worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.

translated_text: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.
original_text: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.

translated_text: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.
original_text: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.

translated_text:
As for me, behold, I
am in your hand: do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you.
original_text:
As for me, behold, I
am in your hand: do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you.

translated_text: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth the LORD hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.
original_text: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth the LORD hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.

translated_text:
Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man
is not worthy to die: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.
original_text:
Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man
is not worthy to die: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.

translated_text: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,
original_text: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,

translated_text:
Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Zion shall be plowed
like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
original_text:
Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Zion shall be plowed
like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.

translated_text: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death? did he not fear the LORD, and besought the LORD, and the LORD repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.
