original_text: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death? did he not fear the LORD, and besought the LORD, and the LORD repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.

translated_text: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the LORD, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath-jearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:
original_text: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the LORD, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath-jearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:

translated_text: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;
original_text: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;

translated_text:
And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt,
namely, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and
certain men with him into Egypt.
original_text:
And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt,
namely, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and
certain men with him into Egypt.

translated_text: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
original_text: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.

translated_text: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
original_text: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.

translated_text: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,
original_text: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,

translated_text:
From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even unto this day, that
is the three and twentieth year, the word of the LORD hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.
original_text:
From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even unto this day, that
is the three and twentieth year, the word of the LORD hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.

translated_text:
And the LORD hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending
them; but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.
original_text:
And the LORD hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending
them; but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.

translated_text: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD hath given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:
original_text: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD hath given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:

translated_text: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.
original_text: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.

translated_text: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith the LORD; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.
original_text: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith the LORD; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,

translated_text: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the LORD, and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.
original_text: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the LORD, and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.

translated_text: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.
original_text: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.

translated_text:
And this whole land shall be a desolation,
and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
original_text:
And this whole land shall be a desolation,
and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished,
that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the LORD, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished,
that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the LORD, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.

translated_text:
And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it,
even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.
original_text:
And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it,
even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.

translated_text: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.
original_text: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.
original_text: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.

translated_text: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.
original_text: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.

translated_text: Then took I the cup at the LORD’S hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the LORD had sent me:
original_text: Then took I the cup at the LORD’S hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the LORD had sent me:

translated_text:
To wit, Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as
it is this day;
original_text:
To wit, Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as
it is this day;

translated_text: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
original_text: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;

translated_text: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,
original_text: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,

translated_text: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,
original_text: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,

translated_text: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,
original_text: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,

translated_text:
Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all
that are in the utmost corners,
original_text:
Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all
that are in the utmost corners,

translated_text: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,
original_text: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,

translated_text: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,
original_text: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,

translated_text:
And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which
are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
original_text:
And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which
are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.

translated_text: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
original_text: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.

translated_text: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.
original_text: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.

translated_text: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the LORD of hosts.
original_text: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the LORD of hosts.

translated_text:
Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The LORD shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread
the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
original_text:
Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The LORD shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread
the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.

translated_text:
A noise shall come
even to the ends of the earth; for the LORD hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them
that are wicked to the sword, saith the LORD.
original_text:
A noise shall come
even to the ends of the earth; for the LORD hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them
that are wicked to the sword, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.

translated_text:
And the slain of the LORD shall be at that day from
one end of the earth even unto the
other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.
original_text:
And the slain of the LORD shall be at that day from
one end of the earth even unto the
other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.

translated_text:
Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves
in the ashes,
 ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.
original_text:
Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves
in the ashes,
 ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.

translated_text: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.
original_text: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.

translated_text:
A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock,
shall be heard: for the LORD hath spoiled their pasture.
original_text:
A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock,
shall be heard: for the LORD hath spoiled their pasture.

translated_text: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
original_text: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the LORD.

translated_text: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.
original_text: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.

translated_text:
The LORD shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs
were
 set before the temple of the LORD, after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
original_text:
The LORD shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs
were
 set before the temple of the LORD, after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

translated_text:
One basket
had very good figs,
even like the figs
that are first ripe: and the other basket
had very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
original_text:
One basket
had very good figs,
even like the figs
that are first ripe: and the other basket
had very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.

translated_text: Then said the LORD unto me, What seest thou, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
original_text: Then said the LORD unto me, What seest thou, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.

translated_text: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for
their good.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for
their good.

translated_text:
For I will set mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull
them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck
them up.
original_text:
For I will set mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull
them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck
them up.

translated_text:
And I will give them an heart to know me, that I
am the LORD: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God: for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.
original_text:
And I will give them an heart to know me, that I
am the LORD: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God: for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.

translated_text: And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus saith the LORD, So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:
original_text: And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus saith the LORD, So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:

translated_text:
And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for
their hurt,
to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.
original_text:
And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for
their hurt,
to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.

translated_text: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.
original_text: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.

translated_text: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the LORD.
original_text: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the LORD.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the LORD.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the LORD.

translated_text: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.
original_text: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.

translated_text: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the LORD.
original_text: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
original_text: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.

translated_text:
In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this
is his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.
original_text:
In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this
is his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.

translated_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that they shall no more say, The LORD liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
original_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that they shall no more say, The LORD liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

translated_text: But, The LORD liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.
original_text: But, The LORD liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.

translated_text: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the LORD, and because of the words of his holiness.
original_text: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the LORD, and because of the words of his holiness.

translated_text:
For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force
is not right.
original_text:
For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force
is not right.

translated_text: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the LORD.
original_text: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery
ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them,
even the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery
ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them,
even the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.

translated_text: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
original_text: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.

translated_text: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
original_text: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart,
and not out of the mouth of the LORD.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart,
and not out of the mouth of the LORD.

translated_text: They say still unto them that despise me, The LORD hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.
original_text: They say still unto them that despise me, The LORD hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.

translated_text:
For who hath stood in the counsel of the LORD, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard
it?
original_text:
For who hath stood in the counsel of the LORD, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard
it?

translated_text: Behold, a whirlwind of the LORD is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.
original_text: Behold, a whirlwind of the LORD is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.

translated_text: The anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.
original_text: The anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.

translated_text: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
original_text: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.

translated_text: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
original_text: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.

translated_text: Am I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?
original_text: Am I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?

translated_text: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the LORD. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the LORD.
original_text: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the LORD. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the LORD.

translated_text: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
original_text: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.

translated_text: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.
original_text: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.

translated_text:
The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What
is the chaff to the wheat? saith the LORD.
original_text:
The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What
is the chaff to the wheat? saith the LORD.

translated_text:
Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer
that breaketh the rock in pieces?
original_text:
Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer
that breaketh the rock in pieces?

translated_text:
Therefore, behold, I
am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.
original_text:
Therefore, behold, I
am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.

translated_text:
Behold, I
am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.
original_text:
Behold, I
am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.

translated_text:
Behold, I
am against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the LORD, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Behold, I
am against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the LORD, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What
is the burden of the LORD? thou shalt then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the LORD.
original_text:
And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What
is the burden of the LORD? thou shalt then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
And
as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the LORD, I will even punish that man and his house.
original_text:
And
as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the LORD, I will even punish that man and his house.

translated_text: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the LORD answered? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
original_text: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the LORD answered? and, What hath the LORD spoken?

translated_text: And the burden of the LORD shall ye mention no more: for every man’s word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.
original_text: And the burden of the LORD shall ye mention no more: for every man’s word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.

translated_text: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the LORD answered thee? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
original_text: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the LORD answered thee? and, What hath the LORD spoken?

translated_text: But since ye say, The burden of the LORD; therefore thus saith the LORD; Because ye say this word, The burden of the LORD, and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the LORD;
original_text: But since ye say, The burden of the LORD; therefore thus saith the LORD; Because ye say this word, The burden of the LORD, and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the LORD;

translated_text:
Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers,
and cast you
 out of my presence:
original_text:
Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers,
and cast you
 out of my presence:

translated_text: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.
original_text: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD; Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,
original_text: Thus saith the LORD; Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,

translated_text: And say, Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates:
original_text: And say, Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates:

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD; Execute ye judgment and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD; Execute ye judgment and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.

translated_text: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.
original_text: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.

translated_text: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the LORD, that this house shall become a desolation.
original_text: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the LORD, that this house shall become a desolation.

translated_text:
For thus saith the LORD unto the king’s house of Judah; Thou
art
 Gilead unto me,
and the head of Lebanon:
yet surely I will make thee a wilderness,
and cities
which are not inhabited.
original_text:
For thus saith the LORD unto the king’s house of Judah; Thou
art
 Gilead unto me,
and the head of Lebanon:
yet surely I will make thee a wilderness,
and cities
which are not inhabited.

translated_text:
And I will prepare destroyers against thee, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast
them into the fire.
original_text:
And I will prepare destroyers against thee, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast
them into the fire.

translated_text: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this great city?
original_text: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this great city?

translated_text: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.
original_text: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.

translated_text:
Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him:
but weep sore for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.
original_text:
Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him:
but weep sore for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:
original_text: For thus saith the LORD touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:

translated_text: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.
original_text: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.

translated_text:
Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong;
that useth his neighbour’s service without wages, and giveth him not for his work;
original_text:
Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong;
that useth his neighbour’s service without wages, and giveth him not for his work;

translated_text:
That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and
it is cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.
original_text:
That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and
it is cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.

translated_text:
Shalt thou reign, because thou closest
thyself in cedar? did not thy father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice,
and
 then
it was well with him?
original_text:
Shalt thou reign, because thou closest
thyself in cedar? did not thy father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice,
and
 then
it was well with him?

translated_text:
He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then
it was well
with him: was not this to know me? saith the LORD.
original_text:
He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then
it was well
with him: was not this to know me? saith the LORD.

translated_text:
But thine eyes and thine heart
are not but for thy covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do
it.
original_text:
But thine eyes and thine heart
are not but for thy covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do
it.

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah; They shall not lament for him,
saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him,
saying, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah; They shall not lament for him,
saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him,
saying, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!

translated_text: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
original_text: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.

translated_text: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all thy lovers are destroyed.
original_text: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all thy lovers are destroyed.

translated_text: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.
original_text: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.

translated_text: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!
original_text: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!

translated_text: As I live, saith the LORD, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;
original_text: As I live, saith the LORD, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;

translated_text:
And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand
of them whose face thou fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
original_text:
And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand
of them whose face thou fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

translated_text: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.
original_text: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.

translated_text: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.
original_text: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.

translated_text:
Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol?
is he
 a vessel wherein
is no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?
original_text:
Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol?
is he
 a vessel wherein
is no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?

translated_text: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the LORD.
original_text: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the LORD.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD, Write ye this man childless, a man
that
 shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Judah.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD, Write ye this man childless, a man
that
 shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Judah.

translated_text: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,
original_text: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,

translated_text: Enquire, I pray thee, of the LORD for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us; if so be that the LORD will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.
original_text: Enquire, I pray thee, of the LORD for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us; if so be that the LORD will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.

translated_text: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:
original_text: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that
are in your hands, wherewith ye fight
against
 the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that
are in your hands, wherewith ye fight
against
 the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.

translated_text: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.
original_text: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.

translated_text: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.
original_text: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.

translated_text: And afterward, saith the LORD, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.
original_text: And afterward, saith the LORD, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.

translated_text: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.
original_text: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.

translated_text: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth out, and falleth to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.
original_text: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth out, and falleth to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.

translated_text: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, saith the LORD: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.
original_text: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, saith the LORD: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.

translated_text: And touching the house of the king of Judah, say, Hear ye the word of the LORD;
original_text: And touching the house of the king of Judah, say, Hear ye the word of the LORD;

translated_text:
O house of David, thus saith the LORD; Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver
him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench
it,
 because of the evil of your doings.
original_text:
O house of David, thus saith the LORD; Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver
him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench
it,
 because of the evil of your doings.

translated_text:
Behold, I
am against thee, O inhabitant of the valley,
and rock of the plain, saith the LORD; which say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?
original_text:
Behold, I
am against thee, O inhabitant of the valley,
and rock of the plain, saith the LORD; which say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?

translated_text: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, saith the LORD: and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.
original_text: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, saith the LORD: and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.

translated_text:
Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who
was also chief governor in the house of the LORD, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.
original_text:
Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who
was also chief governor in the house of the LORD, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.

translated_text:
Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that
were in the high gate of Benjamin, which
was by the house of the LORD.
original_text:
Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that
were in the high gate of Benjamin, which
was by the house of the LORD.

translated_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, The LORD hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magor-missabib.
original_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, The LORD hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magor-missabib.

translated_text:
For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold
it: and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.
original_text:
For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold
it: and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.

translated_text: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all the labours thereof, and all the precious things thereof, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies, which shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.
original_text: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all the labours thereof, and all the precious things thereof, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies, which shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.

translated_text: And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried there, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.
original_text: And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried there, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.

translated_text: O LORD, thou hast deceived me, and I was deceived: thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocketh me.
original_text: O LORD, thou hast deceived me, and I was deceived: thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocketh me.

translated_text: For since I spake, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of the LORD was made a reproach unto me, and a derision, daily.
original_text: For since I spake, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of the LORD was made a reproach unto me, and a derision, daily.

translated_text:
Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But
his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not
stay.
original_text:
Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But
his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not
stay.

translated_text:
For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report,
say they, and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting,
saying, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.
original_text:
For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report,
say they, and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting,
saying, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.

translated_text:
But the LORD
is with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper:
their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.
original_text:
But the LORD
is with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper:
their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.

translated_text:
But, O LORD of hosts, that triest the righteous,
and seest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I opened my cause.
original_text:
But, O LORD of hosts, that triest the righteous,
and seest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I opened my cause.

translated_text: Sing unto the LORD, praise ye the LORD: for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.
original_text: Sing unto the LORD, praise ye the LORD: for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.

translated_text:
Cursed
be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.
original_text:
Cursed
be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.

translated_text:
Cursed
be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto thee; making him very glad.
original_text:
Cursed
be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto thee; making him very glad.

translated_text: And let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;
original_text: And let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;

translated_text:
Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb
to be always great
with me.
original_text:
Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb
to be always great
with me.

translated_text: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?
original_text: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?

translated_text:
Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
original_text:
Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name
was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

translated_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
original_text:
And he did
that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

translated_text: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
original_text: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month,
that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.
original_text:
And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month,
that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.

translated_text: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
original_text: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

translated_text:
And in the fourth month, in the ninth
day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
original_text:
And in the fourth month, in the ninth
day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

translated_text:
Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which
was by the king’s garden; (now the Chaldeans
were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.
original_text:
Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which
was by the king’s garden; (now the Chaldeans
were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.

translated_text: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
original_text: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

translated_text: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.
original_text: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.

translated_text: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
original_text: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

translated_text: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.
original_text: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.

translated_text:
Now in the fifth month, in the tenth
day of the month, which
was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard,
which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,
original_text:
Now in the fifth month, in the tenth
day of the month, which
was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard,
which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,

translated_text:
And burned the house of the LORD, and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great
men, burned he with fire:
original_text:
And burned the house of the LORD, and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great
men, burned he with fire:

translated_text:
And all the army of the Chaldeans, that
were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.
original_text:
And all the army of the Chaldeans, that
were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.

translated_text:
Then Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive
certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.
original_text:
Then Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive
certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

translated_text:
But Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard left
certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.
original_text:
But Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard left
certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.

translated_text:
Also the pillars of brass that
were in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that
was in the house of the LORD, the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.
original_text:
Also the pillars of brass that
were in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that
was in the house of the LORD, the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.

translated_text: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
original_text: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

translated_text:
And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups;
that which
was of gold
in gold, and
that which
was
 of silver
in silver, took the captain of the guard away.
original_text:
And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups;
that which
was of gold
in gold, and
that which
was
 of silver
in silver, took the captain of the guard away.

translated_text:
The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that
were
 under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the LORD: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
original_text:
The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that
were
 under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the LORD: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

translated_text:
And
concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar
was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof
was four fingers:
it was hollow.
original_text:
And
concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar
was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof
was four fingers:
it was hollow.

translated_text:
And a chapiter of brass
was upon it; and the height of one chapiter
was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates
were like unto these.
original_text:
And a chapiter of brass
was upon it; and the height of one chapiter
was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates
were like unto these.

translated_text:
And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side;
and
 all the pomegranates upon the network
were an hundred round about.
original_text:
And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side;
and
 all the pomegranates upon the network
were an hundred round about.

translated_text: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
original_text: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

translated_text: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king’s person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.
original_text: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king’s person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.

translated_text: So Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.
original_text: So Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

translated_text: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.
original_text: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.

translated_text: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty:
original_text: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty:

translated_text: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:
original_text: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:

translated_text:
In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons
were four thousand and six hundred.
original_text:
In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons
were four thousand and six hundred.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth
day of the month,
that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the
first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison,
original_text:
And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth
day of the month,
that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the
first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison,

translated_text:
And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that
were with him in Babylon,
original_text:
And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that
were with him in Babylon,

translated_text: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.
original_text: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.

translated_text:
And
for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
original_text:
And
for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;
original_text: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;

translated_text: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.
original_text: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.

translated_text:
Against
him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against
him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.
original_text:
Against
him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against
him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.

translated_text:
Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and
they that are thrust through in her streets.
original_text:
Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and
they that are thrust through in her streets.

translated_text:
For Israel
hath not
been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the LORD of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.
original_text:
For Israel
hath not
been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the LORD of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.

translated_text:
Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this
is the time of the LORD’S vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.
original_text:
Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this
is the time of the LORD’S vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.

translated_text:
Babylon
hath been a golden cup in the LORD’S hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.
original_text:
Babylon
hath been a golden cup in the LORD’S hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.

translated_text: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so she may be healed.
original_text: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so she may be healed.

translated_text:
We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up
even to the skies.
original_text:
We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up
even to the skies.

translated_text: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.
original_text: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.

translated_text:
Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device
is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it
is the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance of his temple.
original_text:
Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device
is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it
is the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance of his temple.

translated_text: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the LORD hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.
original_text: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the LORD hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.

translated_text:
O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come,
and the measure of thy covetousness.
original_text:
O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come,
and the measure of thy covetousness.

translated_text:
The LORD of hosts hath sworn by himself,
saying, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.
original_text:
The LORD of hosts hath sworn by himself,
saying, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.

translated_text: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.
original_text: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.

translated_text:
When he uttereth
his voice,
there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
original_text:
When he uttereth
his voice,
there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.

translated_text:
Every man is brutish by
his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image
is falsehood, and
there is no breath in them.
original_text:
Every man is brutish by
his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image
is falsehood, and
there is no breath in them.

translated_text:
They
are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
original_text:
They
are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

translated_text:
The portion of Jacob
is not like them; for he
is
 the former of all things: and
Israel is the rod of his inheritance: the LORD of hosts is his name.
original_text:
The portion of Jacob
is not like them; for he
is
 the former of all things: and
Israel is the rod of his inheritance: the LORD of hosts is his name.

translated_text: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;
original_text: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;

translated_text: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;
original_text: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;

translated_text: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.
original_text: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.

translated_text: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the LORD.
original_text: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
Behold, I
am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the LORD, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.
original_text:
Behold, I
am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the LORD, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.

translated_text: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the LORD.
original_text: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.
original_text: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.

translated_text: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.
original_text: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.

translated_text: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of the LORD shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.
original_text: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of the LORD shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.

translated_text:
The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in
their holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.
original_text:
The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in
their holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.

translated_text:
One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at
one end,
original_text:
One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at
one end,

translated_text: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.
original_text: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.

translated_text:
For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; The daughter of Babylon
is like a threshingfloor,
it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.
original_text:
For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; The daughter of Babylon
is like a threshingfloor,
it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.

translated_text: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.
original_text: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.

translated_text:
The violence done to me and to my flesh
be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.
original_text:
The violence done to me and to my flesh
be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.

translated_text: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwelling place for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.
original_text: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwelling place for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.

translated_text: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions’ whelps.
original_text: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions’ whelps.

translated_text: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the LORD.
