original_text: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the LORD.

translated_text: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.
original_text: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.

translated_text: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!
original_text: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!

translated_text: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.
original_text: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.

translated_text:
Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth
any son of man pass thereby.
original_text:
Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth
any son of man pass thereby.

translated_text: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.
original_text: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.

translated_text: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the LORD.
original_text: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the LORD.

translated_text:
And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come
one year, and after that in
another year
shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.
original_text:
And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come
one year, and after that in
another year
shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

translated_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.
original_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.

translated_text:
Then the heaven and the earth, and all that
is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Then the heaven and the earth, and all that
is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
As Babylon
hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.
original_text:
As Babylon
hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.

translated_text: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the LORD afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.
original_text: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the LORD afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.

translated_text: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD’S house.
original_text: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD’S house.

translated_text: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
original_text: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.

translated_text:
Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength,
yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength,
yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
A sound of a cry
cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:
original_text:
A sound of a cry
cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:

translated_text: Because the LORD hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:
original_text: Because the LORD hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:

translated_text:
Because the spoiler is come upon her,
even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the LORD God of recompences shall surely requite.
original_text:
Because the spoiler is come upon her,
even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the LORD God of recompences shall surely requite.

translated_text:
And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise
men, her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name
is the LORD of hosts.
original_text:
And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise
men, her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name
is the LORD of hosts.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.

translated_text:
The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And
this Seraiah was a quiet prince.
original_text:
The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And
this Seraiah was a quiet prince.

translated_text:
So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon,
even all these words that are written against Babylon.
original_text:
So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon,
even all these words that are written against Babylon.

translated_text: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;
original_text: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;

translated_text: Then shalt thou say, O LORD, thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.
original_text: Then shalt thou say, O LORD, thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.

translated_text:
And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book,
that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:
original_text:
And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book,
that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:

translated_text:
And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far
are
 the words of Jeremiah.
original_text:
And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far
are
 the words of Jeremiah.

translated_text:
The word that the LORD spake against Babylon
and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.
original_text:
The word that the LORD spake against Babylon
and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.

translated_text:
Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish,
and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.
original_text:
Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish,
and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.

translated_text: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.
original_text: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.

translated_text: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the LORD their God.
original_text: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the LORD their God.

translated_text:
They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward,
saying,
 Come, and let us join ourselves to the LORD in a perpetual covenant
that shall not be forgotten.
original_text:
They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward,
saying,
 Come, and let us join ourselves to the LORD in a perpetual covenant
that shall not be forgotten.

translated_text:
My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away
on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.
original_text:
My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away
on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.

translated_text: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of justice, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.
original_text: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of justice, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.

translated_text: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.
original_text: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.

translated_text:
For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows
shall be
 as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.
original_text:
For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows
shall be
 as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.

translated_text: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the LORD.
original_text: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;
original_text: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;

translated_text:
Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations
shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
original_text:
Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations
shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

translated_text: Because of the wrath of the LORD it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.
original_text: Because of the wrath of the LORD it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

translated_text: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the LORD.
original_text: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the LORD.

translated_text:
Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it
is the vengeance of the LORD: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.
original_text:
Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it
is the vengeance of the LORD: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.

translated_text: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.
original_text: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.

translated_text:
Israel
is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven
him
 away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.
original_text:
Israel
is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven
him
 away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

translated_text: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.
original_text: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.

translated_text:
In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and
there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.
original_text:
In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and
there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.

translated_text:
Go up against the land of Merathaim,
even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the LORD, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.
original_text:
Go up against the land of Merathaim,
even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the LORD, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.

translated_text:
A sound of battle
is in the land, and of great destruction.
original_text:
A sound of battle
is in the land, and of great destruction.

translated_text: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!
original_text: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

translated_text: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the LORD.
original_text: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the LORD.

translated_text:
The LORD hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this
is the work of the Lord GOD of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
original_text:
The LORD hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this
is the work of the Lord GOD of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.

translated_text: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.
original_text: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.

translated_text: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.
original_text: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.

translated_text: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple.
original_text: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple.

translated_text: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.
original_text: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.

translated_text: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD.
original_text: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
Behold, I
am against thee,
O thou most proud, saith the Lord GOD of hosts: for thy day is come, the time
that I will visit thee.
original_text:
Behold, I
am against thee,
O thou most proud, saith the Lord GOD of hosts: for thy day is come, the time
that I will visit thee.

translated_text: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.
original_text: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah
were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah
were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.

translated_text:
Their Redeemer
is strong; the LORD of hosts
is
 his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
original_text:
Their Redeemer
is strong; the LORD of hosts
is
 his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

translated_text:
A sword
is upon the Chaldeans, saith the LORD, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise
men.
original_text:
A sword
is upon the Chaldeans, saith the LORD, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise
men.

translated_text:
A sword
is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword
is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.
original_text:
A sword
is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword
is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.

translated_text:
A sword
is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that
are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword
is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.
original_text:
A sword
is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that
are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword
is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.

translated_text:
A drought
is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it
is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon
their
 idols.
original_text:
A drought
is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it
is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon
their
 idols.

translated_text:
Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell
there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
original_text:
Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell
there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.

translated_text:
As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour
cities
 thereof, saith the LORD;
so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.
original_text:
As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour
cities
 thereof, saith the LORD;
so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.

translated_text: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
original_text: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.

translated_text:
They shall hold the bow and the lance: they
are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses,
every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.
original_text:
They shall hold the bow and the lance: they
are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses,
every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.

translated_text:
The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him,
and pangs as of a woman in travail.
original_text:
The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him,
and pangs as of a woman in travail.

translated_text:
Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who
is a chosen
man, that I may appoint over her? for who
is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who
is that shepherd that will stand before me?
original_text:
Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who
is a chosen
man, that I may appoint over her? for who
is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who
is that shepherd that will stand before me?

translated_text:
Therefore hear ye the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make
their habitation desolate with them.
original_text:
Therefore hear ye the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make
their habitation desolate with them.

translated_text: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.
original_text: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.

translated_text:
Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the LORD; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why
then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?
original_text:
Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the LORD; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why
then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?

translated_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the LORD.
original_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity,
and his priests and his princes together.
original_text:
Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity,
and his priests and his princes together.

translated_text:
Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures,
saying, Who shall come unto me?
original_text:
Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures,
saying, Who shall come unto me?

translated_text: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.
original_text: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.

translated_text: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the LORD.
original_text: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
Concerning Edom, thus saith the LORD of hosts;
Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?
original_text:
Concerning Edom, thus saith the LORD of hosts;
Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?

translated_text:
Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time
that I will visit him.
original_text:
Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time
that I will visit him.

translated_text:
If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave
some
 gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.
original_text:
If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave
some
 gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.

translated_text: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.
original_text: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.

translated_text:
Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve
them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.
original_text:
Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve
them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.

translated_text:
For thus saith the LORD; Behold, they whose judgment
was
 not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and
art thou he
that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink
of it.
original_text:
For thus saith the LORD; Behold, they whose judgment
was
 not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and
art thou he
that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink
of it.

translated_text: For I have sworn by myself, saith the LORD, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.
original_text: For I have sworn by myself, saith the LORD, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.

translated_text:
I have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen,
saying, Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.
original_text:
I have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen,
saying, Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.

translated_text:
For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen,
and despised among men.
original_text:
For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen,
and despised among men.

translated_text:
Thy terribleness hath deceived thee,
and the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Thy terribleness hath deceived thee,
and the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.
original_text: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.

translated_text:
As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour
cities
 thereof, saith the LORD, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.
original_text:
As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour
cities
 thereof, saith the LORD, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.

translated_text:
Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who
is a chosen
man, that I may appoint over her? for who
is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who
is that shepherd that will stand before me?
original_text:
Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who
is a chosen
man, that I may appoint over her? for who
is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who
is that shepherd that will stand before me?

translated_text: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.
original_text: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.

translated_text: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.
original_text: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.

translated_text: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
original_text: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

translated_text:
Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted;
there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.
original_text:
Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted;
there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.

translated_text:
Damascus is waxed feeble,
and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on
her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.
original_text:
Damascus is waxed feeble,
and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on
her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.

translated_text: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!
original_text: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!

translated_text: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD of hosts.
original_text: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD of hosts.

translated_text: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben-hadad.
original_text: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben-hadad.

translated_text: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the LORD; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.
original_text: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the LORD; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.

translated_text:
Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear
is on every side.
original_text:
Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear
is on every side.

translated_text: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the LORD; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.
original_text: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the LORD; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.

translated_text:
Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the LORD, which have neither gates nor bars,
which dwell alone.
original_text:
Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the LORD, which have neither gates nor bars,
which dwell alone.

translated_text:
And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them
that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the LORD.
original_text:
And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them
that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons,
and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor
any son of man dwell in it.
original_text:
And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons,
and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor
any son of man dwell in it.

translated_text: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,
original_text: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

translated_text: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.
original_text: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.

translated_text:
For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them
even
 my fierce anger, saith the LORD; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:
original_text:
For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them
even
 my fierce anger, saith the LORD; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:

translated_text: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the LORD.
original_text: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
But it shall come to pass in the latter days,
that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the LORD.
original_text:
But it shall come to pass in the latter days,
that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
Against Moab thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded
and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.
original_text:
Against Moab thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded
and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.

translated_text:
There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from
being
 a nation. Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue thee.
original_text:
There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from
being
 a nation. Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue thee.

translated_text:
A voice of crying
shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.
original_text:
A voice of crying
shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.

translated_text: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
original_text: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

translated_text: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.
original_text: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.

translated_text: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
original_text: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.

translated_text:
For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou shalt also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity
with
 his priests and his princes together.
original_text:
For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou shalt also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity
with
 his priests and his princes together.

translated_text: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the LORD hath spoken.
original_text: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the LORD hath spoken.

translated_text: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.
original_text: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.

translated_text:
Cursed
be he that doeth the work of the LORD deceitfully, and cursed
be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.
original_text:
Cursed
be he that doeth the work of the LORD deceitfully, and cursed
be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.

translated_text: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.
original_text: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.

translated_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.
original_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.

translated_text: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence.
original_text: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence.

translated_text:
How say ye, We
are mighty and strong men for the war?
original_text:
How say ye, We
are mighty and strong men for the war?

translated_text:
Moab is spoiled, and gone up
out of her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name
is the LORD of hosts.
original_text:
Moab is spoiled, and gone up
out of her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name
is the LORD of hosts.

translated_text:
The calamity of Moab
is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.
original_text:
The calamity of Moab
is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.

translated_text:
All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken,
and the beautiful rod!
original_text:
All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken,
and the beautiful rod!

translated_text:
Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon, come down from
thy
 glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee,
and he shall destroy thy strong holds.
original_text:
Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon, come down from
thy
 glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee,
and he shall destroy thy strong holds.

translated_text:
O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth,
and say, What is done?
original_text:
O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth,
and say, What is done?

translated_text: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; and tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,
original_text: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; and tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,

translated_text: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,
original_text: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,

translated_text: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth-diblathaim,
original_text: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth-diblathaim,

translated_text: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Beth-gamul, and upon Beth-meon,
original_text: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Beth-gamul, and upon Beth-meon,

translated_text: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
original_text: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

translated_text: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith the LORD.
original_text: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
Make ye him drunken: for he magnified
himself against the LORD: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
original_text:
Make ye him drunken: for he magnified
himself against the LORD: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.

translated_text: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy.
original_text: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy.

translated_text:
O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove
that maketh her nest in the sides of the hole’s mouth.
original_text:
O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove
that maketh her nest in the sides of the hole’s mouth.

translated_text: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.
original_text: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.

translated_text:
I know his wrath, saith the LORD; but
it shall not
be
 so; his lies shall not so effect
it.
original_text:
I know his wrath, saith the LORD; but
it shall not
be
 so; his lies shall not so effect
it.

translated_text:
Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab;
mine heart shall mourn for the men of Kir-heres.
original_text:
Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab;
mine heart shall mourn for the men of Kir-heres.

translated_text:
O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants are gone over the sea, they reach
even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.
original_text:
O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants are gone over the sea, they reach
even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.

translated_text:
From the cry of Heshbon
even unto Elealeh,
and even
 unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar
even
 unto Horonaim,
as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.
original_text:
From the cry of Heshbon
even unto Elealeh,
and even
 unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar
even
 unto Horonaim,
as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.

translated_text: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the LORD, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.
original_text: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the LORD, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.

translated_text:
Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir-heres: because the riches
that he hath gotten are perished.
original_text:
Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir-heres: because the riches
that he hath gotten are perished.

translated_text:
For every head
shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands
shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.
original_text:
For every head
shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands
shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.

translated_text:
There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein
is no pleasure, saith the LORD.
original_text:
There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein
is no pleasure, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
They shall howl,
saying, How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.
original_text:
They shall howl,
saying, How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.
original_text: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.

translated_text: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men’s hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
original_text: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men’s hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

translated_text:
And Moab shall be destroyed from
being a people, because he hath magnified
himself against the LORD.
original_text:
And Moab shall be destroyed from
being a people, because he hath magnified
himself against the LORD.

translated_text:
Fear, and the pit, and the snare,
shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Fear, and the pit, and the snare,
shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it,
even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
original_text:
He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it,
even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.

translated_text: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
original_text: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

translated_text: Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.
original_text: Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.

translated_text:
Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the LORD. Thus far
is the judgment of Moab.
original_text:
Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the LORD. Thus far
is the judgment of Moab.

translated_text: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.
original_text: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.

translated_text:
At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong
horses,
 at the rushing of his chariots,
and at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to
their children for feebleness of hands;
original_text:
At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong
horses,
 at the rushing of his chariots,
and at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to
their children for feebleness of hands;

translated_text:
Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines,
and
 to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remaineth: for the LORD will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.
original_text:
Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines,
and
 to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remaineth: for the LORD will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.

translated_text:
Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off
with the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?
original_text:
Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off
with the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?

translated_text:
O thou sword of the LORD, how long
will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.
original_text:
O thou sword of the LORD, how long
will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.

translated_text: How can it be quiet, seeing the LORD hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.
original_text: How can it be quiet, seeing the LORD hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.

translated_text: The word of the LORD which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles;
original_text: The word of the LORD which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles;

translated_text: Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaoh-necho king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah.
original_text: Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaoh-necho king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah.

translated_text: Order ye the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.
original_text: Order ye the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.

translated_text:
Harness the horses; and get up, ye horsemen, and stand forth with
your helmets; furbish the spears,
and put on the brigandines.
original_text:
Harness the horses; and get up, ye horsemen, and stand forth with
your helmets; furbish the spears,
and put on the brigandines.

translated_text:
Wherefore have I seen them dismayed
and turned away back? and their mighty ones are beaten down, and are fled apace, and look not back:
for fear
was round about, saith the LORD.
original_text:
Wherefore have I seen them dismayed
and turned away back? and their mighty ones are beaten down, and are fled apace, and look not back:
for fear
was round about, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; they shall stumble, and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates.
original_text: Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; they shall stumble, and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates.

translated_text:
Who
is this
that cometh up as a flood, whose waters are moved as the rivers?
original_text:
Who
is this
that cometh up as a flood, whose waters are moved as the rivers?

translated_text:
Egypt riseth up like a flood, and
his waters are moved like the rivers; and he saith, I will go up,
and will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof.
original_text:
Egypt riseth up like a flood, and
his waters are moved like the rivers; and he saith, I will go up,
and will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof.

translated_text:
Come up, ye horses; and rage, ye chariots; and let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans, that handle the shield; and the Lydians, that handle
and bend the bow.
original_text:
Come up, ye horses; and rage, ye chariots; and let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans, that handle the shield; and the Lydians, that handle
and bend the bow.

translated_text:
For this
is the day of the Lord GOD of hosts, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour, and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood: for the Lord GOD of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.
original_text:
For this
is the day of the Lord GOD of hosts, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour, and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood: for the Lord GOD of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.

translated_text:
Go up into Gilead, and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt: in vain shalt thou use many medicines;
for thou shalt not be cured.
original_text:
Go up into Gilead, and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt: in vain shalt thou use many medicines;
for thou shalt not be cured.

translated_text:
The nations have heard of thy shame, and thy cry hath filled the land: for the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty,
and they are fallen both together.
original_text:
The nations have heard of thy shame, and thy cry hath filled the land: for the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty,
and they are fallen both together.

translated_text:
The word that the LORD spake to Jeremiah the prophet, how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come
and smite the land of Egypt.
original_text:
The word that the LORD spake to Jeremiah the prophet, how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come
and smite the land of Egypt.

translated_text: Declare ye in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Noph and in Tahpanhes: say ye, Stand fast, and prepare thee; for the sword shall devour round about thee.
original_text: Declare ye in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Noph and in Tahpanhes: say ye, Stand fast, and prepare thee; for the sword shall devour round about thee.

translated_text:
Why are thy valiant
men swept away? they stood not, because the LORD did drive them.
original_text:
Why are thy valiant
men swept away? they stood not, because the LORD did drive them.

translated_text: He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.
original_text: He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.

translated_text:
They did cry there, Pharaoh king of Egypt
is but a noise; he hath passed the time appointed.
original_text:
They did cry there, Pharaoh king of Egypt
is but a noise; he hath passed the time appointed.

translated_text:
As I live, saith the King, whose name
is the LORD of hosts, Surely as Tabor
is among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea,
so shall he come.
original_text:
As I live, saith the King, whose name
is the LORD of hosts, Surely as Tabor
is among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea,
so shall he come.

translated_text: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt, furnish thyself to go into captivity: for Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant.
original_text: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt, furnish thyself to go into captivity: for Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant.

translated_text:
Egypt
is like a very fair heifer,
but destruction cometh; it cometh out of the north.
original_text:
Egypt
is like a very fair heifer,
but destruction cometh; it cometh out of the north.

translated_text:
Also her hired men
are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks; for they also are turned back,
and are fled away together: they did not stand, because the day of their calamity was come upon them,
and the time of their visitation.
original_text:
Also her hired men
are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks; for they also are turned back,
and are fled away together: they did not stand, because the day of their calamity was come upon them,
and the time of their visitation.

translated_text: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as hewers of wood.
original_text: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as hewers of wood.

translated_text:
They shall cut down her forest, saith the LORD, though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and
are
 innumerable.
original_text:
They shall cut down her forest, saith the LORD, though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and
are
 innumerable.

translated_text: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.
original_text: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.

translated_text:
The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saith; Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods, and their kings; even Pharaoh, and
all them that trust in him:
original_text:
The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saith; Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods, and their kings; even Pharaoh, and
all them that trust in him:

translated_text: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith the LORD.
original_text: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
But fear not thou, O my servant Jacob, and be not dismayed, O Israel: for, behold, I will save thee from afar off, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make
him afraid.
original_text:
But fear not thou, O my servant Jacob, and be not dismayed, O Israel: for, behold, I will save thee from afar off, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make
him afraid.

translated_text:
Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD: for I
am
 with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.
original_text:
Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD: for I
am
 with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.

translated_text: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,
original_text: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, unto thee, O Baruch;
original_text: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, unto thee, O Baruch;

translated_text: Thou didst say, Woe is me now! for the LORD hath added grief to my sorrow; I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest.
original_text: Thou didst say, Woe is me now! for the LORD hath added grief to my sorrow; I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest.

translated_text:
Thus shalt thou say unto him, The LORD saith thus; Behold,
that
 which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up, even this whole land.
original_text:
Thus shalt thou say unto him, The LORD saith thus; Behold,
that
 which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up, even this whole land.

translated_text:
And seekest thou great things for thyself? seek
them not: for, behold, I will bring evil upon all flesh, saith the LORD: but thy life will I give unto thee for a prey in all places whither thou goest.
original_text:
And seekest thou great things for thyself? seek
them not: for, behold, I will bring evil upon all flesh, saith the LORD: but thy life will I give unto thee for a prey in all places whither thou goest.

translated_text: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews which dwell in the land of Egypt, which dwell at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Noph, and in the country of Pathros, saying,
original_text: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews which dwell in the land of Egypt, which dwell at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Noph, and in the country of Pathros, saying,

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Ye have seen all the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, and upon all the cities of Judah; and, behold, this day they
are a desolation, and no man dwelleth therein,
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Ye have seen all the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, and upon all the cities of Judah; and, behold, this day they
are a desolation, and no man dwelleth therein,

translated_text:
Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense,
and to serve other gods, whom they knew not,
neither they, ye, nor your fathers.
original_text:
Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense,
and to serve other gods, whom they knew not,
neither they, ye, nor your fathers.

translated_text:
Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending
them, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.
original_text:
Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending
them, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.

translated_text: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.
original_text: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.

translated_text:
Wherefore my fury and mine anger was poured forth, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted
and desolate, as at this day.
original_text:
Wherefore my fury and mine anger was poured forth, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted
and desolate, as at this day.

translated_text:
Therefore now thus saith the LORD, the God of hosts, the God of Israel; Wherefore commit ye
this great evil against your souls, to cut off from you man and woman, child and suckling, out of Judah, to leave you none to remain;
original_text:
Therefore now thus saith the LORD, the God of hosts, the God of Israel; Wherefore commit ye
this great evil against your souls, to cut off from you man and woman, child and suckling, out of Judah, to leave you none to remain;

translated_text: In that ye provoke me unto wrath with the works of your hands, burning incense unto other gods in the land of Egypt, whither ye be gone to dwell, that ye might cut yourselves off, and that ye might be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?
original_text: In that ye provoke me unto wrath with the works of your hands, burning incense unto other gods in the land of Egypt, whither ye be gone to dwell, that ye might cut yourselves off, and that ye might be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?

translated_text: Have ye forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Judah, and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they have committed in the land of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?
original_text: Have ye forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Judah, and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they have committed in the land of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?

translated_text:
They are not humbled
even unto this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.
original_text:
They are not humbled
even unto this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, and to cut off all Judah.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, and to cut off all Judah.

translated_text:
And I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be consumed,
and fall in the land of Egypt; they shall
even be consumed by the sword and by the famine: they shall die, from the least even unto the greatest, by the sword
and by the famine: and they shall be an execration,
and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.
original_text:
And I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be consumed,
and fall in the land of Egypt; they shall
even be consumed by the sword and by the famine: they shall die, from the least even unto the greatest, by the sword
and by the famine: and they shall be an execration,
and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.

translated_text: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:
original_text: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:

translated_text: So that none of the remnant of Judah, which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall escape or remain, that they should return into the land of Judah, to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there: for none shall return but such as shall escape.
original_text: So that none of the remnant of Judah, which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall escape or remain, that they should return into the land of Judah, to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there: for none shall return but such as shall escape.

translated_text: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods, and all the women that stood by, a great multitude, even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,
original_text: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods, and all the women that stood by, a great multitude, even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,

translated_text: As for the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the LORD, we will not hearken unto thee.
original_text: As for the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the LORD, we will not hearken unto thee.

translated_text:
But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth, to burn incense unto the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, as we have done, we, and our fathers, our kings, and our princes, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem: for
then had we plenty of victuals, and were well, and saw no evil.
original_text:
But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth, to burn incense unto the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, as we have done, we, and our fathers, our kings, and our princes, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem: for
then had we plenty of victuals, and were well, and saw no evil.

translated_text:
But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, we have wanted all
things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.
original_text:
But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, we have wanted all
things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.

translated_text: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and poured out drink offerings unto her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings unto her, without our men?
original_text: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and poured out drink offerings unto her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings unto her, without our men?

translated_text:
Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, and to all the people which had given him
that answer, saying,
original_text:
Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, and to all the people which had given him
that answer, saying,

translated_text:
The incense that ye burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, ye, and your fathers, your kings, and your princes, and the people of the land, did not the LORD remember them, and came it
not into his mind?
original_text:
The incense that ye burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, ye, and your fathers, your kings, and your princes, and the people of the land, did not the LORD remember them, and came it
not into his mind?

translated_text:
So that the LORD could no longer bear, because of the evil of your doings,
and because of the abominations which ye have committed; therefore is your land a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without an inhabitant, as at this day.
original_text:
So that the LORD could no longer bear, because of the evil of your doings,
and because of the abominations which ye have committed; therefore is your land a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without an inhabitant, as at this day.

translated_text: Because ye have burned incense, and because ye have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil is happened unto you, as at this day.
original_text: Because ye have burned incense, and because ye have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil is happened unto you, as at this day.

translated_text:
Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of the LORD, all Judah that
are in the land of Egypt:
original_text:
Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of the LORD, all Judah that
are in the land of Egypt:

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying; Ye and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your hand, saying, We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her: ye will surely accomplish your vows, and surely perform your vows.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying; Ye and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your hand, saying, We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her: ye will surely accomplish your vows, and surely perform your vows.

translated_text: Therefore hear ye the word of the LORD, all Judah that dwell in the land of Egypt; Behold, I have sworn by my great name, saith the LORD, that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, The Lord GOD liveth.
original_text: Therefore hear ye the word of the LORD, all Judah that dwell in the land of Egypt; Behold, I have sworn by my great name, saith the LORD, that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, The Lord GOD liveth.

translated_text: Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good: and all the men of Judah that are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.
original_text: Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good: and all the men of Judah that are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.

translated_text: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah, and all the remnant of Judah, that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall know whose words shall stand, mine, or theirs.
original_text: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah, and all the remnant of Judah, that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall know whose words shall stand, mine, or theirs.

translated_text:
And this
shall be a sign unto you, saith the LORD, that I will punish you in this place, that ye may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil:
original_text:
And this
