shall be a sign unto you, saith the LORD, that I will punish you in this place, that ye may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil:

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give Pharaoh-hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of them that seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, his enemy, and that sought his life.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give Pharaoh-hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of them that seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, his enemy, and that sought his life.

translated_text:
And it came to pass,
that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of the LORD their God, for which the LORD their God had sent him to them,
even all these words,
original_text:
And it came to pass,
that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of the LORD their God, for which the LORD their God had sent him to them,
even all these words,

translated_text: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men, saying unto Jeremiah, Thou speakest falsely: the LORD our God hath not sent thee to say, Go not into Egypt to sojourn there:
original_text: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men, saying unto Jeremiah, Thou speakest falsely: the LORD our God hath not sent thee to say, Go not into Egypt to sojourn there:

translated_text: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us, for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to death, and carry us away captives into Babylon.
original_text: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us, for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to death, and carry us away captives into Babylon.

translated_text: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, obeyed not the voice of the LORD, to dwell in the land of Judah.
original_text: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, obeyed not the voice of the LORD, to dwell in the land of Judah.

translated_text: But Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, took all the remnant of Judah, that were returned from all nations, whither they had been driven, to dwell in the land of Judah;
original_text: But Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, took all the remnant of Judah, that were returned from all nations, whither they had been driven, to dwell in the land of Judah;

translated_text: Even men, and women, and children, and the king’s daughters, and every person that Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.
original_text: Even men, and women, and children, and the king’s daughters, and every person that Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.

translated_text:
So they came into the land of Egypt: for they obeyed not the voice of the LORD: thus came they
even to Tahpanhes.
original_text:
So they came into the land of Egypt: for they obeyed not the voice of the LORD: thus came they
even to Tahpanhes.

translated_text: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,
original_text: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

translated_text:
Take great stones in thine hand, and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln, which
is at the entry of Pharaoh’s house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah;
original_text:
Take great stones in thine hand, and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln, which
is at the entry of Pharaoh’s house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah;

translated_text: And say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.
original_text: And say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.

translated_text:
And when he cometh, he shall smite the land of Egypt,
and deliver
 such
as are for death to death; and such
as are
 for captivity to captivity; and such
as are for the sword to the sword.
original_text:
And when he cometh, he shall smite the land of Egypt,
and deliver
 such
as are for death to death; and such
as are
 for captivity to captivity; and such
as are for the sword to the sword.

translated_text: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them, and carry them away captives: and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd putteth on his garment; and he shall go forth from thence in peace.
original_text: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them, and carry them away captives: and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd putteth on his garment; and he shall go forth from thence in peace.

translated_text:
He shall break also the images of Beth-shemesh, that
is in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall he burn with fire.
original_text:
He shall break also the images of Beth-shemesh, that
is in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall he burn with fire.

translated_text: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even unto the greatest, came near,
original_text: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even unto the greatest, came near,

translated_text:
And said unto Jeremiah the prophet, Let, we beseech thee, our supplication be accepted before thee, and pray for us unto the LORD thy God,
even for all this remnant; (for we are left
but a few of many, as thine eyes do behold us:)
original_text:
And said unto Jeremiah the prophet, Let, we beseech thee, our supplication be accepted before thee, and pray for us unto the LORD thy God,
even for all this remnant; (for we are left
but a few of many, as thine eyes do behold us:)

translated_text: That the LORD thy God may shew us the way wherein we may walk, and the thing that we may do.
original_text: That the LORD thy God may shew us the way wherein we may walk, and the thing that we may do.

translated_text:
Then Jeremiah the prophet said unto them, I have heard
you;
 behold, I will pray unto the LORD your God according to your words; and it shall come to pass,
that whatsoever thing the LORD shall answer you, I will declare
it unto you; I will keep nothing back from you.
original_text:
Then Jeremiah the prophet said unto them, I have heard
you;
 behold, I will pray unto the LORD your God according to your words; and it shall come to pass,
that whatsoever thing the LORD shall answer you, I will declare
it unto you; I will keep nothing back from you.

translated_text: Then they said to Jeremiah, The LORD be a true and faithful witness between us, if we do not even according to all things for the which the LORD thy God shall send thee to us.
original_text: Then they said to Jeremiah, The LORD be a true and faithful witness between us, if we do not even according to all things for the which the LORD thy God shall send thee to us.

translated_text:
Whether
it be good, or whether
it be evil, we will obey the voice of the LORD our God, to whom we send thee; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of the LORD our God.
original_text:
Whether
it be good, or whether
it be evil, we will obey the voice of the LORD our God, to whom we send thee; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of the LORD our God.

translated_text: And it came to pass after ten days, that the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah.
original_text: And it came to pass after ten days, that the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah.

translated_text:
Then called he Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces which
were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,
original_text:
Then called he Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces which
were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,

translated_text: And said unto them, Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, unto whom ye sent me to present your supplication before him;
original_text: And said unto them, Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, unto whom ye sent me to present your supplication before him;

translated_text:
If ye will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull
you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck
you up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.
original_text:
If ye will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull
you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck
you up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.

translated_text:
Be not afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom ye are afraid; be not afraid of him, saith the LORD: for I
am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.
original_text:
Be not afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom ye are afraid; be not afraid of him, saith the LORD: for I
am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.

translated_text: And I will shew mercies unto you, that he may have mercy upon you, and cause you to return to your own land.
original_text: And I will shew mercies unto you, that he may have mercy upon you, and cause you to return to your own land.

translated_text: But if ye say, We will not dwell in this land, neither obey the voice of the LORD your God,
original_text: But if ye say, We will not dwell in this land, neither obey the voice of the LORD your God,

translated_text: Saying, No; but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there will we dwell:
original_text: Saying, No; but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there will we dwell:

translated_text: And now therefore hear the word of the LORD, ye remnant of Judah; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; If ye wholly set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to sojourn there;
original_text: And now therefore hear the word of the LORD, ye remnant of Judah; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; If ye wholly set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to sojourn there;

translated_text:
Then it shall come to pass,
that the sword, which ye feared, shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt, and the famine, whereof ye were afraid, shall follow close after you there in Egypt; and there ye shall die.
original_text:
Then it shall come to pass,
that the sword, which ye feared, shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt, and the famine, whereof ye were afraid, shall follow close after you there in Egypt; and there ye shall die.

translated_text: So shall it be with all the men that set their faces to go into Egypt to sojourn there; they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: and none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring upon them.
original_text: So shall it be with all the men that set their faces to go into Egypt to sojourn there; they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: and none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring upon them.

translated_text: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As mine anger and my fury hath been poured forth upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem; so shall my fury be poured forth upon you, when ye shall enter into Egypt: and ye shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach; and ye shall see this place no more.
original_text: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As mine anger and my fury hath been poured forth upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem; so shall my fury be poured forth upon you, when ye shall enter into Egypt: and ye shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach; and ye shall see this place no more.

translated_text: The LORD hath said concerning you, O ye remnant of Judah; Go ye not into Egypt: know certainly that I have admonished you this day.
original_text: The LORD hath said concerning you, O ye remnant of Judah; Go ye not into Egypt: know certainly that I have admonished you this day.

translated_text:
For ye dissembled in your hearts, when ye sent me unto the LORD your God, saying, Pray for us unto the LORD our God; and according unto all that the LORD our God shall say, so declare unto us, and we will do
it.
original_text:
For ye dissembled in your hearts, when ye sent me unto the LORD your God, saying, Pray for us unto the LORD our God; and according unto all that the LORD our God shall say, so declare unto us, and we will do
it.

translated_text:
And
now I have this day declared
it to you; but ye have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God, nor any
thing for the which he hath sent me unto you.
original_text:
And
now I have this day declared
it to you; but ye have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God, nor any
thing for the which he hath sent me unto you.

translated_text:
Now therefore know certainly that ye shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, in the place whither ye desire to go
and to sojourn.
original_text:
Now therefore know certainly that ye shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, in the place whither ye desire to go
and to sojourn.

translated_text:
Now it came to pass in the seventh month,
that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, and the princes of the king, even ten men with him, came unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they did eat bread together in Mizpah.
original_text:
Now it came to pass in the seventh month,
that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, and the princes of the king, even ten men with him, came unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they did eat bread together in Mizpah.

translated_text: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten men that were with him, and smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and slew him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.
original_text: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten men that were with him, and smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and slew him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.

translated_text:
Ishmael also slew all the Jews that were with him,
even with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans that were found there,
and
 the men of war.
original_text:
Ishmael also slew all the Jews that were with him,
even with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans that were found there,
and
 the men of war.

translated_text:
And it came to pass the second day after he had slain Gedaliah, and no man knew
it,
original_text:
And it came to pass the second day after he had slain Gedaliah, and no man knew
it,

translated_text:
That there came certain from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria,
even fourscore men, having their beards shaven, and their clothes rent, and having cut themselves, with offerings and incense in their hand, to bring
them to the house of the LORD.
original_text:
That there came certain from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria,
even fourscore men, having their beards shaven, and their clothes rent, and having cut themselves, with offerings and incense in their hand, to bring
them to the house of the LORD.

translated_text: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it came to pass, as he met them, he said unto them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.
original_text: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it came to pass, as he met them, he said unto them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.

translated_text:
And it was
so, when they came into the midst of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah slew them,
and cast them into the midst of the pit, he, and the men that
were with him.
original_text:
And it was
so, when they came into the midst of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah slew them,
and cast them into the midst of the pit, he, and the men that
were with him.

translated_text: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.
original_text: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.

translated_text:
Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men, whom he had slain because of Gedaliah,
was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel:
and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with
them that were slain.
original_text:
Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men, whom he had slain because of Gedaliah,
was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel:
and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with
them that were slain.

translated_text:
Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that
were in Mizpah,
even the king’s daughters, and all the people that remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the Ammonites.
original_text:
Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that
were in Mizpah,
even the king’s daughters, and all the people that remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the Ammonites.

translated_text:
But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that
were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,
original_text:
But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that
were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,

translated_text:
Then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that
are in Gibeon.
original_text:
Then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that
are in Gibeon.

translated_text:
Now it came to pass,
that when all the people which
were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that
were with him, then they were glad.
original_text:
Now it came to pass,
that when all the people which
were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that
were with him, then they were glad.

translated_text: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned, and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah.
original_text: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned, and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah.

translated_text: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the Ammonites.
original_text: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the Ammonites.

translated_text:
Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that
were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after
that
 he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam,
even mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon:
original_text:
Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that
were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after
that
 he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam,
even mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon:

translated_text: And they departed, and dwelt in the habitation of Chimham, which is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt,
original_text: And they departed, and dwelt in the habitation of Chimham, which is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt,

translated_text: Because of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land.
original_text: Because of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land.

translated_text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, after that Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah, which were carried away captive unto Babylon.
original_text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, after that Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah, which were carried away captive unto Babylon.

translated_text: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said unto him, The LORD thy God hath pronounced this evil upon this place.
original_text: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said unto him, The LORD thy God hath pronounced this evil upon this place.

translated_text:
Now the LORD hath brought
it, and done according as he hath said: because ye have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing is come upon you.
original_text:
Now the LORD hath brought
it, and done according as he hath said: because ye have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing is come upon you.

translated_text:
And now, behold, I loose thee this day from the chains which
were
 upon thine hand. If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon, come; and I will look well unto thee: but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon, forbear: behold, all the land
is before thee: whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go, thither go.
original_text:
And now, behold, I loose thee this day from the chains which
were
 upon thine hand. If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon, come; and I will look well unto thee: but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon, forbear: behold, all the land
is before thee: whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go, thither go.

translated_text:
Now while he was not yet gone back,
he said, Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people: or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto thee to go. So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward, and let him go.
original_text:
Now while he was not yet gone back,
he said, Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people: or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto thee to go. So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward, and let him go.

translated_text: Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land.
original_text: Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land.

translated_text: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
original_text: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

translated_text: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men, saying, Fear not to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.
original_text: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men, saying, Fear not to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.

translated_text:
As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans, which will come unto us: but ye, gather ye wine, and summer fruits, and oil, and put
them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that ye have taken.
original_text:
As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans, which will come unto us: but ye, gather ye wine, and summer fruits, and oil, and put
them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that ye have taken.

translated_text: Even all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, unto Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.
original_text: Even all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, unto Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.

translated_text:
Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that
were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,
original_text:
Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that
were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,

translated_text: And said unto him, Dost thou certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not.
original_text: And said unto him, Dost thou certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not.

translated_text:
Then Johanan the son of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Let me go, I pray thee, and I will slay Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man shall know
it: wherefore should he slay thee, that all the Jews which are gathered unto thee should be scattered, and the remnant in Judah perish?
original_text:
Then Johanan the son of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Let me go, I pray thee, and I will slay Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man shall know
it: wherefore should he slay thee, that all the Jews which are gathered unto thee should be scattered, and the remnant in Judah perish?

translated_text: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto Johanan the son of Kareah, Thou shalt not do this thing: for thou speakest falsely of Ishmael.
original_text: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto Johanan the son of Kareah, Thou shalt not do this thing: for thou speakest falsely of Ishmael.

translated_text:
How is the gold become dim!
how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.
original_text:
How is the gold become dim!
how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.

translated_text: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
original_text: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

translated_text:
Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people
is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
original_text:
Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people
is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

translated_text:
The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread,
and no man breaketh
it unto them.
original_text:
The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread,
and no man breaketh
it unto them.

translated_text: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
original_text: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

translated_text: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.
original_text: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.

translated_text:
Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing
was of sapphire:
original_text:
Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing
was of sapphire:

translated_text: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.
original_text: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.

translated_text:
They that be slain with the sword are better than
they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for
want of the fruits of the field.
original_text:
They that be slain with the sword are better than
they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for
want of the fruits of the field.

translated_text: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
original_text: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

translated_text: The LORD hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.
original_text: The LORD hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.

translated_text: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.
original_text: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.

translated_text:
For the sins of her prophets,
and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,
original_text:
For the sins of her prophets,
and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,

translated_text:
They have wandered
as blind
men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.
original_text:
They have wandered
as blind
men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.

translated_text: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.
original_text: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.

translated_text:
As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation
that could not save
us.
original_text:
As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation
that could not save
us.

translated_text: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.
original_text: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.

translated_text: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
original_text: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.

translated_text: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.
original_text: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.

translated_text: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.
original_text: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.

translated_text: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.
original_text: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.

translated_text: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
original_text: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.

translated_text: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
original_text: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.

translated_text:
We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers
are as widows.
original_text:
We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers
are as widows.

translated_text: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.
original_text: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.

translated_text:
Our necks
are under persecution: we labour,
and
 have no rest.
original_text:
Our necks
are under persecution: we labour,
and
 have no rest.

translated_text:
We have given the hand
to the Egyptians,
and to
 the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
original_text:
We have given the hand
to the Egyptians,
and to
 the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

translated_text:
Our fathers have sinned,
and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.
original_text:
Our fathers have sinned,
and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.

translated_text:
Servants have ruled over us:
there is none that doth deliver
us out of their hand.
original_text:
Servants have ruled over us:
there is none that doth deliver
us out of their hand.

translated_text:
We gat our bread with
the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
original_text:
We gat our bread with
the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.

translated_text: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
original_text: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.

translated_text:
They ravished the women in Zion,
and the maids in the cities of Judah.
original_text:
They ravished the women in Zion,
and the maids in the cities of Judah.

translated_text: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.
original_text: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.

translated_text: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
original_text: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.

translated_text: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.
original_text: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.

translated_text: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
original_text: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.

translated_text:
The crown is fallen
from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!
original_text:
The crown is fallen
from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!

translated_text:
For this our heart is faint; for these
things our eyes are dim.
original_text:
For this our heart is faint; for these
things our eyes are dim.

translated_text: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.
original_text: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.

translated_text: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
original_text: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.

translated_text:
Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever,
and forsake us so long time?
original_text:
Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever,
and forsake us so long time?

translated_text: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
original_text: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.

translated_text: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.
original_text: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.

translated_text:
How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger,
and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!
original_text:
How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger,
and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!

translated_text:
The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought
them down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.
original_text:
The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought
them down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.

translated_text:
He hath cut off in
his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire,
which devoureth round about.
original_text:
He hath cut off in
his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire,
which devoureth round about.

translated_text:
He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all
that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.
original_text:
He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all
that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.

translated_text: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.
original_text: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.

translated_text:
And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as
if it were of
 a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the LORD hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.
original_text:
And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as
if it were of
 a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the LORD hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.

translated_text: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the LORD, as in the day of a solemn feast.
original_text: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the LORD, as in the day of a solemn feast.

translated_text: The LORD hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.
original_text: The LORD hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.

translated_text:
Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes
are among the Gentiles: the law
is no
more; her prophets also find no vision from the LORD.
original_text:
Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes
are among the Gentiles: the law
is no
more; her prophets also find no vision from the LORD.

translated_text:
The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground,
and
 keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
original_text:
The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground,
and
 keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

translated_text: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.
original_text: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.

translated_text:
They say to their mothers, Where
is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers’ bosom.
original_text:
They say to their mothers, Where
is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers’ bosom.

translated_text: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?
original_text: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?

translated_text: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.
original_text: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.

translated_text:
All that pass by clap
their hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem,
saying, Is this the city that
men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?
original_text:
All that pass by clap
their hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem,
saying, Is this the city that
men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?

translated_text:
All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed
her up: certainly this
is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen
it.
original_text:
All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed
her up: certainly this
is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen
it.

translated_text:
The LORD hath done
that which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused
thine enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.
original_text:
The LORD hath done
that which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused
thine enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.

translated_text: Their heart cried unto the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.
original_text: Their heart cried unto the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.

translated_text: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.
original_text: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.

translated_text:
Behold, O LORD, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit,
and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?
original_text:
Behold, O LORD, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit,
and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?

translated_text:
The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain
them in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed,
and not pitied.
original_text:
The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain
them in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed,
and not pitied.

translated_text: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the LORD’S anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.
original_text: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the LORD’S anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.

translated_text:
I
am the man
that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
original_text:
I
am the man
that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

translated_text:
He hath led me, and brought
me into darkness, but not
into light.
original_text:
He hath led me, and brought
me into darkness, but not
into light.

translated_text:
Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand
against me
 all the day.
original_text:
Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand
against me
 all the day.

translated_text: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
original_text: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

translated_text:
He hath builded against me, and compassed
me with gall and travail.
original_text:
He hath builded against me, and compassed
me with gall and travail.

translated_text:
He hath set me in dark places, as
they that be dead of old.
original_text:
He hath set me in dark places, as
they that be dead of old.

translated_text: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
original_text: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.

translated_text: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
original_text: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.

translated_text: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
original_text: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.

translated_text:
He
was unto me
as a bear lying in wait,
and as
 a lion in secret places.
original_text:
He
was unto me
as a bear lying in wait,
and as
 a lion in secret places.

translated_text: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
original_text: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.

translated_text: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
original_text: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

translated_text: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
original_text: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.

translated_text:
I was a derision to all my people;
and their song all the day.
original_text:
I was a derision to all my people;
and their song all the day.

translated_text: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
original_text: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.

translated_text: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
original_text: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.

translated_text: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
original_text: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.

translated_text: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:
original_text: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:

translated_text: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
original_text: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

translated_text:
My soul hath
them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
original_text:
My soul hath
them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.

translated_text: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
original_text: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.

translated_text: It is of the LORD’S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
original_text: It is of the LORD’S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

translated_text:
They are new every morning: great
is thy faithfulness.
original_text:
They are new every morning: great
is thy faithfulness.

translated_text:
The LORD
is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
original_text:
The LORD
is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

translated_text:
The LORD
is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul
that seeketh him.
original_text:
The LORD
is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul
that seeketh him.

translated_text:
It is good that
a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
original_text:
It is good that
a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.

translated_text: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
original_text: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

translated_text: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.
original_text: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.

translated_text: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
original_text: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.

translated_text:
He giveth
his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
original_text:
He giveth
his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.

translated_text: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:
original_text: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:

translated_text: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
original_text: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.

translated_text: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
original_text: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.

translated_text: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
original_text: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

translated_text: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
original_text: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,

translated_text: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.
original_text: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.

translated_text:
Who
is he
that saith, and it cometh to pass,
when the Lord commandeth
it not?
original_text:
Who
is he
that saith, and it cometh to pass,
when the Lord commandeth
it not?

translated_text: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
original_text: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?

translated_text: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
original_text: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

translated_text: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
original_text: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.

translated_text:
Let us lift up our heart with
our hands unto God in the heavens.
original_text:
Let us lift up our heart with
our hands unto God in the heavens.

translated_text: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
original_text: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.

translated_text: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
original_text: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

translated_text:
Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that
our prayer should not pass through.
original_text:
Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that
our prayer should not pass through.

translated_text:
Thou hast made us
as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
original_text:
Thou hast made us
as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.

translated_text: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
original_text: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

translated_text: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
original_text: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.

translated_text: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
original_text: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

translated_text: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,
original_text: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

translated_text: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
original_text: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.

translated_text: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.
original_text: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.

translated_text: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
original_text: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.

translated_text: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
original_text: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.

translated_text:
Waters flowed over mine head;
then I said, I am cut off.
original_text:
Waters flowed over mine head;
then I said, I am cut off.

translated_text: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.
original_text: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.

translated_text: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
original_text: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

translated_text:
Thou drewest near in the day
that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
original_text:
Thou drewest near in the day
that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.

translated_text: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
original_text: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

translated_text: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
original_text: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.

translated_text:
Thou hast seen all their vengeance
and all their imaginations against me.
original_text:
Thou hast seen all their vengeance
and all their imaginations against me.

translated_text:
Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD,
and all their imaginations against me;
original_text:
Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD,
and all their imaginations against me;

translated_text: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
original_text: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

translated_text:
Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I
am their musick.
original_text:
Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I
am their musick.

translated_text: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
original_text: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.

translated_text: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.
original_text: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.

translated_text: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
original_text: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.

translated_text:
How doth the city sit solitary,
that was full of people
how is she become as a widow she
that was great among the nations,
and princess among the provinces,
how is she become tributary
original_text:
How doth the city sit solitary,
that was full of people
how is she become as a widow she
that was great among the nations,
and princess among the provinces,
how is she become tributary

translated_text:
She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears
are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort
her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.
original_text:
She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears
are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort
her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.

translated_text: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.
original_text: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.

translated_text:
The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she
is in bitterness.
original_text:
The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she
is in bitterness.

translated_text: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the LORD hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.
original_text: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the LORD hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.

translated_text:
And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts
that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
original_text:
And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts
that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.

translated_text:
Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her,
and did mock at her sabbaths.
original_text:
Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her,
and did mock at her sabbaths.

translated_text: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.
original_text: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.

translated_text:
Her filthiness
is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O LORD, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified
himself.
original_text:
Her filthiness
is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O LORD, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified
himself.

translated_text:
The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen
that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command
that they should not enter into thy congregation.
original_text:
The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen
that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command
that they should not enter into thy congregation.

translated_text: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O LORD, and consider; for I am become vile.
original_text: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O LORD, and consider; for I am become vile.

translated_text:
Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted
me in the day of his fierce anger.
original_text:
Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted
me in the day of his fierce anger.

translated_text:
From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate
and faint all the day.
original_text:
From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate
and faint all the day.

translated_text:
The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed,
and come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the Lord hath delivered me into
their hands,
from whom I am not able to rise up.
original_text:
The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed,
and come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the Lord hath delivered me into
their hands,
from whom I am not able to rise up.

translated_text:
The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty
men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah,
as in a winepress.
original_text:
The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty
men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah,
as in a winepress.

translated_text:
For these
things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.
original_text:
For these
things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.

translated_text:
Zion spreadeth forth her hands,
and there is none to comfort her: the LORD hath commanded concerning Jacob,
that his adversaries
should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.
original_text:
Zion spreadeth forth her hands,
and there is none to comfort her: the LORD hath commanded concerning Jacob,
that his adversaries
should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.

translated_text: The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
original_text: The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.

translated_text:
I called for my lovers,
but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.
original_text:
I called for my lovers,
but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.

translated_text:
Behold, O LORD; for I
am in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home
there is as death.
original_text:
Behold, O LORD; for I
am in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home
there is as death.

translated_text:
They have heard that I sigh:
there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done
it: thou wilt bring the day
that thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.
original_text:
They have heard that I sigh:
there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done
it: thou wilt bring the day
that thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.

translated_text:
Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs
are many, and my heart
is faint.
original_text:
Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs
are many, and my heart
is faint.

translated_text:
Therefore, thou son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I
am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:
original_text:
Therefore, thou son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I
am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

translated_text: And I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part of thee, and will cause thee to come up from the north parts, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel:
original_text: And I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part of thee, and will cause thee to come up from the north parts, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel:

translated_text: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.
original_text: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.

translated_text:
Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy bands, and the people that
is with thee: I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and
to the beasts of the field to be devoured.
original_text:
Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy bands, and the people that
is with thee: I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and
to the beasts of the field to be devoured.

translated_text:
Thou shalt fall upon the open field: for I have spoken
it,
 saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
Thou shalt fall upon the open field: for I have spoken
it,
 saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles: and they shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles: and they shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel; and I will not
let them pollute my holy name any more: and the heathen shall know that I
am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
original_text:
So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel; and I will not
let them pollute my holy name any more: and the heathen shall know that I
am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.

translated_text:
Behold, it is come, and it is done, saith the Lord GOD; this
is
 the day whereof I have spoken.
original_text:
Behold, it is come, and it is done, saith the Lord GOD; this
is
 the day whereof I have spoken.

translated_text: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves, and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years:
original_text: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves, and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years:

translated_text:
So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down
any out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down
any out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel, the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the
noses of the passengers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call
it The valley of Hamon-gog.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel, the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the
noses of the passengers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call
it The valley of Hamon-gog.

translated_text: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them, that they may cleanse the land.
original_text: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them, that they may cleanse the land.

translated_text:
Yea, all the people of the land shall bury
them; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
Yea, all the people of the land shall bury
them; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: And they shall sever out men of continual employment, passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.
original_text: And they shall sever out men of continual employment, passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.

translated_text:
And the passengers
that pass through the land, when
any seeth a man’s bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon-gog.
original_text:
And the passengers
that pass through the land, when
any seeth a man’s bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon-gog.

translated_text:
And also the name of the city
shall be Hamonah. Thus shall they cleanse the land.
original_text:
And also the name of the city
shall be Hamonah. Thus shall they cleanse the land.

translated_text:
And, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD; Speak unto every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you,
even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh, and drink blood.
original_text:
And, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD; Speak unto every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you,
even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh, and drink blood.

translated_text: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.
original_text: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

translated_text: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
original_text: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

translated_text: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: And I will set my glory among the heathen, and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.
original_text: And I will set my glory among the heathen, and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.

translated_text:
So the house of Israel shall know that I
am the LORD their God from that day and forward.
original_text:
So the house of Israel shall know that I
am the LORD their God from that day and forward.

translated_text: And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity: because they trespassed against me, therefore hid I my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies: so fell they all by the sword.
original_text: And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity: because they trespassed against me, therefore hid I my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies: so fell they all by the sword.

translated_text: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them, and hid my face from them.
original_text: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them, and hid my face from them.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for my holy name;
original_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for my holy name;

translated_text:
After that they have borne their shame, and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me, when they dwelt safely in their land, and none made
them afraid.
original_text:
After that they have borne their shame, and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me, when they dwelt safely in their land, and none made
them afraid.

translated_text: When I have brought them again from the people, and gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;
original_text: When I have brought them again from the people, and gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;

translated_text:
Then shall they know that I
am the LORD their God, which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen: but I have gathered them unto their own land, and have left none of them any more there.
original_text:
Then shall they know that I
am the LORD their God, which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen: but I have gathered them unto their own land, and have left none of them any more there.

translated_text: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
original_text: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Howl ye, Woe worth the day
original_text: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Howl ye, Woe worth the day

translated_text:
For the day
