is near, even the day of the LORD
is
 near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.
original_text:
For the day
is near, even the day of the LORD
is
 near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.

translated_text: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.
original_text: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.

translated_text: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.
original_text: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries
that are
 desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities
that are wasted.
original_text:
And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries
that are
 desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities
that are wasted.

translated_text:
And they shall know that I
am the LORD, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and
when all her helpers shall be destroyed.
original_text:
And they shall know that I
am the LORD, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and
when all her helpers shall be destroyed.

translated_text: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it cometh.
original_text: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it cometh.

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.

translated_text: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.
original_text: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.

translated_text:
And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I the LORD have spoken
it.
original_text:
And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I the LORD have spoken
it.

translated_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause
their images to cease out of Noph; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.
original_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause
their images to cease out of Noph; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

translated_text: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.
original_text: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.

translated_text: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.
original_text: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.

translated_text:
And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Noph
shall have distresses daily.
original_text:
And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Noph
shall have distresses daily.

translated_text:
The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword: and these
cities shall go into captivity.
original_text:
The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword: and these
cities shall go into captivity.

translated_text: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt: and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.
original_text: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt: and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.

translated_text:
Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt: and they shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt: and they shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first
month,
 in the seventh
day of the month,
that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text:
And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first
month,
 in the seventh
day of the month,
that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.
original_text: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I
am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I
am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

translated_text: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
original_text: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

translated_text:
And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break Pharaoh’s arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded
man.
original_text:
And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break Pharaoh’s arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded
man.

translated_text:
But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I
am the LORD, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.
original_text:
But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I
am the LORD, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them among the countries; and they shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them among the countries; and they shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
The hand of the LORD was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the LORD, and set me down in the midst of the valley which
was full of bones,
original_text:
The hand of the LORD was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the LORD, and set me down in the midst of the valley which
was full of bones,

translated_text:
And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold,
there were
 very many in the open valley; and, lo,
they were very dry.
original_text:
And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold,
there were
 very many in the open valley; and, lo,
they were very dry.

translated_text: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.
original_text: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.

translated_text: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.
original_text: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:

translated_text:
And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.
original_text: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.

translated_text:
And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but
there was
no breath in them.
original_text:
And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but
there was
no breath in them.

translated_text: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.
original_text: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.

translated_text: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
original_text: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.

translated_text: Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.
original_text: Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.

translated_text: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.
original_text: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.

translated_text:
And ye shall know that I
am the LORD, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,
original_text:
And ye shall know that I
am the LORD, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,

translated_text:
And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the LORD have spoken
it,
 and performed
it, saith the LORD.
original_text:
And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the LORD have spoken
it,
 and performed
it, saith the LORD.

translated_text: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
original_text: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Moreover, thou son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and
for all the house of Israel his companions:
original_text:
Moreover, thou son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and
for all the house of Israel his companions:

translated_text: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.
original_text: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.

translated_text:
And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew us what thou
meanest by these?
original_text:
And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew us what thou
meanest by these?

translated_text:
Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which
is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him,
even with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.
original_text:
Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which
is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him,
even with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.

translated_text: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.
original_text: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.

translated_text: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:
original_text: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

translated_text: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:
original_text: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

translated_text: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.
original_text: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.

translated_text:
And David my servant
shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.
original_text:
And David my servant
shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.

translated_text:
And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein,
even they, and their children, and their children’s children for ever: and my servant David
shall be their prince for ever.
original_text:
And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein,
even they, and their children, and their children’s children for ever: and my servant David
shall be their prince for ever.

translated_text: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.
original_text: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.

translated_text: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
original_text: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

translated_text: And the heathen shall know that I the LORD do sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.
original_text: And the heathen shall know that I the LORD do sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
original_text: Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

translated_text:
And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold I
am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:
original_text:
And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold I
am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

translated_text:
And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts
of armour, even a great company
with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords:
original_text:
And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts
of armour, even a great company
with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords:

translated_text: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:
original_text: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:

translated_text:
Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands:
and many people with thee.
original_text:
Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands:
and many people with thee.

translated_text: Be thou prepared, and prepare for thyself, thou, and all thy company that are assembled unto thee, and be thou a guard unto them.
original_text: Be thou prepared, and prepare for thyself, thou, and all thy company that are assembled unto thee, and be thou a guard unto them.

translated_text:
After many days thou shalt be visited: in the latter years thou shalt come into the land
that is brought back from the sword,
and is
 gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Israel, which have been always waste: but it is brought forth out of the nations, and they shall dwell safely all of them.
original_text:
After many days thou shalt be visited: in the latter years thou shalt come into the land
that is brought back from the sword,
and is
 gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Israel, which have been always waste: but it is brought forth out of the nations, and they shall dwell safely all of them.

translated_text: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, and many people with thee.
original_text: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, and many people with thee.

translated_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; It shall also come to pass,
that
 at the same time shall things come into thy mind, and thou shalt think an evil thought:
original_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; It shall also come to pass,
that
 at the same time shall things come into thy mind, and thou shalt think an evil thought:

translated_text: And thou shalt say, I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,
original_text: And thou shalt say, I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,

translated_text:
To take a spoil, and to take a prey; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places
that are now inhabited, and upon the people
that are gathered out of the nations, which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the midst of the land.
original_text:
To take a spoil, and to take a prey; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places
that are now inhabited, and upon the people
that are gathered out of the nations, which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the midst of the land.

translated_text: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto thee, Art thou come to take a spoil? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?
original_text: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto thee, Art thou come to take a spoil? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?

translated_text:
Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say unto Gog, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely, shalt thou not know
it?
original_text:
Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say unto Gog, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely, shalt thou not know
it?

translated_text: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the north parts, thou, and many people with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great company, and a mighty army:
original_text: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the north parts, thou, and many people with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great company, and a mighty army:

translated_text: And thou shalt come up against my people of Israel, as a cloud to cover the land; it shall be in the latter days, and I will bring thee against my land, that the heathen may know me, when I shall be sanctified in thee, O Gog, before their eyes.
original_text: And thou shalt come up against my people of Israel, as a cloud to cover the land; it shall be in the latter days, and I will bring thee against my land, that the heathen may know me, when I shall be sanctified in thee, O Gog, before their eyes.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord GOD,
that my fury shall come up in my face.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord GOD,
that my fury shall come up in my face.

translated_text:
For in my jealousy
and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel;
original_text:
For in my jealousy
and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel;

translated_text:
So that the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, and all the men that
are upon the face of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.
original_text:
So that the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, and all the men that
are upon the face of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.

translated_text: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, saith the Lord GOD: every man’s sword shall be against his brother.
original_text: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, saith the Lord GOD: every man’s sword shall be against his brother.

translated_text:
And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many people that
are
 with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.
original_text:
And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many people that
are
 with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.

translated_text:
Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
original_text: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

translated_text:
And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O mount Seir, I
am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.
original_text:
And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O mount Seir, I
am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.

translated_text:
I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed
the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time
that their iniquity
had an end:
original_text:
Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed
the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time
that their iniquity
had an end:

translated_text:
Therefore,
as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.
original_text:
Therefore,
as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.

translated_text: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth.
original_text: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth.

translated_text:
And I will fill his mountains with his slain
men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.
original_text:
And I will fill his mountains with his slain
men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.

translated_text:
I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the LORD was there:
original_text: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the LORD was there:

translated_text: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.
original_text: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.

translated_text:
And thou shalt know that I
am the LORD,
and that
 I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.
original_text:
And thou shalt know that I
am the LORD,
and that
 I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.

translated_text:
Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard
them.
original_text:
Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard
them.

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.

translated_text:
As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea,
even all of it: and they shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea,
even all of it: and they shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: Also, thou son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD:
original_text: Also, thou son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD:

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:

translated_text:
Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they have made
you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and
are an infamy of the people:
original_text:
Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they have made
you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and
are an infamy of the people:

translated_text:
Therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that
are round about;
original_text:
Therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that
are round about;

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all
their
 heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all
their
 heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.

translated_text: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because ye have borne the shame of the heathen:
original_text: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because ye have borne the shame of the heathen:

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I have lifted up mine hand, Surely the heathen that
are about you, they shall bear their shame.
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I have lifted up mine hand, Surely the heathen that
are about you, they shall bear their shame.

translated_text: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are at hand to come.
original_text: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are at hand to come.

translated_text:
For, behold, I
am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown:
original_text:
For, behold, I
am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown:

translated_text:
And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel,
even
 all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:
original_text:
And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel,
even
 all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:

translated_text:
And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better
unto you than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better
unto you than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you,
even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them
of men.
original_text:
Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you,
even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them
of men.

translated_text: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
Neither will I cause
men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
Neither will I cause
men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.
original_text: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.

translated_text:
Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols
wherewith they had polluted it:
original_text:
Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols
wherewith they had polluted it:

translated_text: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.
original_text: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.

translated_text:
And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These
are the people of the LORD, and are gone forth out of his land.
original_text:
And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These
are the people of the LORD, and are gone forth out of his land.

translated_text: But I had pity for mine holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.
original_text: But I had pity for mine holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.

translated_text:
Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I do not
this for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for mine holy name’s sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.
original_text:
Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I do not
this for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for mine holy name’s sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.

translated_text:
And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I
am the LORD, saith the Lord GOD, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.
original_text:
And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I
am the LORD, saith the Lord GOD, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.

translated_text: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.
original_text: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.

translated_text: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
original_text: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.

translated_text: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
original_text: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

translated_text:
And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do
them.
original_text:
And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do
them.

translated_text: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
original_text: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

translated_text: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.
original_text: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.

translated_text: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.
original_text: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.

translated_text:
Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that
were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
original_text:
Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that
were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

translated_text:
Not for your sakes do I
this, saith the Lord GOD, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.
original_text:
Not for your sakes do I
this, saith the Lord GOD, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.

translated_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause
you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.
original_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause
you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.

translated_text: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.
original_text: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.

translated_text:
And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities
are become
 fenced,
and are inhabited.
original_text:
And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities
are become
 fenced,
and are inhabited.

translated_text:
Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the LORD build the ruined
places, and plant that that was desolate: I the LORD have spoken
it, and I will do
it.
original_text:
Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the LORD build the ruined
places, and plant that that was desolate: I the LORD have spoken
it, and I will do
it.

translated_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will yet
for this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do
it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.
original_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will yet
for this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do
it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.

translated_text:
As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man of their coasts, and set him for their watchman:
original_text: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man of their coasts, and set him for their watchman:

translated_text: If when he seeth the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;
original_text: If when he seeth the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;

translated_text: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning; if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.
original_text: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning; if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.

translated_text: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul.
original_text: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul.

translated_text:
But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come, and take
any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman’s hand.
original_text:
But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come, and take
any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman’s hand.

translated_text: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.
original_text: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.

translated_text:
When I say unto the wicked, O wicked
man, thou shalt surely die; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked
man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
original_text:
When I say unto the wicked, O wicked
man, thou shalt surely die; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked
man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

translated_text: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
original_text: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

translated_text:
Therefore, O thou son of man, speak unto the house of Israel; Thus ye speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins
be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?
original_text:
Therefore, O thou son of man, speak unto the house of Israel; Thus ye speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins
be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?

translated_text:
Say unto them,
As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
original_text:
Say unto them,
As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

translated_text:
Therefore, thou son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his
righteousness in the day that he sinneth.
original_text:
Therefore, thou son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his
righteousness in the day that he sinneth.

translated_text:
When I shall say to the righteous,
that he shall surely live; if he trust to his own righteousness, and commit iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he hath committed, he shall die for it.
original_text:
When I shall say to the righteous,
that he shall surely live; if he trust to his own righteousness, and commit iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he hath committed, he shall die for it.

translated_text: Again, when I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;
original_text: Again, when I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;

translated_text: If the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had robbed, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.
original_text: If the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had robbed, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.

translated_text: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.
original_text: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.

translated_text: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.
original_text: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.

translated_text: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die thereby.
original_text: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die thereby.

translated_text: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.
original_text: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.

translated_text: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O ye house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.
original_text: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O ye house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth
month, in the fifth
day of the month,
that
 one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.
original_text:
And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth
month, in the fifth
day of the month,
that
 one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.

translated_text: Now the hand of the LORD was upon me in the evening, afore he that was escaped came; and had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.
original_text: Now the hand of the LORD was upon me in the evening, afore he that was escaped came; and had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.

translated_text: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we
are
 many; the land is given us for inheritance.
original_text:
Son of man, they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we
are
 many; the land is given us for inheritance.

translated_text: Wherefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood: and shall ye possess the land?
original_text: Wherefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood: and shall ye possess the land?

translated_text: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbour’s wife: and shall ye possess the land?
original_text: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbour’s wife: and shall ye possess the land?

translated_text:
Say thou thus unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD;
As I live, surely they that
are in the wastes shall fall by the sword, and him that
is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.
original_text:
Say thou thus unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD;
As I live, surely they that
are in the wastes shall fall by the sword, and him that
is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.

translated_text: For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.
original_text: For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.

translated_text:
Then shall they know that I
am the LORD, when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.
original_text:
Then shall they know that I
am the LORD, when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.

translated_text: Also, thou son of man, the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the LORD.
original_text: Also, thou son of man, the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the LORD.

translated_text:
And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love,
but their heart goeth after their covetousness.
original_text:
And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love,
but their heart goeth after their covetousness.

translated_text:
And, lo, thou
art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.
original_text:
And, lo, thou
art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.

translated_text: And when this cometh to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.
original_text: And when this cometh to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto the shepherds; Woe
be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?
original_text:
Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto the shepherds; Woe
be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?

translated_text:
Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed:
but ye feed not the flock.
original_text:
Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed:
but ye feed not the flock.

translated_text:
The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up
that which was broken, neither have ye brought again that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have ye ruled them.
original_text:
The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up
that which was broken, neither have ye brought again that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have ye ruled them.

translated_text:
And they were scattered, because
there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.
original_text:
And they were scattered, because
there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.

translated_text:
My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek
after them.
original_text:
My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek
after them.

translated_text: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;
original_text: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;

translated_text:
As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because
there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;
original_text:
As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because
there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;

translated_text: Therefore, O ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;
original_text: Therefore, O ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;

translated_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I
am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.
original_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I
am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.

translated_text:
For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I,
even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.
original_text:
For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I,
even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.

translated_text:
As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep
that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
original_text:
As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep
that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

translated_text: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
original_text: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

translated_text:
I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and
in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.
original_text:
I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and
in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.

translated_text: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up
that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
original_text:
I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up
that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.

translated_text:
And
as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.
original_text:
And
as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.

translated_text: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?
original_text: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?

translated_text:
And
as for my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.
original_text:
And
as for my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD unto them; Behold, I,
even
 I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle.
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD unto them; Behold, I,
even
 I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle.

translated_text: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;
original_text: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;

translated_text: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.
original_text: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.

translated_text:
And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them,
even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.
original_text:
And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them,
even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.

translated_text:
And I the LORD will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them; I the LORD have spoken
it.
original_text:
And I the LORD will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them; I the LORD have spoken
it.

translated_text: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.
original_text: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.

translated_text: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.
original_text: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.

translated_text:
And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I
am the LORD, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them.
original_text:
And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I
am the LORD, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them.

translated_text:
And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make
them afraid.
original_text:
And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make
them afraid.

translated_text: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more.
original_text: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more.

translated_text:
Thus shall they know that I the LORD their God
am with them, and
that they,
even the house of Israel,
are
 my people, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
Thus shall they know that I the LORD their God
am with them, and
that they,
even the house of Israel,
are
 my people, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture,
are men,
and
 I
am your God, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture,
are men,
and
 I
am your God, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third
month,
 in the first
day of the month,
that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text:
And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third
month,
 in the first
day of the month,
that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom art thou like in thy greatness?
original_text: Son of man, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom art thou like in thy greatness?

translated_text:
Behold, the Assyrian
was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.
original_text:
Behold, the Assyrian
was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.

translated_text: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field.
original_text: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field.

translated_text: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.
original_text: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.

translated_text: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.
original_text: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.

translated_text: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.
original_text: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.

translated_text: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chesnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty.
original_text: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chesnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty.

translated_text:
I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that
were in the garden of God, envied him.
original_text:
I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that
were in the garden of God, envied him.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast lifted up thyself in height, and he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;
original_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast lifted up thyself in height, and he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;

translated_text: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.
original_text: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.

translated_text: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.
original_text: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.

translated_text: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:
original_text: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:

translated_text: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.
original_text: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed: and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed: and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

translated_text: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth.
original_text: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth.

translated_text:
They also went down into hell with him unto
them that be
 slain with the sword; and
they that were his arm,
that
 dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.
original_text:
They also went down into hell with him unto
them that be
 slain with the sword; and
they that were his arm,
that
 dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.

translated_text:
To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with
them that be slain by the sword. This
is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with
them that be slain by the sword. This
is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first
day of the month,
that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text:
And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first
day of the month,
that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou art like a young lion of the nations, and thou
art as a whale in the seas: and thou camest forth with thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.
original_text:
Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou art like a young lion of the nations, and thou
art as a whale in the seas: and thou camest forth with thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people; and they shall bring thee up in my net.
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people; and they shall bring thee up in my net.

translated_text: Then will I leave thee upon the land, I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee.
original_text: Then will I leave thee upon the land, I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee.

translated_text: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.
original_text: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.

translated_text:
I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest,
even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of thee.
original_text:
I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest,
even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of thee.

translated_text: And when I shall put thee out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.
original_text: And when I shall put thee out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.

translated_text: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.
original_text: I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.

translated_text:
Yea, I will make many people amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at
every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.
original_text:
Yea, I will make many people amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at
every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.

translated_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.
original_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.

translated_text: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall, the terrible of the nations, all of them: and they shall spoil the pomp of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.
original_text: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall, the terrible of the nations, all of them: and they shall spoil the pomp of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.

translated_text: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.
original_text: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.

translated_text: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate, and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate, and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
This
is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall lament her: they shall lament for her,
