even for Egypt, and for all her multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
This
is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall lament her: they shall lament for her,
even for Egypt, and for all her multitude, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month,
that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text:
It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month,
that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down,
even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.
original_text:
Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down,
even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.

translated_text: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.
original_text: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.

translated_text:
They shall fall in the midst of
them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword: draw her and all her multitudes.
original_text:
They shall fall in the midst of
them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword: draw her and all her multitudes.

translated_text: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.
original_text: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.

translated_text:
Asshur
is there and all her company: his graves
are
 about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword:
original_text:
Asshur
is there and all her company: his graves
are
 about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword:

translated_text: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which caused terror in the land of the living.
original_text: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which caused terror in the land of the living.

translated_text:
There
is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, which caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.
original_text:
There
is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, which caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.

translated_text:
They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude: her graves
are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword: though their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of
them that be slain.
original_text:
They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude: her graves
are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword: though their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of
them that be slain.

translated_text:
There
is Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude: her graves
are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.
original_text:
There
is Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude: her graves
are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.

translated_text:
And they shall not lie with the mighty
that are fallen of the uncircumcised, which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war: and they have laid their swords under their heads, but their iniquities shall be upon their bones, though
they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.
original_text:
And they shall not lie with the mighty
that are fallen of the uncircumcised, which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war: and they have laid their swords under their heads, but their iniquities shall be upon their bones, though
they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

translated_text:
Yea, thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with
them that are slain with the sword.
original_text:
Yea, thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with
them that are slain with the sword.

translated_text:
There
is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, which with their might are laid by
them that were slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.
original_text:
There
is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, which with their might are laid by
them that were slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.

translated_text:
There
be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with
them that be
 slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.
original_text:
There
be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with
them that be
 slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.

translated_text:
Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude,
even Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude,
even Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with
them that are slain with the sword,
even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with
them that are slain with the sword,
even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth
day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day the hand of the LORD was upon me, and brought me thither.
original_text:
In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth
day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day the hand of the LORD was upon me, and brought me thither.

translated_text:
In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me upon a very high mountain, by which
was as the frame of a city on the south.
original_text:
In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me upon a very high mountain, by which
was as the frame of a city on the south.

translated_text:
And he brought me thither, and, behold,
there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
original_text:
And he brought me thither, and, behold,
there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

translated_text:
And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for to the intent that I might shew
them unto thee
art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.
original_text:
And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for to the intent that I might shew
them unto thee
art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.

translated_text:
And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed of six cubits
long by the cubit and an hand breadth: so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.
original_text:
And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed of six cubits
long by the cubit and an hand breadth: so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

translated_text:
Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east, and went up the stairs thereof, and measured the threshold of the gate,
which was
 one reed broad; and the other threshold
of the gate, which was
 one reed broad.
original_text:
Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east, and went up the stairs thereof, and measured the threshold of the gate,
which was
 one reed broad; and the other threshold
of the gate, which was
 one reed broad.

translated_text:
And
every little chamber
was one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the little chambers
were five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within
was one reed.
original_text:
And
every little chamber
was one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the little chambers
were five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within
was one reed.

translated_text: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.
original_text: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.

translated_text:
Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate
was inward.
original_text:
Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate
was inward.

translated_text:
And the little chambers of the gate eastward
were three on this side, and three on that side; they three
were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.
original_text:
And the little chambers of the gate eastward
were three on this side, and three on that side; they three
were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.

translated_text:
And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits;
and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.
original_text:
And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits;
and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.

translated_text:
The space also before the little chambers
was one cubit
on this side, and the space
was one cubit on that side: and the little chambers
were six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
original_text:
The space also before the little chambers
was one cubit
on this side, and the space
was one cubit on that side: and the little chambers
were six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

translated_text:
He measured then the gate from the roof of
one little chamber to the roof of another: the breadth
was five and twenty cubits, door against door.
original_text:
He measured then the gate from the roof of
one little chamber to the roof of another: the breadth
was five and twenty cubits, door against door.

translated_text: He made also posts of threescore cubits, even unto the post of the court round about the gate.
original_text: He made also posts of threescore cubits, even unto the post of the court round about the gate.

translated_text:
And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate
were fifty cubits.
original_text:
And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate
were fifty cubits.

translated_text:
And
there were narrow windows to the little chambers, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches: and windows
were round about inward: and upon
each post
were palm trees.
original_text:
And
there were narrow windows to the little chambers, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches: and windows
were round about inward: and upon
each post
were palm trees.

translated_text:
Then brought he me into the outward court, and, lo,
there were
 chambers, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty chambers
were upon the pavement.
original_text:
Then brought he me into the outward court, and, lo,
there were
 chambers, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty chambers
were upon the pavement.

translated_text:
And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates
was the lower pavement.
original_text:
And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates
was the lower pavement.

translated_text: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, an hundred cubits eastward and northward.
original_text: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, an hundred cubits eastward and northward.

translated_text: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north, he measured the length thereof, and the breadth thereof.
original_text: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north, he measured the length thereof, and the breadth thereof.

translated_text:
And the little chambers thereof
were three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate: the length thereof
was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
original_text:
And the little chambers thereof
were three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate: the length thereof
was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

translated_text:
And their windows, and their arches, and their palm trees,
were
 after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof
were before them.
original_text:
And their windows, and their arches, and their palm trees,
were
 after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof
were before them.

translated_text:
And the gate of the inner court
was over against the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits.
original_text:
And the gate of the inner court
was over against the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits.

translated_text: After that he brought me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.
original_text: After that he brought me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.

translated_text:
And
there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length
was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
original_text:
And
there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length
was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

translated_text:
And
there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof
were before them: and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.
original_text:
And
there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof
were before them: and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.

translated_text:
And
there was a gate in the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits.
original_text:
And
there was a gate in the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits.

translated_text: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;
original_text: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;

translated_text:
And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and
there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about:
it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
original_text:
And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and
there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about:
it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

translated_text:
And the arches round about
were five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.
original_text:
And the arches round about
were five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.

translated_text:
And the arches thereof
were toward the utter court; and palm trees
were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it
had eight steps.
original_text:
And the arches thereof
were toward the utter court; and palm trees
were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it
had eight steps.

translated_text: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.
original_text: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.

translated_text:
And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof,
were according to these measures: and
there were
 windows therein and in the arches thereof round about:
it was
 fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
original_text:
And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof,
were according to these measures: and
there were
 windows therein and in the arches thereof round about:
it was
 fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

translated_text:
And the arches thereof
were toward the outward court; and palm trees
were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it
had eight steps.
original_text:
And the arches thereof
were toward the outward court; and palm trees
were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it
had eight steps.

translated_text:
And he brought me to the north gate, and measured
it according to these measures;
original_text:
And he brought me to the north gate, and measured
it according to these measures;

translated_text:
The little chambers thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, and the windows to it round about: the length
was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
original_text:
The little chambers thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, and the windows to it round about: the length
was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

translated_text:
And the posts thereof
were toward the utter court; and palm trees
were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it
had eight steps.
original_text:
And the posts thereof
were toward the utter court; and palm trees
were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it
had eight steps.

translated_text:
And the chambers and the entries thereof
were by the posts of the gates, where they washed the burnt offering.
original_text:
And the chambers and the entries thereof
were by the posts of the gates, where they washed the burnt offering.

translated_text:
And in the porch of the gate
were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.
original_text:
And in the porch of the gate
were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.

translated_text:
And at the side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate,
were two tables; and on the other side, which
was at the porch of the gate,
were two tables.
original_text:
And at the side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate,
were two tables; and on the other side, which
was at the porch of the gate,
were two tables.

translated_text:
Four tables
were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew
their sacrifices.
original_text:
Four tables
were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew
their sacrifices.

translated_text:
And the four tables
were of hewn stone for the burnt offering, of a cubit and an half long, and a cubit and an half broad, and one cubit high: whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
original_text:
And the four tables
were of hewn stone for the burnt offering, of a cubit and an half long, and a cubit and an half broad, and one cubit high: whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice.

translated_text:
And within
were hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables
was the flesh of the offering.
original_text:
And within
were hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables
was the flesh of the offering.

translated_text:
And without the inner gate
were the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which
was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect
was toward the south: one at the side of the east gate
having the prospect toward the north.
original_text:
And without the inner gate
were the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which
was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect
was toward the south: one at the side of the east gate
having the prospect toward the north.

translated_text:
And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect
is toward the south,
is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.
original_text:
And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect
is toward the south,
is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.

translated_text:
And the chamber whose prospect
is toward the north
is
 for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these
are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, which come near to the LORD to minister unto him.
original_text:
And the chamber whose prospect
is toward the north
is
 for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these
are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, which come near to the LORD to minister unto him.

translated_text:
So he measured the court, an hundred cubits long, and an hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar
that was before the house.
original_text:
So he measured the court, an hundred cubits long, and an hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar
that was before the house.

translated_text:
And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured
each
 post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate
was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.
original_text:
And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured
each
 post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate
was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.

translated_text:
The length of the porch
was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; and
he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it: and
there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.
original_text:
The length of the porch
was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; and
he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it: and
there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.

translated_text:
Afterward he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side,
which was
 the breadth of the tabernacle.
original_text:
Afterward he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side,
which was
 the breadth of the tabernacle.

translated_text:
And the breadth of the door
was ten cubits; and the sides of the door
were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits: and the breadth, twenty cubits.
original_text:
And the breadth of the door
was ten cubits; and the sides of the door
were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits: and the breadth, twenty cubits.

translated_text: Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.
original_text: Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.

translated_text:
So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This
is the most holy
place.
original_text:
So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This
is the most holy
place.

translated_text:
After he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of
every side chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.
original_text:
After he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of
every side chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.

translated_text:
And the side chambers
were three, one over another, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which
was of the house for the side chambers round about, that they might have hold, but they had not hold in the wall of the house.
original_text:
And the side chambers
were three, one over another, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which
was of the house for the side chambers round about, that they might have hold, but they had not hold in the wall of the house.

translated_text:
And
there was an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house
was still upward, and so increased
from the lowest
chamber to the highest by the midst.
original_text:

there was an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house

translated_text:
I saw also the height of the house round about: the foundations of the side chambers
were a full reed of six great cubits.
original_text:
I saw also the height of the house round about: the foundations of the side chambers
were a full reed of six great cubits.

translated_text:
The thickness of the wall, which
was for the side chamber without,
was five cubits: and
that which
was
 left

were
 within.
original_text:

was for the side chamber without,
was five cubits: and
that which
was
 left

 within.

translated_text:

original_text:
And between the chambers
was the wideness of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.

translated_text:
And the doors of the side chambers
were toward
the place that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south: and the breadth of the place that was left
was five cubits round about.
original_text:
And the doors of the side chambers
were toward
the place that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south: and the breadth of the place that was left
was five cubits round about.

translated_text:
Now the building that
was before the separate place at the end toward the west
was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building
was five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.
original_text:
Now the building that
was before the separate place at the end toward the west
was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building
was five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.

translated_text: So he measured the house, an hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, an hundred cubits long;
original_text: So he measured the house, an hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, an hundred cubits long;

translated_text: Also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, an hundred cubits.
original_text: Also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, an hundred cubits.

translated_text:
And he measured the length of the building over against the separate place which
was behind it, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, an hundred cubits, with the inner temple, and the porches of the court;
original_text:
And he measured the length of the building over against the separate place which
was behind it, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, an hundred cubits, with the inner temple, and the porches of the court;

translated_text:
The door posts, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the door, cieled with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows
were covered;
original_text:
The door posts, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the door, cieled with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows
were covered;

translated_text: To that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.
original_text: To that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.

translated_text:
And
it was made with cherubims and palm trees, so that a palm tree
was between a cherub and a cherub; and
every cherub had two faces;
original_text:

it was made with cherubims and palm trees, so that a palm tree
was between a cherub and a cherub; and
every cherub had two faces;

translated_text:

was toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side:
it was made through all the house round about.
original_text:
So that the face of a man
was toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side:

translated_text:

on the wall of the temple.
original_text:
From the ground unto above the door

on the wall of the temple.

translated_text:

were squared,

original_text:
The posts of the temple
were squared,
and the face of the sanctuary; the appearance
of the one as the appearance
of the other.

is
 the table that

 the table that

translated_text: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
original_text: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

door.
original_text:
And the doors had two leaves

translated_text:
And
there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as
were made upon the walls; and
there were thick planks upon the face of the porch without.
original_text:
And
there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as
were made upon the walls; and
there were thick planks upon the face of the porch without.

translated_text:
And
there were narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and
upon the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.
original_text:
And
there were narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and
upon the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.

translated_text:
Now these
are the names of the tribes. From the north end to the coast of the way of Hethlon, as one goeth to Hamath, Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus northward, to the coast of Hamath; for these are his sides east
and west; a
portion for Dan.
original_text:
Now these

portion for Dan.

translated_text:
And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a
portion for Asher.
original_text:
And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a
portion for Asher.

translated_text:
And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a
portion for Naphtali.
original_text:
And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a
portion for Naphtali.

translated_text:
And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, a
portion for Manasseh.
original_text:

portion for Manasseh.

translated_text:

portion for Ephraim.
original_text:

portion for Ephraim.

translated_text:

portion for Reuben.
original_text:

portion for Reuben.

translated_text:
And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a
portion for Judah.
original_text:
And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a
portion for Judah.

translated_text:
And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand
reeds in breadth, and
in length as one of the
other parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.
original_text:
And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand
reeds in breadth, and
in length as one of the
other parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.

translated_text:
The oblation that ye shall offer unto the LORD
shall be of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.
original_text:
The oblation that ye shall offer unto the LORD
shall be of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.

translated_text:
And for them,
even for the priests, shall be
this
 holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand
in length, and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the midst thereof.
original_text:
And for them,
even for the priests, shall be
this
 holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand
in length, and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the midst thereof.

translated_text: It shall be for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; which have kept my charge, which went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.
original_text: It shall be for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; which have kept my charge, which went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

translated_text:
And
this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.
original_text:
And
this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.

translated_text:
And over against the border of the priests the Levites
shall have
 five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length
shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.
original_text:
And over against the border of the priests the Levites
shall have
 five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length

translated_text:
And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for
it is holy unto the LORD.
original_text:
And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for
it is holy unto the LORD.

translated_text:
And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth over against the five and twenty thousand, shall be a profane
place for the city, for dwelling, and for suburbs: and the city shall be in the midst thereof.
original_text:
And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth over against the five and twenty thousand, shall be a profane
place for the city, for dwelling, and for suburbs: and the city shall be in the midst thereof.

translated_text:
And these
shall be the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
original_text:
And these
shall be the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.

translated_text: And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.
original_text: And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.

translated_text:
And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy
portion shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy
portion;
 and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.
original_text:
And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy
portion shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy
portion;
 and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.

translated_text: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.
original_text: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.

translated_text:
All the oblation
shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.
original_text:
All the oblation
shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.

translated_text:
And the residue
shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house
shall be in the midst thereof.
original_text:
And the residue
shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house
shall be in the midst thereof.

translated_text:
Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city,
being in the midst
of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.
original_text:
Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city,
being in the midst

shall have a
portion.

shall have a
portion.

shall have a
portion.

shall have a

portion.

portion.

portion.
original_text:

portion.

portion.
original_text:

unto the waters of strife

original_text:

unto the waters of strife
in Kadesh,
and to the river toward the great sea.

translated_text:
This
is the land which ye shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these
are their portions, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
This
is the land which ye shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these
are their portions, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:

are the goings out of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.
original_text:
And these
are the goings out of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.

translated_text:
And the gates of the city
shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.
original_text:
And the gates of the city
shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.

translated_text: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.
original_text: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.

translated_text: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.
original_text: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.

translated_text:
At the west side four thousand and five hundred,
with their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.
original_text:
At the west side four thousand and five hundred,
with their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.

translated_text:
It was round about eighteen thousand
measures:
 and the name of the city from
that day
shall be,
 The LORD
is there.
original_text:
It was round about eighteen thousand
measures:
 and the name of the city from
that day
shall be,
 The LORD
is there.

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

translated_text:
And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of
that
 gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.
original_text:
And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of
that
 gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

translated_text: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before the LORD in the sabbaths and in the new moons.
original_text: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before the LORD in the sabbaths and in the new moons.

translated_text:
And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer unto the LORD in the sabbath day
shall be six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.
original_text:
And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer unto the LORD in the sabbath day
shall be six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.

translated_text:
And the meat offering
shall be an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
original_text:
And the meat offering
shall be an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

translated_text:
And in the day of the new moon
it shall be a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.
original_text:
And in the day of the new moon
it shall be a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.

translated_text: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
original_text: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

translated_text:
And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of
that gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.
original_text:
And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of
that gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.

translated_text: But when the people of the land shall come before the LORD in the solemn feasts, he that entereth in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth over against it.
original_text: But when the people of the land shall come before the LORD in the solemn feasts, he that entereth in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth over against it.

translated_text: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.
original_text: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.

translated_text: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
original_text: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

translated_text:
Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily unto the LORD,
one shall then open him the gate that looketh toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth
one shall shut the gate.
original_text:
Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily unto the LORD,
one shall then open him the gate that looketh toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth
one shall shut the gate.

translated_text:
Thou shalt daily prepare a burnt offering unto the LORD
of
 a lamb of the first year without blemish: thou shalt prepare it every morning.
original_text:
Thou shalt daily prepare a burnt offering unto the LORD
of
 a lamb of the first year without blemish: thou shalt prepare it every morning.

translated_text: And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto the LORD.
original_text: And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto the LORD.

translated_text:
Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning
for a continual burnt offering.
original_text:
Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning
for a continual burnt offering.

translated_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, the inheritance thereof shall be his sons’; it
shall be their possession by inheritance.
original_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, the inheritance thereof shall be his sons’; it
shall be their possession by inheritance.

translated_text: But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons’ for them.
original_text: But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons’ for them.

translated_text:
Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession;
but he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.
original_text:
Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession;
but he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.

translated_text:
After he brought me through the entry, which
was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there
was a place on the two sides westward.
original_text:
After he brought me through the entry, which
was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there
was a place on the two sides westward.

translated_text:

them not out into the utter court, to sanctify the people.
original_text:
Then said he unto me, This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, where they shall bake the meat offering; that they bear

original_text:

there were courts joined of forty
cubits long and thirty broad: these four corners
were
 of one measure.
original_text:
In the four corners of the court
there were courts joined of forty
cubits long and thirty broad: these four corners
were
 of one measure.

translated_text:
And
there was a row
of building round about in them, round about them four, and
it was made with boiling places under the rows round about.
original_text:
And
there was a row
of building round about in them, round about them four, and
it was made with boiling places under the rows round about.

translated_text:
Then said he unto me, These
are the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.
original_text:
Then said he unto me, These
are the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.

translated_text:
Afterward he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house
stood toward the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south
side
 of the altar.
original_text:
Afterward he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house

 of the altar.

translated_text: Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looketh eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.
original_text: Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looketh eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.

translated_text:
And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters
were to the ancles.
original_text:
And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters
were to the ancles.

translated_text:
Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters
were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters
were to the loins.
original_text:
Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters
were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters
were to the loins.

translated_text:
Afterward he measured a thousand;
and it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.
original_text:
Afterward he measured a thousand;
and it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.

translated_text:
And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen
this? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.
original_text:
And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen
this? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.

translated_text:
Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river
were
 very many trees on the one side and on the other.
original_text:
Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river
were
 very many trees on the one side and on the other.

translated_text:
Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea:
which being brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.
original_text:
Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea:
which being brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that the fishers shall stand upon it from En-gedi even unto En-eglaim; they shall be a
place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that the fishers shall stand upon it from En-gedi even unto En-eglaim; they shall be a
place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.

translated_text: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.
original_text: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.

translated_text: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.
original_text: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.

translated_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; This
shall be the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph
shall have two portions.
original_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; This
shall be the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph
shall have two portions.

translated_text:
And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another:
concerning
 the which I lifted up mine hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.
original_text:
And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another:
concerning
 the which I lifted up mine hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.

translated_text:
And this
shall be the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;
original_text:
And this
shall be the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;

translated_text:
Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which
is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazar-hatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.
original_text:
Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which
is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazar-hatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.

translated_text:
And the border from the sea shall be Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And
this is
 the north side.
original_text:
And the border from the sea shall be Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And
this is
 the north side.

translated_text:
And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And
this is the east side.
original_text:
And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And
this is the east side.

translated_text:
And the south side southward, from Tamar
even to the waters of strife
in Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And
this is
 the south side southward.
original_text:
And the south side southward, from Tamar
even to the waters of strife
in Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And
this is
 the south side southward.

translated_text:
The west side also
shall be the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This
is the west side.
original_text:
The west side also
shall be the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This
is the west side.

translated_text: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.
original_text: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give
him his inheritance, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give
him his inheritance, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it
was shut.
original_text:
Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it
was shut.

translated_text: Then said the LORD unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the LORD, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.
original_text: Then said the LORD unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the LORD, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.

translated_text:
It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the LORD; he shall enter by the way of the porch of
that
 gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.
original_text:
It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the LORD; he shall enter by the way of the porch of
that
 gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.

translated_text: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD: and I fell upon my face.
original_text: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD: and I fell upon my face.

translated_text: And the LORD said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the LORD, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.
original_text: And the LORD said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the LORD, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.

translated_text:
And thou shalt say to the rebellious,
even to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,
original_text:
And thou shalt say to the rebellious,
even to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,

translated_text:
In that ye have brought
into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it,
even my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.
original_text:
In that ye have brought
into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it,
even my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.

translated_text: And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things: but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.
original_text: And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things: but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.

translated_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that
is among the children of Israel.
original_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that
is among the children of Israel.

translated_text: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.
original_text: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.

translated_text:
Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary,
having charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.
original_text:
Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary,
having charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.

translated_text: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up mine hand against them, saith the Lord GOD, and they shall bear their iniquity.
original_text: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up mine hand against them, saith the Lord GOD, and they shall bear their iniquity.

translated_text:
And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy
place:
 but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.
original_text:
And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy
place:
 but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.

translated_text: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.
original_text: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.

translated_text: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord GOD:
original_text: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord GOD:

translated_text: They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me, and they shall keep my charge.
original_text: They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me, and they shall keep my charge.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.

translated_text:
They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird
themselves with any thing that causeth sweat.
original_text:
They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird
themselves with any thing that causeth sweat.

translated_text:
And when they go forth into the utter court,
even into the utter court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.
original_text:
And when they go forth into the utter court,
even into the utter court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.

translated_text: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.
original_text: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.

translated_text: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.
original_text: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.

translated_text: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that had a priest before.
original_text: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that had a priest before.

translated_text:
And they shall teach my people
the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
original_text:
And they shall teach my people
the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

translated_text:
And in controversy they shall stand in judgment;
and they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.
original_text:
And in controversy they shall stand in judgment;
and they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.

translated_text: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that hath had no husband, they may defile themselves.
original_text: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that hath had no husband, they may defile themselves.

translated_text: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.
original_text: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.

translated_text: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary, unto the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary, unto the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I
am their inheritance: and ye shall give them no possession in Israel: I
am
 their possession.
original_text:
And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I
am their inheritance: and ye shall give them no possession in Israel: I
am
 their possession.

translated_text: They shall eat the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs.
original_text: They shall eat the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs.

translated_text:
And the first of all the firstfruits of all
things, and every oblation of all, of every
sort of your oblations, shall be the priest’s: ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house.
original_text:
And the first of all the firstfruits of all
things, and every oblation of all, of every
sort of your oblations, shall be the priest’s: ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house.

translated_text: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.
original_text: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.

translated_text:
Moreover, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall offer an oblation unto the LORD, an holy portion of the land: the length
shall be the length of five and twenty thousand
reeds,
 and the breadth
shall be ten thousand. This
shall be
 holy in all the borders thereof round about.
original_text:
Moreover, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall offer an oblation unto the LORD, an holy portion of the land: the length
shall be the length of five and twenty thousand
reeds,
 and the breadth
shall be ten thousand. This
shall be
 holy in all the borders thereof round about.

translated_text:
Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred
in length,
 with five hundred
in breadth, square round about; and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof.
original_text:
Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred
in length,
 with five hundred
in breadth, square round about; and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof.

translated_text:
And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary
and the most holy
place.
original_text:
And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary
and the most holy
place.

translated_text:
The holy
portion of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary, which shall come near to minister unto the LORD: and it shall be a place for their houses, and an holy place for the sanctuary.
original_text:
The holy
portion of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary, which shall come near to minister unto the LORD: and it shall be a place for their houses, and an holy place for the sanctuary.

translated_text: And the five and twenty thousand of length, and the ten thousand of breadth, shall also the Levites, the ministers of the house, have for themselves, for a possession for twenty chambers.
original_text: And the five and twenty thousand of length, and the ten thousand of breadth, shall also the Levites, the ministers of the house, have for themselves, for a possession for twenty chambers.

translated_text:
And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, over against the oblation of the holy
portion: it shall be for the whole house of Israel.
original_text:
And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, over against the oblation of the holy
portion: it shall be for the whole house of Israel.

translated_text:
And
a portion shall be for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy
portion, and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy
portion,
 and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length
shall be over against one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.
original_text:
And
a portion shall be for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy
portion, and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy
portion,
 and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length
shall be over against one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.

translated_text:
In the land shall be his possession in Israel: and my princes shall no more oppress my people; and
the rest of the land shall they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes.
original_text:
In the land shall be his possession in Israel: and my princes shall no more oppress my people; and
the rest of the land shall they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes.

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel: remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel: remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.
original_text: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.

translated_text: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.
original_text: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.

translated_text:
And the shekel
shall be twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.
original_text:
And the shekel
shall be twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.

translated_text:
This
is the oblation that ye shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:
original_text:
This
is the oblation that ye shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:

translated_text:
Concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil,
ye shall offer
 the tenth part of a bath out of the cor,
which is an homer of ten baths; for ten baths
are an homer:
original_text:
Concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil,
ye shall offer
 the tenth part of a bath out of the cor,
which is an homer of ten baths; for ten baths
are an homer:

translated_text: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Israel; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Israel; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.
original_text: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.

translated_text:
And it shall be the prince’s part
to give burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all solemnities of the house of Israel: he shall prepare the sin offering, and the meat offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make reconciliation for the house of Israel.
original_text:
And it shall be the prince’s part
