to give burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all solemnities of the house of Israel: he shall prepare the sin offering, and the meat offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make reconciliation for the house of Israel.

translated_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the first
month, in the first
day of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:
original_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the first
month, in the first
day of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:

translated_text:
And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put
it upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.
original_text:
And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put
it upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.

translated_text:
And so thou shalt do the seventh
day of the month for every one that erreth, and for
him that is simple: so shall ye reconcile the house.
original_text:
And so thou shalt do the seventh
day of the month for every one that erreth, and for
him that is simple: so shall ye reconcile the house.

translated_text:
In the first
month, in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
original_text:
In the first
month, in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

translated_text:
And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock
for a sin offering.
original_text:
And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock
for a sin offering.

translated_text:
And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily
for a sin offering.
original_text:
And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily
for a sin offering.

translated_text: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.
original_text: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.

translated_text:
In the seventh
month, in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do the like in the feast of the seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the meat offering, and according to the oil.
original_text:
In the seventh
month, in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do the like in the feast of the seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the meat offering, and according to the oil.

translated_text:
Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that
was over against the separate place, and which
was before the building toward the north.
original_text:
Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that
was over against the separate place, and which
was before the building toward the north.

translated_text:
Before the length of an hundred cubits
was the north door, and the breadth
was fifty cubits.
original_text:
Before the length of an hundred cubits
was the north door, and the breadth
was fifty cubits.

translated_text:
Over against the twenty
cubits which
were for the inner court, and over against the pavement which
was for the utter court,
was gallery against gallery in three
stories.
original_text:
Over against the twenty
cubits which
were for the inner court, and over against the pavement which
was for the utter court,
was gallery against gallery in three
stories.

translated_text:
And before the chambers
was a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.
original_text:
And before the chambers
was a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.

translated_text:
Now the upper chambers
were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.
original_text:
Now the upper chambers
were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.

translated_text:
For they
were in three
stories, but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore
the building was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.
original_text:
For they
were in three
stories, but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore
the building was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.

translated_text:
And the wall that
was without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof
was fifty cubits.
original_text:
And the wall that
was without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof
was fifty cubits.

translated_text:
For the length of the chambers that
were in the utter court
was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple
were an hundred cubits.
original_text:
For the length of the chambers that
were in the utter court
was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple
were an hundred cubits.

translated_text:
And from under these chambers
was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.
original_text:
And from under these chambers
was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.

translated_text:
The chambers
were in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.
original_text:
The chambers
were in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.

translated_text:
And the way before them
was like the appearance of the chambers which
were toward the north, as long as they,
and
 as broad as they: and all their goings out
were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.
original_text:
And the way before them
was like the appearance of the chambers which
were toward the north, as long as they,
and
 as broad as they: and all their goings out
were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.

translated_text:
And according to the doors of the chambers that
were toward the south
was a door in the head of the way,
even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.
original_text:
And according to the doors of the chambers that
were toward the south
was a door in the head of the way,
even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.

translated_text:
Then said he unto me, The north chambers
and the south chambers, which
are before the separate place, they
be
 holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the LORD shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place
is holy.
original_text:
Then said he unto me, The north chambers
and the south chambers, which
are before the separate place, they
be
 holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the LORD shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place
is holy.

translated_text:
When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy
place into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they
are holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to
those things which
are
 for the people.
original_text:
When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy
place into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they
are holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to
those things which
are
 for the people.

translated_text:
Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect
is toward the east, and measured it round about.
original_text:
Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect
is toward the east, and measured it round about.

translated_text: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
original_text: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

translated_text: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
original_text: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

translated_text: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.
original_text: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.

translated_text:
He turned about to the west side,
and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
original_text:
He turned about to the west side,
and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

translated_text:
He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred
reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.
original_text:
He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred
reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.

translated_text:
Afterward he brought me to the gate,
even the gate that looketh toward the east:
original_text:
Afterward he brought me to the gate,
even the gate that looketh toward the east:

translated_text:
And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice
was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.
original_text:
And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice
was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.

translated_text:
And
it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw,
even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city: and the visions
were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.
original_text:
And
it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw,
even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city: and the visions
were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.

translated_text:
And the glory of the LORD came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect
is toward the east.
original_text:
And the glory of the LORD came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect
is toward the east.

translated_text: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.
original_text: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.

translated_text:
And I heard
him speaking unto me out of the house; and the man stood by me.
original_text:
And I heard
him speaking unto me out of the house; and the man stood by me.

translated_text:
And he said unto me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile,
neither they, nor their kings, by their whoredom, nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places.
original_text:
And he said unto me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile,
neither they, nor their kings, by their whoredom, nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places.

translated_text: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger.
original_text: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger.

translated_text: Now let them put away their whoredom, and the carcases of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.
original_text: Now let them put away their whoredom, and the carcases of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.

translated_text: Thou son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.
original_text: Thou son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.

translated_text:
And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write
it
 in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.
original_text:
And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write
it
 in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.

translated_text:
This
is the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about
shall be most holy. Behold, this
is the law of the house.
original_text:
This
is the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about
shall be most holy. Behold, this
is the law of the house.

translated_text:
And these
are the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit
is a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom
shall be
 a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about
shall be a span: and this
shall be
 the higher place of the altar.
original_text:
And these
are the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit
is a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom
shall be
 a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about
shall be a span: and this
shall be
 the higher place of the altar.

translated_text:
And from the bottom
upon the ground
even to the lower settle
shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle
even to the greater settle
shall be
 four cubits, and the breadth
one cubit.
original_text:
And from the bottom
upon the ground
even to the lower settle
shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle
even to the greater settle
shall be
 four cubits, and the breadth
one cubit.

translated_text:
So the altar
shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward
shall be four horns.
original_text:
So the altar
shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward
shall be four horns.

translated_text:
And the altar
shall be twelve
cubits long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.
original_text:
And the altar
shall be twelve
cubits long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.

translated_text:
And the settle
shall be fourteen
cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it
shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof
shall be
 a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.
original_text:
And the settle
shall be fourteen
cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it
shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof
shall be
 a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.

translated_text:
And he said unto me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD; These
are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.
original_text:
And he said unto me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD; These
are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.

translated_text: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord GOD, a young bullock for a sin offering.
original_text: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord GOD, a young bullock for a sin offering.

translated_text:
And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put
it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it.
original_text:
And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put
it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it.

translated_text: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.
original_text: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.

translated_text:
And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse
it with the bullock.
original_text:
And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse
it with the bullock.

translated_text:
When thou hast made an end of cleansing
it, thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.
original_text:
When thou hast made an end of cleansing
it, thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.

translated_text:
And thou shalt offer them before the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up
for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
original_text:
And thou shalt offer them before the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up
for a burnt offering unto the LORD.

translated_text:
Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat
for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.
original_text:
Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat
for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.

translated_text: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.
original_text: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.

translated_text:
And when these days are expired, it shall be,
that upon the eighth day, and
so forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
And when these days are expired, it shall be,
that upon the eighth day, and
so forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
original_text: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

translated_text:
And say, What
is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.
original_text:
And say, What
is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.

translated_text: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.
original_text: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.

translated_text: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.
original_text: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
Now when she saw that she had waited,
and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps,
and made him a young lion.
original_text:
Now when she saw that she had waited,
and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps,
and made him a young lion.

translated_text:
And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey,
and devoured men.
original_text:
And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey,
and devoured men.

translated_text: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.
original_text: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.

translated_text: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.
original_text: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.

translated_text: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.
original_text: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.

translated_text:
Thy mother
is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
original_text:
Thy mother
is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

translated_text: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.
original_text: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.

translated_text: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.
original_text: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.

translated_text:
And now she
is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.
original_text:
And now she
is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.

translated_text:
And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches,
which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod
to be a sceptre to rule. This
is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.
original_text:
And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches,
which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod
to be a sceptre to rule. This
is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;
original_text: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;

translated_text: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:
original_text: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:

translated_text: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.
original_text: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.

translated_text:
He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed
it by great waters,
and set it
as
 a willow tree.
original_text:
He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed
it by great waters,
and set it
as
 a willow tree.

translated_text: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.
original_text: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.

translated_text: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.
original_text: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.

translated_text: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.
original_text: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.

translated_text: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.
original_text: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.

translated_text:
Yea, behold,
being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.
original_text:
Yea, behold,
being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.

translated_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: And hath taken of the king’s seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land:
original_text: And hath taken of the king’s seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land:

translated_text:
That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up,
but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.
original_text:
That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up,
but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.

translated_text:
But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such
things? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?
original_text:
But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such
things? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?

translated_text:
As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely in the place
where
 the king
dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake,
even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
original_text:
As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely in the place
where
 the king
dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake,
even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.

translated_text:
Neither shall Pharaoh with
his mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:
original_text:
Neither shall Pharaoh with
his mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:

translated_text:
Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these
things, he shall not escape.
original_text:
Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these
things, he shall not escape.

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD;
As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD;
As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.

translated_text: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.
original_text: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.

translated_text:
And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the LORD have spoken
it.
original_text:
And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the LORD have spoken
it.

translated_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set
it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant
it upon an high mountain and eminent:
original_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set
it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant
it upon an high mountain and eminent:

translated_text: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.
original_text: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.

translated_text:
And all the trees of the field shall know that I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the LORD have spoken and have done
it.
original_text:
And all the trees of the field shall know that I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the LORD have spoken and have done
it.

translated_text: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,
original_text: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,

translated_text: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge?
original_text: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge?

translated_text:
As I live, saith the Lord GOD, ye shall not have
occasion
 any more to use this proverb in Israel.
original_text:
As I live, saith the Lord GOD, ye shall not have
occasion
 any more to use this proverb in Israel.

translated_text: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.
original_text: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.

translated_text: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,
original_text: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,

translated_text: And hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour’s wife, neither hath come near to a menstruous woman,
original_text: And hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour’s wife, neither hath come near to a menstruous woman,

translated_text:
And hath not oppressed any,
but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath spoiled none by violence, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;
original_text:
And hath not oppressed any,
but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath spoiled none by violence, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;

translated_text:
He
that hath not given forth upon usury, neither hath taken any increase,
that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true judgment between man and man,
original_text:
He
that hath not given forth upon usury, neither hath taken any increase,
that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true judgment between man and man,

translated_text:
Hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept my judgments, to deal truly; he
is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
Hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept my judgments, to deal truly; he
is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
If he beget a son
that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and
that doeth the like to
any one of these
things,
original_text:
If he beget a son
that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and
that doeth the like to
any one of these
things,

translated_text:
And that doeth not any of those
duties, but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour’s wife,
original_text:
And that doeth not any of those
duties, but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour’s wife,

translated_text: Hath oppressed the poor and needy, hath spoiled by violence, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,
original_text: Hath oppressed the poor and needy, hath spoiled by violence, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,

translated_text: Hath given forth upon usury, and hath taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.
original_text: Hath given forth upon usury, and hath taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.

translated_text:
Now, lo,
if he beget a son, that seeth all his father’s sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like,
original_text:
Now, lo,
if he beget a son, that seeth all his father’s sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like,

translated_text: That hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbour’s wife,
original_text: That hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbour’s wife,

translated_text:
Neither hath oppressed any, hath not withholden the pledge, neither hath spoiled by violence,
but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment,
original_text:
Neither hath oppressed any, hath not withholden the pledge, neither hath spoiled by violence,
but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment,

translated_text:
That hath taken off his hand from the poor,
that
 hath not received usury nor increase, hath executed my judgments, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.
original_text:
That hath taken off his hand from the poor,
that
 hath not received usury nor increase, hath executed my judgments, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.

translated_text:
As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did
that which
is not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.
original_text:
As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did
that which
is not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.

translated_text:
Yet say ye, Why? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right,
and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.
original_text:
Yet say ye, Why? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right,
and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.

translated_text: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.
original_text: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.

translated_text: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
original_text: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

translated_text: All his transgressions that he hath committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.
original_text: All his transgressions that he hath committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.

translated_text:
Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord GOD:
and not that he should return from his ways, and live?
original_text:
Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord GOD:
and not that he should return from his ways, and live?

translated_text:
But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity,
and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked
man doeth, shall he live? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.
original_text:
But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity,
and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked
man doeth, shall he live? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.

translated_text: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?
original_text: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?

translated_text:
When a righteous
man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth in them; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.
original_text:
When a righteous
man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth in them; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.

translated_text:
Again, when the wicked
man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.
original_text:
Again, when the wicked
man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.

translated_text: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
original_text: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

translated_text: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?
original_text: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?

translated_text:
Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord GOD. Repent, and turn
yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.
original_text:
Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord GOD. Repent, and turn
yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.

translated_text: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
original_text: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

translated_text:
For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord GOD: wherefore turn
yourselves, and live ye.
original_text:
For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord GOD: wherefore turn
yourselves, and live ye.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, What is the vine tree more than any tree,
or than
 a branch which is among the trees of the forest?
original_text:
Son of man, What is the vine tree more than any tree,
or than
 a branch which is among the trees of the forest?

translated_text:
Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will
men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?
original_text:
Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will
men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?

translated_text:
Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for
any work?
original_text:
Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for
any work?

translated_text:
Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for
any work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned?
original_text:
Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for
any work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned?

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

translated_text:
And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from
one
 fire, and
another fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I
am the LORD, when I set my face against them.
original_text:
And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from
one
 fire, and
another fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I
am the LORD, when I set my face against them.

translated_text: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,
original_text: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,

translated_text:
And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity
is of the land of Canaan; thy father
was an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.
original_text:
And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity
is of the land of Canaan; thy father
was an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.

translated_text:
And
as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple
thee;
 thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
original_text:
And
as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple
thee;
 thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.

translated_text: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.
original_text: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.

translated_text:
And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee
when thou wast in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee
when thou wast in thy blood, Live.
original_text:
And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee
when thou wast in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee
when thou wast in thy blood, Live.

translated_text:
I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and waxen great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments:
thy breasts are fashioned, and thine hair is grown, whereas thou
wast naked and bare.
original_text:
I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and waxen great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments:
thy breasts are fashioned, and thine hair is grown, whereas thou
wast naked and bare.

translated_text:
Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time
was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord GOD, and thou becamest mine.
original_text:
Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time
was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord GOD, and thou becamest mine.

translated_text: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.
original_text: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.

translated_text: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers’ skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.
original_text: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers’ skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.

translated_text: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.
original_text: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.

translated_text: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.
original_text: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.

translated_text:
Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment
was of
 fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.
original_text:
Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment
was of
 fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.

translated_text:
And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it
was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it
was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.
original_text: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.

translated_text:
And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon:
the like things
 shall not come, neither shall it be so.
original_text:
And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon:
the like things
 shall not come, neither shall it be so.

translated_text: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,
original_text: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,

translated_text: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.
original_text: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.

translated_text:
My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey,
wherewith I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and
thus it was, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey,
wherewith I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and
thus it was, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured.
Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter,
original_text:
Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured.
Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter,

translated_text:
That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through
the fire for them?
original_text:
That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through
the fire for them?

translated_text:
And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare,
and wast polluted in thy blood.
original_text:
And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare,
and wast polluted in thy blood.

translated_text: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord GOD;)
original_text: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord GOD;)

translated_text: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.
original_text: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.

translated_text: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.
original_text: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.

translated_text: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.
original_text: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.

translated_text:
Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary
food, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.
original_text:
Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary
food, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.

translated_text: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.
original_text: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.

translated_text: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.
original_text: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.

translated_text:
How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord GOD, seeing thou doest all these
things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;
original_text:
How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord GOD, seeing thou doest all these
things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;

translated_text: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thine high place in every street; and hast not been as an harlot, in that thou scornest hire;
original_text: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thine high place in every street; and hast not been as an harlot, in that thou scornest hire;

translated_text:
But as a wife that committeth adultery,
which taketh strangers instead of her husband!
original_text:
But as a wife that committeth adultery,
which taketh strangers instead of her husband!

translated_text: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.
original_text: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.

translated_text:
And the contrary is in thee from
other women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.
original_text:
And the contrary is in thee from
other women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.

translated_text: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD:
original_text: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD:

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;

translated_text:
Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all
them that thou hast loved, with all
them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.
original_text:
Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all
them that thou hast loved, with all
them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.

translated_text: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.
original_text: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.

translated_text: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.
original_text: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.

translated_text: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.
original_text: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.

translated_text: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.
original_text: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.

translated_text: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.
original_text: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.

translated_text:
Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these
things; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon
thine head, saith the Lord GOD: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.
original_text:
Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these
things; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon
thine head, saith the Lord GOD: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.

translated_text:
Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use
this proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother,
so is her daughter.
original_text:
Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use
this proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother,
so is her daughter.

translated_text:
Thou
art thy mother’s daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou
art the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother
was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
original_text:
Thou
art thy mother’s daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou
art the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother
was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

translated_text:
And thine elder sister
is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand,
is Sodom and her daughters.
original_text:
And thine elder sister
is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand,
is Sodom and her daughters.

translated_text:
Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as
if that were a very little
thing,
 thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.
original_text:
Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as
if that were a very little
thing,
 thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.

translated_text: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.
original_text: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.

translated_text: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
original_text: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

translated_text:
And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw
good.
original_text:
And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw
good.

translated_text: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done.
original_text: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done.

translated_text: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.
original_text: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.

translated_text:
When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then
will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:
original_text:
When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then
will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:

translated_text: That thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.
original_text: That thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.

translated_text: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.
original_text: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.

translated_text: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,
original_text: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,

translated_text:
Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of
thy
 reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all
that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise thee round about.
original_text:
Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of
thy
 reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all
that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise thee round about.

translated_text: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the LORD.
original_text: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the LORD.

translated_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
original_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

translated_text: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
original_text: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.

translated_text: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.
original_text: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.

translated_text:
And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I
am the LORD:
original_text:
And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I
am the LORD:

translated_text: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear ye the word of the LORD;
original_text: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear ye the word of the LORD;

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

translated_text: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.
original_text: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.

translated_text: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD.
original_text: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD.

translated_text:
They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The LORD saith: and the LORD hath not sent them: and they have made
others to hope that they would confirm the word.
original_text:
They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The LORD saith: and the LORD hath not sent them: and they have made
others to hope that they would confirm the word.

translated_text:
Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The LORD saith
it; albeit I have not spoken?
original_text:
Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The LORD saith
it; albeit I have not spoken?

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I
am against you, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I
am against you, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I
am the Lord GOD.
original_text:
And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I
am the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and
there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered
morter:
original_text:
Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and
there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered
morter:

translated_text:
Say unto them which daub it with untempered
morter, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend
it.
original_text:
Say unto them which daub it with untempered
morter, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend
it.

translated_text:
Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where
is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed
it?
original_text:
Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where
is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed
it?

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even rend
it with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in
my fury to consume
it.
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even rend
it with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in
my fury to consume
it.

translated_text:
So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered
morter, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered
morter, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered
morter, and will say unto you, The wall
is no
more, neither they that daubed it;
original_text:
Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered
morter, and will say unto you, The wall
is no
more, neither they that daubed it;

translated_text:
To wit, the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and
there is
 no peace, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
To wit, the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and
there is
 no peace, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,
original_text: Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,

translated_text:
And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the
women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive
that come unto you?
original_text:
And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the
women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive
that come unto you?

translated_text:
And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear
your
 lies?
original_text:
And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear
your
 lies?

translated_text:
Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I
am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make
them fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go,
even
 the souls that ye hunt to make
them fly.
original_text:
Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I
am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make
them fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go,
even
 the souls that ye hunt to make
them fly.

translated_text:
Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:
original_text: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:

translated_text:
Therefore ye shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and ye shall know that I
am
 the LORD.
original_text:
Therefore ye shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and ye shall know that I
am
 the LORD.

translated_text: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.
original_text: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?
original_text: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?

translated_text: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the LORD will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;
original_text: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the LORD will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;

translated_text: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.
original_text: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.

translated_text:
Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Repent, and turn
yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
original_text:
Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Repent, and turn
yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.

translated_text: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel, which separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the LORD will answer him by myself:
original_text: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel, which separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the LORD will answer him by myself:

translated_text:
And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the LORD have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
