original_text: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the LORD have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.

translated_text:
And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh
unto him;
original_text:
And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh
unto him;

translated_text: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,
original_text: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out mine hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:
original_text: Son of man, when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out mine hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:

translated_text:
Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver
but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver
but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:
original_text: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:

translated_text:
Though these three men
were in it,
as
 I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.
original_text:
Though these three men
were in it,
as
 I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.

translated_text:
Or
if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:
original_text:
Or
if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:

translated_text:
Though these three men
were in it,
as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.
original_text:
Though these three men
were in it,
as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.

translated_text:
Or
if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:
original_text:
Or
if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:

translated_text:
Though Noah, Daniel, and Job,
were in it,
as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall
but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.
original_text:
Though Noah, Daniel, and Job,
were in it,
as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall
but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.

translated_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?
original_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?

translated_text:
Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth,
both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings: and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem,
even concerning all that I have brought upon it.
original_text:
Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth,
both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings: and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem,
even concerning all that I have brought upon it.

translated_text: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD’S house, which looketh eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, the princes of the people.
original_text: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD’S house, which looketh eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, the princes of the people.

translated_text:
Then said he unto me, Son of man, these
are the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:
original_text:
Then said he unto me, Son of man, these
are the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:

translated_text:
Which say,
It is not near; let us build houses: this
city is the caldron, and we
be the flesh.
original_text:
Which say,
It is not near; let us build houses: this
city is the caldron, and we
be the flesh.

translated_text: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.
original_text: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.

translated_text:
And the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus saith the LORD; Thus have ye said, O house of Israel: for I know the things that come into your mind,
every one of them.
original_text:
And the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus saith the LORD; Thus have ye said, O house of Israel: for I know the things that come into your mind,
every one of them.

translated_text: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.
original_text: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they
are the flesh, and this
city is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they
are the flesh, and this
city is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.

translated_text: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
original_text: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

translated_text:
Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
And ye shall know that I
am the LORD: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that
are round about you.
original_text:
And ye shall know that I
am the LORD: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that
are round about you.

translated_text: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?
original_text: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?

translated_text: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, thy brethren,
even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel wholly,
are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from the LORD: unto us is this land given in possession.
original_text:
Son of man, thy brethren,
even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel wholly,
are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from the LORD: unto us is this land given in possession.

translated_text: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.
original_text: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.

translated_text: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.
original_text: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.

translated_text: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.
original_text: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.

translated_text: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:
original_text: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:

translated_text: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.
original_text: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.

translated_text:
But
as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
But
as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel
was over them above.
original_text:
Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel
was over them above.

translated_text:
And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which
is on the east side of the city.
original_text:
And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which
is on the east side of the city.

translated_text: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.
original_text: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

translated_text: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the LORD had shewed me.
original_text: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the LORD had shewed me.

translated_text: The word of the LORD also came unto me, saying,
original_text: The word of the LORD also came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they
are a rebellious house.
original_text:
Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they
are a rebellious house.

translated_text:
Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they
be a rebellious house.
original_text:
Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they
be a rebellious house.

translated_text: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.
original_text: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.

translated_text: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
original_text: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.

translated_text:
In their sight shalt thou bear
it upon
thy shoulders,
and carry
it forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee
for a sign unto the house of Israel.
original_text:
In their sight shalt thou bear
it upon
thy shoulders,
and carry
it forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee
for a sign unto the house of Israel.

translated_text:
And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought
it forth in the twilight,
and I bare
it
 upon
my shoulder in their sight.
original_text:
And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought
it forth in the twilight,
and I bare
it
 upon
my shoulder in their sight.

translated_text: And in the morning came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,
original_text: And in the morning came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?
original_text: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?

translated_text:
Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; This burden
concerneth
 the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that
are
 among them.
original_text:
Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; This burden
concerneth
 the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that
are
 among them.

translated_text:
Say, I
am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove
and go into captivity.
original_text:
Say, I
am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove
and go into captivity.

translated_text:
And the prince that
is among them shall bear upon
his
 shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with
his eyes.
original_text:
And the prince that
is among them shall bear upon
his
 shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with
his eyes.

translated_text:
My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon
to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
original_text:
My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon
to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.

translated_text:
And I will scatter toward every wind all that
are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
original_text:
And I will scatter toward every wind all that
are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.

translated_text:
And they shall know that I
am the LORD, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.
original_text:
And they shall know that I
am the LORD, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.

translated_text:
But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
original_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;
original_text: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;

translated_text:
And say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord GOD of the inhabitants of Jerusalem,
and of the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.
original_text:
And say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord GOD of the inhabitants of Jerusalem,
and of the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.

translated_text:
And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, what
is that proverb
that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
original_text:
Son of man, what
is that proverb
that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?

translated_text: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.
original_text: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.

translated_text: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
original_text: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

translated_text:
For I
am the LORD: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
For I
am the LORD: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
original_text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, behold,
they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth
is for many days
to come, and he prophesieth of the times
that are far off.
original_text:
Son of man, behold,
they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth
is for many days
to come, and he prophesieth of the times
that are far off.

translated_text: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
original_text: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

translated_text:
And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels,
even under the cherub, and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter
them over the city. And he went in in my sight.
original_text:
And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels,
even under the cherub, and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter
them over the city. And he went in in my sight.

translated_text: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
original_text: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

translated_text:
Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub,
and stood
 over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’S glory.
original_text:
Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub,
and stood
 over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’S glory.

translated_text:
And the sound of the cherubims’ wings was heard
even to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.
original_text:
And the sound of the cherubims’ wings was heard
even to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.

translated_text:
And it came to pass,
that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.
original_text:
And it came to pass,
that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.

translated_text:
And
one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that
was between the cherubims, and took
thereof, and put
it into the hands of
him that was
 clothed with linen: who took
it, and went out.
original_text:
And
one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that
was between the cherubims, and took
thereof, and put
it into the hands of
him that was
 clothed with linen: who took
it, and went out.

translated_text: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man’s hand under their wings.
original_text: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man’s hand under their wings.

translated_text:
And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubims, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels
was as the colour of a beryl stone.
original_text:
And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubims, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels
was as the colour of a beryl stone.

translated_text:
And
as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.
original_text:
And
as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.

translated_text: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.
original_text: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.

translated_text:
And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels,
were full of eyes round about,
even the wheels that they four had.
original_text:
And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels,
were full of eyes round about,
even the wheels that they four had.

translated_text: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.
original_text: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.

translated_text:
And every one had four faces: the first face
was the face of a cherub, and the second face
was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
original_text:
And every one had four faces: the first face
was the face of a cherub, and the second face
was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

translated_text:
And the cherubims were lifted up. This
is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.
original_text:
And the cherubims were lifted up. This
is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.

translated_text: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.
original_text: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.

translated_text:
When they stood,
these stood; and when they were lifted up,
these lifted up themselves
also: for the spirit of the living creature
was in them.
original_text:
When they stood,
these stood; and when they were lifted up,
these lifted up themselves
also: for the spirit of the living creature
was in them.

translated_text: Then the glory of the LORD departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.
original_text: Then the glory of the LORD departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.

translated_text:
And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also
were beside them, and
every one stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’S house; and the glory of the God of Israel
was over them above.
original_text:
And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also
were beside them, and
every one stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’S house; and the glory of the God of Israel
was over them above.

translated_text:
This
is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they
were the cherubims.
original_text:
This
is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they
were the cherubims.

translated_text:
Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man
was under their wings.
original_text:
Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man
was under their wings.

translated_text:
And the likeness of their faces
was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.
original_text:
And the likeness of their faces
was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.

translated_text: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
original_text: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thine heart
is lifted up, and thou hast said, I
am
 a God, I sit
in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou
art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God:
original_text:
Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thine heart
is lifted up, and thou hast said, I
am
 a God, I sit
in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou
art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God:

translated_text:
Behold, thou
art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee:
original_text:
Behold, thou
art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee:

translated_text: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures:
original_text: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures:

translated_text:
By thy great wisdom
and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches:
original_text:
By thy great wisdom
and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches:

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God;
original_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God;

translated_text: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.
original_text: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.

translated_text:
They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of
them that are slain in the midst of the seas.
original_text:
They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of
them that are slain in the midst of the seas.

translated_text:
Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I
am God? but thou
shalt be a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.
original_text:
Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I
am God? but thou
shalt be a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.

translated_text:
Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken
it, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken
it, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
original_text: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

translated_text:
Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone
was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.
original_text:
Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone
was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.

translated_text:
Thou
art the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee
so: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.
original_text:
Thou
art the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee
so: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.

translated_text:
Thou
wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.
original_text:
Thou
wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.

translated_text: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
original_text: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.

translated_text: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.
original_text: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.

translated_text: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.
original_text: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.

translated_text:
All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never
shalt thou
be any more.
original_text:
All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never
shalt thou
be any more.

translated_text: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, set thy face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,
original_text: Son of man, set thy face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,

translated_text:
And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I
am against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I
am the LORD, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.
original_text:
And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I
am against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I
am the LORD, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.

translated_text:
For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her street; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her street; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor
any grieving thorn of all
that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I
am the Lord GOD.
original_text:
And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor
any grieving thorn of all
that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I
am the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.

translated_text:
And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I
am the LORD their God.
original_text:
And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I
am the LORD their God.

translated_text:
In the tenth year, in the tenth
month, in the twelfth
day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text:
In the tenth year, in the tenth
month, in the twelfth
day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:
original_text: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:

translated_text:
Speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I
am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which hath said, My river
is mine own, and I have made
it for myself.
original_text:
Speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I
am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which hath said, My river
is mine own, and I have made
it for myself.

translated_text: But I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales.
original_text: But I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales.

translated_text:
And I will leave thee
thrown into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open fields; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.
original_text:
And I will leave thee
thrown into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open fields; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.

translated_text:
And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I
am the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
original_text:
And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I
am the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

translated_text: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.
original_text: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast out of thee.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast out of thee.

translated_text:
And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I
am the LORD: because he hath said, The river
is
 mine, and I have made
it.
original_text:
And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I
am the LORD: because he hath said, The river
is
 mine, and I have made
it.

translated_text:
Behold, therefore I
am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste
and desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.
original_text:
Behold, therefore I
am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste
and desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.

translated_text: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.
original_text: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.

translated_text:
And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries
that are desolate, and her cities among the cities
that are
 laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
original_text:
And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries
that are desolate, and her cities among the cities
that are
 laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

translated_text: Yet thus saith the Lord GOD; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:
original_text: Yet thus saith the Lord GOD; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:

translated_text:
And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return
into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.
original_text:
And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return
into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.

translated_text: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.
original_text: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.

translated_text:
And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, which bringeth
their iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I
am the Lord GOD.
original_text:
And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, which bringeth
their iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I
am the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first
month, in the first
day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text:
And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first
month, in the first
day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head
was made bald, and every shoulder
was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:
original_text:
Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head
was made bald, and every shoulder
was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.

translated_text:
I have given him the land of Egypt
for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
I have given him the land of Egypt
for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first
day
 of the month,
that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text:
And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first
day
 of the month,
that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, because that Tyrus hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken
that was the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished,
now she is laid waste:
original_text:
Son of man, because that Tyrus hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken
that was the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished,
now she is laid waste:

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I
am against thee, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I
am against thee, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.

translated_text: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.
original_text: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.

translated_text:
It shall be
a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken
it, saith the Lord GOD: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.
original_text:
It shall be
a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken
it, saith the Lord GOD: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.

translated_text:
And her daughters which
are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And her daughters which
are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.
original_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.

translated_text: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.
original_text: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.

translated_text: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.
original_text: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.

translated_text: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.
original_text: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.

translated_text: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.
original_text: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.

translated_text: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.
original_text: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.

translated_text: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.
original_text: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.

translated_text:
And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be
a place
 to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the LORD have spoken
it, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be
a place
 to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the LORD have spoken
it, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?

translated_text:
Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at
every moment, and be astonished at thee.
original_text:
Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at
every moment, and be astonished at thee.

translated_text:
And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed,
that wast inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror
to be on all that haunt it!
original_text:
And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed,
that wast inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror
to be on all that haunt it!

translated_text:
Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that
are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.
original_text:
Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that
are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.

translated_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and great waters shall cover thee;
original_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and great waters shall cover thee;

translated_text: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;
original_text: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;

translated_text:
I will make thee a terror, and thou
shalt be no
more:
 though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
I will make thee a terror, and thou
shalt be no
more:
 though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
original_text: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

translated_text: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;
original_text: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;

translated_text:
And say unto Tyrus, O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea,
which art a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O Tyrus, thou hast said, I
am of perfect beauty.
original_text:
And say unto Tyrus, O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea,
which art a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O Tyrus, thou hast said, I
am of perfect beauty.

translated_text:
Thy borders
are in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.
original_text:
Thy borders
are in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.

translated_text:
They have made all thy
ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.
original_text:
They have made all thy
ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.

translated_text:
Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches
of ivory,
brought
 out of the isles of Chittim.
original_text:
Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches
of ivory,
brought
 out of the isles of Chittim.

translated_text: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.
original_text: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.

translated_text:
The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise
men, O Tyrus,
that were in thee, were thy pilots.
original_text:
The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise
men, O Tyrus,
that were in thee, were thy pilots.

translated_text:
The ancients of Gebal and the wise
men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise.
original_text:
The ancients of Gebal and the wise
men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise.

translated_text: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.
original_text: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.

translated_text:
The men of Arvad with thine army
were upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty perfect.
original_text:
The men of Arvad with thine army
were upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty perfect.

translated_text:
Tarshish
was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all
kind of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in thy fairs.
original_text:
Tarshish
was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all
kind of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in thy fairs.

translated_text:
Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they
were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.
original_text:
Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they
were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.

translated_text: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.
original_text: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.

translated_text:
The men of Dedan
were thy merchants; many isles
were
 the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee
for a present horns of ivory and ebony.
original_text:
The men of Dedan
were thy merchants; many isles
were
 the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee
for a present horns of ivory and ebony.

translated_text:
Syria
was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.
original_text:
Syria
was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.

translated_text:
Judah, and the land of Israel, they
were thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.
original_text:
Judah, and the land of Israel, they
were thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.

translated_text:
Damascus
was thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
original_text:
Damascus
was thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

translated_text: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.
original_text: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.

translated_text:
Dedan
was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.
original_text:
Dedan
was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.

translated_text:
Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these
were they thy merchants.
original_text:
Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these
were they thy merchants.

translated_text:
The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they
were thy merchants: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.
original_text:
The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they
were thy merchants: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.

translated_text:
Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur,
and
 Chilmad,
were thy merchants.
original_text:
Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur,
and
 Chilmad,
were thy merchants.

translated_text:
These
were thy merchants in all sorts
of things,
 in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.
original_text:
These
were thy merchants in all sorts
of things,
 in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.

translated_text: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.
original_text: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.

translated_text: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.
original_text: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.

translated_text:
Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that
are in thee, and in all thy company which
is
 in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.
original_text:
Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that
are in thee, and in all thy company which
is
 in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.

translated_text: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.
original_text: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.

translated_text:
And all that handle the oar, the mariners,
and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;
original_text:
And all that handle the oar, the mariners,
and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;

translated_text: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:
original_text: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:

translated_text:
And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart
and
 bitter wailing.
original_text:
And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart
and
 bitter wailing.

translated_text:
And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee,
saying, What
city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?
original_text:
And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee,
saying, What
city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?

translated_text: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.
original_text: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.

translated_text:
In the time
when thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall.
original_text:
In the time
when thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall.

translated_text:
All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in
their countenance.
original_text:
All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in
their countenance.

translated_text:
The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou
shalt be
 a terror, and never shalt be any more.
original_text:
The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou
shalt be
 a terror, and never shalt be any more.

translated_text:
Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth
day
 of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text:
Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth
day
 of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, write thee the name of the day,
even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.
original_text:
Son of man, write thee the name of the day,
even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.

translated_text:
And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Set on a pot, set
it on, and also pour water into it:
original_text:
And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Set on a pot, set
it on, and also pour water into it:

translated_text:
Gather the pieces thereof into it,
even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill
it with the choice bones.
original_text:
Gather the pieces thereof into it,
even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill
it with the choice bones.

translated_text:
Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it,
and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.
original_text:
Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it,
and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.

translated_text:
Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum is therein, and whose scum
is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall up on it.
original_text:
Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum is therein, and whose scum
is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall up on it.

translated_text: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;
original_text: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;

translated_text: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.
original_text: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.

translated_text: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.
original_text: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.

translated_text:
Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and
that the filthiness of it may be molten in it,
that the scum of it may be consumed.
original_text:
Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and
that the filthiness of it may be molten in it,
that the scum of it may be consumed.

translated_text:
She hath wearied
herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum
shall be in the fire.
original_text:
She hath wearied
herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum
shall be in the fire.

translated_text:
In thy filthiness
is lewdness: because I have purged thee, and thou wast not purged, thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee.
original_text:
In thy filthiness
is lewdness: because I have purged thee, and thou wast not purged, thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee.

translated_text:
I the LORD have spoken
it: it shall come to pass, and I will do
it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
I the LORD have spoken
it: it shall come to pass, and I will do
it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Also the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Also the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.
original_text: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.

translated_text:
Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of thine head upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not
thy
 lips, and eat not the bread of men.
original_text:
Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of thine head upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not
thy
 lips, and eat not the bread of men.

translated_text: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.
original_text: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.

translated_text:
And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these
things are to us, that thou doest
so?
original_text:
And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these
things are to us, that thou doest
so?

translated_text: Then I answered them, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Then I answered them, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword.
original_text: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword.

translated_text:
And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover
your lips, nor eat the bread of men.
original_text:
And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover
your lips, nor eat the bread of men.

translated_text:
And your tires
shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.
original_text:
And your tires
shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.

translated_text:
Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: and when this cometh, ye shall know that I
am the Lord GOD.
original_text:
Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: and when this cometh, ye shall know that I
am the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
Also, thou son of man,
shall it not
be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,
original_text:
Also, thou son of man,
shall it not
be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,

translated_text:
That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee, to cause
thee to hear
it with
thine ears?
original_text:
That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee, to cause
thee to hear
it with
thine ears?

translated_text:
In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
original_text: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;
original_text: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;

translated_text: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;
original_text: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;

translated_text: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.
original_text: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.

translated_text:
And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
Behold, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
Behold, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah
is like unto all the heathen;
original_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah
is like unto all the heathen;

translated_text:
Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities
which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,
original_text:
Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities
which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,

translated_text: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.
original_text: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.

translated_text:
And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.

translated_text: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

translated_text:
And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I
am the LORD, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
original_text:
And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I
am the LORD, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.

translated_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
