original_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.
original_text: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.

translated_text: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.
original_text: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.

translated_text:
Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come
even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.
original_text:
Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come
even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.

translated_text:
Those that be near, and
those that be far from thee, shall mock thee,
which art infamous
and much vexed.
original_text:
Those that be near, and
those that be far from thee, shall mock thee,
which art infamous
and much vexed.

translated_text: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.
original_text: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.

translated_text: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.
original_text: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.

translated_text: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.
original_text: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.

translated_text: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.
original_text: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.

translated_text: In thee have they discovered their fathers’ nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.
original_text: In thee have they discovered their fathers’ nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.

translated_text: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour’s wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.
original_text: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour’s wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.

translated_text: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.
original_text: Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.

translated_text:
Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the LORD have spoken
it, and will do
it.
original_text:
Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the LORD have spoken
it, and will do
it.

translated_text: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.
original_text: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.

translated_text:
And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they
are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are
even the dross of silver.
original_text:
Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they
are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are
even the dross of silver.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.

translated_text:
As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt
it;
 so will I gather
you in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave
you there, and melt you.
original_text:
As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt
it;
 so will I gather
you in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave
you there, and melt you.

translated_text: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.
original_text: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.

translated_text: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the LORD have poured out my fury upon you.
original_text: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the LORD have poured out my fury upon you.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, say unto her, Thou
art the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.
original_text:
Son of man, say unto her, Thou
art the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.

translated_text: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.
original_text: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.

translated_text:
Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed
difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.
original_text:
Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed
difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.

translated_text:
Her princes in the midst thereof
are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood,
and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.
original_text:
Her princes in the midst thereof
are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood,
and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.

translated_text:
And her prophets have daubed them with untempered
morter,
 seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.
original_text:
And her prophets have daubed them with untempered
morter,
 seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.

translated_text: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.
original_text: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.

translated_text: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.
original_text: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.

translated_text: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
original_text: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:
original_text: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:

translated_text: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.
original_text: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.

translated_text:
And the names of them
were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus
were
 their names; Samaria
is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.
original_text:
And the names of them
were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus
were
 their names; Samaria
is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.

translated_text:
And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians
her neighbours,
original_text:
And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians
her neighbours,

translated_text: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
original_text: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.

translated_text:
Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them
that were
 the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.
original_text:
Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them
that were
 the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.

translated_text:
Neither left she her whoredoms
brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.
original_text:
Neither left she her whoredoms
brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.

translated_text: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.
original_text: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.

translated_text: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.
original_text: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.

translated_text:
And when her sister Aholibah saw
this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in
her whoredoms.
original_text:
And when her sister Aholibah saw
this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in
her whoredoms.

translated_text:
She doted upon the Assyrians
her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.
original_text:
She doted upon the Assyrians
her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.

translated_text:
Then I saw that she was defiled,
that they
took
 both one way,
original_text:
Then I saw that she was defiled,
that they
took
 both one way,

translated_text:
And
that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,
original_text:
And
that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,

translated_text: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:
original_text: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:

translated_text: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.
original_text: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.

translated_text: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.
original_text: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.

translated_text: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.
original_text: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.

translated_text: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.
original_text: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh
is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue
is like the issue of horses.
original_text:
For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh
is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue
is like the issue of horses.

translated_text: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.
original_text: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.

translated_text: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;
original_text: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;

translated_text:
The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa,
and all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.
original_text:
The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa,
and all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.

translated_text:
And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people,
which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.
original_text:
And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people,
which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.

translated_text: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.
original_text: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.

translated_text: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.
original_text: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.

translated_text:
Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom
brought from the land of Egypt: so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.
original_text:
Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom
brought from the land of Egypt: so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.

translated_text:
For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand
of them whom thou hatest, into the hand
of them from whom thy mind is alienated:
original_text:
For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand
of them whom thou hatest, into the hand
of them from whom thy mind is alienated:

translated_text: And they shall deal with thee hatefully, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare: and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
original_text: And they shall deal with thee hatefully, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare: and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

translated_text:
I will do these
things unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen,
and because thou art polluted with their idols.
original_text:
I will do these
things unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen,
and because thou art polluted with their idols.

translated_text: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.
original_text: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou shalt drink of thy sister’s cup deep and large: thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou shalt drink of thy sister’s cup deep and large: thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.

translated_text: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.
original_text: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.

translated_text:
Thou shalt even drink it and suck
it out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken
it, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
Thou shalt even drink it and suck
it out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken
it, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
original_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

translated_text: The LORD said moreover unto me; Son of man, wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;
original_text: The LORD said moreover unto me; Son of man, wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;

translated_text:
That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through
the fire, to devour
them.
original_text:
That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through
the fire, to devour
them.

translated_text: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.
original_text: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.

translated_text: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.
original_text: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.

translated_text:
And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger
was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,
original_text:
And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger
was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,

translated_text: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil.
original_text: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil.

translated_text:
And a voice of a multitude being at ease
was with her: and with the men of the common sort
were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.
original_text:
And a voice of a multitude being at ease
was with her: and with the men of the common sort
were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.

translated_text:
Then said I unto
her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she
with them?
original_text:
Then said I unto
her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she
with them?

translated_text: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.
original_text: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.

translated_text:
And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they
are adulteresses, and blood
is in their hands.
original_text:
And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they
are adulteresses, and blood
is in their hands.

translated_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.
original_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.

translated_text: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
original_text: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

translated_text: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.
original_text: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.

translated_text:
And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I
am the Lord GOD.
original_text:
And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I
am the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth
month,
 the tenth
day of the month,
that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the LORD, and sat before me.
original_text:
And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth
month,
 the tenth
day of the month,
that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the LORD, and sat before me.

translated_text: Then came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,
original_text: Then came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye come to enquire of me?
As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.
original_text:
Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye come to enquire of me?
As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.

translated_text:
Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge
them? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:
original_text:
Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge
them? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:

translated_text:
And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up mine hand unto them, saying, I
am the LORD your God;
original_text:
And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up mine hand unto them, saying, I
am the LORD your God;

translated_text:
In the day
that I lifted up mine hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which
is the glory of all lands:
original_text:
In the day
that I lifted up mine hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which
is the glory of all lands:

translated_text:
Then said I unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I
am the LORD your God.
original_text:
Then said I unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I
am the LORD your God.

translated_text: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
original_text: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they
were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.
original_text:
But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they
were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.

translated_text: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.
original_text: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.

translated_text:
And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which
if a man do, he shall even live in them.
original_text:
And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which
if a man do, he shall even live in them.

translated_text:
Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I
am the LORD that sanctify them.
original_text:
Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I
am the LORD that sanctify them.

translated_text:
But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which
if
 a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.
original_text:
But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which
if
 a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.

translated_text: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.
original_text: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.

translated_text: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.
original_text: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.

translated_text: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.
original_text: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.

translated_text: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:
original_text: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:

translated_text:
I
am the LORD your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;
original_text:
I
am the LORD your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;

translated_text:
And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I
am the LORD your God.
original_text:
And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I
am the LORD your God.

translated_text:
Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which
if a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
original_text:
Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which
if a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.

translated_text: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand, and wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.
original_text: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand, and wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.

translated_text: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;
original_text: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;

translated_text: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.
original_text: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.

translated_text:
Wherefore I gave them also statutes
that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;
original_text:
Wherefore I gave them also statutes
that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;

translated_text:
And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through
the fire all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through
the fire all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
original_text: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.

translated_text:
For when I had brought them into the land,
for
 the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.
original_text:
For when I had brought them into the land,
for
 the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.

translated_text:
Then I said unto them, What
is the high place whereunto ye go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.
original_text:
Then I said unto them, What
is the high place whereunto ye go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.

translated_text: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?
original_text: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?

translated_text:
For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Israel?
As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.
original_text:
For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Israel?
As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.

translated_text: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.
original_text: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.

translated_text: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:
original_text: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:

translated_text: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.
original_text: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.

translated_text: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.
original_text: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.

translated_text: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:
original_text: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:

translated_text:
And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord GOD; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and hereafter
also, if ye will not hearken unto me: but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.
original_text:
As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord GOD; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and hereafter
also, if ye will not hearken unto me: but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.

translated_text: For in mine holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.
original_text: For in mine holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.

translated_text: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.
original_text: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.

translated_text:
And ye shall know that I
am the LORD, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country
for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers.
original_text:
And ye shall know that I
am the LORD, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country
for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers.

translated_text: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have been defiled; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.
original_text: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have been defiled; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.

translated_text:
And ye shall know that I
am the LORD, when I have wrought with you for my name’s sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
And ye shall know that I
am the LORD, when I have wrought with you for my name’s sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the LORD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.
original_text: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the LORD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.

translated_text: And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.
original_text: And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.

translated_text: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?
original_text: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text:
Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop
thy word
 toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,
original_text:
Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop
thy word
 toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,

translated_text:
And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I
am
 against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.
original_text:
And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I
am
 against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.

translated_text: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:
original_text: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:

translated_text: That all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.
original_text: That all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.

translated_text:
Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of
thy
 loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.
original_text:
Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of
thy
 loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.

translated_text:
And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak
as water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak
as water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:
original_text: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:

translated_text:
It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son,
as every tree.
original_text:
It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son,
as every tree.

translated_text: And he hath given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.
original_text: And he hath given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.

translated_text:
Cry and howl, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it
shall be upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon
thy thigh.
original_text:
Cry and howl, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it
shall be upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon
thy thigh.

translated_text:
Because
it is a trial, and what if
the sword contemn even the rod? it shall be no
more, saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
Because
it is a trial, and what if
the sword contemn even the rod? it shall be no
more, saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite
thine hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it
is the sword of the great
men that are slain, which entereth into their privy chambers.
original_text:
Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite
thine hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it
is the sword of the great
men that are slain, which entereth into their privy chambers.

translated_text:
I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that
their heart may faint, and
their ruins be multiplied: ah!
it is made bright,
it is wrapped up for the slaughter.
original_text:
I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that
their heart may faint, and
their ruins be multiplied: ah!
it is made bright,
it is wrapped up for the slaughter.

translated_text:
Go thee one way or other,
either on the right hand,
or on the left, whithersoever thy face
is set.
original_text:
Go thee one way or other,
either on the right hand,
or on the left, whithersoever thy face
is set.

translated_text:
I will also smite mine hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I the LORD have said
it.
original_text:
I will also smite mine hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I the LORD have said
it.

translated_text: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,
original_text: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,

translated_text:
Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose thou a place, choose
it at the head of the way to the city.
original_text:
Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose thou a place, choose
it at the head of the way to the city.

translated_text: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced.
original_text: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced.

translated_text:
For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made
his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.
original_text:
For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made
his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.

translated_text:
At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint
battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount,
and to build a fort.
original_text:
At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint
battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount,
and to build a fort.

translated_text: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.
original_text: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because,
I say, that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because,
I say, that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.

translated_text:
And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity
shall have an end,
original_text:
And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity
shall have an end,

translated_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this
shall not
be the same: exalt
him that is low, and abase
him that is high.
original_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this
shall not
be the same: exalt
him that is low, and abase
him that is high.

translated_text:
I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no
more,
 until he come whose right it is; and I will give it
him.
original_text:
I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no
more,
 until he come whose right it is; and I will give it
him.

translated_text:
And thou, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say thou, The sword, the sword
is drawn: for the slaughter
it is furbished, to consume because of the glittering:
original_text:
And thou, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say thou, The sword, the sword
is drawn: for the slaughter
it is furbished, to consume because of the glittering:

translated_text:
Whiles they see vanity unto thee, whiles they divine a lie unto thee, to bring thee upon the necks of
them that are slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity
shall have an end.
original_text:
Whiles they see vanity unto thee, whiles they divine a lie unto thee, to bring thee upon the necks of
them that are slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity
shall have an end.

translated_text:
Shall I cause
it to return into his sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.
original_text:
Shall I cause
it to return into his sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.

translated_text:
And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee, I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath, and deliver thee into the hand of brutish men,
and skilful to destroy.
original_text:
And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee, I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath, and deliver thee into the hand of brutish men,
and skilful to destroy.

translated_text:
Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no
more remembered: for I the LORD have spoken
it.
original_text:
Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no
more remembered: for I the LORD have spoken
it.

translated_text:
Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth
month,
 in the fifth
day of the month, as I
was among the captives by the river of Chebar,
that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
original_text:
Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth
month,
 in the fifth
day of the month, as I
was among the captives by the river of Chebar,
that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

translated_text:
In the fifth
day of the month, which
was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin’s captivity,
original_text:
In the fifth
day of the month, which
was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin’s captivity,

translated_text: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.
original_text: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.

translated_text:
And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness
was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.
original_text:
And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness
was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.

translated_text:
Also out of the midst thereof
came the likeness of four living creatures. And this
was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.
original_text:
Also out of the midst thereof
came the likeness of four living creatures. And this
was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.

translated_text: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.
original_text: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.

translated_text:
And their feet
were straight feet; and the sole of their feet
was like the sole of a calf’s foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.
original_text:
And their feet
were straight feet; and the sole of their feet
was like the sole of a calf’s foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.

translated_text:
And
they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.
original_text:
And
they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.

translated_text:
Their wings
were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.
original_text:
Their wings
were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.

translated_text: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.
original_text: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.

translated_text:
Thus
were their faces: and their wings
were stretched upward; two
wings of every one
were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.
original_text:
Thus
were their faces: and their wings
were stretched upward; two
wings of every one
were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.

translated_text:
And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went;
and they turned not when they went.
original_text:
And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went;
and they turned not when they went.

translated_text:
As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance
was like burning coals of fire,
and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
original_text:
As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance
was like burning coals of fire,
and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.

translated_text: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
original_text: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

translated_text: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.
original_text: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.

translated_text:
The appearance of the wheels and their work
was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
original_text:
The appearance of the wheels and their work
was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.

translated_text:
When they went, they went upon their four sides:
and they turned not when they went.
original_text:
When they went, they went upon their four sides:
and they turned not when they went.

translated_text:
As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings
were full of eyes round about them four.
original_text:
As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings
were full of eyes round about them four.

translated_text: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
original_text: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

translated_text:
Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither
was their
 spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature
was in the wheels.
original_text:
Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither
was their
 spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature
was in the wheels.

translated_text:
When those went,
these went; and when those stood,
these
 stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature
was
 in the wheels.
original_text:
When those went,
these went; and when those stood,
these
 stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature
was
 in the wheels.

translated_text:
And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature
was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.
original_text:
And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature
was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.

translated_text:
And under the firmament
were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.
original_text:
And under the firmament
were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.

translated_text: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.
original_text: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.

translated_text:
And there was a voice from the firmament that
was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.
original_text:
And there was a voice from the firmament that
was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.

translated_text:
And above the firmament that
was over their heads
was
 the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne
was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.
original_text:
And above the firmament that
was over their heads
was
 the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne
was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.

translated_text: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.
original_text: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.

translated_text:
As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so
was the appearance of the brightness round about. This
was
 the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw
it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.
original_text:
As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so
was the appearance of the brightness round about. This
was
 the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw
it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.

translated_text:
Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and pourtray upon it the city,
even Jerusalem:
original_text:
Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and pourtray upon it the city,
even Jerusalem:

translated_text:
And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set
battering rams against it round about.
original_text:
And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set
battering rams against it round about.

translated_text:
Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city: and set thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it. This
shall be a sign to the house of Israel.
original_text:
Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city: and set thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it. This
shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

translated_text:
Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it:
according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.
original_text:
Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it:
according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.

translated_text: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
original_text: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

translated_text: And when thou hast accomplished them, lie again on thy right side, and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year.
original_text: And when thou hast accomplished them, lie again on thy right side, and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year.

translated_text:
Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and thine arm
shall be uncovered, and thou shalt prophesy against it.
original_text:
Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and thine arm
shall be uncovered, and thou shalt prophesy against it.

translated_text: And, behold, I will lay bands upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another, till thou hast ended the days of thy siege.
original_text: And, behold, I will lay bands upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another, till thou hast ended the days of thy siege.

translated_text:
Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof,
according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof.
original_text:
Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof,
according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof.

translated_text:
And thy meat which thou shalt eat
shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat it.
original_text:
And thy meat which thou shalt eat
shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat it.

translated_text: Thou shalt drink also water by measure, the sixth part of an hin: from time to time shalt thou drink.
original_text: Thou shalt drink also water by measure, the sixth part of an hin: from time to time shalt thou drink.

translated_text:
And thou shalt eat it
as barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.
original_text:
And thou shalt eat it
as barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.

translated_text: And the LORD said, Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, whither I will drive them.
original_text: And the LORD said, Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, whither I will drive them.

translated_text: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! behold, my soul hath not been polluted: for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.
original_text: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! behold, my soul hath not been polluted: for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.

translated_text: Then he said unto me, Lo, I have given thee cow’s dung for man’s dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith.
original_text: Then he said unto me, Lo, I have given thee cow’s dung for man’s dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith.

translated_text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with care; and they shall drink water by measure, and with astonishment:
original_text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with care; and they shall drink water by measure, and with astonishment:

translated_text: That they may want bread and water, and be astonied one with another, and consume away for their iniquity.
original_text: That they may want bread and water, and be astonied one with another, and consume away for their iniquity.

translated_text:
And thou, son of man, take thee a sharp knife, take thee a barber’s razor, and cause
it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard: then take thee balances to weigh, and divide the
hair.
original_text:
And thou, son of man, take thee a sharp knife, take thee a barber’s razor, and cause
it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard: then take thee balances to weigh, and divide the
hair.

translated_text:
Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and thou shalt take a third part,
and
 smite about it with a knife: and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.
original_text:
Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and thou shalt take a third part,
and
 smite about it with a knife: and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.

translated_text: Thou shalt also take thereof a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts.
original_text: Thou shalt also take thereof a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts.

translated_text:
Then take of them again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire;
for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel.
original_text:
Then take of them again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire;
for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel.

translated_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; This
is Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries
that are round about her.
original_text:
Thus saith the Lord GOD; This
is Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries
that are round about her.

translated_text:
And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that
are round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.
original_text:
And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that
are round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that
are round about you,
and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that
are round about you;
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that
are round about you,
and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that
are round about you;

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I,
am against thee, and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations.
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I,
am against thee, and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations.

translated_text: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.
original_text: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.

translated_text: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in thee, and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds.
original_text: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in thee, and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds.

translated_text:
Wherefore,
as I live, saith the Lord GOD; Surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish
thee; neither shall mine eye spare, neither will I have any pity.
original_text:
Wherefore,
as I live, saith the Lord GOD; Surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish
thee; neither shall mine eye spare, neither will I have any pity.

translated_text: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.
original_text: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.

translated_text:
Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I the LORD have spoken
it in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.
original_text:
Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I the LORD have spoken
it in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.

translated_text:
Moreover I will make thee waste, and a reproach among the nations that
are round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.
original_text:
Moreover I will make thee waste, and a reproach among the nations that
are round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.

translated_text:
So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that
are round about thee, when I shall execute judgments in thee in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I the LORD have spoken
it.
original_text:
So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that
are round about thee, when I shall execute judgments in thee in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I the LORD have spoken
it.

translated_text:
When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for
their destruction,
and which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:
original_text:
When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for
their destruction,
and which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:

translated_text:
So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee. I the LORD have spoken
it.
original_text:
So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee. I the LORD have spoken
it.

translated_text: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee.
original_text: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee.

translated_text: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.
original_text: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.

translated_text:
And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me,
even unto this very day.
original_text:
And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me,
even unto this very day.

translated_text:
For
they are impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD.
original_text:
For
they are impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD.

translated_text:
And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they
are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.
original_text:
And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they
are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.

translated_text:
And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns
be with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they
be a rebellious house.
original_text:
And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns
be with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they
be a rebellious house.

translated_text:
And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they
are most rebellious.
original_text:
And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they
are most rebellious.

translated_text: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.
