original_text: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.

translated_text:
And he spread it before me; and it
was written within and without: and
there was written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.
original_text:
And he spread it before me; and it
was written within and without: and
there was written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.

translated_text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.
original_text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.

translated_text: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.
original_text: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.

translated_text:
And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat
it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
original_text:
And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat
it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.

translated_text: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.
original_text: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.

translated_text: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee.
original_text: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee.

translated_text:
But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel
are impudent and hardhearted.
original_text:
But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel
are impudent and hardhearted.

translated_text: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.
original_text: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.

translated_text:
As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they
be a rebellious house.
original_text:
As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they
be a rebellious house.

translated_text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.
original_text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.

translated_text: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.
original_text: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.

translated_text:
Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing,
saying, Blessed
be the glory of the LORD from his place.
original_text:
Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing,
saying, Blessed
be the glory of the LORD from his place.

translated_text: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.
original_text: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.

translated_text: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.
original_text: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.

translated_text: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel-abib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.
original_text: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel-abib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.

translated_text: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.
original_text: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

translated_text:
When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked
man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
original_text:
When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked
man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

translated_text: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
original_text: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

translated_text:
Again, When a righteous
man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
original_text:
Again, When a righteous
man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

translated_text:
Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous
man, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.
original_text:
Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous
man, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.

translated_text: And the hand of the LORD was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.
original_text: And the hand of the LORD was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.

translated_text: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.
original_text: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.

translated_text: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.
original_text: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.

translated_text: But thou, O son of man, behold, they shall put bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:
original_text: But thou, O son of man, behold, they shall put bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:

translated_text:
And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they
are
 a rebellious house.
original_text:
And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they
are
 a rebellious house.

translated_text:
But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they
are a rebellious house.
original_text:
But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they
are a rebellious house.

translated_text:
And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth
month,
 in the fifth
day of the month,
as I sat in mine house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.
original_text:
And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth
month,
 in the fifth
day of the month,
as I sat in mine house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.

translated_text: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.
original_text: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.

translated_text:
And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of mine head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north; where
was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.
original_text:
And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of mine head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north; where
was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.

translated_text:
And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel
was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.
original_text:
And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel
was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.

translated_text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.
original_text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.

translated_text:
He said furthermore unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do?
even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn thee yet again,
and thou shalt see greater abominations.
original_text:
He said furthermore unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do?
even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn thee yet again,
and thou shalt see greater abominations.

translated_text: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.
original_text: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.

translated_text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.
original_text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.

translated_text: And he said unto me, Go in, and behold the wicked abominations that they do here.
original_text: And he said unto me, Go in, and behold the wicked abominations that they do here.

translated_text: So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, pourtrayed upon the wall round about.
original_text: So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, pourtrayed upon the wall round about.

translated_text: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel, and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.
original_text: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel, and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.

translated_text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The LORD seeth us not; the LORD hath forsaken the earth.
original_text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The LORD seeth us not; the LORD hath forsaken the earth.

translated_text:
He said also unto me, Turn thee yet again,
and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do.
original_text:
He said also unto me, Turn thee yet again,
and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do.

translated_text:
Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’S house which
was toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.
original_text:
Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’S house which
was toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.

translated_text:
Then said he unto me, Hast thou seen
this, O son of man? turn thee yet again,
and thou shalt see greater abominations than these.
original_text:
Then said he unto me, Hast thou seen
this, O son of man? turn thee yet again,
and thou shalt see greater abominations than these.

translated_text:
And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD’S house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of the LORD, between the porch and the altar,
were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the LORD, and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.
original_text:
And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD’S house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of the LORD, between the porch and the altar,
were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the LORD, and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.

translated_text:
Then he said unto me, Hast thou seen
this, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.
original_text:
Then he said unto me, Hast thou seen
this, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.

translated_text:
Therefore will I also deal in fury: mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice,
yet will I not hear them.
original_text:
Therefore will I also deal in fury: mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice,
yet will I not hear them.

translated_text:
He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man
with his destroying weapon in his hand.
original_text:
He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man
with his destroying weapon in his hand.

translated_text:
And, behold, six men came from the way of the higher gate, which lieth toward the north, and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man among them
was clothed with linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side: and they went in, and stood beside the brasen altar.
original_text:
And, behold, six men came from the way of the higher gate, which lieth toward the north, and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man among them
was clothed with linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side: and they went in, and stood beside the brasen altar.

translated_text:
And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which
had the writer’s inkhorn by his side;
original_text:
And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which
had the writer’s inkhorn by his side;

translated_text: And the LORD said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.
original_text: And the LORD said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.

translated_text: And to the others he said in mine hearing, Go ye after him through the city, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have ye pity:
original_text: And to the others he said in mine hearing, Go ye after him through the city, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have ye pity:

translated_text:
Slay utterly old
and young, both maids, and little children, and women: but come not near any man upon whom
is the mark; and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the ancient men which
were
 before the house.
original_text:
Slay utterly old
and young, both maids, and little children, and women: but come not near any man upon whom
is the mark; and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the ancient men which
were
 before the house.

translated_text: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.
original_text: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.

translated_text: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem?
original_text: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem?

translated_text:
Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah
is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, The LORD hath forsaken the earth, and the LORD seeth not.
original_text:
Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah
is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, The LORD hath forsaken the earth, and the LORD seeth not.

translated_text:
And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity,
but I will recompense their way upon their head.
original_text:
And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity,
but I will recompense their way upon their head.

translated_text:
And, behold, the man clothed with linen, which
had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as thou hast commanded me.
original_text:
And, behold, the man clothed with linen, which
had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as thou hast commanded me.

translated_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Son of man, set thy face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them,
original_text: Son of man, set thy face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them,

translated_text:
And say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys; Behold, I,
even I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.
original_text:
And say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys; Behold, I,
even I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.

translated_text:
And your altars shall be desolate, and your images shall be broken: and I will cast down your slain
men before your idols.
original_text:
And your altars shall be desolate, and your images shall be broken: and I will cast down your slain
men before your idols.

translated_text: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.
original_text: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.

translated_text: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.
original_text: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.

translated_text:
And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have
some that shall escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.
original_text:
Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have
some that shall escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.

translated_text: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their whorish heart, which hath departed from me, and with their eyes, which go a whoring after their idols: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.
original_text: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their whorish heart, which hath departed from me, and with their eyes, which go a whoring after their idols: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

translated_text:
And they shall know that I
am the LORD,
and that
 I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them.
original_text:
And they shall know that I
am the LORD,
and that
 I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them.

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Smite with thine hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Smite with thine hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

translated_text: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.
original_text: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.

translated_text:
Then shall ye know that I
am the LORD, when their slain
men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.
original_text:
Then shall ye know that I
am the LORD, when their slain
men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.

translated_text:
So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate, yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all their habitations: and they shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate, yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all their habitations: and they shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
original_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

translated_text: Also, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD unto the land of Israel; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.
original_text: Also, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD unto the land of Israel; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.

translated_text:
Now
is the end
come upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations.
original_text:
Now
is the end
come upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations.

translated_text:
And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.
original_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.

translated_text: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come.
original_text: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come.

translated_text:
The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble
is near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.
original_text:
The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble
is near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.

translated_text: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish mine anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thine abominations.
original_text: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish mine anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thine abominations.

translated_text:
And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations
that are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I
am the LORD that smiteth.
original_text:
And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations
that are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I
am the LORD that smiteth.

translated_text: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.
original_text: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.

translated_text:
Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them
shall remain, nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither
shall there be wailing for them.
original_text:
Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them
shall remain, nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither
shall there be wailing for them.

translated_text:
The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath
is upon all the multitude thereof.
original_text:
The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath
is upon all the multitude thereof.

translated_text:
For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision
is touching the whole multitude thereof,
which shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
original_text:
For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision
is touching the whole multitude thereof,
which shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.

translated_text:
They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath
is upon all the multitude thereof.
original_text:
They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath
is upon all the multitude thereof.

translated_text:
The sword
is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that
is in the field shall die with the sword; and he that
is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
original_text:
The sword
is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that
is in the field shall die with the sword; and he that
is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.

translated_text: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.
original_text: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.

translated_text:
All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak
as
 water.
original_text:
All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak
as
 water.

translated_text:
They shall also gird
themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame
shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.
original_text:
They shall also gird
themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame
shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.

translated_text: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.
original_text: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.

translated_text:
As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations
and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.
original_text:
As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations
and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.

translated_text: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.
original_text: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.

translated_text:
My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret
place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.
original_text:
My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret
place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.

translated_text: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
original_text: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

translated_text: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.
original_text: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.

translated_text:
Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and
there shall be
 none.
original_text:
Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and
there shall be
 none.

translated_text: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.
original_text: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.

translated_text:
The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I
am the LORD.
original_text:
The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I
am the LORD.

translated_text:
In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me,
even unto me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.
original_text:
In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me,
even unto me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.

translated_text:
And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I
was at Shushan
in the palace, which
is in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.
original_text:
And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I
was at Shushan
in the palace, which
is in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.

translated_text:
Then I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had
two horns: and the
two horns
were high; but one
was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.
original_text:
Then I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had
two horns: and the
two horns
were high; but one
was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.

translated_text:
I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither
was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.
original_text:
I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither
was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.

translated_text:
And as I was considering, behold, an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat
had
 a notable horn between his eyes.
original_text:
And as I was considering, behold, an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat
had
 a notable horn between his eyes.

translated_text:
And he came to the ram that had
two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.
original_text:
And he came to the ram that had
two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.

translated_text: And I saw him come close unto the ram, and he was moved with choler against him, and smote the ram, and brake his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.
original_text: And I saw him come close unto the ram, and he was moved with choler against him, and smote the ram, and brake his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.

translated_text: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.
original_text: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.

translated_text:
And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant
land.
original_text:
And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant
land.

translated_text:
And it waxed great,
even to the host of heaven; and it cast down
some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.
original_text:
And it waxed great,
even to the host of heaven; and it cast down
some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.

translated_text:
Yea, he magnified
himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily
sacrifice was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.
original_text:
Yea, he magnified
himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily
sacrifice was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.

translated_text:
And an host was given
him against the daily
sacrifice
 by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.
original_text:
And an host was given
him against the daily
sacrifice
 by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.

translated_text:
Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain
saint which spake, How long
shall be the vision
concerning the daily
sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?
original_text:
Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain
saint which spake, How long
shall be the vision
concerning the daily
sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?

translated_text: And he said unto me, Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.
original_text: And he said unto me, Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.

translated_text:
And it came to pass, when I,
even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.
original_text:
And it came to pass, when I,
even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.

translated_text:
And I heard a man’s voice between
the banks of Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this
man to understand the vision.
original_text:
And I heard a man’s voice between
the banks of Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this
man to understand the vision.

translated_text:
So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of man: for at the time of the end
shall be the vision.
original_text:
So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of man: for at the time of the end
shall be the vision.

translated_text: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.
original_text: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.

translated_text:
And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end
shall be.
original_text:
And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end
shall be.

translated_text:
The ram which thou sawest having
two horns
are
 the kings of Media and Persia.
original_text:
The ram which thou sawest having
two horns
are
 the kings of Media and Persia.

translated_text:
And the rough goat
is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that
is between his eyes
is the first king.
original_text:
And the rough goat
is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that
is between his eyes
is the first king.

translated_text: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.
original_text: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.

translated_text: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.
original_text: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.

translated_text: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.
original_text: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.

translated_text:
And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify
himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.
original_text:
And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify
himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.

translated_text:
And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told
is
 true: wherefore shut thou up the vision; for it
shall be
 for many days.
original_text:
And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told
is
 true: wherefore shut thou up the vision; for it
shall be
 for many days.

translated_text:
And I Daniel fainted, and was sick
certain days; afterward I rose up, and did the king’s business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood
it.
original_text:
And I Daniel fainted, and was sick
certain days; afterward I rose up, and did the king’s business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood
it.

translated_text: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;
original_text: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;

translated_text: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, whereof the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.
original_text: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, whereof the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.

translated_text: And I set my face unto the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:
original_text: And I set my face unto the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:

translated_text: And I prayed unto the LORD my God, and made my confession, and said, O Lord, the great and dreadful God, keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;
original_text: And I prayed unto the LORD my God, and made my confession, and said, O Lord, the great and dreadful God, keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;

translated_text: We have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments:
original_text: We have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments:

translated_text: Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets, which spake in thy name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.
original_text: Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets, which spake in thy name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

translated_text:
O Lord, righteousness
belongeth unto thee, but unto us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Israel,
that are near, and
that are far off, through all the countries whither thou hast driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee.
original_text:
O Lord, righteousness
belongeth unto thee, but unto us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Israel,
that are near, and
that are far off, through all the countries whither thou hast driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee.

translated_text:
O Lord, to us
belongeth confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against thee.
original_text:
O Lord, to us
belongeth confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against thee.

translated_text:
To the Lord our God
belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;
original_text:
To the Lord our God
belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;

translated_text: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the LORD our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.
original_text: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the LORD our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

translated_text:
Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that
is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.
original_text:
Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that
is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.

translated_text: And he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.
original_text: And he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.

translated_text:
As
it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet made we not our prayer before the LORD our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand thy truth.
original_text:
As
it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet made we not our prayer before the LORD our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand thy truth.

translated_text:
Therefore hath the LORD watched upon the evil, and brought it upon us: for the LORD our God
is righteous in all his works which he doeth: for we obeyed not his voice.
original_text:
Therefore hath the LORD watched upon the evil, and brought it upon us: for the LORD our God
is righteous in all his works which he doeth: for we obeyed not his voice.

translated_text: And now, O Lord our God, that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and hast gotten thee renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.
original_text: And now, O Lord our God, that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and hast gotten thee renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.

translated_text:
O Lord, according to all thy righteousness, I beseech thee, let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem, thy holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and thy people
are become a reproach to all
that are about us.
original_text:
O Lord, according to all thy righteousness, I beseech thee, let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem, thy holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and thy people
are become a reproach to all
that are about us.

translated_text: Now therefore, O our God, hear the prayer of thy servant, and his supplications, and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.
original_text: Now therefore, O our God, hear the prayer of thy servant, and his supplications, and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.

translated_text: O my God, incline thine ear, and hear; open thine eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by thy name: for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses, but for thy great mercies.
original_text: O my God, incline thine ear, and hear; open thine eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by thy name: for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses, but for thy great mercies.

translated_text: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, hearken and do; defer not, for thine own sake, O my God: for thy city and thy people are called by thy name.
original_text: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, hearken and do; defer not, for thine own sake, O my God: for thy city and thy people are called by thy name.

translated_text:
And whiles I
was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God;
original_text:
And whiles I
was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God;

translated_text:
Yea, whiles I
was speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.
original_text:
Yea, whiles I
was speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.

translated_text:
And he informed
me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding.
original_text:
And he informed
me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding.

translated_text:
At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth, and I am come to shew
thee; for thou
art greatly beloved: therefore understand the matter, and consider the vision.
original_text:
At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth, and I am come to shew
thee; for thou
art greatly beloved: therefore understand the matter, and consider the vision.

translated_text: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.
original_text: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.

translated_text:
Know therefore and understand,
that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince
shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.
original_text:
Know therefore and understand,
that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince
shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.

translated_text:
And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof
shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.
original_text:
And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof
shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.

translated_text:
And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make
it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.
original_text:
And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make
it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.

translated_text: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom an hundred and twenty princes, which should be over the whole kingdom;
original_text: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom an hundred and twenty princes, which should be over the whole kingdom;

translated_text:
And over these three presidents; of whom Daniel
was first: that the princes might give accounts unto them, and the king should have no damage.
original_text:
And over these three presidents; of whom Daniel
was first: that the princes might give accounts unto them, and the king should have no damage.

translated_text:
Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes, because an excellent spirit
was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.
original_text:
Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes, because an excellent spirit
was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.

translated_text:
Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find none occasion nor fault; forasmuch as he
was faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.
original_text:
Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find none occasion nor fault; forasmuch as he
was faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.

translated_text:
Then said these men, We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel, except we find
it against him concerning the law of his God.
original_text:
Then said these men, We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel, except we find
it against him concerning the law of his God.

translated_text: Then these presidents and princes assembled together to the king, and said thus unto him, King Darius, live for ever.
original_text: Then these presidents and princes assembled together to the king, and said thus unto him, King Darius, live for ever.

translated_text: All the presidents of the kingdom, the governors, and the princes, the counsellors, and the captains, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a firm decree, that whosoever shall ask a petition of any God or man for thirty days, save of thee, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.
original_text: All the presidents of the kingdom, the governors, and the princes, the counsellors, and the captains, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a firm decree, that whosoever shall ask a petition of any God or man for thirty days, save of thee, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.

translated_text: Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing, that it be not changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.
original_text: Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing, that it be not changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.

translated_text: Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree.
original_text: Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree.

translated_text: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.
original_text: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.

translated_text: Then these men assembled, and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God.
original_text: Then these men assembled, and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God.

translated_text:
Then they came near, and spake before the king concerning the king’s decree; Hast thou not signed a decree, that every man that shall ask
a petition of any God or man within thirty days, save of thee, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions? The king answered and said, The thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.
original_text:
Then they came near, and spake before the king concerning the king’s decree; Hast thou not signed a decree, that every man that shall ask
a petition of any God or man within thirty days, save of thee, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions? The king answered and said, The thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.

translated_text:
Then answered they and said before the king, That Daniel, which
is of the children of the captivity of Judah, regardeth not thee, O king, nor the decree that thou hast signed, but maketh his petition three times a day.
original_text:
Then answered they and said before the king, That Daniel, which
is of the children of the captivity of Judah, regardeth not thee, O king, nor the decree that thou hast signed, but maketh his petition three times a day.

translated_text:
Then the king, when he heard
these words, was sore displeased with himself, and set
his heart on Daniel to deliver him: and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him.
original_text:
Then the king, when he heard
these words, was sore displeased with himself, and set
his heart on Daniel to deliver him: and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him.

translated_text:
Then these men assembled unto the king, and said unto the king, Know, O king, that the law of the Medes and Persians
is, That no decree nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed.
original_text:
Then these men assembled unto the king, and said unto the king, Know, O king, that the law of the Medes and Persians
is, That no decree nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed.

translated_text:
Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast
him
 into the den of lions.
Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.
original_text:
Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast
him
 into the den of lions.
Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.

translated_text: And a stone was brought and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.
original_text: And a stone was brought and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.

translated_text: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting: neither were instruments of musick brought before him: and his sleep went from him.
original_text: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting: neither were instruments of musick brought before him: and his sleep went from him.

translated_text: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste unto the den of lions.
original_text: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste unto the den of lions.

translated_text:
And when he came to the den, he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel:
and the king spake and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living God, is thy God, whom thou servest continually, able to deliver thee from the lions?
original_text:
And when he came to the den, he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel:
and the king spake and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living God, is thy God, whom thou servest continually, able to deliver thee from the lions?

translated_text: Then said Daniel unto the king, O king, live for ever.
original_text: Then said Daniel unto the king, O king, live for ever.

translated_text: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.
original_text: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.

translated_text: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his God.
original_text: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his God.

translated_text:
And the king commanded, and they brought those men which had accused Daniel, and they cast
them into the den of lions, them, their children, and their wives; and the lions had the mastery of them, and brake all their bones in pieces or ever they came at the bottom of the den.
original_text:
And the king commanded, and they brought those men which had accused Daniel, and they cast
them into the den of lions, them, their children, and their wives; and the lions had the mastery of them, and brake all their bones in pieces or ever they came at the bottom of the den.

translated_text: Then king Darius wrote unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.
original_text: Then king Darius wrote unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.

translated_text:
I make a decree, That in every dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel: for he is the living God, and stedfast for ever, and his kingdom
that which shall not be destroyed, and his dominion
shall be even unto the end.
original_text:
I make a decree, That in every dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel: for he is the living God, and stedfast for ever, and his kingdom
that which shall not be destroyed, and his dominion
shall be even unto the end.

translated_text: He delivereth and rescueth, and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and in earth, who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.
original_text: He delivereth and rescueth, and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and in earth, who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.

translated_text: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.
original_text: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

translated_text:
In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed: then he wrote the dream,
and
 told the sum of the matters.
original_text:
In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed: then he wrote the dream,
and
 told the sum of the matters.

translated_text: Daniel spake and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea.
original_text: Daniel spake and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea.

translated_text: And four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another.
original_text: And four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another.

translated_text:
The first
was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings: I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth, and made stand upon the feet as a man, and a man’s heart was given to it.
original_text:
The first
was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings: I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth, and made stand upon the feet as a man, and a man’s heart was given to it.

translated_text:
And behold another beast, a second, like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and
it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it: and they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh.
original_text:
And behold another beast, a second, like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and
it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it: and they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh.

translated_text: After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.
original_text: After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.

translated_text:
After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it
was diverse from all the beasts that
were before it; and it had ten horns.
original_text:
After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it
was diverse from all the beasts that
were before it; and it had ten horns.

translated_text:
I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another little horn, before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots: and, behold, in this horn
were eyes like the eyes of man, and a mouth speaking great things.
original_text:
I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another little horn, before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots: and, behold, in this horn
were eyes like the eyes of man, and a mouth speaking great things.

translated_text:
I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment
was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne
was like the fiery flame,
and
 his wheels
as burning fire.
original_text:
I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment
was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne
was like the fiery flame,
and
 his wheels
as burning fire.

translated_text: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.
original_text: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

translated_text:
I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld
even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.
original_text:
I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld
even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.

translated_text: As concerning the rest of the beasts, they had their dominion taken away: yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time.
original_text: As concerning the rest of the beasts, they had their dominion taken away: yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time.

translated_text:
I saw in the night visions, and, behold,
one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.
original_text:
I saw in the night visions, and, behold,
one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

translated_text:
And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion
is
 an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom
that which shall not be destroyed.
original_text:
And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion
is
 an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom
that which shall not be destroyed.

translated_text:
I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of
my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.
original_text:
I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of
my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.

translated_text: I came near unto one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth of all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.
original_text: I came near unto one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth of all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.

translated_text:
These great beasts, which are four,
are four kings,
which shall arise out of the earth.
original_text:
These great beasts, which are four,
are four kings,
which shall arise out of the earth.

translated_text: But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.
original_text: But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.

translated_text:
And of the ten horns that
were in his head, and
of
 the other which came up, and before whom three fell; even
of
 that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things, whose look
was more stout than his fellows.
original_text:
And of the ten horns that
were in his head, and
of
 the other which came up, and before whom three fell; even
of
 that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things, whose look
was more stout than his fellows.

translated_text: I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them;
original_text: I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them;

translated_text: Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.
original_text: Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.

translated_text: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.
original_text: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.

translated_text:
And the ten horns out of this kingdom
are ten kings
that shall arise: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings.
original_text:
And the ten horns out of this kingdom
are ten kings
that shall arise: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings.

translated_text:
And he shall speak
great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.
original_text:
And he shall speak
great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.

translated_text:
But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy
it unto the end.
original_text:
But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy
it unto the end.

translated_text:
And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom
is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.
original_text:
And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom
is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.

translated_text:
Hitherto
is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.
original_text:
Hitherto
is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.

translated_text: Nebuchadnezzar the king, unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.
original_text: Nebuchadnezzar the king, unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.

translated_text: I thought it good to shew the signs and wonders that the high God hath wrought toward me.
original_text: I thought it good to shew the signs and wonders that the high God hath wrought toward me.

translated_text:
How great
are his signs! and how mighty
are his wonders! his kingdom
is an everlasting kingdom, and his dominion
is from generation to generation.
original_text:
How great
are his signs! and how mighty
are his wonders! his kingdom
is an everlasting kingdom, and his dominion
is from generation to generation.

translated_text: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house, and flourishing in my palace:
original_text: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house, and flourishing in my palace:

translated_text: I saw a dream which made me afraid, and the thoughts upon my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.
original_text: I saw a dream which made me afraid, and the thoughts upon my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.

translated_text:
Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise
men of Babylon before me, that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream.
original_text:
Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise
men of Babylon before me, that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream.

translated_text: Then came in the magicians, the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers: and I told the dream before them; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof.
original_text: Then came in the magicians, the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers: and I told the dream before them; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof.

translated_text:
But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name
was Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods: and before him I told the dream,
saying,
original_text:
But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name
was Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods: and before him I told the dream,
saying,

translated_text:
O Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods
is in thee, and no secret troubleth thee, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and the interpretation thereof.
original_text:
O Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods
is in thee, and no secret troubleth thee, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and the interpretation thereof.
