translated_text:
Thus
were the visions of mine head in my bed; I saw, and behold a tree in the midst of the earth, and the height thereof
was
 great.
original_text:
Thus
were the visions of mine head in my bed; I saw, and behold a tree in the midst of the earth, and the height thereof
was
 great.

translated_text: The tree grew, and was strong, and the height thereof reached unto heaven, and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth:
original_text: The tree grew, and was strong, and the height thereof reached unto heaven, and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth:

translated_text:
The leaves thereof
were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it
was meat for all: the beasts of the field had shadow under it, and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs thereof, and all flesh was fed of it.
original_text:
The leaves thereof
were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it
was meat for all: the beasts of the field had shadow under it, and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs thereof, and all flesh was fed of it.

translated_text: I saw in the visions of my head upon my bed, and, behold, a watcher and an holy one came down from heaven;
original_text: I saw in the visions of my head upon my bed, and, behold, a watcher and an holy one came down from heaven;

translated_text: He cried aloud, and said thus, Hew down the tree, and cut off his branches, shake off his leaves, and scatter his fruit: let the beasts get away from under it, and the fowls from his branches:
original_text: He cried aloud, and said thus, Hew down the tree, and cut off his branches, shake off his leaves, and scatter his fruit: let the beasts get away from under it, and the fowls from his branches:

translated_text:
Nevertheless leave the stump of his roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and
let his portion
be with the beasts in the grass of the earth:
original_text:
Nevertheless leave the stump of his roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and
let his portion
be with the beasts in the grass of the earth:

translated_text: Let his heart be changed from man’s, and let a beast’s heart be given unto him; and let seven times pass over him.
original_text: Let his heart be changed from man’s, and let a beast’s heart be given unto him; and let seven times pass over him.

translated_text:
This matter
is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.
original_text:
This matter
is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.

translated_text:
This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen. Now thou, O Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation thereof, forasmuch as all the wise
men
 of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation: but thou
art able; for the spirit of the holy gods
is in thee.
original_text:
This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen. Now thou, O Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation thereof, forasmuch as all the wise
men
 of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation: but thou
art able; for the spirit of the holy gods
is in thee.

translated_text:
Then Daniel, whose name
was Belteshazzar, was astonied for one hour, and his thoughts troubled him. The king spake, and said, Belteshazzar, let not the dream, or the interpretation thereof, trouble thee. Belteshazzar answered and said, My lord, the dream
be to them that hate thee, and the interpretation thereof to thine enemies.
original_text:
Then Daniel, whose name
was Belteshazzar, was astonied for one hour, and his thoughts troubled him. The king spake, and said, Belteshazzar, let not the dream, or the interpretation thereof, trouble thee. Belteshazzar answered and said, My lord, the dream
be to them that hate thee, and the interpretation thereof to thine enemies.

translated_text: The tree that thou sawest, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached unto the heaven, and the sight thereof to all the earth;
original_text: The tree that thou sawest, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached unto the heaven, and the sight thereof to all the earth;

translated_text:
Whose leaves
were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it
was meat for all; under which the beasts of the field dwelt, and upon whose branches the fowls of the heaven had their habitation:
original_text:
Whose leaves
were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it
was meat for all; under which the beasts of the field dwelt, and upon whose branches the fowls of the heaven had their habitation:

translated_text:
It
is thou, O king, that art grown and become strong: for thy greatness is grown, and reacheth unto heaven, and thy dominion to the end of the earth.
original_text:
It
is thou, O king, that art grown and become strong: for thy greatness is grown, and reacheth unto heaven, and thy dominion to the end of the earth.

translated_text:
This
is the interpretation, O king, and this
is
 the decree of the most High, which is come upon my lord the king:
original_text:
This
is the interpretation, O king, and this
is
 the decree of the most High, which is come upon my lord the king:

translated_text: That they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field, and they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and they shall wet thee with the dew of heaven, and seven times shall pass over thee, till thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.
original_text: That they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field, and they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and they shall wet thee with the dew of heaven, and seven times shall pass over thee, till thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.

translated_text: And whereas they commanded to leave the stump of the tree roots; thy kingdom shall be sure unto thee, after that thou shalt have known that the heavens do rule.
original_text: And whereas they commanded to leave the stump of the tree roots; thy kingdom shall be sure unto thee, after that thou shalt have known that the heavens do rule.

translated_text: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee, and break off thy sins by righteousness, and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquility.
original_text: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee, and break off thy sins by righteousness, and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquility.

translated_text: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar.
original_text: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar.

translated_text: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.
original_text: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.

translated_text: The king spake, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?
original_text: The king spake, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?

translated_text:
While the word
was in the king’s mouth, there fell a voice from heaven,
saying, O king Nebuchadnezzar, to thee it is spoken; The kingdom is departed from thee.
original_text:
While the word
was in the king’s mouth, there fell a voice from heaven,
saying, O king Nebuchadnezzar, to thee it is spoken; The kingdom is departed from thee.

translated_text:
And they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling
shall be
 with the beasts of the field: they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and seven times shall pass over thee, until thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.
original_text:
And they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling
shall be
 with the beasts of the field: they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and seven times shall pass over thee, until thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.

translated_text:
The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar: and he was driven from men, and did eat grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven, till his hairs were grown like eagles
feathers, and his nails like birds’
claws.
original_text:
The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar: and he was driven from men, and did eat grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven, till his hairs were grown like eagles
feathers, and his nails like birds’
claws.

translated_text:
And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven, and mine understanding returned unto me, and I blessed the most High, and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever, whose dominion
is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom
is from generation to generation:
original_text:
And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven, and mine understanding returned unto me, and I blessed the most High, and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever, whose dominion
is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom
is from generation to generation:

translated_text:
And all the inhabitants of the earth
are reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and
among
 the inhabitants of the earth: and none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou?
original_text:
And all the inhabitants of the earth
are reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and
among
 the inhabitants of the earth: and none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou?

translated_text: At the same time my reason returned unto me; and for the glory of my kingdom, mine honour and brightness returned unto me; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent majesty was added unto me.
original_text: At the same time my reason returned unto me; and for the glory of my kingdom, mine honour and brightness returned unto me; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent majesty was added unto me.

translated_text:
Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven, all whose works
are truth, and his ways judgment: and those that walk in pride he is able to abase.
original_text:
Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven, all whose works
are truth, and his ways judgment: and those that walk in pride he is able to abase.

translated_text: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.
original_text: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.

translated_text:
Belshazzar, whiles he tasted the wine, commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple which
was in Jerusalem; that the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, might drink therein.
original_text:
Belshazzar, whiles he tasted the wine, commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple which
was in Jerusalem; that the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, might drink therein.

translated_text:
Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God which
was at Jerusalem; and the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, drank in them.
original_text:
Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God which
was at Jerusalem; and the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, drank in them.

translated_text: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of brass, of iron, of wood, and of stone.
original_text: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of brass, of iron, of wood, and of stone.

translated_text: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man’s hand, and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaister of the wall of the king’s palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.
original_text: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man’s hand, and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaister of the wall of the king’s palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.

translated_text: Then the king’s countenance was changed, and his thoughts troubled him, so that the joints of his loins were loosed, and his knees smote one against another.
original_text: Then the king’s countenance was changed, and his thoughts troubled him, so that the joints of his loins were loosed, and his knees smote one against another.

translated_text:
The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers.
And the king spake, and said to the wise
men
 of Babylon, Whosoever shall read this writing, and shew me the interpretation thereof, shall be clothed with scarlet, and
have
 a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.
original_text:
The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers.
And the king spake, and said to the wise
men
 of Babylon, Whosoever shall read this writing, and shew me the interpretation thereof, shall be clothed with scarlet, and
have
 a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.

translated_text:
Then came in all the king’s wise
men: but they could not read the writing, nor make known to the king the interpretation thereof.
original_text:
Then came in all the king’s wise
men: but they could not read the writing, nor make known to the king the interpretation thereof.

translated_text: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled, and his countenance was changed in him, and his lords were astonied.
original_text: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled, and his countenance was changed in him, and his lords were astonied.

translated_text:
Now the queen, by reason of the words of the king and his lords, came into the banquet house:
and the queen spake and said, O king, live for ever: let not thy thoughts trouble thee, nor let thy countenance be changed:
original_text:
Now the queen, by reason of the words of the king and his lords, came into the banquet house:
and the queen spake and said, O king, live for ever: let not thy thoughts trouble thee, nor let thy countenance be changed:

translated_text:
There is a man in thy kingdom, in whom
is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, was found in him; whom the king Nebuchadnezzar thy father, the king,
I say, thy father, made master of the magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans,
and soothsayers;
original_text:
There is a man in thy kingdom, in whom
is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, was found in him; whom the king Nebuchadnezzar thy father, the king,
I say, thy father, made master of the magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans,
and soothsayers;

translated_text: Forasmuch as an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, interpreting of dreams, and shewing of hard sentences, and dissolving of doubts, were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar: now let Daniel be called, and he will shew the interpretation.
original_text: Forasmuch as an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, interpreting of dreams, and shewing of hard sentences, and dissolving of doubts, were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar: now let Daniel be called, and he will shew the interpretation.

translated_text:
Then was Daniel brought in before the king.
And the king spake and said unto Daniel,
Art thou that Daniel, which
art
 of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Jewry?
original_text:
Then was Daniel brought in before the king.
And the king spake and said unto Daniel,
Art thou that Daniel, which
art
 of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Jewry?

translated_text:
I have even heard of thee, that the spirit of the gods
is
 in thee, and
that light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in thee.
original_text:
I have even heard of thee, that the spirit of the gods
is
 in thee, and
that light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in thee.

translated_text:
And now the wise
men, the astrologers, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known unto me the interpretation thereof: but they could not shew the interpretation of the thing:
original_text:
And now the wise
men, the astrologers, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known unto me the interpretation thereof: but they could not shew the interpretation of the thing:

translated_text:
And I have heard of thee, that thou canst make interpretations, and dissolve doubts: now if thou canst read the writing, and make known to me the interpretation thereof, thou shalt be clothed with scarlet, and
have
 a chain of gold about thy neck, and shalt be the third ruler in the kingdom.
original_text:
And I have heard of thee, that thou canst make interpretations, and dissolve doubts: now if thou canst read the writing, and make known to me the interpretation thereof, thou shalt be clothed with scarlet, and
have
 a chain of gold about thy neck, and shalt be the third ruler in the kingdom.

translated_text: Then Daniel answered and said before the king, Let thy gifts be to thyself, and give thy rewards to another; yet I will read the writing unto the king, and make known to him the interpretation.
original_text: Then Daniel answered and said before the king, Let thy gifts be to thyself, and give thy rewards to another; yet I will read the writing unto the king, and make known to him the interpretation.

translated_text: O thou king, the most high God gave Nebuchadnezzar thy father a kingdom, and majesty, and glory, and honour:
original_text: O thou king, the most high God gave Nebuchadnezzar thy father a kingdom, and majesty, and glory, and honour:

translated_text: And for the majesty that he gave him, all people, nations, and languages, trembled and feared before him: whom he would he slew; and whom he would he kept alive; and whom he would he set up; and whom he would he put down.
original_text: And for the majesty that he gave him, all people, nations, and languages, trembled and feared before him: whom he would he slew; and whom he would he kept alive; and whom he would he set up; and whom he would he put down.

translated_text: But when his heart was lifted up, and his mind hardened in pride, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him:
original_text: But when his heart was lifted up, and his mind hardened in pride, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him:

translated_text:
And he was driven from the sons of men; and his heart was made like the beasts, and his dwelling
was with the wild asses: they fed him with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven; till he knew that the most high God ruled in the kingdom of men, and
that he appointeth over it whomsoever he will.
original_text:
And he was driven from the sons of men; and his heart was made like the beasts, and his dwelling
was with the wild asses: they fed him with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven; till he knew that the most high God ruled in the kingdom of men, and
that he appointeth over it whomsoever he will.

translated_text: And thou his son, O Belshazzar, hast not humbled thine heart, though thou knewest all this;
original_text: And thou his son, O Belshazzar, hast not humbled thine heart, though thou knewest all this;

translated_text:
But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee, and thou, and thy lords, thy wives, and thy concubines, have drunk wine in them; and thou hast praised the gods of silver, and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor know: and the God in whose hand thy breath
is, and whose
are all thy ways, hast thou not glorified:
original_text:
But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee, and thou, and thy lords, thy wives, and thy concubines, have drunk wine in them; and thou hast praised the gods of silver, and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor know: and the God in whose hand thy breath
is, and whose
are all thy ways, hast thou not glorified:

translated_text: Then was the part of the hand sent from him; and this writing was written.
original_text: Then was the part of the hand sent from him; and this writing was written.

translated_text:
And this
is the writing that was written, MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.
original_text:
And this
is the writing that was written, MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.

translated_text:
This
is the interpretation of the thing: MENE; God hath numbered thy kingdom, and finished it.
original_text:
This
is the interpretation of the thing: MENE; God hath numbered thy kingdom, and finished it.

translated_text: TEKEL; Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.
original_text: TEKEL; Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.

translated_text: PERES; Thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.
original_text: PERES; Thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.

translated_text:
Then commanded Belshazzar, and they clothed Daniel with scarlet, and
put a chain of gold about his neck, and made a proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.
original_text:
Then commanded Belshazzar, and they clothed Daniel with scarlet, and
put a chain of gold about his neck, and made a proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.

translated_text: In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain.
original_text: In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain.

translated_text:
And Darius the Median took the kingdom,
being about threescore and two years old.
original_text:
And Darius the Median took the kingdom,
being about threescore and two years old.

translated_text: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake from him.
original_text: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake from him.

translated_text: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the astrologers, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, for to shew the king his dreams. So they came and stood before the king.
original_text: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the astrologers, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, for to shew the king his dreams. So they came and stood before the king.

translated_text: And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.
original_text: And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.

translated_text: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack, O king, live for ever: tell thy servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation.
original_text: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack, O king, live for ever: tell thy servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation.

translated_text: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if ye will not make known unto me the dream, with the interpretation thereof, ye shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.
original_text: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if ye will not make known unto me the dream, with the interpretation thereof, ye shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.

translated_text: But if ye shew the dream, and the interpretation thereof, ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour: therefore shew me the dream, and the interpretation thereof.
original_text: But if ye shew the dream, and the interpretation thereof, ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour: therefore shew me the dream, and the interpretation thereof.

translated_text: They answered again and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation of it.
original_text: They answered again and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation of it.

translated_text: The king answered and said, I know of certainty that ye would gain the time, because ye see the thing is gone from me.
original_text: The king answered and said, I know of certainty that ye would gain the time, because ye see the thing is gone from me.

translated_text:
But if ye will not make known unto me the dream,
there is but
 one decree for you: for ye have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, till the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that ye can shew me the interpretation thereof.
original_text:
But if ye will not make known unto me the dream,
there is but
 one decree for you: for ye have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, till the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that ye can shew me the interpretation thereof.

translated_text:
The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king’s matter: therefore
there is
 no king, lord, nor ruler,
that asked such things at any magician, or astrologer, or Chaldean.
original_text:
The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king’s matter: therefore
there is
 no king, lord, nor ruler,
that asked such things at any magician, or astrologer, or Chaldean.

translated_text:
And
it is a rare thing that the king requireth, and there is none other that can shew it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.
original_text:
And
it is a rare thing that the king requireth, and there is none other that can shew it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.

translated_text:
For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise
men of Babylon.
original_text:
For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise
men of Babylon.

translated_text:
And the decree went forth that the wise
men should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain.
original_text:
And the decree went forth that the wise
men should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain.

translated_text:
Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, which was gone forth to slay the wise
men of Babylon:
original_text:
Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, which was gone forth to slay the wise
men of Babylon:

translated_text:
He answered and said to Arioch the king’s captain, Why
is
 the decree
so hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
original_text:
He answered and said to Arioch the king’s captain, Why
is
 the decree
so hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.

translated_text: Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would shew the king the interpretation.
original_text: Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would shew the king the interpretation.

translated_text: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:
original_text: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:

translated_text:
That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise
men of Babylon.
original_text:
That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise
men of Babylon.

translated_text: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.
original_text: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

translated_text: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:
original_text: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:

translated_text: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:
original_text: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:

translated_text:
He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what
is
 in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.
original_text:
He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what
is
 in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.

translated_text:
I thank thee, and praise thee, O thou God of my fathers, who hast given me wisdom and might, and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee: for thou hast
now made known unto us the king’s matter.
original_text:
I thank thee, and praise thee, O thou God of my fathers, who hast given me wisdom and might, and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee: for thou hast
now made known unto us the king’s matter.

translated_text:
Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch, whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise
men of Babylon: he went and said thus unto him; Destroy not the wise
men of Babylon: bring me in before the king, and I will shew unto the king the interpretation.
original_text:
Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch, whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise
men of Babylon: he went and said thus unto him; Destroy not the wise
men of Babylon: bring me in before the king, and I will shew unto the king the interpretation.

translated_text: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste and said thus unto him, I have found a man of the captives of Judah, that will make known unto the king the interpretation.
original_text: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste and said thus unto him, I have found a man of the captives of Judah, that will make known unto the king the interpretation.

translated_text:
The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name
was Belteshazzar, Art thou able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen, and the interpretation thereof?
original_text:
The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name
was Belteshazzar, Art thou able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen, and the interpretation thereof?

translated_text:
Daniel answered in the presence of the king, and said, The secret which the king hath demanded cannot the wise
men, the astrologers, the magicians, the soothsayers, shew unto the king;
original_text:
Daniel answered in the presence of the king, and said, The secret which the king hath demanded cannot the wise
men, the astrologers, the magicians, the soothsayers, shew unto the king;

translated_text: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these;
original_text: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these;

translated_text:
As for thee, O king, thy thoughts came
into thy mind upon thy bed, what should come to pass hereafter: and he that revealeth secrets maketh known to thee what shall come to pass.
original_text:
As for thee, O king, thy thoughts came
into thy mind upon thy bed, what should come to pass hereafter: and he that revealeth secrets maketh known to thee what shall come to pass.

translated_text:
But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for
any
 wisdom that I have more than any living, but for
their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king, and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart.
original_text:
But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for
any
 wisdom that I have more than any living, but for
their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king, and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart.

translated_text:
Thou, O king, sawest, and behold a great image. This great image, whose brightness was excellent, stood before thee; and the form thereof
was
 terrible.
original_text:
Thou, O king, sawest, and behold a great image. This great image, whose brightness was excellent, stood before thee; and the form thereof
was
 terrible.

translated_text:
This image’s head
was of fine gold, his breast and his arms of silver, his belly and his thighs of brass,
original_text:
This image’s head
was of fine gold, his breast and his arms of silver, his belly and his thighs of brass,

translated_text: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.
original_text: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.

translated_text:
Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet
that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.
original_text:
Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet
that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.

translated_text: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.
original_text: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.

translated_text:
This
is the dream; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king.
original_text:
This
is the dream; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king.

translated_text:
Thou, O king,
art a king of kings: for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.
original_text:
Thou, O king,
art a king of kings: for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.

translated_text:
And wheresoever the children of men dwell, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven hath he given into thine hand, and hath made thee ruler over them all. Thou
art this head of gold.
original_text:
And wheresoever the children of men dwell, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven hath he given into thine hand, and hath made thee ruler over them all. Thou
art this head of gold.

translated_text: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.
original_text: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.

translated_text:
And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all
things: and as iron that breaketh all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.
original_text:
And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all
things: and as iron that breaketh all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.

translated_text: And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron, forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay.
original_text: And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron, forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay.

translated_text:
And
as the toes of the feet
were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.
original_text:
And
as the toes of the feet
were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.

translated_text: And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.
original_text: And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.

translated_text:
And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people,
but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.
original_text:
And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people,
but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.

translated_text: Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: and the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.
original_text: Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: and the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.

translated_text: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him.
original_text: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him.

translated_text:
The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth
it is,
 that your God is a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou couldst reveal this secret.
original_text:
The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth
it is,
 that your God is a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou couldst reveal this secret.

translated_text:
Then the king made Daniel a great man, and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and chief of the governors over all the wise
men of Babylon.
original_text:
Then the king made Daniel a great man, and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and chief of the governors over all the wise
men of Babylon.

translated_text:
Then Daniel requested of the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon: but Daniel
sat
 in the gate of the king.
original_text:
Then Daniel requested of the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon: but Daniel
sat
 in the gate of the king.

translated_text:
Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height
was
 threescore cubits,
and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
original_text:
Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height
was
 threescore cubits,
and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.

translated_text: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes, the governors, and the captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
original_text: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes, the governors, and the captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

translated_text: Then the princes, the governors, and captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, were gathered together unto the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
original_text: Then the princes, the governors, and captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, were gathered together unto the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

translated_text: Then an herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages,
original_text: Then an herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages,

translated_text: That at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up:
original_text: That at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up:

translated_text: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
original_text: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.

translated_text:
Therefore at that time, when all the people heard the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and all kinds of musick, all the people, the nations, and the languages, fell down
and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
original_text:
Therefore at that time, when all the people heard the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and all kinds of musick, all the people, the nations, and the languages, fell down
and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

translated_text: Wherefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and accused the Jews.
original_text: Wherefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and accused the Jews.

translated_text: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar, O king, live for ever.
original_text: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar, O king, live for ever.

translated_text: Thou, O king, hast made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, shall fall down and worship the golden image:
original_text: Thou, O king, hast made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, shall fall down and worship the golden image:

translated_text:
And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth,
that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
original_text:
And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth,
that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.

translated_text: There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego; these men, O king, have not regarded thee: they serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.
original_text: There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego; these men, O king, have not regarded thee: they serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.

translated_text:
Then Nebuchadnezzar in
his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego. Then they brought these men before the king.
original_text:
Then Nebuchadnezzar in
his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego. Then they brought these men before the king.

translated_text:
Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them,
Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, do not ye serve my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?
original_text:
Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them,
Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, do not ye serve my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?

translated_text:
Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we
are not careful to answer thee in this matter.
original_text:
Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we
are not careful to answer thee in this matter.

translated_text:
If it be
so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver
us out of thine hand, O king.
original_text:
If it be
so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver
us out of thine hand, O king.

translated_text: But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.
original_text: But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.

translated_text:
Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego:
therefore he spake, and commanded that they should heat the furnace one seven times more than it was wont to be heated.
original_text:
Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego:
therefore he spake, and commanded that they should heat the furnace one seven times more than it was wont to be heated.

translated_text:
And he commanded the most mighty men that
were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego,
and to cast
them
 into the burning fiery furnace.
original_text:
And he commanded the most mighty men that
were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego,
and to cast
them
 into the burning fiery furnace.

translated_text:
Then these men were bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats, and their
other garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
original_text:
Then these men were bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats, and their
other garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

translated_text: Therefore because the king’s commandment was urgent, and the furnace exceeding hot, the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego.
original_text: Therefore because the king’s commandment was urgent, and the furnace exceeding hot, the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego.

translated_text: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
original_text: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

translated_text:
Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonied, and rose up in haste,
and spake, and said unto his counsellors, Did not we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire? They answered and said unto the king, True, O king.
original_text:
Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonied, and rose up in haste,
and spake, and said unto his counsellors, Did not we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire? They answered and said unto the king, True, O king.

translated_text: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.
original_text: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.

translated_text:
Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace,
and spake, and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, ye servants of the most high God, come forth, and come
hither. Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, came forth of the midst of the fire.
original_text:
Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace,
and spake, and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, ye servants of the most high God, come forth, and come
hither. Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, came forth of the midst of the fire.

translated_text: And the princes, governors, and captains, and the king’s counsellors, being gathered together, saw these men, upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.
original_text: And the princes, governors, and captains, and the king’s counsellors, being gathered together, saw these men, upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.

translated_text:
Then Nebuchadnezzar spake, and said, Blessed
be
 the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, who hath sent his angel, and delivered his servants that trusted in him, and have changed the king’s word, and yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.
original_text:
Then Nebuchadnezzar spake, and said, Blessed
be
 the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, who hath sent his angel, and delivered his servants that trusted in him, and have changed the king’s word, and yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.

translated_text: Therefore I make a decree, That every people, nation, and language, which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill: because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort.
original_text: Therefore I make a decree, That every people, nation, and language, which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill: because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort.

translated_text: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, in the province of Babylon.
original_text: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, in the province of Babylon.

translated_text: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem, and besieged it.
original_text: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem, and besieged it.

translated_text: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God: which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.
original_text: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God: which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.

translated_text:
And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring
certain of the children of Israel, and of the king’s seed, and of the princes;
original_text:
And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring
certain of the children of Israel, and of the king’s seed, and of the princes;

translated_text:
Children in whom
was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science, and such as
had ability in them to stand in the king’s palace, and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.
original_text:
Children in whom
was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science, and such as
had ability in them to stand in the king’s palace, and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.

translated_text: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king’s meat, and of the wine which he drank: so nourishing them three years, that at the end thereof they might stand before the king.
original_text: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king’s meat, and of the wine which he drank: so nourishing them three years, that at the end thereof they might stand before the king.

translated_text: Now among these were of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
original_text: Now among these were of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:

translated_text:
Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names: for he gave unto Daniel
the name of Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, of Shadrach; and to Mishael, of Meshach; and to Azariah, of Abed-nego.
original_text:
Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names: for he gave unto Daniel
the name of Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, of Shadrach; and to Mishael, of Meshach; and to Azariah, of Abed-nego.

translated_text: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
original_text: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

translated_text: Now God had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs.
original_text: Now God had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs.

translated_text:
And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who hath appointed your meat and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which
are of your sort? then shall ye make
me endanger my head to the king.
original_text:
And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who hath appointed your meat and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which
are of your sort? then shall ye make
me endanger my head to the king.

translated_text: Then said Daniel to Melzar, whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,
original_text: Then said Daniel to Melzar, whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,

translated_text: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.
original_text: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.

translated_text: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee, and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king’s meat: and as thou seest, deal with thy servants.
original_text: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee, and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king’s meat: and as thou seest, deal with thy servants.

translated_text: So he consented to them in this matter, and proved them ten days.
original_text: So he consented to them in this matter, and proved them ten days.

translated_text: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king’s meat.
original_text: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king’s meat.

translated_text: Thus Melzar took away the portion of their meat, and the wine that they should drink; and gave them pulse.
original_text: Thus Melzar took away the portion of their meat, and the wine that they should drink; and gave them pulse.

translated_text: As for these four children, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.
original_text: As for these four children, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.

translated_text: Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in, then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.
original_text: Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in, then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.

translated_text: And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.
original_text: And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.

translated_text:
And in all matters of wisdom
and understanding, that the king enquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians
and astrologers that
were in all his realm.
original_text:
And in all matters of wisdom
and understanding, that the king enquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians
and astrologers that
were in all his realm.

translated_text:
And Daniel continued
even unto the first year of king Cyrus.
original_text:
And Daniel continued
even unto the first year of king Cyrus.

translated_text:
And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation
even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.
original_text:
And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation
even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.

translated_text:
And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame
and everlasting contempt.
original_text:
And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame
and everlasting contempt.

translated_text: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
original_text: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.

translated_text:
But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book,
even
 to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.
original_text:
But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book,
even
 to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.

translated_text: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.
original_text: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.

translated_text:
And
one said to the man clothed in linen, which
was
 upon the waters of the river, How long
shall it be to the end of these wonders?
original_text:
And
one said to the man clothed in linen, which
was
 upon the waters of the river, How long
shall it be to the end of these wonders?

translated_text:
And I heard the man clothed in linen, which
was upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that liveth for ever that
it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these
things shall be finished.
original_text:
And I heard the man clothed in linen, which
was upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that liveth for ever that
it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these
things shall be finished.

translated_text:
And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what
shall be the end of these
things?
original_text:
And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what
shall be the end of these
things?

translated_text:
And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words
are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.
original_text:
And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words
are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.

translated_text: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
original_text: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.

translated_text:
And from the time
that the daily
sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up,
there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.
original_text:
And from the time
that the daily
sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up,
there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.

translated_text:
Blessed
is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.
original_text:
Blessed
is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.

translated_text:
But go thou thy way till the end
be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.
original_text:
But go thou thy way till the end
be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.

translated_text:
Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede,
even I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.
original_text:
Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede,
even I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.

translated_text:
And now will I shew thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than
they
 all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.
original_text:
And now will I shew thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than
they
 all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.

translated_text: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
original_text: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

translated_text: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.
original_text: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.

translated_text:
And the king of the south shall be strong, and
one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion
shall be a great dominion.
original_text:
And the king of the south shall be strong, and
one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion
shall be a great dominion.

translated_text:
And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king’s daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in
these times.
original_text:
And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king’s daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in
these times.

translated_text:
But out of a branch of her roots shall
one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:
original_text:
But out of a branch of her roots shall
one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:

translated_text:
And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes,
and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue
more years than the king of the north.
original_text:
And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes,
and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue
more years than the king of the north.

translated_text:
So the king of the south shall come into
his kingdom, and shall return into his own land.
original_text:
So the king of the south shall come into
his kingdom, and shall return into his own land.

translated_text:
But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and
one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up,
even to his fortress.
original_text:
But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and
one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up,
even to his fortress.

translated_text:
And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him,
even with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.
original_text:
And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him,
even with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.

translated_text:
And when he hath taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down
many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened
by it.
original_text:
And when he hath taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down
many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened
by it.

translated_text: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.
original_text: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.

translated_text: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.
original_text: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.

translated_text:
So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither
shall there be any strength to withstand.
original_text:
So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither
shall there be any strength to withstand.

translated_text: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.
original_text: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.

translated_text:
He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand
on his side, neither be for him.
original_text:
He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand
on his side, neither be for him.

translated_text:
After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause
it to turn upon him.
original_text:
After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause
it to turn upon him.

translated_text: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.
original_text: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.

translated_text:
Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes
in the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.
original_text:
Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes
in the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.

translated_text: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
original_text: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

translated_text: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.
original_text: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.

translated_text:
And after the league
made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.
original_text:
And after the league
made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.

translated_text:
He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do
that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches:
yea, and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.
original_text:
He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do
that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches:
yea, and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.

translated_text: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.
original_text: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.

translated_text: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.
original_text: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.

translated_text:
And both these kings’ hearts
shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end
shall be at the time appointed.
original_text:
And both these kings’ hearts
shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end
shall be at the time appointed.

translated_text:
Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart
shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do
exploits,
 and return to his own land.
original_text:
Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart
shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do
exploits,
 and return to his own land.

translated_text: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.
original_text: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.

translated_text: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.
original_text: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.

translated_text:
And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily
sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.
original_text:
And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily
sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.

translated_text:
And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do
exploits.
original_text:
And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do
exploits.

translated_text:
And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil,
many
 days.
original_text:
And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil,
many
 days.

translated_text: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.
original_text: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.

translated_text:
And
some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make
them white,
even to the time of the end: because
it is yet for a time appointed.
original_text:
And
some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make
them white,
even to the time of the end: because
it is yet for a time appointed.

translated_text: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.
original_text: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.

translated_text: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.
original_text: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.

translated_text: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.
original_text: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.

translated_text:
Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge
and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.
original_text:
Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge
and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.

translated_text: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.
original_text: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.

translated_text:
