He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many
countries
 shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand,
even
 Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
original_text:
He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many
countries
 shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand,
even
 Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

translated_text: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.
original_text: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.

translated_text:
But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians
shall be at his steps.
original_text:
But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians
shall be at his steps.

translated_text: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.
original_text: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.

translated_text: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.
original_text: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.

translated_text:
In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing
was true, but the time appointed
was long: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.
original_text:
In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing
was true, but the time appointed
was long: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.

translated_text: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.
original_text: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.

translated_text: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.
original_text: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.

translated_text:
And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which
is Hiddekel;
original_text:
And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which
is Hiddekel;

translated_text:
Then I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins
were girded with fine gold of Uphaz:
original_text:
Then I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins
were girded with fine gold of Uphaz:

translated_text:
His body also
was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.
original_text:
His body also
was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.

translated_text: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.
original_text: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.

translated_text: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.
original_text: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.

translated_text: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.
original_text: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.

translated_text:
And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and
upon the palms of my hands.
original_text:
And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and
upon the palms of my hands.

translated_text: And he said unto me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto thee, and stand upright: for unto thee am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.
original_text: And he said unto me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto thee, and stand upright: for unto thee am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.

translated_text: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words.
original_text: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words.

translated_text: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.
original_text: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

translated_text:
Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days: for yet the vision
is for
many days.
original_text:
Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days: for yet the vision
is for
many days.

translated_text: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.
original_text: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.

translated_text:
And, behold,
one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.
original_text:
And, behold,
one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.

translated_text: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.
original_text: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.

translated_text:
Then there came again and touched me
one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,
original_text:
Then there came again and touched me
one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,

translated_text:
And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace
be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.
original_text:
And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace
be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.

translated_text: Then said he, Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.
original_text: Then said he, Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.

translated_text:
But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and
there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.
original_text:
But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and
there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.

translated_text: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.
original_text: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.

translated_text: The LORD hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.
original_text: The LORD hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.

translated_text: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:
original_text: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:

translated_text:
Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him
in Bethel, and there he spake with us;
original_text:
Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him
in Bethel, and there he spake with us;

translated_text:
Even the LORD God of hosts; the LORD
is his memorial.
original_text:
Even the LORD God of hosts; the LORD
is his memorial.

translated_text: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.
original_text: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.

translated_text:
He is a merchant, the balances of deceit
are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.
original_text:
He is a merchant, the balances of deceit
are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.

translated_text:
And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance:
in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that
were sin.
original_text:
And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance:
in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that
were sin.

translated_text:
And I
that am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.
original_text:
And I
that am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.

translated_text: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.
original_text: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.

translated_text:
Is there iniquity
in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars
are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
original_text:
Is there iniquity
in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars
are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.

translated_text:
And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept
sheep.
original_text:
And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept
sheep.

translated_text: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
original_text: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.

translated_text:
Ephraim provoked
him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.
original_text:
Ephraim provoked
him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.

translated_text: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
original_text: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.

translated_text:
And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver,
and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.
original_text:
And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver,
and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.

translated_text:
Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff
that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
original_text:
Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff
that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.

translated_text:
Yet I
am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no god but me: for
there is no saviour beside me.
original_text:
Yet I
am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no god but me: for
there is no saviour beside me.

translated_text: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
original_text: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.

translated_text: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.
original_text: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.

translated_text:
Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe
them:
original_text:
Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe
them:

translated_text:
I will meet them as a bear
that is bereaved
of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.
original_text:
I will meet them as a bear
that is bereaved
of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.

translated_text:
O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me
is thine help.
original_text:
O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me
is thine help.

translated_text:
I will be thy king: where
is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?
original_text:
I will be thy king: where
is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?

translated_text:
I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took
him away in my wrath.
original_text:
I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took
him away in my wrath.

translated_text:
The iniquity of Ephraim
is bound up; his sin
is
 hid.
original_text:
The iniquity of Ephraim
is bound up; his sin
is
 hid.

translated_text:
The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he
is
 an unwise son; for he should not stay long in
the place of
 the breaking forth of children.
original_text:
The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he
is
 an unwise son; for he should not stay long in
the place of
 the breaking forth of children.

translated_text: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
original_text: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.

translated_text:
Though he be fruitful among
his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.
original_text:
Though he be fruitful among
his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.

translated_text: Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
original_text: Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.

translated_text: O Israel, return unto the LORD thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
original_text: O Israel, return unto the LORD thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.

translated_text:
Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive
us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
original_text:
Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive
us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.

translated_text:
Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands,
Ye are our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
original_text:
Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands,
Ye are our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.

translated_text: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
original_text: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.

translated_text: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
original_text: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.

translated_text: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
original_text: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.

translated_text:
They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive
as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof
shall be
 as the wine of Lebanon.
original_text:
They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive
as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof
shall be
 as the wine of Lebanon.

translated_text:
Ephraim
shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard
him, and observed him: I
am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.
original_text:
Ephraim
shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard
him, and observed him: I
am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.

translated_text:
Who
is wise, and he shall understand these
things?
 prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD
are
 right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
original_text:
Who
is wise, and he shall understand these
things?
 prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD
are
 right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.

translated_text:
Israel
is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
original_text:
Israel
is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.

translated_text: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
original_text: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.

translated_text: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the LORD; what then should a king do to us?
original_text: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the LORD; what then should a king do to us?

translated_text: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
original_text: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.

translated_text:
The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth-aven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof
that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
original_text:
The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth-aven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof
that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.

translated_text:
It shall be also carried unto Assyria
for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
original_text:
It shall be also carried unto Assyria
for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.

translated_text: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.
original_text: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.

translated_text: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
original_text: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.

translated_text: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
original_text: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.

translated_text: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
original_text: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.

translated_text:
And Ephraim
is as an heifer
that is taught,
and loveth to tread out
the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow,
and
 Jacob shall break his clods.
original_text:
And Ephraim
is as an heifer
that is taught,
and loveth to tread out
the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow,
and
 Jacob shall break his clods.

translated_text:
Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for
it is time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
original_text:
Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for
it is time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.

translated_text: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
original_text: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.

translated_text:
Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon
her children.
original_text:
Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon
her children.

translated_text: So shall Bethel do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
original_text: So shall Bethel do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.

translated_text:
When Israel
was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
original_text:
When Israel
was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

translated_text: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
original_text: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.

translated_text: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
original_text: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.

translated_text: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
original_text: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.

translated_text: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.
original_text: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.

translated_text:
And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour
them, because of their own counsels.
original_text:
And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour
them, because of their own counsels.

translated_text:
And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt
him.
original_text:
And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt
him.

translated_text:
How shall I give thee up, Ephraim?
how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah?
how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
original_text:
How shall I give thee up, Ephraim?
how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah?
how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.

translated_text:
I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I
am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.
original_text:
I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I
am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.

translated_text: They shall walk after the LORD: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.
original_text: They shall walk after the LORD: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.

translated_text: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the LORD.
original_text: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.
original_text: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.

translated_text:
Set the trumpet to thy mouth.
He shall come as an eagle against the house of the LORD, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.
original_text:
Set the trumpet to thy mouth.
He shall come as an eagle against the house of the LORD, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.

translated_text: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.
original_text: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.

translated_text:
Israel hath cast off
the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.
original_text:
Israel hath cast off
the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.

translated_text:
They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew
it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
original_text:
They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew
it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.

translated_text:
Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast
thee off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long
will it be ere they attain to innocency?
original_text:
Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast
thee off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long
will it be ere they attain to innocency?

translated_text:
For from Israel
was it also: the workman made it; therefore it
is not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
original_text:
For from Israel
was it also: the workman made it; therefore it
is not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.

translated_text: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
original_text: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.

translated_text:
Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein
is no pleasure.
original_text:
Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein
is no pleasure.

translated_text: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
original_text: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.

translated_text: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.
original_text: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.

translated_text: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.
original_text: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.

translated_text:
I have written to him the great things of my law,
but they were counted as a strange thing.
original_text:
I have written to him the great things of my law,
but they were counted as a strange thing.

translated_text:
They sacrifice flesh
for the sacrifices of mine offerings, and
eat it; but the LORD accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.
original_text:
They sacrifice flesh
for the sacrifices of mine offerings, and
eat it; but the LORD accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.

translated_text: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
original_text: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.

translated_text:
When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in,
and the troop of robbers spoileth without.
original_text:
When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in,
and the troop of robbers spoileth without.

translated_text:
And they consider not in their hearts
that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.
original_text:
And they consider not in their hearts
that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.

translated_text: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
original_text: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

translated_text:
They
are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker,
who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
original_text:
They
are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker,
who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.

translated_text:
In the day of our king the princes have made
him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
original_text:
In the day of our king the princes have made
him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.

translated_text: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
original_text: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.

translated_text:
They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen:
there is none among them that calleth unto me.
original_text:
They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen:
there is none among them that calleth unto me.

translated_text: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
original_text: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.

translated_text:
Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth
it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.
original_text:
Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth
it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.

translated_text: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the LORD their God, nor seek him for all this.
original_text: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the LORD their God, nor seek him for all this.

translated_text: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
original_text: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.

translated_text: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.
original_text: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.

translated_text: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
original_text: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.

translated_text:
And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine,
and they rebel against me.
original_text:
And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine,
and they rebel against me.

translated_text:
Though I have bound
and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.
original_text:
Though I have bound
and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.

translated_text:
They return,
but not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this
shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.
original_text:
They return,
but not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this
shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as
other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
original_text:
Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as
other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.

translated_text: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.
original_text: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.

translated_text:
They shall not dwell in the LORD’S land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean
things in Assyria.
original_text:
They shall not dwell in the LORD’S land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean
things in Assyria.

translated_text:
They shall not offer wine
offerings to the LORD, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices
shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the LORD.
original_text:
They shall not offer wine
offerings to the LORD, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices
shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the LORD.

translated_text: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?
original_text: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?

translated_text:
For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant
places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns
shall be in their tabernacles.
original_text:
For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant
places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns
shall be in their tabernacles.

translated_text:
The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know
it: the prophet
is a fool, the spiritual man
is mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.
original_text:
The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know
it: the prophet
is a fool, the spiritual man
is mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.

translated_text:
The watchman of Ephraim
was with my God:
but the prophet
is a snare of a fowler in all his ways,
and hatred in the house of his God.
original_text:
The watchman of Ephraim
was with my God:
but the prophet
is a snare of a fowler in all his ways,
and hatred in the house of his God.

translated_text:
They have deeply corrupted
themselves, as in the days of Gibeah:
therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
original_text:
They have deeply corrupted
themselves, as in the days of Gibeah:
therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.

translated_text:
I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time:
but they went to Baal-peor, and separated themselves unto
that shame; and
their
 abominations were according as they loved.
original_text:
I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time:
but they went to Baal-peor, and separated themselves unto
that shame; and
their
 abominations were according as they loved.

translated_text: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
original_text: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.

translated_text:
Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them,
that there shall not
be a man
left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
original_text:
Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them,
that there shall not
be a man
left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!

translated_text:
Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus,
is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
original_text:
Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus,
is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.

translated_text: Give them, O LORD: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
original_text: Give them, O LORD: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.

translated_text:
All their wickedness
is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes
are revolters.
original_text:
All their wickedness
is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes
are revolters.

translated_text:
Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay
even the beloved
fruit of their womb.
original_text:
Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay
even the beloved
fruit of their womb.

translated_text: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
original_text: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.

translated_text:
Hear the word of the LORD, ye children of Israel: for the LORD hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because
there is
 no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.
original_text:
Hear the word of the LORD, ye children of Israel: for the LORD hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because
there is
 no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.

translated_text: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
original_text: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.

translated_text: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
original_text: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.

translated_text:
Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people
are
 as they that strive with the priest.
original_text:
Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people
are
 as they that strive with the priest.

translated_text: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.
original_text: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.

translated_text: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.
original_text: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.

translated_text:
As they were increased, so they sinned against me:
therefore
 will I change their glory into shame.
original_text:
As they were increased, so they sinned against me:
therefore
 will I change their glory into shame.

translated_text: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.
original_text: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.

translated_text: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.
original_text: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.

translated_text: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the LORD.
original_text: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the LORD.

translated_text: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
original_text: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.

translated_text:
My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused
them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God.
original_text:
My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused
them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God.

translated_text:
They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof
is
 good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.
original_text:
They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof
is
 good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.

translated_text:
I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people
that doth not understand shall fall.
original_text:
I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people
that doth not understand shall fall.

translated_text:
Though thou, Israel, play the harlot,
yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Beth-aven, nor swear, The LORD liveth.
original_text:
Though thou, Israel, play the harlot,
yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Beth-aven, nor swear, The LORD liveth.

translated_text: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the LORD will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
original_text: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the LORD will feed them as a lamb in a large place.

translated_text:
Ephraim
is joined to idols: let him alone.
original_text:
Ephraim
is joined to idols: let him alone.

translated_text:
Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers
with shame do love, Give ye.
original_text:
Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers
with shame do love, Give ye.

translated_text: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
original_text: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.

translated_text:
Then said the LORD unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of
her
 friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the LORD toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.
original_text:
Then said the LORD unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of
her
 friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the LORD toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.

translated_text:
And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for
another man: so
will I also
be for thee.
original_text:
And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for
another man: so
will I also
be for thee.

translated_text:
For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and
without teraphim:
original_text:
For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and
without teraphim:

translated_text: Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the LORD their God, and David their king; and shall fear the LORD and his goodness in the latter days.
original_text: Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the LORD their God, and David their king; and shall fear the LORD and his goodness in the latter days.

translated_text: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
original_text: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.

translated_text: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.
original_text: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.

translated_text:
Then shall we know,
if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter
and former rain unto the earth.
original_text:
Then shall we know,
if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter
and former rain unto the earth.

translated_text:
O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness
is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.
original_text:
O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness
is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.

translated_text:
Therefore have I hewed
them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments
are as the light
that goeth forth.
original_text:
Therefore have I hewed
them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments
are as the light
that goeth forth.

translated_text: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
original_text: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

translated_text: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.
original_text: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.

translated_text:
Gilead
is a city of them that work iniquity,
and is
 polluted with blood.
original_text:
Gilead
is a city of them that work iniquity,
and is
 polluted with blood.

translated_text:
And as troops of robbers wait for a man,
so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.
original_text:
And as troops of robbers wait for a man,
so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.

translated_text:
I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there
is
 the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
original_text:
I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there
is
 the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.

translated_text: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.
original_text: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.

translated_text:
Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment
is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
original_text:
Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment
is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.

translated_text:
And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I
have been a rebuker of them all.
original_text:
And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I
have been a rebuker of them all.

translated_text:
I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom,
and Israel is defiled.
original_text:
I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom,
and Israel is defiled.

translated_text:
They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms
is in the midst of them, and they have not known the LORD.
original_text:
They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms
is in the midst of them, and they have not known the LORD.

translated_text: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.
original_text: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.

translated_text:
They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD; but they shall not find
him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.
original_text:
They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD; but they shall not find
him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.

translated_text: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
original_text: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.

translated_text:
Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah,
and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud
at Beth-aven, after thee, O Benjamin.
original_text:
Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah,
and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud
at Beth-aven, after thee, O Benjamin.

translated_text: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.
original_text: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.

translated_text:
The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound:
therefore
 I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
original_text:
The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound:
therefore
 I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.

translated_text:
Ephraim
is oppressed
and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.
original_text:
Ephraim
is oppressed
and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.

translated_text:
Therefore
will I
be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.
original_text:
Therefore
will I
be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.

translated_text:
When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah
saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.
original_text:
When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah
saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.

translated_text:
For I will
be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I,
even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue
him.
original_text:
For I will
be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I,
even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue
him.

translated_text:
I will go
and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.
original_text:
I will go
and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.

translated_text: Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ru-hamah.
original_text: Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ru-hamah.

translated_text: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.
original_text: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.

translated_text:
And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they
be the children of whoredoms.
original_text:
And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they
be the children of whoredoms.

translated_text:
For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give
me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.
original_text:
For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give
me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.

translated_text: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
original_text: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.

translated_text:
And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find
them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then
was it
 better with me than now.
original_text:
And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find
them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then
was it
 better with me than now.

translated_text:
For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold,
which they prepared for Baal.
original_text:
For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold,
which they prepared for Baal.

translated_text:
Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax
given to cover her nakedness.
original_text:
Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax
given to cover her nakedness.

translated_text: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of mine hand.
original_text: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of mine hand.

translated_text: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.
original_text: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.

translated_text:
And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she hath said, These
are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.
original_text:
And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she hath said, These
are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.

translated_text: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith the LORD.
original_text: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith the LORD.

translated_text: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.
original_text: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.

translated_text: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
original_text: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.

translated_text:
And it shall be at that day, saith the LORD,
that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.
original_text:
And it shall be at that day, saith the LORD,
that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.

translated_text: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.
original_text: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.

translated_text:
And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and
with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.
original_text:
And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and
with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.

translated_text: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.
original_text: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.

translated_text: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the LORD.
original_text: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the LORD.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the LORD, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;
original_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the LORD, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;

translated_text: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.
original_text: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.

translated_text:
And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to
them which were
 not my people, Thou
art my people; and they shall say,
Thou art my God.
original_text:
And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to
them which were
 not my people, Thou
art my people; and they shall say,
Thou art my God.

translated_text:
The word of the LORD that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz,
and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
original_text:
The word of the LORD that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz,
and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

translated_text:
The beginning of the word of the LORD by Hosea. And the LORD said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom,
departing from the LORD.
original_text:
The beginning of the word of the LORD by Hosea. And the LORD said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom,
departing from the LORD.

translated_text: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.
original_text: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.

translated_text:
And the LORD said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little
while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.
original_text:
And the LORD said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little
while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.
original_text: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.

translated_text:
And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And
God said unto him, Call her name Lo-ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.
original_text:
And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And
God said unto him, Call her name Lo-ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.

translated_text: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.
original_text: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.

translated_text: Now when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.
original_text: Now when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.

translated_text:
Then said
God, Call his name Lo-ammi: for ye
are
 not my people, and I will not be your
God.
original_text:
Then said
God, Call his name Lo-ammi: for ye
are
 not my people, and I will not be your
God.

translated_text:
Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass,
that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye
are
 not my people,
there it shall be said unto them,
Ye are
 the sons of the living God.
original_text:
Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass,
that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye
are
 not my people,
there it shall be said unto them,
Ye are
 the sons of the living God.

translated_text:
Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great
shall be the day of Jezreel.
original_text:
Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great
shall be the day of Jezreel.

translated_text: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,
original_text: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,

translated_text:
I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and
for
 my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.
original_text:
I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and
for
 my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.

translated_text: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.
original_text: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.

translated_text:
Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly
and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
original_text:
Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly
and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;

translated_text: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:
original_text: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:

translated_text: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.
original_text: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.

translated_text: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:
original_text: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:

translated_text:
And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the LORD hath spoken
it.
original_text:
And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the LORD hath spoken
it.

translated_text: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:
original_text: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:

translated_text:
Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I
am strong.
original_text:
Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I
am strong.

translated_text: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O LORD.
original_text: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O LORD.

translated_text: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.
original_text: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.

translated_text:
Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness
is great.
original_text:
Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness
is great.

translated_text:
Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD
is near in the valley of decision.
original_text:
Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD
is near in the valley of decision.

translated_text: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.
original_text: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.

translated_text:
The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the LORD
will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.
original_text:
The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the LORD
will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.

translated_text:
So shall ye know that I
am the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.
original_text:
So shall ye know that I
am the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the LORD, and shall water the valley of Shittim.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the LORD, and shall water the valley of Shittim.

translated_text:
Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence
against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
original_text:
Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence
against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.

translated_text: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
original_text: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.

translated_text:
For I will cleanse their blood
that I have not cleansed: for the LORD dwelleth in Zion.
original_text:
For I will cleanse their blood
that I have not cleansed: for the LORD dwelleth in Zion.

translated_text:
Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for
it is nigh at hand;
original_text:
Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for
it is nigh at hand;

translated_text:
A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it,
even to the years of many generations.
original_text:
A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it,
even to the years of many generations.

translated_text:
A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land
is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.
original_text:
A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land
is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.

translated_text:
The appearance of them
is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.
original_text:
The appearance of them
is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.

translated_text: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.
original_text: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.

translated_text: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.
original_text: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.

translated_text: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:
original_text: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:

translated_text:
Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and
when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.
original_text:
Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and
when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.

translated_text: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
original_text: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.

translated_text: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:
original_text: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:

translated_text:
And the LORD shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp
is very great: for
he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the LORD
is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
original_text:
And the LORD shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp
is very great: for
he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the LORD
is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?

translated_text:
Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye
even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
original_text:
Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye
even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
