original_text: Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots:
original_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots:

translated_text: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and throw down all thy strong holds:
original_text: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and throw down all thy strong holds:

translated_text:
And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; and thou shalt have no
more soothsayers:
original_text:
And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; and thou shalt have no
more soothsayers:

translated_text: Thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy standing images out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands.
original_text: Thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy standing images out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands.

translated_text: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities.
original_text: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities.

translated_text: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.
original_text: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.

translated_text: Hear ye now what the LORD saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.
original_text: Hear ye now what the LORD saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.

translated_text: Hear ye, O mountains, the LORD’S controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the LORD hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.
original_text: Hear ye, O mountains, the LORD’S controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the LORD hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.

translated_text: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.
original_text: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.

translated_text: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
original_text: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

translated_text: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the LORD.
original_text: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the LORD.

translated_text:
Wherewith shall I come before the LORD,
and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?
original_text:
Wherewith shall I come before the LORD,
and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?

translated_text:
Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams,
or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn
for my transgression, the fruit of my body
for the sin of my soul?
original_text:
Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams,
or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn
for my transgression, the fruit of my body
for the sin of my soul?

translated_text:
He hath shewed thee, O man, what
is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
original_text:
He hath shewed thee, O man, what
is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

translated_text:
The LORD’S voice crieth unto the city, and
the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.
original_text:
The LORD’S voice crieth unto the city, and
the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.

translated_text:
Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure
that is abominable?
original_text:
Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure
that is abominable?

translated_text:
Shall I count
them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
original_text:
Shall I count
them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?

translated_text:
For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue
is deceitful in their mouth.
original_text:
For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue
is deceitful in their mouth.

translated_text:
Therefore also will I make
thee sick in smiting thee, in making
thee desolate because of thy sins.
original_text:
Therefore also will I make
thee sick in smiting thee, in making
thee desolate because of thy sins.

translated_text:
Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down
shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and
that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.
original_text:
Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down
shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and
that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.

translated_text: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.
original_text: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.

translated_text: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.
original_text: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.

translated_text:
Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage:
there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.
original_text:
Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage:
there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.

translated_text:
The good
man is perished out of the earth: and
there is
 none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.
original_text:
The good
man is perished out of the earth: and
there is
 none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.

translated_text:
That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge
asketh for a reward; and the great
man, he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.
original_text:
That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge
asketh for a reward; and the great
man, he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.

translated_text:
The best of them
is as a brier: the most upright
is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen
and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.
original_text:
The best of them
is as a brier: the most upright
is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen
and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.

translated_text: Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.
original_text: Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.

translated_text:
For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man’s enemies
are the men of his own house.
original_text:
For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man’s enemies
are the men of his own house.

translated_text: Therefore I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
original_text: Therefore I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.

translated_text:
Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD
shall be a light unto me.
original_text:
Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD
shall be a light unto me.

translated_text:
I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light,
and I shall behold his righteousness.
original_text:
I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light,
and I shall behold his righteousness.

translated_text:
Then
she that is mine enemy shall see
it, and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the LORD thy God? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.
original_text:
Then
she that is mine enemy shall see
it, and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the LORD thy God? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.

translated_text:
In the day that thy walls are to be built,
in that day shall the decree be far removed.
original_text:
In the day that thy walls are to be built,
in that day shall the decree be far removed.

translated_text:
In that day
also he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and
from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and
from mountain to mountain.
original_text:
In that day
also he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and
from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and
from mountain to mountain.

translated_text: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
original_text: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.

translated_text:
Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily
in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed
in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
original_text:
Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily
in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed
in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

translated_text:
According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous
things.
original_text:
According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous
things.

translated_text:
The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay
their hand upon
their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
original_text:
The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay
their hand upon
their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.

translated_text: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the LORD our God, and shall fear because of thee.
original_text: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the LORD our God, and shall fear because of thee.

translated_text:
Who
is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth
in mercy.
original_text:
Who
is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth
in mercy.

translated_text: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
original_text: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

translated_text:
Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob,
and the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
original_text:
Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob,
and the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.

translated_text:
The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz,
and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
original_text:
The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz,
and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

translated_text: Hear, all ye people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
original_text: Hear, all ye people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

translated_text: For, behold, the LORD cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
original_text: For, behold, the LORD cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.

translated_text:
And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire,
and as the waters
that are
 poured down a steep place.
original_text:
And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire,
and as the waters
that are
 poured down a steep place.

translated_text:
For the transgression of Jacob
is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What
is the transgression of Jacob?
is it
 not Samaria? and what
are the high places of Judah?
are they not Jerusalem?
original_text:
For the transgression of Jacob
is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What
is the transgression of Jacob?
is it
 not Samaria? and what
are the high places of Judah?
are they not Jerusalem?

translated_text:
Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field,
and
 as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.
original_text:
Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field,
and
 as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.

translated_text:
And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered
it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.
original_text:
And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered
it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.

translated_text: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.
original_text: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.

translated_text:
For her wound
is incurable; for it is come unto Judah; he is come unto the gate of my people,
even to Jerusalem.
original_text:
For her wound
is incurable; for it is come unto Judah; he is come unto the gate of my people,
even to Jerusalem.

translated_text:
Declare ye
it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.
original_text:
Declare ye
it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.

translated_text: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth-ezel; he shall receive of you his standing.
original_text: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth-ezel; he shall receive of you his standing.

translated_text: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from the LORD unto the gate of Jerusalem.
original_text: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from the LORD unto the gate of Jerusalem.

translated_text:
O thou inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she
is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.
original_text:
O thou inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she
is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.

translated_text:
Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moresheth-gath: the houses of Achzib
shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.
original_text:
Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moresheth-gath: the houses of Achzib
shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.

translated_text: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel.
original_text: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel.

translated_text: Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.
original_text: Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.

translated_text: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.
original_text: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.

translated_text:
And they covet fields, and take
them by violence; and houses, and take
them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
original_text:
And they covet fields, and take
them by violence; and houses, and take
them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

translated_text:
Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time
is evil.
original_text:
Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time
is evil.

translated_text:
In that day shall
one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation,
and say, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed
it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields.
original_text:
In that day shall
one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation,
and say, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed
it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields.

translated_text: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the LORD.
original_text: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the LORD.

translated_text:
Prophesy ye not,
say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them,
that they shall not take shame.
original_text:
Prophesy ye not,
say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them,
that they shall not take shame.

translated_text:
O
thou that art named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of the LORD straitened?
are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?
original_text:
O
thou that art named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of the LORD straitened?
are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?

translated_text: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.
original_text: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.

translated_text: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever.
original_text: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever.

translated_text:
Arise ye, and depart; for this
is not
your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy
you, even with a sore destruction.
original_text:
Arise ye, and depart; for this
is not
your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy
you, even with a sore destruction.

translated_text:
If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie,
saying,
 I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.
original_text:
If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie,
saying,
 I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.

translated_text:
I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of
the multitude of men.
original_text:
I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of
the multitude of men.

translated_text: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the LORD on the head of them.
original_text: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the LORD on the head of them.

translated_text:
And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel;
Is it not for you to know judgment?
original_text:
And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel;
Is it not for you to know judgment?

translated_text: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;
original_text: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;

translated_text: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.
original_text: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.

translated_text: Then shall they cry unto the LORD, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.
original_text: Then shall they cry unto the LORD, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.

translated_text: Thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.
original_text: Thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.

translated_text:
Therefore night
shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.
original_text:
Therefore night
shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.

translated_text:
Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for
there is no answer of God.
original_text:
Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for
there is no answer of God.

translated_text: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the LORD, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.
original_text: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the LORD, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.

translated_text: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.
original_text: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.

translated_text: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
original_text: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

translated_text:
The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the LORD, and say,
Is not the LORD among us? none evil can come upon us.
original_text:
The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the LORD, and say,
Is not the LORD among us? none evil can come upon us.

translated_text:
Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed
as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.
original_text:
Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed
as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.

translated_text:
But in the last days it shall come to pass,
that the mountain of the house of the LORD shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow unto it.
original_text:
But in the last days it shall come to pass,
that the mountain of the house of the LORD shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow unto it.

translated_text: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
original_text: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

translated_text: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
original_text: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

translated_text:
But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make
them afraid: for the mouth of the LORD of hosts hath spoken
it.
original_text:
But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make
them afraid: for the mouth of the LORD of hosts hath spoken
it.

translated_text: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever.
original_text: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever.

translated_text: In that day, saith the LORD, will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;
original_text: In that day, saith the LORD, will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;

translated_text: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and the LORD shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.
original_text: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and the LORD shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.

translated_text: And thou, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.
original_text: And thou, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.

translated_text:
Now why dost thou cry out aloud?
is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.
original_text:
Now why dost thou cry out aloud?
is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.

translated_text:
Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go
even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the LORD shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.
original_text:
Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go
even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the LORD shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.

translated_text: Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.
original_text: Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.

translated_text: But they know not the thoughts of the LORD, neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.
original_text: But they know not the thoughts of the LORD, neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.

translated_text: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make thine horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass: and thou shalt beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain unto the LORD, and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.
original_text: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make thine horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass: and thou shalt beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain unto the LORD, and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.

translated_text:
Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies
and robbery; the prey departeth not;
original_text:
Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies
and robbery; the prey departeth not;

translated_text: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.
original_text: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.

translated_text:
The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and
there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and
there is none end of
their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:
original_text:
The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and
there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and
there is none end of
their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:

translated_text: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.
original_text: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.

translated_text:
Behold, I
am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face, and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.
original_text:
Behold, I
am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face, and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.

translated_text: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazingstock.
original_text: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazingstock.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?
original_text:
And it shall come to pass,
that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?

translated_text:
Art thou better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers,
that had the waters round about it, whose rampart
was
 the sea,
and her wall
was from the sea?
original_text:
Art thou better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers,
that had the waters round about it, whose rampart
was
 the sea,
and her wall
was from the sea?

translated_text:
Ethiopia and Egypt
were her strength, and
it was
 infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.
original_text:
Ethiopia and Egypt
were her strength, and
it was
 infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.

translated_text:
Yet
was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
original_text:
Yet
was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

translated_text: Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid, thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy.
original_text: Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid, thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy.

translated_text:
All thy strong holds
shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.
original_text:
All thy strong holds
shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.

translated_text:
Behold, thy people in the midst of thee
are women: the gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies: the fire shall devour thy bars.
original_text:
Behold, thy people in the midst of thee
are women: the gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies: the fire shall devour thy bars.

translated_text: Draw thee waters for the siege, fortify thy strong holds: go into clay, and tread the morter, make strong the brickkiln.
original_text: Draw thee waters for the siege, fortify thy strong holds: go into clay, and tread the morter, make strong the brickkiln.

translated_text: There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off, it shall eat thee up like the cankerworm: make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locusts.
original_text: There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off, it shall eat thee up like the cankerworm: make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locusts.

translated_text: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoileth, and fleeth away.
original_text: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoileth, and fleeth away.

translated_text:
Thy crowned
are as the locusts, and thy captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day,
but when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they
are.
original_text:
Thy crowned
are as the locusts, and thy captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day,
but when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they
are.

translated_text:
Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: thy nobles shall dwell
in the dust: thy people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth
them.
original_text:
Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: thy nobles shall dwell
in the dust: thy people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth
them.

translated_text: There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?
original_text: There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?

translated_text:
He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face: keep the munition, watch the way, make
thy loins strong, fortify
thy power mightily.
original_text:
He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face: keep the munition, watch the way, make
thy loins strong, fortify
thy power mightily.

translated_text: For the LORD hath turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.
original_text: For the LORD hath turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.

translated_text:
The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men
are
 in scarlet: the chariots
shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.
original_text:
The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men
are
 in scarlet: the chariots
shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.

translated_text: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.
original_text: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.

translated_text: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.
original_text: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.

translated_text: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.
original_text: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.

translated_text:
And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead
her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.
original_text:
And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead
her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.

translated_text:
But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand,
shall they cry; but none shall look back.
original_text:
But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand,
shall they cry; but none shall look back.

translated_text:
Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for
there is
 none end of the store
and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.
original_text:
Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for
there is
 none end of the store
and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.

translated_text:
She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain
is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.
original_text:
She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain
is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.

translated_text:
Where
is the dwelling of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion,
even the old lion, walked,
and the lion’s whelp, and none made
them afraid?
original_text:
Where
is the dwelling of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion,
even the old lion, walked,
and the lion’s whelp, and none made
them afraid?

translated_text: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.
original_text: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.

translated_text:
Behold, I
am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour thy young lions: and I will cut off thy prey from the earth, and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.
original_text:
Behold, I
am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour thy young lions: and I will cut off thy prey from the earth, and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.

translated_text: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
original_text: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

translated_text:
God
is jealous, and the LORD revengeth; the LORD revengeth, and
is furious; the LORD will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth
wrath for his enemies.
original_text:
God
is jealous, and the LORD revengeth; the LORD revengeth, and
is furious; the LORD will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth
wrath for his enemies.

translated_text:
The LORD
is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit
the wicked: the LORD hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds
are the dust of his feet.
original_text:
The LORD
is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit
the wicked: the LORD hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds
are the dust of his feet.

translated_text: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
original_text: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.

translated_text: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.
original_text: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.

translated_text: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.
original_text: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.

translated_text:
The LORD
is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
original_text:
The LORD
is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

translated_text: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.
original_text: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.

translated_text: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.
original_text: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.

translated_text:
For while
they be folden together
as thorns, and while they are drunken
as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.
original_text:
For while
they be folden together
as thorns, and while they are drunken
as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.

translated_text:
There is
one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the LORD, a wicked counsellor.
original_text:
There is
one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the LORD, a wicked counsellor.

translated_text:
Thus saith the LORD: Though
they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.
original_text:
Thus saith the LORD: Though
they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.

translated_text: For now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.
original_text: For now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.

translated_text:
And the LORD hath given a commandment concerning thee,
that
 no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.
original_text:
And the LORD hath given a commandment concerning thee,
that
 no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.

translated_text: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
original_text: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.

translated_text: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.
original_text: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.

translated_text:
O LORD, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear!
even
 cry out unto thee
of violence, and thou wilt not save!
original_text:
O LORD, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear!
even
 cry out unto thee
of violence, and thou wilt not save!

translated_text:
Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause
me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence
are before me: and there are
that raise up strife and contention.
original_text:
Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause
me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence
are before me: and there are
that raise up strife and contention.

translated_text: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.
original_text: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.

translated_text:
Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for
I will work a work in your days,
which ye will not believe, though it be told
you.
original_text:
Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for
I will work a work in your days,
which ye will not believe, though it be told
you.

translated_text:
For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans,
that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces
that are not theirs.
original_text:
For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans,
that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces
that are not theirs.

translated_text:
They
are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.
original_text:
They
are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.

translated_text:
Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle
that
 hasteth to eat.
original_text:
Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle
that
 hasteth to eat.

translated_text:
They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up
as
 the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.
original_text:
They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up
as
 the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.

translated_text: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.
original_text: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.

translated_text:
Then shall
his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend,
imputing this his power unto his god.
original_text:
Then shall
his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend,
imputing this his power unto his god.

translated_text: Art thou not from everlasting, O LORD my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O LORD, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.
original_text: Art thou not from everlasting, O LORD my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O LORD, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.

translated_text:
Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously,
and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth
the man that is more righteous than he?
original_text:
Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously,
and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth
the man that is more righteous than he?

translated_text:
And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things,
that have no ruler over them?
original_text:
And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things,
that have no ruler over them?

translated_text: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.
original_text: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.

translated_text:
Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion
is fat, and their meat plenteous.
original_text:
Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion
is fat, and their meat plenteous.

translated_text: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?
original_text: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?

translated_text: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.
original_text: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.

translated_text:
And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make
it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
original_text:
And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make
it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.

translated_text:
For the vision
is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
original_text:
For the vision
is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.

translated_text:
Behold, his soul
which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.
original_text:
Behold, his soul
which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.

translated_text:
Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine,
he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and
is
 as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:
original_text:
Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine,
he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and
is
 as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:

translated_text:
Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth
that which is
 not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!
original_text:
Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth
that which is
 not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!

translated_text: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?
original_text: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?

translated_text:
Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men’s blood, and
for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
original_text:
Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men’s blood, and
for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.

translated_text: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!
original_text: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!

translated_text:
Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned
against thy soul.
original_text:
Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned
against thy soul.

translated_text: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
original_text: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.

translated_text: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!
original_text: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!

translated_text:
Behold,
is it not of the LORD of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?
original_text:
Behold,
is it not of the LORD of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?

translated_text: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
original_text: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

translated_text:
Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to
him, and makest
him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!
original_text:
Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to
him, and makest
him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!

translated_text:
Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the LORD’S right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing
shall be on thy glory.
original_text:
Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the LORD’S right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing
shall be on thy glory.

translated_text:
For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts,
which made them afraid, because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
original_text:
For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts,
which made them afraid, because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.

translated_text: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?
original_text: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?

translated_text:
Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it
is laid over with gold and silver, and
there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
original_text:
Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it
is laid over with gold and silver, and
there is no breath at all in the midst of it.

translated_text:
But the LORD
is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
original_text:
But the LORD
is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.

translated_text: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.
original_text: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.

translated_text:
O LORD, I have heard thy speech,
and was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.
original_text:
O LORD, I have heard thy speech,
and was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.

translated_text: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.
original_text: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.

translated_text:
And
his brightness was as the light; he had horns
coming
 out of his hand: and there
was the hiding of his power.
original_text:
And
his brightness was as the light; he had horns
coming
 out of his hand: and there
was the hiding of his power.

translated_text: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.
original_text: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.

translated_text:
He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways
are everlasting.
original_text:
He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways
are everlasting.

translated_text:
I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction:
and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.
original_text:
I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction:
and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.

translated_text:
Was the LORD displeased against the rivers?
was thine anger against the rivers?
was thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thine horses
and thy chariots of salvation?
original_text:
Was the LORD displeased against the rivers?
was thine anger against the rivers?
was thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thine horses
and thy chariots of salvation?

translated_text:
Thy bow was made quite naked,
according to the oaths of the tribes,
even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.
original_text:
Thy bow was made quite naked,
according to the oaths of the tribes,
even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.

translated_text:
The mountains saw thee,
and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice,
and lifted up his hands on high.
original_text:
The mountains saw thee,
and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice,
and lifted up his hands on high.

translated_text:
The sun
and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went,
and at the shining of thy glittering spear.
original_text:
The sun
and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went,
and at the shining of thy glittering spear.

translated_text: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.
original_text: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.

translated_text:
Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people,
even
 for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.
original_text:
Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people,
even
 for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.

translated_text:
Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing
was as to devour the poor secretly.
original_text:
Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing
was as to devour the poor secretly.

translated_text:
Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses,
through
 the heap of great waters.
original_text:
Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses,
through
 the heap of great waters.

translated_text: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.
original_text: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.

translated_text:
Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither
shall fruit
be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and
there shall be no herd in the stalls:
original_text:
Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither
shall fruit
be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and
there shall be no herd in the stalls:

translated_text: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
original_text: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

translated_text:
The LORD God
is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds’
feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
original_text:
The LORD God
is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds’
feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

translated_text: The word of the LORD which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
original_text: The word of the LORD which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.

translated_text:
I will utterly consume all
things from off the land, saith the LORD.
original_text:
I will utterly consume all
things from off the land, saith the LORD.

translated_text: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumblingblocks with the wicked; and I will cut off man from off the land, saith the LORD.
original_text: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumblingblocks with the wicked; and I will cut off man from off the land, saith the LORD.

translated_text:
I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place,
and the name of the Chemarims with the priests;
original_text:
I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place,
and the name of the Chemarims with the priests;

translated_text:
And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship
and that swear by the LORD, and that swear by Malcham;
original_text:
And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship
and that swear by the LORD, and that swear by Malcham;

translated_text:
And them that are turned back from the LORD; and
those that have not sought the LORD, nor enquired for him.
original_text:
And them that are turned back from the LORD; and
those that have not sought the LORD, nor enquired for him.

translated_text:
Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord GOD: for the day of the LORD
is at hand: for the LORD hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests.
original_text:
Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord GOD: for the day of the LORD
is at hand: for the LORD hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests.

translated_text: And it shall come to pass in the day of the LORD’S sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king’s children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.
original_text: And it shall come to pass in the day of the LORD’S sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king’s children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.

translated_text: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters’ houses with violence and deceit.
original_text: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters’ houses with violence and deceit.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD,
that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and an howling from the second, and a great crashing from the hills.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD,
that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and an howling from the second, and a great crashing from the hills.

translated_text: Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.
original_text: Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.

translated_text:
And it shall come to pass at that time,
that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.
original_text:
And it shall come to pass at that time,
that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.

translated_text:
The great day of the LORD
is near,
it is near, and hasteth greatly,
even the voice of the day of the LORD: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.
original_text:
The great day of the LORD
is near,
it is near, and hasteth greatly,
even the voice of the day of the LORD: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.

translated_text:
That day
is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,
original_text:
That day
is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,

translated_text: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.
original_text: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.

translated_text: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the LORD: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.
original_text: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the LORD: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.

translated_text: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’S wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.
original_text: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’S wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.

translated_text: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;
original_text: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;

translated_text:
Before the decree bring forth,
before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD come upon you, before the day of the LORD’S anger come upon you.
original_text:
Before the decree bring forth,
before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD come upon you, before the day of the LORD’S anger come upon you.

translated_text: Seek ye the LORD, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the LORD’S anger.
original_text: Seek ye the LORD, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the LORD’S anger.

translated_text: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noonday, and Ekron shall be rooted up.
original_text: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noonday, and Ekron shall be rooted up.

translated_text:
Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of the LORD
is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.
original_text:
Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of the LORD
is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.

translated_text:
And the sea coast shall be dwellings
and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.
original_text:
And the sea coast shall be dwellings
and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.

translated_text: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the LORD their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.
original_text: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the LORD their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.

translated_text:
I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified
themselves
 against their border.
original_text:
I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified
themselves
 against their border.

translated_text:
Therefore
as I live, saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah,
even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.
original_text:
Therefore
as I live, saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah,
even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.

translated_text:
This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified
themselves against the people of the LORD of hosts.
original_text:
This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified
themselves against the people of the LORD of hosts.

translated_text:
The LORD
will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and
men shall worship him, every one from his place,
even all the isles of the heathen.
original_text:
The LORD
will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and
men shall worship him, every one from his place,
even all the isles of the heathen.

translated_text:
Ye Ethiopians also, ye
shall be slain by my sword.
original_text:
Ye Ethiopians also, ye
shall be slain by my sword.

translated_text:
And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation,
and dry like a wilderness.
original_text:
And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation,
and dry like a wilderness.

translated_text:
This
is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I
am, and
there is none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss,
and wag his hand.
original_text:
This
is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I
am, and
there is none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss,
and wag his hand.

translated_text: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!
original_text: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!

translated_text: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the LORD; she drew not near to her God.
original_text: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the LORD; she drew not near to her God.

translated_text:
Her princes within her
are roaring lions; her judges
are evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.
original_text:
Her princes within her
are roaring lions; her judges
are evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.

translated_text:
Her prophets
are light
and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.
original_text:
Her prophets
are light
and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.

translated_text:
The just LORD
is in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: every morning doth he bring his judgment to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.
original_text:
The just LORD
is in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: every morning doth he bring his judgment to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.

translated_text: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.
original_text: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.

translated_text:
I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early,
and corrupted all their doings.
original_text:
I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early,
and corrupted all their doings.

translated_text:
Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the LORD, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination
is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation,
even
 all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
original_text:
Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the LORD, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination
is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation,
even
 all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

translated_text: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent.
original_text: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent.

translated_text:
From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants,
even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.
original_text:
From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants,
even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.
